tr.19: Thou wilt see the guilty on that day linked together in chains,
tr.22: And thou wilt see the sinners that day bound together in fetters;-
tr.203: And you will see the Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism, polytheists) that Day Muqarranûn (bound together) in fetters.

14.ar: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
14.en: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire
14.tl: sarābīluhum min qaṭirānin wataghshā wujūhahumu l-nāru

tr.85: in garments of pitch, faces covered in fire.
tr.19: Their raiment of pitch, and the Fire covering their faces,
tr.22: Their garments of liquid pitch, and their faces covered with Fire;
tr.203: Their garments will be of pitch, and fire will cover their faces.

14.ar: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
14.en: So that Allāh will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.
14.tl: liyajziya l-lahu kulla nafsin mā kasabat inna l-laha sarīʿu l-ḥisābi

tr.85: [All will be judged] so that God may reward each soul as it deserves: God is swift in His reckoning.
tr.19: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.
tr.22: That Allah may requite each soul according to its deserts; and verily Allah is swift in calling to account.
tr.203: That Allâh may requite each person according to what he has earned. Truly, Allâh is Swift at reckoning.

14.ar: هَـٰذَا بَلَـٰغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
14.en: This [Qur’ān] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
14.tl: hādhā balāghun lilnnāsi waliyundharū bihi waliyaʿlamū annamā huwa ilāhun wāḥidun waliyadhakkara ulū l-albābi

tr.85: This is a message to all people, so that they may be warned by it, and know that He is the only God, and so that those who have minds may take heed.
tr.19: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One Allah, and that men of understanding may take heed.
tr.22: Here is a Message for mankind: Let them take warning therefrom, and let them know that He is (no other than) One Allah: let men of understanding take heed.
tr.203: This (Qur’an) is a Message for mankind (and a clear proof against them), in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is the only One Ilâh (God - Allâh) - (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) - and that men of understanding may take heed.

15.ar: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
15.en: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
15.tl: alif-lam-ra til'ka āyātu l-kitābi waqur'ānin mubīnin

tr.85: Alif Lam Ra These are the verses of the Scripture, a Quran that makes things clear.
tr.19: Alif. Lam. Ra. These are verses of the Scripture and a plain Reading.
tr.22: A. L. R. These are the Ayats of Revelation,- of a Qur'an that makes things clear.
tr.203: Alif-Lâm-Râ. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings].These are Verses of the Book and a plain Qur’ân.

15.ar: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
15.en: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
15.tl: rubamā yawaddu alladhīna kafarū law kānū mus'limīna

tr.85: The disbelievers may well come to wish they had submitted to God,
tr.19: It may be that those who disbelieve wish ardently that they were Muslims.
tr.22: Again and again will those who disbelieve, wish that they had bowed (to Allah's will) in Islam.
tr.203: How much would those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims [those who have submitted themselves to Allâh’s Will in Islâm i.e. Islâmic Monotheism - this will be on the Day of Resurrection when they will see the disbelievers going to Hell and the Muslims going to Paradise].

15.ar: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
15.en: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
15.tl: dharhum yakulū wayatamattaʿū wayul'hihimu l-amalu fasawfa yaʿlamūna

tr.85: so [Prophet] leave them to eat and enjoy themselves. Let [false] hopes distract them: they will come to know.
tr.19: Let them eat and enjoy life, and let (false) hope beguile them. They will come to know!
tr.22: Leave them alone, to enjoy (the good things of this life) and to please themselves: let (false) hope amuse them: soon will knowledge (undeceive them).
tr.203: Leave them to eat and enjoy, and let them be preoccupied with (false) hope. They will come to know!

15.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
15.en: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
15.tl: wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā walahā kitābun maʿlūmun

tr.85: Never have We destroyed a community that did not have a set time;
tr.19: And We destroyed no township but there was a known decree for it.
tr.22: Never did We destroy a population that had not a term decreed and assigned beforehand.
tr.203: And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it.

15.ar: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
15.en: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
15.tl: mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna

tr.85: no community can bring its time forward, nor delay it.
tr.19: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.
tr.22: Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
tr.203: No nation can advance its term, nor delay it.

15.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
15.en: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
15.tl: waqālū yāayyuhā alladhī nuzzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru innaka lamajnūnun

tr.85: They say, ‘Receiver of this Quran! You are definitely mad.
tr.19: And they say: O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed, lo! thou art indeed a madman!
tr.22: They say: "O thou to whom the Message is being revealed! truly thou art mad (or possessed)!
tr.203: And they say: "O you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to whom the Dhikr (the Qur’ân) has been sent down! Verily, you are a mad man!

15.ar: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
15.en: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
15.tl: law mā tatīnā bil-malāikati in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna

tr.85: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are telling the truth?’
tr.19: Why bringest thou not angels unto us, if thou art of the truthful?
tr.22: "Why bringest thou not angels to us if it be that thou hast the Truth?"
tr.203: "Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful?"

15.ar: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
15.en: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
15.tl: mā nunazzilu l-malāikata illā bil-ḥaqi wamā kānū idhan munẓarīna

tr.85: But We send down the angels only to bring justice and then these people will not be reprieved.
tr.19: We send not down the angels save with the Fact, and in that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated.
tr.22: We send not the angels down except for just cause: if they came (to the ungodly), behold! no respite would they have!
tr.203: We send not the angels down except with the truth (i.e. for torment), and in that case, they (the disbelievers) would have no respite!

15.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
15.en: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
15.tl: innā naḥnu nazzalnā l-dhik'ra wa-innā lahu laḥāfiẓūna

tr.85: We have sent down the Quran Ourself, and We Ourself will guard it. Even before you [Prophet],
tr.19: Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder, and lo! We verily are its Guardian.
tr.22: We have, without doubt, sent down the Message; and We will assuredly guard it (from corruption).
tr.203: Verily, We, it is We Who have sent down the Dhikr (i.e. the Qur’ân) and surely, We will guard it (from corruption).

15.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
15.en: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
15.tl: walaqad arsalnā min qablika fī shiyaʿi l-awalīna

tr.85: We sent messengers among the various communities of old,
tr.19: We verily sent (messengers) before thee among the factions of the men of old.
tr.22: We did send messengers before thee amongst the religious sects of old:
tr.203: Indeed, We sent (Messengers) before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) amongst the sects (communities) of old.

15.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
15.en: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
15.tl: wamā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna

tr.85: but they mocked every single messenger that came to them:
tr.19: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.
tr.22: But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
tr.203: And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock at him.

15.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
15.en: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
15.tl: kadhālika naslukuhu fī qulūbi l-muj'rimīna

tr.85: in this way We make the message slip through the hearts of evildoers.
tr.19: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty:
tr.22: Even so do we let it creep into the hearts of the sinners -
tr.203: Thus do We let it (polytheism and disbelief) enter the hearts of the Mujrimûn [criminals, polytheists and pagans (because of their mocking at the Messengers)].

15.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
15.en: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
15.tl: lā yu'minūna bihi waqad khalat sunnatu l-awalīna

tr.85: They will not believe in it. That was what happened with the peoples of long ago,
tr.19: They believe not therein, though the example of the men of old hath gone before.
tr.22: That they should not believe in the (Message); but the ways of the ancients have passed away.
tr.203: They would not believe in it (the Qur’ân); and already the example of (Allâh’s punishment of) the ancients (who disbelieved) has gone forth.

15.ar: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
15.en: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
15.tl: walaw fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban mina l-samāi faẓallū fīhi yaʿrujūna

tr.85: and even if We opened a gateway into Heaven for them and they rose through it, higher and higher,
tr.19: And even if We opened unto them a gate of heaven and they kept mounting through it,
tr.22: Even if We opened out to them a gate from heaven, and they were to continue (all day) ascending therein,
tr.203: And even if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to keep on ascending thereto (all the day long)

15.ar: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
15.en: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
15.tl: laqālū innamā sukkirat abṣārunā bal naḥnu qawmun masḥūrūna

tr.85: they would still say, ‘Our eyes are hallucinating. We are bewitched.’
tr.19: They would say: Our sight is wrong - nay, but we are folk bewitched.
tr.22: They would only say: "Our eyes have been intoxicated: Nay, we have been bewitched by sorcery."
tr.203: They would surely say (in the evening): "Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled (we have not seen any angel or heaven). Nay, we are a people bewitched."

15.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
15.en: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
15.tl: walaqad jaʿalnā fī l-samāi burūjan wazayyannāhā lilnnāẓirīna

tr.85: We have set constellations up in the sky and made it beautiful for all to see,
tr.19: And verily in the heaven we have set mansions of the stars, and We have beautified it for beholders.
tr.22: It is We Who have set out the zodiacal signs in the heavens, and made them fair-seeming to (all) beholders;
tr.203: And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders.

15.ar: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
15.en: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
15.tl: waḥafiẓ'nāhā min kulli shayṭānin rajīmin

tr.85: and guarded it from every stoned satan:
tr.19: And We have guarded it from every outcast devil,
tr.22: And (moreover) We have guarded them from every cursed devil:
tr.203: And We have guarded it (near heaven) from every outcast Shaitân (devil).

15.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
15.en: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
15.tl: illā mani is'taraqa l-samʿa fa-atbaʿahu shihābun mubīnun

tr.85: any eavesdropper will be pursued by a clearly visible flame.
tr.19: Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue.
tr.22: But any that gains a hearing by stealth, is pursued by a flaming fire, bright (to see).
tr.203: Except him (devil) who steals the hearing then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire.

15.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
15.en: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
15.tl: wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli shayin mawzūnin

tr.85: As for the earth, We have spread it out, set firm mountains on it, and made everything grow there in due balance.
tr.19: And the earth have We spread out, and placed therein firm hills, and caused each seemly thing to grow therein.
tr.22: And the earth We have spread out (like a carpet); set thereon mountains firm and immovable; and produced therein all kinds of things in due balance.
tr.203: And the earth We have spread out, and have placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein all kinds of things in due proportion.

15.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
15.en: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
15.tl: wajaʿalnā lakum fīhā maʿāyisha waman lastum lahu birāziqīna

tr.85: We have provided sustenance in it for you and for all those creatures for whom you do not provide.
tr.19: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.
tr.22: And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
tr.203: And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not [moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals].

15.ar: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
15.en: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
15.tl: wa-in min shayin illā ʿindanā khazāinuhu wamā nunazziluhu illā biqadarin maʿlūmin

tr.85: There is not a thing whose storehouses are not with Us. We send it down only according to a well-defined measure:
tr.19: And there is not a thing but with Us are the stores thereof. And we send it not down save in appointed measure.
tr.22: And there is not a thing but its (sources and) treasures (inexhaustible) are with Us; but We only send down thereof in due and ascertainable measures.
tr.203: And there is not a thing, but with Us are the stores thereof. And We send it not down except in a known measure.

15.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
15.en: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
15.tl: wa-arsalnā l-riyāḥa lawāqiḥa fa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan fa-asqaynākumūhu wamā antum lahu bikhāzinīna

tr.85: We send the winds to fertilize, and We bring down water from the sky for you to drink- you do not control its sources.
tr.19: And We send the winds fertilising, and cause water to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink. It is not ye who are the holders of the store thereof.
tr.22: And We send the fecundating winds, then cause the rain to descend from the sky, therewith providing you with water (in abundance), though ye are not the guardians of its stores.
tr.203: And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then cause the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like].

15.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
15.en: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
15.tl: wa-innā lanaḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wanaḥnu l-wārithūna

tr.85: It is We who give life and death; it is We who inherit [everything].
tr.19: Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken and give death, and We are the Inheritor.
tr.22: And verily, it is We Who give life, and Who give death: it is We Who remain inheritors (after all else passes away).
tr.203: And certainly We! We it is Who give life, and cause death, and We are the Inheritors.

15.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
15.en: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
15.tl: walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'taqdimīna minkum walaqad ʿalim'nā l-mus'takhirīna

tr.85: We know exactly those of you who come first and those who come later.
tr.19: And verily We know the eager among you and verily We know the laggards.
tr.22: To Us are known those of you who hasten forward, and those who lag behind.
tr.203: And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will come afterwards.

15.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
15.en: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
15.tl: wa-inna rabbaka huwa yaḥshuruhum innahu ḥakīmun ʿalīmun

tr.85: [Prophet], it is your Lord who will gather them all together: He is all wise, all knowing.
tr.19: Lo! thy Lord will gather them together. Lo! He is Wise, Aware.
tr.22: Assuredly it is thy Lord Who will gather them together: for He is perfect in Wisdom and Knowledge.
tr.203: And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is All-Wise, All-Knowing.

15.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
15.en: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
15.tl: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin

tr.85: We created man out of dried clay formed from dark mud-
tr.19: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
tr.22: We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
tr.203: And indeed, We created man from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.

15.ar: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
15.en: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
15.tl: wal-jāna khalaqnāhu min qablu min nāri l-samūmi

tr.85: the jinn We created before, from the fire of scorching wind.
tr.19: And the jinn did We create aforetime of essential fire.
tr.22: And the Jinn race, We had created before, from the fire of a scorching wind.
tr.203: And the jinn, We created aforetime from the smokeless flame of fire.

15.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
15.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
15.tl: wa-idh qāla rabbuka lil'malāikati innī khāliqun basharan min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin

tr.85: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a mortal out of dried clay, formed from dark mud.
tr.19: And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered,
tr.22: Behold! thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man, from sounding clay from mud moulded into shape;
tr.203: And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "I am going to create a man (Adam) from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.

15.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
15.en: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
15.tl: fa-idhā sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu fīhi min rūḥī faqaʿū lahu sājidīna

tr.85: When I have fashioned him and breathed My spirit into him, bow down before him,’
tr.19: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
tr.22: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
tr.203: "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."

15.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
15.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
15.tl: fasajada l-malāikatu kulluhum ajmaʿūna

tr.85: and the angels all did so.
tr.19: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them together
tr.22: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
tr.203: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together.

15.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
15.en: Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.
15.tl: illā ib'līsa abā an yakūna maʿa l-sājidīna

tr.85: But not Iblis: he refused to bow down like the others.
tr.19: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.
tr.22: Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
tr.203: Except Iblîs (Satan) - he refused to be among the prostrators.

15.ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
15.en: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
15.tl: qāla yāib'līsu mā laka allā takūna maʿa l-sājidīna

tr.85: God said, ‘Iblis, why did you not bow down like the others?’
tr.19: He said: O Iblis! What aileth thee that thou art not among the prostrate?
tr.22: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! what is your reason for not being among those who prostrated themselves?"
tr.203: (Allâh) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What is your reason for not being among the prostrators?"

15.ar: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
15.en: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
15.tl: qāla lam akun li-asjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min ṣalṣālin min ḥama-in masnūnin

tr.85: and he answered, ‘I will not bow to a mortal You created from dried clay, formed from dark mud.’
tr.19: He said: I am not one to prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered!
tr.22: (Iblis) said: "I am not one to prostrate myself to man, whom Thou didst create from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape."
tr.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "I am not the one to prostrate myself to a human being, whom You created from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud."

15.ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
15.en: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it, for indeed, you are expelled.
15.tl: qāla fa-ukh'ruj min'hā fa-innaka rajīmun

tr.85: ‘Get out of here!’ said God. ‘You are an outcast,
tr.19: He said: Then go thou forth from hence, for lo! thou art outcast.
tr.22: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here; for thou art rejected, accursed.
tr.203: (Allâh) said: "Then, get out from here, for verily, you are Rajîm (an outcast or a cursed one)." [Tafsîr At-Tabarî]

15.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
15.en: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
15.tl: wa-inna ʿalayka l-laʿnata ilā yawmi l-dīni

tr.85: rejected until the Day of Judgement.’
tr.19: And lo! the curse shall be upon thee till the Day of Judgment.
tr.22: "And the curse shall be on thee till the day of Judgment."
tr.203: "And verily, the curse shall be upon you till the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)."

15.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
15.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
15.tl: qāla rabbi fa-anẓir'nī ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna

tr.85: Iblis said, ‘My Lord, give me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead.’
tr.19: He said: My Lord! Reprieve me till the day when they are raised.
tr.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
tr.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected."

15.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
15.en: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
15.tl: qāla fa-innaka mina l-munẓarīna

tr.85: ‘You have respite,’ said God,
tr.19: He said: Then lo! thou art of those reprieved
tr.22: (Allah) said: "Respite is granted thee
tr.203: Allâh said: "Then, verily, you are of those reprieved,

15.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
15.en: Until the Day of the time well-known."
15.tl: ilā yawmi l-waqti l-maʿlūmi

tr.85: ‘until the Day of the Appointed Time.’
tr.19: Till the Day of appointed time.
tr.22: "Till the Day of the Time appointed."
tr.203: "Till the Day of the time appointed."

15.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
15.en: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
15.tl: qāla rabbi bimā aghwaytanī la-uzayyinanna lahum fī l-arḍi wala-ugh'wiyannahum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: Iblis then said to God, ‘Because You have put me in the wrong, I will lure mankind on earth and put them in the wrong,
tr.19: He said: My Lord! Because Thou hast sent me astray, I verily shall adorn the path of error for them in the earth, and shall mislead them every one,
tr.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! because Thou hast put me in the wrong, I will make (wrong) fair-seeming to them on the earth, and I will put them all in the wrong,-
tr.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "O my Lord! Because you misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all.

15.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
15.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
15.tl: illā ʿibādaka min'humu l-mukh'laṣīna

tr.85: all except Your devoted servants.’
tr.19: Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves.
tr.22: "Except Thy servants among them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
tr.203: "Except Your chosen, (guided) slaves among them."

15.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
15.en: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
15.tl: qāla hādhā ṣirāṭun ʿalayya mus'taqīmun

tr.85: God said, ‘[Devotion] is a straight path to Me:
tr.19: He said: This is a right course incumbent upon Me:
tr.22: (Allah) said: "This (way of My sincere servants) is indeed a way that leads straight to Me.
tr.203: (Allâh) said: "This is the Way which will lead straight to Me."

15.ar: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
15.en: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
15.tl: inna ʿibādī laysa laka ʿalayhim sul'ṭānun illā mani ittabaʿaka mina l-ghāwīna

tr.85: you will have no power over My servants, only over the ones who go astray and follow you.
tr.19: Lo! as for My slaves, thou hast no power over any of them save such of the froward as follow thee,
tr.22: "For over My servants no authority shalt thou have, except such as put themselves in the wrong and follow thee."
tr.203: "Certainly, you shall have no authority over My slaves, except those who follow you of the Ghâwûn (Mushrikûn and those who go astray, criminals, polytheists, and evil-doers).

15.ar: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
15.en: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
15.tl: wa-inna jahannama lamawʿiduhum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: Hell is the promised place for all these,
tr.19: And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place.
tr.22: And verily, Hell is the promised abode for them all!
tr.203: "And surely, Hell is the promised place for them all.

15.ar: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
15.en: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
15.tl: lahā sabʿatu abwābin likulli bābin min'hum juz'on maqsūmun

tr.85: with seven gates, each gate having its allotted share of them.
tr.19: It hath seven gates, and each gate hath an appointed portion.
tr.22: To it are seven gates: for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.
tr.203: "It (Hell) has seven gates, for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned.

15.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
15.en: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
15.tl: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin

tr.85: But the righteous will be in Gardens with springs-
tr.19: Lo! those who ward off (evil) are among gardens and watersprings.
tr.22: The righteous (will be) amid gardens and fountains (of clear-flowing water).
tr.203: "Truly! The Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) will be amidst Gardens and water-springs (Paradise).

15.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
15.en: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
15.tl: ud'khulūhā bisalāmin āminīna

tr.85: “Enter them in peace and safety!”––
tr.19: (And it is said unto them): Enter them in peace, secure.
tr.22: (Their greeting will be): "Enter ye here in peace and security."
tr.203: "(It will be said to them): ‘Enter therein (Paradise), in peace and security.’

15.ar: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
15.en: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
15.tl: wanazaʿnā mā fī ṣudūrihim min ghillin ikh'wānan ʿalā sururin mutaqābilīna

tr.85: and We shall remove any bitterness from their hearts: [they will be like] brothers, sitting on couches, face to face.
tr.19: And We remove whatever rancour may be in their breasts. As brethren, face to face, (they rest) on couches raised.
tr.22: And We shall remove from their hearts any lurking sense of injury: (they will be) brothers (joyfully) facing each other on thrones (of dignity).
tr.203: "And We shall remove from their breasts any deep feeling of bitterness (that they may have). (So they will be like) brothers facing each other on thrones.

15.ar: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
15.en: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
15.tl: lā yamassuhum fīhā naṣabun wamā hum min'hā bimukh'rajīna

tr.85: No weariness will ever touch them there, nor will they ever be expelled.’
tr.19: Toil cometh not unto them there, nor will they be expelled from thence.
tr.22: There no sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave.
tr.203: "No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave it."

15.ar: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
15.en: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
15.tl: nabbi ʿibādī annī anā l-ghafūru l-raḥīmu

tr.85: [Prophet], tell My servants that I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
tr.19: Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves that verily I am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
tr.22: Tell My servants that I am indeed the Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful;
tr.203: Declare (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) unto My slaves, that truly, I am the Oft-Forgiving, the Most-Merciful.

15.ar: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
15.en: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
15.tl: wa-anna ʿadhābī huwa l-ʿadhābu l-alīmu

tr.85: but My torment is the truly painful one.
tr.19: And that My doom is the dolorous doom.
tr.22: And that My Penalty will be indeed the most grievous Penalty.
tr.203: And that My Torment is indeed the most painful torment.

15.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
15.en: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
15.tl: wanabbi'hum ʿan ḍayfi ib'rāhīma

tr.85: Tell them too about Abraham’s guests:
tr.19: And tell them of Abraham's guests,
tr.22: Tell them about the guests of Abraham.
tr.203: And tell them about the guests (the angels) of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

15.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
15.en: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
15.tl: idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla innā minkum wajilūna

tr.85: when they came to him and said, ‘Peace,’ he said, ‘We are afraid of you.’
tr.19: (How) when they came in unto him, and said: Peace. He said: Lo! we are afraid of you.
tr.22: When they entered his presence and said, "Peace!" He said, "We feel afraid of you!"
tr.203: When they entered unto him, and said: Salâm (peace)! [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Indeed! We are afraid of you."

15.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
15.en: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
15.tl: qālū lā tawjal innā nubashiruka bighulāmin ʿalīmin

tr.85: ‘Do not be afraid,’ they said, ‘We bring you good news of a son who will have great knowledge.’
tr.19: They said: Be not afraid! Lo! we bring thee good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom.
tr.22: They said: "Fear not! We give thee glad tidings of a son endowed with wisdom."
tr.203: They (the angels) said: "Do not be afraid! We give you glad tidings of a boy (son) possessing much knowledge and wisdom."

15.ar: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
15.en: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
15.tl: qāla abashartumūnī ʿalā an massaniya l-kibaru fabima tubashirūna

tr.85: He said, ‘How can you give me such news when old age has come to me? What sort of news is this?’
tr.19: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?
tr.22: He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news?"
tr.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Do you give me glad tidings (of a son) when old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your news?"

15.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
15.en: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
15.tl: qālū basharnāka bil-ḥaqi falā takun mina l-qāniṭīna

tr.85: They said, ‘We have told you the truth, so do not despair.’
tr.19: They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth. So be not thou of the despairing.
tr.22: They said: "We give thee glad tidings in truth: be not then in despair!"
tr.203: They (the angels) said: "We give you glad tidings in truth. So be not of the despairing."

15.ar: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
15.en: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
15.tl: qāla waman yaqnaṭu min raḥmati rabbihi illā l-ḍālūna

tr.85: He said, ‘Who but the misguided despair of the mercy of their Lord?’
tr.19: He said: And who despaireth of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?
tr.22: He said: "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord, but such as go astray?"
tr.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?"

15.ar: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
15.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
15.tl: qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna

tr.85: and then asked, ‘Messengers, what is your errand?’
tr.19: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?
tr.22: Abraham said: "What then is the business on which ye (have come), O ye messengers (of Allah)?"
tr.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham) again] said: "What then is the business on which you have come, O Messengers?"

15.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
15.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
15.tl: qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna

tr.85: They replied, ‘We have been sent to a people who are guilty.’
tr.19: They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk,
tr.22: They said: "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin,
tr.203: They (the angels) said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners).

15.ar: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
15.en: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
15.tl: illā āla lūṭin innā lamunajjūhum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: But We shall save the household of Lot,
tr.19: (All) save the family of Lot. Them we shall deliver every one,
tr.22: "Excepting the adherents of Lut: them we are certainly (charged) to save (from harm),- All -
tr.203: "(All) except the family of Lût (Lot). Them all we are surely going to save (from destruction).

15.ar: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
15.en: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
15.tl: illā im'ra-atahu qaddarnā innahā lamina l-ghābirīna

tr.85: all except his wife: We have decreed that she will be one of those who stay behind.
tr.19: Except his wife, of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind.
tr.22: "Except his wife, who, We have ascertained, will be among those who will lag behind."
tr.203: "Except his wife, of whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind (i.e. she will be destroyed)."

15.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
15.en: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
15.tl: falammā jāa āla lūṭin l-mur'salūna

tr.85: When the messengers came to the household of Lot,
tr.19: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,
tr.22: At length when the messengers arrived among the adherents of Lut,
tr.203: Then, when the Messengers (the angels) came unto the family of Lût (Lot).

15.ar: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
15.en: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
15.tl: qāla innakum qawmun munkarūna

tr.85: he said, ‘You are strangers.’
tr.19: He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me).
tr.22: He said: "Ye appear to be uncommon folk."
tr.203: He said: "Verily! You are people unknown to me."

15.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
15.en: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
15.tl: qālū bal ji'nāka bimā kānū fīhi yamtarūna

tr.85: They said, ‘We have brought you what they said would never happen:
tr.19: They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing,
tr.22: They said: "Yea, we have come to thee to accomplish that of which they doubt.
tr.203: They said: "Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting.

15.ar: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
15.en: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
15.tl: wa-ataynāka bil-ḥaqi wa-innā laṣādiqūna

tr.85: we have brought you the Truth. We speak truly,
tr.19: And bring thee the Truth, and lo! we are truth-tellers.
tr.22: "We have brought to thee that which is inevitably due, and assuredly we tell the truth.
tr.203: "And we have brought you the truth (the news of the destruction of your nation) and certainly, we tell the truth.

15.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
15.en: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
15.tl: fa-asri bi-ahlika biqiṭ'ʿin mina al-layli wa-ittabiʿ adbārahum walā yaltafit minkum aḥadun wa-im'ḍū ḥaythu tu'marūna

tr.85: so leave in the dead of the night with your household, and walk behind them. Let none of you look back. Go where you are commanded.’
tr.19: So travel with thy household in a portion of the night, and follow thou their backs. Let none of you turn round, but go whither ye are commanded.
tr.22: "Then travel by night with thy household, when a portion of the night (yet remains), and do thou bring up the rear: let no one amongst you look back, but pass on whither ye are ordered."
tr.203: "Then travel in a part of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered."

15.ar: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
15.en: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
15.tl: waqaḍaynā ilayhi dhālika l-amra anna dābira hāulāi maqṭūʿun muṣ'biḥīna

tr.85: We made this decree known to him: the last remnants of those people would be wiped out in the morning.
tr.19: And We made plain the case to him, that the root of them (who did wrong) was to be cut at early morn.
tr.22: And We made known this decree to him, that the last remnants of those (sinners) should be cut off by the morning.
tr.203: And We made known this decree to him, that the root of those (sinners) was to be cut off in the early morning.

15.ar: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
15.en: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
15.tl: wajāa ahlu l-madīnati yastabshirūna

tr.85: The people of the town came along, revelling,
tr.19: And the people of the city came, rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals).
tr.22: The inhabitants of the city came in (mad) joy (at news of the young men).
tr.203: And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing (at the news of the young men’s arrival).

15.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
15.en: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
15.tl: qāla inna hāulāi ḍayfī falā tafḍaḥūni

tr.85: and he told them, ‘These are my guests, do not disgrace me.
tr.19: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!
tr.22: Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not:
tr.203: [Lût (Lot)] said: "Verily! these are my guests, so shame me not.

15.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
15.en: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
15.tl: wa-ittaqū l-laha walā tukh'zūni

tr.85: Fear God, and do not shame me.’
tr.19: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!
tr.22: "But fear Allah, and shame me not."
tr.203: "And fear Allâh and disgrace me not."

15.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
15.en: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
15.tl: qālū awalam nanhaka ʿani l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: They answered, ‘Have we not told you not to interfere [between us and] anyone else?’
tr.19: They said; Have we not forbidden you from (entertaining) anyone?
tr.22: They said: "Did we not forbid thee (to speak) for all and sundry?"
tr.203: They (people of the city) said: "Did we not forbid you from entertaining (or protecting) any of the ‘Âlamîn (people, foreigners and strangers from us)?"

15.ar: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
15.en: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
15.tl: qāla hāulāi banātī in kuntum fāʿilīna

tr.85: He said, ‘My daughters are here, if you must.’
tr.19: He said: Here are my daughters, if ye must be doing (so).
tr.22: He said: "There are my daughters (to marry), if ye must act (so)."
tr.203: [Lût (Lot)] said: "These (the girls of the nation) are my daughters (to marry lawfully), if you must act (so)."

15.ar: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
15.en: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
15.tl: laʿamruka innahum lafī sakratihim yaʿmahūna

tr.85: By your life [Prophet], they wandered on in their wild intoxication
tr.19: By thy life (O Muhammad) they moved blindly in the frenzy of approaching death.
tr.22: Verily, by thy life (O Prophet), in their wild intoxication, they wander in distraction, to and fro.
tr.203: Verily, by your life (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly.

15.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
15.en: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
15.tl: fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu mush'riqīna

tr.85: and the blast overtook them at sunrise:
tr.19: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.
tr.22: But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning,
tr.203: So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them at the time of sunrise.

15.ar: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
15.en: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
15.tl: fajaʿalnā ʿāliyahā sāfilahā wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min sijjīlin

tr.85: We turned their city upside down and rained on them a shower of clay stones.
tr.19: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.
tr.22: And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay.
tr.203: And We turned (the towns of Sodom in Palestine) upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay.

15.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
15.en: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
15.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyātin lil'mutawassimīna

tr.85: There truly is a sign in this for those who can learn-
tr.19: Lo! therein verily are portents for those who read the signs.
tr.22: Behold! in this are Signs for those who by tokens do understand.
tr.203: Surely! In this are signs for those who see (or understand or learn the lessons from the Signs of Allâh).

15.ar: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
15.en: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
15.tl: wa-innahā labisabīlin muqīmin

tr.85: it is still there on the highway-
tr.19: And lo! it is upon a road still uneffaced.
tr.22: And the (cities were) right on the high-road.
tr.203: And verily! They (the cities) were right on the highroad (from Makkah to Syria i.e. the place where the Dead Sea is now).

15.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
15.en: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
15.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyatan lil'mu'minīna

tr.85: there truly is a sign in this for those who believe.
tr.19: Lo! therein is indeed a portent for believers.
tr.22: Behold! in this is a sign for those who believed.
tr.203: Surely! Therein is indeed a sign for the believers.

15.ar: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
15.en: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
15.tl: wa-in kāna aṣḥābu l-aykati laẓālimīna

tr.85: The forest-dwellers, too, were wrongdoers
tr.19: And the dwellers in the wood indeed were evil-doers.
tr.22: And the Companions of the Wood were also wrong-doers;
tr.203: And the Dwellers in the Wood [i.e. the people of Madyan (Midian) to whom Prophet Shu‘aib (عليه السلام) was sent by Allâh), were also Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).

15.ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
15.en: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
15.tl: fa-intaqamnā min'hum wa-innahumā labi-imāmin mubīnin

tr.85: and We took retribution on them; both are still there on the highway, plain for all to see.
tr.19: So we took vengeance on them; and lo! they both are on a high-road plain to see.
tr.22: So We exacted retribution from them. They were both on an open highway, plain to see.
tr.203: So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open highway, plain to see.

15.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
15.en: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
15.tl: walaqad kadhaba aṣḥābu l-ḥij'ri l-mur'salīna

tr.85: The people of al-Hijr also rejected Our messengers:
tr.19: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.
tr.22: The Companions of the Rocky Tract also rejected the messengers:
tr.203: And verily, the dwellers of Al-Hijr (the rocky tract) denied the Messengers.

15.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
15.en: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
15.tl: waātaynāhum āyātinā fakānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna

tr.85: We gave them Our signs, but they turned their backs.
tr.19: And we gave them Our revelations, but they were averse to them.
tr.22: We sent them Our Signs, but they persisted in turning away from them.
tr.203: And We gave them Our Signs, but they were averse to them.

15.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
15.en: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
15.tl: wakānū yanḥitūna mina l-jibāli buyūtan āminīna

tr.85: They carved out dwellings in the mountains, and lived in security-
tr.19: And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills, (wherein they dwelt) secure.
tr.22: Out of the mountains did they hew (their) edifices, (feeling themselves) secure.
tr.203: And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains (feeling themselves) secure.

15.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
15.en: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
15.tl: fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu muṣ'biḥīna

tr.85: the blast overwhelmed them early in the morning.
tr.19: But the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the morning hour,
tr.22: But the (mighty) Blast seized them of a morning,
tr.203: But As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in the early morning (of the fourth day of their promised punishment days).

15.ar: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
15.en: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
15.tl: famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūna

tr.85: What they had gained was of no use to them.
tr.19: And that which they were wont to count as gain availed them not.
tr.22: And of no avail to them was all that they did (with such art and care)!
tr.203: And all that they used to earn availed them not.

15.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
15.en: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
15.tl: wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-inna l-sāʿata laātiyatun fa-iṣ'faḥi l-ṣafḥa l-jamīla

tr.85: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them without a true purpose: the Hour will certainly come, so [Prophet] bear with them graciously.
tr.19: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, (O Muhammad), with a gracious forgiveness.
tr.22: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, but for just ends. And the Hour is surely coming (when this will be manifest). So overlook (any human faults) with gracious forgiveness.
tr.203: And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and the Hour is surely coming, so overlook (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) their faults with gracious forgiveness. [This was before the ordainment of Jihâd - holy fighting in Allâh’s cause].

15.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
15.en: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
15.tl: inna rabbaka huwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu

tr.85: Your Lord is the All Knowing Creator.
tr.19: Lo! Thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator.
tr.22: For verily it is thy Lord who is the Master-Creator, knowing all things.
tr.203: Verily, your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator.

15.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
15.en: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
15.tl: walaqad ātaynāka sabʿan mina l-mathānī wal-qur'āna l-ʿaẓīma

tr.85: We have given you the seven oft-recited versesand the whole glorious Quran.
tr.19: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.
tr.22: And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an.
tr.203: And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al-Mathâni (seven repeatedly recited Verses), (i.e. Sûrat Al-Fâtihah) and the Grand Qur’ân.

15.ar: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
15.en: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
15.tl: lā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājan min'hum walā taḥzan ʿalayhim wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka lil'mu'minīna

tr.85: Do not look longingly at the good things We have given some to enjoy. Do not grieve over the [disbelievers], but lower your wings over the believers
tr.19: Strain not thine eyes toward that which We cause some wedded pairs among them to enjoin, and be not grieved on their account, and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers.
tr.22: Strain not thine eyes. (Wistfully) at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them, nor grieve over them: but lower thy wing (in gentleness) to the believers.
tr.203: Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them (the disbelievers), nor grieve over them. And lower your wings for the believers (be courteous to the fellow-believers).

15.ar: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
15.en: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
15.tl: waqul innī anā l-nadhīru l-mubīnu

tr.85: and say, ‘I am here to give plain warning,’
tr.19: And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner,
tr.22: And say: "I am indeed he that warneth openly and without ambiguity,"-
tr.203: And say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم): "I am indeed a plain warner."

15.ar: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
15.en: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
15.tl: kamā anzalnā ʿalā l-muq'tasimīna

tr.85: like the [warning] We have sent down for those who divide themselves into bands
tr.19: Such as We send down for those who make division,
tr.22: (Of just such wrath) as We sent down on those who divided (Scripture into arbitrary parts),-
tr.203: As We have sent down on the dividers, (Quraish pagans or Jews and Christians).

15.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
15.en: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.
15.tl: alladhīna jaʿalū l-qur'āna ʿiḍīna

tr.85: and abuse the Quran––
tr.19: Those who break the Qur'an into parts.
tr.22: (So also on such) as have made Qur'an into shreds (as they please).
tr.203: Who have made the Qur’ân into parts. (i.e. believed in one part and disbelieved in the other). [Tafsir At-Tabari]

15.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
15.en: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
15.tl: fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: by your Lord, We will question them all
tr.19: Them, by thy Lord, We shall question, every one,
tr.22: Therefore, by the Lord, We will, of a surety, call them to account,
tr.203: So, by your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), We shall certainly call all of them to account.

15.ar: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
15.en: About what they used to do.
15.tl: ʿammā kānū yaʿmalūna

tr.85: about their deeds.
tr.19: Of what they used to do.
tr.22: For all their deeds.
tr.203: For all that they used to do.

15.ar: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
15.en: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
15.tl: fa-iṣ'daʿ bimā tu'maru wa-aʿriḍ ʿani l-mush'rikīna

tr.85: So proclaim openly what you have been commanded [to say], and ignore the idolaters.
tr.19: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.
tr.22: Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah.
tr.203: Therefore proclaim openly (Allâh’s Message - Islâmic Monotheism) that which you are commanded, and turn away from Al-Mushrikûn (polytheists, idolaters, and disbelievers - See V.2:105).

15.ar: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
15.en: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
15.tl: innā kafaynāka l-mus'tahziīna

tr.85: We are enough for you against all those who ridicule your message,
tr.19: Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers,
tr.22: For sufficient are We unto thee against those who scoff,-
tr.203: Truly! We will suffice you against the scoffers,

15.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
15.en: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
15.tl: alladhīna yajʿalūna maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fasawfa yaʿlamūna

tr.85: who set up another god beside God- they will come to know.
tr.19: Who set some other god along with Allah. But they will come to know.
tr.22: Those who adopt, with Allah, another god: but soon will they come to know.
tr.203: Who set up along with Allâh another ilâh (god); but they will come to know.

15.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
15.en: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
15.tl: walaqad naʿlamu annaka yaḍīqu ṣadruka bimā yaqūlūna

tr.85: We are well aware that your heart is weighed down by what they say.
tr.19: Well know We that thy bosom is oppressed by what they say,
tr.22: We do indeed know how thy heart is distressed at what they say.
tr.203: Indeed, We know that your breast is straitened at what they say.

15.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
15.en: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
15.tl: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wakun mina l-sājidīna

tr.85: Celebrate the glory of your Lord and be among those who bow down to Him:
tr.19: But hymn the praise of thy Lord, and be of those who make prostration (unto Him).
tr.22: But celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and be of those who prostrate themselves in adoration.
tr.203: So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him).

15.ar: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
15.en: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
15.tl: wa-uʿ'bud rabbaka ḥattā yatiyaka l-yaqīnu

tr.85: worship your Lord until what is certain comes to you.
tr.19: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
tr.22: And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
tr.203: And worship your Lord until there comes unto you the certainty (i.e. death).

16.ar: أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
16.en: The command of Allāh is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
16.tl: atā amru l-lahi falā tastaʿjilūhu sub'ḥānahu wataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna

tr.85: God’s Judgement is coming, so do not ask to bring it on sooner. Glory be to Him! He is far above anything they join with Him!
tr.19: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).
tr.22: (Inevitable) cometh (to pass) the Command of Allah: seek ye not then to hasten it: Glory to Him, and far is He above having the partners they ascribe unto Him!
tr.203: The Event (the Hour or the punishment of disbelievers and polytheists or the Islâmic laws or commandments) ordained by Allâh will come to pass, so seek not to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate as partners with Him.

16.ar: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
16.en: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration [i.e., revelation] of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
16.tl: yunazzilu l-malāikata bil-rūḥi min amrihi ʿalā man yashāu min ʿibādihi an andhirū annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-ittaqūni

tr.85: He sends down angels with inspiration at His command, to whichever of His servants He chooses, to give [His] warning: ‘There is no god but Me, so beware of Me.’
tr.19: He sendeth down the angels with the Spirit of His command unto whom He will of His bondmen, (saying): Warn mankind that there is no Allah save Me, so keep your duty unto Me.
tr.22: He doth send down His angels with inspiration of His Command, to such of His servants as He pleaseth, (saying): "Warn (Man) that there is no god but I: so do your duty unto Me."
tr.203: He sends down the angels with the Rûh (revelation) of His Command to whom of His slaves He wills (saying): "Warn mankind that Lâ ilâha illâ Ana (none has the right to be worshipped but I), so fear Me (by abstaining from sins and evil deeds).

16.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
16.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
16.tl: khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi taʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna

tr.85: He created the heavens and earth for a true purpose, and He is far above whatever they join with Him!
tr.19: He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth. High be He Exalted above all that they associate (with Him).
tr.22: He has created the heavens and the earth for just ends: Far is He above having the partners they ascribe to Him!
tr.203: He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. High is He, Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him.

16.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
16.en: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once he is a clear adversary.
16.tl: khalaqa l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun

tr.85: He created man from a drop of fluid, and yet man openly challenges Him.
tr.19: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.
tr.22: He has created man from a sperm-drop; and behold this same (man) becomes an open disputer!
tr.203: He has created man from Nutfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge), then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent.

16.ar: وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
16.en: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
16.tl: wal-anʿāma khalaqahā lakum fīhā dif'on wamanāfiʿu wamin'hā takulūna

tr.85: And livestock––He created them too. You derive warmth and other benefits from them: you get food from them;
tr.19: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;
tr.22: And cattle He has created for you (men): from them ye derive warmth, and numerous benefits, and of their (meat) ye eat.
tr.203: And the cattle, He has created them for you; in them there is warmth (warm clothing), and numerous benefits, and of them you eat.

16.ar: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
16.en: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
16.tl: walakum fīhā jamālun ḥīna turīḥūna waḥīna tasraḥūna

tr.85: you find beauty in them when you bring them home to rest and when you drive them out to pasture.
tr.19: And wherein is beauty for you, when ye bring them home, and when ye take them out to pasture.
tr.22: And ye have a sense of pride and beauty in them as ye drive them home in the evening, and as ye lead them forth to pasture in the morning.
tr.203: And wherein is beauty for you, when you bring them home in the evening, and as you lead them forth to pasture in the morning.

16.ar: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَـٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
16.en: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
16.tl: wataḥmilu athqālakum ilā baladin lam takūnū bālighīhi illā bishiqqi l-anfusi inna rabbakum laraūfun raḥīmun

tr.85: They carry your loads to lands you yourselves could not reach without great hardship––truly your Lord is kind and merciful––
tr.19: And they bear your loads for you unto a land ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves. Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity, Merciful.
tr.22: And they carry your heavy loads to lands that ye could not (otherwise) reach except with souls distressed: for your Lord is indeed Most Kind, Most Merciful,
tr.203: And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach except with great trouble to yourselves. Truly, your Lord is full of Kindness, Most Merciful.

16.ar: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
16.en: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
16.tl: wal-khayla wal-bighāla wal-ḥamīra litarkabūhā wazīnatan wayakhluqu mā lā taʿlamūna

tr.85: horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride and use for show, and other things you know nothing about.
tr.19: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.
tr.22: And (He has created) horses, mules, and donkeys, for you to ride and use for show; and He has created (other) things of which ye have no knowledge.
tr.203: And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys, for you to ride and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge.

16.ar: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
16.en: And upon Allāh is the direction of the [right] way, and among them [i.e., the various paths] are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
16.tl: waʿalā l-lahi qaṣdu l-sabīli wamin'hā jāirun walaw shāa lahadākum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: God points out the right path, for some paths lead the wrong way: if He wished, He could guide you all.
tr.19: And Allah's is the direction of the way, and some (roads) go not straight. And had He willed He would have led you all aright.
tr.22: And unto Allah leads straight the Way, but there are ways that turn aside: if Allah had willed, He could have guided all of you.
tr.203: And upon Allâh is the responsibility to explain the Straight Path. But there are ways that turn aside (such as Paganism, Judaism and Christianity). And had He willed, He would have guided you all (mankind).

16.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
16.en: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
16.tl: huwa alladhī anzala mina l-samāi māan lakum min'hu sharābun wamin'hu shajarun fīhi tusīmūna

tr.85: It is He who sends down water for you from the sky, from which comes a drink for you, and the shrubs that you feed to your animals.
tr.19: He it is Who sendeth down water from the sky, whence ye have drink, and whence are trees on which ye send your beasts to pasture.
tr.22: It is He who sends down rain from the sky: from it ye drink, and out of it (grows) the vegetation on which ye feed your cattle.
tr.203: He it is Who sends down water (rain) from the sky; from it you drink and from it (grows) the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture.

16.ar: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَـٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
16.en: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and of all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
16.tl: yunbitu lakum bihi l-zarʿa wal-zaytūna wal-nakhīla wal-aʿnāba wamin kulli l-thamarāti inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yatafakkarūna

tr.85: With it He grows for you grain, olives, palms, vines, and all kinds of other crops. There truly is a sign in this for those who reflect.
tr.19: Therewith He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for people who reflect.
tr.22: With it He produces for you corn, olives, date-palms, grapes and every kind of fruit: verily in this is a sign for those who give thought.
tr.203: With it He causes to grow for you the crops, the olives, the date-palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily! In this is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for people who give thought.

16.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
16.en: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
16.tl: wasakhara lakumu al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara wal-nujūmu musakharātun bi-amrihi inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yaʿqilūna

tr.85: By His command He has made the night and day, the sun, moon, and stars all of benefit to you. There truly are signs in this for those who use their reason.
tr.19: And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you, and the stars are made subservient by His command. Lo! herein indeed are portents for people who have sense.
tr.22: He has made subject to you the Night and the Day; the sun and the moon; and the stars are in subjection by His Command: verily in this are Signs for men who are wise.
tr.203: And He has subjected to you the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His Command. Surely, in this are proofs for people who understand.

16.ar: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
16.en: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
16.tl: wamā dhara-a lakum fī l-arḍi mukh'talifan alwānuhu inna fī dhālika laāyatan liqawmin yadhakkarūna

tr.85: He has made of benefit to you the many-coloured things He has multiplied on the earth. There truly are signs in this for those who take it to heart.
tr.19: And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of divers hues, lo! therein is indeed a portent for people who take heed.
tr.22: And the things on this earth which He has multiplied in varying colours (and qualities): verily in this is a sign for men who celebrate the praises of Allah (in gratitude).
tr.203: And whatsoever He has created for you on the earth of varying colours [and qualities from vegetation and fruits (botanical life) and from animals (zoological life)] Verily! In this is a sign for people who remember.

16.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًا طَرِيًّا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
16.en: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
16.tl: wahuwa alladhī sakhara l-baḥra litakulū min'hu laḥman ṭariyyan watastakhrijū min'hu ḥil'yatan talbasūnahā watarā l-ful'ka mawākhira fīhi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna

tr.85: It is He who made the sea of benefit to you: you eat fresh fish from it and bring out jewellery to wear; you see the ships cutting through its waves so that you may go in search of His bounty and give thanks.
tr.19: And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service that ye eat fresh meat from thence, and bring forth from thence ornaments which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty and that haply ye may give thanks.
tr.22: It is He Who has made the sea subject, that ye may eat thereof flesh that is fresh and tender, and that ye may extract therefrom ornaments to wear; and thou seest the ships therein that plough the waves, that ye may seek (thus) of the bounty of Allah and that ye may be grateful.
tr.203: And He it is Who has subjected the sea (to you), that you eat thereof fresh tender meat (i.e. fish), and that you bring forth out of it ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing through it, that you may seek (thus) of His Bounty (by transporting the goods from place to place) and that you may be grateful.

16.ar: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَـٰرًا وَسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
16.en: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
16.tl: wa-alqā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bikum wa-anhāran wasubulan laʿallakum tahtadūna

tr.85: He has made mountains stand firm on the earth, to prevent it shaking under you, and rivers and paths so that you may find your way,
tr.19: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way.
tr.22: And He has set up on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads; that ye may guide yourselves;
tr.203: And He has affixed into the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads, that you may guide yourselves.

16.ar: وَعَلَـٰمَـٰتٍ ۚ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
16.en: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
16.tl: waʿalāmātin wabil-najmi hum yahtadūna

tr.85: and landmarks and stars to guide people.
tr.19: And landmarks (too), and by the star they find a way.
tr.22: And marks and sign-posts; and by the stars (men) guide themselves.
tr.203: And landmarks (signposts during the day) and by the stars (during the night), they (mankind) guide themselves.

16.ar: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
16.en: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
16.tl: afaman yakhluqu kaman lā yakhluqu afalā tadhakkarūna

tr.85: Can He who creates be compared to one who cannot create? Why do you not take heed?
tr.19: Is He then Who createth as him who createth not? Will ye not then remember?
tr.22: Is then He Who creates like one that creates not? Will ye not receive admonition?
tr.203: Is then He, Who creates as one who creates not? Will you not then remember?

16.ar: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
16.en: And if you should count the favors of Allāh, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
16.tl: wa-in taʿuddū niʿ'mata l-lahi lā tuḥ'ṣūhā inna l-laha laghafūrun raḥīmun

tr.85: If you tried to count God’s blessings, you could never take them all in: He is truly most forgiving and most merciful.
tr.19: And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.22: If ye would count up the favours of Allah, never would ye be able to number them: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And if you would count the favours of Allâh, never could you be able to count them. Truly! Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

16.ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
16.en: And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you declare.
16.tl: wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tusirrūna wamā tuʿ'linūna

tr.85: He knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
tr.19: And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden and that which ye proclaim.
tr.22: And Allah doth know what ye conceal, and what ye reveal.
tr.203: And Allâh knows what you conceal and what you reveal.

16.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
16.en: And those they invoke other than Allāh create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
16.tl: wa-alladhīna yadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lā yakhluqūna shayan wahum yukh'laqūna

tr.85: Those they invoke beside God create nothing; they are themselves created.
tr.19: Those unto whom they cry beside Allah created naught, but are themselves created.
tr.22: Those whom they invoke besides Allah create nothing and are themselves created.
tr.203: Those whom they (Al-Mushrikûn) invoke besides Allâh have not created anything, but are themselves created.

16.ar: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
16.en: They are [in fact] dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
16.tl: amwātun ghayru aḥyāin wamā yashʿurūna ayyāna yub'ʿathūna

tr.85: They are dead, not living. They do not know when they will be raised up.
tr.19: (They are) dead, not living. And they know not when they will be raised.
tr.22: (They are things) dead, lifeless: nor do they know when they will be raised up.
tr.203: (They are) dead, not alive; and they know not when they will be raised up.

16.ar: إِلَـٰهُكُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ وَٰحِدٌ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
16.en: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
16.tl: ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥidun fa-alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati qulūbuhum munkiratun wahum mus'takbirūna

tr.85: Your God is the One God. As for those who deny the life to come, their hearts refuse to admit the truth and they are arrogant.
tr.19: Your Allah is One Allah. But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter their hearts refuse to know, for they are proud.
tr.22: Your Allah is one Allah: as to those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts refuse to know, and they are arrogant.
tr.203: Your Ilâh[2] (God) is One Ilâh (God - Allâh, none has the right to be worshipped but He). But for those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts deny (the faith in the Oneness of Allâh), and they are proud.[3]

16.ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
16.en: Assuredly, Allāh knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
16.tl: lā jarama anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna innahu lā yuḥibbu l-mus'takbirīna

tr.85: There is no doubt that God knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He does not love the arrogant.
tr.19: Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He loveth not the proud.
