tr.19: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
tr.22: "So peace is on me the day I was born, the day that I die, and the day that I shall be raised up to life (again)"!
tr.203: "And Salâm (peace) be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!"

19.ar: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
19.en: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
19.tl: dhālika ʿīsā ub'nu maryama qawla l-ḥaqi alladhī fīhi yamtarūna

tr.85: Such was Jesus, son of Mary. [This is] a statement of the Truth about which they are in doubt:
tr.19: Such was Jesus, son of Mary: (this is) a statement of the truth concerning which they doubt.
tr.22: Such (was) Jesus the son of Mary: (it is) a statement of truth, about which they (vainly) dispute.
tr.203: Such is ‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary). (It is) a statement of truth, about which they doubt (or dispute).

19.ar: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍ ۖ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
19.en: It is not [befitting] for Allāh to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
19.tl: mā kāna lillahi an yattakhidha min waladin sub'ḥānahu idhā qaḍā amran fa-innamā yaqūlu lahu kun fayakūnu

tr.85: it would not befit God to have a child. He is far above that: when He decrees something, He says only, ‘Be,’ and it is.
tr.19: It befitteth not (the Majesty of) Allah that He should take unto Himself a son. Glory be to Him! When He decreeth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
tr.22: It is not befitting to (the majesty of) Allah that He should beget a son. Glory be to Him! when He determines a matter, He only says to it, "Be", and it is.
tr.203: It befits not (the Majesty of) Allâh that He should beget a son [this refers to the slander of Christians against Allâh, by saying that ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is the son of Allâh]. Glorified (and Exalted) be He (above all that they associate with Him). When He decrees a thing, He only says to it: "Be!" - and it is.

19.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
19.en: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
19.tl: wa-inna l-laha rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun

tr.85: ‘God is my Lord and your Lord, so serve Him: that is a straight path.’
tr.19: And lo! Allah is my Lord and your Lord. So serve Him. That is the right path.
tr.22: Verily Allah is my Lord and your Lord: Him therefore serve ye: this is a Way that is straight.
tr.203: [‘Îsâ (Jesus) said]: "And verily Allâh is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him (Alone). That is the Straight Path. (Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism which He did ordain for all of His Prophets)." [Tafsir At-Tabarî]

19.ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
19.en: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
19.tl: fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min mashhadi yawmin ʿaẓīmin

tr.85: But factions have differed among themselves. What suffering will come to those who obscure the truth when a dreadful Day arrives!
tr.19: The sects among them differ: but woe unto the disbelievers from the meeting of an awful Day.
tr.22: But the sects differ among themselves: and woe to the unbelievers because of the (coming) Judgment of a Momentous Day!
tr.203: Then the sects differed [i.e. the Christians about ‘Îsâ (Jesus) عليه السلام], so woe unto the disbelievers [those who gave false witness by saying that ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is the son of Allâh] from the Meeting of a great Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection, when they will be thrown in the blazing Fire).

19.ar: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَـٰكِنِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
19.en: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
19.tl: asmiʿ bihim wa-abṣir yawma yatūnanā lākini l-ẓālimūna l-yawma fī ḍalālin mubīnin

tr.85: How sharp of hearing, how sharp of sight they will be when they come to Us, although now they are clearly off course! Warn them [Muhammad] of the Day of Remorse when the matter will be decided,
tr.19: See and hear them on the Day they come unto Us! yet the evil-doers are to-day in error manifest.
tr.22: How plainly will they see and hear, the Day that they will appear before Us! but the unjust today are in error manifest!
tr.203: How clearly will they (polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) see and hear the Day when they will appear before Us! But the Zalimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) today are in plain error.

19.ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
19.en: And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
19.tl: wa-andhir'hum yawma l-ḥasrati idh quḍiya l-amru wahum fī ghaflatin wahum lā yu'minūna

tr.85: for they are heedless and do not believe.
tr.19: And warn them of the Day of anguish when the case hath been decided. Now they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.
tr.22: But warn them of the Day of Distress, when the matter will be determined: for (behold,) they are negligent and they do not believe!
tr.203: And warn them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of the Day of grief and regrets, when the case has been decided, while (now) they are in a state of carelessness, and they believe not.

19.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
19.en: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
19.tl: innā naḥnu narithu l-arḍa waman ʿalayhā wa-ilaynā yur'jaʿūna

tr.85: It is We who will inherit the earth and all who are on it: they will all be returned to Us.
tr.19: Lo! We, only We, inherit the earth and all who are thereon, and unto Us they are returned.
tr.22: It is We Who will inherit the earth, and all beings thereon: to Us will they all be returned.
tr.203: Verily We will inherit the earth and whatsoever is thereon. And to Us they all shall be returned,

19.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
19.en: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
19.tl: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi ib'rāhīma innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan

tr.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
tr.19: And make mention (O Muhammad) in the Scripture of Abraham. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet.
tr.22: (Also mention in the Book (the story of) Abraham: He was a man of Truth, a prophet.
tr.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Ibrâhîm (Abraham). Verily he was a man of truth, a Prophet.

19.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًٔا
19.en: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
19.tl: idh qāla li-abīhi yāabati lima taʿbudu mā lā yasmaʿu walā yub'ṣiru walā yugh'nī ʿanka shayan

tr.85: He said to his father, ‘Father, why do you worship something that can neither hear nor see nor benefit you in any way?
tr.19: When he said unto his father: O my father! Why worshippest thou that which heareth not nor seeth, nor can in aught avail thee?
tr.22: Behold, he said to his father: "O my father! why worship that which heareth not and seeth not, and can profit thee nothing?
tr.203: When he said to his father: "O my father! Why do you worship that which hears not, sees not and cannot avail you in anything?

19.ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًا سَوِيًّا
19.en: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
19.tl: yāabati innī qad jāanī mina l-ʿil'mi mā lam yatika fa-ittabiʿ'nī ahdika ṣirāṭan sawiyyan

tr.85: Father, knowledge that has not reached you has come to me, so follow me: I will guide you to an even path.
tr.19: O my father! Lo! there hath come unto me of knowledge that which came not unto thee. So follow me, and I will lead thee on a right path.
tr.22: "O my father! to me hath come knowledge which hath not reached thee: so follow me: I will guide thee to a way that is even and straight.
tr.203: "O my father! Verily there has come to me of the knowledge that which came not unto you. So follow me, I will guide you to the Straight Path.

19.ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَصِيًّا
19.en: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
19.tl: yāabati lā taʿbudi l-shayṭāna inna l-shayṭāna kāna lilrraḥmāni ʿaṣiyyan

tr.85: Father, do not worship Satan- Satan has rebelled against the Lord of Mercy.
tr.19: O my father! Serve not the devil. Lo! the devil is a rebel unto the Beneficent.
tr.22: "O my father! serve not Satan: for Satan is a rebel against (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.203: "O my father! Worship not Shaitân (Satan). Verily Shaitân (Satan) has been a rebel against the Most Gracious (Allâh).

19.ar: يَـٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَـٰنِ وَلِيًّا
19.en: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
19.tl: yāabati innī akhāfu an yamassaka ʿadhābun mina l-raḥmāni fatakūna lilshayṭāni waliyyan

tr.85: Father, I fear that a punishment from the Lord of Mercy may afflict you and that you may become Satan’s companion [in Hell].’
tr.19: O my father! Lo! I fear lest a punishment from the Beneficent overtake thee so that thou become a comrade of the devil.
tr.22: "O my father! I fear lest a Penalty afflict thee from (Allah) Most Gracious, so that thou become to Satan a friend."
tr.203: "O my father! Verily I fear lest a torment from the Most Gracious (Allâh) should overtake you, so that you become a companion of Shaitân (Satan) (in the Hell-fire)." [Tafsir Al-Qurtubî]

19.ar: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّا
19.en: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
19.tl: qāla arāghibun anta ʿan ālihatī yāib'rāhīmu la-in lam tantahi la-arjumannaka wa-uh'jur'nī maliyyan

tr.85: His father answered, ‘Abraham, do you reject my gods? I will stone you if you do not stop this. Keep out of my way!’
tr.19: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!
tr.22: (The father) replied: "Dost thou hate my gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will indeed stone thee: Now get away from me for a good long while!"
tr.203: He (the father) said: "Do you reject my gods, O Ibrâhîm (Abraham)? If you stop not (this), I will indeed stone you. So get away from me safely (before I punish you)."

19.ar: قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّا
19.en: [Abraham] said, "Peace [i.e., safety] will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
19.tl: qāla salāmun ʿalayka sa-astaghfiru laka rabbī innahu kāna bī ḥafiyyan

tr.85: Abraham said, ‘Peace be with you: I will beg my Lord to forgive you- He is always gracious to me-
tr.19: He said: Peace be unto thee! I shall ask forgiveness of my Lord for thee. Lo! He was ever gracious unto me.
tr.22: Abraham said: "Peace be on thee: I will pray to my Lord for thy forgiveness: for He is to me Most Gracious.
tr.203: Ibrâhîm (Abraham) said: "Peace be on you! I will ask Forgiveness of my Lord for you. Verily He is unto me Ever Most Gracious.

19.ar: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّا
19.en: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allāh and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy [i.e., disappointed]."
19.tl: wa-aʿtazilukum wamā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi wa-adʿū rabbī ʿasā allā akūna biduʿāi rabbī shaqiyyan

tr.85: but for now I will leave you, and the idols you all pray to, and I will pray to my Lord and trust that my prayer will not be in vain.’
tr.19: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
tr.22: "And I will turn away from you (all) and from those whom ye invoke besides Allah: I will call on my Lord: perhaps, by my prayer to my Lord, I shall be not unblest."
tr.203: "And I shall turn away from you and from those whom you invoke besides Allâh. And I shall call upon my Lord and I hope that I shall not be unblest in my invocation to my Lord."

19.ar: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّا
19.en: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allāh, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
19.tl: falammā iʿ'tazalahum wamā yaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi wahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba wakullan jaʿalnā nabiyyan

tr.85: When he left his people and those they served beside God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob and made them both prophets:
tr.19: So, when he had withdrawn from them and that which they were worshipping beside Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob. Each of them We made a prophet.
tr.22: When he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allah, We bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each one of them We made a prophet.
tr.203: So when he had turned away from them and from those whom they worshipped besides Allâh, We gave him Ishâq (Isaac) and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), and each one of them We made a Prophet.

19.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّا
19.en: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honor.
19.tl: wawahabnā lahum min raḥmatinā wajaʿalnā lahum lisāna ṣid'qin ʿaliyyan

tr.85: We granted Our grace to all of them, and gave them a noble reputation.
tr.19: And we gave them of Our mercy, and assigned to them a high and true renown.
tr.22: And We bestowed of Our Mercy on them, and We granted them lofty honour on the tongue of truth.
tr.203: And We gave them of Our Mercy (a good provision in plenty), and We granted them honour on the tongues (of all the nations, i.e. everybody remembers them with a good praise).

19.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًا وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
19.en: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
19.tl: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi mūsā innahu kāna mukh'laṣan wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan

tr.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Moses. He was specially chosen, a messenger and a prophet:
tr.19: And make mention in the Scripture of Moses. Lo! he was chosen, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
tr.22: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Moses: for he was specially chosen, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
tr.203: And mention in the Book (this Qur’ân) Mûsâ (Moses). Verily he was chosen and he was a Messenger (and) a Prophet.

19.ar: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَـٰهُ نَجِيًّا
19.en: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
19.tl: wanādaynāhu min jānibi l-ṭūri l-aymani waqarrabnāhu najiyyan

tr.85: We called to him from the right-hand side of the mountain and brought him close to Us in secret communion;
tr.19: We called him from the right slope of the Mount, and brought him nigh in communion.
tr.22: And we called him from the right side of Mount (Sinai), and made him draw near to Us, for mystic (converse).
tr.203: And We called him from the right side of the Mount, and made him draw near to Us for a talk with him [Mûsâ (Moses)].

19.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ نَبِيًّا
19.en: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
19.tl: wawahabnā lahu min raḥmatinā akhāhu hārūna nabiyyan

tr.85: out of Our grace We granted him his brother Aaron as a prophet.
tr.19: And We bestowed upon him of Our mercy his brother Aaron, a prophet (likewise).
tr.22: And, out of Our Mercy, We gave him his brother Aaron, (also) a prophet.
tr.203: And We granted him his brother Hârûn (Aaron), (also) a Prophet, out of Our Mercy.

19.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا
19.en: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
19.tl: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi is'māʿīla innahu kāna ṣādiqa l-waʿdi wakāna rasūlan nabiyyan

tr.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Ishmael. He was true to his promise, a messenger and a prophet.
tr.19: And make mention in the Scripture of Ishmael. Lo! he was a keeper of his promise, and he was a messenger (of Allah), a prophet.
tr.22: Also mention in the Book (the story of) Isma'il: He was (strictly) true to what he promised, and he was a messenger (and) a prophet.
tr.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael). Verily he was true to what he promised, and he was a Messenger, (and) a Prophet.

19.ar: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّا
19.en: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
19.tl: wakāna yamuru ahlahu bil-ṣalati wal-zakati wakāna ʿinda rabbihi marḍiyyan

tr.85: He commanded his household to pray and give alms, and his Lord was well pleased with him.
tr.19: He enjoined upon his people worship and almsgiving, and was acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
tr.22: He used to enjoin on his people Prayer and Charity, and he was most acceptable in the sight of his Lord.
tr.203: And he used to enjoin on his family and his people As-Salât (the prayers) and the Zakât and his Lord was pleased with him.

19.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا
19.en: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
19.tl: wa-udh'kur fī l-kitābi id'rīsa innahu kāna ṣiddīqan nabiyyan

tr.85: Mention too, in the Quran, the story of Idris. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
tr.19: And make mention in the Scripture of Idris. Lo! he was a saint, a prophet;
tr.22: Also mention in the Book the case of Idris: He was a man of truth (and sincerity), (and) a prophet:
tr.203: And mention in the Book (the Qur’ân) Idrîs (Enoch).Verily he was a man of truth, (and) a Prophet.

19.ar: وَرَفَعْنَـٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
19.en: And We raised him to a high station.
19.tl: warafaʿnāhu makānan ʿaliyyan

tr.85: We raised him to a high position.
tr.19: And We raised him to high station.
tr.22: And We raised him to a lofty station.
tr.203: And We raised him to a high station.

19.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَبُكِيًّا ۩
19.en: Those were the ones upon whom Allāh bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
19.tl: ulāika alladhīna anʿama l-lahu ʿalayhim mina l-nabiyīna min dhurriyyati ādama wamimman ḥamalnā maʿa nūḥin wamin dhurriyyati ib'rāhīma wa-is'rāīla wamimman hadaynā wa-ij'tabaynā idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātu l-raḥmāni kharrū sujjadan wabukiyyan

tr.85: These were the prophets God blessed- from the seed of Adam, of those We carried in the Ark with Noah, from the seed of Abraham and Israel- and those We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Lord of Mercy were recited to them, they fell to their knees and wept,
tr.19: These are they unto whom Allah showed favour from among the prophets, of the seed of Adam and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Noah, and of the seed of Abraham and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the revelations of the Beneficent were recited unto them, they fell down, adoring and weeping.
tr.22: Those were some of the prophets on whom Allah did bestow His Grace,- of the posterity of Adam, and of those who We carried (in the Ark) with Noah, and of the posterity of Abraham and Israel of those whom We guided and chose. Whenever the Signs of (Allah) Most Gracious were rehearsed to them, they would fall down in prostrate adoration and in tears.
tr.203: Those were they unto whom Allâh bestowed His Grace from among the Prophets, of the offspring of Adam, and of those whom We carried (in the ship) with Nûh (Noah), and of the offspring of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Israel, and from among those whom We guided and chose. When the Verses of the Most Gracious (Allâh) were recited unto them, they fell down prostrate and weeping.

19.ar: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
19.en: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
19.tl: fakhalafa min baʿdihim khalfun aḍāʿū l-ṣalata wa-ittabaʿū l-shahawāti fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan

tr.85: but there came after them generations who neglected prayer and were driven by their own desires. These will come face to face with their evil,
tr.19: Now there hath succeeded them a later generation whom have ruined worship and have followed lusts. But they will meet deception.
tr.22: But after them there followed a posterity who missed prayers and followed after lusts soon, then, will they face Destruction,-
tr.203: Then, there has succeeded them a posterity who have given up As-Salât (the prayers) [i.e. made their Salât (prayers) to be lost, either by not offering them or by not offering them perfectly or by not offering them in their proper fixed times] and have followed lusts. So they will be thrown in Hell.

19.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًٔا
19.en: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
19.tl: illā man tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan fa-ulāika yadkhulūna l-janata walā yuẓ'lamūna shayan

tr.85: but those who repent, who believe, who do righteous deeds, will enter Paradise. They will not be wronged in the least:
tr.19: Save him who shall repent and believe and do right. Such will enter the Garden, and they will not be wronged in aught -
tr.22: Except those who repent and believe, and work righteousness: for these will enter the Garden and will not be wronged in the least,-
tr.203: Except those who repent and believe (in the Oneness of Allâh and His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and work righteousness. Such will enter Paradise and they will not be wronged in aught.

19.ar: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّا
19.en: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been eminent.
19.tl: jannāti ʿadnin allatī waʿada l-raḥmānu ʿibādahu bil-ghaybi innahu kāna waʿduhu matiyyan

tr.85: they will enter the Gardens of Lasting Bliss, promised by the Lord of Mercy to His servants- it is not yet seen but truly His promise will be fulfilled.
tr.19: Gardens of Eden, which the Beneficent hath promised to His slaves in the unseen. Lo! His promise is ever sure of fulfilment -
tr.22: Gardens of Eternity, those which (Allah) Most Gracious has promised to His servants in the Unseen: for His promise must (necessarily) come to pass.
tr.203: (They will enter) ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), which the Most Gracious (Allâh) has promised to His slaves in the Unseen: Verily His Promise must come to pass.

19.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَـٰمًا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا
19.en: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
19.tl: lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan illā salāman walahum riz'quhum fīhā buk'ratan waʿashiyyan

tr.85: There they will hear only peaceful talk, nothing bad; there they will be given provision morning and evening.
tr.19: They hear therein no idle talk, but only Peace; and therein they have food for morn and evening.
tr.22: They will not there hear any vain discourse, but only salutations of Peace: And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and evening.
tr.203: They shall not hear therein (in Paradise) any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk), but only Salâm (salutations of peace). And they will have therein their sustenance, morning and afternoon. [See (V.40:55)].

19.ar: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّا
19.en: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allāh.
19.tl: til'ka l-janatu allatī nūrithu min ʿibādinā man kāna taqiyyan

tr.85: That is the Garden We shall give as their own to those of Our servants who were devout.
tr.19: Such is the Garden which We cause the devout among Our bondmen to inherit.
tr.22: Such is the Garden which We give as an inheritance to those of Our servants who guard against Evil.
tr.203: Such is the Paradise which We shall give as an inheritance to those of Our slaves who have been Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

19.ar: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّا
19.en: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
19.tl: wamā natanazzalu illā bi-amri rabbika lahu mā bayna aydīnā wamā khalfanā wamā bayna dhālika wamā kāna rabbuka nasiyyan

tr.85: [Gabriel said],‘We only descend [with revelation] at your Lord’s command––everything before us, everything behind us, everything in between, all belongs to Him––your Lord is never forgetful.
tr.19: We (angels) come not down save by commandment of thy Lord. Unto Him belongeth all that is before us and all that is behind us and all that is between those two, and thy Lord was never forgetful -
tr.22: (The angels say:) "We descend not but by command of thy Lord: to Him belongeth what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between: and thy Lord never doth forget,-
tr.203: And we (angels) descend not except by the Command of your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). To Him belongs what is before us and what is behind us, and what is between those two; and your Lord is never forgetful -

19.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَـٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّا
19.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
19.tl: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā fa-uʿ'bud'hu wa-iṣ'ṭabir liʿibādatihi hal taʿlamu lahu samiyyan

tr.85: He is Lord of the heavens and earth and everything in between so worship Him: be steadfast in worshipping Him. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?’
tr.19: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them! Therefor, worship thou Him and be thou steadfast in His service. Knowest thou one that can be named along with Him?
tr.22: "Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that is between them; so worship Him, and be constant and patient in His worship: knowest thou of any who is worthy of the same Name as He?"
tr.203: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, so worship Him (Alone) and be constant and patient in His worship. Do you know of any who is similar to Him? (of course none is similar or co-equal or comparable to Him, and He has none as partner with Him). [There is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer].

19.ar: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
19.en: And man [i.e., the disbeliever] says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
19.tl: wayaqūlu l-insānu a-idhā mā mittu lasawfa ukh'raju ḥayyan

tr.85: Man says, ‘What? Once I am dead, will I be brought back to life?’
tr.19: And man saith: When I am dead, shall I forsooth be brought forth alive?
tr.22: Man says: "What! When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"
tr.203: And man (the disbeliever) says: "When I am dead, shall I then be raised up alive?"

19.ar: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًٔا
19.en: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
19.tl: awalā yadhkuru l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min qablu walam yaku shayan

tr.85: but does man not remember that We created him when he was nothing before?
tr.19: Doth not man remember that We created him before, when he was naught?
tr.22: But does not man call to mind that We created him before out of nothing?
tr.203: Does not man remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?

19.ar: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّا
19.en: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
19.tl: fawarabbika lanaḥshurannahum wal-shayāṭīna thumma lanuḥ'ḍirannahum ḥawla jahannama jithiyyan

tr.85: By your Lord [Prophet] We shall gather them and the devils together and set them on their knees around Hell;
tr.19: And, by thy Lord, verily We shall assemble them and the devils, then We shall bring them, crouching, around hell.
tr.22: So, by thy Lord, without doubt, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Evil Ones (with them); then shall We bring them forth on their knees round about Hell;
tr.203: So by your Lord, surely, We shall gather them together, and (also) the Shayâtîn (devils) (with them), then We shall bring them round Hell on their knees.

19.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عِتِيًّا
19.en: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
19.tl: thumma lananziʿanna min kulli shīʿatin ayyuhum ashaddu ʿalā l-raḥmāni ʿitiyyan

tr.85: We shall seize out of each group those who were most disobedient towards the Lord of Mercy-
tr.19: Then We shall pluck out from every sect whichever of them was most stubborn in rebellion to the Beneficent.
tr.22: Then shall We certainly drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.203: Then indeed We shall drag out from every sect all those who were worst in obstinate rebellion against the Most Gracious (Allâh).

19.ar: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّا
19.en: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
19.tl: thumma lanaḥnu aʿlamu bi-alladhīna hum awlā bihā ṣiliyyan

tr.85: We know best who most deserves to burn in Hell-
tr.19: And surely We are Best Aware of those most worthy to be burned therein.
tr.22: And certainly We know best those who are most worthy of being burned therein.
tr.203: Then, verily, We know best those who are most worthy of being burnt therein.

19.ar: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًا مَّقْضِيًّا
19.en: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
19.tl: wa-in minkum illā wāriduhā kāna ʿalā rabbika ḥatman maqḍiyyan

tr.85: but every single one of you will approach it, a decree from your Lord which must be fulfilled.
tr.19: There is not one of you but shall approach it. That is a fixed ordinance of thy Lord.
tr.22: Not one of you but will pass over it: this is, with thy Lord, a Decree which must be accomplished.
tr.203: There is not one of you but will pass over it (Hell): this is with your Lord; a Decree which must be accomplished.

19.ar: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّا
19.en: Then We will save those who feared Allāh and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
19.tl: thumma nunajjī alladhīna ittaqaw wanadharu l-ẓālimīna fīhā jithiyyan

tr.85: We shall save the devout and leave the evildoers there on their knees.
tr.19: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
tr.22: But We shall save those who guarded against evil, and We shall leave the wrong-doers therein, (humbled) to their knees.
tr.203: Then We shall save those who used to fear Allâh and were dutiful to Him. And We shall leave the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrongdoers) therein (humbled) to their knees (in Hell).

19.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌ مَّقَامًا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّا
19.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
19.tl: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū ayyu l-farīqayni khayrun maqāman wa-aḥsanu nadiyyan

tr.85: When Our revelations are recited to them in all their clarity, [all that] the disbelievers say to the believers [is], ‘Which side is better situated? Which side has the better following?’
tr.19: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Which of the two parties (yours or ours) is better in position, and more imposing as an army?
tr.22: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, the Unbelievers say to those who believe, "Which of the two sides is best in point of position? Which makes the best show in council?"
tr.203: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, those who disbelieve (the rich and strong among the pagans of Quraish who live a life of luxury) say to those who believe (the weak, poor companions of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم who have a hard life): "Which of the two groups (i.e. believers or disbelievers) is best in (point of) position and as regards station (place of council for consultation)."

19.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَـٰثًا وَرِءْيًا
19.en: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
19.tl: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum aḥsanu athāthan wari'yan

tr.85: We have destroyed many a generation before them who surpassed them in riches and outward glitter!
tr.19: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who were more imposing in respect of gear and outward seeming!
tr.22: But how many (countless) generations before them have we destroyed, who were even better in equipment and in glitter to the eye?
tr.203: And how many a generation (past nations) have We destroyed before them, who were better in wealth, goods and outward appearance?

19.ar: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَـٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًا
19.en: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
19.tl: qul man kāna fī l-ḍalālati falyamdud lahu l-raḥmānu maddan ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna immā l-ʿadhāba wa-immā l-sāʿata fasayaʿlamūna man huwa sharrun makānan wa-aḍʿafu jundan

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘The Lord of Mercy lengthens [the lives] of the misguided, until, when they are confronted with what they have been warned about- either the punishment [in this life] or the Hour [of Judgement]- they realize who is worse situated and who has the weakest forces.’
tr.19: Say: As for him who is in error, the Beneficent will verily prolong his span of life until, when they behold that which they were promised, whether it be punishment (in the world), or the Hour (of doom), they will know who is worse in position and who is weaker as an army.
tr.22: Say: "If any men go astray, (Allah) Most Gracious extends (the rope) to them, until, when they see the warning of Allah (being fulfilled) - either in punishment or in (the approach of) the Hour,- they will at length realise who is worst in position, and (who) weakest in forces!
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) whoever is in error, the Most Gracious (Allâh) will extend (the rope) to him, until, when they see that which they were promised, either the torment or the Hour, they will come to know who is worst in position, and who is weaker in forces. [This is the answer to the question in Verse No.19:73]

19.ar: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًى ۗ وَٱلْبَـٰقِيَـٰتُ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًا وَخَيْرٌ مَّرَدًّا
19.en: And Allāh increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
19.tl: wayazīdu l-lahu alladhīna ih'tadaw hudan wal-bāqiyātu l-ṣāliḥātu khayrun ʿinda rabbika thawāban wakhayrun maraddan

tr.85: But God gives more guidance to those who are guided, and good deeds of lasting merit are best and most rewarding in your Lord’s sight.
tr.19: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
tr.22: "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
tr.203: And Allâh increases in guidance those who walk aright. And the righteous good deeds that last, are better with your Lord, for reward and better for resort.

19.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًا وَوَلَدًا
19.en: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]"?
19.tl: afara-ayta alladhī kafara biāyātinā waqāla laūtayanna mālan wawaladan

tr.85: Have you considered the man who rejects Our revelation, who says, ‘I will certainly be given wealth and children’?
tr.19: Hast thou seen him who disbelieveth in Our revelations and saith: Assuredly I shall be given wealth and children?
tr.22: Hast thou then seen the (sort of) man who rejects Our Signs, yet says: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children?"
tr.203: Have you seen him who disbelieved in Our Ayât (this Qur’ân and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and said: "I shall certainly be given wealth and children [if I will be alive (again)]."

19.ar: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
19.en: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
19.tl: aṭṭalaʿa l-ghayba ami ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan

tr.85: Has he penetrated the unknown or received a pledge to that effect from the Lord of Mercy?
tr.19: Hath he perused the Unseen, or hath he made a pact with the Beneficent?
tr.22: Has he penetrated to the Unseen, or has he taken a contract with (Allah) Most Gracious?
tr.203: Has he known the Unseen or has he taken a covenant from the Most Gracious (Allâh)?

19.ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّا
19.en: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
19.tl: kallā sanaktubu mā yaqūlu wanamuddu lahu mina l-ʿadhābi maddan

tr.85: No! We shall certainly record what he says and prolong his punishment:
tr.19: Nay, but We shall record that which he saith and prolong for him a span of torment.
tr.22: Nay! We shall record what he says, and We shall add and add to his punishment.
tr.203: Nay, We shall record what he says, and We shall increase his torment (in the Hell);

19.ar: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًا
19.en: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
19.tl: wanarithuhu mā yaqūlu wayatīnā fardan

tr.85: We shall inherit from him all that he speaks of and he will come to Us all alone.
tr.19: And We shall inherit from him that whereof he spake, and he will come unto Us, alone (without his wealth and children).
tr.22: To Us shall return all that he talks of and he shall appear before Us bare and alone.
tr.203: And We shall inherit from him (at his death) all that he talks of (i.e. wealth and children which We have bestowed upon him in this world), and he shall come to Us alone.

19.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّا
19.en: And they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
19.tl: wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan liyakūnū lahum ʿizzan

tr.85: They have taken other gods beside God to give them strength,
tr.19: And they have chosen (other) gods beside Allah that they may be a power for them.
tr.22: And they have taken (for worship) gods other than Allah, to give them power and glory!
tr.203: And they have taken (for worship) âlihah (gods) besides Allâh, that they might give them honour, power and glory (and also protect them from Allâh’s punishment).

19.ar: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
19.en: No! They [i.e., those "gods"] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
19.tl: kallā sayakfurūna biʿibādatihim wayakūnūna ʿalayhim ḍiddan

tr.85: but these gods will reject their worship and will even turn against them.
tr.19: Nay, but they will deny their worship of them, and become opponents unto them.
tr.22: Instead, they shall reject their worship, and become adversaries against them.
tr.203: Nay, but they (the so-called gods) will deny their worship of them, and become opponents to them (on the Day of Resurrection).

19.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّا
19.en: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
19.tl: alam tara annā arsalnā l-shayāṭīna ʿalā l-kāfirīna ta-uzzuhum azzan

tr.85: Have you [Prophet] not seen how We send devils to incite the disbelievers to sin?
tr.19: Seest thou not that We have set the devils on the disbelievers to confound them with confusion?
tr.22: Seest thou not that We have set the Evil Ones on against the unbelievers, to incite them with fury?
tr.203: See you not that We have sent the Shayâtîn (devils) against the disbelievers to push them to do evil.

19.ar: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّا
19.en: So be not impatient over them. We only count out [i.e., allow] to them a [limited] number.
19.tl: falā taʿjal ʿalayhim innamā naʿuddu lahum ʿaddan

tr.85: There is no need for you to be impatient concerning them: We are counting down their [allotted] time.
tr.19: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
tr.22: So make no haste against them, for We but count out to them a (limited) number (of days).
tr.203: So make no haste against them; We only count out to them a (limited) number (of the days of the life of this world and delay their term so that they may increase in evil and sins).

19.ar: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَفْدًا
19.en: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
19.tl: yawma naḥshuru l-mutaqīna ilā l-raḥmāni wafdan

tr.85: On the Day We gather the righteous as an honoured company before the Lord of Mercy
tr.19: On the day when We shall gather the righteous unto the Beneficent, a goodly company.
tr.22: The day We shall gather the righteous to (Allah) Most Gracious, like a band presented before a king for honours,
tr.203: The Day We shall gather the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) unto the Most Gracious (Allâh), like a delegation (presented before a king for honour).

19.ar: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًا
19.en: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
19.tl: wanasūqu l-muj'rimīna ilā jahannama wir'dan

tr.85: and drive the sinful like a thirsty herd into Hell,
tr.19: And drive the guilty unto hell, a weary herd,
tr.22: And We shall drive the sinners to Hell, like thirsty cattle driven down to water,-
tr.203: And We shall drive the Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) to Hell, in a thirsty state (like a thirsty herd driven down to water).

19.ar: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَهْدًا
19.en: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
19.tl: lā yamlikūna l-shafāʿata illā mani ittakhadha ʿinda l-raḥmāni ʿahdan

tr.85: no one will have power to intercede except for those who have permission from the Lord of Mercy.
tr.19: They will have no power of intercession, save him who hath made a covenant with his Lord.
tr.22: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.203: None shall have the power of intercession, but such a one as has received permission (or promise) from the Most Gracious (Allâh).

19.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا
19.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
19.tl: waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan

tr.85: The disbelievers say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has offspring.’
tr.19: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son.
tr.22: They say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten a son!"
tr.203: And they say: "The Most Gracious (Allâh) has begotten a son (or offspring or children) [as the Jews say: ‘Uzair (Ezra) is the son of Allâh, and the Christians say that He has begotten a son [‘Îsâ (Jesus) عليه السلام], and the pagan Arabs say that He has begotten daughters (angels and others.)]."

19.ar: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّا
19.en: You have done an atrocious thing.
19.tl: laqad ji'tum shayan iddan

tr.85: How terrible is this thing you assert:
tr.19: Assuredly ye utter a disastrous thing
tr.22: Indeed ye have put forth a thing most monstrous!
tr.203: Indeed you have brought forth (said) a terrible evil thing.

19.ar: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
19.en: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
19.tl: takādu l-samāwātu yatafaṭṭarna min'hu watanshaqqu l-arḍu watakhirru l-jibālu haddan

tr.85: it almost causes the heavens to be torn apart, the earth to split asunder, the mountains to crumble to pieces,
tr.19: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
tr.22: At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
tr.203: Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains fall in ruins,

19.ar: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدًا
19.en: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
19.tl: an daʿaw lilrraḥmāni waladan

tr.85: that they attribute offspring to the Lord of Mercy.
tr.19: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son,
tr.22: That they should invoke a son for (Allah) Most Gracious.
tr.203: That they ascribe a son (or offspring or children) to the Most Gracious (Allâh).

19.ar: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
19.en: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
19.tl: wamā yanbaghī lilrraḥmāni an yattakhidha waladan

tr.85: It does not befit the Lord of Mercy [to have offspring]:
tr.19: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son.
tr.22: For it is not consonant with the majesty of (Allah) Most Gracious that He should beget a son.
tr.203: But it is not suitable for (the Majesty of) the Most Gracious (Allâh) that He should beget a son (or offspring or children).

19.ar: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ عَبْدًا
19.en: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
19.tl: in kullu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi illā ātī l-raḥmāni ʿabdan

tr.85: there is no one in the heavens or earth who will not come to the Lord of Mercy as a servant-
tr.19: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
tr.22: Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
tr.203: There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Gracious (Allâh) as a slave.

19.ar: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّا
19.en: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
19.tl: laqad aḥṣāhum waʿaddahum ʿaddan

tr.85: He has counted them all: He has numbered them exactly-
tr.19: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
tr.22: He does take an account of them (all), and hath numbered them (all) exactly.
tr.203: Verily He knows each one of them, and has counted them a full counting.

19.ar: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
19.en: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
19.tl: wakulluhum ātīhi yawma l-qiyāmati fardan

tr.85: and they will each return to Him on the Day of Resurrection all alone.
tr.19: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone.
tr.22: And everyone of them will come to Him singly on the Day of Judgment.
tr.203: And everyone of them will come to Him alone on the Day of Resurrection (without any helper, or protector or defender).

19.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وُدًّا
19.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
19.tl: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sayajʿalu lahumu l-raḥmānu wuddan

tr.85: But the Lord of Mercy will give love to those who believe and do righteous deeds:
tr.19: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
tr.22: On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
tr.203: Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh and in His Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)] and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Gracious (Allâh) will bestow love for them (in the hearts of the believers).

19.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًا لُّدًّا
19.en: So, [O Muḥammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
19.tl: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika litubashira bihi l-mutaqīna watundhira bihi qawman luddan

tr.85: We have made it easy, in your own language [Prophet], so that you may bring glad news to the righteous and warnings to a stubborn people.
tr.19: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk.
tr.22: So have We made the (Qur'an) easy in thine own tongue, that with it thou mayest give Glad Tidings to the righteous, and warnings to people given to contention.
tr.203: So We have made this (the Qur’ân) easy in your own tongue (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), only that you may give glad tidings to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2), and warn with it the Ludd (most quarrelsome) people.

19.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
19.en: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
19.tl: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hal tuḥissu min'hum min aḥadin aw tasmaʿu lahum rik'zan

tr.85: How many generations We have destroyed before them! Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
tr.19: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound?
tr.22: But how many (countless) generations before them have We destroyed? Canst thou find a single one of them (now) or hear (so much as) a whisper of them?
tr.203: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them?

20.ar: طه
20.en: Ṭā, Hā.
20.tl: tta-ha

tr.85: Ta Ha
tr.19: Ta. Ha.
tr.22: Ta-Ha.
tr.203: Tâ-Hâ.

20.ar: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
20.en: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed
20.tl: mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashqā

tr.85: It was not to distress you [Prophet] that We sent down the Quran to you,
tr.19: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed,
tr.22: We have not sent down the Qur'an to thee to be (an occasion) for thy distress,
tr.203: We have not sent down the Qur’ân unto you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to cause you distress,

20.ar: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
20.en: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allāh] -
20.tl: illā tadhkiratan liman yakhshā

tr.85: but as a reminder for those who hold God in awe,
tr.19: But as a reminder unto him who feareth,
tr.22: But only as an admonition to those who fear (Allah),-
tr.203: But only as a Reminder to those who fear (Allâh).

20.ar: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
20.en: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
20.tl: tanzīlan mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wal-samāwāti l-ʿulā

tr.85: a revelation from the One who created the earth and the high heaven,
tr.19: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens,
tr.22: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the heavens on high.
tr.203: A revelation from Him (Allâh) Who has created the earth and high heavens.

20.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
20.en: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
20.tl: al-raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi is'tawā

tr.85: the Lord of Mercy, established on the throne.
tr.19: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne.
tr.22: (Allah) Most Gracious is firmly established on the throne (of authority).
tr.203: The Most Gracious (Allâh) rose over (Istawâ) the (Mighty) Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty).

20.ar: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
20.en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
20.tl: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta l-tharā

tr.85: Everything in the heavens and on earth, everything between them, everything beneath the soil, belongs to Him.
tr.19: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod.
tr.22: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and on earth, and all between them, and all beneath the soil.
tr.203: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and all that is between them, and all that is under the soil.

20.ar: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
20.en: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
20.tl: wa-in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu l-sira wa-akhfā

tr.85: Whatever you may say aloud, He knows what you keep secret and what is even more hidden.
tr.19: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.
tr.22: If thou pronounce the word aloud, (it is no matter): for verily He knoweth what is secret and what is yet more hidden.
tr.203: And if you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) speak (the invocation) aloud, then verily, He knows the secret and that which is yet more hidden.

20.ar: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
20.en: Allāh - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
20.tl: al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā

tr.85: God––there is no god but Him––the most excellent names belong to Him.
tr.19: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names.
tr.22: Allah! there is no god but He! To Him belong the most Beautiful Names.
tr.203: Allâh! Lâ ilâha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He)! To Him belong the Best Names.

20.ar: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
20.en: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
20.tl: wahal atāka ḥadīthu mūsā

tr.85: Has the story of Moses come to you [Prophet]?
tr.19: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses?
tr.22: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
tr.203: And has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)?

20.ar: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
20.en: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
20.tl: idh raā nāran faqāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum min'hā biqabasin aw ajidu ʿalā l-nāri hudan

tr.85: He saw a fire and said to his people, ‘Stay here––I can see a fire. Maybe I can bring you a flaming brand from it or find some guidance there.’
tr.19: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire.
tr.22: Behold, he saw a fire: So he said to his family, "Tarry ye; I perceive a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."
tr.203: When he saw a fire, he said to his family: "Wait! Verily, I have seen a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."

20.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ
20.en: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
20.tl: falammā atāhā nūdiya yāmūsā

tr.85: When he came to the fire, he was summoned, ‘Moses!
tr.19: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses!
tr.22: But when he came to the fire, a voice was heard: "O Moses!
tr.203: And when he came to it (the fire), he was called by name: "O Mûsâ (Moses)!

20.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
20.en: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the blessed valley of Ṭuwā.
20.tl: innī anā rabbuka fa-ikh'laʿ naʿlayka innaka bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwan

tr.85: I am your Lord. Take off your shoes: you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
tr.19: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa.
tr.22: "Verily I am thy Lord! therefore (in My presence) put off thy shoes: thou art in the sacred valley Tuwa.
tr.203: "Verily I am your Lord! So take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley, Tuwa.

20.ar: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
20.en: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
20.tl: wa-anā ikh'tartuka fa-is'tamiʿ limā yūḥā

tr.85: I have chosen you, so listen to what is being revealed.
tr.19: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired.
tr.22: "I have chosen thee: listen, then, to the inspiration (sent to thee).
tr.203: "And I have chosen you. So listen to that which will be revealed (to you).

20.ar: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
20.en: Indeed, I am Allāh. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
20.tl: innanī anā l-lahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'bud'nī wa-aqimi l-ṣalata lidhik'rī

tr.85: I am God; there is no god but Me. So worship Me and keep up the prayer so that you remember Me.
tr.19: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance.
tr.22: "Verily, I am Allah: There is no god but I: So serve thou Me (only), and establish regular prayer for celebrating My praise.
tr.203: "Verily! I am Allâh! Lâ ilâha illa Ana (none has the right to be worshipped but I), so worship Me, and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) for My Remembrance.

20.ar: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
20.en: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
20.tl: inna l-sāʿata ātiyatun akādu ukh'fīhā lituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿā

tr.85: The Hour is coming––though I choose to keep it hidden––for each soul to be rewarded for its labour.
tr.19: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve).
tr.22: "Verily the Hour is coming - My design is to keep it hidden - for every soul to receive its reward by the measure of its Endeavour.
tr.203: "Verily, the Hour is coming - and I am almost hiding it from Myself - that every person may be rewarded for that which he strives.

20.ar: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
20.en: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
20.tl: falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā man lā yu'minu bihā wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu fatardā

tr.85: Do not let anyone who does not believe in it and follows his own desires distract you from it, and so bring you to ruin.’
tr.19: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
tr.22: "Therefore let not such as believe not therein but follow their own lusts, divert thee therefrom, lest thou perish!"..
tr.203: "Therefore, let not the one who believes not therein (i.e. in the Day of Resurrection, Reckoning, Paradise and Hell.), but follows his own lusts, divert you therefrom, lest you perish.

20.ar: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
20.en: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
20.tl: wamā til'ka biyamīnika yāmūsā

tr.85: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’
tr.19: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?
tr.22: "And what is that in the right hand, O Moses?"
tr.203: "And what is that in your right hand, O Mûsâ (Moses)?"

20.ar: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
20.en: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
20.tl: qāla hiya ʿaṣāya atawakka-u ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamī waliya fīhā maāribu ukh'rā

tr.85: ‘It is my staff,’ he said, ‘I lean on it; restrain my sheep with it; I also have other uses for it.’
tr.19: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses.
tr.22: He said, "It is my rod: on it I lean; with it I beat down fodder for my flocks; and in it I find other uses."
tr.203: He said: "This is my stick, whereon I lean, and wherewith I beat down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses."

20.ar: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
20.en: [Allāh] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
20.tl: qāla alqihā yāmūsā

tr.85: God said, ‘Throw it down, Moses.’
tr.19: He said: Cast it down, O Moses!
tr.22: (Allah) said, "Throw it, O Moses!"
tr.203: (Allâh) said: "Cast it down, O Mûsâ (Moses)!"

20.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
20.en: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
20.tl: fa-alqāhā fa-idhā hiya ḥayyatun tasʿā

tr.85: He threw it down and- lo and behold!- it became a fast-moving snake.
tr.19: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding.
tr.22: He threw it, and behold! It was a snake, active in motion.
tr.203: He cast it down, and behold! It was a snake, moving quickly.

20.ar: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
20.en: [Allāh] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
20.tl: qāla khudh'hā walā takhaf sanuʿīduhā sīratahā l-ūlā

tr.85: He said, ‘Pick it up without fear: We shall turn it back into its former state.
tr.19: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state.
tr.22: (Allah) said, "Seize it, and fear not: We shall return it at once to its former condition"..
tr.203: Allâh said: "Grasp it and fear not; We shall return it to its former state,

20.ar: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
20.en: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
20.tl: wa-uḍ'mum yadaka ilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin āyatan ukh'rā

tr.85: Now place your hand under your armpit and it will come out white, though unharmed: that is another sign.
tr.19: And thrust thy hand within thine armpit, it will come forth white without hurt. (That will be) another token.
tr.22: "Now draw thy hand close to thy side: It shall come forth white (and shining), without harm (or stain),- as another Sign,-
tr.203: "And press your (right) hand to your (left) side: it will come forth white (and shining), without any disease as another sign,

20.ar: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
20.en: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
20.tl: linuriyaka min āyātinā l-kub'rā

tr.85: We do this to show you some of Our greatest signs.
tr.19: That We may show thee (some) of Our greater portents,
tr.22: "In order that We may show thee (two) of our Greater Signs.
tr.203: "That We may show you (some) of Our Greater Signs.

20.ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
20.en: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized]."
20.tl: idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭaghā

tr.85: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly become a tyrant.’
tr.19: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
tr.22: "Go thou to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds."
tr.203: "Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)! Verily, he has transgressed (all bounds in disbelief and disobedience, and has behaved as an arrogant and as a tyrant)."

20.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
20.en: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance]
20.tl: qāla rabbi ish'raḥ lī ṣadrī

tr.85: Moses said, ‘Lord, lift up my heart
tr.19: (Moses) said: My Lord! relieve my mind
tr.22: (Moses) said: "O my Lord! expand me my breast;
tr.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "O my Lord! Open for me my chest (grant me self-confidence, contentment, and boldness).

20.ar: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
20.en: And ease for me my task
20.tl: wayassir lī amrī

tr.85: and ease my task for me.
tr.19: And ease my task for me;
tr.22: "Ease my task for me;
tr.203: "And ease my task for me;

20.ar: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
20.en: And untie the knot from my tongue
20.tl: wa-uḥ'lul ʿuq'datan min lisānī

tr.85: Untie my tongue,
tr.19: And loose a knot from my tongue,
tr.22: "And remove the impediment from my speech,
tr.203: "And loose the knot (the defect) from my tongue, (i.e. remove the incorrectness from my speech) [That occurred as a result of a brand of fire which Mûsâ (Moses) put in his mouth when he was an infant]. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).

20.ar: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
20.en: That they may understand my speech.
20.tl: yafqahū qawlī

tr.85: so that they may understand my words,
tr.19: That they may understand my saying.
tr.22: "So they may understand what I say:
tr.203: "That they understand my speech.

20.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
20.en: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -
20.tl: wa-ij'ʿal lī wazīran min ahlī

tr.85: and give me a helper from my family,
tr.19: Appoint for me a henchman from my folk,
tr.22: "And give me a Minister from my family,
tr.203: "And appoint for me a helper from my family,

20.ar: هَـٰرُونَ أَخِى
20.en: Aaron, my brother.
20.tl: hārūna akhī

tr.85: my brother Aaron-
tr.19: Aaron, my brother.
tr.22: "Aaron, my brother;
tr.203: "Hârûn (Aaron), my brother.

20.ar: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
20.en: Increase through him my strength
20.tl: ush'dud bihi azrī

tr.85: augment my strength through him.
tr.19: Confirm my strength with him
tr.22: "Add to my strength through him,
tr.203: "Increase my strength with him,

20.ar: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
20.en: And let him share my task
20.tl: wa-ashrik'hu fī amrī

tr.85: Let him share my task
tr.19: And let him share my task,
tr.22: "And make him share my task:
tr.203: "And let him share my task (of conveying Allâh’s Message and Prophethood),

20.ar: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
20.en: That we may exalt You much
20.tl: kay nusabbiḥaka kathīran

tr.85: so that we can glorify You much
tr.19: That we may glorify Thee much
tr.22: "That we may celebrate Thy praise without stint,
tr.203: "That we may glorify You much,

20.ar: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
20.en: And remember You much.
20.tl: wanadhkuraka kathīran

tr.85: and remember You often:
tr.19: And much remember Thee.
tr.22: "And remember Thee without stint:
tr.203: "And remember You much,

20.ar: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
20.en: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
20.tl: innaka kunta binā baṣīran

tr.85: You are always watching over us.’
tr.19: Lo! Thou art ever Seeing us.
tr.22: "For Thou art He that (ever) regardeth us."
tr.203: "Verily You are Ever a Well-Seer of us."

20.ar: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
20.en: [Allāh] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
20.tl: qāla qad ūtīta su'laka yāmūsā

tr.85: God said, ‘Moses, your request is granted.
tr.19: He said: Thou art granted thy request, O Moses.
tr.22: (Allah) said: "Granted is thy prayer, O Moses!"
tr.203: (Allâh) said: "You are granted your request, O Mûsâ (Moses)!

20.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
20.en: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
20.tl: walaqad manannā ʿalayka marratan ukh'rā

tr.85: Indeed We showed you favour before.
tr.19: And indeed, another time, already We have shown thee favour,
tr.22: "And indeed We conferred a favour on thee another time (before).
tr.203: "And indeed We conferred a favour on you another time (before).

20.ar: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
20.en: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
20.tl: idh awḥaynā ilā ummika mā yūḥā

tr.85: We inspired your mother, saying,
tr.19: When we inspired in thy mother that which is inspired,
tr.22: "Behold! We sent to thy mother, by inspiration, the message:
tr.203: "When We inspired your mother with that which We inspired.

20.ar: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
20.en: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye [i.e., observation and care].
20.tl: ani iq'dhifīhi fī l-tābūti fa-iq'dhifīhi fī l-yami falyul'qihi l-yamu bil-sāḥili yakhudh'hu ʿaduwwun lī waʿaduwwun lahu wa-alqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbatan minnī walituṣ'naʿa ʿalā ʿaynī

tr.85: “Put your child into the chest, then place him in the river. Let the river wash him on to its bank, and he will be taken in by an enemy of Mine and his.” I showered you with My love and planned that you should be reared under My watchful eye.
tr.19: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will,
tr.22: "'Throw (the child) into the chest, and throw (the chest) into the river: the river will cast him up on the bank, and he will be taken up by one who is an enemy to Me and an enemy to him': But I cast (the garment of) love over thee from Me: and (this) in order that thou mayest be reared under Mine eye.
tr.203: "Saying: ‘Put him (the child) into the Tabût (a box or a case or a chest) and put it into the river (Nile); then the river shall cast it up on the bank, and there, an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his shall take him.’ And I endued you with love from Me, in order that you may be brought up under My Eye.

20.ar: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَـٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَـٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّـٰكَ فُتُونًا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
20.en: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
20.tl: idh tamshī ukh'tuka fataqūlu hal adullukum ʿalā man yakfuluhu farajaʿnāka ilā ummika kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina l-ghami wafatannāka futūnan falabith'ta sinīna fī ahli madyana thumma ji'ta ʿalā qadarin yāmūsā

tr.85: Your sister went out, saying, “I will tell you someone who will nurse him,” then We returned you to your mother so that she could rejoice and not grieve. Later you killed a man, but We saved you from distress and tried you with other tests. You stayed among the people of Midian for years, then you came here as I ordained.
tr.19: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,
tr.22: "Behold! thy sister goeth forth and saith, 'shall I show you one who will nurse and rear the (child)?' So We brought thee back to thy mother, that her eye might be cooled and she should not grieve. Then thou didst slay a man, but We saved thee from trouble, and We tried thee in various ways. Then didst thou tarry a number of years with the people of Midian. Then didst thou come hither as ordained, O Moses!
tr.203: "When your sister went and said: ‘Shall I show you one who will nurse him?’ So We restored you to your mother, that she might cool her eyes and she should not grieve. Then you did kill a man, but We saved you from great distress and tried you with a heavy trial. Then you stayed a number of years with the people of Madyan (Midian). Then you came here according to the fixed term which I ordained (for you), O Mûsâ (Moses)!

20.ar: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
20.en: And I produced you for Myself.
20.tl: wa-iṣ'ṭanaʿtuka linafsī

tr.85: I have chosen you for Myself.
tr.19: And I have attached thee to Myself.
tr.22: "And I have prepared thee for Myself (for service)"..
tr.203: "And I have chosen you, for Myself.

20.ar: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
20.en: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
20.tl: idh'hab anta wa-akhūka biāyātī walā taniyā fī dhik'rī

tr.85: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and make sure that you remember Me.
tr.19: Go, thou and thy brother, with My tokens, and be not faint in remembrance of Me.
tr.22: "Go, thou and thy brother, with My Signs, and slacken not, either of you, in keeping Me in remembrance.
tr.203: "Go you and your brother with My Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and do not, you both, slacken and become weak in My Remembrance.

20.ar: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
20.en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
20.tl: idh'habā ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭaghā

tr.85: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds.
tr.19: Go, both of you, unto Pharaoh. Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).
tr.22: "Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has indeed transgressed all bounds;
tr.203: "Go, both of you, to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), verily, he has transgressed (all bounds in disbelief and disobedience and behaved as an arrogant and as a tyrant).

20.ar: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
20.en: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allāh]."
20.tl: faqūlā lahu qawlan layyinan laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhshā

tr.85: Speak to him gently so that he may take heed, or show respect.’
tr.19: And speak unto him a gentle word, that peradventure he may heed or fear.
tr.22: "But speak to him mildly; perchance he may take warning or fear (Allah)."
tr.203: "And speak to him mildly, perhaps he may accept admonition or fear (Allâh)."

20.ar: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
20.en: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
20.tl: qālā rabbanā innanā nakhāfu an yafruṭa ʿalaynā aw an yaṭghā

tr.85: They said, ‘Lord, we fear he will do us great harm or exceed all bounds.’
tr.19: They said: Our Lord! Lo! we fear that he may be beforehand with us or that he may play the tyrant.
tr.22: They (Moses and Aaron) said: "Our Lord! We fear lest he hasten with insolence against us, or lest he transgress all bounds."
tr.203: They said: "Our Lord! Verily we fear lest he should hasten to punish us or lest he should transgress (all bounds against us)."

20.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
20.en: [Allāh] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
20.tl: qāla lā takhāfā innanī maʿakumā asmaʿu wa-arā

tr.85: He said, ‘Do not be afraid, I am with you both, hearing and seeing everything.
tr.19: He said: Fear not. Lo! I am with you twain, Hearing and Seeing.
tr.22: He said: "Fear not: for I am with you: I hear and see (everything).
tr.203: He (Allâh) said: "Fear not, verily I am with you both, hearing and seeing.

20.ar: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
