tr.22: They say: "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has not a Clear Sign come to them of all that was in the former Books of revelation?
tr.203: They say: "Why does he not bring us a sign (proof) from his Lord?" Has there not come to them the proof of that which is (written) in the former papers [Scriptures, i.e. the Taurât (Torah), and the Injeel (Gospel), about the coming of the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]?

20.ar: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَـٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
20.en: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
20.tl: walaw annā ahlaknāhum biʿadhābin min qablihi laqālū rabbanā lawlā arsalta ilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli an nadhilla wanakhzā

tr.85: If We had destroyed them through punishment before this Messenger came, they would have said, ‘Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we could have followed Your revelations before we suffered humiliation and disgrace!’
tr.19: And if we had destroyed them with some punishment before it, they would assuredly have said: Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent unto us a messenger, so that we might have followed Thy revelations before we were (thus) humbled and disgraced!
tr.22: And if We had inflicted on them a penalty before this, they would have said: "Our Lord! If only Thou hadst sent us a messenger, we should certainly have followed Thy Signs before we were humbled and put to shame."
tr.203: And if We had destroyed them with a torment before this (i.e. Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân), they would surely have said: "Our Lord! If only You had sent us a Messenger, we should certainly have followed Your Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), before we were humiliated and disgraced."

20.ar: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
20.en: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
20.tl: qul kullun mutarabbiṣun fatarabbaṣū fasataʿlamūna man aṣḥābu l-ṣirāṭi l-sawiyi wamani ih'tadā

tr.85: [Prophet], say, ‘We are all waiting, so you carry on waiting: you will come to learn who has followed the even path, and been rightly guided.’
tr.19: Say: Each is awaiting; so await ye! Ye will come to know who are the owners of the path of equity, and who is right.
tr.22: Say: "Each one (of us) is waiting: wait ye, therefore, and soon shall ye know who it is that is on the straight and even way, and who it is that has received Guidance."
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Each one (believer and disbeliever.) is waiting, so wait you too; and you shall know who are they that are on the Straight and Even Path (i.e. Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism), and who are they that have let themselves be guided (on the Right Path).

21.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
21.en: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
21.tl: iq'taraba lilnnāsi ḥisābuhum wahum fī ghaflatin muʿ'riḍūna

tr.85: Ever closer to people draws their reckoning, while they turn away, heedless.
tr.19: Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness.
tr.22: Closer and closer to mankind comes their Reckoning: yet they heed not and they turn away.
tr.203: Draws near for mankind their reckoning, while they turn away in heedlessness.

21.ar: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
21.en: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
21.tl: mā yatīhim min dhik'rin min rabbihim muḥ'dathin illā is'tamaʿūhu wahum yalʿabūna

tr.85: Whenever any fresh revelation comes to them from their Lord, they listen to it playfully
tr.19: Never cometh there unto them a new reminder from their Lord but they listen to it while they play,
tr.22: Never comes (aught) to them of a renewed Message from their Lord, but they listen to it as in jest,-
tr.203: Comes not unto them an admonition (a chapter of the Qur’ân) from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play

21.ar: لَاهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
21.en: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
21.tl: lāhiyatan qulūbuhum wa-asarrū l-najwā alladhīna ẓalamū hal hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum afatatūna l-siḥ'ra wa-antum tub'ṣirūna

tr.85: with frivolous hearts. The evildoers conferred in secret: ‘Is this man anything but a mortal like yourselves? Are you going to fall under his spell with your eyes wide open?’
tr.19: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)?
tr.22: Their hearts toying as with trifles. The wrong-doers conceal their private counsels, (saying), "Is this (one) more than a man like yourselves? Will ye go to witchcraft with your eyes open?"
tr.203: With their hearts occupied (with evil things). Those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): "Is this (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?"

21.ar: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
21.en: He [the Prophet (ﷺ)] said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
21.tl: qāla rabbī yaʿlamu l-qawla fī l-samāi wal-arḍi wahuwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu

tr.85: He said, ‘My Lord knows everything that is said in the heavens and the earth: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.’
tr.19: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
tr.22: Say: "My Lord knoweth (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth: He is the One that heareth and knoweth (all things)."
tr.203: He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) said: "My Lord knows (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower."

21.ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَـٰثُ أَحْلَـٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
21.en: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
21.tl: bal qālū aḍghāthu aḥlāmin bali if'tarāhu bal huwa shāʿirun falyatinā biāyatin kamā ur'sila l-awalūna

tr.85: Some say, ‘Muddled dreams’; others, ‘He made it up’; yet others, ‘He is just a poet, let him show us a sign as previous messengers did.’
tr.19: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents).
tr.22: "Nay," they say, "(these are) medleys of dream! - Nay, He forged it! - Nay, He is (but) a poet! Let him then bring us a Sign like the ones that were sent to (Prophets) of old!"
tr.203: Nay, they say: "These (revelations of the Qur’ân which are revealed to Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented them! - Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Ayâh (sign as a proof) like the ones (Prophets) the former were sent (with)!"

21.ar: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
21.en: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
21.tl: mā āmanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknāhā afahum yu'minūna

tr.85: But of the communities We destroyed before them not a single one believed. Will these now believe?
tr.19: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe?
tr.22: (As to those) before them, not one of the populations which We destroyed believed: will these believe?
tr.203: Not one of the towns (populations), of those which We destroyed, believed before them (though We sent them signs): will they then believe?

21.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
21.en: And We sent not before you, [O Muḥammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
21.tl: wamā arsalnā qablaka illā rijālan nūḥī ilayhim fasalū ahla l-dhik'ri in kuntum lā taʿlamūna

tr.85: And even before your time [Prophet], all the messengers We sent were only men We inspired–– if you [disbelievers] do not know, ask people who know the Scripture––
tr.19: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not?
tr.22: Before thee, also, the messengers We sent were but men, to whom We granted inspiration: If ye realise this not, ask of those who possess the Message.
tr.203: And We sent not before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) but men to whom We revealed. So ask the people of the Reminder [Scriptures - the Taurât (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel)] if you do not know.

21.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ جَسَدًا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَـٰلِدِينَ
21.en: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
21.tl: wamā jaʿalnāhum jasadan lā yakulūna l-ṭaʿāma wamā kānū khālidīna

tr.85: We did not give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
tr.19: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals.
tr.22: Nor did We give them bodies that ate no food, nor were they exempt from death.
tr.203: And We did not create them (the Messengers, with) bodies that ate not food, nor were they immortals.

21.ar: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
21.en: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
21.tl: thumma ṣadaqnāhumu l-waʿda fa-anjaynāhum waman nashāu wa-ahlaknā l-mus'rifīna

tr.85: We fulfilled Our promise to them in the end: We saved them and those We wished to save, and We destroyed those who exceeded all bounds.
tr.19: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals.
tr.22: In the end We fulfilled to them Our Promise, and We saved them and those whom We pleased, but We destroyed those who transgressed beyond bounds.
tr.203: Then We fulfilled to them the promise. So We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifûn (i.e. disbelievers in Allah, in His Messengers, extravagants, transgressors of Allâh’s limits by committing crimes, oppressions, polytheism and sins).

21.ar: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَـٰبًا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
21.en: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
21.tl: laqad anzalnā ilaykum kitāban fīhi dhik'rukum afalā taʿqilūna

tr.85: And now We have sent down to you [people] a Scripture to remind you. Will you not use your reason?
tr.19: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense?
tr.22: We have revealed for you (O men!) a book in which is a Message for you: will ye not then understand?
tr.203: Indeed, We have sent down for you (O mankind) a Book (the Qur’ân) in which there is Dhikrukum,(your Reminder or an honour for you i.e. honour for the one who follows the teaching of the Qur’ân and acts on its teachings). Will you not then understand?

21.ar: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
21.en: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
21.tl: wakam qaṣamnā min qaryatin kānat ẓālimatan wa-anshanā baʿdahā qawman ākharīna

tr.85: How many communities of evildoers We have destroyed! How many others We have raised up in their places!
tr.19: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk!
tr.22: How many were the populations We utterly destroyed because of their iniquities, setting up in their places other peoples?
tr.203: How many a town (community) given to wrong-doing, have We destroyed, and raised up after them another people!

21.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
21.en: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
21.tl: falammā aḥassū basanā idhā hum min'hā yarkuḍūna

tr.85: When they felt Our might coming upon them, see how they tried to escape it!
tr.19: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it!
tr.22: Yet, when they felt Our Punishment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.
tr.203: Then, when they perceived (saw) Our Torment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it.

21.ar: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَـٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
21.en: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
21.tl: lā tarkuḍū wa-ir'jiʿū ilā mā ut'rif'tum fīhi wamasākinikum laʿallakum tus'alūna

tr.85: ‘Do not try to escape. Go back to your homes and the pleasure you revelled in: you may be questioned.’
tr.19: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned.
tr.22: Flee not, but return to the good things of this life which were given you, and to your homes in order that ye may be called to account.
tr.203: Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned.

21.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
21.en: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
21.tl: qālū yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīna

tr.85: They said, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
tr.19: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers.
tr.22: They said: "Ah! woe to us! We were indeed wrong-doers!"
tr.203: They cried: "Woe to us! Certainly we have been Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)."

21.ar: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَـٰمِدِينَ
21.en: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
21.tl: famā zālat til'ka daʿwāhum ḥattā jaʿalnāhum ḥaṣīdan khāmidīna

tr.85: and that cry of theirs did not cease until We made them burnt-offstubble.
tr.19: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct.
tr.22: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is mown, as ashes silent and quenched.
tr.203: And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is reaped, extinct (dead).

21.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
21.en: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
21.tl: wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna

tr.85: We did not create the heavens and the earth and everything between them playfully.
tr.19: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play.
tr.22: Not for (idle) sport did We create the heavens and the earth and all that is between!
tr.203: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them for a (mere) play.

21.ar: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
21.en: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
21.tl: law aradnā an nattakhidha lahwan la-ittakhadhnāhu min ladunnā in kunnā fāʿilīna

tr.85: If We had wished for a pastime, We could have found it within Us- if We had wished for any such thing.
tr.19: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did.
tr.22: If it had been Our wish to take (just) a pastime, We should surely have taken it from the things nearest to Us, if We would do (such a thing)!
tr.203: Had We intended to take a pastime (i.e. a wife or a son), We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that).

21.ar: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَـٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
21.en: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
21.tl: bal naqdhifu bil-ḥaqi ʿalā l-bāṭili fayadmaghuhu fa-idhā huwa zāhiqun walakumu l-waylu mimmā taṣifūna

tr.85: No! We hurl the truth against falsehood, and truth obliterates it- see how falsehood vanishes away! Woe to you [people] for the way you describe God!
tr.19: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
tr.22: Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us).
tr.203: Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Qur’ân) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Allâh by uttering that Allâh has a wife and a son).

21.ar: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
21.en: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
21.tl: walahu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi waman ʿindahu lā yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatihi walā yastaḥsirūna

tr.85: Everyone in the heavens and earth belongs to Him, and those that are with Him are never too proud to worship Him, nor do they grow weary;
tr.19: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary;
tr.22: To Him belong all (creatures) in the heavens and on earth: Even those who are in His (very) Presence are not too proud to serve Him, nor are they (ever) weary (of His service):
tr.203: To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and on earth. And those who are near Him (i.e. the angels) are not too proud to worship Him, nor are they weary (of His worship).

21.ar: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
21.en: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
21.tl: yusabbiḥūna al-layla wal-nahāra lā yafturūna

tr.85: they glorify Him tirelessly night and day.
tr.19: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not.
tr.22: They celebrate His praises night and day, nor do they ever flag or intermit.
tr.203: They (i.e. the angels) glorify His Praises night and day, (and) they never slacken (to do so).

21.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
21.en: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
21.tl: ami ittakhadhū ālihatan mina l-arḍi hum yunshirūna

tr.85: Have they chosen any gods from the earth who can give life to the dead?
tr.19: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead?
tr.22: Or have they taken (for worship) gods from the earth who can raise (the dead)?
tr.203: Or have they taken (for worship) âlihah (gods) from the earth who raise the dead?

21.ar: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
21.en: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides Allāh, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allāh, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
21.tl: law kāna fīhimā ālihatun illā l-lahu lafasadatā fasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna

tr.85: If there had been in the heavens or earth any gods but Him, both heavens and earth would be in ruins: God, Lord of the Throne, is far above the things they say:
tr.19: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him).
tr.22: If there were, in the heavens and the earth, other gods besides Allah, there would have been confusion in both! but glory to Allah, the Lord of the Throne: (High is He) above what they attribute to Him!
tr.203: Had there been therein (in the heavens and the earth) âlihah (gods) besides Allâh, then verily both would have been ruined. Glorified be Allâh, the Lord of the Throne, (High is He) above all that (evil) they associate with Him!

21.ar: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
21.en: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
21.tl: lā yus'alu ʿammā yafʿalu wahum yus'alūna

tr.85: He cannot be called to account for anything He does, whereas they will be called to account.
tr.19: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.
tr.22: He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs).
tr.203: He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned.

21.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَـٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
21.en: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muḥammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
21.tl: ami ittakhadhū min dūnihi ālihatan qul hātū bur'hānakum hādhā dhik'ru man maʿiya wadhik'ru man qablī bal aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūna l-ḥaqa fahum muʿ'riḍūna

tr.85: Have they chosen to worship other gods instead of Him? Say, ‘Bring your proof. This is the Scripture for those who are with me and the Scripture for those who went before me.’ But most of them do not recognize the truth, so they pay no heed.
tr.19: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse.
tr.22: Or have they taken for worship (other) gods besides him? Say, "Bring your convincing proof: this is the Message of those with me and the Message of those before me." But most of them know not the Truth, and so turn away.
tr.203: Or have they taken for worship (other) âlihah (gods) besides Him? Say: "Bring your proof." This (the Qur’ân) is the Reminder for those with me and the Reminder for those before me. But most of them know not the Truth, so they are averse.

21.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
21.en: And We sent not before you any messenger except We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
21.tl: wamā arsalnā min qablika min rasūlin illā nūḥī ilayhi annahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'budūni

tr.85: We never sent any messenger before you [Muhammad] without revealing to him: ‘There is no god but Me, so serve Me.’
tr.19: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me.
tr.22: Not a messenger did We send before thee without this inspiration sent by Us to him: that there is no god but I; therefore worship and serve Me.
tr.203: And We did not send any Messenger before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) but We revealed to him (saying): Lâ ilâha illa Ana [none has the right to be worshipped but I (Allâh)], so worship Me (Alone and none else)."

21.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَدًا ۗ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
21.en: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
21.tl: waqālū ittakhadha l-raḥmānu waladan sub'ḥānahu bal ʿibādun muk'ramūna

tr.85: And they say, ‘The Lord of Mercy has taken offspring for Himself.’ May He be exalted! No! They are only His honoured servants:
tr.19: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves;
tr.22: And they say: "(Allah) Most Gracious has begotten offspring." Glory to Him! they are (but) servants raised to honour.
tr.203: And they say: "The Most Gracious (Allâh) has begotten a son (or children)." Glory to Him! They [whom they call children of Allâh i.e. the angels, ‘Îsâ (Jesus) - son of Maryam (Mary), ‘Uzair (Ezra)], are but honoured slaves.

21.ar: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
21.en: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
21.tl: lā yasbiqūnahu bil-qawli wahum bi-amrihi yaʿmalūna

tr.85: they do not speak before He speaks and they act by His command.
tr.19: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.
tr.22: They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command.
tr.203: They speak not until He has spoken, and they act on His Command.

21.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
21.en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
21.tl: yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yashfaʿūna illā limani ir'taḍā wahum min khashyatihi mush'fiqūna

tr.85: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede without His permission––indeed they themselves stand in awe of Him.
tr.19: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.
tr.22: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory).
tr.203: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him with whom He is pleased. And they stand in awe for fear of Him.

21.ar: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
21.en: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him" - that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
21.tl: waman yaqul min'hum innī ilāhun min dūnihi fadhālika najzīhi jahannama kadhālika najzī l-ẓālimīna

tr.85: If any of them were to claim, ‘I am a god beside Him,’ We would reward them with Hell: this is how We reward evildoers.
tr.19: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers.
tr.22: If any of them should say, "I am a god besides Him", such a one We should reward with Hell: thus do We reward those who do wrong.
tr.203: And if any of them should say: "Verily, I am an ilâh (a god) besides Him (Allâh)," such a one We should recompense with Hell. Thus We recompense the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers).

21.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًا فَفَتَقْنَـٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
21.en: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and then We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
21.tl: awalam yara alladhīna kafarū anna l-samāwāti wal-arḍa kānatā ratqan fafataqnāhumā wajaʿalnā mina l-māi kulla shayin ḥayyin afalā yu'minūna

tr.85: Are the disbelievers not aware that the heavens and the earth used to be joined together and that We ripped them apart, that We made every living thing from water? Will they not believe?
tr.19: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe?
tr.22: Do not the Unbelievers see that the heavens and the earth were joined together (as one unit of creation), before we clove them asunder? We made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?
tr.203: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were joined together as one united piece, then We parted them? And We have made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?

21.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
21.en: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
21.tl: wajaʿalnā fī l-arḍi rawāsiya an tamīda bihim wajaʿalnā fīhā fijājan subulan laʿallahum yahtadūna

tr.85: And We put firm mountains on the earth, lest it should sway under them, and set broad paths on it, so that they might follow the right direction,
tr.19: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way.
tr.22: And We have set on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with them, and We have made therein broad highways (between mountains) for them to pass through: that they may receive Guidance.
tr.203: And We have placed on the earth firm mountains, lest it should shake with them, and We placed therein broad highways for them to pass through, that they may be guided.

21.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًا مَّحْفُوظًا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَـٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
21.en: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
21.tl: wajaʿalnā l-samāa saqfan maḥfūẓan wahum ʿan āyātihā muʿ'riḍūna

tr.85: and We made the sky a well-secured canopy- yet from its wonders they turn away.
tr.19: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents.
tr.22: And We have made the heavens as a canopy well guarded: yet do they turn away from the Signs which these things (point to)!
tr.203: And We have made the heaven a roof, safe and well guarded. Yet they turn away from its signs (i.e. sun, moon, winds, clouds, etc.).

21.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
21.en: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
21.tl: wahuwa alladhī khalaqa al-layla wal-nahāra wal-shamsa wal-qamara kullun fī falakin yasbaḥūna

tr.85: It is He who created night and day, the sun and the moon, each floating in its orbit.
tr.19: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.
tr.22: It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course.
tr.203: And He it is Who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each in an orbit floating.

21.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِدُونَ
21.en: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
21.tl: wamā jaʿalnā libasharin min qablika l-khul'da afa-in mitta fahumu l-khālidūna

tr.85: We have not granted everlasting life to any other human being before you either [Muhammad]- if you die, will [the disbelievers] live for ever?
tr.19: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal!
tr.22: We granted not to any man before thee permanent life (here): if then thou shouldst die, would they live permanently?
tr.203: And We granted not to any human being immortality before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): then if you die, would they live forever?

21.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
21.en: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
21.tl: kullu nafsin dhāiqatu l-mawti wanablūkum bil-shari wal-khayri fit'natan wa-ilaynā tur'jaʿūna

tr.85: Every soul is certain to taste death: We test you all through the bad and the good, and to Us you will all return.
tr.19: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned.
tr.22: Every soul shall have a taste of death: and We test you by evil and by good by way of trial. to Us must ye return.
tr.203: Everyone is going to taste death, and We shall make a trial of you with evil and with good. And to Us you will be returned.

21.ar: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
21.en: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
21.tl: wa-idhā raāka alladhīna kafarū in yattakhidhūnaka illā huzuwan ahādhā alladhī yadhkuru ālihatakum wahum bidhik'ri l-raḥmāni hum kāfirūna

tr.85: When the disbelievers see you, they laugh at you: ‘Is this the one who talks about your gods?’ They reject any talk of the Lord of Mercy.
tr.19: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent.
tr.22: When the Unbelievers see thee, they treat thee not except with ridicule. "Is this," (they say), "the one who talks of your gods?" and they blaspheme at the mention of (Allah) Most Gracious!
tr.203: And when those who disbelieved (in the Oneness of Allâh) see you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), they take you not except for mockery (saying): "Is this the one who talks (badly) about your gods?" While they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Gracious (Allâh). [Tafsir Al-Qurtubî].

21.ar: خُلِقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ ۚ سَأُو۟رِيكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِى فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
21.en: Man was created of haste [i.e., impatience]. I will show you My signs [i.e., vengeance], so do not impatiently urge Me.
21.tl: khuliqa l-insānu min ʿajalin sa-urīkum āyātī falā tastaʿjilūni

tr.85: Man was created hasty: I will show you My signs soon, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
tr.19: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten.
tr.22: Man is a creature of haste: soon (enough) will I show you My Signs; then ye will not ask Me to hasten them!
tr.203: Man is created of haste. I will show you My Ayât (torments, proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). So ask Me not to hasten (them).

21.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
21.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
21.tl: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna

tr.85: They say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
tr.19: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?
tr.22: They say: "When will this promise come to pass, if ye are telling the truth?"
tr.203: And they say: "When will this promise (come to pass), if you are truthful."

21.ar: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ حِينَ لَا يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلَا عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
21.en: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
21.tl: law yaʿlamu alladhīna kafarū ḥīna lā yakuffūna ʿan wujūhihimu l-nāra walā ʿan ẓuhūrihim walā hum yunṣarūna

tr.85: If the disbelievers only knew, the time will arrive when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces or their backs, and they will get no help.
tr.19: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped!
tr.22: If only the Unbelievers knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the fire from their faces, nor yet from their backs, and (when) no help can reach them!
tr.203: If only those who disbelieved knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs, and they will not be helped.

21.ar: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
21.en: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
21.tl: bal tatīhim baghtatan fatabhatuhum falā yastaṭīʿūna raddahā walā hum yunẓarūna

tr.85: It will come upon them suddenly and stupefy them; they will be powerless to push it away; they will not be reprieved.
tr.19: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.
tr.22: Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite.
tr.203: Nay, it (the Fire or the Day of Resurrection) will come upon them all of a sudden and will perplex them, and they will have no power to avert it nor will they get respite.

21.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِئَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُوا۟ مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
21.en: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
21.tl: walaqadi us'tuh'zi-a birusulin min qablika faḥāqa bi-alladhīna sakhirū min'hum mā kānū bihi yastahziūna

tr.85: Messengers before you [Muhammad] were also ridiculed, but those who mocked them were overwhelmed in the end by the very thing they had mocked.
tr.19: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them.
tr.22: Mocked were (many) messenger before thee; But their scoffers were hemmed in by the thing that they mocked.
tr.203: Indeed, (many) Messengers were mocked before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), but the scoffers were surrounded by that, whereat they used to mock.

21.ar: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۗ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
21.en: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
21.tl: qul man yakla-ukum bi-al-layli wal-nahāri mina l-raḥmāni bal hum ʿan dhik'ri rabbihim muʿ'riḍūna

tr.85: Say, ‘Who could protect you night and day from the Lord of Mercy?’ Yet they turn away when their Lord is mentioned.
tr.19: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
tr.22: Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
tr.203: Say: "Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Gracious (Allâh)?" Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord.

21.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ ءَالِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُم مِّن دُونِنَا ۚ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَلَا هُم مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
21.en: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
21.tl: am lahum ālihatun tamnaʿuhum min dūninā lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣra anfusihim walā hum minnā yuṣ'ḥabūna

tr.85: Do they have gods who can defend them against Us? Their gods have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
tr.19: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us.
tr.22: Or have they gods that can guard them from Us? They have no power to aid themselves, nor can they be defended from Us.
tr.203: Or have they âlihah (gods) who can guard them from Us? They have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us (i.e. from Our Torment).

21.ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ ۗ أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِى ٱلْأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ ۚ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
21.en: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? Is it they who will overcome?
21.tl: bal mattaʿnā hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā ṭāla ʿalayhimu l-ʿumuru afalā yarawna annā natī l-arḍa nanquṣuhā min aṭrāfihā afahumu l-ghālibūna

tr.85: We have allowed these sinners and their forefathers to enjoy life for a long time. But do they not see how We are shrinking their borders? Is it they who will prevail?
tr.19: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors?
tr.22: Nay, We gave the good things of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them; See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will win?
tr.203: Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome?

21.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْىِ ۚ وَلَا يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
21.en: Say, "I only warn you by revelation." But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
21.tl: qul innamā undhirukum bil-waḥyi walā yasmaʿu l-ṣumu l-duʿāa idhā mā yundharūna

tr.85: Say, ‘I warn you only through the Revelation.’ The deaf will not hear the warning call,
tr.19: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned.
tr.22: Say, "I do but warn you according to revelation": But the deaf will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned!
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I warn you only by the revelation (from Allâh and not by the opinion of the religious scholars and others). But the deaf (who follow the religious scholars and others blindly) will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned [i.e. one should follow only the Qur’ân and the Sunnah (legal ways, orders, acts of worship, and the statements of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, as the companions of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم did)].

21.ar: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
21.en: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, "O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers."
21.tl: wala-in massathum nafḥatun min ʿadhābi rabbika layaqūlunna yāwaylanā innā kunnā ẓālimīna

tr.85: yet if a mere breath of your Lord’s punishment touches them, they will be sure to cry, ‘Woe to us! We were wrong!’
tr.19: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers.
tr.22: If but a breath of the Wrath of thy Lord do touch them, they will then say, "Woe to us! we did wrong indeed!"
tr.203: And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: "Woe unto us! Indeed we have been Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."

21.ar: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَـٰسِبِينَ
21.en: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
21.tl: wanaḍaʿu l-mawāzīna l-qis'ṭa liyawmi l-qiyāmati falā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan wa-in kāna mith'qāla ḥabbatin min khardalin ataynā bihā wakafā binā ḥāsibīna

tr.85: We will set up scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection so that no one can be wronged in the least, and if there should be even the weight of a mustard seed, We shall bring it out- We take excellent account.
tr.19: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
tr.22: We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account.
tr.203: And We shall set up balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection, then none will be dealt with unjustly in anything. And if there be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it. And Sufficient are We to take account.

21.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْرًا لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
21.en: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and a light and a reminder for the righteous
21.tl: walaqad ātaynā mūsā wahārūna l-fur'qāna waḍiyāan wadhik'ran lil'muttaqīna

tr.85: We gave Moses and Aaron [the Scripture] that distinguishes right from wrong, a light and a reminder for those who are mindful of God,
tr.19: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil,
tr.22: In the past We granted to Moses and Aaron the criterion (for judgment), and a Light and a Message for those who would do right,-
tr.203: And indeed We granted to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron) the criterion (of right and wrong), and a shining light [i.e. the Taurât (Torah)] and a Reminder for Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

21.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
21.en: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
21.tl: alladhīna yakhshawna rabbahum bil-ghaybi wahum mina l-sāʿati mush'fiqūna

tr.85: those who stand in awe of their Lord, though He is unseen, and who fear the Hour.
tr.19: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom).
tr.22: Those who fear their Lord in their most secret thoughts, and who hold the Hour (of Judgment) in awe.
tr.203: Those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, and they are afraid of the Hour.

21.ar: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ ۚ أَفَأَنتُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
21.en: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
21.tl: wahādhā dhik'run mubārakun anzalnāhu afa-antum lahu munkirūna

tr.85: This [Quran] too is a blessed message We have sent down- are you [people] going to deny it?
tr.19: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it?
tr.22: And this is a blessed Message which We have sent down: will ye then reject it?
tr.203: And this is a blessed Reminder (the Qur’ân) which We have sent down: will you then (dare to) deny it?

21.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ رُشْدَهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِۦ عَـٰلِمِينَ
21.en: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
21.tl: walaqad ātaynā ib'rāhīma rush'dahu min qablu wakunnā bihi ʿālimīna

tr.85: Long ago We bestowed right judgement on Abraham and We knew him well.
tr.19: And We verily gave Abraham of old his proper course, and We were Aware of him,
tr.22: We bestowed aforetime on Abraham his rectitude of conduct, and well were We acquainted with him.
tr.203: And indeed We bestowed aforetime on Ibrâhîm (Abraham) his (portion of) guidance, and We were Well-Acquainted with him (as to his Belief in the Oneness of Allâh).

21.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَـٰكِفُونَ
21.en: When he said to his father and his people, "What are these statues to which you are devoted?"
21.tl: idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā hādhihi l-tamāthīlu allatī antum lahā ʿākifūna

tr.85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are these images to which you are so devoted?’
tr.19: When he said unto his father and his folk: What are these images unto which ye pay devotion?
tr.22: Behold! he said to his father and his people, "What are these images, to which ye are (so assiduously) devoted?"
tr.203: When he said to his father and his people: "What are these images, to which you are devoted?"

21.ar: قَالُوا۟ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا لَهَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
21.en: They said, "We found our fathers worshippers of them."
21.tl: qālū wajadnā ābāanā lahā ʿābidīna

tr.85: They replied, ‘We found our fathers worshipping them.’
tr.19: They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them.
tr.22: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."
tr.203: They said: "We found our fathers worshipping them."

21.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمْ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
21.en: He said, "You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error."
21.tl: qāla laqad kuntum antum waābāukum fī ḍalālin mubīnin

tr.85: He said, ‘You and your fathers have clearly gone astray.’
tr.19: He said: Verily ye and your fathers were in plain error.
tr.22: He said, "Indeed ye have been in manifest error - ye and your fathers."
tr.203: He said: "Indeed, you and your fathers have been in manifest error."

21.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللَّـٰعِبِينَ
21.en: They said, "Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?"
21.tl: qālū aji'tanā bil-ḥaqi am anta mina l-lāʿibīna

tr.85: They asked, ‘Have you brought us the truth or are you just playing about?’
tr.19: They said: Bringest thou unto us the truth, or art thou some jester?
tr.22: They said, "Have you brought us the Truth, or are you one of those who jest?"
tr.203: They said: "Have you brought us the truth, or are you one of those who play about?"

21.ar: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَا۠ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
21.en: He said, "[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who created them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
21.tl: qāla bal rabbukum rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi alladhī faṭarahunna wa-anā ʿalā dhālikum mina l-shāhidīna

tr.85: He said, ‘Listen! Your true Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He who created them, and I am a witness to this.
tr.19: He said: Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that.
tr.22: He said, "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, He Who created them (from nothing): and I am a witness to this (Truth).
tr.203: He said: "Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them and to that I am one of the witnesses.

21.ar: وَتَٱللَّهِ لَأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَـٰمَكُم بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّوا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
21.en: And [I swear] by Allāh, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away."
21.tl: watal-lahi la-akīdanna aṣnāmakum baʿda an tuwallū mud'birīna

tr.85: By God I shall certainly plot against your idols as soon as you have turned your backs!’
tr.19: And, by Allah, I shall circumvent your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs.
tr.22: "And by Allah, I have a plan for your idols - after ye go away and turn your backs"..
tr.203: "And by Allâh, I shall plot a plan (to destroy) your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs."

21.ar: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَٰذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
21.en: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
21.tl: fajaʿalahum judhādhan illā kabīran lahum laʿallahum ilayhi yarjiʿūna

tr.85: He broke them all into pieces, but left the biggest one for them to return to.
tr.19: Then he reduced them to fragments, all save the chief of them, that haply they might have recourse to it.
tr.22: So he broke them to pieces, (all) but the biggest of them, that they might turn (and address themselves) to it.
tr.203: So he broke them to pieces, (all) except the biggest of them, that they might turn to it.

21.ar: قَالُوا۟ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
21.en: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers."
21.tl: qālū man faʿala hādhā biālihatinā innahu lamina l-ẓālimīna

tr.85: They said, ‘Who has done this to our gods? How wicked he must be!’
tr.19: They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer.
tr.22: They said, "Who has done this to our gods? He must indeed be some man of impiety!"
tr.203: They said: "Who has done this to our âlihah (gods)? He must indeed be one of the Zâlimun (wrong-doers)."

21.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُۥٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ
21.en: They said, "We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham."
21.tl: qālū samiʿ'nā fatan yadhkuruhum yuqālu lahu ib'rāhīmu

tr.85: Some said, ‘We heard a youth called Abraham talking about them.’
tr.19: They said: We heard a youth make mention of them, who is called Abraham.
tr.22: They said, "We heard a youth talk of them: He is called Abraham."
tr.203: They said: "We heard a young man talking against them, who is called Ibrâhîm (Abraham)."

21.ar: قَالُوا۟ فَأْتُوا۟ بِهِۦ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
21.en: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify."
21.tl: qālū fatū bihi ʿalā aʿyuni l-nāsi laʿallahum yashhadūna

tr.85: They said, ‘Bring him before the eyes of the people, so that they may witness [his trial].’
tr.19: They said: Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes that they may testify.
tr.22: They said, "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may bear witness."
tr.203: They said: "Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may testify."

21.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَنتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِـَٔالِهَتِنَا يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
21.en: They said, "Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?"
21.tl: qālū a-anta faʿalta hādhā biālihatinā yāib'rāhīmu

tr.85: They asked, ‘Was it you, Abraham, who did this to our gods?’
tr.19: They said: Is it thou who hast done this to our gods, O Abraham?
tr.22: They said, "Art thou the one that did this with our gods, O Abraham?"
tr.203: They said: "Are you the one who has done this to our gods, O Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?"

21.ar: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُۥ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَسْـَٔلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ يَنطِقُونَ
21.en: He said, "Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak."
21.tl: qāla bal faʿalahu kabīruhum hādhā fasalūhum in kānū yanṭiqūna

tr.85: He said, ‘No, it was done by the biggest of them- this one. Ask them, if they can talk.’
tr.19: He said: But this, their chief hath done it. So question them, if they can speak.
tr.22: He said: "Nay, this was done by - this is their biggest one! ask them, if they can speak intelligently!"
tr.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Nay, this one, the biggest of them (idols) did it. Ask them, if they can speak!"

21.ar: فَرَجَعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ أَنتُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
21.en: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], "Indeed, you are the wrongdoers."
21.tl: farajaʿū ilā anfusihim faqālū innakum antumu l-ẓālimūna

tr.85: They turned to one another, saying, ‘It is you who are in the wrong,’
tr.19: Then gathered they apart and said: Lo! ye yourselves are the wrong-doers.
tr.22: So they turned to themselves and said, "Surely ye are the ones in the wrong!"
tr.203: So they turned to themselves and said: "Verily, you are the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."

21.ar: ثُمَّ نُكِسُوا۟ عَلَىٰ رُءُوسِهِمْ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يَنطِقُونَ
21.en: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], "You have already known that these do not speak!"
21.tl: thumma nukisū ʿalā ruūsihim laqad ʿalim'ta mā hāulāi yanṭiqūna

tr.85: but then they lapsed again and said, ‘You know very well these gods cannot speak.’
tr.19: And they were utterly confounded, and they said: Well thou knowest that these speak not.
tr.22: Then were they confounded with shame: (they said), "Thou knowest full well that these (idols) do not speak!"
tr.203: Then they turned to themselves (their first thought and said): "Indeed you [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] know well that these (idols) speak not!"

21.ar: قَالَ أَفَتَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُكُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَضُرُّكُمْ
21.en: He said, "Then do you worship instead of Allāh that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
21.tl: qāla afataʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lā yanfaʿukum shayan walā yaḍurrukum

tr.85: Abraham said, ‘How can you worship what can neither benefit nor harm you, instead of God?
tr.19: He said: Worship ye then instead of Allah that which cannot profit you at all, nor harm you?
tr.22: (Abraham) said, "Do ye then worship, besides Allah, things that can neither be of any good to you nor do you harm?
tr.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Do you then worship besides Allâh, things that can neither profit you, nor harm you?

21.ar: أُفٍّ لَّكُمْ وَلِمَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
21.en: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allāh. Then will you not use reason?"
21.tl: uffin lakum walimā taʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi afalā taʿqilūna

tr.85: Shame on you and on the things you worship instead of God. Have you no sense?’
tr.19: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?
tr.22: "Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense?"..
tr.203: "Fie upon you, and upon that which you worship besides Allâh! Have you then no sense?"

21.ar: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
21.en: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act."
21.tl: qālū ḥarriqūhu wa-unṣurū ālihatakum in kuntum fāʿilīna

tr.85: They said, ‘Burn him and avenge your gods, if you are going to do the right thing.’
tr.19: They cried: Burn him and stand by your gods, if ye will be doing.
tr.22: They said, "Burn him and protect your gods, If ye do (anything at all)!"
tr.203: They said: "Burn him and help your âlihah (gods), if you will be doing."

21.ar: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
21.en: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham."
21.tl: qul'nā yānāru kūnī bardan wasalāman ʿalā ib'rāhīma

tr.85: But We said, ‘Fire, be cool and safe for Abraham.’
tr.19: We said: O fire, be coolness and peace for Abraham,
tr.22: We said, "O Fire! be thou cool, and (a means of) safety for Abraham!"
tr.203: We (Allâh) said: "O fire! Be you coolness and safety for Ibrâhîm (Abraham)!"

21.ar: وَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ
21.en: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.
21.tl: wa-arādū bihi kaydan fajaʿalnāhumu l-akhsarīna

tr.85: They planned to harm him, but We made them suffer the greatest loss.
tr.19: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.
tr.22: Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most!
tr.203: And they wanted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.

21.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَلُوطًا إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا لِلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
21.en: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
21.tl: wanajjaynāhu walūṭan ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā lil'ʿālamīna

tr.85: We saved him and Lot [and sent them] to the land We blessed for all people,
tr.19: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.
tr.22: But We delivered him and (his nephew) Lut (and directed them) to the land which We have blessed for the nations.
tr.203: And We rescued him and Lût (Lot) to the land which We have blessed for the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).

21.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ نَافِلَةً ۖ وَكُلًّا جَعَلْنَا صَـٰلِحِينَ
21.en: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
21.tl: wawahabnā lahu is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba nāfilatan wakullan jaʿalnā ṣāliḥīna

tr.85: and We gave him Isaac and Jacob as an additional gift, and made each of them righteous.
tr.19: And We bestowed upon him Isaac, and Jacob as a grandson. Each of them We made righteous.
tr.22: And We bestowed on him Isaac and, as an additional gift, (a grandson), Jacob, and We made righteous men of every one (of them).
tr.203: And We bestowed upon him Ishâq (Isaac), and (a grandson) Ya‘qûb (Jacob). Each one We made righteous.

21.ar: وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِمْ فِعْلَ ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَإِقَامَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَإِيتَآءَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةِ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا عَـٰبِدِينَ
21.en: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
21.tl: wajaʿalnāhum a-immatan yahdūna bi-amrinā wa-awḥaynā ilayhim fiʿ'la l-khayrāti wa-iqāma l-ṣalati waītāa l-zakati wakānū lanā ʿābidīna

tr.85: We made all of them leaders, guiding others by Our command, and We inspired them to do good works, to keep up the prayer, and to give alms: they were Our true worshippers.
tr.19: And We made them chiefs who guide by Our command, and We inspired in them the doing of good deeds and the right establishment of worship and the giving of alms, and they were worshippers of Us (alone).
tr.22: And We made them leaders, guiding (men) by Our Command, and We sent them inspiration to do good deeds, to establish regular prayers, and to practise regular charity; and they constantly served Us (and Us only).
tr.203: And We made them leaders, guiding (mankind) by Our Command, and We revealed to them the doing of good deeds, performing Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât), and the giving of Zakât and of Us (Alone) they were the worshippers.

21.ar: وَلُوطًا ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِى كَانَت تَّعْمَلُ ٱلْخَبَـٰٓئِثَ ۗ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَـٰسِقِينَ
21.en: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
21.tl: walūṭan ātaynāhu ḥuk'man waʿil'man wanajjaynāhu mina l-qaryati allatī kānat taʿmalu l-khabāitha innahum kānū qawma sawin fāsiqīna

tr.85: We gave Lot sound judgement and knowledge and saved him from the community who practised obscenities- they were shameless people who broke God’s law!
tr.19: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.
tr.22: And to Lut, too, We gave Judgment and Knowledge, and We saved him from the town which practised abominations: truly they were a people given to Evil, a rebellious people.
tr.203: And (remember) Lût (Lot), We gave him Hukm (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and (religious) knowledge, and We saved him from the town (folk) who practised Al-Khabâ’ith (evil, wicked and filthy deeds). Verily, they were a people given to evil, and were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

21.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
21.en: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
21.tl: wa-adkhalnāhu fī raḥmatinā innahu mina l-ṣāliḥīna

tr.85: We admitted him to Our mercy; he was a righteous man.
tr.19: And We brought him in unto Our mercy. Lo! he was of the righteous.
tr.22: And We admitted him to Our Mercy: for he was one of the Righteous.
tr.203: And We admitted him to Our Mercy; truly, he was of the righteous.

21.ar: وَنُوحًا إِذْ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبْلُ فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
21.en: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allāh] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
21.tl: wanūḥan idh nādā min qablu fa-is'tajabnā lahu fanajjaynāhu wa-ahlahu mina l-karbi l-ʿaẓīmi

tr.85: Long before that, We answered Noah when he cried out to Us: We saved him and his family from the great calamity
tr.19: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.
tr.22: (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress.
tr.203: And (remember) Nûh (Noah), when he cried (to Us) aforetime. We answered his invocation and saved him and his family from the great distress.

21.ar: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمَ سَوْءٍ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
21.en: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
21.tl: wanaṣarnāhu mina l-qawmi alladhīna kadhabū biāyātinā innahum kānū qawma sawin fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: and We helped him against the people who rejected Our signs- they were evil people, so We drowned them all.
tr.19: And delivered him from the people who denied Our revelations. Lo! they were folk of evil, therefor did We drown them all.
tr.22: We helped him against people who rejected Our Signs: truly they were a people given to Evil: so We drowned them (in the Flood) all together.
tr.203: We helped him against the people who denied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.). Verily, they were a people given to evil. So We drowned them all.

21.ar: وَدَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَـٰنَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِى ٱلْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ ٱلْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَـٰهِدِينَ
21.en: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field - when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
21.tl: wadāwūda wasulaymāna idh yaḥkumāni fī l-ḥarthi idh nafashat fīhi ghanamu l-qawmi wakunnā liḥuk'mihim shāhidīna

tr.85: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgement regarding the field into which sheep strayed by night and grazed. We witnessed their judgement
tr.19: And David and Solomon, when they gave judgment concerning the field, when people's sheep had strayed and browsed therein by night; and We were witnesses to their judgment.
tr.22: And remember David and Solomon, when they gave judgment in the matter of the field into which the sheep of certain people had strayed by night: We did witness their judgment.
tr.203: And (remember) Dâwûd (David) and Sulaimân (Solomon), when they gave judgement in the case of the field in which the sheep of certain people had pastured at night; and We were witness to their judgement.

21.ar: فَفَهَّمْنَـٰهَا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ وَكُلًّا ءَاتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا ۚ وَسَخَّرْنَا مَعَ دَاوُۥدَ ٱلْجِبَالَ يُسَبِّحْنَ وَٱلطَّيْرَ ۚ وَكُنَّا فَـٰعِلِينَ
21.en: And We gave understanding of it [i.e., the case] to Solomon, and to each [of them] We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains to exalt [Us], along with David and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
21.tl: fafahhamnāhā sulaymāna wakullan ātaynā ḥuk'man waʿil'man wasakharnā maʿa dāwūda l-jibāla yusabbiḥ'na wal-ṭayra wakunnā fāʿilīna

tr.85: and made Solomon understand the case [better], though We gave sound judgement and knowledge to both of them. We made the mountains and the birds celebrate Our praises with David- We did all these things-
tr.19: And We made Solomon to understand (the case); and unto each of them We gave judgment and knowledge. And we subdued the hills and the birds to hymn (His) praise along with David. We were the doers (thereof).
tr.22: To Solomon We inspired the (right) understanding of the matter: to each (of them) We gave Judgment and Knowledge; it was Our power that made the hills and the birds celebrate Our praises, with David: it was We Who did (all these things).
tr.203: And We made Sulaimân (Solomon) to understand (the case); and to each of them We gave Hukm (right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) and knowledge. And We subjected the mountains and the birds to glorify Our Praises along with Dâwûd (David). And it was We Who were the doer (of all these things).

21.ar: وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ صَنْعَةَ لَبُوسٍ لَّكُمْ لِتُحْصِنَكُم مِّنۢ بَأْسِكُمْ ۖ فَهَلْ أَنتُمْ شَـٰكِرُونَ
21.en: And We taught him the fashioning of coats of armor to protect you from your [enemy in] battle. So will you then be grateful?
21.tl: waʿallamnāhu ṣanʿata labūsin lakum lituḥ'ṣinakum min basikum fahal antum shākirūna

tr.85: We taught him how to make coats of mail for the benefit of you [people], to protect you in your wars, but are you grateful for this?
tr.19: And We taught him the art of making garments (of mail) to protect you in your daring. Are ye then thankful?
tr.22: It was We Who taught him the making of coats of mail for your benefit, to guard you from each other's violence: will ye then be grateful?
tr.203: And We taught him the making of metal coats of mail (for battles), to protect you in your fighting. Are you then grateful?

21.ar: وَلِسُلَيْمَـٰنَ ٱلرِّيحَ عَاصِفَةً تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلَّتِى بَـٰرَكْنَا فِيهَا ۚ وَكُنَّا بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَـٰلِمِينَ
21.en: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
21.tl: walisulaymāna l-rīḥa ʿāṣifatan tajrī bi-amrihi ilā l-arḍi allatī bāraknā fīhā wakunnā bikulli shayin ʿālimīna

tr.85: We harnessed the stormy wind for Solomon, so that it sped by his command to the land We had blessed- We have knowledge of all things-
tr.19: And unto Solomon (We subdued) the wind in its raging. It set by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are Aware.
tr.22: (It was Our power that made) the violent (unruly) wind flow (tamely) for Solomon, to his order, to the land which We had blessed: for We do know all things.
tr.203: And to Sulaimân (Solomon) (We subjected) the wind strongly raging, running by his command towards the land which We had blessed. And of everything We are the All-Knower.

21.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ مَن يَغُوصُونَ لَهُۥ وَيَعْمَلُونَ عَمَلًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَكُنَّا لَهُمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
21.en: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
21.tl: wamina l-shayāṭīni man yaghūṣūna lahu wayaʿmalūna ʿamalan dūna dhālika wakunnā lahum ḥāfiẓīna

tr.85: and We made some of the jinn subservient to him, to dive for him and do other works besides. We were watching over them.
tr.19: And of the evil ones (subdued We unto him) some who dived (for pearls) for him and did other work, and We were warders unto them.
tr.22: And of the evil ones, were some who dived for him, and did other work besides; and it was We Who guarded them.
tr.203: And of the Shayâtîn (devils from the jinn) were some who dived for him, and did other work besides that; and it was We Who guarded them.

21.ar: ۞ وَأَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
21.en: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful."
21.tl: wa-ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-ḍuru wa-anta arḥamu l-rāḥimīna

tr.85: Remember Job, when he cried to his Lord, ‘Suffering has truly afflicted me, but you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.’
tr.19: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
tr.22: And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
tr.203: And (remember) Ayyûb (Job), when he cried to his Lord: "Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy."

21.ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ فَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِۦ مِن ضُرٍّ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
21.en: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of Allāh].
21.tl: fa-is'tajabnā lahu fakashafnā mā bihi min ḍurrin waātaynāhu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan min ʿindinā wadhik'rā lil'ʿābidīna

tr.85: We answered him, removed his suffering, and restored his family to him, along with more like them, as an act of grace from Us and a reminder for all who serve Us.
tr.19: Then We heard his prayer and removed that adversity from which he suffered, and We gave him his household (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them, a mercy from Our store, and a remembrance for the worshippers;
tr.22: So We listened to him: We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his people to him, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who serve Us.
tr.203: So We answered his call, and We removed the distress that was on him, and We restored his family to him (that he had lost) and the like thereof along with them as a mercy from Ourselves and a Reminder for all those who worship Us.

21.ar: وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ كُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
21.en: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
21.tl: wa-is'māʿīla wa-id'rīsa wadhā l-kif'li kullun mina l-ṣābirīna

tr.85: And remember Ishmael, Idris, and Dhu’l-Kifl: they were all steadfast.
tr.19: And (mention) Ishmael, and Idris, and Dhu'l-Kifl. All were of the steadfast.
tr.22: And (remember) Isma'il, Idris, and Zul-kifl, all (men) of constancy and patience;
tr.203: And (remember) Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael), and Idrîs (Enoch) and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah): all were from among As-Sâbirûn (the patient).

21.ar: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
21.en: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
21.tl: wa-adkhalnāhum fī raḥmatinā innahum mina l-ṣāliḥīna

tr.85: We admitted them to Our mercy; they were truly righteous.
tr.19: And We brought them in unto Our mercy. Lo! they are among the righteous.
tr.22: We admitted them to Our mercy: for they were of the righteous ones.
tr.203: And We admitted them to Our Mercy. Verily, they were of the righteous.

21.ar: وَذَا ٱلنُّونِ إِذ ذَّهَبَ مُغَـٰضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَن لَّن نَّقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَادَىٰ فِى ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ أَن لَّآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
21.en: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, "There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers."
21.tl: wadhā l-nūni idh dhahaba mughāḍiban faẓanna an lan naqdira ʿalayhi fanādā fī l-ẓulumāti an lā ilāha illā anta sub'ḥānaka innī kuntu mina l-ẓālimīna

tr.85: And remember the man with the whale,when he went off angrily, thinking We could not restrict him, but then he cried out in the deep darkness, ‘There is no God but You, glory be to You, I was wrong.’
tr.19: And (mention) Dhu'n-Nun, when he went off in anger and deemed that We had no power over him, but he cried out in the darkness, saying: There is no Allah save Thee. Be Thou Glorified! Lo! I have been a wrong-doer.
tr.22: And remember Zun-nun, when he departed in wrath: He imagined that We had no power over him! But he cried through the deptHs of darkness, "There is no god but thou: glory to thee: I was indeed wrong!"
tr.203: And (remember) Dhun-Nûn (Jonah), when he went off in anger, and imagined that We shall not punish him (i.e. the calamities which had befallen him)! But he cried through the darkness (saying): Lâ ilâha illâ Anta [none has the right to be worshipped but You (O, Allâh)], Glorified (and Exalted) be You [above all that (evil) they associate with You]! Truly, I have been of the wrong-doers."

21.ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نُـۨجِى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
21.en: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the believers.
21.tl: fa-is'tajabnā lahu wanajjaynāhu mina l-ghami wakadhālika nunjī l-mu'minīna

tr.85: We answered him and saved him from distress: this is how We save the faithful.
tr.19: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.
tr.22: So We listened to him: and delivered him from distress: and thus do We deliver those who have faith.
tr.203: So We answered his call, and delivered him from the distress. And thus We do deliver the believers (who believe in the Oneness of Allâh, abstain from evil and work righteousness).

21.ar: وَزَكَرِيَّآ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِى فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
21.en: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, "My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors."
21.tl: wazakariyyā idh nādā rabbahu rabbi lā tadharnī fardan wa-anta khayru l-wārithīna

tr.85: Remember Zachariah, when he cried to his Lord, ‘My Lord, do not leave me childless, though You are the best of heirs.’
tr.19: And Zachariah, when he cried unto his Lord: My Lord! Leave me not childless, though Thou art the Best of inheritors.
tr.22: And (remember) Zakariya, when he cried to his Lord: "O my Lord! leave me not without offspring, though thou art the best of inheritors."
tr.203: And (remember) Zakariyyâ (Zachariah), when he cried to his Lord: "O My Lord! Leave me not single (childless), though You are the Best of the inheritors."

21.ar: فَٱسْتَجَبْنَا لَهُۥ وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ وَأَصْلَحْنَا لَهُۥ زَوْجَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَيَدْعُونَنَا رَغَبًا وَرَهَبًا ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ لَنَا خَـٰشِعِينَ
21.en: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
21.tl: fa-is'tajabnā lahu wawahabnā lahu yaḥyā wa-aṣlaḥnā lahu zawjahu innahum kānū yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wayadʿūnanā raghaban warahaban wakānū lanā khāshiʿīna

tr.85: We answered him––We gave him John, and cured his wife of barrenness- they were always keen to do good deeds. They called upon Us out of longing and awe, and humbled themselves before Us.
tr.19: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us.
tr.22: So We listened to him: and We granted him Yahya: We cured his wife's (Barrenness) for him. These (three) were ever quick in emulation in good works; they used to call on Us with love and reverence, and humble themselves before Us.
