22.tl: wayastaʿjilūnaka bil-ʿadhābi walan yukh'lifa l-lahu waʿdahu wa-inna yawman ʿinda rabbika ka-alfi sanatin mimmā taʿuddūna

tr.85: They will challenge you [Prophet] to hasten the punishment. God will not fail in His promise- a Day with your Lord is like a thousand years by your reckoning.
tr.19: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.
tr.22: Yet they ask thee to hasten on the Punishment! But Allah will not fail in His Promise. Verily a Day in the sight of thy Lord is like a thousand years of your reckoning.
tr.203: And they ask you to hasten on the torment! And Allâh fails not His Promise. And verily, a day with your Lord is as a thousand years of what you reckon.

22.ar: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَمْلَيْتُ لَهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهَا وَإِلَىَّ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
22.en: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
22.tl: waka-ayyin min qaryatin amlaytu lahā wahiya ẓālimatun thumma akhadhtuhā wa-ilayya l-maṣīru

tr.85: To many a town steeped in wrongdoing I gave more time and then struck them down: they all return to Me in the end.
tr.19: And how many a township did I suffer long though it was sinful! Then I grasped it. Unto Me is the return.
tr.22: And to how many populations did I give respite, which were given to wrong-doing? in the end I punished them. To me is the destination (of all).
tr.203: And many a township did I give respite while it was given to wrong-doing. Then (in the end) I seized it (with punishment). And to Me is the (final) return (of all).

22.ar: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
22.en: Say, "O people, I am only to you a clear warner."
22.tl: qul yāayyuhā l-nāsu innamā anā lakum nadhīrun mubīnun

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘People, I am sent only to give you clear warning.’
tr.19: Say: O mankind! I am only a plain warner unto you.
tr.22: Say: "O men! I am (sent) to you only to give a Clear Warning:
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "O mankind! I am (sent) to you only as a plain warner."

22.ar: فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
22.en: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
22.tl: fa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun

tr.85: Those who believe and do good deeds will be forgiven and have a generous reward,
tr.19: Those who believe and do good works, for them is pardon and a rich provision;
tr.22: "Those who believe and work righteousness, for them is forgiveness and a sustenance most generous.
tr.203: So those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, for them is forgiveness and Rizqun Karîm (generous provision, i.e. Paradise).

22.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ سَعَوْا۟ فِىٓ ءَايَـٰتِنَا مُعَـٰجِزِينَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
22.en: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to cause failure - those are the companions of Hellfire.
22.tl: wa-alladhīna saʿaw fī āyātinā muʿājizīna ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: but those who strive to oppose Our messages and try in vain to defeat Us are destined for the Blaze.
tr.19: While those who strive to thwart Our revelations, such are rightful owners of the Fire.
tr.22: "But those who strive against Our Signs, to frustrate them,- they will be Companions of the Fire."
tr.203: But those who strive against Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), to frustrate them, they will be dwellers of the Hell-fire.

22.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ وَلَا نَبِىٍّ إِلَّآ إِذَا تَمَنَّىٰٓ أَلْقَى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِىٓ أُمْنِيَّتِهِۦ فَيَنسَخُ ٱللَّهُ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ثُمَّ يُحْكِمُ ٱللَّهُ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
22.en: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But Allāh abolishes that which Satan throws in; then Allāh makes precise His verses. And Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
22.tl: wamā arsalnā min qablika min rasūlin walā nabiyyin illā idhā tamannā alqā l-shayṭānu fī um'niyyatihi fayansakhu l-lahu mā yul'qī l-shayṭānu thumma yuḥ'kimu l-lahu āyātihi wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun

tr.85: We have never sent any messenger or prophet before you [Muhammad] into whose wishes Satan did not insinuate something, but God removes what Satan insinuates and then God affirms His message. God is all knowing and wise:
tr.19: Never sent We a messenger or a prophet before thee but when He recited (the message) Satan proposed (opposition) in respect of that which he recited thereof. But Allah abolisheth that which Satan proposeth. Then Allah establisheth His revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise;
tr.22: Never did We send a messenger or a prophet before thee, but, when he framed a desire, Satan threw some (vanity) into his desire: but Allah will cancel anything (vain) that Satan throws in, and Allah will confirm (and establish) His Signs: for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom:
tr.203: Never did We send a Messenger or a Prophet before you but when he did recite the revelation or narrated or spoke, Shaitân (Satan) threw (some falsehood) in it. But Allâh abolishes that which Shaitân (Satan) throws in. Then Allâh establishes His Revelations. And Allâh is All-Knower, All-Wise:

22.ar: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
22.en: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
22.tl: liyajʿala mā yul'qī l-shayṭānu fit'natan lilladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-qāsiyati qulūbuhum wa-inna l-ẓālimīna lafī shiqāqin baʿīdin

tr.85: He makes Satan’s insinuations a temptation only for the sick at heart and those whose hearts are hardened- the evildoers are profoundly opposed [to the Truth]-
tr.19: That He may make that which the devil proposeth a temptation for those in whose hearts is a disease, and those whose hearts are hardened - Lo! the evil-doers are in open schism -
tr.22: That He may make the suggestions thrown in by Satan, but a trial for those in whose hearts is a disease and who are hardened of heart: verily the wrong-doers are in a schism far (from the Truth):
tr.203: That He (Allâh) may make what is thrown in by Shaitân (Satan) a trial for those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy and disbelief) and whose hearts are hardened. And certainly, the Zalimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers) are in an opposition far-off (from the truth against Allâh’s Messenger and the believers).

22.ar: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
22.en: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allāh the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
22.tl: waliyaʿlama alladhīna ūtū l-ʿil'ma annahu l-ḥaqu min rabbika fayu'minū bihi fatukh'bita lahu qulūbuhum wa-inna l-laha lahādi alladhīna āmanū ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin

tr.85: and He causes those given knowledge to realize that this Revelation is your Lord’s Truth, so that they may believe in it and humble their hearts to Him: God guides the faithful to the straight path.
tr.19: And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it is the truth from thy Lord, so that they may believe therein and their hearts may submit humbly unto Him. Lo! Allah verily is guiding those who believe unto a right path.
tr.22: And that those on whom knowledge has been bestowed may learn that the (Qur'an) is the Truth from thy Lord, and that they may believe therein, and their hearts may be made humbly (open) to it: for verily Allah is the Guide of those who believe, to the Straight Way.
tr.203: And that those who have been given knowledge may know that it (this Qur’ân) is the truth from your Lord, so that they may believe therein, and their hearts may submit to it with humility. And verily, Allâh is the Guide of those who believe, to the Straight Path.

22.ar: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
22.en: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.
22.tl: walā yazālu alladhīna kafarū fī mir'yatin min'hu ḥattā tatiyahumu l-sāʿatu baghtatan aw yatiyahum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaqīmin

tr.85: The disbelievers will remain in doubt about it until the Hour suddenly overpowers them or until torment descends on them on a Day devoid of all hope.
tr.19: And those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt thereof until the Hour come upon them unawares, or there come unto them the doom of a disastrous day.
tr.22: Those who reject Faith will not cease to be in doubt concerning (Revelation) until the Hour (of Judgment) comes suddenly upon them, or there comes to them the Penalty of a Day of Disaster.
tr.203: And those who disbelieved will not cease to be in doubt about it (this Qur’ân) until the Hour comes suddenly upon them, or there comes to them the torment of the Day after which there will be no night (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

22.ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
22.en: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allāh; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
22.tl: al-mul'ku yawma-idhin lillahi yaḥkumu baynahum fa-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fī jannāti l-naʿīmi

tr.85: On that Day control will belong to God: He will judge between them. Those who believe and do good deeds will be admitted to Gardens of Delight,
tr.19: The Sovereignty on that day will be Allah's, He will judge between them. Then those who believed and did good works will be in Gardens of Delight,
tr.22: On that Day of Dominion will be that of Allah: He will judge between them: so those who believe and work righteous deeds will be in Gardens of Delight.
tr.203: The sovereignty on that Day will be that of Allâh (the One Who has no partners). He will judge between them. So those who believed (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and did righteous good deeds will be in Gardens of delight (Paradise).

22.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
22.en: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
22.tl: wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā fa-ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun

tr.85: while those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations will receive a humiliating torment.
tr.19: While those who disbelieved and denied Our revelations, for them will be a shameful doom.
tr.22: And for those who reject Faith and deny our Signs, there will be a humiliating Punishment.
tr.203: And those who disbelieved and belied Our Verses (of this Qur’ân), for them will be a humiliating torment (in Hell).

22.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
22.en: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allāh and then were killed or died - Allāh will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allāh who is the best of providers.
22.tl: wa-alladhīna hājarū fī sabīli l-lahi thumma qutilū aw mātū layarzuqannahumu l-lahu riz'qan ḥasanan wa-inna l-laha lahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna

tr.85: He will give a generous provision to those who migrated in God’s way and were killed or died. He is the Best Provider.
tr.19: Those who fled their homes for the cause of Allah and then were slain or died, Allah verily will provide for them a good provision. Lo! Allah, He verily is Best of all who make provision.
tr.22: Those who leave their homes in the cause of Allah, and are then slain or die,- On them will Allah bestow verily a goodly Provision: Truly Allah is He Who bestows the best provision.
tr.203: Those who emigrated in the Cause of Allâh and after that were killed or died, surely, Allâh will provide a good provision for them. And verily, it is Allâh Who indeed is the Best of those who make provision.

22.ar: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌ
22.en: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allāh is Knowing and Forbearing.
22.tl: layud'khilannahum mud'khalan yarḍawnahu wa-inna l-laha laʿalīmun ḥalīmun

tr.85: He will admit them to a place that will please them: God is all knowing and most forbearing.
tr.19: Assuredly He will cause them to enter by an entry that they will love. Lo! Allah verily is Knower, Indulgent.
tr.22: Verily He will admit them to a place with which they shall be well pleased: for Allah is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.
tr.203: Truly, He will make them enter an entrance with which they shall be well-pleased, and verily, Allâh indeed is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.

22.ar: ۞ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
22.en: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allāh will surely aid him. Indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.
22.tl: dhālika waman ʿāqaba bimith'li mā ʿūqiba bihi thumma bughiya ʿalayhi layanṣurannahu l-lahu inna l-laha laʿafuwwun ghafūrun

tr.85: So it will be. God will help those who retaliate against an aggressive act merely with its like and are then wronged again: God is pardoning and most forgiving.
tr.19: That (is so). And whoso hath retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer and then hath (again) been wronged, Allah will succour him. Lo! Allah verily is Mild, Forgiving.
tr.22: That (is so). And if one has retaliated to no greater extent than the injury he received, and is again set upon inordinately, Allah will help him: for Allah is One that blots out (sins) and forgives (again and again).
tr.203: That is so. And whoever has retaliated with the like of that which he was made to suffer, and then has again been wronged, Allâh will surely help him. Verily Allâh indeed is Oft-Pardoning, Oft-Forgiving.

22.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
22.en: That is because Allāh causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
22.tl: dhālika bi-anna l-laha yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wa-anna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun

tr.85: So it will be, because God makes night pass into day, and day into night, and He is all hearing and all seeing.
tr.19: That is because Allah maketh the night to pass into the day and maketh the day to pass into the night, and because Allah is Hearer, Seer.
tr.22: That is because Allah merges night into day, and He merges day into night, and verily it is Allah Who hears and sees (all things).
tr.203: That is because Allâh merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night. And verily, Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Seer.

22.ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَـٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
22.en: That is because Allāh is the True Reality, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allāh is the Most High, the Grand.
22.tl: dhālika bi-anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu wa-anna mā yadʿūna min dūnihi huwa l-bāṭilu wa-anna l-laha huwa l-ʿaliyu l-kabīru

tr.85: So it will be, because it is God alone who is the Truth, and whatever else they invoke is sheer falsehood: it is God who is the Most High, the Most Great.
tr.19: That is because Allah, He is the True, and that whereon they call instead of Him, it is the false, and because Allah, He is the High, the Great.
tr.22: That is because Allah - He is the Reality; and those besides Him whom they invoke,- they are but vain Falsehood: verily Allah is He, Most High, Most Great.
tr.203: That is because Allâh - He is the Truth (the only True God of all that exists, Who has no partners or rivals with Him), and what they (the polytheists) invoke besides Him, it is Bâtil (falsehood). And verily, Allâh - He is the Most High, the Most Great.

22.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌ
22.en: Do you not see that Allāh has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allāh is Subtle and Aware.
22.tl: alam tara anna l-laha anzala mina l-samāi māan fatuṣ'biḥu l-arḍu mukh'ḍarratan inna l-laha laṭīfun khabīrun

tr.85: Have you [Prophet] not considered how God sends water down from the sky and the next morning the earth becomes green? God is truly most subtle, all aware;
tr.19: Seest thou not how Allah sendeth down water from the sky and then the earth becometh green upon the morrow? Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.
tr.22: Seest thou not that Allah sends down rain from the sky, and forthwith the earth becomes clothed with green? for Allah is He Who understands the finest mysteries, and is well-acquainted (with them).
tr.203: See you not that Allâh sends down water (rain) from the sky, and then the earth becomes green? Verily, Allâh is the Most Kind and Courteous, Well-Acquainted with all things.

22.ar: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
22.en: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
22.tl: lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wa-inna l-laha lahuwa l-ghaniyu l-ḥamīdu

tr.85: everything in the heavens and earth belongs to Him; God alone is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise.
tr.19: Unto Him belongeth all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Lo! Allah, He verily is the Absolute, the Owner of Praise.
tr.22: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: for verily Allah,- He is free of all wants, Worthy of all Praise.
tr.203: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth. And verily, Allâh - He is Rich (Free of all needs), Worthy of all praise.

22.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
22.en: Do you not see that Allāh has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allāh, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
22.tl: alam tara anna l-laha sakhara lakum mā fī l-arḍi wal-ful'ka tajrī fī l-baḥri bi-amrihi wayum'siku l-samāa an taqaʿa ʿalā l-arḍi illā bi-idh'nihi inna l-laha bil-nāsi laraūfun raḥīmun

tr.85: Have you not considered how God has made everything on the earth of service to you? That ships sail the sea at His command? That He keeps the heavens from falling down on the earth without His permission? God is most compassionate and most merciful to mankind-
tr.19: Hast thou not seen how Allah hath made all that is in the earth subservient unto you? And the ship runneth upon the sea by His command, and He holdeth back the heaven from falling on the earth unless by His leave. Lo! Allah is, for mankind, Full of Pity, Merciful.
tr.22: Seest thou not that Allah has made subject to you (men) all that is on the earth, and the ships that sail through the sea by His Command? He withholds the sky (rain) from failing on the earth except by His leave: for Allah is Most Kind and Most Merciful to man.
tr.203: See you not that Allâh has subjected to you (mankind) all that is on the earth, and the ships that sail through the sea by His Command? He withholds the heaven from falling on the earth except by His Leave. Verily, Allâh is, for mankind, Full of Kindness, Most Merciful.

22.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ
22.en: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
22.tl: wahuwa alladhī aḥyākum thumma yumītukum thumma yuḥ'yīkum inna l-insāna lakafūrun

tr.85: it is He who gave you [people] life, will cause you to die, then will give you life again- but man is ungrateful.
tr.19: And He it is Who gave you life, then He will cause you to die, and then will give you life (again). Lo! man is verily an ingrate.
tr.22: It is He Who gave you life, will cause you to die, and will again give you life: Truly man is a most ungrateful creature!
tr.203: It is He, Who gave you life, and then will cause you to die, and will again give you life (on the Day of Resurrection). Verily man is indeed an ingrate.

22.ar: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَـٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۚ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًى مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
22.en: For every [religious] community We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muḥammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite [them] to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
22.tl: likulli ummatin jaʿalnā mansakan hum nāsikūhu falā yunāziʿunnaka fī l-amri wa-ud'ʿu ilā rabbika innaka laʿalā hudan mus'taqīmin

tr.85: We have appointed acts of devotion for every community to observe, so do not let them argue with you [Prophet] about this matter. Call them to your Lord- you are on the right path-
tr.19: Unto each nation have We given sacred rites which they are to perform; so let them not dispute with thee of the matter, but summon thou unto thy Lord. Lo! thou indeed followest right guidance.
tr.22: To every People have We appointed rites and ceremonies which they must follow: let them not then dispute with thee on the matter, but do thou invite (them) to thy Lord: for thou art assuredly on the Right Way.
tr.203: For every nation We have ordained religious ceremonies [e.g. slaughtering of the cattle during the three days of stay at Mîna (Makkah) during the Hajj (pilgrimage)] which they must follow; so let them (the pagans) not dispute with you on the matter (i.e. to eat of the cattle which you slaughter, and not to eat of the cattle which Allâh kills by its natural death), but invite them to your Lord. Verily you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) indeed are on the (true) straight guidance (i.e. the true religion of Islâmic Monotheism).

22.ar: وَإِن جَـٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
22.en: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allāh is most knowing of what you do.
22.tl: wa-in jādalūka faquli l-lahu aʿlamu bimā taʿmalūna

tr.85: and if they argue with you, say, ‘God is well aware of what you are doing.’
tr.19: And if they wrangle with thee, say: Allah is Best Aware of what ye do.
tr.22: If they do wrangle with thee, say, "Allah knows best what it is ye are doing."
tr.203: And if they argue with you (as regards the slaughtering of the sacrifices), say "Allâh knows best of what you do.

22.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
22.en: Allāh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
22.tl: al-lahu yaḥkumu baynakum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūna

tr.85: On the Day of Resurrection, God will judge between you regarding your differences.
tr.19: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ.
tr.22: "Allah will judge between you on the Day of Judgment concerning the matters in which ye differ."
tr.203: "Allâh will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection about that wherein you used to differ."

22.ar: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
22.en: Do you not know that Allāh knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allāh, is easy.
22.tl: alam taʿlam anna l-laha yaʿlamu mā fī l-samāi wal-arḍi inna dhālika fī kitābin inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun

tr.85: Are you [Prophet] not aware that God knows all that is in the heavens and earth? All this is written in a Record; this is easy for God.
tr.19: Hast thou not known that Allah knoweth all that is in the heaven and the earth? Lo! it is in a record. Lo! that is easy for Allah.
tr.22: Knowest thou not that Allah knows all that is in heaven and on earth? Indeed it is all in a Record, and that is easy for Allah.
tr.203: Know you not that Allâh knows all that is in the heaven and on the earth? Verily, it is (all) in the Book (Al-Lauh-al-Mahfûz). Verily that is easy for Allâh.

22.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍ
22.en: And they worship besides Allāh that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
22.tl: wayaʿbudūna min dūni l-lahi mā lam yunazzil bihi sul'ṭānan wamā laysa lahum bihi ʿil'mun wamā lilẓẓālimīna min naṣīrin

tr.85: Yet beside God they serve that for which He has sent no authority and of which they have no knowledge: the evildoers will have no one to help them.
tr.19: And they worship instead of Allah that for which He hath sent down no warrant, and that whereof they have no knowledge. For evil-doers there is no helper.
tr.22: Yet they worship, besides Allah, things for which no authority has been sent down to them, and of which they have (really) no knowledge: for those that do wrong there is no helper.
tr.203: And they worship besides Allâh others for which He has sent down no authority, and of which they have no knowledge; and for the Zâlimûn (wrong-doers, polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh) there is no helper.

22.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
22.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allāh has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
22.tl: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin taʿrifu fī wujūhi alladhīna kafarū l-munkara yakādūna yasṭūna bi-alladhīna yatlūna ʿalayhim āyātinā qul afa-unabbi-ukum bisharrin min dhālikumu l-nāru waʿadahā l-lahu alladhīna kafarū wabi'sa l-maṣīru

tr.85: [Prophet], you can see the hostility on the faces of the disbelievers when Our messages are recited clearly to them: it is almost as if they are going to attack those who recite Our messages to them. Say, ‘Shall I tell you what is far worse than what you feel now? The Fire that God has promised the disbelievers! What a dismal end!’
tr.19: And when Our revelations are recited unto them, thou knowest the denial in the faces of those who disbelieve; they all but attack those who recite Our revelations unto them. Say: Shall I proclaim unto you worse than that? The Fire! Allah hath promised it for those who disbelieve. A hapless journey's end!
tr.22: When Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them, thou wilt notice a denial on the faces of the Unbelievers! they nearly attack with violence those who rehearse Our Signs to them. Say, "Shall I tell you of something (far) worse than these Signs? It is the Fire (of Hell)! Allah has promised it to the Unbelievers! and evil is that destination!"
tr.203: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, you will notice a denial on the faces of the disbelievers! They are nearly ready to attack with violence those who recite Our Verses to them. Say: "Shall I tell you of something worse than that? The Fire (of Hell) which Allâh has promised to those who disbelieved, and worst indeed is that destination!"

22.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
22.en: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allāh will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
22.tl: yāayyuhā l-nāsu ḍuriba mathalun fa-is'tamiʿū lahu inna alladhīna tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi lan yakhluqū dhubāban walawi ij'tamaʿū lahu wa-in yaslub'humu l-dhubābu shayan lā yastanqidhūhu min'hu ḍaʿufa l-ṭālibu wal-maṭlūbu

tr.85: People, here is an illustration, so listen carefully: those you call on beside God could not, even if they combined all their forces, create a fly, and if a fly took something away from them, they would not be able to retrieve it. How feeble are the petitioners and how feeble are those they petition!
tr.19: O mankind! A similitude is coined, so pay ye heed to it: Lo! those on whom ye call beside Allah will never create a fly though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly took something from them, they could not rescue it from it. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought!
tr.22: O men! Here is a parable set forth! listen to it! Those on whom, besides Allah, ye call, cannot create (even) a fly, if they all met together for the purpose! and if the fly should snatch away anything from them, they would have no power to release it from the fly. Feeble are those who petition and those whom they petition!
tr.203: O mankind! A similitude has been coined, so listen to it (carefully): Verily those on whom you call besides Allâh, cannot create (even) a fly, even though they combine together for the purpose. And if the fly snatches away a thing from them, they will have no power to release it from the fly. So weak are (both) the seeker and the sought.

22.ar: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
22.en: They have not appraised Allāh with true appraisal. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
22.tl: mā qadarū l-laha ḥaqqa qadrihi inna l-laha laqawiyyun ʿazīzun

tr.85: They have no grasp of God’s true measure: God is truly most strong and mighty.
tr.19: They measure not Allah His rightful measure. Lo! Allah is Strong, Almighty.
tr.22: No just estimate have they made of Allah: for Allah is He Who is strong and able to Carry out His Will.
tr.203: They have not estimated Allâh His Rightful Estimate. Verily, Allâh is All-Strong, All-Mighty.

22.ar: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
22.en: Allāh chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.
22.tl: al-lahu yaṣṭafī mina l-malāikati rusulan wamina l-nāsi inna l-laha samīʿun baṣīrun

tr.85: God chooses messengers from among the angels and from among men. God is all hearing, all seeing:
tr.19: Allah chooseth from the angels messengers, and (also) from mankind. Lo! Allah is Hearer, Seer.
tr.22: Allah chooses messengers from angels and from men for Allah is He Who hears and sees (all things).
tr.203: Allâh chooses Messengers from angels and from men. Verily, Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Seer.

22.ar: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
22.en: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allāh will be returned [all] matters.
22.tl: yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru

tr.85: He knows what lies before and behind them. All matters return to Him.
tr.19: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A
tr.22: He knows what is before them and what is behind them: and to Allah go back all questions (for decision).
tr.203: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them. And to Allâh return all matters (for decision).

22.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩
22.en: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
22.tl: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū ir'kaʿū wa-us'judū wa-uʿ'budū rabbakum wa-if'ʿalū l-khayra laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna

tr.85: Believers, bow down, prostrate yourselves, worship your Lord, and do good so that you may succeed.
tr.19: O ye who believe! Bow down and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord, and do good, that haply ye may prosper.
tr.22: O ye who believe! bow down, prostrate yourselves, and adore your Lord; and do good; that ye may prosper.
tr.203: O you who have believed! Bow down, and prostrate yourselves, and worship your Lord and do good that you may be successful.

22.ar: وَجَـٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَـٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
22.en: And strive for Allāh with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. He [i.e., Allāh] named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakāh and hold fast to Allāh. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
22.tl: wajāhidū fī l-lahi ḥaqqa jihādihi huwa ij'tabākum wamā jaʿala ʿalaykum fī l-dīni min ḥarajin millata abīkum ib'rāhīma huwa sammākumu l-mus'limīna min qablu wafī hādhā liyakūna l-rasūlu shahīdan ʿalaykum watakūnū shuhadāa ʿalā l-nāsi fa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-iʿ'taṣimū bil-lahi huwa mawlākum faniʿ'ma l-mawlā waniʿ'ma l-naṣīru

tr.85: Strive hard for God as is His due: He has chosen you and placed no hardship in your religion, the faith of your forefather Abraham. God has called you Muslims––both in the past and in this [message]––so that the Messenger can bear witness about you and so that you can bear witness about other people. So keep up the prayer, give the prescribed alms, and seek refuge in God: He is your protector––an excellent protector and an excellent helper.
tr.19: And strive for Allah with the endeavour which is His right. He hath chosen you and hath not laid upon you in religion any hardship; the faith of your father Abraham (is yours). He hath named you Muslims of old time and in this (Scripture), that the messenger may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against mankind. So establish worship, pay the poor-due, and hold fast to Allah. He is your Protecting friend. A blessed Patron and a blessed Helper!
tr.22: And strive in His cause as ye ought to strive, (with sincerity and under discipline). He has chosen you, and has imposed no difficulties on you in religion; it is the cult of your father Abraham. It is He Who has named you Muslims, both before and in this (Revelation); that the Messenger may be a witness for you, and ye be witnesses for mankind! So establish regular Prayer, give regular Charity, and hold fast to Allah! He is your Protector - the Best to protect and the Best to help!
tr.203: And strive hard in Allâh’s Cause as you ought to strive (with sincerity and with all your efforts that His Name should be superior). He has chosen you (to convey His Message of Islâmic Monotheism to mankind by inviting them to His religion of Islâm), and has not laid upon you in religion any hardship: it is the religion of your father Ibrâhîm (Abraham) (Islâmic Monotheism). It is He (Allâh) Who has named you Muslims both before and in this (the Qur’ân), that the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) may be a witness over you and you be witnesses over mankind! So perform As-Salât (Iqamat-as-Salât), give Zakât and hold fast to Allâh [i.e. have confidence in Allâh, and depend upon Him in all your affairs]. He is your Maulâ (Patron, Lord), what an Excellent Maulâ (Patron, Lord) and what an Excellent Helper!

23.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
23.en: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
23.tl: qad aflaḥa l-mu'minūna

tr.85: [How] prosperous are the believers!
tr.19: Successful indeed are the believers
tr.22: The believers must (eventually) win through,-
tr.203: Successful indeed are the believers.

23.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ
23.en: They who are during their prayer humbly intent
23.tl: alladhīna hum fī ṣalātihim khāshiʿūna

tr.85: Those who pray humbly,
tr.19: Who are humble in their prayers,
tr.22: Those who humble themselves in their prayers;
tr.203: Those who offer their Salât (prayers) with all solemnity and full submissiveness.

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
23.en: And they who turn away from ill speech
23.tl: wa-alladhīna hum ʿani l-laghwi muʿ'riḍūna

tr.85: who shun idle talk,
tr.19: And who shun vain conversation,
tr.22: Who avoid vain talk;
tr.203: And those who turn away from Al-Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk, falsehood, and all that Allâh has forbidden).

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ
23.en: And they who are observant of zakāh
23.tl: wa-alladhīna hum lilzzakati fāʿilūna

tr.85: who pay the prescribed alms,
tr.19: And who are payers of the poor-due;
tr.22: Who are active in deeds of charity;
tr.203: And those who pay the Zakât.

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
23.en: And they who guard their private parts
23.tl: wa-alladhīna hum lifurūjihim ḥāfiẓūna

tr.85: who guard their chastity
tr.19: And who guard their modesty -
tr.22: Who abstain from sex,
tr.203: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts, from illegal sexual acts)

23.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
23.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
23.tl: illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna

tr.85: except with their spouses or their slaves––with these they are not to blame,
tr.19: Save from their wives or the (slaves) that their right hands possess, for then they are not blameworthy,
tr.22: Except with those joined to them in the marriage bond, or (the captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (in their case) they are free from blame,
tr.203: Except from their wives or (the slaves) that their right hands possess, - for then, they are free from blame;

23.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
23.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
23.tl: famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna

tr.85: but anyone who seeks more than this is exceeding the limits––
tr.19: But whoso craveth beyond that, such are transgressors -
tr.22: But those whose desires exceed those limits are transgressors;-
tr.203: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors;

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
23.en: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
23.tl: wa-alladhīna hum li-amānātihim waʿahdihim rāʿūna

tr.85: who are faithful to their trusts and pledges
tr.19: And who are shepherds of their pledge and their covenant,
tr.22: Those who faithfully observe their trusts and their covenants;
tr.203: Those who are faithfully true to their Amanât (all the duties which Allâh has ordained, honesty, moral responsibility and trusts) and to their covenants;

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
23.en: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
23.tl: wa-alladhīna hum ʿalā ṣalawātihim yuḥāfiẓūna

tr.85: and who keep up their prayers,
tr.19: And who pay heed to their prayers.
tr.22: And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
tr.203: And those who strictly guard their (five compulsory congregational) Salawât (prayers) (at their fixed stated hours).

23.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
23.en: Those are the inheritors
23.tl: ulāika humu l-wārithūna

tr.85: will rightly be given
tr.19: These are the heirs
tr.22: These will be the heirs,
tr.203: These are indeed the inheritors

23.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
23.en: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
23.tl: alladhīna yarithūna l-fir'dawsa hum fīhā khālidūna

tr.85: Paradise as their own, there to remain.
tr.19: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
tr.22: Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
tr.203: Who shall inherit the Firdaus (Paradise). They shall dwell therein forever.

23.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن طِينٍ
23.en: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
23.tl: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna min sulālatin min ṭīnin

tr.85: We created man from an essence of clay,
tr.19: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
tr.22: Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
tr.203: And indeed We created man (Adam) out of an extract of clay (water and earth).

23.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةً فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
23.en: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
23.tl: thumma jaʿalnāhu nuṭ'fatan fī qarārin makīnin

tr.85: then We placed him as a drop of fluid in a safe place,
tr.19: Then placed him as a drop (of seed) in a safe lodging;
tr.22: Then We placed him as (a drop of) sperm in a place of rest, firmly fixed;
tr.203: Thereafter We made him (the offspring of Adam) as a Nutfah (mixed drops of the male and female sexual discharge and lodged it) in a safe lodging (womb of the woman).

23.ar: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةً فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
23.en: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allāh, the best of creators.
23.tl: thumma khalaqnā l-nuṭ'fata ʿalaqatan fakhalaqnā l-ʿalaqata muḍ'ghatan fakhalaqnā l-muḍ'ghata ʿiẓāman fakasawnā l-ʿiẓāma laḥman thumma anshanāhu khalqan ākhara fatabāraka l-lahu aḥsanu l-khāliqīna

tr.85: then We made that drop into a clinging form, and We made that form into a lump of flesh, and We made that lump into bones, and We clothed those bones with flesh, and later We made him into other forms––glory be to God, the best of creators!––
tr.19: Then fashioned We the drop a clot, then fashioned We the clot a little lump, then fashioned We the little lump bones, then clothed the bones with flesh, and then produced it as another creation. So blessed be Allah, the Best of creators!
tr.22: Then We made the sperm into a clot of congealed blood; then of that clot We made a (foetus) lump; then we made out of that lump bones and clothed the bones with flesh; then we developed out of it another creature. So blessed be Allah, the best to create!
tr.203: Then We made the Nutfah into a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood), then We made the clot into a little lump of flesh, then We made out of that little lump of flesh bones, then We clothed the bones with flesh, and then We brought it forth as another creation. So Blessed is Allâh, the Best of creators.

23.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
23.en: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
23.tl: thumma innakum baʿda dhālika lamayyitūna

tr.85: then you will die
tr.19: Then lo! after that ye surely die.
tr.22: After that, at length ye will die
tr.203: After that, surely, you will die.

23.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
23.en: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
23.tl: thumma innakum yawma l-qiyāmati tub'ʿathūna

tr.85: and then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be raised up again.
tr.19: Then lo! on the Day of Resurrection ye are raised (again).
tr.22: Again, on the Day of Judgment, will ye be raised up.
tr.203: Then (again), surely, you will be resurrected on the Day of Resurrection.

23.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ
23.en: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
23.tl: walaqad khalaqnā fawqakum sabʿa ṭarāiqa wamā kunnā ʿani l-khalqi ghāfilīna

tr.85: We created seven levels above you: We are never unmindful of Our creation.
tr.19: And We have created above you seven paths, and We are never unmindful of creation.
tr.22: And We have made, above you, seven tracts; and We are never unmindful of (our) Creation.
tr.203: And indeed We have created above you seven heavens (one over the other), and We are never unaware of the creation.

23.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
23.en: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
23.tl: wa-anzalnā mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-askannāhu fī l-arḍi wa-innā ʿalā dhahābin bihi laqādirūna

tr.85: We sent water down from the sky in due measure and lodged it in the earth––We have the power to take it all away if We so wish––
tr.19: And we send down from the sky water in measure, and We give it lodging in the earth, and lo! We are Able to withdraw it.
tr.22: And We send down water from the sky according to (due) measure, and We cause it to soak in the soil; and We certainly are able to drain it off (with ease).
tr.203: And We sent down from the sky water (rain) in (due) measure, and We gave it lodging in the earth, and verily, We are Able to take it away.

23.ar: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
23.en: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
23.tl: fa-anshanā lakum bihi jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin lakum fīhā fawākihu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna

tr.85: with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines, with many fruits there for you to eat,
tr.19: Then We produce for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you and whereof ye eat;
tr.22: With it We grow for you gardens of date-palms and vines: in them have ye abundant fruits: and of them ye eat (and have enjoyment),-
tr.203: Then We brought forth for you therewith gardens of date-palms and grapes, wherein is much fruit for you, and whereof you eat.

23.ar: وَشَجَرَةً تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ
23.en: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
23.tl: washajaratan takhruju min ṭūri saynāa tanbutu bil-duh'ni waṣib'ghin lil'ākilīna

tr.85: and a tree, growing out of Mount Sinai, that produces oil and seasoning for your food.
tr.19: And a tree that springeth forth from Mount Sinai that groweth oil and relish for the eaters.
tr.22: Also a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, which produces oil, and relish for those who use it for food.
tr.203: And a tree (olive) that springs forth from Mount Sinai, that grows (produces) oil, and (it is a) relish for the eaters.

23.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةً ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
23.en: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
23.tl: wa-inna lakum fī l-anʿāmi laʿib'ratan nus'qīkum mimmā fī buṭūnihā walakum fīhā manāfiʿu kathīratun wamin'hā takulūna

tr.85: There is a lesson for you in livestock: We produce milk for you to drink from their bellies. And they have many other benefits: you eat them
tr.19: And lo! in the cattle there is verily a lesson for you. We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and many uses have ye in them, and of them do ye eat;
tr.22: And in cattle (too) ye have an instructive example: from within their bodies We produce (milk) for you to drink; there are, in them, (besides), numerous (other) benefits for you; and of their (meat) ye eat;
tr.203: And verily in the cattle there is indeed a lesson for you. We give you to drink (milk) of that which is in their bellies. And there are, in them, numerous (other) benefits for you, and of them you eat.

23.ar: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
23.en: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
23.tl: waʿalayhā waʿalā l-ful'ki tuḥ'malūna

tr.85: and you ride on them, as you do in ships.
tr.19: And on them and on the ship ye are carried.
tr.22: And on them, as well as in ships, ye ride.
tr.203: And on them, and on ships you are carried.

23.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
23.en: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
23.tl: walaqad arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi faqāla yāqawmi uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna

tr.85: We sent Noah to his people. He said, ‘My people, serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
tr.19: And We verily sent Noah unto his folk, and he said: O my people! Serve Allah. Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: (Further, We sent a long line of prophets for your instruction). We sent Noah to his people: He said, "O my people! worship Allah! Ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
tr.203: And indeed We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people, and he said: "O my people! Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh (God) but Him (Islâmic Monotheism). Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"

23.ar: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
23.en: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allāh had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
23.tl: faqāla l-mala-u alladhīna kafarū min qawmihi mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yurīdu an yatafaḍḍala ʿalaykum walaw shāa l-lahu la-anzala malāikatan mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī ābāinā l-awalīna

tr.85: But the leading disbelievers among his people said, ‘He is merely a mortal like you, trying to gain some superiority over you. God would have sent down angels if He had wished; besides, we never heard of anything like this from our forefathers.
tr.19: But the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved, said: This is only a mortal like you who would make himself superior to you. Had Allah willed, He surely could have sent down angels. We heard not of this in the case of our fathers of old.
tr.22: The chiefs of the Unbelievers among his people said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: his wish is to assert his superiority over you: if Allah had wished (to send messengers), He could have sent down angels; never did we hear such a thing (as he says), among our ancestors of old."
tr.203: But the chiefs of his people who disbelieved said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he seeks to make himself superior to you. Had Allâh willed, He surely could have sent down angels. Never did we hear such a thing among our fathers of old.

23.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
23.en: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
23.tl: in huwa illā rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbaṣū bihi ḥattā ḥīnin

tr.85: He is just a madman, so let’s wait and see what happens to him.’
tr.19: He is only a man in whom is a madness, so watch him for a while.
tr.22: (And some said): "He is only a man possessed: wait (and have patience) with him for a time."
tr.203: "He is only a man in whom is madness, so wait for him a while."

23.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
23.en: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
23.tl: qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni

tr.85: Noah said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
tr.19: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
tr.22: (Noah) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood!"
tr.203: [Nûh (Noah)] said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."

23.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
23.en: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except him for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
23.tl: fa-awḥaynā ilayhi ani iṣ'naʿi l-ful'ka bi-aʿyuninā wawaḥyinā fa-idhā jāa amrunā wafāra l-tanūru fa-us'luk fīhā min kullin zawjayni ith'nayni wa-ahlaka illā man sabaqa ʿalayhi l-qawlu min'hum walā tukhāṭib'nī fī alladhīna ẓalamū innahum mugh'raqūna

tr.85: and so We revealed to him: ‘Build the Ark under Our watchful eye and according to Our revelation. When Our command comes and water gushes up out of the earth,take pairs of every species on board, and your family, except for those on whom the sentence has already been passed- do not plead with me for the evildoers: they will be drowned-
tr.19: Then We inspired in him, saying: Make the ship under Our eyes and Our inspiration. Then, when Our command cometh and the oven gusheth water, introduce therein of every (kind) two spouses, and thy household save him thereof against whom the Word hath already gone forth. And plead not with Me on behalf of those who have done wrong. Lo! they will be drowned.
tr.22: So We inspired him (with this message): "Construct the Ark within Our sight and under Our guidance: then when comes Our Command, and the fountains of the earth gush forth, take thou on board pairs of every species, male and female, and thy family- except those of them against whom the Word has already gone forth: And address Me not in favour of the wrong-doers; for they shall be drowned (in the Flood).
tr.203: So We revealed to him (saying): "Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our Revelation (guidance). Then, when Our Command comes, and water gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two (male and female), and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favour of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned.

23.ar: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
23.en: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allāh who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
23.tl: fa-idhā is'tawayta anta waman maʿaka ʿalā l-ful'ki faquli l-ḥamdu lillahi alladhī najjānā mina l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna

tr.85: and when you and your companions are settled on the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who delivered us from the wicked people,”
tr.19: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
tr.22: And when thou hast embarked on the Ark - thou and those with thee,- say: "Praise be to Allah, Who has saved us from the people who do wrong."
tr.203: And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: "All the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Who has saved us from the people who are Zâlimûn (i.e. oppressors, wrong-doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allâh).

23.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًا مُّبَارَكًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
23.en: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].'"
23.tl: waqul rabbi anzil'nī munzalan mubārakan wa-anta khayru l-munzilīna

tr.85: and say, “My Lord, let me land with Your blessing: it is You who provide the best landings”.’
tr.19: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
tr.22: And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
tr.203: And say: "My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land."

23.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
23.en: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
23.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyātin wa-in kunnā lamub'talīna

tr.85: There are signs in all this: We have always put [people] to the test.
tr.19: Lo! herein verily are portents, for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test.
tr.22: Verily in this there are Signs (for men to understand); (thus) do We try (men).
tr.203: Verily, in this [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nûh (Noah)], there are indeed Ayât (proofs, evidence, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand), for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test.

23.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
23.en: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
23.tl: thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qarnan ākharīna

tr.85: Then We raised another generation after them,
tr.19: Then, after them, We brought forth another generation;
tr.22: Then We raised after them another generation.
tr.203: Then, after them, We created another generation.

23.ar: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
23.en: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allāh; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
23.tl: fa-arsalnā fīhim rasūlan min'hum ani uʿ'budū l-laha mā lakum min ilāhin ghayruhu afalā tattaqūna

tr.85: and sent one of their own as a messenger: ‘Serve God, for He is your only god. Will you not heed Him?’
tr.19: And we sent among them a messenger of their own, saying: Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him. Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: And We sent to them a messenger from among themselves, (saying), "Worship Allah! ye have no other god but Him. Will ye not fear (Him)?"
tr.203: And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): "Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh (God) but Him. Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?"

23.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
23.en: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
23.tl: waqāla l-mala-u min qawmihi alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biliqāi l-ākhirati wa-atrafnāhum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā mā hādhā illā basharun mith'lukum yakulu mimmā takulūna min'hu wayashrabu mimmā tashrabūna

tr.85: But the leading disbelievers among his people, who denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, to whom We had granted ease and plenty in this life, said, ‘He is just a mortal like you- he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink-
tr.19: And the chieftains of his folk, who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and whom We had made soft in the life of the world, said: This is only a mortal like you, who eateth of that whereof ye eat and drinketh of that ye drink.
tr.22: And the chiefs of his people, who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and on whom We had bestowed the good things of this life, said: "He is no more than a man like yourselves: he eats of that of which ye eat, and drinks of what ye drink.
tr.203: And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: "He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink.

23.ar: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
23.en: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
23.tl: wala-in aṭaʿtum basharan mith'lakum innakum idhan lakhāsirūna

tr.85: and you will really be losers if you obey a mortal like yourselves.
tr.19: If ye were to obey a mortal like yourselves, then, lo! ye surely would be losers.
tr.22: "If ye obey a man like yourselves, behold, it is certain ye will be lost.
tr.203: "If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily you indeed would be losers.

23.ar: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
23.en: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
23.tl: ayaʿidukum annakum idhā mittum wakuntum turāban waʿiẓāman annakum mukh'rajūna

tr.85: How can he promise you that after you die and become dust and bones you will be brought out alive?
tr.19: Doth he promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust and bones, will (again) be brought forth?
tr.22: "Does he promise that when ye die and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth (again)?
tr.203: "Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive (resurrected)?

23.ar: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
23.en: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
23.tl: hayhāta hayhāta limā tūʿadūna

tr.85: What you are promised is very farfetched.
tr.19: Begone, begone, with that which ye are promised!
tr.22: "Far, very far is that which ye are promised!
tr.203: "Far, very far is that which you are promised!

23.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
23.en: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
23.tl: in hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā naḥnu bimabʿūthīna

tr.85: There is only the life of this world: we die, we live, but we will never be resurrected.
tr.19: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
tr.22: "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
tr.203: "There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!

23.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
23.en: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allāh, and we will not believe him."
23.tl: in huwa illā rajulun if'tarā ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban wamā naḥnu lahu bimu'minīna

tr.85: He is just a man making lies up about God. We will never believe in him.’
tr.19: He is only a man who hath invented a lie about Allah. We are not going to put faith in him.
tr.22: "He is only a man who invents a lie against Allah, but we are not the ones to believe in him!"
tr.203: "He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allâh, and we are not going to believe in him."

23.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
23.en: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
23.tl: qāla rabbi unṣur'nī bimā kadhabūni

tr.85: The prophet said, ‘My Lord, help me! They call me a liar,’
tr.19: He said: My Lord! Help me because they deny me.
tr.22: (The prophet) said: "O my Lord! help me: for that they accuse me of falsehood."
tr.203: He said: "O my Lord! Help me because they deny me."

23.ar: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ
23.en: [Allāh] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
23.tl: qāla ʿammā qalīlin layuṣ'biḥunna nādimīna

tr.85: and so God said, ‘Soon they will be filled with regret.’
tr.19: He said: In a little while they surely will become repentant.
tr.22: (Allah) said: "In but a little while, they are sure to be sorry!"
tr.203: (Allâh) said: "In a little while, they are sure to be regretful."

23.ar: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءً ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
23.en: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
23.tl: fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣayḥatu bil-ḥaqi fajaʿalnāhum ghuthāan fabuʿ'dan lil'qawmi l-ẓālimīna

tr.85: The blast justly struck them and We swept them away like scum. Away with the evildoers!
tr.19: So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully, and We made them like as wreckage (that a torrent hurleth). A far removal for wrongdoing folk!
tr.22: Then the Blast overtook them with justice, and We made them as rubbish of dead leaves (floating on the stream of Time)! So away with the people who do wrong!
tr.203: So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry) overtook them in truth (with justice), and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So away with the people who are Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, disobedient to His Messengers).

23.ar: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
23.en: Then We produced after them other generations.
23.tl: thumma anshanā min baʿdihim qurūnan ākharīna

tr.85: We raised other generations after them-
tr.19: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
tr.22: Then We raised after them other generations.
tr.203: Then, after them, We created other generations.

23.ar: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
23.en: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
23.tl: mā tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahā wamā yastakhirūna

tr.85: no community can advance or delay its time-
tr.19: No nation can outstrip its term, nor yet postpone it.
tr.22: No people can hasten their term, nor can they delay (it).
tr.203: No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it.

23.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًا لِّقَوْمٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
23.en: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
23.tl: thumma arsalnā rusulanā tatrā kulla mā jāa ummatan rasūluhā kadhabūhu fa-atbaʿnā baʿḍahum baʿḍan wajaʿalnāhum aḥādītha fabuʿ'dan liqawmin lā yu'minūna

tr.85: and We sent Our messengers in succession: whenever a messenger came to a community they invariably called him a liar, so We destroyed them one after the other and made them into cautionary tales. Away with the disbelievers!
tr.19: Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him; so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster) and We made them bywords. A far removal for folk who believe not!
tr.22: Then sent We our messengers in succession: every time there came to a people their messenger, they accused him of falsehood: so We made them follow each other (in punishment): We made them as a tale (that is told): So away with a people that will not believe!
tr.203: Then We sent Our Messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them as Ahadîth (the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them). So away with a people who believe not!

23.ar: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
23.en: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
23.tl: thumma arsalnā mūsā wa-akhāhu hārūna biāyātinā wasul'ṭānin mubīnin

tr.85: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and clear authority,
tr.19: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our tokens and a clear warrant
tr.22: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our Signs and authority manifest,
tr.203: Then We sent Mûsa (Moses) and his brother Hârûn‎‎ (Aaron), with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and manifest authority,

23.ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
23.en: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
23.tl: ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi fa-is'takbarū wakānū qawman ʿālīna

tr.85: to Pharaoh and his prominent leaders, but they responded with arrogance: they were a haughty people.
tr.19: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them) and they were despotic folk.
tr.22: To Pharaoh and his Chiefs: But these behaved insolently: they were an arrogant people.
tr.203: To Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allâh).

23.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ
23.en: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
23.tl: faqālū anu'minu libasharayni mith'linā waqawmuhumā lanā ʿābidūna

tr.85: They said, ‘Are we to believe in two mortals like us? And their people are our servants?’
tr.19: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
tr.22: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
tr.203: They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like)."

23.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
23.en: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
23.tl: fakadhabūhumā fakānū mina l-muh'lakīna

tr.85: and so they called them both liars: they became another ruined people.
tr.19: So they denied them, and became of those who were destroyed.
tr.22: So they accused them of falsehood, and they became of those who were destroyed.
tr.203: So they denied them both [Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)] and became of those who were destroyed.

23.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
23.en: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
23.tl: walaqad ātaynā mūsā l-kitāba laʿallahum yahtadūna

tr.85: We gave Moses the Scripture, so that they might be rightly guided.
tr.19: And We verily gave Moses the Scripture, that haply they might go aright.
tr.22: And We gave Moses the Book, in order that they might receive guidance.
tr.203: And indeed We gave Mûsâ (Moses) the Scripture, that they may be guided.

23.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةً وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
23.en: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
23.tl: wajaʿalnā ib'na maryama wa-ummahu āyatan waāwaynāhumā ilā rabwatin dhāti qarārin wamaʿīnin

tr.85: We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign; We gave them shelter on a peaceful hillside with flowing water.
tr.19: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a portent, and We gave them refuge on a height, a place of flocks and watersprings.
tr.22: And We made the son of Mary and his mother as a Sign: We gave them both shelter on high ground, affording rest and security and furnished with springs.
tr.203: And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams.

23.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
23.en: [Allāh said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
23.tl: yāayyuhā l-rusulu kulū mina l-ṭayibāti wa-iʿ'malū ṣāliḥan innī bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun

tr.85: Messengers, eat good things and do good deeds: I am well aware of what you do.
tr.19: O ye messengers! Eat of the good things, and do right. Lo! I am Aware of what ye do.
tr.22: O ye messengers! enjoy (all) things good and pure, and work righteousness: for I am well-acquainted with (all) that ye do.
tr.203: O (you) Messengers! Eat of the Tayyibât [all kinds of Halâl foods which Allâh has made lawful (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, milk products, fats, vegetables, fruits, etc.] and do righteous deeds. Verily! I am Well-Acquainted with what you do.

23.ar: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
23.en: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
23.tl: wa-inna hādhihi ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa-anā rabbukum fa-ittaqūni

tr.85: This community of yours is one- and I am your Lord: be mindful of Me-
tr.19: And lo! this your religion is one religion and I am your Lord, so keep your duty unto Me.
tr.22: And verily this Brotherhood of yours is a single Brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore fear Me (and no other).
tr.203: And verily this your religion (of Islâmic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear (keep your duty to) Me.

23.ar: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
23.en: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
23.tl: fataqaṭṭaʿū amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu ḥiz'bin bimā ladayhim fariḥūna

tr.85: but they have split their community into sects, each rejoicing in their own.
tr.19: But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in its tenets.
tr.22: But people have cut off their affair (of unity), between them, into sects: each party rejoices in that which is with itself.
tr.203: But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects, each group rejoicing in what is with it (as its beliefs).

23.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
23.en: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
23.tl: fadharhum fī ghamratihim ḥattā ḥīnin

tr.85: So [Muhammad] leave them for a while steeped [in their ignorance].
tr.19: So leave them in their error till a time.
tr.22: But leave them in their confused ignorance for a time.
tr.203: So leave them in their error for a time.

23.ar: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
23.en: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
23.tl: ayaḥsabūna annamā numidduhum bihi min mālin wabanīna

tr.85: Do they reckon that, by giving them wealth and sons,
tr.19: Think they that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them
tr.22: Do they think that because We have granted them abundance of wealth and sons,
tr.203: Do they think that in wealth and children with which We enlarge them

23.ar: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
23.en: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
23.tl: nusāriʿu lahum fī l-khayrāti bal lā yashʿurūna

tr.85: We race to give them good things? They really have no idea!
tr.19: We hasten unto them with good things? Nay, but they perceive not.
tr.22: We would hasten them on in every good? Nay, they do not understand.
tr.203: We hasten unto them with good things. Nay, [it is a Fitnah (trial) in this worldly life so that they will have no share of good things in the Hereafter] but they perceive not. [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi].

23.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
23.en: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
23.tl: inna alladhīna hum min khashyati rabbihim mush'fiqūna

tr.85: Those who stand in awe of their Lord,
tr.19: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
tr.22: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
tr.203: Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
23.en: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
23.tl: wa-alladhīna hum biāyāti rabbihim yu'minūna

tr.85: who believe in His messages,
tr.19: And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord,
tr.22: Those who believe in the Signs of their Lord;
tr.203: And those who believe in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord;

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
23.en: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
23.tl: wa-alladhīna hum birabbihim lā yush'rikūna

tr.85: who do not ascribe partners to Him,
tr.19: And those who ascribe not partners unto their Lord,
tr.22: Those who join not (in worship) partners with their Lord;
tr.203: And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;

23.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
23.en: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
23.tl: wa-alladhīna yu'tūna mā ātaw waqulūbuhum wajilatun annahum ilā rabbihim rājiʿūna

tr.85: who always give with hearts that tremble at the thought that they must return to Him,
tr.19: And those who give that which they give with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord,
tr.22: And those who dispense their charity with their hearts full of fear, because they will return to their Lord;-
tr.203: And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities have been accepted or not), because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning).

23.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ
23.en: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
