23.tl: ulāika yusāriʿūna fī l-khayrāti wahum lahā sābiqūna

tr.85: are the ones who race toward good things, and they will be the first to get them.
tr.19: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.
tr.22: It is these who hasten in every good work, and these who are foremost in them.
tr.203: It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them [e.g. offering the compulsory Salât (prayers) in their (early) stated, fixed times and so on].

23.ar: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَـٰبٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
23.en: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
23.tl: walā nukallifu nafsan illā wus'ʿahā waladaynā kitābun yanṭiqu bil-ḥaqi wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna

tr.85: We do not burden any soul with more than it can bear- We have a Record that tells the truth- they will not be wronged.
tr.19: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
tr.22: On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
tr.203: And We task not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.

23.ar: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلٌ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ
23.en: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
23.tl: bal qulūbuhum fī ghamratin min hādhā walahum aʿmālun min dūni dhālika hum lahā ʿāmilūna

tr.85: But the disbelievers’ hearts are steeped [in ignorance of ] all this; and there are other things besides this that they do.
tr.19: Nay, but their hearts are in ignorance of this (Qur'an), and they have other works, besides, which they are doing;
tr.22: But their hearts are in confused ignorance of this; and there are, besides that, deeds of theirs, which they will (continue) to do,-
tr.203: Nay, but their hearts are covered from (understanding) this (the Qur’ân), and they have other (evil) deeds, besides, which they are doing.

23.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
23.en: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allāh] for help.
23.tl: ḥattā idhā akhadhnā mut'rafīhim bil-ʿadhābi idhā hum yajarūna

tr.85: When We bring Our punishment on those corrupted with wealth, they will cry for help:
tr.19: Till when We grasp their luxurious ones with the punishment, behold! they supplicate.
tr.22: Until, when We seize in Punishment those of them who received the good things of this world, behold, they will groan in supplication!
tr.203: Until when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment: behold they make humble invocation with a loud voice.

23.ar: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
23.en: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
23.tl: lā tajarū l-yawma innakum minnā lā tunṣarūna

tr.85: ‘Do not cry out today: you will get no help from Us.
tr.19: Supplicate not this day! Assuredly ye will not be helped by Us.
tr.22: (It will be said): "Groan not in supplication this day: for ye shall certainly not be helped by Us.
tr.203: Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly you shall not be helped by Us.

23.ar: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
23.en: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels.
23.tl: qad kānat āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum ʿalā aʿqābikum tankiṣūna

tr.85: Time and time again My messages were recited to you, but you turned arrogantly on your heels,
tr.19: My revelations were recited unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels,
tr.22: "My Signs used to be rehearsed to you, but ye used to turn back on your heels-
tr.203: Indeed My Verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (denying them, and refusing with hatred to listen to them).

23.ar: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَـٰمِرًا تَهْجُرُونَ
23.en: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
23.tl: mus'takbirīna bihi sāmiran tahjurūna

tr.85: and spent the evening making fun of [the Quran].’
tr.19: In scorn thereof. Nightly did ye rave together.
tr.22: "In arrogance: talking nonsense about the (Qur'an), like one telling fables by night."
tr.203: In pride (they - Quraish pagans and polytheists of Makkah used to feel proud that they are the dwellers of Makkah sanctuary - Haram), talking evil about it (the Qur’ân) by night.

23.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
23.en: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
23.tl: afalam yaddabbarū l-qawla am jāahum mā lam yati ābāahumu l-awalīna

tr.85: Have they not contemplated the Word of God? Has something come to them that did not come to their forefathers?
tr.19: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
tr.22: Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
tr.203: Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allâh, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?

23.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
23.en: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
23.tl: am lam yaʿrifū rasūlahum fahum lahu munkirūna

tr.85: Do they not recognize their Messenger? So why do they reject him?
tr.19: Or know they not their messenger, and so reject him?
tr.22: Or do they not recognise their Messenger, that they deny him?
tr.203: Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) so they deny him?

23.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
23.en: Or do they say, "In him is madness"? Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
23.tl: am yaqūlūna bihi jinnatun bal jāahum bil-ḥaqi wa-aktharuhum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna

tr.85: Why do they say he is possessed? He has brought them the truth and most of them hate it,
tr.19: Or say they: There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth; and most of them are haters of the Truth.
tr.22: Or do they say, "He is possessed"? Nay, he has brought them the Truth, but most of them hate the Truth.
tr.203: Or say they: There is madness in him? Nay, but he brought them the truth [i.e. Tauhîd: Worshipping Allâh Alone in all aspects, the Qur’ân and the religion of Islâm], but most of them (the disbelievers) are averse to the truth.

23.ar: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
23.en: But if the Truth [i.e., Allāh] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
23.tl: walawi ittabaʿa l-ḥaqu ahwāahum lafasadati l-samāwātu wal-arḍu waman fīhinna bal ataynāhum bidhik'rihim fahum ʿan dhik'rihim muʿ'riḍūna

tr.85: but if the truth were in accordance with their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would disintegrate. We have brought them their Reminder and they turn away from it.
tr.19: And if the Truth had followed their desires, verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder, but from their Reminder they now turn away.
tr.22: If the Truth had been in accord with their desires, truly the heavens and the earth, and all beings therein would have been in confusion and corruption! Nay, We have sent them their admonition, but they turn away from their admonition.
tr.203: And if the truth had been in accordance with their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder, but they turn away from their reminder.

23.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
23.en: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
23.tl: am tasaluhum kharjan fakharāju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru l-rāziqīna

tr.85: Do you [Prophet] ask them for any payment? Your Lord’s is the best payment: He is the Best of Providers.
tr.19: Or dost thou ask of them (O Muhammad) any tribute? But the bounty of thy Lord is better, for He is Best of all who make provision.
tr.22: Or is it that thou askest them for some recompense? But the recompense of thy Lord is best: He is the Best of those who give sustenance.
tr.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask them for some wages? But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance.

23.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
23.en: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
23.tl: wa-innaka latadʿūhum ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin

tr.85: You call them to a straight path
tr.19: And lo! thou summonest them indeed unto a straight path.
tr.22: But verily thou callest them to the Straight Way;
tr.203: And certainly, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) call them to the Straight Path (true religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

23.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ
23.en: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
23.tl: wa-inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati ʿani l-ṣirāṭi lanākibūna

tr.85: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter turn away from that path.
tr.19: And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed astray from the path.
tr.22: And verily those who believe not in the Hereafter are deviating from that Way.
tr.203: And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the Path (true religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

23.ar: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
23.en: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
23.tl: walaw raḥim'nāhum wakashafnā mā bihim min ḍurrin lalajjū fī ṭugh'yānihim yaʿmahūna

tr.85: Even if We were to show them mercy and relieve them of distress, they would blindly persist in their transgression.
tr.19: Though We had mercy on them and relieved them of the harm afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on in their contumacy.
tr.22: If We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering in distraction to and fro.
tr.203: And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.

23.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
23.en: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
23.tl: walaqad akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi famā is'takānū lirabbihim wamā yataḍarraʿūna

tr.85: We have already afflicted them, yet they did not submit to their Lord: they will not humble themselves
tr.19: Already have We grasped them with punishment, but they humble not themselves unto their Lord, nor do they pray,
tr.22: We inflicted Punishment on them, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor do they submissively entreat (Him)!-
tr.203: And indeed We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke (Allâh) with submission to Him.

23.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
23.en: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
23.tl: ḥattā idhā fataḥnā ʿalayhim bāban dhā ʿadhābin shadīdin idhā hum fīhi mub'lisūna

tr.85: until We open a gate to severe torment for them- then they will be plunged into utter despair.
tr.19: Until, when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment, behold! they are aghast thereat.
tr.22: Until We open on them a gate leading to a severe Punishment: then Lo! they will be plunged in despair therein!
tr.203: Until, when We open for them the gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair.

23.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
23.en: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
23.tl: wahuwa alladhī ansha-a lakumu l-samʿa wal-abṣāra wal-afidata qalīlan mā tashkurūna

tr.85: It is God who endowed you with hearing, sight, and hearts- how seldom you are grateful!
tr.19: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
tr.22: It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
tr.203: It is He Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), eyes (sight), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give.

23.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
23.en: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
23.tl: wahuwa alladhī dhara-akum fī l-arḍi wa-ilayhi tuḥ'sharūna

tr.85: It is He who made you multiply on earth. It is to Him that you will be gathered:
tr.19: And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered.
tr.22: And He has multiplied you through the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered back.
tr.203: And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back.

23.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَـٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
23.en: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
23.tl: wahuwa alladhī yuḥ'yī wayumītu walahu ikh'tilāfu al-layli wal-nahāri afalā taʿqilūna

tr.85: it is He who gives life and death; the alternation of night and day depends on Him; will you not use your minds?
tr.19: And He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and His is the difference of night and day. Have ye then no sense?
tr.22: It is He Who gives life and death, and to Him (is due) the alternation of Night and Day: will ye not then understand?
tr.203: And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?

23.ar: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
23.en: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
23.tl: bal qālū mith'la mā qāla l-awalūna

tr.85: But, like others before them,
tr.19: Nay, but they say the like of that which said the men of old;
tr.22: On the contrary they say things similar to what the ancients said.
tr.203: Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said.

23.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
23.en: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
23.tl: qālū a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna

tr.85: they say, ‘What? When we die and turn to dust and bones, shall we really be resurrected?
tr.19: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
tr.22: They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
tr.203: They said: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?

23.ar: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
23.en: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
23.tl: laqad wuʿid'nā naḥnu waābāunā hādhā min qablu in hādhā illā asāṭīru l-awalīna

tr.85: We have heard such promises before, and so did our forefathers. These are just ancient fables.’
tr.19: We were already promised this, we and our forefathers. Lo! this is naught but fables of the men of old.
tr.22: "Such things have been promised to us and to our fathers before! they are nothing but tales of the ancients!"
tr.203: "Verily, this we have been promised - we and our fathers before (us)! This is only the tales of the ancients!"

23.ar: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
23.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
23.tl: qul limani l-arḍu waman fīhā in kuntum taʿlamūna

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Who owns the earth and all who live in it, if you know [so much]?’
tr.19: Say: Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein, if ye have knowledge?
tr.22: Say: "To whom belong the earth and all beings therein? (say) if ye know!"
tr.203: Say: "Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know!"

23.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
23.en: They will say, "To Allāh." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
23.tl: sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tadhakkarūna

tr.85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not take heed?’
tr.19: They will say: Unto Allah. Say: Will ye not then remember?
tr.22: They will say, "To Allah!" say: "Yet will ye not receive admonition?"
tr.203: They will say: "It is Allâh’s!" Say: "Will you not then remember?"

23.ar: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
23.en: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
23.tl: qul man rabbu l-samāwāti l-sabʿi warabbu l-ʿarshi l-ʿaẓīmi

tr.85: Say, ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens? Who is the Lord of the Mighty Throne?’
tr.19: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?
tr.22: Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
tr.203: Say: "Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne?"

23.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
23.en: They will say, "[They belong] to Allāh." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
23.tl: sayaqūlūna lillahi qul afalā tattaqūna

tr.85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Will you not be mindful?’
tr.19: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)?
tr.22: They will say, "(They belong) to Allah." Say: "Will ye not then be filled with awe?"
tr.203: They will say: "Allâh." Say: "Will you not then fear Allâh (believe in His Oneness, obey Him, believe in the Resurrection and Recompense for every good or bad deed)?"

23.ar: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
23.en: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
23.tl: qul man biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wahuwa yujīru walā yujāru ʿalayhi in kuntum taʿlamūna

tr.85: Say, ‘Who holds control of everything in His hand? Who protects, while there is no protection against Him, if you know [so much]?’
tr.19: Say: In Whose hand is the dominion over all things and He protecteth, while against Him there is no protection, if ye have knowledge?
tr.22: Say: "Who is it in whose hands is the governance of all things,- who protects (all), but is not protected (of any)? (say) if ye know."
tr.203: Say "In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything (i.e. treasures of each and everything)? And He protects (all), while against Whom there is no protector, (i.e. if Allâh saves anyone none can punish or harm him, and if Allâh punishes or harms anyone none can save him), if you know?" [Tafsir Al-Qurtubî]

23.ar: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
23.en: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allāh." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
23.tl: sayaqūlūna lillahi qul fa-annā tus'ḥarūna

tr.85: and they will reply, ‘God.’ Say, ‘Then how can you be so deluded?’
tr.19: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth). Say: How then are ye bewitched?
tr.22: They will say, "(It belongs) to Allah." Say: "Then how are ye deluded?"
tr.203: They will say: "(All that belongs) to Allâh." Say: "How then are you deceived and turn away from the truth?"

23.ar: بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
23.en: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
23.tl: bal ataynāhum bil-ḥaqi wa-innahum lakādhibūna

tr.85: The fact is, We brought them the truth and they are lying.
tr.19: Nay, but We have brought them the Truth, and lo! they are liars.
tr.22: We have sent them the Truth: but they indeed practise falsehood!
tr.203: Nay, but We have brought them the truth (Islâmic Monotheism), and verily, they (disbelievers) are liars.

23.ar: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
23.en: Allāh has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have [sought to] overcome others. Exalted is Allāh above what they describe [concerning Him].
23.tl: mā ittakhadha l-lahu min waladin wamā kāna maʿahu min ilāhin idhan ladhahaba kullu ilāhin bimā khalaqa walaʿalā baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yaṣifūna

tr.85: God has never had a child. Nor is there any god beside Him- if there were, each god would have taken his creation aside and tried to overcome the others. May God be exalted above what they describe!
tr.19: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.
tr.22: No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
tr.203: No son (or offspring) did Allâh beget, nor is there any ilâh (god) along with Him. (If there had been many gods), then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allâh above all that they attribute to Him!

23.ar: عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
23.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
23.tl: ʿālimi l-ghaybi wal-shahādati fataʿālā ʿammā yush'rikūna

tr.85: He knows what is not seen as well as what is seen; He is far above any partner they claim for Him.
tr.19: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible! and Exalted be He over all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)!
tr.22: He knows what is hidden and what is open: too high is He for the partners they attribute to Him!
tr.203: All-Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted be He over all that they associate as partners to Him!

23.ar: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
23.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
23.tl: qul rabbi immā turiyannī mā yūʿadūna

tr.85: Say, ‘Lord, if You are going to show me the punishment You have promised them,
tr.19: Say: My Lord! If Thou shouldst show me that which they are promised.
tr.22: Say: "O my Lord! if Thou wilt show me (in my lifetime) that which they are warned against,-
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "My Lord! If You would show me that with which they are threatened (torment),

23.ar: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
23.en: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
23.tl: rabbi falā tajʿalnī fī l-qawmi l-ẓālimīna

tr.85: then Lord, do not include me among the evildoers!’
tr.19: My Lord! then set me not among the wrongdoing folk.
tr.22: "Then, O my Lord! put me not amongst the people who do wrong!"
tr.203: "My Lord! Then (save me from Your punishment), put me not amongst the people who are the Zâlimûn (polytheists and wrong-doers)."

23.ar: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
23.en: And indeed, We are Able to show you what We have promised them.
23.tl: wa-innā ʿalā an nuriyaka mā naʿiduhum laqādirūna

tr.85: We certainly are able to show you the punishment We have promised them.
tr.19: And verily We are Able to show thee that which We have promised them.
tr.22: And We are certainly able to show thee (in fulfilment) that against which they are warned.
tr.203: And indeed We are Able to show you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that with which We have threatened them.

23.ar: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
23.en: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
23.tl: id'faʿ bi-allatī hiya aḥsanu l-sayi-ata naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaṣifūna

tr.85: Repel evil with good- We are well aware of what they attribute to Us-
tr.19: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best Aware of that which they allege.
tr.22: Repel evil with that which is best: We are well acquainted with the things they say.
tr.203: Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best-Acquainted with the things they utter.

23.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
23.en: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
23.tl: waqul rabbi aʿūdhu bika min hamazāti l-shayāṭīni

tr.85: and say, ‘Lord, I take refuge with You from the goadings of the evil ones;
tr.19: And say: My Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from suggestions of the evil ones,
tr.22: And say "O my Lord! I seek refuge with Thee from the suggestions of the Evil Ones.
tr.203: And say: "My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayâtîn (devils).

23.ar: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
23.en: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
23.tl: wa-aʿūdhu bika rabbi an yaḥḍurūni

tr.85: I seek refuge with you, Lord, so that they may not come near me.’
tr.19: And I seek refuge in Thee, my Lord, lest they be present with me,
tr.22: "And I seek refuge with Thee O my Lord! lest they should come near me."
tr.203: "And I seek refuge with You, My Lord! lest they should come near me."

23.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
23.en: [For such is the state of the disbelievers] until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
23.tl: ḥattā idhā jāa aḥadahumu l-mawtu qāla rabbi ir'jiʿūni

tr.85: When death comes to one of them, he cries, ‘My Lord, let me return
tr.19: Until, when death cometh unto one of them, he saith: My Lord! Send me back,
tr.22: (In Falsehood will they be) Until, when death comes to one of them, he says: "O my Lord! send me back (to life),-
tr.203: Until, when death comes to one of them (those who join partners with Allâh), he says: "My Lord! Send me back,

23.ar: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
23.en: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
23.tl: laʿallī aʿmalu ṣāliḥan fīmā taraktu kallā innahā kalimatun huwa qāiluhā wamin warāihim barzakhun ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna

tr.85: so as to make amends for the things I neglected.’ Never! This will not go beyond his words: a barrier stands behind such people until the very Day they are resurrected.
tr.19: That I may do right in that which I have left behind! But nay! It is but a word that he speaketh; and behind them is a barrier until the day when they are raised.
tr.22: "In order that I may work righteousness in the things I neglected." - "By no means! It is but a word he says."- Before them is a Partition till the Day they are raised up.
tr.203: "So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!" No! It is but a word that he speaks; and behind them is Barzakh (a barrier) until the Day when they will be resurrected.

23.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
23.en: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
23.tl: fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri falā ansāba baynahum yawma-idhin walā yatasāalūna

tr.85: On that Day when the Trumpet is blown, the ties between them will be as nothing and they will not ask about each other:
tr.19: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.
tr.22: Then when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no more relationships between them that Day, nor will one ask after another!
tr.203: Then, when the Trumpet is blown, there will be no kinship among them that Day, nor will they ask of one another.

23.ar: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
23.en: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
23.tl: faman thaqulat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika humu l-muf'liḥūna

tr.85: those whose good deeds weigh heavy will be successful,
tr.19: Then those whose scales are heavy, they are the successful.
tr.22: Then those whose balance (of good deeds) is heavy,- they will attain salvation:
tr.203: Then, those whose scales (of good deeds) are heavy, they are the successful.

23.ar: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
23.en: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
23.tl: waman khaffat mawāzīnuhu fa-ulāika alladhīna khasirū anfusahum fī jahannama khālidūna

tr.85: but those whose balance is light will have lost their souls for ever and will stay in Hell-
tr.19: And those whose scales are light are those who lose their souls, in hell abiding.
tr.22: But those whose balance is light, will be those who have lost their souls, in Hell will they abide.
tr.203: And those whose scales (of good deeds) are light, they are those who lose their ownselves, in Hell will they abide.

23.ar: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ
23.en: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
23.tl: talfaḥu wujūhahumu l-nāru wahum fīhā kāliḥūna

tr.85: the Fire will scorch their faces and their lips will be twisted in pain.
tr.19: The fire burneth their faces, and they are glum therein.
tr.22: The Fire will burn their faces, and they will therein grin, with their lips displaced.
tr.203: The Fire will burn their faces, and therein they will grin, with displaced lips (disfigured).

23.ar: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
23.en: [It will be said], "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
23.tl: alam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fakuntum bihā tukadhibūna

tr.85: ‘Were My messages not recited over and over to you and still you rejected them?’
tr.19: (It will be said): Were not My revelations recited unto you, and then ye used to deny them?
tr.22: "Were not My Signs rehearsed to you, and ye did but treat them as falsehood?"
tr.203: "Were not My Verses (this Qur’ân) recited to you, and then you used to deny them?"

23.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًا ضَآلِّينَ
23.en: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
23.tl: qālū rabbanā ghalabat ʿalaynā shiq'watunā wakunnā qawman ḍāllīna

tr.85: They will say, ‘Lord, our waywardness overcame us and we went astray.
tr.19: They will say: Our Lord! Our evil fortune conquered us, and we were erring folk.
tr.22: They will say: "our Lord! Our misfortune overwhelmed us, and we became a people astray!
tr.203: They will say: "Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were (an) erring people.

23.ar: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
23.en: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
23.tl: rabbanā akhrij'nā min'hā fa-in ʿud'nā fa-innā ẓālimūna

tr.85: Lord, take us away from this and if we go back to our old ways, then we shall really be evildoers.’
tr.19: Our Lord! Oh, bring us forth from hence! If we return (to evil) then indeed we shall be wrong-doers.
tr.22: "Our Lord! bring us out of this: if ever we return (to Evil), then shall we be wrong-doers indeed!"
tr.203: "Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If ever we return (to evil), then indeed we shall be Zâlimûn: (polytheists, oppressors, unjust, and wrong-doers)."

23.ar: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
23.en: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
23.tl: qāla ikh'saū fīhā walā tukallimūni

tr.85: He will say, ‘Away with you! In you go! Do not speak to Me!
tr.19: He saith: Begone therein, and speak not unto Me.
tr.22: He will say: "Be ye driven into it (with ignominy)! And speak ye not to Me!
tr.203: He (Allâh) will say: "Remain you in it with ignominy! And speak you not to Me!"

23.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
23.en: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
23.tl: innahu kāna farīqun min ʿibādī yaqūlūna rabbanā āmannā fa-igh'fir lanā wa-ir'ḥamnā wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna

tr.85: Among My servants there were those who said, “Lord, We believe. Forgive us and have mercy on us: You are the most merciful of all.”
tr.19: Lo! there was a party of My slaves who said: Our Lord! We believe, therefor forgive us and have mercy on us for Thou art Best of all who show mercy;
tr.22: "A part of My servants there was, who used to pray 'our Lord! we believe; then do Thou forgive us, and have mercy upon us: For Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
tr.203: Verily there was a party of My slaves, who used to say: "Our Lord! We believe, so forgive us, and have mercy on us, for You are the Best of all who show mercy!"

23.ar: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
23.en: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
23.tl: fa-ittakhadhtumūhum sikh'riyyan ḥattā ansawkum dhik'rī wakuntum min'hum taḍḥakūna

tr.85: But you kept on laughing at them: so intent were you on laughing at them that it made you forget My warning.
tr.19: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
tr.22: "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
tr.203: But you took them for a laughing stock, so much so that they made you forget My Remembrance while you used to laugh at them!

23.ar: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
23.en: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
23.tl: innī jazaytuhumu l-yawma bimā ṣabarū annahum humu l-fāizūna

tr.85: Today I have rewarded them for their patience: it is they who will succeed.’
tr.19: Lo! I have rewarded them this day forasmuch as they were steadfast in that they, even they, are the triumphant.
tr.22: "I have rewarded them this Day for their patience and constancy: they are indeed the ones that have achieved Bliss..."
tr.203: Verily I have rewarded them this Day for their patience: they are indeed the ones that are successful.

23.ar: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
23.en: [Allāh] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
23.tl: qāla kam labith'tum fī l-arḍi ʿadada sinīna

tr.85: He will say, ‘How many years were you on earth?’
tr.19: He will say: How long tarried ye in the earth, counting by years?
tr.22: He will say: "What number of years did ye stay on earth?"
tr.203: He (Allâh) will say: "What number of years did you stay on earth?"

23.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
23.en: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
23.tl: qālū labith'nā yawman aw baʿḍa yawmin fasali l-ʿādīna

tr.85: and they will reply, ‘We stayed a day or a part of a day, but ask those who keep count.’
tr.19: They will say: We tarried by a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep count!
tr.22: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day: but ask those who keep account."
tr.203: They will say: "We stayed a day or part of a day. Ask of those who keep account."

23.ar: قَـٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
23.en: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
23.tl: qāla in labith'tum illā qalīlan law annakum kuntum taʿlamūna

tr.85: He will say, ‘You stayed but a little, if you had only known.
tr.19: He will say: Ye tarried but a little if ye only knew.
tr.22: He will say: "Ye stayed not but a little,- if ye had only known!
tr.203: He (Allâh) will say: "You stayed not but a little, if you had only known!

23.ar: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
23.en: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
23.tl: afaḥasib'tum annamā khalaqnākum ʿabathan wa-annakum ilaynā lā tur'jaʿūna

tr.85: Did you think We had created you in vain, and that you would not be brought back to Us?’
tr.19: Deemed ye then that We had created you for naught, and that ye would not be returned unto Us?
tr.22: "Did ye then think that We had created you in jest, and that ye would not be brought back to Us (for account)?"
tr.203: "Did you think that We had created you in play (without any purpose), and that you would not be brought back to Us?"

23.ar: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
23.en: So exalted is Allāh, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
23.tl: fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu lā ilāha illā huwa rabbu l-ʿarshi l-karīmi

tr.85: Exalted be God, the true King, there is no god but Him, the Lord of the Glorious Throne!
tr.19: Now Allah be Exalted, the True King! There is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Throne of Grace.
tr.22: Therefore exalted be Allah, the King, the Reality: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Throne of Honour!
tr.203: So Exalted be Allâh, the True King: Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!

23.ar: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
23.en: And whoever invokes besides Allāh another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
23.tl: waman yadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara lā bur'hāna lahu bihi fa-innamā ḥisābuhu ʿinda rabbihi innahu lā yuf'liḥu l-kāfirūna

tr.85: Whoever prays to another god alongside Him- a god for whose existence he has no evidence- will face his reckoning with his Lord. Those who reject the truth will not prosper.
tr.19: He who crieth unto any other god along with Allah hath no proof thereof. His reckoning is only with his Lord. Lo! disbelievers will not be successful.
tr.22: If anyone invokes, besides Allah, Any other god, he has no authority therefor; and his reckoning will be only with his Lord! and verily the Unbelievers will fail to win through!
tr.203: And whoever invokes (or worships), besides Allâh, any other ilâh (god), of whom he has no proof; then his reckoning is only with his Lord. Surely! Al-Kâfirûn (the disbelievers in Allâh and in the Oneness of Allâh, polytheists, pagans, idolaters) will not be successful.

23.ar: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
23.en: And, [O Muḥammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
23.tl: waqul rabbi igh'fir wa-ir'ḥam wa-anta khayru l-rāḥimīna

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Lord, forgive and have mercy: You are the most merciful of all.’
tr.19: And (O Muhammad) say: My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for Thou art Best of all who show mercy.
tr.22: So say: "O my Lord! grant Thou forgiveness and mercy for Thou art the Best of those who show mercy!"
tr.203: And say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "My Lord! Forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of those who show mercy!"

24.ar: سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَـٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
24.en: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
24.tl: sūratun anzalnāhā wafaraḍnāhā wa-anzalnā fīhā āyātin bayyinātin laʿallakum tadhakkarūna

tr.85: This is a sura We have sent down and made obligatory: We have sent down clear revelations in it, so that you may take heed.
tr.19: (Here is) a surah which We have revealed and enjoined, and wherein We have revealed plain tokens, that haply ye may take heed.
tr.22: A sura which We have sent down and which We have ordained in it have We sent down Clear Signs, in order that ye may receive admonition.
tr.203: (This is) a Sûrah (chapter of the Qur’ân) which We have sent down and which We have enjoined, (ordained its laws); and in it We have revealed manifest Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations - lawful and unlawful things, and set boundaries of Islâmic Religion), that you may remember.

24.ar: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
24.en: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., law] of Allāh, if you should believe in Allāh and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
24.tl: al-zāniyatu wal-zānī fa-ij'lidū kulla wāḥidin min'humā mi-ata jaldatin walā takhudh'kum bihimā rafatun fī dīni l-lahi in kuntum tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-yawmi l-ākhiri walyashhad ʿadhābahumā ṭāifatun mina l-mu'minīna

tr.85: Strike the adulteress and the adulterer one hundred times. Do not let compassion for them keep you from carrying out God’s law––if you believe in God and the Last Day––and ensure that a group of believers witnesses the punishment.
tr.19: The adulterer and the adulteress, scourge ye each one of them (with) a hundred stripes. And let not pity for the twain withhold you from obedience to Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a party of believers witness their punishment.
tr.22: The woman and the man guilty of adultery or fornication,- flog each of them with a hundred stripes: Let not compassion move you in their case, in a matter prescribed by Allah, if ye believe in Allah and the Last Day: and let a party of the Believers witness their punishment.
tr.203: The fornicatress and the fornicator, flog each of them with a hundred stripes. Let not pity withhold you in their case, in a punishment prescribed by Allâh, if you believe in Allâh and the Last Day. And let a party of the believers witness their punishment. (This punishment is for unmarried persons guilty of the above crime, but if married persons commit it (illegal sex), the punishment is to stone them to death, according to Allâh’s Law).

24.ar: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةً وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
24.en: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the believers.
24.tl: al-zānī lā yankiḥu illā zāniyatan aw mush'rikatan wal-zāniyatu lā yankiḥuhā illā zānin aw mush'rikun waḥurrima dhālika ʿalā l-mu'minīna

tr.85: The adulterer is only [fit] to marry an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress is only [fit] to marry an adulterer or an idolater: such behaviour is forbidden to believers.
tr.19: The adulterer shall not marry save an adulteress or an idolatress, and the adulteress none shall marry save an adulterer or an idolater. All that is forbidden unto believers.
tr.22: Let no man guilty of adultery or fornication marry and but a woman similarly guilty, or an Unbeliever: nor let any but such a man or an Unbeliever marry such a woman: to the Believers such a thing is forbidden.
tr.203: The adulterer-fornicator marries not but an adulteress-fornicatress or a Mushrikah, and the adulteress-fornicatress none marries her except an adulterer-fornicator or a Muskrik [and that means that the man who agrees to marry (have a sexual relation with) a Mushrikah (female polytheist, pagan or idolatress) or a prostitute, then surely he is either an adulterer-fornicator, or a Mushrik (polytheist, pagan or idolater). And the woman who agrees to marry (have a sexual relation with) a Mushrik (polytheist, pagan or idolater) or an adulterer-fornicator, then she is either a prostitute or a Mushrikah (female polytheist, pagan, or idolatress)]. Such a thing is forbidden to the believers (of Islâmic Monotheism).

24.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَـٰنِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَـٰدَةً أَبَدًا ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
24.en: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
24.tl: wa-alladhīna yarmūna l-muḥ'ṣanāti thumma lam yatū bi-arbaʿati shuhadāa fa-ij'lidūhum thamānīna jaldatan walā taqbalū lahum shahādatan abadan wa-ulāika humu l-fāsiqūna

tr.85: As for those who accuse chaste women of fornication, and then fail to provide four witnesses, strike them eighty times, and reject their testimony ever afterwards: they are the lawbreakers,
tr.19: And those who accuse honourable women but bring not four witnesses, scourge them (with) eighty stripes and never (afterward) accept their testimony - They indeed are evil-doers -
tr.22: And those who launch a charge against chaste women, and produce not four witnesses (to support their allegations),- flog them with eighty stripes; and reject their evidence ever after: for such men are wicked transgressors;-
tr.203: And those who accuse chaste women, and produce not four witnesses, flog them with eighty stripes, and reject their testimony forever. They indeed are the Fâsiqûn (liars, rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

24.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
24.en: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
24.tl: illā alladhīna tābū min baʿdi dhālika wa-aṣlaḥū fa-inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun

tr.85: except for those who repent later and make amends––God is most forgiving and merciful.
tr.19: Save those who afterward repent and make amends. (For such) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.22: Unless they repent thereafter and mend (their conduct); for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.203: Except those who repent thereafter and do righteous deeds; (for such) verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

24.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَـٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
24.en: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the truthful.
24.tl: wa-alladhīna yarmūna azwājahum walam yakun lahum shuhadāu illā anfusuhum fashahādatu aḥadihim arbaʿu shahādātin bil-lahi innahu lamina l-ṣādiqīna

tr.85: As for those who accuse their own wives of adultery, but have no other witnesses, let each one four times call God to witness that he is telling the truth,
tr.19: As for those who accuse their wives but have no witnesses except themselves; let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies, (swearing) by Allah that he is of those who speak the truth;
tr.22: And for those who launch a charge against their spouses, and have (in support) no evidence but their own,- their solitary evidence (can be received) if they bear witness four times (with an oath) by Allah that they are solemnly telling the truth;
tr.203: And for those who accuse their wives, but have no witnesses except themselves, let the testimony of one of them be four testimonies (i.e. testifies four times) by Allâh that he is one of those who speak the truth.

24.ar: وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
24.en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allāh be upon him if he should be of the liars.
24.tl: wal-khāmisatu anna laʿnata l-lahi ʿalayhi in kāna mina l-kādhibīna

tr.85: and, the fifth time, call God to reject him if he is lying;
tr.19: And yet a fifth, invoking the curse of Allah on him if he is of those who lie.
tr.22: And the fifth (oath) (should be) that they solemnly invoke the curse of Allah on themselves if they tell a lie.
tr.203: And the fifth (testimony should be) the invoking of the Curse of Allâh on him if he be of those who tell a lie (against her).

24.ar: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَـٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
24.en: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allāh that indeed, he is of the liars.
24.tl: wayadra-u ʿanhā l-ʿadhāba an tashhada arbaʿa shahādātin bil-lahi innahu lamina l-kādhibīna

tr.85: punishment shall be averted from his wife if she in turn four times calls God to witness that her husband is lying
tr.19: And it shall avert the punishment from her if she bear witness before Allah four times that the thing he saith is indeed false,
tr.22: But it would avert the punishment from the wife, if she bears witness four times (with an oath) By Allah, that (her husband) is telling a lie;
tr.203: But it shall avert the punishment (of stoning to death) from her, if she bears witness four times by Allâh, that he (her husband) is telling a lie.

24.ar: وَٱلْخَـٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
24.en: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allāh be upon her if he was of the truthful.
24.tl: wal-khāmisata anna ghaḍaba l-lahi ʿalayhā in kāna mina l-ṣādiqīna

tr.85: and, the fifth time, calls God to reject her if he is telling the truth.
tr.19: And a fifth (time) that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he speaketh truth.
tr.22: And the fifth (oath) should be that she solemnly invokes the wrath of Allah on herself if (her accuser) is telling the truth.
tr.203: And the fifth (testimony) should be that the Wrath of Allâh be upon her if he (her husband) speaks the truth.

24.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌ حَكِيمٌ
24.en: And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Accepting of Repentance and Wise.
24.tl: walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna l-laha tawwābun ḥakīmun

tr.85: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, if it were not that God accepts repentance and is wise . . .!
tr.19: And had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Wise, (ye had been undone).
tr.22: If it were not for Allah's grace and mercy on you, and that Allah is Oft-Returning, full of Wisdom,- (Ye would be ruined indeed).
tr.203: And had it not been for the Grace of Allâh and His Mercy on you (He would have hastened the punishment upon you)! And that Allâh is the One Who forgives and accepts repentance, the All-Wise.

24.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ جَآءُو بِٱلْإِفْكِ عُصْبَةٌ مِّنكُمْ ۚ لَا تَحْسَبُوهُ شَرًّا لَّكُم ۖ بَلْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُم مَّا ٱكْتَسَبَ مِنَ ٱلْإِثْمِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ كِبْرَهُۥ مِنْهُمْ لَهُۥ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
24.en: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather, it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
24.tl: inna alladhīna jāū bil-if'ki ʿuṣ'batun minkum lā taḥsabūhu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli im'ri-in min'hum mā ik'tasaba mina l-ith'mi wa-alladhī tawallā kib'rahu min'hum lahu ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun

tr.85: It was a group from among you that concocted the lie––do not consider it a bad thing for you [people]; it was a good thing––and every one of them will be charged with the sin he has earned. He who took the greatest part in it will have a painful punishment.
tr.19: Lo! they who spread the slander are a gang among you. Deem it not a bad thing for you; nay, it is good for you. Unto every man of them (will be paid) that which he hath earned of the sin; and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be an awful doom.
tr.22: Those who brought forward the lie are a body among yourselves: think it not to be an evil to you; On the contrary it is good for you: to every man among them (will come the punishment) of the sin that he earned, and to him who took on himself the lead among them, will be a penalty grievous.
tr.203: Verily those who brought forth the slander (against ‘Âishah رضي الله عنها the wife of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم) are a group among you. Consider it not a bad thing for you. Nay, it is good for you. Unto every man among them will be paid that which he had earned of the sin, and as for him among them who had the greater share therein, his will be a great torment.

24.ar: لَّوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ ظَنَّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتُ بِأَنفُسِهِمْ خَيْرًا وَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَآ إِفْكٌ مُّبِينٌ
24.en: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, "This is an obvious falsehood"?
24.tl: lawlā idh samiʿ'tumūhu ẓanna l-mu'minūna wal-mu'minātu bi-anfusihim khayran waqālū hādhā if'kun mubīnun

tr.85: When you heard the lie, why did believing men and women not think well of their own people and declare, ‘This is obviously a lie’?
tr.19: Why did not the believers, men and women, when ye heard it, think good of their own own folk, and say: It is a manifest untruth?
tr.22: Why did not the believers - men and women - when ye heard of the affair,- put the best construction on it in their own minds and say, "This (charge) is an obvious lie"?
tr.203: Why then, did not the believers, men and women, when you heard it (the slander), think good of their own people and say: "This (charge) is an obvious lie?"

24.ar: لَّوْلَا جَآءُو عَلَيْهِ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلشُّهَدَآءِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُمُ ٱلْكَـٰذِبُونَ
24.en: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of Allāh, who are the liars.
24.tl: lawlā jāū ʿalayhi bi-arbaʿati shuhadāa fa-idh lam yatū bil-shuhadāi fa-ulāika ʿinda l-lahi humu l-kādhibūna

tr.85: And why did the accusers not bring four witnesses to it? If they cannot produce such witnesses, they are the liars in God’s eyes.
tr.19: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they produce not witnesses, they verily are liars in the sight of Allah.
tr.22: Why did they not bring four witnesses to prove it? When they have not brought the witnesses, such men, in the sight of Allah, (stand forth) themselves as liars!
tr.203: Why did they not produce four witnesses? Since they (the slanderers) have not produced witnesses! Then with Allâh they are the liars.

24.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَمَسَّكُمْ فِى مَآ أَفَضْتُمْ فِيهِ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
24.en: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment
24.tl: walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati lamassakum fī mā afaḍtum fīhi ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun

tr.85: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you in this world and the next, you would already have been afflicted by terrible suffering for indulging in such talk.
tr.19: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you in the world and the Hereafter an awful doom had overtaken you for that whereof ye murmured.
tr.22: Were it not for the grace and mercy of Allah on you, in this world and the Hereafter, a grievous penalty would have seized you in that ye rushed glibly into this affair.
tr.203: Had it not been for the Grace of Allâh and His Mercy unto you in this world and in the Hereafter, a great torment would have touched you for that whereof you had spoken.

24.ar: إِذْ تَلَقَّوْنَهُۥ بِأَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَتَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَاهِكُم مَّا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَتَحْسَبُونَهُۥ هَيِّنًا وَهُوَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ عَظِيمٌ
24.en: When you received it with your tongues and said with your mouths that of which you had no knowledge and thought it was insignificant while it was, in the sight of Allāh, tremendous.
24.tl: idh talaqqawnahu bi-alsinatikum wataqūlūna bi-afwāhikum mā laysa lakum bihi ʿil'mun wataḥsabūnahu hayyinan wahuwa ʿinda l-lahi ʿaẓīmun

tr.85: When you took it up with your tongues, and spoke with your mouths things you did not know [to be true], you thought it was trivial but to God it was very serious.
tr.19: When ye welcomed it with your tongues, and uttered with your mouths that whereof ye had no knowledge, ye counted it a trifle. In the sight of Allah it is very great.
tr.22: Behold, ye received it on your tongues, and said out of your mouths things of which ye had no knowledge; and ye thought it to be a light matter, while it was most serious in the sight of Allah.
tr.203: When you were propagating it with your tongues, and uttering with your mouths that whereof you had no knowledge, you counted it a little thing, while with Allâh it was very great.

24.ar: وَلَوْلَآ إِذْ سَمِعْتُمُوهُ قُلْتُم مَّا يَكُونُ لَنَآ أَن نَّتَكَلَّمَ بِهَـٰذَا سُبْحَـٰنَكَ هَـٰذَا بُهْتَـٰنٌ عَظِيمٌ
24.en: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, "It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O Allāh]; this is a great slander"?
24.tl: walawlā idh samiʿ'tumūhu qul'tum mā yakūnu lanā an natakallama bihādhā sub'ḥānaka hādhā buh'tānun ʿaẓīmun

tr.85: When you heard the lie, why did you not say, ‘We should not repeat this- God forbid!- It is a monstrous slander’?
tr.19: Wherefor, when ye heard it, said ye not: It is not for us to speak of this. Glory be to Thee (O Allah)! This is awful calumny.
tr.22: And why did ye not, when ye heard it, say? - "It is not right of us to speak of this: Glory to Allah! this is a most serious slander!"
tr.203: And why did you not, when you heard it, say: "It is not right for us to speak of this. Glory be to You (O Allâh)! This is a great lie."

24.ar: يَعِظُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَن تَعُودُوا۟ لِمِثْلِهِۦٓ أَبَدًا إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
24.en: Allāh warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be believers.
24.tl: yaʿiẓukumu l-lahu an taʿūdū limith'lihi abadan in kuntum mu'minīna

tr.85: God warns you never to do anything like this again, if you are true believers.
tr.19: Allah admonisheth you that ye repeat not the like thereof ever, if ye are (in truth) believers.
tr.22: Allah doth admonish you, that ye may never repeat such (conduct), if ye are (true) Believers.
tr.203: Allâh forbids you from it and warns you not to repeat the like of it forever, if you are believers.

24.ar: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
24.en: And Allāh makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and Allāh is Knowing and Wise.
24.tl: wayubayyinu l-lahu lakumu l-āyāti wal-lahu ʿalīmun ḥakīmun

tr.85: God makes His messages clear to you: God is all knowing, all wise.
tr.19: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise.
tr.22: And Allah makes the Signs plain to you: for Allah is full of knowledge and wisdom.
tr.203: And Allâh makes the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) plain to you, and Allâh is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

24.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحِبُّونَ أَن تَشِيعَ ٱلْفَـٰحِشَةُ فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
24.en: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And Allāh knows and you do not know.
24.tl: inna alladhīna yuḥibbūna an tashīʿa l-fāḥishatu fī alladhīna āmanū lahum ʿadhābun alīmun fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati wal-lahu yaʿlamu wa-antum lā taʿlamūna

tr.85: A painful punishment waits in this world and the next for those who like indecency to spread among the believers: God knows and you do not.
tr.19: Lo! those who love that slander should be spread concerning those who believe, theirs will be a painful punishment in the world and the Hereafter. Allah knoweth. Ye know not.
tr.22: Those who love (to see) scandal published broadcast among the Believers, will have a grievous Penalty in this life and in the Hereafter: Allah knows, and ye know not.
tr.203: Verily, those who like that (the crime of) illegal sexual intercourse should be propagated among those who believe, they will have a painful torment in this world and in the Hereafter. And Allâh knows and you know not.

24.ar: وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
24.en: And if it had not been for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy... and because Allāh is Kind and Merciful.
24.tl: walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu wa-anna l-laha raūfun raḥīmun

tr.85: If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy and the fact that He is compassionate and merciful . . .!
tr.19: Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, and that Allah is Clement, Merciful, (ye had been undone).
tr.22: Were it not for the grace and mercy of Allah on you, and that Allah is full of kindness and mercy, (ye would be ruined indeed).
tr.203: And had it not been for the Grace of Allâh and His Mercy on you, (Allâh would have hastened the punishment upon you). And that Allâh is full of Kindness, Most Merciful.

24.ar: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّبِعُوا۟ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ۚ وَمَن يَتَّبِعْ خُطُوَٰتِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْفَحْشَآءِ وَٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَتُهُۥ مَا زَكَىٰ مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَبَدًا وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُزَكِّى مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
24.en: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favor of Allāh upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but Allāh purifies whom He wills, and Allāh is Hearing and Knowing.
24.tl: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tattabiʿū khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni waman yattabiʿ khuṭuwāti l-shayṭāni fa-innahu yamuru bil-faḥshāi wal-munkari walawlā faḍlu l-lahi ʿalaykum waraḥmatuhu mā zakā minkum min aḥadin abadan walākinna l-laha yuzakkī man yashāu wal-lahu samīʿun ʿalīmun

tr.85: Believers, do not follow in Satan’s footsteps- if you do so, he will urge you to indecency and evil. If it were not for God’s bounty and mercy towards you, not one of you would ever have attained purity. God purifies whoever He will: God is all hearing, all seeing.
tr.19: O ye who believe! Follow not the footsteps of the devil. Unto whomsoever followeth the footsteps of the devil, lo! he commandeth filthiness and wrong. Had it not been for the grace of Allah and His mercy unto you, not one of you would ever have grown pure. But Allah causeth whom He will to grow. And Allah is Hearer, Knower.
tr.22: O ye who believe! follow not Satan's footsteps: if any will follow the footsteps of Satan, he will (but) command what is shameful and wrong: and were it not for the grace and mercy of Allah on you, not one of you would ever have been pure: but Allah doth purify whom He pleases: and Allah is One Who hears and knows (all things).
tr.203: O you who believe! Follow not the footsteps of Shaitân (Satan). And whosoever follows the footsteps of Shaitân (Satan), then, verily he commands Al-Fahshâ’ [i.e. to commit indecency (illegal sexual intercourse)], and Al-Munkar [disbelief and polytheism (i.e. to do evil and wicked deeds; and to speak or to do what is forbidden in Islâm)]. And had it not been for the Grace of Allâh and His Mercy on you, not one of you would ever have been pure from sins. But Allâh purifies (guides to Islâm) whom He wills, and Allâh is All-Hearer, All-Knower.

24.ar: وَلَا يَأْتَلِ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْفَضْلِ مِنكُمْ وَٱلسَّعَةِ أَن يُؤْتُوٓا۟ أُو۟لِى ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ وَٱلْمَسَـٰكِينَ وَٱلْمُهَـٰجِرِينَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَلْيَعْفُوا۟ وَلْيَصْفَحُوٓا۟ ۗ أَلَا تُحِبُّونَ أَن يَغْفِرَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
24.en: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of Allāh, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that Allāh should forgive you? And Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
24.tl: walā yatali ulū l-faḍli minkum wal-saʿati an yu'tū ulī l-qur'bā wal-masākīna wal-muhājirīna fī sabīli l-lahi walyaʿfū walyaṣfaḥū alā tuḥibbūna an yaghfira l-lahu lakum wal-lahu ghafūrun raḥīmun

tr.85: Those who have been graced with bounty and plenty should not swear that they will [no longer] give to kinsmen, the poor, those who emigrated in God’s way: let them pardon and forgive. Do you not wish that God should forgive you? God is most forgiving and merciful.
tr.19: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.22: Let not those among you who are endued with grace and amplitude of means resolve by oath against helping their kinsmen, those in want, and those who have left their homes in Allah's cause: let them forgive and overlook, do you not wish that Allah should forgive you? For Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And let not those among you who are blessed with graces and wealth swear not to give (any sort of help) to their kinsmen, Al-Masâkîn (the poor), and those who left their homes for Allâh’s Cause. Let them pardon and forgive. Do you not love that Allâh should forgive you? And Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.

24.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَـٰتِ ٱلْغَـٰفِلَـٰتِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ لُعِنُوا۟ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
24.en: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment
24.tl: inna alladhīna yarmūna l-muḥ'ṣanāti l-ghāfilāti l-mu'mināti luʿinū fī l-dun'yā wal-ākhirati walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun

tr.85: Those who accuse honourable but unwary believing women are rejected by God, in this life and the next. A painful punishment awaits them
tr.19: Lo! as for those who traduce virtuous, believing women (who are) careless, cursed are they in the world and the Hereafter. Theirs will be an awful doom
tr.22: Those who slander chaste women, indiscreet but believing, are cursed in this life and in the Hereafter: for them is a grievous Penalty,-
tr.203: Verily, those who accuse chaste women, who never even think of anything touching their chastity and are good believers - are cursed in this life and in the Hereafter, and for them will be a great torment -

24.ar: يَوْمَ تَشْهَدُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَلْسِنَتُهُمْ وَأَيْدِيهِمْ وَأَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
24.en: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.
24.tl: yawma tashhadu ʿalayhim alsinatuhum wa-aydīhim wa-arjuluhum bimā kānū yaʿmalūna

tr.85: on the Day when their own tongues, hands, and feet will testify against them about what they have done-
tr.19: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do,
tr.22: On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their feet will bear witness against them as to their actions.
tr.203: On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their legs (or feet) will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.

24.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يُوَفِّيهِمُ ٱللَّهُ دِينَهُمُ ٱلْحَقَّ وَيَعْلَمُونَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ ٱلْمُبِينُ
24.en: That Day, Allāh will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is Allāh who is the manifest Truth [i.e., perfect in justice].
24.tl: yawma-idhin yuwaffīhimu l-lahu dīnahumu l-ḥaqa wayaʿlamūna anna l-laha huwa l-ḥaqu l-mubīnu

tr.85: on that Day, God will pay them their just due in full- and they will realize that God is the Truth that makes everything clear.
tr.19: On that day Allah will pay them their just due, and they will know that Allah, He is the Manifest Truth.
tr.22: On that Day Allah will pay them back (all) their just dues, and they will realise that Allah is the (very) Truth, that makes all things manifest.
tr.203: On that Day Allâh will pay them the recompense of their deeds in full, and they will know that Allâh, He is the Manifest Truth.

24.ar: ٱلْخَبِيثَـٰتُ لِلْخَبِيثِينَ وَٱلْخَبِيثُونَ لِلْخَبِيثَـٰتِ ۖ وَٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتُ لِلطَّيِّبِينَ وَٱلطَّيِّبُونَ لِلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مُبَرَّءُونَ مِمَّا يَقُولُونَ ۖ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ كَرِيمٌ
24.en: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
24.tl: al-khabīthātu lil'khabīthīna wal-khabīthūna lil'khabīthāti wal-ṭayibātu lilṭṭayyibīna wal-ṭayibūna lilṭṭayyibāti ulāika mubarraūna mimmā yaqūlūna lahum maghfiratun wariz'qun karīmun

tr.85: Corrupt women are for corrupt men, and corrupt men are for corrupt women; good women are for good men and good men are for good women. The good are innocent of what has been said against them; they will have forgiveness and a generous provision.
tr.19: Vile women are for vile men, and vile men for vile women. Good women are for good men, and good men for good women; such are innocent of that which people say: For them is pardon and a bountiful provision.
tr.22: Women impure are for men impure, and men impure for women impure and women of purity are for men of purity, and men of purity are for women of purity: these are not affected by what people say: for them there is forgiveness, and a provision honourable.
tr.203: Bad statements are for bad people (or bad women for bad men) and bad people for bad statements (or bad men for bad women). Good statements are for good people (or good women for good men) and good people for good statements (or good men for good women): such (good people) are innocent of (every) bad statement which they say; for them is Forgiveness, and Rizqun Karîm (generous provision i.e. Paradise).

24.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ بُيُوتِكُمْ حَتَّىٰ تَسْتَأْنِسُوا۟ وَتُسَلِّمُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
24.en: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].
24.tl: yāayyuhā alladhīna āmanū lā tadkhulū buyūtan ghayra buyūtikum ḥattā tastanisū watusallimū ʿalā ahlihā dhālikum khayrun lakum laʿallakum tadhakkarūna

tr.85: Believers, do not enter other people’s houses until you have asked permission to do so and greeted those inside- that is best for you: perhaps you will bear this in mind.
tr.19: O ye who believe! Enter not houses other than your own without first announcing your presence and invoking peace upon the folk thereof. That is better for you, that ye may be heedful.
tr.22: O ye who believe! enter not houses other than your own, until ye have asked permission and saluted those in them: that is best for you, in order that ye may heed (what is seemly).
tr.203: O you who believe! Enter not houses other than your own, until you have asked permission and greeted those in them; that is better for you, in order that you may remember.

24.ar: فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فِيهَآ أَحَدًا فَلَا تَدْخُلُوهَا حَتَّىٰ يُؤْذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن قِيلَ لَكُمُ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ فَٱرْجِعُوا۟ ۖ هُوَ أَزْكَىٰ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
24.en: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, "Go back," then go back; it is purer for you. And Allāh is Knowing of what you do.
24.tl: fa-in lam tajidū fīhā aḥadan falā tadkhulūhā ḥattā yu'dhana lakum wa-in qīla lakumu ir'jiʿū fa-ir'jiʿū huwa azkā lakum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna ʿalīmun

tr.85: If you find no one in, do not enter unless you have been given permission to do so. If you are told, ‘Go away’, then do so- that is more proper for you. God knows well what you do.
tr.19: And if ye find no-one therein, still enter not until permission hath been given. And if it be said unto you: Go away again, then go away, for it is purer for you. Allah knoweth what ye do.
tr.22: If ye find no one in the house, enter not until permission is given to you: if ye are asked to go back, go back: that makes for greater purity for yourselves: and Allah knows well all that ye do.
tr.203: And if you find no one therein, still, enter not until permission has been given. And if you are asked to go back, go back, for it is purer for you. And Allâh is All-Knower of what you do.

24.ar: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكُمْ جُنَاحٌ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ بُيُوتًا غَيْرَ مَسْكُونَةٍ فِيهَا مَتَـٰعٌ لَّكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُبْدُونَ وَمَا تَكْتُمُونَ
24.en: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And Allāh knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
24.tl: laysa ʿalaykum junāḥun an tadkhulū buyūtan ghayra maskūnatin fīhā matāʿun lakum wal-lahu yaʿlamu mā tub'dūna wamā taktumūna

tr.85: You will not be blamed for entering houses where no one lives, and which could provide you with some useful service. God knows everything you do openly and everything you conceal.
tr.19: (It is) no sin for you to enter uninhabited houses wherein is comfort for you. Allah knoweth what ye proclaim and what ye hide.
tr.22: It is no fault on your part to enter houses not used for living in, which serve some (other) use for you: And Allah has knowledge of what ye reveal and what ye conceal.
tr.203: There is no sin on you that you enter (without taking permission) houses uninhabited (i.e. not possessed by anybody), (when) you have any interest in them. And Allâh has knowledge of what you reveal and what you conceal.

24.ar: قُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَغُضُّوا۟ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ وَيَحْفَظُوا۟ فُرُوجَهُمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ أَزْكَىٰ لَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ
24.en: Tell the believing men to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, Allāh is [fully] Aware of what they do.
24.tl: qul lil'mu'minīna yaghuḍḍū min abṣārihim wayaḥfaẓū furūjahum dhālika azkā lahum inna l-laha khabīrun bimā yaṣnaʿūna

tr.85: [Prophet], tell believing men to lower their glances and guard their private parts: that is purer for them. God is well aware of everything they do.
tr.19: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze and be modest. That is purer for them. Lo! Allah is aware of what they do.
tr.22: Say to the believing men that they should lower their gaze and guard their modesty: that will make for greater purity for them: And Allah is well acquainted with all that they do.
tr.203: Tell the believing men to lower their gaze (from looking at forbidden things), and protect their private parts (from illegal sexual acts). That is purer for them. Verily, Allâh is All-Aware of what they do.

24.ar: وَقُل لِّلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَغْضُضْنَ مِنْ أَبْصَـٰرِهِنَّ وَيَحْفَظْنَ فُرُوجَهُنَّ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَلْيَضْرِبْنَ بِخُمُرِهِنَّ عَلَىٰ جُيُوبِهِنَّ ۖ وَلَا يُبْدِينَ زِينَتَهُنَّ إِلَّا لِبُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ ءَابَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ أَبْنَآءِ بُعُولَتِهِنَّ أَوْ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ إِخْوَٰنِهِنَّ أَوْ بَنِىٓ أَخَوَٰتِهِنَّ أَوْ نِسَآئِهِنَّ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُنَّ أَوِ ٱلتَّـٰبِعِينَ غَيْرِ أُو۟لِى ٱلْإِرْبَةِ مِنَ ٱلرِّجَالِ أَوِ ٱلطِّفْلِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَمْ يَظْهَرُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَوْرَٰتِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۖ وَلَا يَضْرِبْنَ بِأَرْجُلِهِنَّ لِيُعْلَمَ مَا يُخْفِينَ مِن زِينَتِهِنَّ ۚ وَتُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا أَيُّهَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
24.en: And tell the believing women to reduce [some] of their vision and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands' fathers, their sons, their husbands' sons, their brothers, their brothers' sons, their sisters' sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to Allāh in repentance, all of you, O believers, that you might succeed.
24.tl: waqul lil'mu'mināti yaghḍuḍ'na min abṣārihinna wayaḥfaẓna furūjahunna walā yub'dīna zīnatahunna illā mā ẓahara min'hā walyaḍrib'na bikhumurihinna ʿalā juyūbihinna walā yub'dīna zīnatahunna illā libuʿūlatihinna aw ābāihinna aw ābāi buʿūlatihinna aw abnāihinna aw abnāi buʿūlatihinna aw ikh'wānihinna aw banī ikh'wānihinna aw banī akhawātihinna aw nisāihinna aw mā malakat aymānuhunna awi l-tābiʿīna ghayri ulī l-ir'bati mina l-rijāli awi l-ṭif'li alladhīna lam yaẓharū ʿalā ʿawrāti l-nisāi walā yaḍrib'na bi-arjulihinna liyuʿ'lama mā yukh'fīna min zīnatihinna watūbū ilā l-lahi jamīʿan ayyuha l-mu'minūna laʿallakum tuf'liḥūna
