26.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
26.en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
26.tl: qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu l-siḥ'ra falasawfa taʿlamūna la-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfin wala-uṣallibannakum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’
tr.19: (Pharaoh) said: Ye put your faith in him before I give you leave. Lo! he doubtless is your chief who taught you magic! But verily ye shall come to know. Verily I will cut off your hands and your feet alternately, and verily I will crucify you every one.
tr.22: Said (Pharaoh): "Believe ye in Him before I give you permission? surely he is your leader, who has taught you sorcery! but soon shall ye know! Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross!"
tr.203: [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] said: "You have believed in him before I give you leave. Surely, he indeed is your chief, who has taught you magic! So verily, you shall come to know. Verily, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all."

26.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
26.en: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
26.tl: qālū lā ḍayra innā ilā rabbinā munqalibūna

tr.85: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord.
tr.19: They said: It is no hurt, for lo! unto our Lord we shall return.
tr.22: They said: "No matter! for us, we shall but return to our Lord!
tr.203: They said: "No harm! Surely, to our Lord (Allâh) we are to return.

26.ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
26.tl: innā naṭmaʿu an yaghfira lanā rabbunā khaṭāyānā an kunnā awwala l-mu'minīna

tr.85: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’
tr.19: Lo! we ardently hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we are the first of the believers.
tr.22: "Only, our desire is that our Lord will forgive us our faults, that we may become foremost among the believers!"
tr.203: "Verily we really hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we are the first of the believers [in Mûsâ (Moses) and in the Monotheism which he has brought from Allâh]."

26.ar: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
26.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
26.tl: wa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī innakum muttabaʿūna

tr.85: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’
tr.19: And We inspired Moses, saying: Take away My slaves by night, for ye will be pursued.
tr.22: By inspiration we told Moses: "Travel by night with my servants; for surely ye shall be pursued."
tr.203: And We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses), saying: "Depart by night with My slaves, verily you will be pursued."

26.en: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers

tr.85: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming,
tr.19: Then Pharaoh sent into the cities summoners,
tr.22: Then Pharaoh sent heralds to (all) the Cities,
tr.203: Then Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) sent callers to (all) the cities.

26.en: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

tr.85: ‘These people are a puny band––
tr.19: (Who said): Lo! these indeed are but a little troop,
tr.22: (Saying): "These (Israelites) are but a small band,
tr.203: (Saying): "Verily these indeed are but a small band.

26.en: And indeed, they are enraging us,

tr.85: they have enraged us-
tr.19: And lo! they are offenders against us.
tr.22: "And they are raging furiously against us;
tr.203: "And verily, they have done what has enraged us.

26.en: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."

tr.85: and we are a large army, on the alert.’
tr.19: And lo! we are a ready host.
tr.22: "But we are a multitude amply fore-warned."
tr.203: "But we are a host all assembled, amply fore-warned."

26.en: So We removed them from gardens and springs

tr.85: So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs,
tr.19: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,
tr.22: So We expelled them from gardens, springs,
tr.203: So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,

26.en: And treasures and honorable station -

tr.85: their treasures and their noble dwellings-
tr.19: And treasures and a fair estate.
tr.22: Treasures, and every kind of honourable position;
tr.203: Treasures, and every kind of honourable place.

26.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

tr.85: We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel.
tr.19: Thus (were those things taken from them) and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.
tr.22: Thus it was, but We made the Children of Israel inheritors of such things.
tr.203: Thus [We turned them (Pharaoh’s people) out] and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit them.

26.en: So they pursued them at sunrise.

tr.85: Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,
tr.19: And they overtook them at sunrise.
tr.22: So they pursued them at sunrise.
tr.203: So they pursued them at sunrise.

26.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
26.en: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
26.tl: falammā tarāā l-jamʿāni qāla aṣḥābu mūsā innā lamud'rakūna

tr.85: and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’
tr.19: And when the two hosts saw each other, those with Moses said: Lo! we are indeed caught.
tr.22: And when the two bodies saw each other, the people of Moses said: "We are sure to be overtaken."
tr.203: And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mûsâ (Moses) said: "We are sure to be overtaken."

26.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
26.en: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
26.tl: qāla kallā inna maʿiya rabbī sayahdīni

tr.85: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’
tr.19: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
tr.22: (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me!"
tr.203: [Mûsâ (Moses)] said: "Nay, verily with me is my Lord. He will guide me."

26.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
26.en: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
26.tl: fa-awḥaynā ilā mūsā ani iḍ'rib biʿaṣāka l-baḥra fa-infalaqa fakāna kullu fir'qin kal-ṭawdi l-ʿaẓīmi

tr.85: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain-
tr.19: Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And it parted, and each part was as a mountain vast.
tr.22: Then We told Moses by inspiration: "Strike the sea with thy rod." So it divided, and each separate part became like the huge, firm mass of a mountain.
tr.203: Then We revealed to Mûsâ (Moses) (saying): "Strike the sea with your stick." And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like huge mountain.

26.en: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].

tr.85: and We brought the others to that place:
tr.19: Then brought We near the others to that place.
tr.22: And We made the other party approach thither.
tr.203: Then We brought near the others [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) party] to that place.

26.en: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

tr.85: We saved Moses and all his companions,
tr.19: And We saved Moses and those with him, every one;
tr.22: We delivered Moses and all who were with him;
tr.203: And We saved Mûsâ (Moses) and all those with him.

26.en: Then We drowned the others.

tr.85: and drowned the rest.
tr.19: And We drowned the others.
tr.22: But We drowned the others.
tr.203: Then We drowned the others.

26.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
26.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna

tr.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
tr.19: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
tr.22: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.203: Verily in this is indeed a sign (or a proof), yet most of them are not believers.

26.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tr.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
tr.19: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And verily your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26.en: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

tr.85: Tell them the story of Abraham,
tr.19: Recite unto them the story of Abraham:
tr.22: And rehearse to them (something of) Abraham's story.
tr.203: And recite to them the story of Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

26.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
26.en: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
26.tl: idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mā taʿbudūna

tr.85: when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’
tr.19: When he said unto his father and his folk: What worship ye?
tr.22: Behold, he said to his father and his people: "What worship ye?"
tr.203: When he said to his father and his people: "What do you worship?"

26.ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
26.en: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
26.tl: qālū naʿbudu aṣnāman fanaẓallu lahā ʿākifīna

tr.85: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’
tr.19: They said: We worship idols, and are ever devoted unto them.
tr.22: They said: "We worship idols, and we remain constantly in attendance on them."
tr.203: They said: "We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted."

26.en: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

tr.85: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call?
tr.19: He said: Do they hear you when ye cry?
tr.22: He said: "Do they listen to you when ye call (on them)?"
tr.203: He said: "Do they hear you, when you call on (them)?

26.en: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

tr.85: Do they help or harm you?’
tr.19: Or do they benefit or harm you?
tr.22: "Or do you good or harm?"
tr.203: "Or do they benefit you or do they harm (you)?"

26.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
26.en: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
26.tl: qālū bal wajadnā ābāanā kadhālika yafʿalūna

tr.85: They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’
tr.19: They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this wise.
tr.22: They said: "Nay, but we found our fathers doing thus (what we do)."
tr.203: They said: "(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so."

26.en: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

tr.85: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped,
tr.19: He said: See now that which ye worship,
tr.22: He said: "Do ye then see whom ye have been worshipping,-
tr.203: He said: "Do you observe that which you have been worshipping -

26.en: You and your ancient forefathers?

tr.85: you and your forefathers,
tr.19: Ye and your forefathers!
tr.22: "Ye and your fathers before you?-
tr.203: "You and your ancient fathers?

26.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
26.en: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
26.tl: fa-innahum ʿaduwwun lī illā rabba l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds,
tr.19: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,
tr.22: "For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds;
tr.203: "Verily they are enemies to me, save the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

26.en: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

tr.85: who created me. It is He who guides me;
tr.19: Who created me, and He doth guide me,
tr.22: "Who created me, and it is He Who guides me;
tr.203: "Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me.

26.en: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

tr.85: He who gives me food and drink;
tr.19: And Who feedeth me and watereth me.
tr.22: "Who gives me food and drink,
tr.203: "And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink.

26.en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

tr.85: He who cures me when I am ill;
tr.19: And when I sicken, then He healeth me,
tr.22: "And when I am ill, it is He Who cures me;
tr.203: "And when I am ill, it is He who cures me.

26.en: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

tr.85: He who will make me die and then give me life again;
tr.19: And Who causeth me to die, then giveth me life (again),
tr.22: "Who will cause me to die, and then to life (again);
tr.203: "And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (again).

26.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
26.en: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
26.tl: wa-alladhī aṭmaʿu an yaghfira lī khaṭīatī yawma l-dīni

tr.85: and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement.
tr.19: And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgment.
tr.22: "And who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the day of Judgment.
tr.203: "And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense, (the Day of Resurrection).

26.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
26.en: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
26.tl: rabbi hab lī ḥuk'man wa-alḥiq'nī bil-ṣāliḥīna

tr.85: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous;
tr.19: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.
tr.22: "O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous;
tr.203: My Lord! Bestow Hukm (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous.

26.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
26.en: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.
26.tl: wa-ij'ʿal lī lisāna ṣid'qin fī l-ākhirīna

tr.85: give me a good name among later generations;
tr.19: And give unto me a good report in later generations.
tr.22: "Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations);
tr.203: And grant me an honourable mention in later generations.

26.en: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

tr.85: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss-
tr.19: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight,
tr.22: "Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss;
tr.203: And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight.

26.ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
26.en: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
26.tl: wa-igh'fir li-abī innahu kāna mina l-ḍālīna

tr.85: forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray-
tr.19: And forgive my father. Lo! he is of those who err.
tr.22: "Forgive my father, for that he is among those astray;
tr.203: And forgive my father, verily he is of the erring.

26.en: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

tr.85: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected:
tr.19: And abase me not on the day when they are raised,
tr.22: "And let me not be in disgrace on the Day when (men) will be raised up;-
tr.203: And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected.

26.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
26.en: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
26.tl: yawma lā yanfaʿu mālun walā banūna

tr.85: the Day when neither wealth nor children can help,
tr.19: The day when wealth and sons avail not (any man)
tr.22: "The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,
tr.203: The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,

26.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
26.en: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."
26.tl: illā man atā l-laha biqalbin salīmin

tr.85: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’
tr.19: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart.
tr.22: "But only he (will prosper) that brings to Allah a sound heart;
tr.203: Except him who brings to Allâh a clean heart [clean from Shirk (polytheism) and Nifâq (hypocrisy)]."

26.en: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

tr.85: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous
tr.19: And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil).
tr.22: "To the righteous, the Garden will be brought near,
tr.203: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2).

26.en: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

tr.85: and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided,
tr.19: And hell will appear plainly to the erring.
tr.22: "And to those straying in Evil, the Fire will be placed in full view;
tr.203: And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the erring.

26.ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
26.en: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
26.tl: waqīla lahum ayna mā kuntum taʿbudūna

tr.85: it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped
tr.19: And it will be said unto them: Where is (all) that ye used to worship
tr.22: "And it shall be said to them: 'Where are the (gods) ye worshipped-
tr.203: And it will be said to them: "Where are those (the false gods whom you used to set up as rivals with Allâh) that you used to worship.

26.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
26.en: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"
26.tl: min dūni l-lahi hal yanṣurūnakum aw yantaṣirūna

tr.85: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’
tr.19: Instead of Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?
tr.22: "'Besides Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?'
tr.203: "Instead of Allâh? Can they help you or (even) help themselves?"

26.en: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators

tr.85: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them,
tr.19: Then will they be hurled therein, they and the seducers
tr.22: "Then they will be thrown headlong into the (Fire),- they and those straying in Evil,
tr.203: Then they will be thrown on their faces into the (Fire), they and the Ghâwûn (devils, and those who were in error).

26.en: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

tr.85: and all Iblis’s supporters.
tr.19: And the hosts of Iblis, together.
tr.22: "And the whole hosts of Iblis together.
tr.203: And the whole hosts of Iblîs (Satan) together.

26.en: They will say while they dispute therein,

tr.85: There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves,
tr.19: And they will say, when they are quarrelling therein:
tr.22: "They will say there in their mutual bickerings:
tr.203: They will say while contending therein,

26.ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
26.en: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error
26.tl: tal-lahi in kunnā lafī ḍalālin mubīnin

tr.85: ‘We were clearly misguided
tr.19: By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest
tr.22: "'By Allah, we were truly in an error manifest,
tr.203: By Allâh, we were truly in a manifest error,

26.en: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

tr.85: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.19: When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: "'When we held you as equals with the Lord of the Worlds;
tr.203: When We held you (false gods) as equals (in worship) with the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists);

26.en: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

tr.85: It was the evildoers who led us astray,
tr.19: It was but the guilty who misled us.
tr.22: "'And our seducers were only those who were steeped in guilt.
tr.203: And none has brought us into error except the Mujrimûn [Iblîs (Satan) and those of human beings who commit crimes, murderers, polytheists, oppressors].

26.en: So now we have no intercessors

tr.85: and now we have no intercessor
tr.19: Now we have no intercessors
tr.22: "'Now, then, we have none to intercede (for us),
tr.203: Now we have no intercessors,

26.en: And not a devoted friend.

tr.85: and no true friend.
tr.19: Nor any loving friend.
tr.22: "'Nor a single friend to feel (for us).
tr.203: Nor a close friend (to help us).

26.ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."
26.tl: falaw anna lanā karratan fanakūna mina l-mu'minīna

tr.85: If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’
tr.19: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
tr.22: "'Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe!'"
tr.203: (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!

26.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
26.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna

tr.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
tr.19: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers!
tr.22: Verily in this is a Sign but most of them do not believe.
tr.203: Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tr.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
tr.19: And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26.en: The people of Noah denied the messengers

tr.85: The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars.
tr.19: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
tr.22: The people of Noah rejected the messengers.
tr.203: The people of Nûh (Noah) belied the Messengers.

26.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26.en: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
26.tl: idh qāla lahum akhūhum nūḥun alā tattaqūna

tr.85: Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
tr.19: When their brother Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: Behold, their brother Noah said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
tr.203: When their brother Nûh (Noah) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

26.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tr.85: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
tr.19: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
tr.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:
tr.203: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tr.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
tr.19: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
tr.22: "So fear Allah, and obey me.
tr.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
26.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
26.tl: wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds:
tr.19: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:
tr.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me."

tr.85: be mindful of God and obey me.’
tr.19: So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
tr.22: "So fear Allah, and obey me."
tr.203: "So keep your duty to Allâh, fear Him and obey me."

26.en: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

tr.85: They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’
tr.19: They said: Shall we put faith in thee, when the lowest (of the people) follow thee?
tr.22: They said: "Shall we believe in thee when it is the meanest that follow thee?"
tr.203: They said: "Shall we believe in you, when the meanest (of the people) follow you?"

26.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
26.en: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
26.tl: qāla wamā ʿil'mī bimā kānū yaʿmalūna

tr.85: He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do?
tr.19: He said: And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)?
tr.22: He said: "And what do I know as to what they do?
tr.203: He said: "And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?

26.ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
26.en: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
26.tl: in ḥisābuhum illā ʿalā rabbī law tashʿurūna

tr.85: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see-
tr.19: Lo! their reckoning is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew;
tr.22: "Their account is only with my Lord, if ye could (but) understand.
tr.203: "Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know.

26.en: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

tr.85: I will not drive believers away.
tr.19: And I am not (here) to repulse believers.
tr.22: "I am not one to drive away those who believe.
tr.203: "And I am not going to drive away the believers.

26.en: I am only a clear warner."

tr.85: I am here only to give people a clear warning.’
tr.19: I am only a plain warner.
tr.22: "I am sent only to warn plainly in public."
tr.203: I am only a plain warner."

26.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
26.en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
26.tl: qālū la-in lam tantahi yānūḥu latakūnanna mina l-marjūmīna

tr.85: So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’
tr.19: They said: If thou cease not, O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death).
tr.22: They said: "If thou desist not, O Noah! thou shalt be stoned (to death)."
tr.203: They said: "If you cease not, O Nûh (Noah) you will surely be among those stoned (to death)."

26.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

tr.85: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me,
tr.19: He said: My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me.
tr.22: He said: "O my Lord! truly my people have rejected me.
tr.203: He said: "My Lord! Verily, my people have belied me.

26.ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
26.tl: fa-if'taḥ baynī wabaynahum fatḥan wanajjinī waman maʿiya mina l-mu'minīna

tr.85: so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’
tr.19: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
tr.22: "Judge Thou, then, between me and them openly, and deliver me and those of the Believers who are with me."
tr.203: Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me."

26.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
26.en: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
26.tl: fa-anjaynāhu waman maʿahu fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni

tr.85: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship,
tr.19: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
tr.22: So We delivered him and those with him, in the Ark filled (with all creatures).
tr.203: And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

26.en: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

tr.85: and drowned the rest.
tr.19: Then afterward We drowned the others.
tr.22: Thereafter We drowned those who remained behind.
tr.203: Then We drowned the rest (disbelievers) thereafter.

26.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
26.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna

tr.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
tr.19: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
tr.22: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.203: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tr.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
tr.19: And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26.en: ʿAad denied the messengers

tr.85: The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars.
tr.19: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).
tr.22: The 'Ad (people) rejected the messengers.
tr.203: ‘Âd (people) belied the Messengers.

26.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26.en: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
26.tl: idh qāla lahum akhūhum hūdun alā tattaqūna

tr.85: Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
tr.19: When their brother Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: Behold, their brother Hud said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
tr.203: When their brother Hûd said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

26.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tr.85: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
tr.19: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
tr.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust:
tr.203: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tr.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
tr.19: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
tr.22: "So fear Allah and obey me.
tr.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
26.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
26.tl: wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.19: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists).

26.en: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

tr.85: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place?
tr.19: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?
tr.22: "Do ye build a landmark on every high place to amuse yourselves?
tr.203: "Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?

26.en: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?

tr.85: Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal?
tr.19: And seek ye out strongholds, that haply ye may last for ever?
tr.22: "And do ye get for yourselves fine buildings in the hope of living therein (for ever)?
tr.203: "And do you get for yourselves palaces (fine buildings) as if you will live therein for ever.

26.en: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

tr.85: Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone?
tr.19: And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?
tr.22: "And when ye exert your strong hand, do ye do it like men of absolute power?
tr.203: "And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants?

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tr.85: Be mindful of God and obey me;
tr.19: Rather keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
tr.22: "Now fear Allah, and obey me.
tr.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26.en: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

tr.85: be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know-
tr.19: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,
tr.22: "Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know.
tr.203: "And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know.

26.en: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

tr.85: He has given you livestock, sons,
tr.19: Hath aided you with cattle and sons.
tr.22: "Freely has He bestowed on you cattle and sons,-
tr.203: "He has aided you with cattle and children.

26.en: And gardens and springs.

tr.85: gardens, springs-
tr.19: And gardens and watersprings.
tr.22: "And Gardens and Springs.
tr.203: "And gardens and springs.

26.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
26.en: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
26.tl: innī akhāfu ʿalaykum ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin

tr.85: for I truly fear that the torment of a grievous day will overtake you.’
tr.19: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.
tr.22: "Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day."
tr.203: "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."

26.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
26.en: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
26.tl: qālū sawāon ʿalaynā awaʿaẓta am lam takun mina l-wāʿiẓīna

tr.85: They replied, ‘It makes no difference to us whether you warn us or not,
tr.19: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;
tr.22: They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers!
tr.203: They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.

26.en: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

tr.85: for we only do what our forefathers used to do:
tr.19: This is but a fable of the men of old,
tr.22: "This is no other than a customary device of the ancients,
tr.203: "This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients, [Tafsir At-Tabarî]

26.en: And we are not to be punished."

tr.85: we shall not be punished.’
tr.19: And we shall not be doomed.
tr.22: "And we are not the ones to receive Pains and Penalties!"
tr.203: "And we are not going to be punished."

26.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
26.tl: fakadhabūhu fa-ahlaknāhum inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna

tr.85: They denounced him as a liar, and so We destroyed them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
tr.19: And they denied him; therefor We destroyed them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
tr.22: So they rejected him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.203: So they belied him, and We destroyed them. Verily in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tr.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
tr.19: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26.en: Thamūd denied the messengers

tr.85: The people of Thamud, too, called the messengers liars.
tr.19: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)
tr.22: The Thamud (people) rejected the messengers.
tr.203: Thamûd (people) belied the Messengers.

26.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26.en: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
26.tl: idh qāla lahum akhūhum ṣāliḥun alā tattaqūna

tr.85: Their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
tr.19: When their brother Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: Behold, their brother Salih said to them: "Will you not fear (Allah)?
tr.203: When their brother Sâlih said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

26.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tr.85: I am a faithful messenger to you:
tr.19: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
tr.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
tr.203: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tr.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
tr.19: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
tr.22: "So fear Allah, and obey me.
tr.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
26.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
26.tl: wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.19: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

26.en: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

tr.85: [Do you think] you will be left secure for ever in what you have here-
tr.19: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,
tr.22: "Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here?-
tr.203: "Will you be left secure in that which you have here?

26.en: Within gardens and springs

tr.85: gardens, springs,
tr.19: In gardens and watersprings.
tr.22: "Gardens and Springs,
tr.203: "In gardens and springs.

26.en: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

tr.85: fields, palm trees laden with fruit-
tr.19: And tilled fields and heavy-sheathed palm-trees,
tr.22: "And corn-fields and date-palms with spathes near breaking (with the weight of fruit)?
tr.203: And green crops (fields) and date-palms with soft spadix.

26.en: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

tr.85: carving your fine houses from the mountains?
tr.19: Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?
tr.22: "And ye carve houses out of (rocky) mountains with great skill.
tr.203: "And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill.

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tr.85: Be mindful of God and obey me:
tr.19: Therefor keep your duty to Allah and obey me,
tr.22: "But fear Allah and obey me;
tr.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26.en: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

tr.85: do not obey those who are given to excess
tr.19: And obey not the command of the prodigal,
tr.22: "And follow not the bidding of those who are extravagant,-
tr.203: "And follow not the command of Al-Musrifûn [i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners],

26.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
26.en: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
26.tl: alladhīna yuf'sidūna fī l-arḍi walā yuṣ'liḥūna

tr.85: and who spread corruption in the land instead of doing what is right.’
tr.19: Who spread corruption in the earth, and reform not.
tr.22: "Who make mischief in the land, and mend not (their ways)."
tr.203: "Who make mischief in the land, and reform not."

26.en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

tr.85: They said, ‘You are bewitched!
tr.19: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
tr.22: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
tr.203: They said: "You are only of those bewitched!

26.ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
26.en: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
26.tl: mā anta illā basharun mith'lunā fati biāyatin in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna

tr.85: You are nothing but a man like us. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth.’
tr.19: Thou art but a mortal like us. So bring some token if thou art of the truthful.
tr.22: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us: then bring us a Sign, if thou tellest the truth!"
tr.203: "You are but a human being like us. Then bring us a sign if you are of the truthful."

26.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
26.en: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
26.tl: qāla hādhihi nāqatun lahā shir'bun walakum shir'bu yawmin maʿlūmin

tr.85: He said, ‘Here is a camel. She should have her turn to drink and so should you, each on a specified day,
tr.19: He said: (Behold) this she-camel. She hath the right to drink (at the well), and ye have the right to drink, (each) on an appointed day.
tr.22: He said: "Here is a she-camel: she has a right of watering, and ye have a right of watering, (severally) on a day appointed.
tr.203: He said: "Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known.

26.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
26.en: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
26.tl: walā tamassūhā bisūin fayakhudhakum ʿadhābu yawmin ʿaẓīmin

tr.85: so do not harm her, or the punishment of a terrible day will befall you.’
tr.19: And touch her not with ill lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.
tr.22: "Touch her not with harm, lest the Penalty of a Great Day seize you."
tr.203: "And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you."

26.en: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.

tr.85: But they hamstrung her. In the morning they had cause to regret it:
tr.19: But they hamstrung her, and then were penitent.
tr.22: But they ham-strung her: then did they become full of regrets.
tr.203: But they killed her, and then they became regretful.

26.ar: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
26.tl: fa-akhadhahumu l-ʿadhābu inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna

tr.85: the punishment fell upon them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
tr.19: So the retribution came on them. Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
tr.22: But the Penalty seized them. Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.203: So the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tr.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
tr.19: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26.en: The people of Lot denied the messengers

tr.85: The people of Lot, too, called the messengers liars.
tr.19: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),
tr.22: The people of Lut rejected the messengers.
tr.203: The people of Lût (Lot) (-who dwelt in the town of Sodom in Palestine) belied the Messengers.

26.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26.en: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
26.tl: idh qāla lahum akhūhum lūṭun alā tattaqūna

tr.85: Their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
tr.19: When their brother Lot said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: Behold, their brother Lut said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
tr.203: When their brother Lût (Lot) said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh and obey Him?

26.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tr.85: I am a faithful messenger to you:
tr.19: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
tr.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
tr.203: "Verily I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tr.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
tr.19: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
tr.22: "So fear Allah and obey me.
tr.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
26.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
26.tl: wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.19: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the lord of the Worlds.
tr.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

26.en: Do you approach males among the worlds

tr.85: Must you, unlike [other] people, lust after males
tr.19: What! Of all creatures do ye come unto the males,
tr.22: "Of all the creatures in the world, will ye approach males,
tr.203: "Go you in unto the males of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind),

26.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
26.en: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
26.tl: watadharūna mā khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwājikum bal antum qawmun ʿādūna

tr.85: and abandon the wives that God has created for you? You are exceeding all bounds,’
tr.19: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.
tr.22: "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your mates? Nay, ye are a people transgressing (all limits)!"
tr.203: "And leave those whom Allâh has created for you to be your wives? Nay, you are a trespassing people!"

26.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
26.en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
26.tl: qālū la-in lam tantahi yālūṭu latakūnanna mina l-mukh'rajīna

tr.85: but they replied, ‘Lot! If you do not stop this, you will be driven away.’
tr.19: They said: If thou cease not, O Lot, thou wilt soon be of the outcast.
tr.22: They said: "If thou desist not, O Lut! thou wilt assuredly be cast out!"
tr.203: They said: "If you cease not O Lût (Lot)! verily, you will be one of those who are driven out!"

26.en: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].

tr.85: So he said, ‘I loathe what you do:
tr.19: He said: I am in truth of those who hate your conduct.
tr.22: He said: "I do detest your doings."
tr.203: He said: "I am, indeed, of those who disapprove with severe anger and fury your (this evil) action (of sodomy).

26.en: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."

tr.85: Lord, save me and my family from what they are doing.’
tr.19: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.
tr.22: "O my Lord! deliver me and my family from such things as they do!"
tr.203: "My Lord! Save me and my family from what they do."

26.en: So We saved him and his family, all,

tr.85: We saved him and all his family,
tr.19: So We saved him and his household, every one,
tr.22: So We delivered him and his family,- all
tr.203: So We saved him and his family, all,

26.en: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.

tr.85: except for an old woman who stayed behind,
tr.19: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind.
tr.22: Except an old woman who lingered behind.
tr.203: Except an old woman (his wife) among those who remained behind.

26.en: Then We destroyed the others.

tr.85: then We destroyed the others,
tr.19: Then afterward We destroyed the others.
tr.22: But the rest We destroyed utterly.
tr.203: Then afterward We destroyed the others.

26.ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
26.en: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
26.tl: wa-amṭarnā ʿalayhim maṭaran fasāa maṭaru l-mundharīna

tr.85: and poured a rain of destruction down upon them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been forewarned!
tr.19: And We rained on them a rain. And dreadful is the rain of those who have been warned.
tr.22: We rained down on them a shower (of brimstone): and evil was the shower on those who were admonished (but heeded not)!
tr.203: And We rained on them a rain (of torment). And how evil was the rain of those who had been warned!

26.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
26.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna

tr.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
tr.19: Lo! herein is indeed a portent, yet most of them are not believers.
tr.22: Verily in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.203: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tr.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
tr.19: And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might Most Merciful.
tr.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26.en: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers

tr.85: The forest-dwellers, too, called the messengers liars.
tr.19: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),
tr.22: The Companions of the Wood rejected the messengers.
tr.203: The dwellers of Al-Aikah [near Madyan (Midian)] belied the Messengers.

26.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
26.en: When Shuʿayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?
26.tl: idh qāla lahum shuʿaybun alā tattaqūna

tr.85: Shuayb said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
tr.19: When Shu'eyb said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: Behold, Shu'aib said to them: "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
tr.203: When Shu‘aib said to them: "Will you not fear Allâh (and obey Him)?

26.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tr.85: I am a faithful messenger to you:
tr.19: Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you,
tr.22: "I am to you a messenger worthy of all trust.
tr.203: "I am a trustworthy Messenger to you.

26.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tr.85: be mindful of God and obey me.
tr.19: So keep your duty to Allah and obey me.
tr.22: "So fear Allah and obey me.
tr.203: "So fear Allâh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me.

26.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
26.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
26.tl: wamā asalukum ʿalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illā ʿalā rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.19: And I ask of you no wage for it; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.203: "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islâmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

26.ar: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
26.en: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
26.tl: awfū l-kayla walā takūnū mina l-mukh'sirīna

tr.85: Give full measure: do not sell others short.
tr.19: Give full measure, and be not of those who give less (than the due).
tr.22: "Give just measure, and cause no loss (to others by fraud).
tr.203: "Give full measure, and cause no loss (to others).

26.en: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.

tr.85: Weigh with correct scales:
tr.19: And weigh with the true balance.
tr.22: "And weigh with scales true and upright.
tr.203: "And weigh with the true and straight balance.

26.ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
26.en: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
26.tl: walā tabkhasū l-nāsa ashyāahum walā taʿthaw fī l-arḍi muf'sidīna

tr.85: do not deprive people of what is theirs. Do not spread corruption on earth.
tr.19: Wrong not mankind in their goods, and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth.
tr.22: "And withhold not things justly due to men, nor do evil in the land, working mischief.
tr.203: "And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land.

26.en: And fear He who created you and the former creation."

tr.85: Be mindful of God who created you and former generations,’
tr.19: And keep your duty unto Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.
tr.22: "And fear Him Who created you and (who created) the generations before (you)"
tr.203: "And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old."

26.en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

tr.85: but they replied, ‘You are bewitched!
tr.19: They said: Thou art but one of the bewitched;
tr.22: They said: "Thou art only one of those bewitched!
tr.203: They said: "You are only one of those bewitched!

26.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
26.en: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
26.tl: wamā anta illā basharun mith'lunā wa-in naẓunnuka lamina l-kādhibīna

tr.85: You are nothing but a man like us. In fact we think you are a liar.
tr.19: Thou art but a mortal like us, and lo! we deem thee of the liars.
tr.22: "Thou art no more than a mortal like us, and indeed we think thou art a liar!
tr.203: "You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!

26.ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
26.en: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
26.tl: fa-asqiṭ ʿalaynā kisafan mina l-samāi in kunta mina l-ṣādiqīna

tr.85: Make bits of the heavens fall down on us, if you are telling the truth.’
tr.19: Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us, if thou art of the truthful.
tr.22: "Now cause a piece of the sky to fall on us, if thou art truthful!"
tr.203: "So cause a piece of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!"

26.en: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."

tr.85: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’
tr.19: He said: My Lord is Best Aware of what ye do.
tr.22: He said: "My Lord knows best what ye do."
tr.203: He said: "My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do."

26.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
26.en: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
26.tl: fakadhabūhu fa-akhadhahum ʿadhābu yawmi l-ẓulati innahu kāna ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīmin

tr.85: They called him a liar, and so the torment of the Day of Shadow came upon them- it was the torment of a terrible day.
tr.19: But they denied him, so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom. Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day.
tr.22: But they rejected him. Then the punishment of a day of overshadowing gloom seized them, and that was the Penalty of a Great Day.
tr.203: But they belied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed that was the torment of a Great Day.

26.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
26.tl: inna fī dhālika laāyatan wamā kāna aktharuhum mu'minīna

tr.85: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
tr.19: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
tr.22: Verily in that is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
tr.203: Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers.

26.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tr.85: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
tr.19: And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And verily thy Lord is He, the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.203: And verily your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

26.en: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.

tr.85: Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds:
tr.19: And lo! it is a revelation of the Lord of the Worlds,
tr.22: Verily this is a Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds:
tr.203: And truly, this (the Qur’ân) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),

26.en: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down

tr.85: the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down
tr.19: Which the True Spirit hath brought down
tr.22: With it came down the spirit of Faith and Truth-
tr.203: Which the trustworthy Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] has brought down

26.en: Upon your heart, [O Muḥammad] - that you may be of the warners -

tr.85: to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning
tr.19: Upon thy heart, that thou mayst be (one) of the warners,
tr.22: To thy heart and mind, that thou mayest admonish.
tr.203: Upon your heart (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that you may be (one) of the warners,

26.en: In a clear Arabic language.

tr.85: in a clear Arabic tongue.
tr.19: In plain Arabic speech.
tr.22: In the perspicuous Arabic tongue.
tr.203: In the plain Arabic language.

26.en: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.

tr.85: This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions.
tr.19: And lo! it is in the Scriptures of the men of old.
tr.22: Without doubt it is (announced) in the mystic Books of former peoples.
tr.203: And verily, it (the Qur’ân, and its revelation to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people.

26.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
26.en: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
26.tl: awalam yakun lahum āyatan an yaʿlamahu ʿulamāu banī is'rāīla

tr.85: Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it?
tr.19: Is it not a token for them that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?
tr.22: Is it not a Sign to them that the Learned of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?
tr.203: Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullâh bin Salâm رضي الله عنه who embraced Islâm) of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?

26.en: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners

tr.85: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab,
tr.19: And if We had revealed it unto one of any other nation than the Arabs,
tr.22: Had We revealed it to any of the non-Arabs,
tr.203: And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ân) unto any of the non-Arabs,

26.ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
26.tl: faqara-ahu ʿalayhim mā kānū bihi mu'minīna

tr.85: and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
tr.19: And he had read it unto them, they would not have believed in it.
tr.22: And had he recited it to them, they would not have believed in it.
tr.203: And he had recited it unto them, they would not have believed in it.

26.en: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.

tr.85: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty:
tr.19: Thus do We make it traverse the hearts of the guilty.
tr.22: Thus have We caused it to enter the hearts of the sinners.
tr.203: Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ân) to enter the hearts of the Mûjrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners).

26.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
26.en: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
26.tl: lā yu'minūna bihi ḥattā yarawū l-ʿadhāba l-alīma

tr.85: they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment,
tr.19: They will not believe in it till they behold the painful doom,
tr.22: They will not believe in it until they see the grievous Penalty;
tr.203: They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment.

26.en: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.

tr.85: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it,
tr.19: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
tr.22: But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
tr.203: It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not.

26.en: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"

tr.85: and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’
tr.19: Then they will say: Are we to be reprieved?
tr.22: Then they will say: "Shall we be respited?"
tr.203: Then they will say: "Can we be respited?"

26.en: So for Our punishment are they impatient?

tr.85: How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner?
tr.19: Would they (now) hasten on Our doom?
tr.22: Do they then ask for Our Penalty to be hastened on?
tr.203: Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?

26.en: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years

tr.85: Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years
tr.19: Hast thou then seen, if We content them for (long) years,
tr.22: Seest thou? If We do let them enjoy (this life) for a few years,
tr.203: Tell Me, (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,

26.en: And then there came to them that which they were promised?

tr.85: and then the promised torment came upon them,
tr.19: And then cometh that which they were promised,
tr.22: Yet there comes to them at length the (Punishment) which they were promised!
tr.203: And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,

26.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
26.en: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
26.tl: mā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yumattaʿūna

tr.85: what good would their past enjoyment be to them?
tr.19: (How) that wherewith they were contented naught availeth them?
tr.22: It will profit them not that they enjoyed (this life)!
tr.203: All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them.

26.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
26.en: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
26.tl: wamā ahlaknā min qaryatin illā lahā mundhirūna

tr.85: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,
tr.19: And We destroyed no township but it had its warners
tr.22: Never did We destroy a population, but had its warners -
tr.203: And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners

26.en: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.

tr.85: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.
tr.19: For reminder, for We never were oppressors.
tr.22: By way of reminder; and We never are unjust.
tr.203: By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust.

26.en: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.

tr.85: It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran:
tr.19: The devils did not bring it down.
tr.22: No evil ones have brought down this (Revelation):
tr.203: And it is not the Shayâtîn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ân) down.

26.en: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.

tr.85: it is neither in their interests nor in their power,
tr.19: It is not meet for them, nor is it in their power,
tr.22: It would neither suit them nor would they be able (to produce it).
tr.203: Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it).

26.en: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.

tr.85: indeed they are prevented from overhearing it.
tr.19: Lo! verily they are banished from the hearing.
tr.22: Indeed they have been removed far from even (a chance of) hearing it.
tr.203: Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it.

26.ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
26.en: So do not invoke with Allāh another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
26.tl: falā tadʿu maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fatakūna mina l-muʿadhabīna

tr.85: So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment.
tr.19: Therefor invoke not with Allah another god, lest thou be one of the doomed.
tr.22: So call not on any other god with Allah, or thou wilt be among those under the Penalty.
tr.203: So invoke not with Allâh another ilâh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment.

26.en: And warn, [O Muḥammad], your closest kindred.

tr.85: Warn your nearest kinsfolk
tr.19: And warn thy tribe of near kindred,
tr.22: And admonish thy nearest kinsmen,
tr.203: And warn your tribe (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of near kindred.

26.ar: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
26.en: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the believers.
26.tl: wa-ikh'fiḍ janāḥaka limani ittabaʿaka mina l-mu'minīna

tr.85: and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you.
tr.19: And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee.
tr.22: And lower thy wing to the Believers who follow thee.
tr.203: And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you.

26.ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
26.en: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
26.tl: fa-in ʿaṣawka faqul innī barīon mimmā taʿmalūna

tr.85: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’
tr.19: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
tr.22: Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
tr.203: Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."

26.en: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

tr.85: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful,
tr.19: And put thy trust in the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: And put thy trust on the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,-
tr.203: And put your trust in the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful,

26.en: Who sees you when you arise

tr.85: who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]
tr.19: Who seeth thee when thou standest up (to pray)
tr.22: Who seeth thee standing forth (in prayer),
tr.203: Who sees you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers).

26.en: And your movement among those who prostrate.

tr.85: and sees your movements among the worshippers:
tr.19: And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship).
tr.22: And thy movements among those who prostrate themselves,
tr.203: And your movements among those who fall prostrate (to Allâh in the five compulsory congregational prayers).

26.en: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

tr.85: He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
tr.19: Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer, the Knower.
tr.22: For it is He Who heareth and knoweth all things.
tr.203: Verily He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

26.ar: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ
26.en: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
26.tl: hal unabbi-ukum ʿalā man tanazzalu l-shayāṭīnu

tr.85: Shall I tell you who the jinn come down to?
tr.19: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
tr.22: Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
tr.203: Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayâtîn (devils) descend?

26.en: They descend upon every sinful liar.

tr.85: They come down to every lying sinner
tr.19: They descend on every sinful, false one.
tr.22: They descend on every lying, wicked person,
tr.203: They descend on every lying, sinful person.

26.en: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.

tr.85: who readily lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars:
tr.19: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
tr.22: (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
tr.203: Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the Unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars.

26.en: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;

tr.85: only those who are lost in error follow the poets.
tr.19: As for poets, the erring follow them.
tr.22: And the Poets,- It is those straying in Evil, who follow them:
tr.203: As for the poets, the erring ones follow them,

26.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
26.en: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
26.tl: alam tara annahum fī kulli wādin yahīmūna

tr.85: Do you not see how they rove aimlessly in every valley;
tr.19: Hast thou not seen how they stray in every valley,
tr.22: Seest thou not that they wander distracted in every valley?-
tr.203: See you not that they speak about every subject (praising people - right or wrong) in their poetry?

26.en: And that they say what they do not do? -

tr.85: how they say what they do not do?
tr.19: And how they say that which they do not?
tr.22: And that they say what they practise not?-
tr.203: And that they say what they do not do.

26.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
26.en: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allāh often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
26.tl: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti wadhakarū l-laha kathīran wa-intaṣarū min baʿdi mā ẓulimū wasayaʿlamu alladhīna ẓalamū ayya munqalabin yanqalibūna

tr.85: Not so those [poets] who believe, do good deeds, remember God often, and defend themselves after they have been wronged. The evildoers will find out what they will return to.
tr.19: Save those who believe and do good works, and remember Allah much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged. Those who do wrong will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!
tr.22: Except those who believe, work righteousness, engage much in the remembrance of Allah, and defend themselves only after they are unjustly attacked. And soon will the unjust assailants know what vicissitudes their affairs will take!
tr.203: Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, and remember Allâh much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged [by replying back in poetry to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims)]. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned.

27.ar: طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
27.en: Ṭā, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book
27.tl: tta-seen til'ka āyātu l-qur'āni wakitābin mubīnin

tr.85: Ta Sin These are the verses of the Quran––a scripture that makes things clear;
tr.19: Ta. Sin. These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain;
tr.22: These are verses of the Qur'an,-a book that makes (things) clear;
tr.203: Tâ-Sîn. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ân, and none but Allâh (Alone) knows their meanings].

27.ar: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
27.en: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
27.tl: hudan wabush'rā lil'mu'minīna

tr.85: a guide and joyful news for the believers
tr.19: A guidance and good tidings for believers
tr.22: A guide: and glad tidings for the believers,-
tr.203: A guide (to the Right Path) and glad tidings for the believers [who believe in the Oneness of Allâh (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism)].

27.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
27.en: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
27.tl: alladhīna yuqīmūna l-ṣalata wayu'tūna l-zakata wahum bil-ākhirati hum yūqinūna

tr.85: who keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and believe firmly in the life to come.
tr.19: Who establish worship and pay the poor-due and are sure of the Hereafter.
tr.22: Those who establish regular prayers and give in regular charity, and also have (full) assurance of the hereafter.
tr.203: Those who perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter (resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell).

27.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
27.en: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
27.tl: inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati zayyannā lahum aʿmālahum fahum yaʿmahūna

tr.85: As for those who do not believe in the life to come, We have made their deeds seem alluring to them, so they wander blindly:
tr.19: Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their works fairseeming unto them so that they are all astray.
tr.22: As to those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds pleasing in their eyes; and so they wander about in distraction.
tr.203: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair-seeming to them, so that they wander about blindly.

27.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
27.en: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
27.tl: ulāika alladhīna lahum sūu l-ʿadhābi wahum fī l-ākhirati humu l-akhsarūna

tr.85: it is they who will have the worst suffering, and will be the ones to lose most in the life to come.
tr.19: Those are they for whom is the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
tr.22: Such are they for whom a grievous Penalty is (waiting); and in the Hereafter theirs will be the greatest loss.
tr.203: They are those for whom there will be an evil torment (in this world). And in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.

27.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
27.en: And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.
27.tl: wa-innaka latulaqqā l-qur'āna min ladun ḥakīmin ʿalīmin

tr.85: You [Prophet] receive the Quran from One who is all wise, all knowing.
tr.19: Lo! as for thee (Muhammad), thou verily receivest the Qur'an from the presence of One Wise, Aware.
tr.22: As to thee, the Qur'an is bestowed upon thee from the presence of one who is wise and all-knowing.
tr.203: And verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are being taught the Qur’ân from One, All-Wise, All-Knowing.

27.ar: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
27.en: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
27.tl: idh qāla mūsā li-ahlihi innī ānastu nāran saātīkum min'hā bikhabarin aw ātīkum bishihābin qabasin laʿallakum taṣṭalūna

tr.85: Moses said to his family, ‘I have seen a fire. I will bring you news from there, or a burning stick for you to warm yourselves.’
tr.19: (Remember) when Moses said unto his household: Lo! I spy afar off a fire; I will bring you tidings thence, or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves.
tr.22: Behold! Moses said to his family: "I perceive a fire; soon will I bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand to light our fuel, that ye may warm yourselves.
tr.203: (Remember) when Mûsâ (Moses) said to his household: "Verily I have seen a fire; I will bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand, that you may warm yourselves."

27.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
27.en: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
27.tl: falammā jāahā nūdiya an būrika man fī l-nāri waman ḥawlahā wasub'ḥāna l-lahi rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: When he reached the fire, a voice called: ‘Blessed is the person near this fireand those around it; may God be exalted, the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.19: But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire and Whosoever is round about it! And Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Worlds!
tr.22: But when he came to the (fire), a voice was heard: "Blessed are those in the fire and those around: and glory to Allah, the Lord of the worlds.
tr.203: But when he came to it, he was called: "Blessed is whosoever is in the fire, and whosoever is round about it! And glorified be Allâh, the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

27.ar: يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
27.en: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
27.tl: yāmūsā innahu anā l-lahu l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu

tr.85: Moses, I am God, the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.19: O Moses! Lo! it is I, Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.22: "O Moses! verily, I am Allah, the exalted in might, the wise!....
tr.203: "O Mûsâ (Moses)! Verily it is I, Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

27.ar: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
27.en: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allāh said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
