tr.203: Verily, We give life to the dead, and We record that which they send before (them), and their traces and all things We have recorded with numbers (as a record) in a Clear Book.

36.ar: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
36.en: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
36.tl: wa-iḍ'rib lahum mathalan aṣḥāba l-qaryati idh jāahā l-mur'salūna

tr.85: Give them the example of the people to whose town messengers came.
tr.19: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;
tr.22: Set forth to them, by way of a parable, the (story of) the Companions of the City. Behold!, there came messengers to it.
tr.203: And put forward to them a similitude: the (story of the) dwellers of the town, [it is said that the town was Antioch (Antâkiya)], when there came Messengers to them.

36.ar: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
36.en: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened [them] with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
36.tl: idh arsalnā ilayhimu ith'nayni fakadhabūhumā faʿazzaznā bithālithin faqālū innā ilaykum mur'salūna

tr.85: We sent two messengers but they rejected both. Then We reinforced them with a third. They said, ‘Truly, we are messengers to you,’
tr.19: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
tr.22: When We (first) sent to them two messengers, they rejected them: But We strengthened them with a third: they said, "Truly, we have been sent on a mission to you."
tr.203: When We sent to them two Messengers, they belied them both; so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: "Verily we have been sent to you as Messengers."

36.ar: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
36.en: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
36.tl: qālū mā antum illā basharun mith'lunā wamā anzala l-raḥmānu min shayin in antum illā takdhibūna

tr.85: but they answered, ‘You are only men like ourselves. The Lord of Mercy has sent nothing; you are just lying.'
tr.19: They said: Ye are but mortals like unto us. The Beneficent hath naught revealed. Ye do but lie!
tr.22: The (people) said: "Ye are only men like ourselves; and (Allah) Most Gracious sends no sort of revelation: ye do nothing but lie."
tr.203: They (people of the town) said: "You are only human beings like ourselves, and the Most Gracious (Allâh) has revealed nothing. You are only telling lies."

36.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
36.en: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
36.tl: qālū rabbunā yaʿlamu innā ilaykum lamur'salūna

tr.85: They said, ‘Our Lord knows that we have been sent to you.
tr.19: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
tr.22: They said: "Our Lord doth know that we have been sent on a mission to you:
tr.203: The Messengers said: "Our Lord knows that we have been sent as Messengers to you,

36.ar: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
36.en: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
36.tl: wamā ʿalaynā illā l-balāghu l-mubīnu

tr.85: Our duty is only to deliver the message to you,’
tr.19: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
tr.22: "And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message."
tr.203: "And our duty is only to convey plainly (the Message)."

36.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
36.en: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
36.tl: qālū innā taṭayyarnā bikum la-in lam tantahū lanarjumannakum walayamassannakum minnā ʿadhābun alīmun

tr.85: but they answered, ‘We think you are an evil omen. If you do not stop, we shall stone you, and inflict a painful torment on you.’
tr.19: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
tr.22: The (people) said: "for us, we augur an evil omen from you: if ye desist not, we will certainly stone you. And a grievous punishment indeed will be inflicted on you by us."
tr.203: They (people) said: "For us, we see an evil omen from you: if you cease not, we will surely stone you, and a painful torment will touch you from us."

36.ar: قَالُوا۟ طَـٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّسْرِفُونَ
36.en: They said, "Your omen [i.e., fate] is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
36.tl: qālū ṭāirukum maʿakum a-in dhukkir'tum bal antum qawmun mus'rifūna

tr.85: The messengers said, ‘The evil omen is within yourselves. Why do you take it as an evil omen when you are reminded of the Truth? You are going too far!’
tr.19: They said: Your evil augury be with you! Is it because ye are reminded (of the truth)? Nay, but ye are froward folk!
tr.22: They said: "Your evil omens are with yourselves: (deem ye this an evil omen). If ye are admonished? Nay, but ye are a people transgressing all bounds!"
tr.203: They (Messengers) said: "Your evil omens be with you! (Do you call it "evil omen") because you are admonished? Nay, but you are a people Musrifûn (transgressing all bounds by committing all kinds of great sins, and by disobeying Allâh).

36.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
36.en: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
36.tl: wajāa min aqṣā l-madīnati rajulun yasʿā qāla yāqawmi ittabiʿū l-mur'salīna

tr.85: Then, from the furthest part of the city, a man came running. He said, ‘My people, follow the messengers.
tr.19: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
tr.22: Then there came running, from the farthest part of the City, a man, saying, "O my people! Obey the messengers:
tr.203: And there came a man running from the farthest part of the town. He said: "O my people! Obey the Messengers.

36.ar: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
36.en: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
36.tl: ittabiʿū man lā yasalukum ajran wahum muh'tadūna

tr.85: Follow them: they are not asking you to reward them and they are rightly guided.
tr.19: Follow those who ask of you no fee, and who are rightly guided.
tr.22: "Obey those who ask no reward of you (for themselves), and who have themselves received Guidance.
tr.203: "Obey those who ask no wages of you (for themselves), and who are rightly guided.

36.ar: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
36.en: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
36.tl: wamā liya lā aʿbudu alladhī faṭaranī wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna

tr.85: Why should I not worship the One who created me? It is to Him that you will be returned.
tr.19: For what cause should I not serve Him Who hath created me, and unto Whom ye will be brought back?
tr.22: "It would not be reasonable in me if I did not serve Him Who created me, and to Whom ye shall (all) be brought back.
tr.203: "And why should I not worship Him (Allâh Alone) Who has created me and to Whom you shall be returned.

36.ar: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
36.en: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
36.tl: a-attakhidhu min dūnihi ālihatan in yurid'ni l-raḥmānu biḍurrin lā tugh'ni ʿannī shafāʿatuhum shayan walā yunqidhūni

tr.85: How could I take besides Him any other gods, whose intercession will not help me and who would not be able to save me if the Lord of Mercy wished to harm me?
tr.19: Shall I take (other) gods in place of Him when, if the Beneficent should wish me any harm, their intercession will avail me naught, nor can they save?
tr.22: "Shall I take (other) gods besides Him? If (Allah) Most Gracious should intend some adversity for me, of no use whatever will be their intercession for me, nor can they deliver me.
tr.203: "Shall I take besides Him âlihah (gods)? If the Most Gracious (Allâh) intends me any harm, their intercession will be of no use for me whatsoever, nor can they save me?

36.ar: إِنِّىٓ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
36.en: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
36.tl: innī idhan lafī ḍalālin mubīnin

tr.85: Then I would clearly be in the wrong.
tr.19: Then truly I should be in error manifest.
tr.22: "I would indeed, if I were to do so, be in manifest Error.
tr.203: "Then verily, I should be in plain error.

36.ar: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
36.en: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
36.tl: innī āmantu birabbikum fa-is'maʿūni

tr.85: I believe in your Lord, so listen to me.’
tr.19: Lo! I have believed in your Lord, so hear me!
tr.22: "For me, I have faith in the Lord of you (all): listen, then, to me!"
tr.203: "Verily! I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me!"

36.ar: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
36.en: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
36.tl: qīla ud'khuli l-janata qāla yālayta qawmī yaʿlamūna

tr.85: He was told, ‘Enter the Garden,’ so he said, ‘If only my people knew
tr.19: It was said (unto him): Enter paradise. He said: Would that my people knew
tr.22: It was said: "Enter thou the Garden." He said: "Ah me! Would that my People knew (what I know)!-
tr.203: It was said (to him when the disbelievers killed him): "Enter Paradise." He said: "Would that my people knew

36.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
36.en: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
36.tl: bimā ghafara lī rabbī wajaʿalanī mina l-muk'ramīna

tr.85: how my Lord has forgiven me and set me among the highly honoured.’
tr.19: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
tr.22: "For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour!"
tr.203: "That my Lord (Allâh) has forgiven me, and made me of the honoured ones!"

36.ar: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
36.en: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
36.tl: wamā anzalnā ʿalā qawmihi min baʿdihi min jundin mina l-samāi wamā kunnā munzilīna

tr.85: After him We did not send any army from heaven against his people, nor were We about to:
tr.19: We sent not down against his people after him a host from heaven, nor do We ever send.
tr.22: And We sent not down against his People, after him, any hosts from heaven, nor was it needful for Us so to do.
tr.203: And We sent not against his people after him a host from the heaven, nor was it needful for Us to send (such a thing).

36.ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ خَـٰمِدُونَ
36.en: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
36.tl: in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum khāmidūna

tr.85: there was just one blast, and they fell down lifeless.
tr.19: It was but one Shout, and lo! they were extinct.
tr.22: It was no more than a single mighty Blast, and behold! they were (like ashes) quenched and silent.
tr.203: It was but one Saihah (shout) and lo! they (all) were still (silent,dead,destroyed).

36.ar: يَـٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
36.en: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
36.tl: yāḥasratan ʿalā l-ʿibādi mā yatīhim min rasūlin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna

tr.85: Alas for human beings! Whenever a messenger comes to them they ridicule him.
tr.19: Ah, the anguish for the bondmen! Never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him!
tr.22: Ah! Alas for (My) Servants! There comes not a messenger to them but they mock him!
tr.203: Alas for mankind! There never came a Messenger to them but they used to mock at him.

36.ar: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
36.en: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
36.tl: alam yaraw kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni annahum ilayhim lā yarjiʿūna

tr.85: Do they not see how many generations We have destroyed before them, none of whom will ever come back to them?
tr.19: Have they not seen how many generations We destroyed before them, which indeed returned not unto them;
tr.22: See they not how many generations before them we destroyed? Not to them will they return:
tr.203: Do they not see how many of the generations We have destroyed before them? Verily, they will not return to them.

36.ar: وَإِن كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
36.en: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
36.tl: wa-in kullun lammā jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūna

tr.85: [Yet] all of them will be brought before Us.
tr.19: But all, without exception, will be brought before Us.
tr.22: But each one of them all - will be brought before Us (for judgment).
tr.203: And surely, all - everyone of them will be brought before Us.

36.ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَـٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
36.en: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
36.tl: waāyatun lahumu l-arḍu l-maytatu aḥyaynāhā wa-akhrajnā min'hā ḥabban famin'hu yakulūna

tr.85: There is a sign for them in the lifeless earth: We give it life and We produce grain from it for them to eat;
tr.19: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;
tr.22: A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat.
tr.203: And a sign for them is the dead land. We give it life, and We bring forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.

36.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّـٰتٍ مِّن نَّخِيلٍ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
36.en: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
36.tl: wajaʿalnā fīhā jannātin min nakhīlin wa-aʿnābin wafajjarnā fīhā mina l-ʿuyūni

tr.85: We have put gardens of date palms and grapes in the earth, and We have made springs of water gush out of it
tr.19: And We have placed therein gardens of the date-palm and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein,
tr.22: And We produce therein orchard with date-palms and vines, and We cause springs to gush forth therein:
tr.203: And We have made therein gardens of date-palms and grapes, and We have caused springs of water to gush forth therein.

36.ar: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
36.en: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
36.tl: liyakulū min thamarihi wamā ʿamilathu aydīhim afalā yashkurūna

tr.85: so that they could eat its fruit. It was not their own hands that made all this. How can they not give thanks?
tr.19: That they may eat of the fruit thereof, and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?
tr.22: That they may enjoy the fruits of this (artistry): It was not their hands that made this: will they not then give thanks?
tr.203: So that they may eat of the fruit thereof - and their hands made it not. Will they not, then, give thanks?

36.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
36.en: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
36.tl: sub'ḥāna alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā mimmā tunbitu l-arḍu wamin anfusihim wamimmā lā yaʿlamūna

tr.85: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs of things that the earth produces, as well as themselves and other things they do not know about.
tr.19: Glory be to Him Who created all the sexual pairs, of that which the earth groweth, and of themselves, and of that which they know not!
tr.22: Glory to Allah, Who created in pairs all things that the earth produces, as well as their own (human) kind and (other) things of which they have no knowledge.
tr.203: Glory be to Him Who has created all the pairs of that which the earth produces, as well as of their own (human) kind (male and female), and of that which they know not.

36.ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
36.en: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
36.tl: waāyatun lahumu al-laylu naslakhu min'hu l-nahāra fa-idhā hum muẓ'limūna

tr.85: The night is also a sign for them: We strip the daylight from it, and- lo and behold!- they are in darkness.
tr.19: A token unto them is night. We strip it of the day, and lo! they are in darkness.
tr.22: And a Sign for them is the Night: We withdraw therefrom the Day, and behold they are plunged in darkness;
tr.203: And a sign for them is the night. We withdraw therefrom the day, and behold, they are in darkness.

36.ar: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
36.en: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
36.tl: wal-shamsu tajrī limus'taqarrin lahā dhālika taqdīru l-ʿazīzi l-ʿalīmi

tr.85: The sun, too, runs its determined course laid down for it by the Almighty, the All Knowing.
tr.19: And the sun runneth on unto a resting-place for him. That is the measuring of the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.22: And the sun runs his course for a period determined for him: that is the decree of (Him), the Exalted in Might, the All-Knowing.
tr.203: And the sun runs on its fixed course for a term (appointed). That is the Decree of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

36.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَـٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
36.en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
36.tl: wal-qamara qaddarnāhu manāzila ḥattā ʿāda kal-ʿur'jūni l-qadīmi

tr.85: We have determined phases for the moon until finally it becomes like an old date-stalk.
tr.19: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
tr.22: And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
tr.203: And the moon, We have measured for it mansions (to traverse) till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.

36.ar: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّ فِى فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
36.en: It is not allowable [i.e., possible] for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
36.tl: lā l-shamsu yanbaghī lahā an tud'rika l-qamara walā al-laylu sābiqu l-nahāri wakullun fī falakin yasbaḥūna

tr.85: The sun cannot overtake the moon, nor can the night outrun the day: each floats in [its own] orbit.
tr.19: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day. They float each in an orbit.
tr.22: It is not permitted to the Sun to catch up the Moon, nor can the Night outstrip the Day: Each (just) swims along in (its own) orbit (according to Law).
tr.203: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon, nor does the night outstrip the day. They all float, each in an orbit.

36.ar: وَءَايَةٌ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
36.en: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
36.tl: waāyatun lahum annā ḥamalnā dhurriyyatahum fī l-ful'ki l-mashḥūni

tr.85: Another sign for them is that We carried their seed in the laden Ark,
tr.19: And a token unto them is that We bear their offspring in the laden ship,
tr.22: And a Sign for them is that We bore their race (through the Flood) in the loaded Ark;
tr.203: And an Ayâh (sign) for them is that We bore their offspring in the laden ship [of Nûh (Noah)].

36.ar: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
36.en: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
36.tl: wakhalaqnā lahum min mith'lihi mā yarkabūna

tr.85: and We have made similar things for them to ride in.
tr.19: And have created for them of the like thereof whereon they ride.
tr.22: And We have created for them similar (vessels) on which they ride.
tr.203: And We have created for them of the like thereunto, on which they ride.

36.ar: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
36.en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
36.tl: wa-in nasha nugh'riq'hum falā ṣarīkha lahum walā hum yunqadhūna

tr.85: If We wished, We could drown them, and there would be no one to help them: they could not be saved.
tr.19: And if We will, We drown them, and there is no help for them, neither can they be saved;
tr.22: If it were Our Will, We could drown them: then would there be no helper (to hear their cry), nor could they be delivered,
tr.203: And if We will, We shall drown them, and there will be no shout (or helper) for them (to hear their cry for help), nor will they be saved.

36.ar: إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَـٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
36.en: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
36.tl: illā raḥmatan minnā wamatāʿan ilā ḥīnin

tr.85: Only by Our mercy could they be reprieved to enjoy life for a while.
tr.19: Unless by mercy from Us and as comfort for a while.
tr.22: Except by way of Mercy from Us, and by way of (world) convenience (to serve them) for a time.
tr.203: Unless it be a mercy from Us, and as an enjoyment for a while.

36.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
36.en: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy..."
36.tl: wa-idhā qīla lahumu ittaqū mā bayna aydīkum wamā khalfakum laʿallakum tur'ḥamūna

tr.85: Yet when they are told, ‘Beware of what lies before and behind you, so that you may be given mercy,’
tr.19: When it is said unto them: Beware of that which is before you and that which is behind you, that haply ye may find mercy (they are heedless).
tr.22: When they are told, "Fear ye that which is before you and that which will be after you, in order that ye may receive Mercy," (they turn back).
tr.203: And when it is said to them: "Fear of that which is before you (worldly torments), and that which is behind you (torments in the Hereafter), in order that you may receive Mercy (i.e. if you believe in Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism, and avoid polytheism, and obey Allâh with righteous deeds)."

36.ar: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ مِّنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
36.en: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
36.tl: wamā tatīhim min āyatin min āyāti rabbihim illā kānū ʿanhā muʿ'riḍīna

tr.85: they ignore every single sign that comes to them from their Lord,
tr.19: Never came a token of the tokens of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it!
tr.22: Not a Sign comes to them from among the Signs of their Lord, but they turn away therefrom.
tr.203: And never came an Ayâh from among the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord to them, but they did turn away from it.

36.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
36.en: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allāh has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allāh had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
36.tl: wa-idhā qīla lahum anfiqū mimmā razaqakumu l-lahu qāla alladhīna kafarū lilladhīna āmanū anuṭ'ʿimu man law yashāu l-lahu aṭʿamahu in antum illā fī ḍalālin mubīnin

tr.85: and when they are told, ‘Give to others out of what God has provided for you,’ the disbelievers say to the believers, ‘Why should we feed those that God could feed if He wanted? You must be deeply misguided.’
tr.19: And when it is said unto them: Spend of that wherewith Allah hath provided you, those who disbelieve say unto those who believe: Shall we feed those whom Allah, if He willed, would feed? Ye are in naught else than error manifest.
tr.22: And when they are told, "Spend ye of (the bounties) with which Allah has provided you," the Unbelievers say to those who believe: "Shall we then feed those whom, if Allah had so willed, He would have fed, (Himself)?- Ye are in nothing but manifest error."
tr.203: And when it is said to them: "Spend of that with which Allâh has provided you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe: "Shall we feed those whom, if Allâh willed, He (Himself) would have fed? You are only in a plain error."

36.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
36.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
36.tl: wayaqūlūna matā hādhā l-waʿdu in kuntum ṣādiqīna

tr.85: And they say, ‘When will this promise be fulfilled, if what you say is true?’
tr.19: And they say: When will this promise be fulfilled, if ye are truthful?
tr.22: Further, they say, "When will this promise (come to pass), if what ye say is true?"
tr.203: And they say: "When will this promise (i.e. Resurrection) be fulfilled, if you are truthful?"

36.ar: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
36.en: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
36.tl: mā yanẓurūna illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan takhudhuhum wahum yakhiṣṣimūna

tr.85: But all they are waiting for is a single blast that will overtake them while they are still arguing with each other.
tr.19: They await but one Shout, which will surprise them while they are disputing.
tr.22: They will not (have to) wait for aught but a single Blast: it will seize them while they are yet disputing among themselves!
tr.203: They await only but a single Saihah (shout), which will seize them while they are disputing!

36.ar: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةً وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
36.en: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
36.tl: falā yastaṭīʿūna tawṣiyatan walā ilā ahlihim yarjiʿūna

tr.85: They will have no time to make bequests, nor will they have the chance to return to their own people.
tr.19: Then they cannot make bequest, nor can they return to their own folk.
tr.22: No (chance) will they then have, by will, to dispose (of their affairs), nor to return to their own people!
tr.203: Then they will not be able to make bequest, nor they will return to their family.

36.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
36.en: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
36.tl: wanufikha fī l-ṣūri fa-idhā hum mina l-ajdāthi ilā rabbihim yansilūna

tr.85: The Trumpet will be sounded and- lo and behold!- they will rush out to their Lord from their graves.
tr.19: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
tr.22: The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
tr.203: And the Trumpet will be blown (i.e. the second blowing) and behold from the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.

36.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَـٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
36.en: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
36.tl: qālū yāwaylanā man baʿathanā min marqadinā hādhā mā waʿada l-raḥmānu waṣadaqa l-mur'salūna

tr.85: They will say, ‘Alas for us! Who has resurrected us from our resting places?’ [They will be told], ‘This is what the Lord of Mercy promised, and the messengers told the truth.’
tr.19: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
tr.22: They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
tr.203: They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Gracious (Allâh) had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"

36.ar: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
36.en: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
36.tl: in kānat illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fa-idhā hum jamīʿun ladaynā muḥ'ḍarūna

tr.85: It was just one single blast and then- lo and behold!- they were all brought before Us.
tr.19: It is but one Shout, and behold them brought together before Us!
tr.22: It will be no more than a single Blast, when lo! they will all be brought up before Us!
tr.203: It will be but a single Saihah (shout), so behold they will all be brought up before Us!

36.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
36.en: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
36.tl: fal-yawma lā tuẓ'lamu nafsun shayan walā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: ‘Today, no soul will be wronged in the least: you will only be repaid for your deeds.
tr.19: This day no soul is wronged in aught; nor are ye requited aught save what ye used to do.
tr.22: Then, on that Day, not a soul will be wronged in the least, and ye shall but be repaid the meeds of your past Deeds.
tr.203: This Day (Day of Resurrection), none will be wronged in anything, nor will you be requited anything except that which you used to do.

36.ar: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
36.en: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
36.tl: inna aṣḥāba l-janati l-yawma fī shughulin fākihūna

tr.85: The people of Paradise today are happily occupied-
tr.19: Lo! those who merit paradise this day are happily employed,
tr.22: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
tr.203: Verily, the dwellers of the Paradise, that Day, will be busy with joyful things.

36.ar: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
36.en: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
36.tl: hum wa-azwājuhum fī ẓilālin ʿalā l-arāiki muttakiūna

tr.85: they and their spouses- seated on couches in the shade.
tr.19: They and their wives, in pleasant shade, on thrones reclining;
tr.22: They and their associates will be in groves of (cool) shade, reclining on Thrones (of dignity);
tr.203: They and their wives will be in pleasant shade, reclining on thrones.

36.ar: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
36.en: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
36.tl: lahum fīhā fākihatun walahum mā yaddaʿūna

tr.85: There they have fruit and whatever they ask for.
tr.19: Theirs the fruit (of their good deeds) and theirs (all) that they ask;
tr.22: (Every) fruit (enjoyment) will be there for them; they shall have whatever they call for;
tr.203: They will have therein fruits (of all kinds) and all that they ask for.

36.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْلًا مِّن رَّبٍّ رَّحِيمٍ
36.en: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
36.tl: salāmun qawlan min rabbin raḥīmin

tr.85: “Peace,” a word from the Lord of Mercy.
tr.19: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
tr.22: "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
tr.203: (It will be said to them): Salâm (peace be on you) - a Word from the Lord (Allâh), Most Merciful.

36.ar: وَٱمْتَـٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
36.en: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
36.tl: wa-im'tāzū l-yawma ayyuhā l-muj'rimūna

tr.85: But step aside today, you guilty ones.
tr.19: But avaunt ye, O ye guilty, this day!
tr.22: "And O ye in sin! Get ye apart this Day!
tr.203: (It will be said): "And O you Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Islâmic Monotheism, wicked evil ones)! Get you apart this Day (from the believers).

36.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَـٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
36.en: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
36.tl: alam aʿhad ilaykum yābanī ādama an lā taʿbudū l-shayṭāna innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun

tr.85: Children of Adam, did I not command you not to serve Satan, for he was your sworn enemy,
tr.19: Did I not charge you, O ye sons of Adam, that ye worship not the devil - Lo! he is your open foe! -
tr.22: "Did I not enjoin on you, O ye Children of Adam, that ye should not worship Satan; for that he was to you an enemy avowed?-
tr.203: Did I not command you, O Children of Adam, that you should not worship Shaitân (Satan). Verily, he is a plain enemy to you.

36.ar: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
36.en: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
36.tl: wa-ani uʿ'budūnī hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun

tr.85: but to serve Me? This is the straight path.
tr.19: But that ye worship Me? That was the right path.
tr.22: "And that ye should worship Me, (for that) this was the Straight Way?
tr.203: And that you should worship Me [Alone - Islâmic Monotheism, and set up not rivals, associate-gods with Me]. That is the Straight Path.

36.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
36.en: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
36.tl: walaqad aḍalla minkum jibillan kathīran afalam takūnū taʿqilūna

tr.85: He has led great numbers of you astray. Did you not use your reason?
tr.19: Yet he hath led astray of you a great multitude. Had ye then no sense?
tr.22: "But he did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did ye not, then, understand?
tr.203: And indeed he (Satan) did lead astray a great multitude of you. Did you not, then, understand?

36.ar: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
36.en: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
36.tl: hādhihi jahannamu allatī kuntum tūʿadūna

tr.85: So this is the Fire that you were warned against.
tr.19: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
tr.22: "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
tr.203: This is Hell which you were promised!

36.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
36.en: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
36.tl: iṣ'lawhā l-yawma bimā kuntum takfurūna

tr.85: Enter it today, because you went on ignoring [my commands].’
tr.19: Burn therein this day for that ye disbelieved.
tr.22: "Embrace ye the (fire) this Day, for that ye (persistently) rejected (Truth)."
tr.203: Burn therein this Day, for that you used to disbelieve.

36.ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
36.en: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
36.tl: al-yawma nakhtimu ʿalā afwāhihim watukallimunā aydīhim watashhadu arjuluhum bimā kānū yaksibūna

tr.85: On that Day We shall seal up their mouths, but their hands will speak to Us, and their feet bear witness to everything they have done.
tr.19: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
tr.22: That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
tr.203: This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one’s left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabarî,]

36.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
36.en: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
36.tl: walaw nashāu laṭamasnā ʿalā aʿyunihim fa-is'tabaqū l-ṣirāṭa fa-annā yub'ṣirūna

tr.85: If it had been Our will, We could have taken away their sight. They would have struggled to find the way, but how could they have seen it?
tr.19: And had We willed, We verily could have quenched their eyesight so that they should struggle for the way. Then how could they have seen?
tr.22: If it had been our Will, We could surely have blotted out their eyes; then should they have run about groping for the Path, but how could they have seen?
tr.203: And if it had been Our Will, We would surely have wiped out (blinded) their eyes, so that they would struggle for the Path, how then would they see?

36.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
36.en: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
36.tl: walaw nashāu lamasakhnāhum ʿalā makānatihim famā is'taṭāʿū muḍiyyan walā yarjiʿūna

tr.85: If it had been Our will, We could have paralysed them where they stood, so that they could not move forward or backward.
tr.19: And had We willed, We verily could have fixed them in their place, making them powerless to go forward or turn back.
tr.22: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (to remain) in their places; then should they have been unable to move about, nor could they have returned (after error).
tr.203: And if it had been Our Will, We could have transformed them (into animals or lifeless objects) in their places. Then they would have been unable to go forward (move about) nor they could have turned back.

36.ar: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
36.en: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
36.tl: waman nuʿammir'hu nunakkis'hu fī l-khalqi afalā yaʿqilūna

tr.85: If We extend anyone’s life, We reverse his development. Do they not use their reason?
tr.19: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
tr.22: If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
tr.203: And he whom We grant long life - We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?

36.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَـٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ وَقُرْءَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
36.en: And We did not give him [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur’ān
36.tl: wamā ʿallamnāhu l-shiʿ'ra wamā yanbaghī lahu in huwa illā dhik'run waqur'ānun mubīnun

tr.85: We have not taught the Prophet poetry, nor could he everhave been a poet.
tr.19: And We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry, nor is it meet for him. This is naught else than a Reminder and a Lecture making plain,
tr.22: We have not instructed the (Prophet) in Poetry, nor is it meet for him: this is no less than a Message and a Qur'an making things clear:
tr.203: And We have not taught him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) poetry, nor is it suitable for him. This is only a Reminder and a plain Qur’ân.

36.ar: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
36.en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
36.tl: liyundhira man kāna ḥayyan wayaḥiqqa l-qawlu ʿalā l-kāfirīna

tr.85: This is a revelation, an illuminating Quran to warn anyone who is truly alive, so that God’s verdict may be passed against the disbelievers.
tr.19: To warn whosoever liveth, and that the word may be fulfilled against the disbelievers.
tr.22: That it may give admonition to any (who are) alive, and that the charge may be proved against those who reject (Truth).
tr.203: That he or it (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم or the Qur’ân) may give warning to him who is living (a healthy minded - the believer), and that Word (charge) may be justified against the disbelievers (dead, as they reject the warnings).

36.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَـٰلِكُونَ
36.en: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
36.tl: awalam yaraw annā khalaqnā lahum mimmā ʿamilat aydīnā anʿāman fahum lahā mālikūna

tr.85: Can they not see how, among the things made by Our hands, We have created livestock they control,
tr.19: Have they not seen how We have created for them of Our handiwork the cattle, so that they are their owners,
tr.22: See they not that it is We Who have created for them - among the things which Our hands have fashioned - cattle, which are under their dominion?-
tr.203: Do they not see that We have created for them of what Our Hands have created the cattle, so that they are their owners.

36.ar: وَذَلَّلْنَـٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
36.en: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
36.tl: wadhallalnāhā lahum famin'hā rakūbuhum wamin'hā yakulūna

tr.85: and made them obedient, so that some can be used for riding, some for food,
tr.19: And have subdued them unto them, so that some of them they have for riding, some for food?
tr.22: And that We have subjected them to their (use)? of them some do carry them and some they eat:
tr.203: And We have subdued them unto them so that some of them they have for riding and some they eat.

36.ar: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
36.en: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
36.tl: walahum fīhā manāfiʿu wamashāribu afalā yashkurūna

tr.85: some for other benefits, and some for drink? Will they not give thanks?
tr.19: Benefits and (divers) drinks have they from them. Will they not then give thanks?
tr.22: And they have (other) profits from them (besides), and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?
tr.203: And they have (other) benefits from them, and they get (milk) to drink. Will they not then be grateful?

36.ar: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
36.en: But they have taken besides Allāh [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
36.tl: wa-ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi ālihatan laʿallahum yunṣarūna

tr.85: Yet they have taken other gods besides God to help them,
tr.19: And they have taken (other) gods beside Allah, in order that they may be helped.
tr.22: Yet they take (for worship) gods other than Allah, (hoping) that they might be helped!
tr.203: And they have taken besides Allâh âlihah (gods), hoping that they might be helped (by those so-called gods).

36.ar: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌ مُّحْضَرُونَ
36.en: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
36.tl: lā yastaṭīʿūna naṣrahum wahum lahum jundun muḥ'ḍarūna

tr.85: though these could not do so even if they called a whole army of them together!
tr.19: It is not in their power to help them; but they (the worshippers) are unto them a host in arms.
tr.22: They have not the power to help them: but they will be brought up (before Our Judgment-seat) as a troop (to be condemned).
tr.203: They cannot help them, but they will be brought forward as a troop against those who worshipped them (at the time of Reckoning).

36.ar: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
36.en: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
36.tl: falā yaḥzunka qawluhum innā naʿlamu mā yusirrūna wamā yuʿ'linūna

tr.85: So [Prophet] do not be distressed at what they say: We know what they conceal and what they reveal.
tr.19: So let not their speech grieve thee (O Muhammad). Lo! We know what they conceal and what proclaim.
tr.22: Let not their speech, then, grieve thee. Verily We know what they hide as well as what they disclose.
tr.203: So let not their speech, then, grieve you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). Verily, We know what they conceal and what they reveal.

36.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
36.en: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
36.tl: awalam yara l-insānu annā khalaqnāhu min nuṭ'fatin fa-idhā huwa khaṣīmun mubīnun

tr.85: Can man not see that We created him from a drop of fluid? Yet- lo and behold!- he disputes openly,
tr.19: Hath not man seen that We have created him from a drop of seed? Yet lo! he is an open opponent.
tr.22: Doth not man see that it is We Who created him from sperm? yet behold! he (stands forth) as an open adversary!
tr.203: Does not man see that We have created him from Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge - semen drops). Yet behold he (stands forth) as an open opponent.

36.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌ
36.en: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
36.tl: waḍaraba lanā mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qāla man yuḥ'yī l-ʿiẓāma wahiya ramīmun

tr.85: producing arguments against Us, forgetting his own creation. He says, ‘Who can give life back to bones after they have decayed?’
tr.19: And he hath coined for Us a similitude, and hath forgotten the fact of his creation, saying: Who will revive these bones when they have rotted away?
tr.22: And he makes comparisons for Us, and forgets his own (origin and) Creation: He says, "Who can give life to (dry) bones and decomposed ones (at that)?"
tr.203: And he puts forth for Us a parable, and forgets his own creation. He says: "Who will give life to these bones after they are rotten and have become dust?"

36.ar: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
36.en: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
36.tl: qul yuḥ'yīhā alladhī ansha-ahā awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin ʿalīmun

tr.85: Say, ‘He who created them in the first place will give them life again: He has full knowledge of every act of creation.
tr.19: Say: He will revive them Who produced them at the first, for He is Knower of every creation,
tr.22: Say, "He will give them life Who created them for the first time! for He is Well-versed in every kind of creation!-
tr.203: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) "He will give life to them Who created them for the first time! And He is the All-Knower of every creation!"

36.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
36.en: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
36.tl: alladhī jaʿala lakum mina l-shajari l-akhḍari nāran fa-idhā antum min'hu tūqidūna

tr.85: It is He who produces fire for you out of the green tree- lo and behold!- and from this you kindle fire.
tr.19: Who hath appointed for you fire from the green tree, and behold! ye kindle from it.
tr.22: "The same Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold! ye kindle therewith (your own fires)!
tr.203: He Who produces for you fire out of the green tree, when behold you kindle therewith.

36.ar: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
36.en: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
36.tl: awalaysa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa biqādirin ʿalā an yakhluqa mith'lahum balā wahuwa l-khalāqu l-ʿalīmu

tr.85: Is He who created the heavens and earth not able to create the likes of these people? Of course He is! He is the All Knowing Creator:
tr.19: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the like of them? Aye, that He is! for He is the All-Wise Creator,
tr.22: "Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like thereof?" - Yea, indeed! for He is the Creator Supreme, of skill and knowledge (infinite)!
tr.203: Is not He Who created the heavens and the earth, Able to create the like of them? Yes, indeed! He is the All-Knowing Supreme Creator.

36.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
36.en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
36.tl: innamā amruhu idhā arāda shayan an yaqūla lahu kun fayakūnu

tr.85: when He wills something to be, His way is to say, “Be”- and it is!
tr.19: But His command, when He intendeth a thing, is only that He saith unto it: Be! and it is.
tr.22: Verily, when He intends a thing, His Command is, "be", and it is!
tr.203: Verily, His Command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, "Be!" - and it is!

36.ar: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
36.en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
36.tl: fasub'ḥāna alladhī biyadihi malakūtu kulli shayin wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna

tr.85: So glory be to Him in whose Hand lies control over all things. It is to Him that you will all be brought back.’
tr.19: Therefor Glory be to Him in Whose hand is the dominion over all things! Unto Him ye will be brought back.
tr.22: So glory to Him in Whose hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him will ye be all brought back.
tr.203: So glorified be He and exalted above all that they associate with Him, and in Whose Hands is the dominion of all things: and to Him you shall be returned.

37.en: By those [angels] lined up in rows

tr.85: By those [angels] ranged in rows,
tr.19: By those who set the ranks in battle order
tr.22: By those who range themselves in ranks,
tr.203: By those (angels) ranged in ranks (or rows).

37.en: And those who drive [the clouds]

tr.85: who rebuke reproachfully
tr.19: And those who drive away (the wicked) with reproof
tr.22: And so are strong in repelling (evil),
tr.203: By those (angels) who drive the clouds in a good way.

37.en: And those who recite the message,

tr.85: and recite God’s word,
tr.19: And those who read (the Word) for a reminder,
tr.22: And thus proclaim the Message (of Allah)!
tr.203: By those (angels) who bring the Book and the Qur’ân from Allâh to mankind [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

37.en: Indeed, your God is One,

tr.85: truly your God is One,
tr.19: Lo! thy Lord is surely One;
tr.22: Verily, verily, your Allah is one!-
tr.203: Verily your Ilâh (God) is indeed One (i.e. Allâh):

37.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ
37.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
37.tl: rabbu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā warabbu l-mashāriqi

tr.85: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them, Lord of every sunrise.
tr.19: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all that is between them, and Lord of the sun's risings.
tr.22: Lord of the heavens and of the earth and all between them, and Lord of every point at the rising of the sun!
tr.203: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and all that is between them, and Lord of every point of the sun’s risings.

37.ar: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
37.en: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
37.tl: innā zayyannā l-samāa l-dun'yā bizīnatin l-kawākibi

tr.85: We have adorned the lowest heaven with stars,
tr.19: Lo! We have adorned the lowest heaven with an ornament, the planets;
tr.22: We have indeed decked the lower heaven with beauty (in) the stars,-
tr.203: Verily We have adorned the near heaven with the stars (for beauty).

37.en: And as protection against every rebellious devil

tr.85: and made them a safeguard against every rebellious devil:
tr.19: With security from every froward devil.
tr.22: (For beauty) and for guard against all obstinate rebellious evil spirits,
tr.203: And to guard against every rebellious devil.

37.ar: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍ
37.en: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
37.tl: lā yassammaʿūna ilā l-mala-i l-aʿlā wayuq'dhafūna min kulli jānibin

tr.85: they cannot eavesdrop on the Higher Assembly––pelted from every side,
tr.19: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
tr.22: (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
tr.203: They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.

37.en: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

tr.85: driven away, they will have perpetual torment––
tr.19: Outcast, and theirs is a perpetual torment;
tr.22: Repulsed, for they are under a perpetual penalty,
tr.203: Outcast, and theirs is a constant (or painful) torment.

37.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ ثَاقِبٌ
37.en: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
37.tl: illā man khaṭifa l-khaṭfata fa-atbaʿahu shihābun thāqibun

tr.85: if any [of them] stealthily snatches away a fragment, he will be pursued by a piercing flame.
tr.19: Save him who snatcheth a fragment, and there pursueth him a piercing flame.
tr.22: Except such as snatch away something by stealth, and they are pursued by a flaming fire, of piercing brightness.
tr.203: Except such as snatch away something by stealing, and they are pursued by a flaming fire of piercing brightness.

37.ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّن طِينٍ لَّازِبٍۭ
37.en: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
37.tl: fa-is'taftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqnā innā khalaqnāhum min ṭīnin lāzibin

tr.85: So [Prophet], ask the disbelievers: is it harder to create them than other beings We have created? We created them from sticky clay.
tr.19: Then ask them (O Muhammad): Are they stronger as a creation, or those (others) whom we have created? Lo! We created them of plastic clay.
tr.22: Just ask their opinion: are they the more difficult to create, or the (other) beings We have created? Them have We created out of a sticky clay!
tr.203: Then ask them (i.e. these polytheists, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are they stronger as creation, or those (others like the heavens and the earth and the mountains) whom We have created?" Verily, We created them of a sticky clay.

37.en: But you wonder, while they mock,

tr.85: You marvel as they scoff,
tr.19: Nay, but thou dost marvel when they mock
tr.22: Truly dost thou marvel, while they ridicule,
tr.203: Nay, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) wondered (at their insolence) while they mock (at you and at the Qur’ân).

37.en: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

tr.85: take no heed when they are warned,
tr.19: And heed not when they are reminded,
tr.22: And, when they are admonished, pay no heed,-
tr.203: And when they are reminded, they pay no attention.

37.en: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

tr.85: and resort to ridicule when they see a sign,
tr.19: And seek to scoff when they behold a portent.
tr.22: And, when they see a Sign, turn it to mockery,
tr.203: And when they see an Ayâh (a sign, or an evidence) from Allâh, they mock at it.

37.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
37.en: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
37.tl: waqālū in hādhā illā siḥ'run mubīnun

tr.85: saying, ‘This is no more than blatant sorcery.’
tr.19: And they say: Lo! this is mere magic;
tr.22: And say, "This is nothing but evident sorcery!
tr.203: And they say: "This is nothing but evident magic!

37.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
37.en: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
37.tl: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna

tr.85: ‘What! After we have died and become dust and bones, shall we really be raised up again,
tr.19: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised (again)?
tr.22: "What! when we die, and become dust and bones, shall we (then) be raised up (again)
tr.203: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we (then) verily be resurrected?

37.en: And our forefathers [as well]?"

tr.85: along with our forefathers?’
tr.19: And our forefathers?
tr.22: "And also our fathers of old?"
tr.203: "And also our fathers of old?"

37.en: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

tr.85: Say, ‘Yes indeed, and you will be humiliated.’
tr.19: Say (O Muhammad): Ye, in truth; and ye will be brought low.
tr.22: Say thou: "Yea, and ye shall then be humiliated (on account of your evil)."
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Yes, and you shall then be humiliated."

37.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
37.en: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
37.tl: fa-innamā hiya zajratun wāḥidatun fa-idhā hum yanẓurūna

tr.85: Just one blast and––lo and behold!––they will look
tr.19: There is but one Shout, and lo! they behold,
tr.22: Then it will be a single (compelling) cry; and behold, they will begin to see!
tr.203: It will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e. the second blowing of the Trumpet)], and behold, they will be staring!

37.en: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

tr.85: and say, ‘Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgement.’
tr.19: And say: Ah, woe for us! This is the Day of Judgment.
tr.22: They will say, "Ah! Woe to us! This is the Day of Judgment!"
tr.203: They will say: "Woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense!"

37.ar: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
37.en: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
37.tl: hādhā yawmu l-faṣli alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna

tr.85: [It will be said], ‘This is the Day of Decision, which you used to deny.
tr.19: This is the Day of Separation, which ye used to deny.
tr.22: (A voice will say,) "This is the Day of Sorting Out, whose truth ye (once) denied!"
tr.203: (It will be said): "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

37.ar: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
37.en: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
37.tl: uḥ'shurū alladhīna ẓalamū wa-azwājahum wamā kānū yaʿbudūna

tr.85: [Angels], gather together those who did wrong, and others like them, as well as whatever they worshipped
tr.19: (And it is said unto the angels): Assemble those who did wrong, together with their wives and what they used to worship
tr.22: "Bring ye up", it shall be said, "The wrong-doers and their wives, and the things they worshipped-
tr.203: (It will be said to the angels): "Assemble those who did wrong, together with their companions (from the devils) and what they used to worship,

37.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
37.en: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
37.tl: min dūni l-lahi fa-ih'dūhum ilā ṣirāṭi l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: beside God, lead them all to the path of Hell,
tr.19: Instead of Allah, and lead them to the path to hell;
tr.22: "Besides Allah, and lead them to the Way to the (Fierce) Fire!
tr.203: "Instead of Allâh, and lead them on to the way of flaming Fire (Hell);

37.en: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

tr.85: and halt them for questioning:
tr.19: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
tr.22: "But stop them, for they must be asked:
tr.203: "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.

37.en: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

tr.85: “Why do you not support each other now?” ’––
tr.19: What aileth you that ye help not one another?
tr.22: "'What is the matter with you that ye help not each other?'"
tr.203: "What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another (as you used to do in the world)?"

37.en: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

tr.85: no indeed! They will be in complete submission on that Day––
tr.19: Nay, but this day they make full submission.
tr.22: Nay, but that day they shall submit (to Judgment);
tr.203: Nay, but that Day they shall surrender.

37.en: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

tr.85: and they will turn on one another accusingly.
tr.19: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
tr.22: And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
tr.203: And they will turn to one another and question one another.

37.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
37.en: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
37.tl: qālū innakum kuntum tatūnanā ʿani l-yamīni

tr.85: They will say, ‘You came to us from a position of power.’
tr.19: They say: Lo! ye used to come unto us, imposing, (swearing that ye spoke the truth).
tr.22: They will say: "It was ye who used to come to us from the right hand (of power and authority)!"
tr.203: They will say: "It was you who used to come to us from the right side [i.e. from the right side of one of us and beautify for us every evil, enjoin on us polytheism, and stop us from the truth i.e. Islâmic Monotheism and from every good deed]."

37.en: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

tr.85: They will say, ‘No! It was you who would not believe-
tr.19: They answer: Nay, but ye (yourselves) were not believers.
tr.22: They will reply: "Nay, ye yourselves had no Faith!
tr.203: They will reply: "Nay, you yourselves were not believers.

37.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَـٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا طَـٰغِينَ
37.en: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
37.tl: wamā kāna lanā ʿalaykum min sul'ṭānin bal kuntum qawman ṭāghīna

tr.85: we had no power over you- and you were already exceeding all limits.
tr.19: We had no power over you, but ye were wayward folk.
tr.22: "Nor had we any authority over you. Nay, it was ye who were a people in obstinate rebellion!
tr.203: "And we had no authority over you. Nay! But you were Tâghûn (transgressing) people (polytheists, and disbelievers).

37.ar: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
37.en: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
37.tl: faḥaqqa ʿalaynā qawlu rabbinā innā ladhāiqūna

tr.85: Our Lord’s sentence on us is just and we must all taste the punishment.
tr.19: Now the Word of our Lord hath been fulfilled concerning us. Lo! we are about to taste (the doom).
tr.22: "So now has been proved true, against us, the word of our Lord that we shall indeed (have to) taste (the punishment of our sins).
tr.203: "So now the Word of our Lord has been justified against us, that we shall certainly (have to) taste (the torment).

37.en: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

tr.85: We led you astray as we ourselves were astray.’
tr.19: Thus we misled you. Lo! we were (ourselves) astray.
tr.22: "We led you astray: for truly we were ourselves astray."
tr.203: "So we led you astray because we were ourselves astray."

37.en: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

tr.85: On that Day they will all share the torment:
tr.19: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
tr.22: Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
tr.203: Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.

37.en: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

tr.85: this is how We deal with the guilty.
tr.19: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
tr.22: Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
tr.203: Certainly, that is how We deal with Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, disbelievers, criminals, the disobedient to Allâh).

37.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
37.en: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant
37.tl: innahum kānū idhā qīla lahum lā ilāha illā l-lahu yastakbirūna

tr.85: Whenever it was said to them, ‘There is no deity but God,’ they became arrogant,
tr.19: For when it was said unto them, There is no Allah save Allah, they were scornful
tr.22: For they, when they were told that there is no god except Allah, would puff themselves up with Pride,
tr.203: Truly, when it was said to them: Lâ ilâha illallâh "(none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)," they puffed themselves up with pride (i.e. denied it).

37.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
37.en: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
37.tl: wayaqūlūna a-innā latārikū ālihatinā lishāʿirin majnūnin

tr.85: and said, ‘Are we to forsake our gods for a mad poet?’
tr.19: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
tr.22: And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
tr.203: And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our âlihah (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?"

37.en: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

tr.85: ‘No: he brought the truth and confirmed the earlier messengers;
tr.19: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
tr.22: Nay! he has come with the (very) Truth, and he confirms (the Message of) the messengers (before him).
tr.203: Nay! he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come with the truth (i.e. Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism and this Qur’ân) and he confirms the Messengers (before him who brought Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

37.en: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

tr.85: you will taste the painful torment,
tr.19: Lo! (now) verily ye taste the painful doom -
tr.22: Ye shall indeed taste of the Grievous Penalty;-
tr.203: Verily, you (pagans of Makkah) are going to taste the painful torment;

37.ar: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
37.en: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
37.tl: wamā tuj'zawna illā mā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: and be repaid only according to your deeds.’
tr.19: Ye are requited naught save what ye did -
tr.22: But it will be no more than the retribution of (the Evil) that ye have wrought;-
tr.203: And you will be requited nothing except for what you used to do (evil deeds, sins, and Allâh’s disobedience which you used to do in this world)

37.en: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

tr.85: Not so God’s true servants.
tr.19: Save single-minded slaves of Allah;
tr.22: But the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah,-
tr.203: Save the chosen slaves of Allâh (i.e. the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

37.en: Those will have a provision determined -

tr.85: They will have familiar provisions––
tr.19: For them there is a known provision,
tr.22: For them is a Sustenance determined,
tr.203: For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise),

37.en: Fruits; and they will be honored

tr.85: fruits- and will be honoured
tr.19: Fruits. And they will be honoured
tr.22: Fruits (Delights); and they (shall enjoy) honour and dignity,
tr.203: Fruits; and they shall be honoured,

37.en: In gardens of pleasure

tr.85: in gardens of delight;
tr.19: In the Gardens of delight,
tr.22: In Gardens of Felicity,
tr.203: In the Gardens of delight (Paradise),

37.en: On thrones facing one another.

tr.85: seated on couches, facing one another.
tr.19: On couches facing one another;
tr.22: Facing each other on Thrones (of Dignity):
tr.203: Facing one another on thrones.

37.en: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

tr.85: A drink will be passed round among them from a flowing spring:
tr.19: A cup from a gushing spring is brought round for them,
tr.22: Round will be passed to them a Cup from a clear-flowing fountain,
tr.203: Round them will be passed a cup of pure wine -

37.en: White and delicious to the drinkers;

tr.85: white, delicious to those who taste it,
tr.19: White, delicious to the drinkers,
tr.22: Crystal-white, of a taste delicious to those who drink (thereof),
tr.203: White, delicious to the drinkers.

37.ar: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
37.en: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
37.tl: lā fīhā ghawlun walā hum ʿanhā yunzafūna

tr.85: causing no headiness or intoxication.
tr.19: Wherein there is no headache nor are they made mad thereby.
tr.22: Free from headiness; nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.
tr.203: Neither will they have Ghoul (any kind of hurt, abdominal pain, headache, a sin) from that, nor will they suffer intoxication therefrom.

37.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,

tr.85: With them will be spouses- modest of gaze and beautiful of eye-
tr.19: And with them are those of modest gaze, with lovely eyes,
tr.22: And besides them will be chaste women, restraining their glances, with big eyes (of wonder and beauty).
tr.203: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives), restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], with wide and beautiful eyes.

37.en: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

tr.85: like protected eggs.
tr.19: (Pure) as they were hidden eggs (of the ostrich).
tr.22: As if they were (delicate) eggs closely guarded.
tr.203: (Delicate and pure) as if they were (hidden) eggs (well) preserved.

37.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

tr.85: They will turn to one another with questions:
tr.19: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
tr.22: Then they will turn to one another and question one another.
tr.203: Then they will turn to one another, mutually questioning.

37.ar: قَالَ قَآئِلٌ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌ
37.en: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].
37.tl: qāla qāilun min'hum innī kāna lī qarīnun

tr.85: one will say, ‘I had a close companion on earth
tr.19: A speaker of them saith: Lo! I had a comrade
tr.22: One of them will start the talk and say: "I had an intimate companion (on the earth),
tr.203: A speaker of them will say: "Verily, I had a companion (in the world),

37.en: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

tr.85: who used to ask me, “Do you really believe that
tr.19: Who used to say: Art thou in truth of those who put faith (in his words)?
tr.22: "Who used to say, 'what! art thou amongst those who bear witness to the Truth (of the Message)?
tr.203: Who used to say: "Are you among those who believe (in resurrection after death).

37.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
37.en: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
37.tl: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamadīnūna

tr.85: after we die and become dust and bone, we shall be brought for judgement?”’
tr.19: Can we, when we are dead and have become mere dust and bones - can we (then) verily be brought to book?
tr.22: "'When we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed receive rewards and punishments?'"
tr.203: "(That) when we die and become dust and bones, shall we indeed (be raised up) to receive reward or punishment (according to our deeds)?"

37.en: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"

tr.85: Then he will say, ‘Shall we look for him?’
tr.19: He saith: Will ye look?
tr.22: (A voice) said: "Would ye like to look down?"
tr.203: (The speaker) said: "Will you look down?"

37.en: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.

tr.85: He will look down and see him in the midst of the Fire,
tr.19: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
tr.22: He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
tr.203: So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.

37.en: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

tr.85: and say to him, ‘By God, you almost brought me to ruin!
tr.19: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
tr.22: He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
tr.203: He said: "By Allâh! You have nearly ruined me.

37.ar: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
37.en: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
37.tl: walawlā niʿ'matu rabbī lakuntu mina l-muḥ'ḍarīna

tr.85: Had it not been for the grace of my Lord, I too would have been taken to Hell.’
tr.19: And had it not been for the favour of my Lord, I too had been of those haled forth (to doom).
tr.22: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I should certainly have been among those brought (there)!
tr.203: "Had it not been for the Grace of my Lord, I would certainly have been among those brought forth (to Hell)."

37.en: Then, are we not to die

tr.85: Then he will say [to his blessed companions], ‘Are we never to die again after our earlier death?
tr.19: Are we then not to die
tr.22: "Is it (the case) that we shall not die,
tr.203: (The dwellers of Paradise will say) "Are we then not to die (any more)?

37.ar: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
37.en: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
37.tl: illā mawtatanā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimuʿadhabīna

tr.85: Shall we never suffer?
tr.19: Saving our former death, and are we not to be punished?
tr.22: "Except our first death, and that we shall not be punished?"
tr.203: Except our first death, and we shall not be punished? (after we have entered Paradise)."

37.en: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

tr.85: This truly is the supreme triumph!’
tr.19: Lo! this is the supreme triumph.
tr.22: Verily this is the supreme achievement!
tr.203: Truly, this is the supreme success!

37.en: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

tr.85: Everyone should strive to attain this.
tr.19: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
tr.22: For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
tr.203: For the like of this let the workers work.

37.ar: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
37.en: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?
37.tl: adhālika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu l-zaqūmi

tr.85: Is this the better welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum,
tr.19: Is this better as a welcome, or the tree of Zaqqum?
tr.22: Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?
tr.203: Is that (Paradise) better entertainment or the tree of Zaqqûm (a horrible tree in Hell)?

37.en: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

tr.85: which we have made a test for the evildoers?
tr.19: Lo! We have appointed it a torment for wrong-doers.
tr.22: For We have truly made it (as) a trial for the wrong-doers.
tr.203: Truly We have made it (as) a trail for the Zâlimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, wrong-doers).

37.ar: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
37.en: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
37.tl: innahā shajaratun takhruju fī aṣli l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: This tree grows in the heart of the blazing Fire,
tr.19: Lo! it is a tree that springeth in the heart of hell.
tr.22: For it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-Fire:
tr.203: Verily, it is a tree that springs out of the bottom of Hell-fire,

37.en: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

tr.85: and its fruits are like devils’ heads.
tr.19: Its crop is as it were the heads of devils
tr.22: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of devils:
tr.203: The shoots of its fruit-stalks are like the heads of Shayâtîn (devils);

37.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
37.en: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
37.tl: fa-innahum laākilūna min'hā famāliūna min'hā l-buṭūna

tr.85: They will fill their bellies eating from it;
tr.19: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
tr.22: Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
tr.203: Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.

37.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
37.en: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
37.tl: thumma inna lahum ʿalayhā lashawban min ḥamīmin

tr.85: then drink scalding water on top of it;
tr.19: And afterward, lo! thereupon they have a drink of boiling water
tr.22: Then on top of that they will be given a mixture made of boiling water.
tr.203: Then on the top of that they will be given boiling water to drink so that it becomes a mixture (of boiling water and Zaqqûm in their bellies).

37.en: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

tr.85: then return to the blazing Fire.
tr.19: And afterward, lo! their return is surely unto hell.
tr.22: Then shall their return be to the (Blazing) Fire.
tr.203: Then thereafter, verily, their return is to the flaming fire of Hell.

37.en: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

tr.85: They found their forefathers astray,
tr.19: They indeed found their fathers astray,
tr.22: Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
tr.203: Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;

37.en: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

tr.85: and rushed to follow in their footsteps- before the disbelievers [of Mecca],
tr.19: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
tr.22: So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
tr.203: So they (too) hastened in their footsteps!

37.en: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

tr.85: most men in the past went astray,
tr.19: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
tr.22: And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
tr.203: And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;

37.en: And We had already sent among them warners.

tr.85: even though We sent messengers to warn them.
tr.19: And verily We sent among them warners.
