tr.22: But We sent aforetime, among them, (messengers) to admonish them;-
tr.203: And indeed We sent among them warners (Messengers);

37.en: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

tr.85: See how those who were warned met their end!
tr.19: Then see the nature of the consequence for those warned,
tr.22: Then see what was the end of those who were admonished (but heeded not),-
tr.203: Then see what was the end of those who were warned (but heeded not).

37.en: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

tr.85: Not so the true servants of God.
tr.19: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.22: Except the sincere (and devoted) Servants of Allah.
tr.203: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh (faithful, obedient, and true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

37.en: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

tr.85: Noah cried to Us, and how excellent was Our response!
tr.19: And Noah verily prayed unto Us, and gracious was the Hearer of his prayer
tr.22: (In the days of old), Noah cried to Us, and We are the best to hear prayer.
tr.203: And indeed Nûh (Noah) invoked Us, and We are the Best of those who answer (the request).

37.en: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

tr.85: We saved him and his people from great distress,
tr.19: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
tr.22: And We delivered him and his people from the Great Calamity,
tr.203: And We rescued him and his family from the great distress (i.e. drowning),

37.en: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

tr.85: We let his offspring remain on the earth,
tr.19: And made his seed the survivors,
tr.22: And made his progeny to endure (on this earth);
tr.203: And, his progeny, them We made the survivors (i.e. Shem, Ham and Japheth).

37.en: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

tr.85: We let him be praised by later generations:
tr.19: And left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.22: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations to come in later times:
tr.203: And left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations:

37.en: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

tr.85: ‘Peace be upon Noah among all the nations!’
tr.19: Peace be unto Noah among the peoples!
tr.22: "Peace and salutation to Noah among the nations!"
tr.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Nûh (Noah) (from Us) among the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)!"

37.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tr.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
tr.19: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.22: Thus indeed do we reward those who do right.
tr.203: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

37.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

tr.85: he was truly one of Our faithful servants.
tr.19: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
tr.22: For he was one of our believing Servants.
tr.203: Verily, he [Nûh (Noah)] was one of Our believing slaves.

37.en: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

tr.85: We drowned the rest.
tr.19: Then We did drown the others.
tr.22: Then the rest we overwhelmed in the Flood.
tr.203: Then We drowned the others (disbelievers and polytheists).

37.en: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

tr.85: Abraham was of the same faith:
tr.19: And lo! of his persuasion verily was Abraham
tr.22: Verily among those who followed his Way was Abraham.
tr.203: And, verily, among those who followed his [Nûh’s (Noah)] way (Islâmic Monotheism) was Ibrâhîm (Abraham).

37.en: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

tr.85: he came to his Lord with a devoted heart.
tr.19: When he came unto his Lord with a whole heart;
tr.22: Behold! he approached his Lord with a sound heart.
tr.203: When he came to his Lord with a pure heart [attached to Allâh Alone and none else, worshipping none but Allâh Alone - true Islâmic Monotheism, pure from the filth of polytheism].

37.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
37.en: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
37.tl: idh qāla li-abīhi waqawmihi mādhā taʿbudūna

tr.85: He said to his father and his people, ‘What are you worshipping?
tr.19: When he said unto his father and his folk: What is it that ye worship?
tr.22: Behold! he said to his father and to his people, "What is that which ye worship?
tr.203: When he said to his father and to his people: "What is it that which you worship?

37.en: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

tr.85: How can you choose false gods instead of the true God?
tr.19: Is it a falsehood - gods beside Allah - that ye desire?
tr.22: "Is it a falsehood- gods other than Allah- that ye desire?
tr.203: "Is it a falsehood - âlihah (gods) other than Allâh - that you desire?

37.en: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

tr.85: So what is your opinion about the Lord of all the Worlds?’
tr.19: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.22: "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
tr.203: "Then what think you about the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)?"

37.en: And he cast a look at the stars.

tr.85: then he looked up to the stars.
tr.19: And he glanced a glance at the stars
tr.22: Then did he cast a glance at the Stars.
tr.203: Then he cast a glance at the stars,

37.en: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

tr.85: He said, ‘I am sick,’
tr.19: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
tr.22: And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
tr.203: And he said: "Verily, I am sick (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)]."

37.en: So they turned away from him, departing.

tr.85: so [his people] turned away from him and left.
tr.19: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
tr.22: So they turned away from him, and departed.
tr.203: So they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease).

37.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
37.en: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
37.tl: farāgha ilā ālihatihim faqāla alā takulūna

tr.85: He turned to their gods and said, ‘Do you not eat?
tr.19: Then turned he to their gods and said: Will ye not eat?
tr.22: Then did he turn to their gods and said, "will ye not eat (of the offerings before you)?...
tr.203: Then he turned to their âlihah (gods) and said: "Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?

37.en: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".

tr.85: Why do you not speak?’
tr.19: What aileth you that ye speak not?
tr.22: "What is the matter with you that ye speak not (intelligently)?"
tr.203: "What is the matter with you that you speak not?"

37.en: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

tr.85: then he turned and struck them with his right arm.
tr.19: Then he attacked them, striking with his right hand.
tr.22: Then did he turn upon them, striking (them) with the right hand.
tr.203: Then he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand.

37.en: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

tr.85: His people hurried towards him,
tr.19: And (his people) came toward him, hastening.
tr.22: Then came (the worshippers) with hurried steps, and faced (him).
tr.203: Then they (the worshippers of idols) came, towards him, hastening.

37.en: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

tr.85: but he said, ‘How can you worship things you carve with your own hands,
tr.19: He said: Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve
tr.22: He said: "Worship ye that which ye have (yourselves) carved?
tr.203: He said: "Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?

37.en: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

tr.85: when it is God who has created you and all your handiwork?’
tr.19: When Allah hath created you and what ye make?
tr.22: "But Allah has created you and your handwork!"
tr.203: "While Allâh has created you and what you make!"

37.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
37.en: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."
37.tl: qālū ib'nū lahu bun'yānan fa-alqūhu fī l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: They said, ‘Build a pyre and throw him into the blazing fire.’
tr.19: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
tr.22: They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
tr.203: They said: "Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!"

37.en: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

tr.85: They wanted to harm him, but We humiliated them.
tr.19: And they designed a snare for him, but We made them the undermost.
tr.22: (This failing), they then sought a stratagem against him, but We made them the ones most humiliated!
tr.203: So they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest.

37.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
37.en: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
37.tl: waqāla innī dhāhibun ilā rabbī sayahdīni

tr.85: He said, ‘I will go to my Lord: He is sure to guide me.
tr.19: And he said: Lo! I am going unto my Lord Who will guide me.
tr.22: He said: "I will go to my Lord! He will surely guide me!
tr.203: And he said (after his rescue from the fire): "Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!"

37.en: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

tr.85: Lord, grant me a righteous son,’
tr.19: My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous.
tr.22: "O my Lord! Grant me a righteous (son)!"
tr.203: "My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous."

37.en: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

tr.85: so We gave him the good news that he would have a patient son.
tr.19: So We gave him tidings of a gentle son.
tr.22: So We gave him the good news of a boy ready to suffer and forbear.
tr.203: So We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy.

37.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
37.en: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."
37.tl: falammā balagha maʿahu l-saʿya qāla yābunayya innī arā fī l-manāmi annī adhbaḥuka fa-unẓur mādhā tarā qāla yāabati if'ʿal mā tu'maru satajidunī in shāa l-lahu mina l-ṣābirīna

tr.85: When the boy was old enough to work with his father, Abraham said, ‘My son, I have seen myself sacrificing you in a dream. What do you think?’ He said, ‘Father, do as you are commanded and, God willing, you will find me steadfast.’
tr.19: And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him, (Abraham) said: O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee. So look, what thinkest thou? He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded. Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast.
tr.22: Then, when (the son) reached (the age of) (serious) work with him, he said: "O my son! I see in vision that I offer thee in sacrifice: Now see what is thy view!" (The son) said: "O my father! Do as thou art commanded: thou will find me, if Allah so wills one practising Patience and Constancy!"
tr.203: And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: "O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice to Allâh). So look what you think!" He said: "O my father! Do that which you are commanded, In shâ’ Allâh (if Allâh wills), you shall find me of As-Sâbirûn (the patient)."

37.en: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,

tr.85: When they had both submitted to God, and he had laid his son down on the side of his face,
tr.19: Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah), and he had flung him down upon his face,
tr.22: So when they had both submitted their wills (to Allah), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (for sacrifice),
tr.203: Then, when they had both submitted themselves (to the Will of Allâh), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering);

37.en: We called to him, "O Abraham,

tr.85: We called out to him, ‘Abraham,
tr.19: We called unto him: O Abraham!
tr.22: We called out to him "O Abraham!
tr.203: We called out to him: "O Abraham!

37.ar: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
37.en: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
37.tl: qad ṣaddaqta l-ru'yā innā kadhālika najzī l-muḥ'sinīna

tr.85: you have fulfilled the dream.’ This is how We reward those who do good-
tr.19: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision. Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.22: "Thou hast already fulfilled the vision!" - thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.203: You have fulfilled the dream!" Verily thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See 2:112).

37.en: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

tr.85: it was a test to prove [their true characters]-
tr.19: Lo! that verily was a clear test.
tr.22: For this was obviously a trial-
tr.203: Verily, that indeed was a manifest trial.

37.en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

tr.85: We ransomed his son with a momentous sacrifice,
tr.19: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.
tr.22: And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:
tr.203: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. كبش - a ram);

37.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

tr.85: and We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
tr.19: And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.22: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
tr.203: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

37.en: "Peace upon Abraham."

tr.85: ‘Peace be upon Abraham!’
tr.19: Peace be unto Abraham!
tr.22: "Peace and salutation to Abraham!"
tr.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Ibrâhîm (Abraham)!"

37.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tr.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
tr.19: Thus do We reward the good.
tr.22: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.203: Thus indeed do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

37.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

tr.85: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
tr.19: Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves.
tr.22: For he was one of our believing Servants.
tr.203: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

37.en: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

tr.85: We gave Abraham the good news of Isaac- a prophet and a righteous man-
tr.19: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.
tr.22: And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.
tr.203: And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishâq (Isaac) - a Prophet from the righteous.

37.ar: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
37.en: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].
37.tl: wabāraknā ʿalayhi waʿalā is'ḥāqa wamin dhurriyyatihimā muḥ'sinun waẓālimun linafsihi mubīnun

tr.85: and blessed him and Isaac too: some of their offspring were good, but some clearly wronged themselves.
tr.19: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
tr.22: We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.
tr.203: We blessed him and Ishâq (Isaac). And of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.

37.en: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

tr.85: We also bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron:
tr.19: And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron,
tr.22: Again (of old) We bestowed Our favour on Moses and Aaron,
tr.203: And, indeed We gave Our Grace to Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron).

37.en: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

tr.85: We saved them and their people from great distress;
tr.19: And saved them and their people from the great distress,
tr.22: And We delivered them and their people from (their) Great Calamity;
tr.203: And We saved them and their people from the great distress,

37.en: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

tr.85: We helped them, so they were the ones to succeed;
tr.19: And helped them so that they became the victors.
tr.22: And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);
tr.203: And helped them, so that they became the victors;

37.en: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

tr.85: We gave them the Scripture that makes things clear;
tr.19: And We gave them the clear Scripture
tr.22: And We gave them the Book which helps to make things clear;
tr.203: And We gave them the clear Scripture;

37.en: And We guided them on the straight path.

tr.85: We guided them to the right path;
tr.19: And showed them the right path.
tr.22: And We guided them to the Straight Way.
tr.203: And guided them to the Right Path.

37.en: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

tr.85: We let them be praised by succeeding generations:
tr.19: And We left for them among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.22: And We left (this blessing) for them among generations (to come) in later times:
tr.203: And We left for them (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

37.en: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

tr.85: ‘Peace be upon Moses and Aaron!’
tr.19: Peace be unto Moses and Aaron!
tr.22: "Peace and salutation to Moses and Aaron!"
tr.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Mûsa (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)!"

37.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tr.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
tr.19: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.22: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.203: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers - See V.2:112).

37.en: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

tr.85: truly they were among Our faithful servants.
tr.19: Lo! they are two of Our believing slaves.
tr.22: For they were two of our believing Servants.
tr.203: Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves.

37.en: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

tr.85: Elijah too was one of the messengers.
tr.19: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),
tr.22: So also was Elias among those sent (by Us).
tr.203: And verily, Iliyâs (Elias) was one of the Messengers.

37.en: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

tr.85: He said to his people, ‘Have you no fear of God?
tr.19: When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)?
tr.22: Behold, he said to his people, "Will ye not fear (Allah)?
tr.203: When he said to his people: "Will you not fear Allâh?

37.en: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -

tr.85: How can you invoke Baal and forsake the Most Gracious Creator,
tr.19: Will ye cry unto Baal and forsake the Best of creators,
tr.22: "Will ye call upon Baal and forsake the Best of Creators,-
tr.203: "Will you call upon Ba‘l (a well known idol of his nation whom they used to worship) and forsake the Best of creators,

37.en: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

tr.85: God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’
tr.19: Allah, your Lord and Lord of your forefathers?
tr.22: "Allah, your Lord and Cherisher and the Lord and Cherisher of your fathers of old?"
tr.203: "Allâh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?"

37.en: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

tr.85: but they rejected him. They will be brought to punishment as a consequence;
tr.19: But they denied him, so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)
tr.22: But they rejected him, and they will certainly be called up (for punishment),-
tr.203: But they denied him [Iliyâs (Elias)], so they will certainly be brought forth (to the punishment),

37.en: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

tr.85: not so the true servants of God.
tr.19: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.22: Except the sincere and devoted Servants of Allah (among them).
tr.203: Except the chosen slaves of Allâh.

37.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

tr.85: We let him be praised by succeeding generations:
tr.19: And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation):
tr.22: And We left (this blessing) for him among generations (to come) in later times:
tr.203: And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations.

37.en: "Peace upon Elias."

tr.85: ‘Peace be to Elijah!’
tr.19: Peace be unto Elias!
tr.22: "Peace and salutation to such as Elias!"
tr.203: "Salâm (peace) be upon Ilyâsîn (Elias)!"

37.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tr.85: This is how We reward those who do good:
tr.19: Lo! thus do We reward the good.
tr.22: Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
tr.203: Verily, thus do We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers, who perform good deeds totally for Allâh’s sake only - See V.2:112).

37.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

tr.85: truly he was one of Our faithful servants.
tr.19: Lo! he is one of our believing slaves.
tr.22: For he was one of our believing Servants.
tr.203: Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves.

37.en: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

tr.85: Lot was also one of the messengers.
tr.19: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).
tr.22: So also was Lut among those sent (by Us).
tr.203: And verily, Lût (Lot) was one of the Messengers.

37.en: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

tr.85: We saved him and all his family-
tr.19: When We saved him and his household, every one,
tr.22: Behold, We delivered him and his adherents, all
tr.203: When We saved him and his family, all,

37.en: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

tr.85: except for an old woman who stayed behind-
tr.19: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind;
tr.22: Except an old woman who was among those who lagged behind:
tr.203: Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind.

37.en: Then We destroyed the others.

tr.85: and We destroyed the rest.
tr.19: Then We destroyed the others.
tr.22: Then We destroyed the rest.
tr.203: Then We destroyed the rest (the town of Sodom at the place of the Dead Sea now in Palestine).

37.en: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

tr.85: You [people] pass by their ruins morning
tr.19: And lo! ye verily pass by (the ruin of) them in the morning
tr.22: Verily, ye pass by their (sites), by day-
tr.203: Verily, you pass by them in the morning

37.en: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

tr.85: and night: will you not take heed?
tr.19: And at night-time; have ye then no sense?
tr.22: And by night: will ye not understand?
tr.203: And at night; will you not then reflect?

37.en: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

tr.85: Jonah too was one of the messengers.
tr.19: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
tr.22: So also was Jonah among those sent (by Us).
tr.203: And, verily, Yûnus (Jonah) was one of the Messengers.

37.en: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

tr.85: He fled to the overloaded ship.
tr.19: When he fled unto the laden ship,
tr.22: When he ran away (like a slave from captivity) to the ship (fully) laden,
tr.203: When he ran to the laden ship:

37.en: And he drew lots and was among the losers.

tr.85: They cast lots, he suffered defeat,
tr.19: And then drew lots and was of those rejected;
tr.22: He (agreed to) cast lots, and he was condemned:
tr.203: Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers.

37.en: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.

tr.85: and a great fish swallowed him, for he had committed blameworthy acts.
tr.19: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
tr.22: Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
tr.203: Then a (big) fish swallowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame.

37.en: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

tr.85: If he had not been one of those who glorified God,
tr.19: And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)
tr.22: Had it not been that he (repented and) glorified Allah,
tr.203: Had he not been of them who glorify Allâh,

37.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
37.en: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
37.tl: lalabitha fī baṭnihi ilā yawmi yub'ʿathūna

tr.85: he would have stayed in its belly until the Day when all are raised up,
tr.19: He would have tarried in its belly till the day when they are raised;
tr.22: He would certainly have remained inside the Fish till the Day of Resurrection.
tr.203: He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection.

37.en: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

tr.85: but We cast him out, sick, on to a barren shore,
tr.19: Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick;
tr.22: But We cast him forth on the naked shore in a state of sickness,
tr.203: But We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,

37.en: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

tr.85: and made a gourd tree grow above him.
tr.19: And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;
tr.22: And We caused to grow, over him, a spreading plant of the gourd kind.
tr.203: And We caused a plant of gourd to grow over him.

37.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
37.en: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
37.tl: wa-arsalnāhu ilā mi-ati alfin aw yazīdūna

tr.85: We sent him to a hundred thousand people or more.
tr.19: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more
tr.22: And We sent him (on a mission) to a hundred thousand (men) or more.
tr.203: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more.

37.en: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

tr.85: They believed, so We let them live out their lives.
tr.19: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
tr.22: And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
tr.203: And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.

37.en: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

tr.85: Now [Muhammad], ask the disbelievers: is it true that your Lord has daughters, while they choose sons for themselves?
tr.19: Now ask them (O Muhammad): Hath thy Lord daughters whereas they have sons?
tr.22: Now ask them their opinion: Is it that thy Lord has (only) daughters, and they have sons?-
tr.203: Now ask them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?"

37.ar: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
37.en: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
37.tl: am khalaqnā l-malāikata ināthan wahum shāhidūna

tr.85: Did We create the angels as females while they were watching?
tr.19: Or created We the angels females while they were present?
tr.22: Or that We created the angels female, and they are witnesses (thereto)?
tr.203: Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?

37.en: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

tr.85: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say,
tr.19: Lo! it is of their falsehood that they say:
tr.22: Is it not that they say, from their own invention,
tr.203: Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:

37.en: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

tr.85: ‘God has begotten.’ How they lie!
tr.19: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
tr.22: "Allah has begotten children"? but they are liars!
tr.203: "Allâh has begotten [offspring - the angels being the daughters of Allâh)?" And, verily, they are liars!

37.en: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

tr.85: Did He truly choose daughters in preference to sons?
tr.19: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
tr.22: Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
tr.203: Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons?

37.en: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

tr.85: What is the matter with you? How do you form your judgements?
tr.19: What aileth you? How judge ye?
tr.22: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
tr.203: What is the matter with you? How do you decide?

37.en: Then will you not be reminded?

tr.85: Do you not reflect?
tr.19: Will ye not then reflect?
tr.22: Will ye not then receive admonition?
tr.203: Will you not then remember?

37.en: Or do you have a clear authority?

tr.85: Do you perhaps have clear authority?
tr.19: Or have ye a clear warrant?
tr.22: Or have ye an authority manifest?
tr.203: Or is there for you a plain authority?

37.en: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

tr.85: Bring your scriptures, if you are telling the truth.
tr.19: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
tr.22: Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
tr.203: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!

37.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
37.en: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
37.tl: wajaʿalū baynahu wabayna l-jinati nasaban walaqad ʿalimati l-jinatu innahum lamuḥ'ḍarūna

tr.85: They claim that He has kinship with the jinn, yet the jinn themselves know that they will be brought before Him.
tr.19: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
tr.22: And they have invented a blood-relationship between Him and the Jinns: but the Jinns know (quite well) that they have indeed to appear (before his Judgment-Seat)!
tr.203: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account).

37.en: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,

tr.85: God is far above what they attribute to Him-
tr.19: Glorified be Allah from that which they attribute (unto Him),
tr.22: Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the things they ascribe (to Him)!
tr.203: Glorified be Allâh! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

37.en: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].

tr.85: the true servants of God do not do such things-
tr.19: Save single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.22: Not (so do) the Servants of Allah, sincere and devoted.
tr.203: Except the slaves of Allâh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islâmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allâh).

37.en: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

tr.85: and neither you nor what you worship
tr.19: Lo! verily, ye and that which ye worship,
tr.22: For, verily, neither ye nor those ye worship-
tr.203: So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols)

37.en: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

tr.85: can lure away from God any
tr.19: Ye cannot excite (anyone) against Him.
tr.22: Can lead (any) into temptation concerning Allah,
tr.203: Cannot lead astray [turn away from Him (Allâh) anyone of the believers],

37.en: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

tr.85: except those who will burn in Hell.
tr.19: Save him who is to burn in hell.
tr.22: Except such as are (themselves) going to the blazing Fire!
tr.203: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!

37.ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
37.en: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
37.tl: wamā minnā illā lahu maqāmun maʿlūmun

tr.85: [The angels say], ‘Every single one of us has his appointed place:
tr.19: There is not one of us but hath his known position.
tr.22: (Those ranged in ranks say): "Not one of us but has a place appointed;
tr.203: And there is not one of us (angels) but has his known place (or position);

37.en: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

tr.85: we are ranged in ranks.
tr.19: Lo! we, even we are they who set the ranks,
tr.22: "And we are verily ranged in ranks (for service);
tr.203: And verily, we (angels), we stand in rows (for the prayers as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers);

37.en: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."

tr.85: We glorify God.’
tr.19: Lo! we, even we are they who hymn His praise
tr.22: "And we are verily those who declare (Allah's) glory!"
tr.203: And verily, we (angels), indeed are those who glorify (Allâh’s Praises i.e. perform prayers).

37.en: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,

tr.85: [The disbelievers] used to say,
tr.19: And indeed they used to say:
tr.22: And there were those who said,
tr.203: And indeed they (Arab pagans) used to say:

37.ar: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
37.en: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
37.tl: law anna ʿindanā dhik'ran mina l-awalīna

tr.85: ‘If only we had a scripture like previous people,
tr.19: If we had but a reminder from the men of old
tr.22: "If only we had had before us a Message from those of old,
tr.203: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old (before the coming of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh),

37.en: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."

tr.85: we would be true servants of God,’
tr.19: We would be single-minded slaves of Allah.
tr.22: "We should certainly have been Servants of Allah, sincere (and devoted)!"
tr.203: "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allâh (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)!"

37.en: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.

tr.85: yet now they reject [the Quran]. They will soon realize.
tr.19: Yet (now that it is come) they disbelieve therein; but they will come to know.
tr.22: But (now that the Qur'an has come), they reject it: But soon will they know!
tr.203: But (now that the Qur’ân has come) they disbelieve therein (i.e. in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and all that he brought, - the Divine Revelation), so they will come to know!

37.en: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

tr.85: Our word has already been given to Our servants the messengers:
tr.19: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
tr.22: Already has Our Word been passed before (this) to our Servants sent (by Us),
tr.203: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,

37.en: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

tr.85: it is they who will be helped,
tr.19: That they verily would be helped,
tr.22: That they would certainly be assisted,
tr.203: That they verily would be made triumphant,

37.en: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.

tr.85: and the ones who support Our cause will be the winners.
tr.19: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
tr.22: And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
tr.203: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.

37.en: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.

tr.85: So [Prophet] turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
tr.19: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) awhile,
tr.22: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
tr.203: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them for a while,

37.en: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

tr.85: Watch them: they will soon see.
tr.19: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
tr.22: And watch them (how they fare), and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
tr.203: And watch them and they shall see (the punishment)!

37.en: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

tr.85: Do they really wish to hasten Our punishment?
tr.19: Would they hasten on Our doom?
tr.22: Do they wish (indeed) to hurry on our Punishment?
tr.203: Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?

37.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
37.en: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
37.tl: fa-idhā nazala bisāḥatihim fasāa ṣabāḥu l-mundharīna

tr.85: When it descends on their courtyards, how ter-rible that morning will be for those who were warned!
tr.19: But when it cometh home to them, then it will be a hapless morn for those who have been warned.
tr.22: But when it descends into the open space before them, evil will be the morning for those who were warned (and heeded not)!
tr.203: Then, when it descends in their courtyard (i.e. near to them), evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!

37.en: And leave them for a time.

tr.85: [Prophet], turn away from the disbelievers for a while.
tr.19: Withdraw from them awhile
tr.22: So turn thou away from them for a little while,
tr.203: So turn (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) away from them for a while,

37.en: And see, for they are going to see.

tr.85: Watch them: they will soon see.
tr.19: And watch, for they will (soon) see.
tr.22: And watch (how they fare) and they soon shall see (how thou farest)!
tr.203: And watch and they shall see (the torment)!

37.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
37.en: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
37.tl: sub'ḥāna rabbika rabbi l-ʿizati ʿammā yaṣifūna

tr.85: Your Lord, the Lord of Glory, is far above what they attribute to Him.
tr.19: Glorified be thy Lord, the Lord of Majesty, from that which they attribute (unto Him)
tr.22: Glory to thy Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they ascribe (to Him)!
tr.203: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power! (He is free) from what they attribute unto Him!

37.en: And peace upon the messengers.

tr.85: Peace be upon the messengers
tr.19: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
tr.22: And Peace on the messengers!
tr.203: And peace be on the Messengers!

37.en: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

tr.85: and praise be to God the Lord of all the Worlds.
tr.19: And praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds!
tr.22: And Praise to Allah, the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds.
tr.203: And all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

38.ar: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
38.en: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...
38.tl: sad wal-qur'āni dhī l-dhik'ri

tr.85: Sad By the Quran with its reminding . . .!
tr.19: Sad. By the renowned Qur'an,
tr.22: Sad: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).
tr.203:
Sâd.
[These letters (Sâd etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Quran full of reminding.

38.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
38.en: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
38.tl: bali alladhīna kafarū fī ʿizzatin washiqāqin

tr.85: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility.
tr.19: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.
tr.22: But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.
tr.203: Nay, those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.

38.ar: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
38.en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
38.tl: kam ahlaknā min qablihim min qarnin fanādaw walāta ḥīna manāṣin

tr.85: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape.
tr.19: How many a generation We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!
tr.22: How many generations before them did We destroy? In the end they cried (for mercy)- when there was no longer time for being saved!
tr.203: How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.

38.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
38.en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
38.tl: waʿajibū an jāahum mundhirun min'hum waqāla l-kāfirūna hādhā sāḥirun kadhābun

tr.85: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer.
tr.19: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come unto them, and the disbelievers say: This is a wizard, a charlatan.
tr.22: So they wonder that a Warner has come to them from among themselves! and the Unbelievers say, "This is a sorcerer telling lies!
tr.203: And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a sorcerer, a liar.

38.ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
38.en: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
38.tl: ajaʿala l-ālihata ilāhan wāḥidan inna hādhā lashayon ʿujābun

tr.85: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’
tr.19: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.
tr.22: "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"
tr.203: "Has he made the âlihah (gods) (all) into One Ilâh (God - Allâh). Verily, this is a curious thing!"

38.ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
38.en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
38.tl: wa-inṭalaqa l-mala-u min'hum ani im'shū wa-iṣ'birū ʿalā ālihatikum inna hādhā lashayon yurādu

tr.85: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do.
tr.19: The chiefs among them go about, exhorting: Go and be staunch to your gods! Lo! this is a thing designed.
tr.22: And the leader among them go away (impatiently), (saying), "Walk ye away, and remain constant to your gods! For this is truly a thing designed (against you)!
tr.203: And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your âlihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!

38.ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
38.en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
38.tl: mā samiʿ'nā bihādhā fī l-milati l-ākhirati in hādhā illā ikh'tilāqun

tr.85: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention.
tr.19: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.
tr.22: "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"
tr.203: "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]

38.ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
38.en: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
38.tl: a-unzila ʿalayhi l-dhik'ru min bayninā bal hum fī shakkin min dhik'rī bal lammā yadhūqū ʿadhābi

tr.85: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet.
tr.19: Hath the reminder been unto him (alone) among us? Nay, but they are in doubt concerning My reminder; nay but they have not yet tasted My doom.
tr.22: "What! has the Message been sent to him - (Of all persons) among us?"... but they are in doubt concerning My (Own) Message! Nay, they have not yet tasted My Punishment!
tr.203: "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ân)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!

38.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
38.en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
38.tl: am ʿindahum khazāinu raḥmati rabbika l-ʿazīzi l-wahābi

tr.85: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving?
tr.19: Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower?
tr.22: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord,- the Exalted in Power, the Grantor of Bounties without measure?
tr.203: Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?

38.ar: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
38.en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
38.tl: am lahum mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā falyartaqū fī l-asbābi

tr.85: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes:
tr.19: Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs? Then let them ascend by ropes!
tr.22: Or have they the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all between? If so, let them mount up with the ropes and means (to reach that end)!
tr.203: Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!

38.ar: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
38.en: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
38.tl: jundun mā hunālika mahzūmun mina l-aḥzābi

tr.85: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed.
tr.19: A defeated host are (all) the factions that are there.
tr.22: But there - will be put to flight even a host of confederates.
tr.203: (As they denied Allâh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated).

38.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
38.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
38.tl: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu dhū l-awtādi

tr.85: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them.
tr.19: The folk of Noah before them denied (their messenger) and (so did the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh firmly planted,
tr.22: Before them (were many who) rejected messengers,- the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh, the Lord of Stakes,
tr.203: Before them (were many who) belied (Messengers) - the people of Nûh (Noah); and ‘Âd; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),

38.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
38.en: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.
38.tl: wathamūdu waqawmu lūṭin wa-aṣḥābu al'aykati ulāika l-aḥzābu

tr.85: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs].
tr.19: And (the tribe of) Thamud, and the folk of Lot, and the dwellers in the wood: these were the factions.
tr.22: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Companions of the Wood; - such were the Confederates.
tr.203: And Thamûd, and the people of Lût (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates.

38.ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
38.en: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
38.tl: in kullun illā kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa ʿiqābi

tr.85: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment:
tr.19: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
tr.22: Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).
tr.203: Not one of them but belied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,

38.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
38.en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
38.tl: wamā yanẓuru hāulāi illā ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan mā lahā min fawāqin

tr.85: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed.
tr.19: These wait for but one Shout, there will be no second thereto.
tr.22: These (today) only wait for a single mighty Blast, which (when it comes) will brook no delay.
tr.203: And these only wait for a single Saihah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrâfil -)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till everything will perish except Allâh (the only God full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour)].

38.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
38.en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
38.tl: waqālū rabbanā ʿajjil lanā qiṭṭanā qabla yawmi l-ḥisābi

tr.85: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’
tr.19: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
tr.22: They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"
tr.203: They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittanâ (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!"

38.ar: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.en: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
38.tl: iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā dāwūda dhā l-aydi innahu awwābun

tr.85: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us:
tr.19: Bear with what they say, and remember Our bondman David, lord of might, Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
tr.22: Have patience at what they say, and remember our servant David, the man of strength: for he ever turned (to Allah).
tr.203: Be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dâwûd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (toward Allâh).

38.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
38.en: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
38.tl: innā sakharnā l-jibāla maʿahu yusabbiḥ'na bil-ʿashiyi wal-ish'rāqi

tr.85: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise;
tr.19: Lo! We subdued the hills to hymn the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise,
tr.22: It was We that made the hills declare, in unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide and at break of day,
tr.203: Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our Praises with him [Dâwûd (David)] in the ‘Ashî (i.e. after the mid-day till sunset) and Ishrâq (i.e. after the sunrise till mid-day).

38.ar: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.en: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
38.tl: wal-ṭayra maḥshūratan kullun lahu awwābun

tr.85: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise.
tr.19: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.
tr.22: And the birds gathered (in assemblies): all with him did turn (to Allah).
tr.203: And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dâwûd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allâh’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi ).

38.ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
38.en: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
38.tl: washadadnā mul'kahu waātaynāhu l-ḥik'mata wafaṣla l-khiṭābi

tr.85: We strengthened his kingdom; We gave him wisdom and a decisive way of speaking.
tr.19: We made his kingdom strong and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
tr.22: We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.
tr.203: We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Hikmah (Prophethood) and sound judgement in speech and decision.

38.ar: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
38.en: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
38.tl: wahal atāka naba-u l-khaṣmi idh tasawwarū l-miḥ'rāba

tr.85: Have you heard the story of the two litigants who climbed into his private quarters?
tr.19: And hath the story of the litigants come unto thee? How they climbed the wall into the royal chamber;
tr.22: Has the Story of the Disputants reached thee? Behold, they climbed over the wall of the private chamber;
tr.203: And has the news of the litigants reached you? When they climbed over the wall into (his) Mihrâb (a praying place or a private room);

38.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
38.en: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
38.tl: idh dakhalū ʿalā dāwūda fafaziʿa min'hum qālū lā takhaf khaṣmāni baghā baʿḍunā ʿalā baʿḍin fa-uḥ'kum baynanā bil-ḥaqi walā tush'ṭiṭ wa-ih'dinā ilā sawāi l-ṣirāṭi

tr.85: When they reached David, he took fright, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We are two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other: judge between us fairly- do not be unjust- and guide us to the right path.
tr.19: How they burst in upon David, and he was afraid of them. They said: Be not afraid! (We are) two litigants, one of whom hath wronged the other, therefor judge aright between us; be not unjust; and show us the fair way.
tr.22: When they entered the presence of David, and he was terrified of them, they said: "Fear not: we are two disputants, one of whom has wronged the other: Decide now between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, but guide us to the even Path..
tr.203: When they entered in upon Dâwûd (David), he was terrified of them. They said: "Fear not! (We are) two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other, therefore judge between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, and guide us to the Right Way.

38.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
38.en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
38.tl: inna hādhā akhī lahu tis'ʿun watis'ʿūna naʿjatan waliya naʿjatun wāḥidatun faqāla akfil'nīhā waʿazzanī fī l-khiṭābi

tr.85: This is my brother. He had ninety-nine ewes and I just the one, and he said, “Let me take charge of her,” and overpowered me with his words.’
tr.19: Lo! this my brother hath ninety and nine ewes while I had one ewe; and he said: Entrust it to me, and he conquered me in speech.
tr.22: "This man is my brother: He has nine and ninety ewes, and I have (but) one: Yet he says, 'commit her to my care,' and is (moreover) harsh to me in speech."
tr.203: Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety-nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: "Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech."

38.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
38.en: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
38.tl: qāla laqad ẓalamaka bisuāli naʿjatika ilā niʿājihi wa-inna kathīran mina l-khulaṭāi layabghī baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti waqalīlun mā hum waẓanna dāwūdu annamā fatannāhu fa-is'taghfara rabbahu wakharra rākiʿan wa-anāba

tr.85: David said, ‘He has done you wrong by demanding to add your ewe to his flock. Many partners treat each other unfairly. Those who sincerely believe and do good deeds do not do this, but these are very few.’ [Then] David realized that We had been testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness, fell down on his knees, and repented:
tr.19: (David) said: He hath wronged thee in demanding thine ewe in addition to his ewes, and lo! many partners oppress one another, save such as believe and do good works, and they are few. And David guessed that We had tried him, and he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he bowed himself and fell down prostrate and repented.
tr.22: (David) said: "He has undoubtedly wronged thee in demanding thy (single) ewe to be added to his (flock of) ewes: truly many are the partners (in business) who wrong each other: Not so do those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and how few are they?"... and David gathered that We had tried him: he asked forgiveness of his Lord, fell down, bowing (in prostration), and turned (to Allah in repentance).
tr.203: [Dâwûd (David)] said (immediately without listening to the opponent): "He has wronged you in demanding your ewe in addition to his ewes. And, verily, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and they are few." And Dâwûd (David) guessed that We have tried him and he sought Forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down prostrate and turned (to Allâh) in repentance.

38.ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
38.en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
38.tl: faghafarnā lahu dhālika wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin

tr.85: We forgave him [his misdeed]. His reward will be nearness to Us, a good place to return to.
tr.19: So We forgave him that; and lo! he had access to Our presence and a happy journey's end.
tr.22: So We forgave him this (lapse): he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful place of (Final) Return.
tr.203: So We forgave him that, and verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good place of (final) return (Paradise).

38.ar: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
38.en: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
38.tl: yādāwūdu innā jaʿalnāka khalīfatan fī l-arḍi fa-uḥ'kum bayna l-nāsi bil-ḥaqi walā tattabiʿi l-hawā fayuḍillaka ʿan sabīli l-lahi inna alladhīna yaḍillūna ʿan sabīli l-lahi lahum ʿadhābun shadīdun bimā nasū yawma l-ḥisābi

tr.85: ‘David, We have given you mastery over the land. Judge fairly between people. Do not follow your desires, lest they divert you from God’s path: those who wander from His path will have a painful torment because they ignore the Day of Reckoning.’
tr.19: (And it was said unto him): O David! Lo! We have set thee as a viceroy in the earth; therefor judge aright between mankind, and follow not desire that it beguile thee from the way of Allah. Lo! those who wander from the way of Allah have an awful doom, forasmuch as they forgot the Day of Reckoning.
tr.22: O David! We did indeed make thee a vicegerent on earth: so judge thou between men in truth (and justice): Nor follow thou the lusts (of thy heart), for they will mislead thee from the Path of Allah: for those who wander astray from the Path of Allah, is a Penalty Grievous, for that they forget the Day of Account.
tr.203: O Dâwûd (David)! Verily! We have placed you as a successor on the earth; so judge you between men in truth (and justice) and follow not your desire - for it will mislead you from the Path of Allâh. Verily, those who wander astray from the Path of Allâh (shall) have a severe torment, because they forgot the Day of Reckoning.

38.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
38.en: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
38.tl: wamā khalaqnā l-samāa wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā bāṭilan dhālika ẓannu alladhīna kafarū fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū mina l-nāri

tr.85: It was not without purpose that We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between. That may be what the disbelievers assume- how they will suffer from the Fire!-
tr.19: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the opinion of those who disbelieve. And woe unto those who disbelieve, from the Fire!
tr.22: Not without purpose did We create heaven and earth and all between! that were the thought of Unbelievers! but woe to the Unbelievers because of the Fire (of Hell)!
tr.203: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Islâmic Monotheism) from the Fire!

38.ar: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
38.en: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
38.tl: am najʿalu alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti kal-muf'sidīna fī l-arḍi am najʿalu l-mutaqīna kal-fujāri

tr.85: but would We treat those who believe and do good deeds and those who spread corruption on earth as equal? Would We treat those who are aware of God and those who recklessly break all bounds in the same way?
tr.19: Shall We treat those who believe and do good works as those who spread corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the pious as the wicked?
tr.22: Shall We treat those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the same as those who do mischief on earth? Shall We treat those who guard against evil, the same as those who turn aside from the right?
tr.203: Shall We treat those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds as Mufsidûn (those who associate partners in worship with Allâh and commit crimes) on earth? Or shall We treat the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) as the Fujjâr (criminals, disbelievers, the wicked)?

38.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
38.en: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
38.tl: kitābun anzalnāhu ilayka mubārakun liyaddabbarū āyātihi waliyatadhakkara ulū l-albābi

tr.85: This is a blessed Scripture which We sent down to you [Muhammad], for people to think about its messages, and for those with understanding to take heed.
tr.19: (This is) a Scripture that We have revealed unto thee, full of blessing, that they may ponder its revelations, and that men of understanding may reflect.
tr.22: (Here is) a Book which We have sent down unto thee, full of blessings, that they may mediate on its Signs, and that men of understanding may receive admonition.
tr.203: (This is) a Book (the Qur’ân) which We have sent down to you, full of blessings, that they may ponder over its Verses, and that men of understanding may remember.

38.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.en: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
38.tl: wawahabnā lidāwūda sulaymāna niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun

tr.85: We gave David Solomon. He was an excellent servant who always turned to God.
tr.19: And We bestowed on David, Solomon. How excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (toward Allah).
tr.22: To David We gave Solomon (for a son),- How excellent in Our service! Ever did he turn (to Us)!
tr.203: And to Dâwûd (David) We gave Sulaimân (Solomon). How excellent a slave! Verily, he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!

38.ar: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
38.en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
38.tl: idh ʿuriḍa ʿalayhi bil-ʿashiyi l-ṣāfinātu l-jiyādu

tr.85: When well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him near the close of day,
tr.19: When there were shown to him at eventide lightfooted coursers
tr.22: Behold, there were brought before him, at eventide coursers of the highest breeding, and swift of foot;
tr.203: When there were displayed before him, in the afternoon, well trained horses of the highest breed [for Jihâd (holy fighting in Allâh’s Cause)].

38.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
38.en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
38.tl: faqāla innī aḥbabtu ḥubba l-khayri ʿan dhik'ri rabbī ḥattā tawārat bil-ḥijābi

tr.85: he kept saying, ‘My love of fine things is part of my remembering my Lord!’ until [the horses] disappeared from sight-
tr.19: And he said: Lo! I have preferred the good things (of the world) to the remembrance of my Lord; till they were taken out of sight behind the curtain.
tr.22: And he said, "Truly do I love the love of good, with a view to the glory of my Lord,"- until (the sun) was hidden in the veil (of night):
tr.203: He said: "I did love the good (these horses) instead of remembering my Lord (in my ‘Asr prayer)" till the time was over, and (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of night).

38.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
38.en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
38.tl: ruddūhā ʿalayya faṭafiqa masḥan bil-sūqi wal-aʿnāqi

tr.85: ‘Bring them back!’ [he said] and started to stroke their legs and necks.
tr.19: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.
tr.22: "Bring them back to me." then began he to pass his hand over (their) legs and their necks.
tr.203: Then he said "Bring them (horses) back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (till the end of the display).

38.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
38.en: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
38.tl: walaqad fatannā sulaymāna wa-alqaynā ʿalā kur'siyyihi jasadan thumma anāba

tr.85: We certainly tested Solomon, reducing him to a mere skeleton on his throne.
tr.19: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.
tr.22: And We did try Solomon: We placed on his throne a body (without life); but he did turn (to Us in true devotion):
tr.203: And indeed, We did try Sulaimân (Solomon) and We placed on his throne Jasad (a devil, so he lost his kingdom for a while) and he did return (to Allâh with obedience and in repentance, and to his throne and kingdom by the Grace of Allâh).

38.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
38.en: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
38.tl: qāla rabbi igh'fir lī wahab lī mul'kan lā yanbaghī li-aḥadin min baʿdī innaka anta l-wahābu

tr.85: He turned to Us and prayed: ‘Lord forgive me! Grant me such power as no one after me will have- You are the Most Generous Provider.’
tr.19: He said: My Lord! Forgive me and bestow on me sovereignty such as shall not belong to any after me. Lo! Thou art the Bestower.
tr.22: He said, "O my Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom which, (it may be), suits not another after me: for Thou art the Grantor of Bounties (without measure).
tr.203: He said: "My Lord! Forgive me, and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me: Verily, You are the Bestower."

38.ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
38.en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
38.tl: fasakharnā lahu l-rīḥa tajrī bi-amrihi rukhāan ḥaythu aṣāba

tr.85: So We gave him power over the wind, which at his request ran gently wherever he willed,
tr.19: So We made the wind subservient unto him, setting fair by his command whithersoever he intended.
tr.22: Then We subjected the wind to his power, to flow gently to his order, Whithersoever he willed,-
tr.203: So, We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently by his order whithersoever he willed,

38.ar: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
38.en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.
38.tl: wal-shayāṭīna kulla bannāin waghawwāṣin

tr.85: and the jinn––every kind of builder and diver
tr.19: And the unruly, every builder and diver (made We subservient),
tr.22: As also the evil ones, (including) every kind of builder and diver,-
tr.203: And also the Shayâtîn (devils) from the jinn (including) every kind of builder and diver,

38.ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
38.en: And others bound together in irons.
38.tl: waākharīna muqarranīna fī l-aṣfādi

tr.85: and others chained in fetters.
tr.19: And others linked together in chains,
tr.22: As also others bound together in fetters.
tr.203: And also others bound in fetters.

38.ar: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
38.en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
38.tl: hādhā ʿaṭāunā fa-um'nun aw amsik bighayri ḥisābin

tr.85: ‘This is Our gift, so give or withhold as you wish without account.’
tr.19: (Saying): This is Our gift, so bestow thou, or withhold, without reckoning.
tr.22: "Such are Our Bounties: whether thou bestow them (on others) or withhold them, no account will be asked."
tr.203: [Allâh said to Sulaimân (Solomon)]: "This is Our gift: so spend you or withhold, no account will be asked (of you)."

38.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
38.en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
38.tl: wa-inna lahu ʿindanā lazul'fā waḥus'na maābin

tr.85: His reward will be nearness to Us, and a good place to return to.
tr.19: And lo! he hath favour with Us, and a happy journey's end.
tr.22: And he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful Place of (Final) Return.
tr.203: And verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good (final) return (Paradise).

38.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
38.en: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
38.tl: wa-udh'kur ʿabdanā ayyūba idh nādā rabbahu annī massaniya l-shayṭānu binuṣ'bin waʿadhābin

tr.85: Bring to mind Our servant Job who cried to his Lord, ‘Satan has afflicted me with weariness and suffering.’
tr.19: And make mention (O Muhammad) of Our bondman Job, when he cried unto his Lord (saying): Lo! the devil doth afflict me with distress and torment.
tr.22: Commemorate Our Servant Job. Behold he cried to his Lord: "The Evil One has afflicted me with distress and suffering!"
tr.203: And remember Our slave Ayyûb (Job), when he invoked his Lord (saying): "Verily Shaitân (Satan) has touched me with distress (by ruining my health) and torment (by ruining my wealth)!

38.ar: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
38.en: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
38.tl: ur'kuḍ birij'lika hādhā mugh'tasalun bāridun washarābun

tr.85: ‘Stamp your foot! Here is cool water for you to wash in and drink,’
tr.19: (And it was said unto him): Strike the ground with thy foot. This (spring) is a cool bath and a refreshing drink.
tr.22: (The command was given:) "Strike with thy foot: here is (water) wherein to wash, cool and refreshing, and (water) to drink."
tr.203: (Allâh said to him): "Strike the ground with your foot: This is (a spring of) water to wash in, cool and a (refreshing) drink."

38.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
38.en: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
38.tl: wawahabnā lahu ahlahu wamith'lahum maʿahum raḥmatan minnā wadhik'rā li-ulī l-albābi

tr.85: and We restored his family to him, with many more like them: a sign of Our mercy and a lesson to all who understand.
tr.19: And We bestowed on him (again) his household and therewith the like thereof, a mercy from Us, and a memorial for men of understanding.
tr.22: And We gave him (back) his people, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who have Understanding.
tr.203: And We gave him (back) his family, and along with them the like thereof, as a Mercy from Us, and a Reminder for those who understand.

38.ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
38.en: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
38.tl: wakhudh biyadika ḍigh'than fa-iḍ'rib bihi walā taḥnath innā wajadnāhu ṣābiran niʿ'ma l-ʿabdu innahu awwābun

tr.85: ‘Take a small bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [her] with that so as not to break your oath.’ We found him patient in adversity; an excellent servant! He, too, always turned to God.
tr.19: And (it was said unto him): Take in thine hand a branch and smite therewith, and break not thine oath. Lo! We found him steadfast, how excellent a slave! Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (to his Lord).
tr.22: "And take in thy hand a little grass, and strike therewith: and break not (thy oath)." Truly We found him full of patience and constancy. How excellent in Our service! ever did he turn (to Us)!
tr.203: "And take in your hand a bundle of thin grass and strike therewith (your wife), and break not your oath. Truly! We found him patient. How excellent a slave! Verily he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!

38.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
38.en: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
38.tl: wa-udh'kur ʿibādanā ib'rāhīma wa-is'ḥāqa wayaʿqūba ulī l-aydī wal-abṣāri

tr.85: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, all men of strength and vision.
tr.19: And make mention of Our bondmen, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, men of parts and vision.
tr.22: And commemorate Our Servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, possessors of Power and Vision.
tr.203: And remember Our slaves, Ibrâhîm (Abraham), Ishâq (Isaac), and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), (all) owners of strength (in worshipping Us) and (also) of religious understanding.

38.ar: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
38.en: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
38.tl: innā akhlaṣnāhum bikhāliṣatin dhik'rā l-dāri

tr.85: We caused them to be devoted to Us through their sincere remembrance of the Final Home:
tr.19: Lo! We purified them with a pure thought, remembrance of the Home (of the Hereafter).
tr.22: Verily We did choose them for a special (purpose)- proclaiming the Message of the Hereafter.
tr.203: Verily, We did choose them by granting them (a good thing, - i.e.) the remembrance of the Home [in the Hereafter and they used to make the people remember it, and also they used to invite the people to obey Allâh and to do good deeds for the Hereafter].

38.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
38.en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
38.tl: wa-innahum ʿindanā lamina l-muṣ'ṭafayna l-akhyāri

tr.85: with Us they will be among the elect, the truly good.
tr.19: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.
tr.22: They were, in Our sight, truly, of the company of the Elect and the Good.
tr.203: And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best!

38.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
38.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
38.tl: wa-udh'kur is'māʿīla wal-yasaʿa wadhā l-kif'li wakullun mina l-akhyāri

tr.85: And remember Our servants Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu ’l-Kifl, each of them truly good.
tr.19: And make mention of Ishmael and Elisha and Dhu'l-Kifl. All are of the chosen.
tr.22: And commemorate Isma'il, Elisha, and Zul-Kifl: Each of them was of the Company of the Good.
tr.203: And remember Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael), Alyasa‘ (Elisha), and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah), all are among the best.

38.ar: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
38.en: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
38.tl: hādhā dhik'run wa-inna lil'muttaqīna laḥus'na maābin

tr.85: This is a lesson. The devout will have a good place to return to:
tr.19: This is a reminder. And lo! for those who ward off (evil) is a happy journey's end,
tr.22: This is a Message (of admonition): and verily, for the righteous, is a beautiful Place of (Final) Return,-
tr.203: This is a Reminder. And verily, for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) is a good final return (Paradise),

38.ar: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
38.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
38.tl: jannāti ʿadnin mufattaḥatan lahumu l-abwābu

tr.85: Gardens of lasting bliss with gates wide open.
tr.19: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,
tr.22: Gardens of Eternity, whose doors will (ever) be open to them;
tr.203: ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), whose doors will be opened for them.

38.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
