tr.19: The guerdon of an ill-deed is an ill the like thereof. But whosoever pardoneth and amendeth, his wage is the affair of Allah. Lo! He loveth not wrong-doers.
tr.22: The recompense for an injury is an injury equal thereto (in degree): but if a person forgives and makes reconciliation, his reward is due from Allah: for (Allah) loveth not those who do wrong.
tr.203: The recompense for an evil is an evil like thereof; but whoever forgives and makes reconciliation, his reward is with Allâh. Verily, He likes not the Zâlimûn (oppressors, polytheists, and wrong-doers).

42.ar: وَلَمَنِ ٱنتَصَرَ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مَا عَلَيْهِم مِّن سَبِيلٍ
42.en: And whoever retaliates after having been wronged - those have not upon them any cause [for blame].
42.tl: walamani intaṣara baʿda ẓul'mihi fa-ulāika mā ʿalayhim min sabīlin

tr.85: There is no cause to act against anyone who defends himself after being wronged,
tr.19: And whoso defendeth himself after he hath suffered wrong - for such, there is no way (of blame) against them.
tr.22: But indeed if any do help and defend themselves after a wrong (done) to them, against such there is no cause of blame.
tr.203: And indeed whosoever takes revenge after he has suffered wrong, for such there is no way (of blame) against them.

42.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلسَّبِيلُ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَظْلِمُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ وَيَبْغُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
42.en: The cause is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
42.tl: innamā l-sabīlu ʿalā alladhīna yaẓlimūna l-nāsa wayabghūna fī l-arḍi bighayri l-ḥaqi ulāika lahum ʿadhābun alīmun

tr.85: but there is cause to act against those who oppress people and transgress in the land against all justice- they will have an agonizing torment-
tr.19: The way (of blame) is only against those who oppress mankind, and wrongfully rebel in the earth. For such there is a painful doom.
tr.22: The blame is only against those who oppress men and wrong-doing and insolently transgress beyond bounds through the land, defying right and justice: for such there will be a penalty grievous.
tr.203: The way (of blame) is only against those who oppress men and rebel in the earth without justification; for such there will be a painful torment.

42.ar: وَلَمَن صَبَرَ وَغَفَرَ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمِنْ عَزْمِ ٱلْأُمُورِ
42.en: And whoever is patient and forgives - indeed, that is of the matters [worthy] of resolve.
42.tl: walaman ṣabara waghafara inna dhālika lamin ʿazmi l-umūri

tr.85: though if a person is patient and forgives, this is one of the greatest things.
tr.19: And verily whoso is patient and forgiveth - lo! that, verily, is (of) the steadfast heart of things.
tr.22: But indeed if any show patience and forgive, that would truly be an exercise of courageous will and resolution in the conduct of affairs.
tr.203: And verily, whosoever shows patience and forgives, that would truly be from the things recommended by Allâh.

42.ar: وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن وَلِىٍّ مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ وَتَرَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ لَمَّا رَأَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ يَقُولُونَ هَلْ إِلَىٰ مَرَدٍّ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
42.en: And he whom Allāh sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, "Is there for return [to the former world] any way?"
42.tl: waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min waliyyin min baʿdihi watarā l-ẓālimīna lammā ra-awū l-ʿadhāba yaqūlūna hal ilā maraddin min sabīlin

tr.85: Anyone God allows to stray will have no one else to protect him: you [Prophet] will see the wrongdoers, when they face the punishment, exclaiming, ‘Is there any way of going back?’
tr.19: He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no protecting friend after Him. And thou (Muhammad) wilt see the evil-doers when they see the doom, (how) they say: Is there any way of return?
tr.22: For any whom Allah leaves astray, there is no protector thereafter. And thou wilt see the Wrong-doers, when in sight of the Penalty, Say: "Is there any way (to effect) a return?"
tr.203: And whomsoever Allâh sends astray, for him there is no Walî (protector, helper, guardian) after Him. And you will see the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, oppressors): when they behold the torment, they will say: "Is there any way of return (to the world)?"

42.ar: وَتَرَىٰهُمْ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا خَـٰشِعِينَ مِنَ ٱلذُّلِّ يَنظُرُونَ مِن طَرْفٍ خَفِىٍّ ۗ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ فِى عَذَابٍ مُّقِيمٍ
42.en: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, "Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment."
42.tl: watarāhum yuʿ'raḍūna ʿalayhā khāshiʿīna mina l-dhuli yanẓurūna min ṭarfin khafiyyin waqāla alladhīna āmanū inna l-khāsirīna alladhīna khasirū anfusahum wa-ahlīhim yawma l-qiyāmati alā inna l-ẓālimīna fī ʿadhābin muqīmin

tr.85: You will see them exposed to the Fire, abject in humiliation, glancing furtively, while those who believed exclaim, ‘The losers are the ones who have lost themselves and their people on the Day of Resurrection.’ Truly the evildoers will remain in lasting torment;
tr.19: And thou wilt see them exposed to (the Fire), made humble by disgrace, and looking with veiled eyes. And those who believe will say: Lo! the (eternal) losers are they who lose themselves and their housefolk on the Day of Resurrection. Lo! are not the wrong-doers in perpetual torment?
tr.22: And thou wilt see them brought forward to the (Penalty), in a humble frame of mind because of (their) disgrace, (and) looking with a stealthy glance. And the Believers will say: "Those are indeed in loss, who have given to perdition their own selves and those belonging to them on the Day of Judgment. Behold! Truly the Wrong-doers are in a lasting Penalty!"
tr.203: And you will see them brought forward to it (Hell) made humble by disgrace, (and) looking with stealthy glance. And those who believe will say: "Verily, the losers are they who lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Verily, the Zâlimûn [i.e. Al-Kâfirûn (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness and in His Messenger صلى الله عليه و سلم, polytheists, wrong-doers)] will be in a lasting torment. (Tafsir At-Tabari).

42.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ يَنصُرُونَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن سَبِيلٍ
42.en: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than Allāh. And whoever Allāh sends astray - for him there is no way.
42.tl: wamā kāna lahum min awliyāa yanṣurūnahum min dūni l-lahi waman yuḍ'lili l-lahu famā lahu min sabīlin

tr.85: they will have no allies to help them against God. There is no way [forward] for those God allows to stray.
tr.19: And they will have no protecting friends to help them instead of Allah. He whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no road.
tr.22: And no protectors have they to help them, other than Allah. And for any whom Allah leaves to stray, there is no way (to the Goal).
tr.203: And they will have no Auliyâ’ (protectors, helpers, guardians, lords) to help them other than Allâh. And he whom Allâh sends astray, for him there is no way.

42.ar: ٱسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلْجَإٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٍ
42.en: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that Day, nor for you will there be any denial.
42.tl: is'tajībū lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun lā maradda lahu mina l-lahi mā lakum min malja-in yawma-idhin wamā lakum min nakīrin

tr.85: So [people] respond to your Lord before there comes a Day that cannot, against God’s will, be averted- you will have no refuge on that Day, and no possibility of denying [your sins].
tr.19: Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal.
tr.22: Hearken ye to your Lord, before there come a Day which there will be no putting back, because of (the Ordainment of) Allah! that Day there will be for you no place of refuge nor will there be for you any room for denial (of your sins)!
tr.203: Answer the Call of your Lord (i.e. accept the Islâmic Monotheism, O mankind, and jinn) before there comes from Allâh a Day which cannot be averted (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). You will have no refuge on that Day nor there will be for you any denying (of your crimes as they are all recorded in the Book of your deeds).

42.ar: فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا۟ فَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَفِيظًا ۖ إِنْ عَلَيْكَ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَإِنَّآ إِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِنَّا رَحْمَةً فَرِحَ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ فَإِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ كَفُورٌ
42.en: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty of] notification. And indeed, when We let man taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, man is ungrateful.
42.tl: fa-in aʿraḍū famā arsalnāka ʿalayhim ḥafīẓan in ʿalayka illā l-balāghu wa-innā idhā adhaqnā l-insāna minnā raḥmatan fariḥa bihā wa-in tuṣib'hum sayyi-atun bimā qaddamat aydīhim fa-inna l-insāna kafūrun

tr.85: If they still turn away [remember that], We have not sent you [Prophet] to be their guardian: your only duty is to deliver the message. When We give man a taste of Our mercy, he rejoices in it, but if some harm befalls him on account of what he has done with his own hands, then he is ungrateful.
tr.19: But if they are averse, We have not sent thee as a warder over them. Thine is only to convey (the message). And lo! when We cause man to taste of mercy from Us he exulteth therefor. And if some evil striketh them because of that which their own hands have sent before, then lo! man is an ingrate.
tr.22: If then they run away, We have not sent thee as a guard over them. Thy duty is but to convey (the Message). And truly, when We give man a taste of a Mercy from Ourselves, he doth exult thereat, but when some ill happens to him, on account of the deeds which his hands have sent forth, truly then is man ungrateful!
tr.203: But if they turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم from the Islâmic Monotheism, which you have brought to them). We have not sent you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) as a Hafîz (watcher, protector) over them (i.e. to take care of their deeds and to recompense them). Your duty is to convey (the Message). And verily, when We cause man to taste of Mercy from Us, he rejoices thereat; but when some ill befalls them because of the deeds which their hands have sent forth, then verily, man (becomes) ingrate!

42.ar: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَـٰثًا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
42.en: To Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what He wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
42.tl: lillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yakhluqu mā yashāu yahabu liman yashāu ināthan wayahabu liman yashāu l-dhukūra

tr.85: God has control of the heavens and the earth; He creates whatever He will- He grants female offspring to whoever He will, male to whoever He will,
tr.19: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. He createth what He will. He bestoweth female (offspring) upon whom He will, and bestoweth male (offspring) upon whom He will;
tr.22: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills (and plans). He bestows (children) male or female according to His Will (and Plan),
tr.203: To Allâh belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. He creates what He wills. He bestows female (offspring) upon whom He wills, and bestows male (offspring) upon whom He wills.

42.ar: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًا وَإِنَـٰثًا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌ قَدِيرٌ
42.en: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
42.tl: aw yuzawwijuhum dhuk'rānan wa-ināthan wayajʿalu man yashāu ʿaqīman innahu ʿalīmun qadīrun

tr.85: Or both male and female, and He makes whoever He will barren: He is all knowing and all powerful.
tr.19: Or He mingleth them, males and females, and He maketh barren whom He will. Lo! He is Knower, Powerful.
tr.22: Or He bestows both males and females, and He leaves barren whom He will: for He is full of Knowledge and Power.
tr.203: Or He bestows both males and females, and He renders barren whom He wills. Verily, He is the All-Knower and is Able to do all things.

42.ar: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
42.en: And it is not for any human being that Allāh should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
42.tl: wamā kāna libasharin an yukallimahu l-lahu illā waḥyan aw min warāi ḥijābin aw yur'sila rasūlan fayūḥiya bi-idh'nihi mā yashāu innahu ʿaliyyun ḥakīmun

tr.85: It is not granted to any mortal that God should speak to him except through revelation or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger to reveal by His command what He will: He is exalted and wise.
tr.19: And it was not (vouchsafed) to any mortal that Allah should speak to him unless (it be) by revelation or from behind a veil, or (that) He sendeth a messenger to reveal what He will by His leave. Lo! He is Exalted, Wise.
tr.22: It is not fitting for a man that Allah should speak to him except by inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by the sending of a messenger to reveal, with Allah's permission, what Allah wills: for He is Most High, Most Wise.
tr.203: It is not given to any human being that Allâh should speak to him unless (it be) by Revelation, or from behind a veil, or (that) He sends a Messenger to reveal what He wills by His Leave. Verily, He is Most High, Most Wise.

42.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
42.en: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -
42.tl: wakadhālika awḥaynā ilayka rūḥan min amrinā mā kunta tadrī mā l-kitābu walā l-īmānu walākin jaʿalnāhu nūran nahdī bihi man nashāu min ʿibādinā wa-innaka latahdī ilā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin

tr.85: So We have revealed a spirit to you [Prophet] by Our command: you knew neither the Scripture nor the faith, but We made it a light, guiding with it whoever We will of Our servants. You give guidance to the straight path,
tr.19: And thus have We inspired in thee (Muhammad) a Spirit of Our command. Thou knewest not what the Scripture was, nor what the Faith. But We have made it a light whereby We guide whom We will of Our bondmen. And lo! thou verily dost guide unto a right path,
tr.22: And thus have We, by Our Command, sent inspiration to thee: thou knewest not (before) what was Revelation, and what was Faith; but We have made the (Qur'an) a Light, wherewith We guide such of Our servants as We will; and verily thou dost guide (men) to the Straight Way,-
tr.203: And thus We have sent to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) Ruh (a Revelation, and a Mercy) of Our Command. You knew not what is the Book, nor what is Faith? But We have made it (this Qur’ân) a light wherewith We guide whosoever of Our slaves We will. And verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) are indeed guiding (mankind) to the Straight Path (i.e. Allâh’s Religion of Islâmic Monotheism).

42.ar: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
42.en: The path of Allāh, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allāh do [all] matters evolve [i.e., return].
42.tl: ṣirāṭi l-lahi alladhī lahu mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi alā ilā l-lahi taṣīru l-umūru

tr.85: the path of God, to whom belongs all that is in the heavens and earth: truly everything will return to God.
tr.19: The path of Allah, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Do not all things reach Allah at last?
tr.22: The Way of Allah, to Whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. Behold (how) all affairs tend towards Allah!
tr.203: The Path of Allâh to Whom belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. Verily, all matters at the end go to Allâh (for decision).

43.ar: حمٓ
43.en: Ḥā, Meem.
43.tl: hha-meem

tr.85: Ha Mim
tr.19: Ha. Mim.
tr.22: Ha-Mim
tr.203: Hâ-Mîm.

43.ar: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
43.en: By the clear Book,
43.tl: wal-kitābi l-mubīni

tr.85: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
tr.19: By the Scripture which maketh plain,
tr.22: By the Book that makes things clear,-
tr.203: By the manifest Book (i.e. this Qur’ân that makes things clear).

43.ar: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
43.en: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
43.tl: innā jaʿalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyan laʿallakum taʿqilūna

tr.85: We have made it a Quran in Arabic so that you [people] may understand.
tr.19: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.
tr.22: We have made it a Qur'an in Arabic, that ye may be able to understand (and learn wisdom).
tr.203: Verily, We have made it a Qur’ân in Arabic that you may be able to understand (its meanings and its admonitions).

43.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
43.en: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
43.tl: wa-innahu fī ummi l-kitābi ladaynā laʿaliyyun ḥakīmun

tr.85: It is truly exalted in the Source of Scripture kept with Us, and full of wisdom.
tr.19: And Lo! in the Source of Decrees, which We possess, it is indeed sublime, decisive.
tr.22: And verily, it is in the Mother of the Book, in Our Presence, high (in dignity), full of wisdom.
tr.203: And verily, it (this Qur’ân) is in the Mother of the Book (i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz), with Us, indeed exalted, full of wisdom.

43.ar: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّسْرِفِينَ
43.en: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
43.tl: afanaḍribu ʿankumu l-dhik'ra ṣafḥan an kuntum qawman mus'rifīna

tr.85: Should We ignore you and turn this revelation away from you because you are insolent people?
tr.19: Shall We utterly ignore you because ye are a wanton folk?
tr.22: Shall We then take away the Message from you and repel (you), for that ye are a people transgressing beyond bounds?
tr.203: Shall We then (warn you not and) take away the Reminder (this Qur’ân) from you, because you are a people Musrifûn.

43.ar: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
43.en: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
43.tl: wakam arsalnā min nabiyyin fī l-awalīna

tr.85: We have sent many a prophet to earlier people
tr.19: How many a prophet did We send among the men of old!
tr.22: But how many were the prophets We sent amongst the peoples of old?
tr.203: And how many a Prophet have We sent amongst the men of old.

43.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
43.en: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
43.tl: wamā yatīhim min nabiyyin illā kānū bihi yastahziūna

tr.85: and they mocked every one of them,
tr.19: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.
tr.22: And never came there a prophet to them but they mocked him.
tr.203: And never came there a Prophet to them but they used to mock at him.

43.ar: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
43.en: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
43.tl: fa-ahlaknā ashadda min'hum baṭshan wamaḍā mathalu l-awalīna

tr.85: so We have destroyed mightier people than [the disbelievers of Mecca] and their example has gone down in history.
tr.19: Then We destroyed men mightier than these in prowess; and the example of the men of old hath gone (before them).
tr.22: So We destroyed (them)- stronger in power than these;- and (thus) has passed on the Parable of the peoples of old.
tr.203: Then We destroyed men stronger (in power) than these - and the example of the ancients has passed away (before them).

43.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
43.en: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,"
43.tl: wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa layaqūlunna khalaqahunna l-ʿazīzu l-ʿalīmu

tr.85: If you [Prophet] ask them, ‘Who created the heavens and earth?’ they are sure to say, ‘They were created by the Almighty, the All Knowing.’
tr.19: And if thou (Muhammad) ask them: Who created the heavens and the earth, they will surely answer: The Mighty, the Knower created them;
tr.22: If thou wert to question them, 'Who created the heavens and the earth?' They would be sure to reply, 'they were created by (Him), the Exalted in Power, Full of Knowledge';-
tr.203: And indeed if you ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" They will surely say: "The All-Mighty, the All-Knower created them."

43.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
43.en: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
43.tl: alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdan wajaʿala lakum fīhā subulan laʿallakum tahtadūna

tr.85: It is He who smoothed out the earth for you and traced out routes on it for you to find your way,
tr.19: Who made the earth a resting-place for you, and placed roads for you therein, that haply ye may find your way;
tr.22: (Yea, the same that) has made for you the earth (like a carpet) spread out, and has made for you roads (and channels) therein, in order that ye may find guidance (on the way);
tr.203: Who has made for you the earth like a bed, and has made for you roads therein, in order that you may find your way.

43.ar: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
43.en: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
43.tl: wa-alladhī nazzala mina l-samāi māan biqadarin fa-ansharnā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika tukh'rajūna

tr.85: who sends water down from the sky in due measure––We resurrect dead land with it, and likewise you will be resurrected from the grave––
tr.19: And Who sendeth down water from the sky in (due) measure, and We revive a dead land therewith. Even so will ye be brought forth;
tr.22: That sends down (from time to time) rain from the sky in due measure;- and We raise to life therewith a land that is dead; even so will ye be raised (from the dead);-
tr.203: And Who sends down water (rain) from the sky in due measure, then We revive a dead land therewith, and even so you will be brought forth (from the graves).

43.ar: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
43.en: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
43.tl: wa-alladhī khalaqa l-azwāja kullahā wajaʿala lakum mina l-ful'ki wal-anʿāmi mā tarkabūna

tr.85: who created every kind of thing, who gave you ships and animals to ride on
tr.19: He Who created all the pairs, and appointed for you ships and cattle whereupon ye ride.
tr.22: That has created pairs in all things, and has made for you ships and cattle on which ye ride,
tr.203: And Who has created all the pairs and has appointed for you ships and cattle on which you ride:

43.ar: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
43.en: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
43.tl: litastawū ʿalā ẓuhūrihi thumma tadhkurū niʿ'mata rabbikum idhā is'tawaytum ʿalayhi wataqūlū sub'ḥāna alladhī sakhara lanā hādhā wamā kunnā lahu muq'rinīna

tr.85: so that you may remember your Lord’s grace when you are seated on them and say, ‘Glory be to Him who has given us control over this; we could not have done it by ourselves.
tr.19: That ye may mount upon their backs, and may remember your Lord's favour when ye mount thereon, and may say: Glorified be He Who hath subdued these unto us, and we were not capable (of subduing them);
tr.22: In order that ye may sit firm and square on their backs, and when so seated, ye may celebrate the (kind) favour of your Lord, and say, "Glory to Him Who has subjected these to our (use), for we could never have accomplished this (by ourselves),
tr.203: In order that you may mount on their backs, and then may remember the Favour of your Lord when you mount thereon, and say: "Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could never have it (by our efforts).

43.ar: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
43.en: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
43.tl: wa-innā ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūna

tr.85: Truly it is to our Lord that we are returning.’
tr.19: And lo! unto our Lord we surely are returning.
tr.22: "And to our Lord, surely, must we turn back!"
tr.203: And verily, to Our Lord we indeed are to return!"

43.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ لَكَفُورٌ مُّبِينٌ
43.en: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
43.tl: wajaʿalū lahu min ʿibādihi juz'an inna l-insāna lakafūrun mubīnun

tr.85: Yet they assign some of His own servants to Him as offspring!Man is clearly ungrateful!
tr.19: And they allot to Him a portion of His bondmen! Lo! man is verily a mere ingrate.
tr.22: Yet they attribute to some of His servants a share with Him (in his godhead)! truly is man a blasphemous ingrate avowed!
tr.203: Yet, they assign to some of His slaves a share with Him (by pretending that He has children, and considering them as equals or co-partners in worship with Him). Verily, man is indeed a manifest ingrate!

43.ar: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
43.en: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
43.tl: ami ittakhadha mimmā yakhluqu banātin wa-aṣfākum bil-banīna

tr.85: Has He taken daughters for Himself and favoured you with sons?
tr.19: Or chooseth He daughters of all that He hath created, and honoureth He you with sons?
tr.22: What! has He taken daughters out of what He himself creates, and granted to you sons for choice?
tr.203: Or has He taken daughters out of what He has created, and He has selected for you sons?

43.ar: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مَثَلًا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
43.en: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
43.tl: wa-idhā bushira aḥaduhum bimā ḍaraba lilrraḥmāni mathalan ẓalla wajhuhu mus'waddan wahuwa kaẓīmun

tr.85: When one of them is given news of the birth of a daughter, such as he so readily ascribes to the Lord of Mercy, his face grows dark and he is filled with gloom-
tr.19: And if one of them hath tidings of that which he likeneth to the Beneficent One, his countenance becometh black and he is full of inward rage.
tr.22: When news is brought to one of them of (the birth of) what he sets up as a likeness to (Allah) Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he is filled with inward grief!
tr.203: And if one of them is informed of the news of (the birth of a girl) that which he sets forth as a parable to the Most Gracious (Allâh), his face becomes dark, and he is filled with grief!

43.ar: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍ
43.en: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allāh]?
43.tl: awaman yunasha-u fī l-ḥil'yati wahuwa fī l-khiṣāmi ghayru mubīnin

tr.85: ‘Someone who is brought up amongst trinkets, who cannot put together a clear argument?’
tr.19: (Liken they then to Allah) that which is bred up in outward show, and in dispute cannot make itself plain?
tr.22: Is then one brought up among trinkets, and unable to give a clear account in a dispute (to be associated with Allah)?
tr.203: (Like they then for Allâh) a creature who is brought up in adornments (wearing silk and gold ornaments, i.e. women), and who in dispute cannot make herself clear?

43.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَـٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ إِنَـٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَـٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
43.en: And they described the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, as females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
43.tl: wajaʿalū l-malāikata alladhīna hum ʿibādu l-raḥmāni ināthan ashahidū khalqahum satuk'tabu shahādatuhum wayus'alūna

tr.85: They consider the angels- God’s servants- to be female. Did they witness their creation? Their claim will be put on record and they will be questioned about it.
tr.19: And they make the angels, who are the slaves of the Beneficent, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded and they will be questioned.
tr.22: And they make into females angels who themselves serve Allah. Did they witness their creation? Their evidence will be recorded, and they will be called to account!
tr.203: And they make the angels who themselves are slaves of the Most Gracious (Allâh) females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned!

43.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَـٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
43.en: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but misjudging.
43.tl: waqālū law shāa l-raḥmānu mā ʿabadnāhum mā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yakhruṣūna

tr.85: They say, ‘If the Lord of Mercy had willed it, we would not have worshipped them,’ but they do not know that- they are only guessing-
tr.19: And they say: If the Beneficent One had (so) willed, we should not have worshipped them. They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do but guess.
tr.22: ("Ah!") they say, "If it had been the will of (Allah) Most Gracious, we should not have worshipped such (deities)!" Of that they have no knowledge! they do nothing but lie!
tr.203: And they said: "If it had been the Will of the Most Gracious (Allâh), we should not have worshipped them (false deities)." They have no knowledge whatsoever of that. They do nothing but lie!

43.ar: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ كِتَـٰبًا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
43.en: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
43.tl: am ātaynāhum kitāban min qablihi fahum bihi mus'tamsikūna

tr.85: or have We perhaps given them a book before this one, to which they hold fast?
tr.19: Or have We given them any scripture before (this Qur'an) so that they are holding fast thereto?
tr.22: What! have We given them a Book before this, to which they are holding fast?
tr.203: Or have We given them any Book before this (the Qur’ân) to which they are holding fast?

43.ar: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
43.en: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
43.tl: bal qālū innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muh'tadūna

tr.85: No indeed! They say, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are guided by their footsteps.’
tr.19: Nay, for they say only: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are guided by their footprints.
tr.22: Nay! they say: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we do guide ourselves by their footsteps."
tr.203: Nay! They say: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we guide ourselves by their footsteps."

43.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
43.en: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
43.tl: wakadhālika mā arsalnā min qablika fī qaryatin min nadhīrin illā qāla mut'rafūhā innā wajadnā ābāanā ʿalā ummatin wa-innā ʿalā āthārihim muq'tadūna

tr.85: When-ever We sent a messenger before you to warn a township, those corrupted by wealth said, in the same way, ‘We saw our fathers following this tradition; we are only following in their footsteps.’
tr.19: And even so We sent not a warner before thee (Muhammad) into any township but its luxurious ones said: Lo! we found our fathers following a religion, and we are following their footprints.
tr.22: Just in the same way, whenever We sent a Warner before thee to any people, the wealthy ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain religion, and we will certainly follow in their footsteps."
tr.203: And similarly, We sent not a warner before you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to any town (people) but the luxurious ones among them said: "We found our fathers following a certain way and religion, and we will indeed follow their footsteps."

43.ar: ۞ قَـٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
43.en: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
43.tl: qāla awalaw ji'tukum bi-ahdā mimmā wajadttum ʿalayhi ābāakum qālū innā bimā ur'sil'tum bihi kāfirūna

tr.85: The messenger said, ‘Even though I bring you a truer religion than what you saw your fathers following?’ and they replied, ‘But we do not believe the message you bring.’
tr.19: (And the warner) said: What! Even though I bring you better guidance than that ye found your fathers following? They answered: Lo! in what ye bring we are disbelievers.
tr.22: He said: "What! Even if I brought you better guidance than that which ye found your fathers following?" They said: "For us, we deny that ye (prophets) are sent (on a mission at all)."
tr.203: (The warner) said: "Even if I bring you better guidance than that which you found your fathers following?" They said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent."

43.ar: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
43.en: So We took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
43.tl: fa-intaqamnā min'hum fa-unẓur kayfa kāna ʿāqibatu l-mukadhibīna

tr.85: We punished them: think about how those who rejected the Truth met their end.
tr.19: So We requited them. Then see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters!
tr.22: So We exacted retribution from them: now see what was the end of those who rejected (Truth)!
tr.203: So We took revenge on them, then see what was the end of those who denied (Islâmic Monotheism).

43.ar: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
43.en: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
43.tl: wa-idh qāla ib'rāhīmu li-abīhi waqawmihi innanī barāon mimmā taʿbudūna

tr.85: Abraham said to his father and his people, ‘I renounce what you worship.
tr.19: And when Abraham said unto his father and his folk: Lo! I am innocent of what ye worship
tr.22: Behold! Abraham said to his father and his people: "I do indeed clear myself of what ye worship:
tr.203: And (remember) when Ibrâhîm (Abraham) said to his father and his people: "Verily, I am innocent of what you worship,

43.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
43.en: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
43.tl: illā alladhī faṭaranī fa-innahu sayahdīni

tr.85: I worship only Him who created me, and it is He who will guide me,’
tr.19: Save Him Who did create me, for He will surely guide me.
tr.22: "(I worship) only Him Who made me, and He will certainly guide me."
tr.203: "Except Him (i.e. I worship none but Allâh Alone) Who did create me; and verily He will guide me."

43.ar: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةً فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
43.en: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
43.tl: wajaʿalahā kalimatan bāqiyatan fī ʿaqibihi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna

tr.85: and he bequeathed these words to his descendants so that they might return [to God].
tr.19: And he made it a word enduring among his seed, that haply they might return.
tr.22: And he left it as a Word to endure among those who came after him, that they may turn back (to Allah).
tr.203: And he made it [i.e. Lâ ilâha illallâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh Alone)] a Word lasting among his offspring, (True Monotheism), that they may turn back (i.e. to repent to Allâh or receive admonition).

43.ar: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
43.en: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
43.tl: bal mattaʿtu hāulāi waābāahum ḥattā jāahumu l-ḥaqu warasūlun mubīnun

tr.85: I have let these people and their fathers enjoy long lives, and now I have given them the Truth and a messenger to make things clear-
tr.19: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.
tr.22: Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and a messenger making things clear.
tr.203: Nay, but I gave (the good things of this life) to these (polytheists) and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth (the Qur’ân), and a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) making things clear.

43.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَـٰفِرُونَ
43.en: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
43.tl: walammā jāahumu l-ḥaqu qālū hādhā siḥ'run wa-innā bihi kāfirūna

tr.85: yet when the Truth came to them, they said, ‘This is sorcery. We do not believe in it,’
tr.19: And now that the Truth hath come unto them they say: This is mere magic, and lo! we are disbelievers therein.
tr.22: But when the Truth came to them, they said: "This is sorcery, and we do reject it."
tr.203: And when the truth (this Qur’ân) came to them, they (the disbelievers in this Qur’ân) said: "This is magic, and we disbelieve therein."

43.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
43.en: And they said, "Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
43.tl: waqālū lawlā nuzzila hādhā l-qur'ānu ʿalā rajulin mina l-qaryatayni ʿaẓīmin

tr.85: and they said, ‘Why was this Quran not sent down to a distinguished man, from either of the two cities?’
tr.19: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?
tr.22: Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities?"
tr.203: And they say: "Why is not this Qur’ân sent down to some great man of the two towns (Makkah and Tâ’if)?"

43.ar: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍ دَرَجَـٰتٍ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًا سُخْرِيًّا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
43.en: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
43.tl: ahum yaqsimūna raḥmata rabbika naḥnu qasamnā baynahum maʿīshatahum fī l-ḥayati l-dun'yā warafaʿnā baʿḍahum fawqa baʿḍin darajātin liyattakhidha baʿḍuhum baʿḍan sukh'riyyan waraḥmatu rabbika khayrun mimmā yajmaʿūna

tr.85: Are they the ones who share out your Lord’s grace? We are the ones who give them their share of livelihood in this world and We have raised some of them above others in rank, so that some may take others into service: your Lord’s grace is better than anything they accumulate.
tr.19: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.
tr.22: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass.
tr.203: Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in this world, and We raised some of them above others in ranks, so that some may employ others in their work. But the Mercy (Paradise) of your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) is better than the (wealth of this world) which they amass.

43.ar: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةً وَٰحِدَةً لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًا مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
43.en: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount.
43.tl: walawlā an yakūna l-nāsu ummatan wāḥidatan lajaʿalnā liman yakfuru bil-raḥmāni libuyūtihim suqufan min fiḍḍatin wamaʿārija ʿalayhā yaẓharūna

tr.85: If it were not that all mankind might have become a single nation [of disbelievers], We could have given all those who disbelieve in the Lord of Mercy houses with roofs of silver, sweeping staircases to ascend,
tr.19: And were it not that mankind would have become one community, We might well have appointed, for those who disbelieve in the Beneficent, roofs of silver for their houses and stairs (of silver) whereby to mount,
tr.22: And were it not that (all) men might become of one (evil) way of life, We would provide, for everyone that blasphemes against (Allah) Most Gracious, silver roofs for their houses and (silver) stair-ways on which to go up,
tr.203: And were it not that mankind would have become of one community (all disbelievers, desiring worldly life only), We would have provided for those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious (Allâh), silver roofs for their houses, and elevators whereby they ascend,

43.ar: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
43.en: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
43.tl: walibuyūtihim abwāban wasururan ʿalayhā yattakiūna

tr.85: massive gates, couches to sit on,
tr.19: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,
tr.22: And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
tr.203: And for their houses, doors (of silver), and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,

43.ar: وَزُخْرُفًا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
43.en: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
43.tl: wazukh'rufan wa-in kullu dhālika lammā matāʿu l-ḥayati l-dun'yā wal-ākhiratu ʿinda rabbika lil'muttaqīna

tr.85: and golden ornaments. All of these are mere enjoyments of this life; your Lord reserves the next life for those who take heed of Him.
tr.19: And ornaments of gold. Yet all that would have been but a provision of the life of the world. And the Hereafter with your Lord would have been for those who keep from evil.
tr.22: And also adornments of gold. But all this were nothing but conveniences of the present life: The Hereafter, in the sight of thy Lord is for the Righteous.
tr.203: And adornments of gold. Yet all this (i.e. the roofs, doors, stairs, elevators, thrones of their houses) would have been nothing but an enjoyment of this world. And the Hereafter with your Lord is (only) for the Muttaqûn.

43.ar: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌ
43.en: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
43.tl: waman yaʿshu ʿan dhik'ri l-raḥmāni nuqayyiḍ lahu shayṭānan fahuwa lahu qarīnun

tr.85: We assign an evil one as a comrade for whoever turns away from the revelations of the Lord of Mercy:
tr.19: And he whose sight is dim to the remembrance of the Beneficent, We assign unto him a devil who becometh his comrade;
tr.22: If anyone withdraws himself from remembrance of (Allah) Most Gracious, We appoint for him an evil one, to be an intimate companion to him.
tr.203: And whosoever turns away blindly from the remembrance of the Most Gracious (Allâh) (i.e. this Qur’ân and worship of Allâh), We appoint for him Shaitan (Satan - devil) to be a Qarîn (a companion) to him.

43.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
43.en: And indeed, they [i.e., the devils] avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
43.tl: wa-innahum layaṣuddūnahum ʿani l-sabīli wayaḥsabūna annahum muh'tadūna

tr.85: evil ones bar people from the right path, even though they may think they are well guided.
tr.19: And lo! they surely turn them from the way of Allah, and yet they deem that they are rightly guided;
tr.22: Such (evil ones) really hinder them from the Path, but they think that they are being guided aright!
tr.203: And verily, they (Satans / devils) hinder them from the Path (of Allâh), but they think that they are guided aright!

43.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَـٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
43.en: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "How I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west; and what a wretched companion."
43.tl: ḥattā idhā jāanā qāla yālayta baynī wabaynaka buʿ'da l-mashriqayni fabi'sa l-qarīnu

tr.85: When such a person comes to Us, he will say [to his comrade], ‘If only you had been as far away from me as east is from west. What an evil comrade!’
tr.19: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!
tr.22: At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)!
tr.203: Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says [to his Qarîn (Satan / devil companion)] "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west)" - a worst (type of) companion (indeed)!

43.ar: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
43.en: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
43.tl: walan yanfaʿakumu l-yawma idh ẓalamtum annakum fī l-ʿadhābi mush'tarikūna

tr.85: [It will be said to them], ‘You have done wrong. Having partners in punishment will not console you today.’
tr.19: And it profiteth you not this day, because ye did wrong, that ye will be sharers in the doom.
tr.22: When ye have done wrong, it will avail you nothing, that Day, that ye shall be partners in Punishment!
tr.203: It will profit you not this Day (O you who turn away from Allâh’s remembrance and His worship) as you did wrong, (and) that you will be sharers (you and your Qarîn ) in the punishment.

43.ar: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
43.en: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muḥammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
43.tl: afa-anta tus'miʿu l-ṣuma aw tahdī l-ʿum'ya waman kāna fī ḍalālin mubīnin

tr.85: Can you [Prophet] make the deaf hear? Or guide either the blind or those who are in gross error?
tr.19: Canst thou (Muhammad) make the deaf to hear, or canst thou guide the blind or him who is in error manifest?
tr.22: Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or give direction to the blind or to such as (wander) in manifest error?
tr.203: Can you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) make the deaf to hear, or can you guide the blind or him who is in manifest error?

43.ar: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
43.en: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
43.tl: fa-immā nadhhabanna bika fa-innā min'hum muntaqimūna

tr.85: Either We shall take you away and punish them- indeed We will-
tr.19: And if We take thee away, We surely shall take vengeance on them,
tr.22: Even if We take thee away, We shall be sure to exact retribution from them,
tr.203: And even if We take you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) away, We shall indeed take vengeance on them.

43.ar: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَـٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
43.en: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
43.tl: aw nuriyannaka alladhī waʿadnāhum fa-innā ʿalayhim muq'tadirūna

tr.85: or We shall let you witness the punishment We threatened them with; We have full power over them.
tr.19: Or (if) We show thee that wherewith We threaten them; for lo! We have complete command of them.
tr.22: Or We shall show thee that (accomplished) which We have promised them: for verily We shall prevail over them.
tr.203: Or (if) We show you that wherewith We threaten them: then verily We have perfect command over them.

43.ar: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
43.en: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
43.tl: fa-is'tamsik bi-alladhī ūḥiya ilayka innaka ʿalā ṣirāṭin mus'taqīmin

tr.85: Hold fast to what has been revealed to you- you truly are on the right path-
tr.19: So hold thou fast to that which is inspired in thee. Lo! thou art on a right path.
tr.22: So hold thou fast to the Revelation sent down to thee; verily thou art on a Straight Way.
tr.203: So hold you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) fast to that which is revealed to you. Verily you are on the Straight Path.

43.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
43.en: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
43.tl: wa-innahu ladhik'run laka waliqawmika wasawfa tus'alūna

tr.85: for it is a reminder for you and your people: you will all be questioned.
tr.19: And lo! it is in truth a Reminder for thee and for thy folk; and ye will be questioned.
tr.22: The (Qur'an) is indeed the message, for thee and for thy people; and soon shall ye (all) be brought to account.
tr.203: And verily this (the Qur’ân) is indeed a Reminder for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) and your people (Quraish people, or your followers), and you will be questioned (about it).

43.ar: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ءَالِهَةً يُعْبَدُونَ
43.en: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
43.tl: wasal man arsalnā min qablika min rusulinā ajaʿalnā min dūni l-raḥmāni ālihatan yuʿ'badūna

tr.85: Ask the prophets We sent before you: ‘Did We ever appoint any gods to be worshipped besides the Lord of Mercy?’
tr.19: And ask those of Our messengers whom We sent before thee: Did We ever appoint gods to be worshipped beside the Beneficent?
tr.22: And question thou our messengers whom We sent before thee; did We appoint any deities other than (Allah) Most Gracious, to be worshipped?
tr.203: And ask (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) those of Our Messengers whom We sent before you: "Did We ever appoint âlihâh (gods) to be worshipped besides the Most Gracious (Allâh)?"

43.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
43.en: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
43.tl: walaqad arsalnā mūsā biāyātinā ilā fir'ʿawna wamala-ihi faqāla innī rasūlu rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: We sent Moses to Pharaoh and his courtiers and he said, ‘I am truly a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds,’
tr.19: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, and he said: I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: We did send Moses aforetime, with Our Signs, to Pharaoh and his Chiefs: He said, "I am a messenger of the Lord of the Worlds."
tr.203: And indeed We did send Mûsâ (Moses) with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs (inviting them to Allâh’s religion of Islâm) He said: "Verily, I am a Messenger of the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)."

43.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
43.en: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
43.tl: falammā jāahum biāyātinā idhā hum min'hā yaḍḥakūna

tr.85: but when he presented Our signs to them, they laughed,
tr.19: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.
tr.22: But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them.
tr.203: But when he came to them with Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations) behold, they laughed at them.

43.ar: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
43.en: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
43.tl: wamā nurīhim min āyatin illā hiya akbaru min ukh'tihā wa-akhadhnāhum bil-ʿadhābi laʿallahum yarjiʿūna

tr.85: even though each sign We showed them was greater than the previous one. We inflicted torment on them so that they might return to the right path.
tr.19: And every token that We showed them was greater than its sister (token), and We grasped them with the torment, that haply they might turn again.
tr.22: We showed them Sign after Sign, each greater than its fellow, and We seized them with Punishment, in order that they might turn (to Us).
tr.203: And not an Ayâh (sign, etc.) We showed them but it was greater than its fellow , and We seized them with torment, in order that they might turn [from their polytheism to Allâh’s religion (Islâmic Monotheism)].

43.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
43.en: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
43.tl: waqālū yāayyuha l-sāḥiru ud'ʿu lanā rabbaka bimā ʿahida ʿindaka innanā lamuh'tadūna

tr.85: They said, ‘Sorcerer, call on your Lord for us, by virtue of His pledge to you: we shall certainly accept guidance,’
tr.19: And they said: O wizard! Entreat thy Lord for us by the pact that He hath made with thee. Lo! we verily will walk aright.
tr.22: And they said, "O thou sorcerer! Invoke thy Lord for us according to His covenant with thee; for we shall truly accept guidance."
tr.203: And they said [to Mûsâ (Moses)]: "O you sorcerer! Invoke your Lord for us according to what He has covenanted with you. Verily, We shall guide ourselves (aright)."

43.ar: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
43.en: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
43.tl: falammā kashafnā ʿanhumu l-ʿadhāba idhā hum yankuthūna

tr.85: but as soon as We relieved their torment they broke their word.
tr.19: But when We eased them of the torment, behold! they broke their word.
tr.22: But when We removed the Penalty from them, behold, they broke their word.
tr.203: But when We removed the torment from them, behold, they broke their covenant (that they will believe if We remove the torment from them).

43.ar: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَـٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
43.en: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
43.tl: wanādā fir'ʿawnu fī qawmihi qāla yāqawmi alaysa lī mul'ku miṣ'ra wahādhihi l-anhāru tajrī min taḥtī afalā tub'ṣirūna

tr.85: Pharaoh proclaimed to his people, ‘My people, is the Kingdom of Egypt not mine? And these rivers that flow at my feet, are they not mine? Do you not see?
tr.19: And Pharaoh caused a proclamation to be made among his people saying: O my people! Is not mine the sovereignty of Egypt and these rivers flowing under me? Can ye not then discern?
tr.22: And Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying: "O my people! Does not the dominion of Egypt belong to me, (witness) these streams flowing underneath my (palace)? What! see ye not then?
tr.203: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) proclaimed among his people (saying): "O my people! Is not mine the dominion of Egypt, and these rivers flowing underneath me. See you not then?

43.ar: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
43.en: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
43.tl: am anā khayrun min hādhā alladhī huwa mahīnun walā yakādu yubīnu

tr.85: Am I not better than this contemptible wretch who can scarcely express himself?
tr.19: I am surely better than this fellow, who is despicable and can hardly make (his meaning) plain!
tr.22: "Am I not better than this (Moses), who is a contemptible wretch and can scarcely express himself clearly?
tr.203: "Am I not better than this one [Mûsâ (Moses)] who is despicable and can scarcely express himself clearly?

43.ar: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
43.en: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
43.tl: falawlā ul'qiya ʿalayhi aswiratun min dhahabin aw jāa maʿahu l-malāikatu muq'tarinīna

tr.85: Why has he not been given any gold bracelets? Why have no angels come to accompany him?’
tr.19: Why, then, have armlets of gold not been set upon him, or angels sent along with him?
tr.22: "Then why are not gold bracelets bestowed on him, or (why) come (not) with him angels accompanying him in procession?"
tr.203: "Why then are not golden bracelets bestowed on him, or angels sent along with him?"

43.ar: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
43.en: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allāh].
43.tl: fa-is'takhaffa qawmahu fa-aṭāʿūhu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna

tr.85: In this way he moved his people to accept and they obeyed him- they were perverse people.
tr.19: Thus he persuaded his people to make light (of Moses), and they obeyed him. Lo! they were a wanton folk.
tr.22: Thus did he make fools of his people, and they obeyed him: truly were they a people rebellious (against Allah).
tr.203: Thus he [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] befooled (and misled) his people, and they obeyed him. Verily, they were ever a people who were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

43.ar: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
43.en: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
43.tl: falammā āsafūnā intaqamnā min'hum fa-aghraqnāhum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: When they provoked Us, We punished and drowned them all:
tr.19: So, when they angered Us, We punished them and drowned them every one.
tr.22: When at length they provoked Us, We exacted retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
tr.203: So when they angered Us, We punished them, and drowned them all.

43.ar: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ سَلَفًا وَمَثَلًا لِّلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
43.en: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
43.tl: fajaʿalnāhum salafan wamathalan lil'ākhirīna

tr.85: We made them a lesson and an example for later people.
tr.19: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).
tr.22: And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
tr.203: And We made them a precedent (as a lesson for those coming after them), and an example to later generations.

43.ar: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
43.en: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
43.tl: walammā ḍuriba ub'nu maryama mathalan idhā qawmuka min'hu yaṣiddūna

tr.85: When the son of Mary is cited as an example, your people [Prophet] laugh and jeer,
tr.19: And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example, behold! the folk laugh out,
tr.22: When (Jesus) the son of Mary is held up as an example, behold, thy people raise a clamour thereat (in ridicule)!
tr.203: And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols], behold, your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example).

43.ar: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَـٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
43.en: And they said, "Are our gods better, or is he?" They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
43.tl: waqālū aālihatunā khayrun am huwa mā ḍarabūhu laka illā jadalan bal hum qawmun khaṣimūna

tr.85: saying, ‘Are our gods better or him?’- they cite him only to challenge you: they are a contentious people-
tr.19: And say: Are our gods better, or is he? They raise not the objection save for argument. Nay! but they are a contentious folk.
tr.22: And they say, "Are our gods best, or he?" This they set forth to thee, only by way of disputation: yea, they are a contentious people.
tr.203: And say: "Are our âlihah (gods) better or is he [‘Îsâ (Jesus)]?" They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people. (See V. 21:98-101)

43.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ مَثَلًا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
43.en: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
43.tl: in huwa illā ʿabdun anʿamnā ʿalayhi wajaʿalnāhu mathalan libanī is'rāīla

tr.85: but he is only a servant We favoured and made an example for the Children of Israel:
tr.19: He is nothing but a slave on whom We bestowed favour, and We made him a pattern for the Children of Israel.
tr.22: He was no more than a servant: We granted Our favour to him, and We made him an example to the Children of Israel.
tr.203: He [‘Îsâ (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father).

43.ar: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَـٰٓئِكَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
43.en: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
43.tl: walaw nashāu lajaʿalnā minkum malāikatan fī l-arḍi yakhlufūna

tr.85: if it had been Our will, We could have made you angels, succeeding one another on earth.
tr.19: And had We willed We could have set among you angels to be viceroys in the earth.
tr.22: And if it were Our Will, We could make angels from amongst you, succeeding each other on the earth.
tr.203: And if it were Our Will, We would have [destroyed you (mankind) all, and] made angels to replace you on the earth. [Tafsir At-Tabarî].

43.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
43.en: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
43.tl: wa-innahu laʿil'mun lilssāʿati falā tamtarunna bihā wa-ittabiʿūni hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun

tr.85: This [Quran] gives knowledge of the Hour: do not doubt it. Follow Me for this is the right path;
tr.19: And lo! verily there is knowledge of the Hour. So doubt ye not concerning it, but follow Me. This is the right path.
tr.22: And (Jesus) shall be a Sign (for the coming of) the Hour (of Judgment): therefore have no doubt about the (Hour), but follow ye Me: this is a Straight Way.
tr.203: And he [‘Îsâ (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)] shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour (Day of Resurrection) [i.e. ‘Isâ’s (Jesus) descent on the earth]. Therefore have no doubt concerning it (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). And follow Me (Allâh) (i.e. be obedient to Allâh and do what He orders you to do, O mankind)! This is the Straight Path (of Islâmic Monotheism, leading to Allâh and to His Paradise).

43.ar: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
43.en: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
43.tl: walā yaṣuddannakumu l-shayṭānu innahu lakum ʿaduwwun mubīnun

tr.85: do not let Satan hinder you, for he is your sworn enemy.
tr.19: And let not Satan turn you aside. Lo! he is an open enemy for you.
tr.22: Let not the Evil One hinder you: for he is to you an enemy avowed.
tr.203: And let not Shaitân (Satan) hinder you (from the right religion, i.e. Islâmic Monotheism). Verily, he (Satan) to you is a plain enemy.

43.ar: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
43.en: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allāh and obey me.
43.tl: walammā jāa ʿīsā bil-bayināti qāla qad ji'tukum bil-ḥik'mati wali-ubayyina lakum baʿḍa alladhī takhtalifūna fīhi fa-ittaqū l-laha wa-aṭīʿūni

tr.85: When Jesus came with clear signs he said, ‘I have brought you wisdom; I have come to clear up some of your differences for you. Be mindful of God and obey me:
tr.19: When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty), he said: I have come unto you with wisdom, and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ. So keep your duty to Allah, and obey me.
tr.22: When Jesus came with Clear Signs, he said: "Now have I come to you with Wisdom, and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which ye dispute: therefore fear Allah and obey me.
tr.203: And when ‘Îsâ (Jesus) came with (Our) clear Proofs, he said: "I have come to you with Al-Hikmah (Prophethood), and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) in which you differ. Therefore fear Allâh and obey me.

43.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
43.en: Indeed, Allāh is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
43.tl: inna l-laha huwa rabbī warabbukum fa-uʿ'budūhu hādhā ṣirāṭun mus'taqīmun

tr.85: God is my Lord and your Lord. Serve Him: this is the straight path.’
tr.19: Lo! Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him. This is a right path.
tr.22: "For Allah, He is my Lord and your Lord: so worship ye Him: this is a Straight Way."
tr.203: "Verily, Allâh! He is my Lord (God) and your Lord (God). So worship Him (Alone). This is the (only) Straight Path (i.e. Allâh’s religion of true Islâmic Monotheism)."

43.ar: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
43.en: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
43.tl: fa-ikh'talafa l-aḥzābu min baynihim fawaylun lilladhīna ẓalamū min ʿadhābi yawmin alīmin

tr.85: Yet still the different factions among them disagreed- woe to the evildoers: they will suffer the torment of a grievous day!-
tr.19: But the factions among them differed. Then woe unto those who do wrong from the doom of a painful day.
tr.22: But sects from among themselves fell into disagreement: then woe to the wrong-doers, from the Penalty of a Grievous Day!
tr.203: But the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong [by ascribing things to ‘Îsâ (Jesus) that are not true] from the torment of a painful Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!

43.ar: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
43.en: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
43.tl: hal yanẓurūna illā l-sāʿata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum lā yashʿurūna

tr.85: what are they waiting for but the Hour, which will come upon them suddenly and take them unawares?
tr.19: Await they aught save the Hour, that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not?
tr.22: Do they only wait for the Hour - that it should come on them all of a sudden, while they perceive not?
tr.203: Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly, while they perceive not?

43.ar: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
43.en: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
43.tl: al-akhilāu yawma-idhin baʿḍuhum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun illā l-mutaqīna

tr.85: On that Day, friends will become each other’s enemies. Not so the righteous-
tr.19: Friends on that day will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah).
tr.22: Friends on that day will be foes, one to another,- except the Righteous.
tr.203: Friends on that Day will be foes one to another except Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).

43.ar: يَـٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
43.en: [To whom Allāh will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
43.tl: yāʿibādi lā khawfun ʿalaykumu l-yawma walā antum taḥzanūna

tr.85: ‘My servants, there is no fear for you today, nor shall you grieve’––
tr.19: O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day, nor is it ye who grieve;
tr.22: My devotees! no fear shall be on you that Day, nor shall ye grieve,-
tr.203: (It will be said to the true believers of Islâmic Monotheism): My worshippers! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,

43.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
43.en: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
43.tl: alladhīna āmanū biāyātinā wakānū mus'limīna

tr.85: those who believed in Our revelations and devoted themselves to Us.
tr.19: (Ye) who believed Our revelations and were self-surrendered,
tr.22: (Being) those who have believed in Our Signs and bowed (their wills to Ours) in Islam.
tr.203: (You) who believed in Our Ayât (proofs, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and were Muslims (i.e. who submit totally to Allâh’s Will, and believe in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism).

43.ar: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
43.en: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
43.tl: ud'khulū l-janata antum wa-azwājukum tuḥ'barūna

tr.85: ‘Enter Paradise, you and your spouses: you will be filled with joy.’
tr.19: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
tr.22: Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
tr.203: Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness.

43.ar: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
43.en: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
43.tl: yuṭāfu ʿalayhim biṣiḥāfin min dhahabin wa-akwābin wafīhā mā tashtahīhi l-anfusu wataladhu l-aʿyunu wa-antum fīhā khālidūna

tr.85: Dishes and goblets of gold will be passed around them with all that their souls desire and their eyes delight in. ‘There you will remain:
tr.19: Therein are brought round for them trays of gold and goblets, and therein is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet. And ye are immortal therein.
tr.22: To them will be passed round, dishes and goblets of gold: there will be there all that the souls could desire, all that their eyes could delight in: and ye shall abide therein (for eye).
tr.203: Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that inner-selves could desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever.

43.ar: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
43.en: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
43.tl: watil'ka l-janatu allatī ūrith'tumūhā bimā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: this is the Garden you are given as your own, because of what you used to do,
tr.19: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
tr.22: Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
tr.203: This is the Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do (in the life of the world).

43.ar: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
43.en: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
43.tl: lakum fīhā fākihatun kathīratun min'hā takulūna

tr.85: and there is abundant fruit in it for you to eat.’
tr.19: Therein for you is fruit in plenty whence to eat.
tr.22: Ye shall have therein abundance of fruit, from which ye shall have satisfaction.
tr.203: Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat (as you desire).

43.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
43.en: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
43.tl: inna l-muj'rimīna fī ʿadhābi jahannama khālidūna

tr.85: But the evildoers will remain in Hell’s punishment,
tr.19: Lo! the guilty are immortal in hell's torment.
tr.22: The sinners will be in the Punishment of Hell, to dwell therein (for aye):
tr.203: Verily, the Mujrimûn (criminals, sinners, disbelievers) will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever.

43.ar: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
43.en: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
43.tl: lā yufattaru ʿanhum wahum fīhi mub'lisūna

tr.85: from which there is no relief: they will remain in utter despair.
tr.19: It is not relaxed for them, and they despair therein.
tr.22: Nowise will the (Punishment) be lightened for them, and in despair will they be there overwhelmed.
tr.203: (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein.

43.ar: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَـٰهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
43.en: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
43.tl: wamā ẓalamnāhum walākin kānū humu l-ẓālimīna

tr.85: We never wronged them; they were the ones who did wrong.
tr.19: We wronged them not, but they it was who did the wrong.
tr.22: Nowise shall We be unjust to them: but it is they who have been unjust themselves.
tr.203: We wronged them not, but they were the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers).

43.ar: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَـٰمَـٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّـٰكِثُونَ
43.en: And they will call, "O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
43.tl: wanādaw yāmāliku liyaqḍi ʿalaynā rabbuka qāla innakum mākithūna

tr.85: They will cry, ‘Malik, if only your Lord would finish us off,’ but he will answer, ‘No! You are here to stay.’
tr.19: And they cry: O master! Let thy Lord make an end of us. He saith: Lo! here ye must remain.
tr.22: They will cry: "O Malik! would that thy Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Nay, but ye shall abide!"
tr.203: And they will cry: "O Malik (Keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us." He will say: "Verily, you shall abide forever."

43.ar: لَقَدْ جِئْنَـٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
43.en: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
43.tl: laqad ji'nākum bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharakum lil'ḥaqqi kārihūna

tr.85: We have brought you the Truth but most of you despise it.
tr.19: We verily brought the Truth unto you, but ye were, most of you, averse to the Truth.
tr.22: Verily We have brought the Truth to you: but most of you have a hatred for Truth.
tr.203: Indeed We have brought the truth (Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم with the Qur’ân) to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth.

43.ar: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
43.en: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
43.tl: am abramū amran fa-innā mub'rimūna

tr.85: Have these disbelievers thought up some scheme? We too have been scheming.
tr.19: Or do they determine any thing (against the Prophet)? Lo! We (also) are determining.
tr.22: What! have they settled some plan (among themselves)? But it is We Who settle things.
tr.203: Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning.

43.ar: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
43.en: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
43.tl: am yaḥsabūna annā lā nasmaʿu sirrahum wanajwāhum balā warusulunā ladayhim yaktubūna

tr.85: Do they think We cannot hear their secret talk and their private counsel? Yes we can: Our messengers are at their sides, recording everything.
