tr.19: Or deem they that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences? Nay, but Our envoys, present with them, do record.
tr.22: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsels? Indeed (We do), and Our messengers are by them, to record.
tr.203: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel? (Yes We do) and Our messengers (appointed angels in charge of mankind) are by them, to record.

43.ar: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَـٰبِدِينَ
43.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
43.tl: qul in kāna lilrraḥmāni waladun fa-anā awwalu l-ʿābidīna

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘If the Lord of Mercy [truly] had offspring I would be the first to worship [them], but-
tr.19: Say (O Muhammad): If the Beneficent One hath a son, then, I shall be first among the worshippers. (But there is no son).
tr.22: Say: "If (Allah) Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship."
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم): "If the Most Gracious (Allâh) had a son (or children as you pretend), then I am the first of Allâh’s worshippers [who deny and refute this claim of yours (and the first to believe in Allâh Alone and testify that He has no children)]." [Tafsir At-Tabarî].

43.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
43.en: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
43.tl: sub'ḥāna rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi rabbi l-ʿarshi ʿammā yaṣifūna

tr.85: exalted be the Lord of the heavens and earth, the Lord of the Throne- He is far above their false descriptions.’
tr.19: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
tr.22: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
tr.203: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him).

43.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
43.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
43.tl: fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna

tr.85: Leave them to wade in deeper and play about, until they face the Day they have been promised.
tr.19: So let them flounder (in their talk) and play until they meet the Day which they are promised.
tr.22: So leave them to babble and play (with vanities) until they meet that Day of theirs, which they have been promised.
tr.203: So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised.

43.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
43.en: And it is He [i.e., Allāh] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
43.tl: wahuwa alladhī fī l-samāi ilāhun wafī l-arḍi ilāhun wahuwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu

tr.85: It is He who is God in heaven and God on earth; He is the All Wise, the All Knowing;
tr.19: And He it is Who in the heaven is Allah, and in the earth Allah. He is the Wise, the Knower.
tr.22: It is He Who is Allah in heaven and Allah on earth; and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge.
tr.203: It is He (Allâh) Who is the only Ilâh (God to be worshipped) in the heaven and the only Ilâh (God to be worshipped) on the earth. And He be the All-Wise, the All-Knower.

43.ar: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
43.en: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
43.tl: watabāraka alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā waʿindahu ʿil'mu l-sāʿati wa-ilayhi tur'jaʿūna

tr.85: Exalted is He who has control of the heavens and earth and everything between them; He has knowledge of the Hour; you will all be returned to Him.
tr.19: And blessed be He unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour, and unto Whom ye will be returned.
tr.22: And blessed is He to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and all between them: with Him is the Knowledge of the Hour (of Judgment): and to Him shall ye be brought back.
tr.203: And Blessed be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned.

43.ar: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
43.en: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
43.tl: walā yamliku alladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihi l-shafāʿata illā man shahida bil-ḥaqi wahum yaʿlamūna

tr.85: Those gods they invoke besides Him have no power of intercession, unlike those who bore witness to the truth and recognized it.
tr.19: And those unto whom they cry instead of Him possess no power of intercession, saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth knowingly.
tr.22: And those whom they invoke besides Allah have no power of intercession;- only he who bears witness to the Truth, and they know (him).
tr.203: And those whom they invoke instead of Him have no power of intercession - except for those who bear witness to the truth knowingly (i.e. believed in the Oneness of Allâh, and obeyed His Orders), and they know (the facts about the Oneness of Allâh).

43.ar: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
43.en: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allāh." So how are they deluded?
43.tl: wala-in sa-altahum man khalaqahum layaqūlunna l-lahu fa-annā yu'fakūna

tr.85: If you [Prophet] ask them who created them they are sure to say, ‘God,’ so why are they so deluded?
tr.19: And if thou ask them who created them, they will surely say: Allah. How then are they turned away?
tr.22: If thou ask them, who created them, they will certainly say, Allah: How then are they deluded away (from the Truth)?
tr.203: And if you ask them who created them, they will surely say: "Allâh." How then are they turned away (from the worship of Allâh, Who created them)?

43.ar: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
43.en: And [Allāh acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
43.tl: waqīlihi yārabbi inna hāulāi qawmun lā yu'minūna

tr.85: The Prophet has said, ‘My Lord, truly these are people who do not believe,’
tr.19: And he saith: O my Lord! Lo! these are a folk who believe not.
tr.22: (Allah has knowledge) of the (Prophet's) cry, "O my Lord! Truly these are people who will not believe!"
tr.203: (And Allâh has the knowledge) of (Prophet Muhammad’s) saying: "O my Lord! Verily, these are a people who believe not!"

43.ar: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَـٰمٌ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
43.en: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
43.tl: fa-iṣ'faḥ ʿanhum waqul salāmun fasawfa yaʿlamūna

tr.85: but turn away from them and say, ‘Peace’: they will come to know.
tr.19: Then bear with them (O Muhammad) and say: Peace. But they will come to know.
tr.22: But turn away from them, and say "Peace!" But soon shall they know!
tr.203: So turn away from them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم), and say: Salâm (peace)! But they will come to know.

44.ar: حمٓ
44.en: Ḥā, Meem.
44.tl: hha-meem

tr.85: Ha Mim
tr.19: Ha. Mim.
tr.22: Ha-Mim.
tr.203: Hâ.-Mîm.

44.ar: وَٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
44.en: By the clear Book,
44.tl: wal-kitābi l-mubīni

tr.85: By the Scripture that makes things clear,
tr.19: By the Scripture that maketh plain
tr.22: By the Book that makes things clear;-
tr.203: By the manifest Book (this Qur’ân) that makes things clear.

44.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَـٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
44.en: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
44.tl: innā anzalnāhu fī laylatin mubārakatin innā kunnā mundhirīna

tr.85: truly We sent it down on a blessed night––We have always sent warnings––
tr.19: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
tr.22: We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
tr.203: We sent it (this Qur’ân) down on a blessed night [(i.e. night of Al-Qadr, Sûrah No. 97) in the month of Ramadân - the 9th month of the Islâmic calendar]. Verily, We are ever warning [mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship].

44.ar: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
44.en: Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter -
44.tl: fīhā yuf'raqu kullu amrin ḥakīmin

tr.85: a night when every matter of wisdom was made distinct
tr.19: Whereon every wise command is made clear
tr.22: In the (Night) is made distinct every affair of wisdom,
tr.203: Therein (that night) is decreed every matter of ordainments.

44.ar: أَمْرًا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
44.en: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
44.tl: amran min ʿindinā innā kunnā mur'silīna

tr.85: at Our command––We have always sent messages to man––
tr.19: As a command from Our presence - Lo! We are ever sending -
tr.22: By command, from Our Presence. For We (ever) send (revelations),
tr.203: As a Command (or this Qur’ân or the Decree of every matter) from Us. Verily, We are ever sending (the Messengers),

44.ar: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
44.en: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
44.tl: raḥmatan min rabbika innahu huwa l-samīʿu l-ʿalīmu

tr.85: as a mercy [Prophet] from your Lord who sees and knows all,
tr.19: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
tr.22: As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
tr.203: (As) a Mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.

44.ar: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
44.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
44.tl: rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā in kuntum mūqinīna

tr.85: Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything between––if only you people were firm believers––
tr.19: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if ye would be sure.
tr.22: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all between them, if ye (but) have an assured faith.
tr.203: The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty.

44.ar: لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
44.en: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
44.tl: lā ilāha illā huwa yuḥ'yī wayumītu rabbukum warabbu ābāikumu l-awalīna

tr.85: there is no god but Him: He gives life and death––He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers––
tr.19: There is no Allah save Him. He quickeneth and giveth death; your Lord and Lord of your forefathers.
tr.22: There is no god but He: It is He Who gives life and gives death,- The Lord and Cherisher to you and your earliest ancestors.
tr.203: Lâ ilaha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). It is He Who gives life and causes death - your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

44.ar: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
44.en: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
44.tl: bal hum fī shakkin yalʿabūna

tr.85: yet in [their state of] doubt they take nothing seriously.
tr.19: Nay, but they play in doubt.
tr.22: Yet they play about in doubt.
tr.203: Nay! They play about in doubt.

44.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
44.en: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke
44.tl: fa-ir'taqib yawma tatī l-samāu bidukhānin mubīnin

tr.85: [Prophet], watch out for the Day when the sky brings forth clouds of smoke for all to see.
tr.19: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
tr.22: Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
tr.203: Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,

44.ar: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
44.en: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
44.tl: yaghshā l-nāsa hādhā ʿadhābun alīmun

tr.85: It will envelop the people. They will cry, ‘This is a terrible torment!
tr.19: That will envelop the people. This will be a painful torment.
tr.22: Enveloping the people: this will be a Penalty Grievous.
tr.203: Covering the people: this is a painful torment.

44.ar: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
44.en: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
44.tl: rabbanā ik'shif ʿannā l-ʿadhāba innā mu'minūna

tr.85: Lord relieve us from this torment! We believe!’
tr.19: (Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment. Lo! we are believers.
tr.22: (They will say:) "Our Lord! remove the Penalty from us, for we do really believe!"
tr.203: (They will say): "Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!"

44.ar: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
44.en: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
44.tl: annā lahumu l-dhik'rā waqad jāahum rasūlun mubīnun

tr.85: How will this [sudden] faith benefit them? When a prophet came to warn them plainly,
tr.19: How can there be remembrance for them, when a messenger making plain (the Truth) had already come unto them,
tr.22: How shall the message be (effectual) for them, seeing that an Messenger explaining things clearly has (already) come to them,-
tr.203: How can there be for them an admonition (at the time when the torment has reached them), when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them.

44.ar: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
44.en: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
44.tl: thumma tawallaw ʿanhu waqālū muʿallamun majnūnun

tr.85: they turned their backs on him, saying, ‘He is tutored! He is possessed!’
tr.19: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
tr.22: Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
tr.203: Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) and said: (He is) one taught (by a human being), a madman!"

44.ar: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
44.en: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
44.tl: innā kāshifū l-ʿadhābi qalīlan innakum ʿāidūna

tr.85: We shall hold the torment back for a while ––you are sure to return [to Us]––
tr.19: Lo! We withdraw the torment a little. Lo! ye return (to disbelief).
tr.22: We shall indeed remove the Penalty for a while, (but) truly ye will revert (to your ways).
tr.203: Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily you will revert (to disbelief).

44.ar: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
44.en: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
44.tl: yawma nabṭishu l-baṭshata l-kub'rā innā muntaqimūna

tr.85: and on the Day We seize [them] mightily We shall exact retribution.
tr.19: On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure, (then) in truth We shall punish.
tr.22: One day We shall seize you with a mighty onslaught: We will indeed (then) exact Retribution!
tr.203: On the Day when We shall seize you with the greatest seizure (punishment). Verily, We will exact retribution.

44.ar: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
44.en: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
44.tl: walaqad fatannā qablahum qawma fir'ʿawna wajāahum rasūlun karīmun

tr.85: We tested the people of Pharaoh before them: a noble messenger was sent to them,
tr.19: And verily We tried before them Pharaoh's folk, when there came unto them a noble messenger,
tr.22: We did, before them, try the people of Pharaoh: there came to them a messenger most honourable,
tr.203: And indeed We tried before them Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people, when there came to them a noble Messenger [i.e. Mûsâ (Moses) عليه السلام],

44.ar: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
44.en: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allāh. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
44.tl: an addū ilayya ʿibāda l-lahi innī lakum rasūlun amīnun

tr.85: saying, ‘Hand the servants of God over to me! I am a faithful messenger who has been sent to you.
tr.19: Saying: Give up to me the slaves of Allah. Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you.
tr.22: Saying: "Restore to me the Servants of Allah: I am to you an messenger worthy of all trust;
tr.203: Saying: "Deliver to me the slaves of Allâh (i.e. the Children of Israel). Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust.

44.ar: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
44.en: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allāh. Indeed, I have come to you with clear evidence.
44.tl: wa-an lā taʿlū ʿalā l-lahi innī ātīkum bisul'ṭānin mubīnin

tr.85: Do not consider yourselves to be above God! I come to you with clear authority.
tr.19: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
tr.22: "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
tr.203: "And exalt not yourselves against Allâh. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority.

44.ar: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
44.en: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
44.tl: wa-innī ʿudh'tu birabbī warabbikum an tarjumūni

tr.85: I seek refuge in my Lord and yours against your insults!
tr.19: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
tr.22: "For me, I have sought safety with my Lord and your Lord, against your injuring me.
tr.203: "And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me (or call me a sorcerer or kill me).

44.ar: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
44.en: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
44.tl: wa-in lam tu'minū lī fa-iʿ'tazilūni

tr.85: If you do not believe me, just let me be.’
tr.19: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
tr.22: "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
tr.203: "But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone."

44.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
44.en: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
44.tl: fadaʿā rabbahu anna hāulāi qawmun muj'rimūna

tr.85: [Moses] cried to his Lord, ‘These people are evildoers!’
tr.19: And he cried unto his Lord, (saying): These are guilty folk.
tr.22: (But they were aggressive:) then he cried to his Lord: "These are indeed a people given to sin."
tr.203: (But they were aggressive), so he [Mûsâ (Moses)] called upon his Lord (saying): "These are indeed the people who are Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals)."

44.ar: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
44.en: [Allāh said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
44.tl: fa-asri biʿibādī laylan innakum muttabaʿūna

tr.85: [God replied], ‘Escape in the night with My servants, for you are sure to be pursued.
tr.19: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
tr.22: (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
tr.203: (Allâh said): "Depart you with My slaves by night. Surely, you will be pursued.

44.ar: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
44.en: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
44.tl: wa-ut'ruki l-baḥra rahwan innahum jundun mugh'raqūna

tr.85: Leave the sea behind you parted and their army will be drowned.’
tr.19: And leave the sea behind at rest, for lo! they are a drowned host.
tr.22: "And leave the sea as a furrow (divided): for they are a host (destined) to be drowned."
tr.203: "And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned."

44.ar: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
44.en: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
44.tl: kam tarakū min jannātin waʿuyūnin

tr.85: Many a garden and spring they left behind,
tr.19: How many were the gardens and the watersprings that they left behind,
tr.22: How many were the gardens and springs they left behind,
tr.203: How many of gardens and springs that they [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people] left behind,

44.ar: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
44.en: And crops and noble sites
44.tl: wazurūʿin wamaqāmin karīmin

tr.85: many a cornfield and noble building,
tr.19: And the cornlands and the goodly sites
tr.22: And corn-fields and noble buildings,
tr.203: And green crops (fields) and goodly places,

44.ar: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَـٰكِهِينَ
44.en: And comfort wherein they were amused.
44.tl: wanaʿmatin kānū fīhā fākihīna

tr.85: many a thing in which they had delighted:
tr.19: And pleasant things wherein they took delight!
tr.22: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
tr.203: And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!

44.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
44.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
44.tl: kadhālika wa-awrathnāhā qawman ākharīna

tr.85: We gave these to another people to inherit.
tr.19: Even so (it was), and We made it an inheritance for other folk;
tr.22: Thus (was their end)! And We made other people inherit (those things)!
tr.203: Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them (i.e. We made the Children of Israel to inherit the kingdom of Egypt).

44.ar: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
44.en: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
44.tl: famā bakat ʿalayhimu l-samāu wal-arḍu wamā kānū munẓarīna

tr.85: Neither heavens nor earth shed a tear for them, nor were they given any time.
tr.19: And the heaven and the earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
tr.22: And neither heaven nor earth shed a tear over them: nor were they given a respite (again).
tr.203: And the heavens and the earth wept not for them, nor were they given a respite.

44.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
44.en: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
44.tl: walaqad najjaynā banī is'rāīla mina l-ʿadhābi l-muhīni

tr.85: We saved the Children of Israel from their degrading suffering
tr.19: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
tr.22: We did deliver aforetime the Children of Israel from humiliating Punishment,
tr.203: And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment:

44.ar: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
44.en: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
44.tl: min fir'ʿawna innahu kāna ʿāliyan mina l-mus'rifīna

tr.85: at the hands of Pharaoh: he was a tyrant who exceeded all bounds.
tr.19: (We delivered them) from Pharaoh. Lo! he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.
tr.22: Inflicted by Pharaoh, for he was arrogant (even) among inordinate transgressors.
tr.203: From Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he was arrogant and was of the Musrifûn (those who transgress beyond bound in spending and other things and commit great sins).

44.ar: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
44.en: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
44.tl: walaqadi ikh'tarnāhum ʿalā ʿil'min ʿalā l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: We chose them knowingly above others:
tr.19: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
tr.22: And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
tr.203: And We chose them (the Children of Israel) above the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn) [during the time of Mûsâ (Moses)] with knowledge,

44.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَـٰٓؤٌا۟ مُّبِينٌ
44.en: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
44.tl: waātaynāhum mina l-āyāti mā fīhi balāon mubīnun

tr.85: We gave them revelations in which there was a clear test.
tr.19: And We gave them portents wherein was a clear trial.
tr.22: And granted them Signs in which there was a manifest trial
tr.203: And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial.

44.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
44.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
44.tl: inna hāulāi layaqūlūna

tr.85: These people here assert,
tr.19: Lo! these, forsooth, are saying:
tr.22: As to these (Quraish), they say forsooth:
tr.203: Verily, these (Quraish) people are saying:

44.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
44.en: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
44.tl: in hiya illā mawtatunā l-ūlā wamā naḥnu bimunsharīna

tr.85: ‘There is nothing beyond our one death: we will not be resurrected.
tr.19: There is naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
tr.22: "There is nothing beyond our first death, and we shall not be raised again.
tr.203: "There is nothing but our first death, and we shall not be resurrected.

44.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
44.en: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
44.tl: fatū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna

tr.85: Bring back our forefathers, if what you say is true.’
tr.19: Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth!
tr.22: "Then bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
tr.203: "Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth!"

44.ar: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
44.en: Are they better or the people of Tubbaʿ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
44.tl: ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaʿin wa-alladhīna min qablihim ahlaknāhum innahum kānū muj'rimīna

tr.85: Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who flourished before them? We destroyed them all- they were guilty.
tr.19: Are they better, or the folk of Tubb'a and those before them? We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty.
tr.22: What! Are they better than the people of Tubba and those who were before them? We destroyed them because they were guilty of sin.
tr.203: Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those before them? We destroyed them because they were indeed Mujrimûn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals).

44.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
44.en: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
44.tl: wamā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā lāʿibīna

tr.85: We were not playing a pointless game when We created the heavens and earth and everything in between;
tr.19: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in play.
tr.22: We created not the heavens, the earth, and all between them, merely in (idle) sport:
tr.203: And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, for mere play.

44.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
44.en: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
44.tl: mā khalaqnāhumā illā bil-ḥaqi walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna

tr.85: We created them for a true purpose, but most people do not comprehend.
tr.19: We created them not save with truth; but most of them know not.
tr.22: We created them not except for just ends: but most of them do not understand.
tr.203: We created them not except with truth (i.e. to examine and test those who are obedient and those who are disobedient and then reward the obedient ones and punish the disobedient ones), but most of them know not.

44.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَـٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
44.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
44.tl: inna yawma l-faṣli mīqātuhum ajmaʿīna

tr.85: The Day of Decision is the time appointed for all;
tr.19: Assuredly the Day of Decision is the term for all of them,
tr.22: Verily the Day of sorting out is the time appointed for all of them,-
tr.203: Verily, the Day of Judgement (when Allâh will judge between the creatures) is the time appointed for all of them -

44.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
44.en: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
44.tl: yawma lā yugh'nī mawlan ʿan mawlan shayan walā hum yunṣarūna

tr.85: a Day when no friend can take another’s place.
tr.19: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
tr.22: The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
tr.203: The Day when a Maulâ (a near relative) cannot avail a Maulâ (a near relative) in aught, and no help can they receive,

44.ar: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
44.en: Except those [believers] on whom Allāh has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
44.tl: illā man raḥima l-lahu innahu huwa l-ʿazīzu l-raḥīmu

tr.85: No one will receive any help except for those to whom God shows mercy: He is the Mighty, the Merciful Lord.
tr.19: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
tr.22: Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
tr.203: Except him on whom Allâh has Mercy. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.

44.ar: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
44.en: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
44.tl: inna shajarata l-zaqūmi

tr.85: The tree of Zaqqum
tr.19: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,
tr.22: Verily the tree of Zaqqum
tr.203: Verily, the tree of Zaqqûm

44.ar: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
44.en: Is food for the sinful.
44.tl: ṭaʿāmu l-athīmi

tr.85: will be food for the sinners:
tr.19: The food of the sinner!
tr.22: Will be the food of the Sinful,-
tr.203: Will be the food of the sinners.

44.ar: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
44.en: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
44.tl: kal-muh'li yaghlī fī l-buṭūni

tr.85: [hot] as molten metal, it boils in their bellies
tr.19: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
tr.22: Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
tr.203: Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies,

44.ar: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
44.en: Like the boiling of scalding water.
44.tl: kaghalyi l-ḥamīmi

tr.85: like seething water.
tr.19: As the seething of boiling water.
tr.22: Like the boiling of scalding water.
tr.203: Like the boiling of scalding water.

44.ar: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
44.en: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
44.tl: khudhūhu fa-iʿ'tilūhu ilā sawāi l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: ‘Take him! Thrust him into the depths of Hell!
tr.19: (And it will be said): Take him and drag him to the midst of hell,
tr.22: (A voice will cry: "Seize ye him and drag him into the midst of the Blazing Fire!
tr.203: (It will be said) "Seize him and drag him into the midst of blazing Fire,

44.ar: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
44.en: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
44.tl: thumma ṣubbū fawqa rasihi min ʿadhābi l-ḥamīmi

tr.85: Pour scalding water over his head as punishment!’
tr.19: Then pour upon his head the torment of boiling water.
tr.22: "Then pour over his head the Penalty of Boiling Water,
tr.203: "Then pour over his head the torment of boiling water.

44.ar: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
44.en: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
44.tl: dhuq innaka anta l-ʿazīzu l-karīmu

tr.85: ‘Taste this, you powerful, respected man!
tr.19: (Saying): Taste! Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty, the noble!
tr.22: "Taste thou (this)! Truly wast thou mighty, full of honour!
tr.203: "Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous!

44.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
44.en: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
44.tl: inna hādhā mā kuntum bihi tamtarūna

tr.85: This is what you doubted.’
tr.19: Lo! this is that whereof ye used to doubt.
tr.22: "Truly this is what ye used to doubt!"
tr.203: "Verily, this is that whereof you used to doubt!"

44.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ
44.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
44.tl: inna l-mutaqīna fī maqāmin amīnin

tr.85: But those mindful of God will be in a safe place
tr.19: Lo! those who kept their duty will be in a place secured.
tr.22: As to the Righteous (they will be) in a position of Security,
tr.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), will be in place of Security (Paradise).

44.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
44.en: Within gardens and springs,
44.tl: fī jannātin waʿuyūnin

tr.85: amid Gardens and springs,
tr.19: Amid gardens and watersprings,
tr.22: Among Gardens and Springs;
tr.203: Among Gardens and Springs,

44.ar: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
44.en: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
44.tl: yalbasūna min sundusin wa-is'tabraqin mutaqābilīna

tr.85: clothed in silk and fine brocade, facing one another:
tr.19: Attired in silk and silk embroidery, facing one another.
tr.22: Dressed in fine silk and in rich brocade, they will face each other;
tr.203: Dressed in fine silk and (also) in thick silk, facing each other,

44.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
44.en: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
44.tl: kadhālika wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin

tr.85: so it will be. We shall wed them to maidens with large, dark eyes.
tr.19: Even so (it will be). And We shall wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
tr.22: So; and We shall join them to fair women with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes.
tr.203: So (it will be). And We shall marry them to Hûr (fair female) with wide, lovely eyes.

44.ar: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
44.en: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
44.tl: yadʿūna fīhā bikulli fākihatin āminīna

tr.85: Secure and contented, they will call for every kind of fruit.
tr.19: They call therein for every fruit in safety.
tr.22: There can they call for every kind of fruit in peace and security;
tr.203: They will call therein for every kind of fruit in peace and security;

44.ar: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
44.en: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
44.tl: lā yadhūqūna fīhā l-mawta illā l-mawtata l-ūlā wawaqāhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: After the one death they will taste death no more. God will guard them from the torment of Hell,
tr.19: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
tr.22: Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
tr.203: They will never taste death therein except the first death (of this world), and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,

44.ar: فَضْلًا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
44.en: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
44.tl: faḍlan min rabbika dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu

tr.85: a bounty from your Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
tr.19: A bounty from thy Lord. That is the supreme triumph.
tr.22: As a Bounty from thy Lord! that will be the supreme achievement!
tr.203: As a Bounty from your Lord! That will be the supreme success!

44.ar: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَـٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
44.en: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
44.tl: fa-innamā yassarnāhu bilisānika laʿallahum yatadhakkarūna

tr.85: We have made this Quran easy to understand- in your own language [Prophet]- so that they may take heed.
tr.19: And We have made (this Scripture) easy in thy language only that they may heed.
tr.22: Verily, We have made this (Qur'an) easy, in thy tongue, in order that they may give heed.
tr.203: Certainly, We have made this (Qur’an) easy in your tongue, in order that they may remember.

44.ar: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
44.en: So watch, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
44.tl: fa-ir'taqib innahum mur'taqibūna

tr.85: So wait; the disbelievers too are waiting.
tr.19: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
tr.22: So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
tr.203: Wait then (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم); verily, they (too) are waiting.

45.ar: حمٓ
45.en: Ḥā, Meem.
45.tl: hha-meem

tr.85: Ha Mim
tr.19: Ha. Mim.
tr.22: Ha-Mim.
tr.203: Hâ-Mîm.

45.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
45.en: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
45.tl: tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi

tr.85: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.19: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah, the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.22: The revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
tr.203: The revelation of the Book (this Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

45.ar: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
45.en: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
45.tl: inna fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi laāyātin lil'mu'minīna

tr.85: There are signs in the heavens and the earth for those who believe:
tr.19: Lo! in the heavens and the earth are portents for believers.
tr.22: Verily in the heavens and the earth, are Signs for those who believe.
tr.203: Verily, in the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers.

45.ar: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
45.en: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
45.tl: wafī khalqikum wamā yabuthu min dābbatin āyātun liqawmin yūqinūna

tr.85: in the creation of you, in the creatures God scattered on earth, there are signs for people of sure faith;
tr.19: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.
tr.22: And in the creation of yourselves and the fact that animals are scattered (through the earth), are Signs for those of assured Faith.
tr.203: And in your creation, and what He scattered (through the earth) of moving (living) creatures are signs for people who have Faith with certainty.

45.ar: وَٱخْتِلَـٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَـٰحِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
45.en: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
45.tl: wa-ikh'tilāfi al-layli wal-nahāri wamā anzala l-lahu mina l-samāi min riz'qin fa-aḥyā bihi l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā wataṣrīfi l-riyāḥi āyātun liqawmin yaʿqilūna

tr.85: in the alternation of night and day, in the rain God provides, sending it down from the sky and reviving the dead earth with it, and in His shifting of the winds there are signs for those who use their reason.
tr.19: And the difference of night and day and the provision that Allah sendeth down from the sky and thereby quickeneth the earth after her death, and the ordering of the winds, are portents for a people who have sense.
tr.22: And in the alternation of Night and Day, and the fact that Allah sends down Sustenance from the sky, and revives therewith the earth after its death, and in the change of the winds,- are Signs for those that are wise.
tr.203: And in the alternation of night and day, and the provision (rain) that Allâh sends down from the sky, and revives therewith the earth after its death, and in the turning about of the winds (i.e. sometimes towards the east or north, and sometimes towards the south or west sometimes bringing glad tidings of rain etc., and sometimes bringing the torment), are signs for a people who understand.

45.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
45.en: These are the verses of Allāh which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allāh and His verses will they believe?
45.tl: til'ka āyātu l-lahi natlūhā ʿalayka bil-ḥaqi fabi-ayyi ḥadīthin baʿda l-lahi waāyātihi yu'minūna

tr.85: These are God’s signs that We recount to you [Prophet, to show] the Truth. If they deny God and His revelations, what message will they believe in?
tr.19: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth. Then in what fact, after Allah and His portents, will they believe?
tr.22: Such are the Signs of Allah, which We rehearse to thee in Truth; then in what exposition will they believe after (rejecting) Allah and His Signs?
tr.203: These are the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, revelations, etc.) of Allâh, which We recite to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) with truth. Then in which speech after Allâh and His Ayât will they believe?

45.ar: وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
45.en: Woe to every sinful liar
45.tl: waylun likulli affākin athīmin

tr.85: Woe to every lying sinful person
tr.19: Woe unto each sinful liar,
tr.22: Woe to each sinful dealer in Falsehoods:
tr.203: Woe to every sinful liar

45.ar: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
45.en: Who hears the verses of Allāh recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
45.tl: yasmaʿu āyāti l-lahi tut'lā ʿalayhi thumma yuṣirru mus'takbiran ka-an lam yasmaʿhā fabashir'hu biʿadhābin alīmin

tr.85: who hears God’s revelations being recited to him, yet persists in his arrogance as if he had never heard them––[Prophet] bring him news of a painful torment!––
tr.19: Who heareth the revelations of Allah recited unto him, and then continueth in pride as though he heard them not. Give him tidings of a painful doom.
tr.22: He hears the Signs of Allah rehearsed to him, yet is obstinate and lofty, as if he had not heard them: then announce to him a Penalty Grievous!
tr.203: Who hears the Verses of Allâh (being) recited to him, yet persists with pride as if he heard them not. So announce to him a painful torment!

45.ar: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
45.en: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
45.tl: wa-idhā ʿalima min āyātinā shayan ittakhadhahā huzuwan ulāika lahum ʿadhābun muhīnun

tr.85: who, if he knows anything about Our revelations, ridicules it! Such people will have a humiliating torment:
tr.19: And when he knoweth aught of Our revelations he maketh it a jest. For such there is a shameful doom.
tr.22: And when he learns something of Our Signs, he takes them in jest: for such there will be a humiliating Penalty.
tr.203: And when he learns something of Our Verses (this Qur’ân), he makes them a jest. For such there will be a humiliating torment.

45.ar: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
45.en: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allāh as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
45.tl: min warāihim jahannamu walā yugh'nī ʿanhum mā kasabū shayan walā mā ittakhadhū min dūni l-lahi awliyāa walahum ʿadhābun ʿaẓīmun

tr.85: Hell lurks behind them and their gains will not benefit them, nor will those beings they took as protectors beside God––a tremendous torment awaits them.
tr.19: Beyond them there is hell, and that which they have earned will naught avail them, nor those whom they have chosen for protecting friends beside Allah. Theirs will be an awful doom.
tr.22: In front of them is Hell: and of no profit to them is anything they may have earned, nor any protectors they may have taken to themselves besides Allah: for them is a tremendous Penalty.
tr.203: In front of them there is Hell. And that which they have earned will be of no profit to them, nor (will be of any profit to them) those whom they have taken as Auliyâ’ (protectors, helpers) besides Allâh. And theirs will be a great torment.

45.ar: هَـٰذَا هُدًى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
45.en: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
45.tl: hādhā hudan wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyāti rabbihim lahum ʿadhābun min rij'zin alīmun

tr.85: This is true guidance; those who reject their Lord’s revelations will have a woeful torment.
tr.19: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.
tr.22: This is (true) Guidance and for those who reject the Signs of their Lord, is a grievous Penalty of abomination.
tr.203: This (Qur’an) is a guidance. And those who disbelieve in the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations) of their Lord, for them there is a painful torment of Rijz (a severe kind of punishment).

45.ar: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
45.en: It is Allāh who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
45.tl: al-lahu alladhī sakhara lakumu l-baḥra litajriya l-ful'ku fīhi bi-amrihi walitabtaghū min faḍlihi walaʿallakum tashkurūna

tr.85: It is God who subjected the sea for you––ships sail on it by His command so that you can seek His bounty and give Him thanks––
tr.19: Allah it is Who hath made the sea of service unto you that the ships may run thereon by His command, and that ye may seek of His bounty, and that haply ye may be thankful;
tr.22: It is Allah Who has subjected the sea to you, that ships may sail through it by His command, that ye may seek of his Bounty, and that ye may be grateful.
tr.203: Allâh, it is He Who has subjected to you the sea, that ships may sail through it by His Command, and that you may seek of His Bounty, and that you may be thankful.

45.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
45.en: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
45.tl: wasakhara lakum mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi jamīʿan min'hu inna fī dhālika laāyātin liqawmin yatafakkarūna

tr.85: He has subjected all that is in the heavens and the earth for your benefit, as a gift from Him. There truly are signs in this for those who reflect.
tr.19: And hath made of service unto you whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; it is all from Him. Lo! herein verily are portents for a people who reflect.
tr.22: And He has subjected to you, as from Him, all that is in the heavens and on earth: Behold, in that are Signs indeed for those who reflect.
tr.203: And has subjected to you all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth; it is all as a favour and kindness from Him. Verily, in it are signs for a people who think deeply.

45.ar: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
45.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allāh [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
45.tl: qul lilladhīna āmanū yaghfirū lilladhīna lā yarjūna ayyāma l-lahi liyajziya qawman bimā kānū yaksibūna

tr.85: Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear God’s days [of punishment]––He will requite people for what they have done.
tr.19: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.
tr.22: Tell those who believe, to forgive those who do not look forward to the Days of Allah: It is for Him to recompense (for good or ill) each People according to what they have earned.
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) to the believers to forgive those who (harm them and) hope not for the Days of Allâh (i.e. His Recompense), that He may recompense people, according to what they have earned (i.e. to punish these disbelievers who harm the believers).

45.ar: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
45.en: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
45.tl: man ʿamila ṣāliḥan falinafsihi waman asāa faʿalayhā thumma ilā rabbikum tur'jaʿūna

tr.85: Whoever does good benefits himself, and whoever does evil harms himself: you will all be returned to your Lord.
tr.19: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.
tr.22: If any one does a righteous deed, it ensures to the benefit of his own soul; if he does evil, it works against (his own soul). In the end will ye (all) be brought back to your Lord.
tr.203: Whosoever does a good deed, it is for his ownself, and whosoever does evil, it is against (his ownself). Then to your Lord you will be made to return.

45.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَـٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَـٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
45.en: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
45.tl: walaqad ātaynā banī is'rāīla l-kitāba wal-ḥuk'ma wal-nubuwata warazaqnāhum mina l-ṭayibāti wafaḍḍalnāhum ʿalā l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: We gave scripture, wisdom, and prophethood to the Children of Israel; We provided them with good things and favoured them above others;
tr.19: And verily we gave the Children of Israel the Scripture and the Command and the Prophethood, and provided them with good things and favoured them above (all) peoples;
tr.22: We did aforetime grant to the Children of Israel the Book the Power of Command, and Prophethood; We gave them, for Sustenance, things good and pure; and We favoured them above the nations.
tr.203: And indeed We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, and the understanding of the Scripture and its laws, and the Prophethood; and provided them with good things, and preferred them above the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn of their time, during that period),

45.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُم بَيِّنَـٰتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
45.en: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
45.tl: waātaynāhum bayyinātin mina l-amri famā ikh'talafū illā min baʿdi mā jāahumu l-ʿil'mu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqḍī baynahum yawma l-qiyāmati fīmā kānū fīhi yakhtalifūna

tr.85: We gave them clear proof in matters [of religion]. They differed among themselves out of mutual rivalry, only after knowledge came to them: on the Day of Resurrection your Lord will judge between them regarding their differences.
tr.19: And gave them plain commandments. And they differed not until after the knowledge came unto them, through rivalry among themselves. Lo! thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein they used to differ.
tr.22: And We granted them Clear Signs in affairs (of Religion): it was only after knowledge had been granted to them that they fell into schisms, through insolent envy among themselves. Verily thy Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment as to those matters in which they set up differences.
tr.203: And gave them clear proofs in matters [by revealing to them the Taurât (Torah)]. And they differed not until after the knowledge came to them, through envy among themselves. Verily, Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection about that wherein they used to differ.

45.ar: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
45.en: Then We put you, [O Muḥammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
45.tl: thumma jaʿalnāka ʿalā sharīʿatin mina l-amri fa-ittabiʿ'hā walā tattabiʿ ahwāa alladhīna lā yaʿlamūna

tr.85: Now We have set you [Muhammad] on a clear religious path, so follow it. Do not follow the desires of those who lack [true] knowledge-
tr.19: And now have We set thee (O Muhammad) on a clear road of (Our) commandment; so follow it, and follow not the whims of those who know not.
tr.22: Then We put thee on the (right) Way of Religion: so follow thou that (Way), and follow not the desires of those who know not.
tr.203: Then We have put you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم) on a (plain) way of (Our) commandment [like the one which We commanded Our Messengers before you (i.e. legal ways and laws of the Islâmic Monotheism)]. So follow you that (Islâmic Monotheism and its laws), and follow not the desires of those who know not. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).

45.ar: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
45.en: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allāh at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allāh is the protector of the righteous.
45.tl: innahum lan yugh'nū ʿanka mina l-lahi shayan wa-inna l-ẓālimīna baʿḍuhum awliyāu baʿḍin wal-lahu waliyyu l-mutaqīna

tr.85: they cannot help you against God in any way. Wrongdoers only have each other to protect them; the righteous have God Himself as their protector.
tr.19: Lo! they can avail thee naught against Allah. And lo! as for the wrong-doers, some of them are friends of others; and Allah is the Friend of those who ward off (evil).
tr.22: They will be of no use to thee in the sight of Allah: it is only Wrong-doers (that stand as) protectors, one to another: but Allah is the Protector of the Righteous.
tr.203: Verily, they can avail you nothing against Allâh (if He wants to punish you). Verily, the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers) are Auliyâ’ (protectors, helpers) of one another, but Allâh is the Walî (Helper, Protector) of the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).

45.ar: هَـٰذَا بَصَـٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ
45.en: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
45.tl: hādhā baṣāiru lilnnāsi wahudan waraḥmatun liqawmin yūqinūna

tr.85: This [revelation] is a means of insight for people, a source of guidance and mercy for those of sure faith.
tr.19: This is clear indication for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for a folk whose faith is sure.
tr.22: These are clear evidences to men and a Guidance and Mercy to those of assured Faith.
tr.203: This (Qur’an) is a clear insight and evidence for mankind, and a guidance and a mercy for people who have Faith with certainty.

45.ar: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ سَوَآءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
45.en: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
45.tl: am ḥasiba alladhīna ij'taraḥū l-sayiāti an najʿalahum ka-alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti sawāan maḥyāhum wamamātuhum sāa mā yaḥkumūna

tr.85: Do those who commit evil deeds really think that We will deal with them in the same way as those who believe and do righteous deeds, that they will be alike in their living and their dying? How badly they judge!
tr.19: Or do those who commit ill-deeds suppose that We shall make them as those who believe and do good works, the same in life and death? Bad is their judgment!
tr.22: What! Do those who seek after evil ways think that We shall hold them equal with those who believe and do righteous deeds,- that equal will be their life and their death? Ill is the judgment that they make.
tr.203: Or do those who earn evil deeds think that We shall hold them equal with those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, in their present life and after their death? Worst is the judgement that they make.

45.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
45.en: And Allāh created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
45.tl: wakhalaqa l-lahu l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bil-ḥaqi walituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā kasabat wahum lā yuẓ'lamūna

tr.85: God created the heavens and earth for a true purpose: to reward each soul according to its deeds. They will not be wronged.
tr.19: And Allah hath created the heavens and the earth with truth, and that every soul may be repaid what it hath earned. And they will not be wronged.
tr.22: Allah created the heavens and the earth for just ends, and in order that each soul may find the recompense of what it has earned, and none of them be wronged.
tr.203: And Allâh has created the heavens and the earth with truth, in order that each person may be recompensed what he has earned, and they will not be wronged.

45.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمْعِهِۦ وَقَلْبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَـٰوَةً فَمَن يَهْدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
45.en: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allāh has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allāh? Then will you not be reminded?
45.tl: afara-ayta mani ittakhadha ilāhahu hawāhu wa-aḍallahu l-lahu ʿalā ʿil'min wakhatama ʿalā samʿihi waqalbihi wajaʿala ʿalā baṣarihi ghishāwatan faman yahdīhi min baʿdi l-lahi afalā tadhakkarūna

tr.85: [Prophet], consider the one who has taken his own desire as a god, whom God allows to stray in the face of knowledge, sealing his ears and heart and covering his eyes- who can guide such a person after God [has done this]? Will you [people] not take heed?
tr.19: Hast thou seen him who maketh his desire his god, and Allah sendeth him astray purposely, and sealeth up his hearing and his heart, and setteth on his sight a covering? Then who will lead him after Allah (hath condemned him)? Will ye not then heed?
tr.22: Then seest thou such a one as takes as his god his own vain desire? Allah has, knowing (him as such), left him astray, and sealed his hearing and his heart (and understanding), and put a cover on his sight. Who, then, will guide him after Allah (has withdrawn Guidance)? Will ye not then receive admonition?
tr.203: Have you seen him who takes his own lust (vain desires) as his ilâh (god)? And Allâh knowing (him as such), left him astray, and sealed his hearing and his heart, and put a cover on his sight. Who then will guide him after Allâh? Will you not then remember?

45.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهْرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
45.en: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
45.tl: waqālū mā hiya illā ḥayātunā l-dun'yā namūtu wanaḥyā wamā yuh'likunā illā l-dahru wamā lahum bidhālika min ʿil'min in hum illā yaẓunnūna

tr.85: They say, ‘There is only our life in this world: we die, we live, nothing but time destroys us.’ They have no knowledge of this; they only follow guesswork. Their only argument,
tr.19: And they say: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and naught destroyeth us save time; when they have no knowledge whatsoever of (all) that; they do but guess.
tr.22: And they say: "What is there but our life in this world? We shall die and we live, and nothing but time can destroy us." But of that they have no knowledge: they merely conjecture:
tr.203: And they say: "There is nothing but our life of this world, we die and we live and nothing destroys us except Ad-Dahr (time). And they have no knowledge of it: they only conjecture.

45.ar: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتُنَا بَيِّنَـٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ ٱئْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
45.en: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
45.tl: wa-idhā tut'lā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin mā kāna ḥujjatahum illā an qālū i'tū biābāinā in kuntum ṣādiqīna

tr.85: when Our clear revelations are recited to them, is to say, ‘Bring back our forefathers if what you say is true.’
tr.19: And when Our clear revelations are recited unto them their only argument is that they say: Bring (back) our fathers. then, if ye are truthful.
tr.22: And when Our Clear Signs are rehearsed to them their argument is nothing but this: They say, "Bring (back) our forefathers, if what ye say is true!"
tr.203: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, their argument is no other than that they say: "Bring back our (dead) fathers, if you are truthful!"

45.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحْيِيكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
45.en: Say, "Allāh causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
45.tl: quli l-lahu yuḥ'yīkum thumma yumītukum thumma yajmaʿukum ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati lā rayba fīhi walākinna akthara l-nāsi lā yaʿlamūna

tr.85: [Prophet], say, ‘It is God who gives you life, then causes you to die, and then He gathers you all to the Day of Resurrection of which there is no doubt, though most people do not comprehend.’
tr.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Allah giveth life to you, then causeth you to die, then gathereth you unto the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not.
tr.22: Say: "It is Allah Who gives you life, then gives you death; then He will gather you together for the Day of Judgment about which there is no doubt": But most men do not understand.
tr.203: Say (to them): "Allâh gives you life, then causes you to die, then He will assemble you on the Day of Resurrection about which there is no doubt. But most of mankind know not."

45.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَخْسَرُ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
45.en: And to Allāh belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
45.tl: walillahi mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wayawma taqūmu l-sāʿatu yawma-idhin yakhsaru l-mub'ṭilūna

tr.85: Control of everything in the heavens and the earth belongs to God. When the Hour comes, those who follow falsehood will be the losers on that Day.
tr.19: And unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and on the day when the Hour riseth, on that day those who follow falsehood will be lost.
tr.22: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and the Day that the Hour of Judgment is established,- that Day will the dealers in Falsehood perish!
tr.203: And to Allâh belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And on the Day that the Hour will be established - on that Day the followers of falsehood (polytheists, disbelievers, worshippers of false deities) shall lose (everything).

45.ar: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍ تُدْعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
45.en: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
45.tl: watarā kulla ummatin jāthiyatan kullu ummatin tud'ʿā ilā kitābihā l-yawma tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: You will see every community kneeling. Every community will be summoned to its record: ‘Today you will be repaid for what you did.
tr.19: And thou wilt see each nation crouching, each nation summoned to its record. (And it will be said unto them): This day ye are requited what ye used to do.
tr.22: And thou wilt see every sect bowing the knee: Every sect will be called to its Record: "This Day shall ye be recompensed for all that ye did!
tr.203: And you will see each nation humbled to their knees (kneeling): each nation will be called to its Record (of deeds). This Day you shall be recompensed for what you used to do.

45.ar: هَـٰذَا كِتَـٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيْكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
45.en: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
45.tl: hādhā kitābunā yanṭiqu ʿalaykum bil-ḥaqi innā kunnā nastansikhu mā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: Here is Our record that tells the truth about you: We have been recording everything you do.’
tr.19: This Our Book pronounceth against you with truth. Lo! We have caused (all) that ye did to be recorded.
tr.22: "This Our Record speaks about you with truth: For We were wont to put on Record all that ye did."
tr.203: This Our Record speaks about you with truth. Verily, We were recording what you used to do (i.e. Our angels used to record your deeds).

45.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
45.en: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
45.tl: fa-ammā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti fayud'khiluhum rabbuhum fī raḥmatihi dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-mubīnu

tr.85: Those who believed and did good deeds will be admitted by their Lord into His mercy- that is the clearest triumph-
tr.19: Then, as for those who believed and did good works, their Lord will bring them in unto His mercy. That is the evident triumph.
tr.22: Then, as to those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them to His Mercy that will be the achievement for all to see.
tr.203: Then, as for those who believed (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and did righteous good deeds, their Lord will admit them to His Mercy. That will be the evident success.

45.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَٱسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِينَ
45.en: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a criminal people?
45.tl: wa-ammā alladhīna kafarū afalam takun āyātī tut'lā ʿalaykum fa-is'takbartum wakuntum qawman muj'rimīna

tr.85: but those who disbelieved [will be asked]: ‘When My revelations were recited to you, were you not arrogant and persistent in wicked deeds?
tr.19: And as for those who disbelieved (it will be said unto them): Were not Our revelations recited unto you? But ye were scornful and became a guilty folk.
tr.22: But as to those who rejected Allah, (to them will be said): "Were not Our Signs rehearsed to you? But ye were arrogant, and were a people given to sin!
tr.203: But as for those who disbelieved (it will be said to them): "Were not Our Verses recited to you? But you were proud, and you were a people who were Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals)."

45.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهَا قُلْتُم مَّا نَدْرِى مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنًّا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِينَ
45.en: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"
45.tl: wa-idhā qīla inna waʿda l-lahi ḥaqqun wal-sāʿatu lā rayba fīhā qul'tum mā nadrī mā l-sāʿatu in naẓunnu illā ẓannan wamā naḥnu bimus'tayqinīna

tr.85: When it was said to you, “God’s promise is true: there is no doubt about the Hour,” did you not reply, “We know nothing of the Hour. This is only conjecture in our opinion. We are not convinced”?’
tr.19: And when it was said: Lo! Allah's promise is the truth, and there is no doubt of the Hour's coming, ye said: We know not what the Hour is. We deem it naught but a conjecture, and we are by no means convinced.
tr.22: "And when it was said that the promise of Allah was true, and that the Hour- there was no doubt about its (coming), ye used to say, 'We know not what is the hour: we only think it is an idea, and we have no firm assurance.'"
tr.203: And when it was said: "Verily, Allâh’s Promise is the truth, and there is no doubt about the coming of the Hour," you said: "We know not what is the Hour: we do not think it but as a conjecture, and we have no firm convincing belief (therein)."

45.ar: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
45.en: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
45.tl: wabadā lahum sayyiātu mā ʿamilū waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihi yastahziūna

tr.85: The evil of their actions will [then] become clear to them. The punishment they mocked will engulf them.
tr.19: And the evils of what they did will appear unto them, and that which they used to deride will befall them.
tr.22: Then will appear to them the evil (fruits) of what they did, and they will be completely encircled by that which they used to mock at!
tr.203: And the evil of what they did will appear to them, and that which they used to mock at will completely encircle them.

45.ar: وَقِيلَ ٱلْيَوْمَ نَنسَىٰكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَا وَمَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
45.en: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
45.tl: waqīla l-yawma nansākum kamā nasītum liqāa yawmikum hādhā wamawākumu l-nāru wamā lakum min nāṣirīna

tr.85: It will be said, ‘Today We shall ignore you just as you ignored your appointment with this Day. The Fire will be your home and no one will help you,
tr.19: And it will be said: This day We forget you, even as ye forgot the meeting of this your day; and your habitation is the Fire, and there is none to help you.
tr.22: It will also be said: "This Day We will forget you as ye forgot the meeting of this Day of yours! and your abode is the Fire, and no helpers have ye!
tr.203: And it will be said: "This Day We will forget you as you forgot the Meeting of this Day of yours. And your abode is the Fire, and there is none to help you."

45.ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذْتُمْ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوًا وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُونَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
45.en: That is because you took the verses of Allāh in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
45.tl: dhālikum bi-annakumu ittakhadhtum āyāti l-lahi huzuwan wagharratkumu l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā fal-yawma lā yukh'rajūna min'hā walā hum yus'taʿtabūna

tr.85: because you received God’s revelations with ridicule and were deceived by worldly life.’ They will not be brought out of the Fire on that Day, nor will they be given the chance to make amends.
tr.19: This, forasmuch as ye made the revelations of Allah a jest, and the life of the world beguiled you. Therefor this day they come not forth from thence, nor can they make amends.
tr.22: "This, because ye used to take the Signs of Allah in jest, and the life of the world deceived you:" (From) that Day, therefore, they shall not be taken out thence, nor shall they be received into Grace.
tr.203: This, because you took the revelations of Allâh (this Qur’ân) in mockery, and the life of the world deceived you. So this Day, they shall not be taken out from there (Hell), nor shall they be returned to the worldly life, (so that they repent to Allâh, and beg His Pardon for their sins).

45.ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْحَمْدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
45.en: Then, to Allāh belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
45.tl: falillahi l-ḥamdu rabbi l-samāwāti warabbi l-arḍi rabbi l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: So praise be to God, Lord of the heavens and earth, Lord of the worlds.
tr.19: Then praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: Then Praise be to Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth,- Lord and Cherisher of all the Worlds!
tr.203: So all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, and the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

45.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْكِبْرِيَآءُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
45.en: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
45.tl: walahu l-kib'riyāu fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu

tr.85: True greatness in the heavens and the earth is rightfully His: He is the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.19: And unto Him (alone) belongeth Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.22: To Him be glory throughout the heavens and the earth: and He is Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom!
tr.203: And His (Alone) is the Majesty in the heavens and the earth, and He is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

46.ar: حمٓ
46.en: Ḥā, Meem.
46.tl: hha-meem

tr.85: Ha Mim
tr.19: Ha. Mim.
tr.22: Ha-Mim.
tr.203: Hâ-Mîm.

46.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
46.en: The revelation of the Book is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
46.tl: tanzīlu l-kitābi mina l-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥakīmi

tr.85: This Scripture is sent down from God, the Almighty, the Wise.
tr.19: The revelation of the Scripture is from Allah the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.22: The Revelation of the Book is from Allah the Exalted in Power, Full of Wisdom.
tr.203: The revelation of the Book (this Qur’ân) is from Allâh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.

46.ar: مَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ عَمَّآ أُنذِرُوا۟ مُعْرِضُونَ
46.en: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
46.tl: mā khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā illā bil-ḥaqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-alladhīna kafarū ʿammā undhirū muʿ'riḍūna

tr.85: It was for a true purpose and a specific term that We created heaven and earth and everything in between, yet those who deny the truth ignore the warning they have been given.
tr.19: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with truth, and for a term appointed. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.
tr.22: We created not the heavens and the earth and all between them but for just ends, and for a Term Appointed: But those who reject Faith turn away from that whereof they are warned.
tr.203: We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and for an appointed term. But those who disbelieve turn away from that whereof they are warned.

46.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَرُونِى مَاذَا خَلَقُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ لَهُمْ شِرْكٌ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ۖ ٱئْتُونِى بِكِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ هَـٰذَآ أَوْ أَثَـٰرَةٍ مِّنْ عِلْمٍ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
46.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered that which you invoke besides Allāh? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a scripture [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful."
46.tl: qul ara-aytum mā tadʿūna min dūni l-lahi arūnī mādhā khalaqū mina l-arḍi am lahum shir'kun fī l-samāwāti i'tūnī bikitābin min qabli hādhā aw athāratin min ʿil'min in kuntum ṣādiqīna

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Consider those you pray to other than God: show me which part of the earth they created or which share of the heavens they own; bring me a previous scripture or some vestige of divine knowledge––if what you say is true.’
tr.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Have ye thought on all that ye invoke beside Allah? Show me what they have created of the earth. Or have they any portion in the heavens? Bring me a scripture before this (Scripture), or some vestige of knowledge (in support of what ye say), if ye are truthful.
tr.22: Say: "Do ye see what it is ye invoke besides Allah? Show me what it is they have created on earth, or have they a share in the heavens bring me a book (revealed) before this, or any remnant of knowledge (ye may have), if ye are telling the truth!
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to these pagans): "Think you about all that you invoke besides Allâh? Show me. What have they created of the earth? Or have they a share in (the creation of) the heavens? Bring me a Book (revealed before this), or some trace of knowledge (in support of your claims), if you are truthful!"

46.ar: وَمَنْ أَضَلُّ مِمَّن يَدْعُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَن لَّا يَسْتَجِيبُ لَهُۥٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَهُمْ عَن دُعَآئِهِمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
46.en: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides Allāh those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
46.tl: waman aḍallu mimman yadʿū min dūni l-lahi man lā yastajību lahu ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati wahum ʿan duʿāihim ghāfilūna
