tr.19: Nay, but they marvel that a warner of their own hath come unto them; and the disbelievers say: This is a strange thing:
tr.22: But they wonder that there has come to them a Warner from among themselves. So the Unbelievers say: "This is a wonderful thing!
tr.203: Nay, they wonder that there has come to them a warner (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from among themselves. So the disbelievers say: "This is a strange thing!

50.ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
50.en: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
50.tl: a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban dhālika rajʿun baʿīdun

tr.85: To come back [to life] after we have died and become dust? That is too farfetched.’
tr.19: When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be brought back again)? That would be a far return!
tr.22: "What! When we die and become dust, (shall we live again?) That is a (sort of) return far (from our understanding)."
tr.203: "When we are dead and have become dust (shall we be resurrected?) That is a far return."

50.ar: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَـٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
50.en: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
50.tl: qad ʿalim'nā mā tanquṣu l-arḍu min'hum waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓun

tr.85: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We keep a comprehensive record.
tr.19: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
tr.22: We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
tr.203: We know that which the earth takes of them (their dead bodies), and with Us is a Book preserved (i.e. the Book of Decrees).

50.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
50.en: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
50.tl: bal kadhabū bil-ḥaqi lammā jāahum fahum fī amrin marījin

tr.85: But the disbelievers deny the truth when it comes to them; they are in a state of confusion.
tr.19: Nay, but they have denied the truth when it came unto them, therefor they are now in troubled case.
tr.22: But they deny the Truth when it comes to them: so they are in a confused state.
tr.203: Nay, but they have denied the truth (this Qur’ân) when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state (cannot differentiate between right and wrong).

50.ar: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
50.en: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
50.tl: afalam yanẓurū ilā l-samāi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūjin

tr.85: Do they not see the sky above them––how We have built and adorned it, with no rifts in it;
tr.19: Have they not then observed the sky above them, how We have constructed it and beautified it, and how there are no rifts therein?
tr.22: Do they not look at the sky above them?- How We have made it and adorned it, and there are no flaws in it?
tr.203: Have they not looked at the heaven above them, how We have made it and adorned it, and there are no rifts in it?

50.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
50.en: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
50.tl: wal-arḍa madadnāhā wa-alqaynā fīhā rawāsiya wa-anbatnā fīhā min kulli zawjin bahījin

tr.85: how We spread out the earth and put solid mountains on it, and caused every kind of joyous plant to grow in it,
tr.19: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
tr.22: And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
tr.203: And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and have produced therein every kind of lovely growth (plants).

50.ar: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
50.en: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
50.tl: tabṣiratan wadhik'rā likulli ʿabdin munībin

tr.85: as a lesson and reminder for every servant who turns to God;
tr.19: A vision and a reminder for every penitent slave.
tr.22: To be observed and commemorated by every devotee turning (to Allah).
tr.203: An insight and a Reminder for every slave who turns to Allâh in repentance (i.e. the one who believes in the Oneness of Allâh and performs deeds of His obedience, and always begs His pardon).

50.ar: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَـٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
50.en: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
50.tl: wanazzalnā mina l-samāi māan mubārakan fa-anbatnā bihi jannātin waḥabba l-ḥaṣīdi

tr.85: and how We send blessed water down from the sky and grow with it gardens, the harvest grain,
tr.19: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
tr.22: And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
tr.203: And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith gardens and grain (every kind of harvests) that are reaped.

50.ar: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَـٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
50.en: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
50.tl: wal-nakhla bāsiqātin lahā ṭalʿun naḍīdun

tr.85: and tall palm trees laden with clusters of dates,
tr.19: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
tr.22: And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
tr.203: And tall date-palms, with ranged clusters.

50.ar: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
50.en: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
50.tl: riz'qan lil'ʿibādi wa-aḥyaynā bihi baldatan maytan kadhālika l-khurūju

tr.85: as a provision for everyone; how with water We give [new] life to a land that is dead? This is how the dead will emerge [from their graves].
tr.19: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
tr.22: As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
tr.203: A provision for (Allâh’s) slaves. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the resurrection (of the dead).

50.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
50.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
50.tl: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin wa-aṣḥābu l-rasi wathamūdu

tr.85: The people of Noah disbelieved long before these disbelievers, as did the people of Rass, Thamud,
tr.19: The folk of Noah denied (the truth) before them, and (so did) the dwellers at Ar-Rass and (the tribe of) Thamud,
tr.22: Before them was denied (the Hereafter) by the People of Noah, the Companions of the Rass, the Thamud,
tr.203: Denied before them (i.e. these pagans of Makkah) the people of Nûh (Noah), and the dwellers of Rass, and Thamûd;

50.ar: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
50.en: And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
50.tl: waʿādun wafir'ʿawnu wa-ikh'wānu lūṭin

tr.85: Ad, Pharaoh, Lot,
tr.19: And (the tribe of) A'ad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot,
tr.22: The 'Ad, Pharaoh, the brethren of Lut,
tr.203: And ‘Âd, and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and the brethren of Lût (Lot);

50.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
50.en: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
50.tl: wa-aṣḥābu l-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿin kullun kadhaba l-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīdi

tr.85: the Forest-Dwellers, Tubba: all of these people disbelieved their messengers, and so My warning was realized.
tr.19: And the dwellers in the wood, and the folk of Tubb'a: every one denied their messengers, therefor My threat took effect.
tr.22: The Companions of the Wood, and the People of Tubba'; each one (of them) rejected the messengers, and My warning was duly fulfilled (in them).
tr.203: And the Dwellers of the Wood, and the people of Tubba‘. Everyone of them denied (their) Messengers, so My Threat took effect.

50.ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
50.en: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
50.tl: afaʿayīnā bil-khalqi l-awali bal hum fī labsin min khalqin jadīdin

tr.85: So were We incapable of the first creation? No indeed! Yet they doubt a second creation.
tr.19: Were We then worn out by the first creation? Yet they are in doubt about a new creation.
tr.22: Were We then weary with the first Creation, that they should be in confused doubt about a new Creation?
tr.203: Were We then tired with the first creation? Nay, they are in confused doubt about a new creation (i.e. Resurrection).

50.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
50.en: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein.
50.tl: walaqad khalaqnā l-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥabli l-warīdi

tr.85: We created man––We know what his soul whispers to him: We are closer to him than his jugular vein––
tr.19: We verily created man and We know what his soul whispereth to him, and We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
tr.22: It was We Who created man, and We know what dark suggestions his soul makes to him: for We are nearer to him than (his) jugular vein.
tr.203: And indeed We have created man, and We know what his ownself whispers to him. And We are nearer to him than his jugular vein (by Our Knowledge).

50.ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
50.en: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
50.tl: idh yatalaqqā l-mutalaqiyāni ʿani l-yamīni waʿani l-shimāli qaʿīdun

tr.85: with two receptors set to record, one on his right side and one on his left:
tr.19: When the two Receivers receive (him), seated on the right hand and on the left,
tr.22: Behold, two (guardian angels) appointed to learn (his doings) learn (and noted them), one sitting on the right and one on the left.
tr.203: (Remember) that the two receivers (recording angels) receive (each human being), one sitting on the right and one on the left (to note his or her actions).

50.ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
50.en: He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
50.tl: mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīdun

tr.85: he does not utter a single word without an ever-present watcher.
tr.19: He uttereth no word but there is with him an observer ready.
tr.22: Not a word does he utter but there is a sentinel by him, ready (to note it).
tr.203: Not a word does he (or she) utter but there is a watcher by him ready (to record it).

50.ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
50.en: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
50.tl: wajāat sakratu l-mawti bil-ḥaqi dhālika mā kunta min'hu taḥīdu

tr.85: The trance of death will bring the Truth with it: ‘This is what you tried to escape.’
tr.19: And the agony of death cometh in truth. (And it is said unto him): This is that which thou wast wont to shun.
tr.22: And the stupor of death will bring Truth (before his eyes): "This was the thing which thou wast trying to escape!"
tr.203: And the stupor of death will come in truth: "This is what you have been avoiding!"

50.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
50.en: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
50.tl: wanufikha fī l-ṣūri dhālika yawmu l-waʿīdi

tr.85: The Trumpet will be sounded: ‘This is the Day [you were] warned of.’
tr.19: And the trumpet is blown. This is the threatened Day.
tr.22: And the Trumpet shall be blown: that will be the Day whereof Warning (had been given).
tr.203: And the Trumpet will be blown - that will be the Day whereof warning (had been given) (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

50.ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
50.en: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
50.tl: wajāat kullu nafsin maʿahā sāiqun washahīdun

tr.85: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness:
tr.19: And every soul cometh, along with it a driver and a witness.
tr.22: And there will come forth every soul: with each will be an (angel) to drive, and an (angel) to bear witness.
tr.203: And every person will come forth along with an (angel) to drive (him) and an (angel) to bear witness.

50.ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
50.en: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
50.tl: laqad kunta fī ghaflatin min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāaka fabaṣaruka l-yawma ḥadīdun

tr.85: ‘You paid no attention to this [Day]; but today We have removed your veil and your sight is sharp.’
tr.19: (And unto the evil-doer it is said): Thou wast in heedlessness of this. Now We have removed from thee thy covering, and piercing is thy sight this day.
tr.22: (It will be said:) "Thou wast heedless of this; now have We removed thy veil, and sharp is thy sight this Day!"
tr.203: (It will be said to the sinners): "Indeed you were heedless of this. Now We have removed from you your covering, and sharp is your sight this Day!"

50.ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَـٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
50.en: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
50.tl: waqāla qarīnuhu hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīdun

tr.85: The person’s attendant will say, ‘Here is what I have prepared’-
tr.19: And (unto the evil-doer) his comrade saith: This is that which I have ready (as testimony).
tr.22: And his Companion will say: "Here is (his Record) ready with me!"
tr.203: And his companion (angel) will say: "Here is (this Record) ready with me!"

50.ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
50.en: [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
50.tl: alqiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīdin

tr.85: ‘Hurl every obstinate disbeliever into Hell,
tr.19: (And it is said): Do ye twain hurl to hell each rebel ingrate,
tr.22: (The sentence will be:) "Throw, throw into Hell every contumacious Rejecter (of Allah)!-
tr.203: (Allah will say to the angels): "Both of you throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever (in the Oneness of Allâh, in His Messengers).

50.ar: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
50.en: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
50.tl: mannāʿin lil'khayri muʿ'tadin murībin

tr.85: everyone who hindered good, was aggressive, caused others to doubt,
tr.19: Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,
tr.22: "Who forbade what was good, transgressed all bounds, cast doubts and suspicions;
tr.203: "Hinderer of good, transgressor, doubter,

50.ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
50.en: Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
50.tl: alladhī jaʿala maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara fa-alqiyāhu fī l-ʿadhābi l-shadīdi

tr.85: and set up other gods alongside God. Hurl him into severe punishment!’-
tr.19: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
tr.22: "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
tr.203: "Who set up another ilâh (god) with Allâh. Then both of you cast him in the severe torment."

50.ar: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
50.en: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
50.tl: qāla qarīnuhu rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhu walākin kāna fī ḍalālin baʿīdin

tr.85: and his [evil] companion will say, ‘Lord, I did not make him transgress; he had already gone far astray himself.’
tr.19: His comrade saith: Our Lord! I did not cause him to rebel, but he was (himself) far gone in error.
tr.22: His Companion will say: "Our Lord! I did not make him transgress, but he was (himself) far astray."
tr.203: His companion (Satan - devil)] will say: "Our Lord! I did not push him to transgression, (in disbelief, oppression, and evil deeds) but he was himself in error far astray."

50.ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
50.en: [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
50.tl: qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīdi

tr.85: God will say, ‘Do not argue in My presence. I sent you a warning
tr.19: He saith: Contend not in My presence, when I had already proffered unto you the warning.
tr.22: He will say: "Dispute not with each other in My Presence: I had already in advance sent you Warning.
tr.203: Allâh will say: "Dispute not in front of Me, I had already in advance sent you the threat.

50.ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّـٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
50.en: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
50.tl: mā yubaddalu l-qawlu ladayya wamā anā biẓallāmin lil'ʿabīdi

tr.85: and My word cannot be changed: I am not unjust to any creature.’
tr.19: The sentence that cometh from Me cannot be changed, and I am in no wise a tyrant unto the slaves.
tr.22: "The Word changes not before Me, and I do not the least injustice to My Servants."
tr.203: The Sentence that comes from Me cannot be changed, and I am not unjust to the slaves."

50.ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
50.en: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
50.tl: yawma naqūlu lijahannama hali im'talati wataqūlu hal min mazīdin

tr.85: We shall say to Hell on that day, ‘Are you full?’ and it will reply, ‘Are there no more?’
tr.19: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
tr.22: One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
tr.203: On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more (to come)?"

50.ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
50.en: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
50.tl: wa-uz'lifati l-janatu lil'muttaqīna ghayra baʿīdin

tr.85: But Paradise will be brought close to the righteous and will no longer be distant:
tr.19: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
tr.22: And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
tr.203: And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2), not far off.

50.ar: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
50.en: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
50.tl: hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓin

tr.85: ‘This is what you were promised––this is for everyone who turned often to God and kept Him in mind,
tr.19: (And it is said): This is that which ye were promised. (It is) for every penitent and heedful one,
tr.22: (A voice will say:) "This is what was promised for you,- for every one who turned (to Allah) in sincere repentance, who kept (His Law),
tr.203: (It will be said): "This is what you were promised - (it is) for those oft-returning (to Allâh) in sincere repentance, and those who preserve their covenant with Allâh (by obeying Him in all what He has ordered, and worshipping none but Allâh Alone, i.e. follow Allâh’s religion - Islâmic Monotheism).

50.ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
50.en: Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
50.tl: man khashiya l-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāa biqalbin munībin

tr.85: who held the Most Gracious in awe, though He is unseen, who comes before Him with a heart turned to Him in devotion-
tr.19: Who feareth the Beneficent in secret and cometh with a contrite heart.
tr.22: "Who feared (Allah) Most Gracious Unseen, and brought a heart turned in devotion (to Him):
tr.203: "Who feared the Most Gracious (Allâh) in the Ghaib (Unseen) and brought a heart turned in repentance (to Him and absolutely free from each and every kind of polytheism).

50.ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
50.en: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
50.tl: ud'khulūhā bisalāmin dhālika yawmu l-khulūdi

tr.85: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting Life.’
tr.19: Enter it in peace. This is the day of immortality.
tr.22: "Enter ye therein in Peace and Security; this is a Day of Eternal Life!"
tr.203: "Enter you therein in peace and security - this is a Day of eternal life!"

50.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
50.en: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
50.tl: lahum mā yashāūna fīhā waladaynā mazīdun

tr.85: They will have all that they wish for there, and We have more for them.
tr.19: There they have all that they desire, and there is more with Us.
tr.22: There will be for them therein all that they wish,- and more besides in Our Presence.
tr.203: There they will have all that they desire - and We have more (for them, i.e. a glance at the All-Mighty, All-Majestic جل جلاله).

50.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
50.en: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
50.tl: wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu min'hum baṭshan fanaqqabū fī l-bilādi hal min maḥīṣin

tr.85: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape?
tr.19: And how many a generation We destroyed before them, who were mightier than these in prowess so that they overran the lands! Had they any place of refuge (when the judgment came)?
tr.22: But how many generations before them did We destroy (for their sins),- stronger in power than they? Then did they wander through the land: was there any place of escape (for them)?
tr.203: And how many a generation We have destroyed before them who were stronger in power than they. And (when Our Torment came), they ran for a refuge in the land! Could they find any place of refuge (for them to save themselves from destruction)?

50.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
50.en: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
50.tl: inna fī dhālika ladhik'rā liman kāna lahu qalbun aw alqā l-samʿa wahuwa shahīdun

tr.85: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively.
tr.19: Lo! therein verily is a reminder for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear with full intelligence.
tr.22: Verily in this is a Message for any that has a heart and understanding or who gives ear and earnestly witnesses (the truth).
tr.203: Verily, therein is indeed a reminder for him who has a heart or gives ear while he is heedful.

50.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
50.en: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
50.tl: walaqad khalaqnā l-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyāmin wamā massanā min lughūbin

tr.85: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring.
tr.19: And verily We created the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, in six Days, and naught of weariness touched Us.
tr.22: We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in Six Days, nor did any sense of weariness touch Us.
tr.203: And indeed We created the heavens and the earth and all between them in six Days and nothing of fatigue touched Us.

50.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
50.en: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
50.tl: fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi l-shamsi waqabla l-ghurūbi

tr.85: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun;
tr.19: Therefor (O Muhammad) bear with what they say, and hymn the praise of thy Lord before the rising and before the setting of the sun;
tr.22: Bear, then, with patience, all that they say, and celebrate the praises of thy Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting.
tr.203: So bear with patience (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) all that they say, and glorify the Praises of your Lord, before the rising of the sun and before (its) setting (i.e. the Fajr, Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers).

50.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
50.en: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
50.tl: wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-adbāra l-sujūdi

tr.85: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer;
tr.19: And in the night-time hymn His praise, and after the (prescribed) prostrations.
tr.22: And during part of the night, (also,) celebrate His praises, and (so likewise) after the postures of adoration.
tr.203: And during a part of the night (also) glorify His praises (i.e. Maghrib and ‘Isha prayers) and (so likewise) after the prayers [As-Sunnah, Nawâfil - optional and additional prayers. And also glorify, praise and magnify Allâh - Subhân Allâh, Alhamdu lillâh, Allâhu-Akbar].

50.ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
50.en: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
50.tl: wa-is'tamiʿ yawma yunādi l-munādi min makānin qarībin

tr.85: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place.
tr.19: And listen on the day when the crier crieth from a near place,
tr.22: And listen for the Day when the Caller will call out from a place quiet near,-
tr.203: And listen on the Day when the caller will call from a near place.

50.ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
50.en: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
50.tl: yawma yasmaʿūna l-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqi dhālika yawmu l-khurūji

tr.85: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality.
tr.19: The day when they will hear the (Awful) Cry in truth. That is the day of coming forth (from the graves).
tr.22: The Day when they will hear a (mighty) Blast in (very) truth: that will be the Day of Resurrection.
tr.203: The Day when they will hear As-Saihah (shout) in truth: that will be the Day of coming out (from the graves, i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

50.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
50.en: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
50.tl: innā naḥnu nuḥ'yī wanumītu wa-ilaynā l-maṣīru

tr.85: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us
tr.19: Lo! We it is Who quicken and give death, and unto Us is the journeying.
tr.22: Verily it is We Who give Life and Death; and to Us is the Final Goal-
tr.203: Verily, We it is Who give life and cause death; and to Us is the final return.

50.ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
50.en: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
50.tl: yawma tashaqqaqu l-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿan dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīrun

tr.85: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us.
tr.19: On the day when the earth splitteth asunder from them, hastening forth (they come). That is a gathering easy for Us (to make).
tr.22: The Day when the Earth will be rent asunder, from (men) hurrying out: that will be a gathering together,- quite easy for Us.
tr.203: On the Day when the earth shall be cleft, from off them, (they will come out) hastening forth. That will be a gathering, quite easy for Us.

50.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
50.en: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
50.tl: naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbārin fadhakkir bil-qur'āni man yakhāfu waʿīdi

tr.85: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning.
tr.19: We are Best Aware of what they say, and thou (O Muhammad) art in no wise a compeller over them. But warn by the Qur'an him who feareth My threat.
tr.22: We know best what they say; and thou art not one to overawe them by force. So admonish with the Qur'an such as fear My Warning!
tr.203: We know best what they say. And you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are not the one to force them (to Belief). But warn by the Qur’an; him who fears My Threat.

51.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
51.en: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]
51.tl: wal-dhāriyāti dharwan

tr.85: By those [winds] that scatter far and wide,
tr.19: By those that winnow with a winnowing
tr.22: By the (Winds) that scatter broadcast;
tr.203: By (the winds) that scatter dust.

51.ar: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
51.en: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
51.tl: fal-ḥāmilāti wiq'ran

tr.85: and those that are heavily laden,
tr.19: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
tr.22: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
tr.203: And (the clouds) that bear heavy weight of water.

51.ar: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
51.en: And the ships sailing with ease
51.tl: fal-jāriyāti yus'ran

tr.85: that speed freely,
tr.19: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
tr.22: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
tr.203: And (the ships) that float with ease and gentleness.

51.ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
51.en: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
51.tl: fal-muqasimāti amran

tr.85: that distribute [rain] as ordained!
tr.19: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
tr.22: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
tr.203: And those (angels) who distribute (provisions, rain, and other blessings) by (Allâh’s) Command.

51.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
51.en: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
51.tl: innamā tūʿadūna laṣādiqun

tr.85: What you [people] are promised is true:
tr.19: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
tr.22: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
tr.203: Verily, that which you are promised (i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds) is surely true.

51.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
51.en: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
51.tl: wa-inna l-dīna lawāqiʿun

tr.85: the Judgement will come––
tr.19: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
tr.22: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
tr.203: And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.

51.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
51.en: By the heaven containing pathways,
51.tl: wal-samāi dhāti l-ḥubuki

tr.85: by the sky with its pathways,
tr.19: By the heaven full of paths,
tr.22: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
tr.203: By the heaven full of paths,

51.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
51.en: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
51.tl: innakum lafī qawlin mukh'talifin

tr.85: you differ in what you say––
tr.19: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
tr.22: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
tr.203: Certainly, you have different ideas (about Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân).

51.ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
51.en: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
51.tl: yu'faku ʿanhu man ufika

tr.85: those who turn away from it are [truly] deceived.
tr.19: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
tr.22: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
tr.203: Turned aside therefrom (i.e. from Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and the Qur’ân) is he who is turned aside (by the Decree and Preordainment القضاء والقدر of Allâh).

51.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
51.en: Destroyed are the misinformers
51.tl: qutila l-kharāṣūna

tr.85: Perish the liars,
tr.19: Accursed be the conjecturers
tr.22: Woe to the falsehood-mongers,-
tr.203: Cursed be the liars

51.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
51.en: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
51.tl: alladhīna hum fī ghamratin sāhūna

tr.85: those steeped in error and unaware!
tr.19: Who are careless in an abyss!
tr.22: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
tr.203: Who are under a cover of heedlessness (think not about the gravity of the Hereafter),

51.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
51.en: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
51.tl: yasalūna ayyāna yawmu l-dīni

tr.85: They ask, ‘When is this Judgement Day coming?’
tr.19: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
tr.22: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
tr.203: They ask: "When will be the Day of Recompense?"

51.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
51.en: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.
51.tl: yawma hum ʿalā l-nāri yuf'tanūna

tr.85: On a Day when they will be punished by the Fire,
tr.19: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
tr.22: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
tr.203: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (punished i.e. burnt) over the Fire!

51.ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
51.en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
51.tl: dhūqū fit'natakum hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tastaʿjilūna

tr.85: ‘Taste the punishment! This is what you wished to hasten.’
tr.19: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
tr.22: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
tr.203: "Taste you your trial (punishment i.e. burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"

51.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
51.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
51.tl: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin waʿuyūnin

tr.85: The righteous will be in Gardens with [flowing] springs.
tr.19: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
tr.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
tr.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),

51.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
51.en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
51.tl: ākhidhīna mā ātāhum rabbuhum innahum kānū qabla dhālika muḥ'sinīna

tr.85: They will receive their Lord’s gifts because of the good they did before:
tr.19: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
tr.22: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
tr.203: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).

51.ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
51.en: They used to sleep but little of the night,
51.tl: kānū qalīlan mina al-layli mā yahjaʿūna

tr.85: sleeping only little at night,
tr.19: They used to sleep but little of the night,
tr.22: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
tr.203: They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allâh) and praying, with fear and hope].

51.ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
51.en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
51.tl: wabil-asḥāri hum yastaghfirūna

tr.85: praying at dawn for God’s forgiveness,
tr.19: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
tr.22: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
tr.203: And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allâh) for forgiveness.

51.ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
51.en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
51.tl: wafī amwālihim ḥaqqun lilssāili wal-maḥrūmi

tr.85: giving a rightful share of their wealth to the beggar and the deprived.
tr.19: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
tr.22: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
tr.203: And in their properties there was the right of the Sâ’il (the beggar who asks) and the Mahrûm (the poor who does not ask others).

51.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
51.en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
51.tl: wafī l-arḍi āyātun lil'mūqinīna

tr.85: On earth there are signs for those with sure faith––
tr.19: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
tr.22: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
tr.203: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty.

51.ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
51.en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
51.tl: wafī anfusikum afalā tub'ṣirūna

tr.85: and in yourselves too, do you not see?––
tr.19: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
tr.22: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
tr.203: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?

51.ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
51.en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
51.tl: wafī l-samāi riz'qukum wamā tūʿadūna

tr.85: in the sky is your sustenance and all that you are promised.
tr.19: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
tr.22: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
tr.203: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.

51.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
51.en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
51.tl: fawarabbi l-samāi wal-arḍi innahu laḥaqqun mith'la mā annakum tanṭiqūna

tr.85: By the Lord of the heavens and earth! All this is as real as your speaking.
tr.19: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
tr.22: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
tr.203: Then by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.

51.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
51.en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
51.tl: hal atāka ḥadīthu ḍayfi ib'rāhīma l-muk'ramīna

tr.85: [Muhammad], have you heard the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?
tr.19: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
tr.22: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
tr.203: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrîl (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrâhîm (Abraham)?

51.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
51.en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."
51.tl: idh dakhalū ʿalayhi faqālū salāman qāla salāmun qawmun munkarūna

tr.85: They went in to see him and said, ‘Peace.’ ‘Peace,’ he said, [adding to himself] ‘These people are strangers.’
tr.19: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
tr.22: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
tr.203: When they came in to him and said: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)!" He answered: "Salâm, (peace be upon you)," and said: "You are a people unknown to me."

51.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
51.en: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.
51.tl: farāgha ilā ahlihi fajāa biʿij'lin samīnin

tr.85: He turned quickly to his household, brought out a fat calf,
tr.19: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
tr.22: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
tr.203: Then he turned to his household, and brought out a roasted calf [as the property of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) was mainly cows].

51.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
51.en: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
51.tl: faqarrabahu ilayhim qāla alā takulūna

tr.85: and placed it before them. ‘Will you not eat?’ he said,
tr.19: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
tr.22: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
tr.203: And placed it before them, (saying): "Will you not eat?"

51.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
51.en: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
51.tl: fa-awjasa min'hum khīfatan qālū lā takhaf wabasharūhu bighulāmin ʿalīmin

tr.85: beginning to be afraid of them, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid.’ They gave him good news of a son who would be gifted with knowledge.
tr.19: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
tr.22: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
tr.203: Then he conceived fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of a son having knowledge (about Allâh and His religion of True Monotheism).

51.ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
51.en: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
51.tl: fa-aqbalati im'ra-atuhu fī ṣarratin faṣakkat wajhahā waqālat ʿajūzun ʿaqīmun

tr.85: His wife then entered with a loud cry, struck her face, and said, ‘A barren old woman?’
tr.19: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
tr.22: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
tr.203: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice: she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"

51.ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
51.en: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
51.tl: qālū kadhāliki qāla rabbuki innahu huwa l-ḥakīmu l-ʿalīmu

tr.85: but they said, ‘It will be so. This is what your Lord said, and He is the Wise, the All Knowing.’
tr.19: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
tr.22: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
tr.203: They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."

51.ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
51.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
51.tl: qāla famā khaṭbukum ayyuhā l-mur'salūna

tr.85: Abraham said, ‘What is your errand, messengers?’
tr.19: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
tr.22: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
tr.203: [Ibrâhîm (Abraham)] said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"

51.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
51.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
51.tl: qālū innā ur'sil'nā ilā qawmin muj'rimīna

tr.85: They said, ‘We are sent to a people lost in sin,
tr.19: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
tr.22: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
tr.203: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimûn (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in Allâh)

51.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
51.en: To send down upon them stones of clay,
51.tl: linur'sila ʿalayhim ḥijāratan min ṭīnin

tr.85: to bring down rocks of clay,
tr.19: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
tr.22: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
tr.203: To send down upon them stones of baked clay.

51.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
51.en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
51.tl: musawwamatan ʿinda rabbika lil'mus'rifīna

tr.85: marked by your Lord for those who exceed all bounds.’
tr.19: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
tr.22: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
tr.203: Marked by your Lord for the Musrifûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners - those who trespass Allâh’s set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins).

51.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
51.en: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.
51.tl: fa-akhrajnā man kāna fīhā mina l-mu'minīna

tr.85: We brought out such believers as were there-
tr.19: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
tr.22: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
tr.203: So We brought out from therein the believers.

51.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
51.en: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
51.tl: famā wajadnā fīhā ghayra baytin mina l-mus'limīna

tr.85: We found only one household devoted to God-
tr.19: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
tr.22: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
tr.203: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one [of Lût (Lot) and his two daughters].

51.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
51.en: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
51.tl: wataraknā fīhā āyatan lilladhīna yakhāfūna l-ʿadhāba l-alīma

tr.85: and left the town to be a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
tr.19: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
tr.22: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
tr.203: And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.

51.ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
51.en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
51.tl: wafī mūsā idh arsalnāhu ilā fir'ʿawna bisul'ṭānin mubīnin

tr.85: There is another sign in Moses: We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
tr.19: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
tr.22: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
tr.203: And in Mûsâ (Moses) (too, there is a sign), when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority.

51.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
51.en: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."
51.tl: fatawallā biruk'nihi waqāla sāḥirun aw majnūnun

tr.85: Pharaoh turned away with his supporters, saying, ‘This is a sorcerer, or maybe a madman,’
tr.19: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
tr.22: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
tr.203: But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."

51.ar: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
51.en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
51.tl: fa-akhadhnāhu wajunūdahu fanabadhnāhum fī l-yami wahuwa mulīmun

tr.85: so We seized him and his forces and threw them into the sea: he was to blame.
tr.19: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
tr.22: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
tr.203: So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy.

51.ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
51.en: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
51.tl: wafī ʿādin idh arsalnā ʿalayhimu l-rīḥa l-ʿaqīma

tr.85: There is another sign in the Ad: We sent the life-destroying wind against them
tr.19: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
tr.22: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
tr.203: And in ‘Âd (there is also a sign) when We sent against them the barren wind;

51.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
51.en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
51.tl: mā tadharu min shayin atat ʿalayhi illā jaʿalathu kal-ramīmi

tr.85: and it reduced everything it came up against to shreds.
tr.19: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
tr.22: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
tr.203: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.

51.ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
51.en: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
51.tl: wafī thamūda idh qīla lahum tamattaʿū ḥattā ḥīnin

tr.85: And also in the Thamud: it was said to them, ‘Make the most of your lives for a while,’
tr.19: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
tr.22: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
tr.203: And in Thamûd (there is also a sign), when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"

51.ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
51.en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
51.tl: faʿataw ʿan amri rabbihim fa-akhadhathumu l-ṣāʿiqatu wahum yanẓurūna

tr.85: but they rebelled against their Lord’s command, so the blast took them. They looked on helplessly:
tr.19: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
tr.22: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
tr.203: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sâ‘iqah overtook them while they were looking.

51.ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
51.en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
51.tl: famā is'taṭāʿū min qiyāmin wamā kānū muntaṣirīna

tr.85: they could not even remain standing, let alone defend themselves.
tr.19: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
tr.22: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
tr.203: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.

51.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
51.en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
51.tl: waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū qawman fāsiqīna

tr.85: Before that We destroyed the people of Noah. They were a truly sinful people!
tr.19: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
tr.22: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
tr.203: (So were) the people of Nûh (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fâsiqûn (rebellious, disobedient to Allâh).

51.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
51.en: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
51.tl: wal-samāa banaynāhā bi-aydin wa-innā lamūsiʿūna

tr.85: We built the heavens with Our power and made them vast,
tr.19: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
tr.22: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of space.
tr.203: With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space thereof.

51.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
51.en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
51.tl: wal-arḍa farashnāhā faniʿ'ma l-māhidūna

tr.85: We spread out the earth- how well We smoothed it out!-
tr.19: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
tr.22: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
tr.203: And We have spread out the earth: how Excellent Spreader (thereof) are We!

51.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
51.en: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
51.tl: wamin kulli shayin khalaqnā zawjayni laʿallakum tadhakkarūna

tr.85: and We created pairs of all things so that you [people] might take note.
tr.19: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
tr.22: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
tr.203: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allâh).

51.ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
51.en: So flee to Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
51.tl: fafirrū ilā l-lahi innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun

tr.85: [So, say to them, Prophet], ‘Quickly, turn to God- I am sent by Him to give you clear warning-
tr.19: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
tr.22: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
tr.203: So flee to Allâh (from His Torment to His Mercy - Islâmic Monotheism). Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.

51.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
51.en: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
51.tl: walā tajʿalū maʿa l-lahi ilāhan ākhara innī lakum min'hu nadhīrun mubīnun

tr.85: and do not set up any other god alongside Him. I am sent by Him to give you clear warning!’
tr.19: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
tr.22: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
tr.203: And set not up (or worship not) any other ilâh (god) along with Allâh [Glorified be He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) am a plain warner to you from Him.

51.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
51.en: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
51.tl: kadhālika mā atā alladhīna min qablihim min rasūlin illā qālū sāḥirun aw majnūnun

tr.85: Every previous people to whom a messenger was sent also said, ‘A sor-cerer, or maybe a madman!’
tr.19: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
tr.22: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
tr.203: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"

51.ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
51.en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
51.tl: atawāṣaw bihi bal hum qawmun ṭāghūna

tr.85: Did they tell one another to do this? No! They are a people who exceed all bounds,
tr.19: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
tr.22: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
tr.203: Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!

51.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
51.en: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.
51.tl: fatawalla ʿanhum famā anta bimalūmin

tr.85: so ignore them [Prophet]- you are not to blame-
tr.19: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
tr.22: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
tr.203: So turn away (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from them (Quraish pagans), you are not blame-worthy (as you have conveyed Allâh’s Message).

51.ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
51.en: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
51.tl: wadhakkir fa-inna l-dhik'rā tanfaʿu l-mu'minīna

tr.85: and go on reminding [people], it is good for those who believe to be reminded.
tr.19: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
tr.22: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
tr.203: And remind (by preaching the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), for verily, the reminding profits the believers.

51.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
51.en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
51.tl: wamā khalaqtu l-jina wal-insa illā liyaʿbudūni

tr.85: I created jinn and mankind only to worship Me:
tr.19: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
tr.22: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
tr.203: And I (Allâh) created not the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me (Alone).

51.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
51.en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
51.tl: mā urīdu min'hum min riz'qin wamā urīdu an yuṭ'ʿimūni

tr.85: I want no provision from them, nor do I want them to feed Me-
tr.19: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
tr.22: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
tr.203: I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures).

51.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
51.en: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
51.tl: inna l-laha huwa l-razāqu dhū l-quwati l-matīnu

tr.85: God is the Provider, the Lord of Power, the Ever Mighty.
tr.19: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
tr.22: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
tr.203: Verily, Allâh is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.

51.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
51.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.
51.tl: fa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū dhanūban mith'la dhanūbi aṣḥābihim falā yastaʿjilūni

tr.85: The evildoers, like their predecessors, will have a share of punishment- they need not ask Me to hasten it-
tr.19: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
tr.22: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
tr.203: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on!

51.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
51.en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
51.tl: fawaylun lilladhīna kafarū min yawmihimu alladhī yūʿadūna

tr.85: and woe betide those who deny the truth on the Day they have been promised.
tr.19: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
tr.22: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
tr.203: Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Allâh and His Oneness - Islâmic Monotheism) from their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment).

52.ar: وَٱلطُّورِ
52.en: By the mount
52.tl: wal-ṭūri

tr.85: By the mountain,
tr.19: By the Mount,
tr.22: By the Mount (of Revelation);
tr.203: By the Tûr (Mount)

52.ar: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
52.en: And [by] a Book inscribed
52.tl: wakitābin masṭūrin

tr.85: by a Scripture inscribed
tr.19: And a Scripture inscribed
tr.22: By a Decree inscribed
tr.203: And by a Book Inscribed

52.ar: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
52.en: In parchment spread open
52.tl: fī raqqin manshūrin

tr.85: in unrolled parch-ment,
tr.19: On fine parchment unrolled,
tr.22: In a Scroll unfolded;
tr.203: In parchment unrolled.

52.ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
52.en: And [by] the frequented House
52.tl: wal-bayti l-maʿmūri

tr.85: by the much-visited House,
tr.19: And the House frequented,
tr.22: By the much-frequented Fane;
tr.203: And by Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mûr (the house over the heavens parallel to the Ka‘bah at Makkah, continuously visited by the angels).

52.ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
52.en: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
52.tl: wal-saqfi l-marfūʿi

tr.85: by the raised canopy,
tr.19: And the roof exalted,
tr.22: By the Canopy Raised High;
tr.203: And by the roof raised high (i.e. the heaven).

52.ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
52.en: And [by] the sea set on fire,
52.tl: wal-baḥri l-masjūri

tr.85: by the ocean ever filled,
tr.19: And the sea kept filled,
tr.22: And by the Ocean filled with Swell;-
tr.203: And by the sea kept filled (or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection).

52.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
52.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
52.tl: inna ʿadhāba rabbika lawāqiʿun

tr.85: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is coming––
tr.19: Lo! the doom of thy Lord will surely come to pass;
tr.22: Verily, the Doom of thy Lord will indeed come to pass;-
tr.203: Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass.

52.ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
52.en: Of it there is no preventer.
52.tl: mā lahu min dāfiʿin

tr.85: it cannot be put off––
tr.19: There is none that can ward it off.
tr.22: There is none can avert it;-
tr.203: There is none that can avert it.

52.ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
52.en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
52.tl: yawma tamūru l-samāu mawran

tr.85: on the Day when the sky sways back and forth
tr.19: On the day when the heaven will heave with (awful) heaving,
tr.22: On the Day when the firmament will be in dreadful commotion.
tr.203: On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,

52.ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
52.en: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
52.tl: watasīru l-jibālu sayran

tr.85: and the mountains float away.
tr.19: And the mountains move away with (awful) movement,
tr.22: And the mountains will fly hither and thither.
tr.203: And the mountains will move away with a (horrible) movement.

52.ar: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
52.en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
52.tl: fawaylun yawma-idhin lil'mukadhibīna

tr.85: Woe on that Day to those who deny the Truth,
tr.19: Then woe that day unto the deniers
tr.22: Then woe that Day to those that treat (Truth) as Falsehood;-
tr.203: Then woe that Day to the beliers.

52.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
52.en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
52.tl: alladhīna hum fī khawḍin yalʿabūna

tr.85: who amuse themselves with idle chatter:
tr.19: Who play in talk of grave matters;
tr.22: That play (and paddle) in shallow trifles.
tr.203: Who are playing in falsehood.

52.ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
52.en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
52.tl: yawma yudaʿʿūna ilā nāri jahannama daʿʿan

tr.85: on that Day they will be thrust into the Fire of Hell.
tr.19: The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust, into the fire of hell
tr.22: That Day shall they be thrust down to the Fire of Hell, irresistibly.
tr.203: The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing.

52.ar: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
52.en: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
52.tl: hādhihi l-nāru allatī kuntum bihā tukadhibūna

tr.85: ‘This is the Fire you used to deny.
tr.19: (And it is said unto them): This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny.
tr.22: "This:, it will be said, "Is the Fire,- which ye were wont to deny!
tr.203: This is the Fire which you used to belie.

52.ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
52.en: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
52.tl: afasiḥ'run hādhā am antum lā tub'ṣirūna

tr.85: So is this sorcery? Do you still not see it?
tr.19: Is this magic, or do ye not see?
tr.22: "Is this then a fake, or is it ye that do not see?
tr.203: Is this magic, or do you not see?

52.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
52.en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
52.tl: iṣ'lawhā fa-iṣ'birū aw lā taṣbirū sawāon ʿalaykum innamā tuj'zawna mā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: Burn in it––it makes no difference whether you bear it patiently or not–– you are only being repaid for what you have done.’
tr.19: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
tr.22: "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
tr.203: Taste you therein its heat and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.

52.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
52.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
52.tl: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaʿīmin

tr.85: Those who were mindful of God are in Gardens and in bliss,
tr.19: Lo! those who kept their duty dwell in gardens and delight,
tr.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in Gardens, and in Happiness,-
tr.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) will be in Gardens (Paradise), and Delight.

52.ar: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
52.en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
52.tl: fākihīna bimā ātāhum rabbuhum wawaqāhum rabbuhum ʿadhāba l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: rejoicing in their Lord’s gifts: He has saved them from the torment of the Blaze,
tr.19: Happy because of what their Lord hath given them, and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hell-fire.
tr.22: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
tr.203: Enjoying in that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire.

52.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
52.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
52.tl: kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: ‘Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment as a reward for what you have done.’
tr.19: (And it is said unto them): Eat and drink in health (as a reward) for what ye used to do,
tr.22: (To them will be said:) "Eat and drink ye, with profit and health, because of your (good) deeds."
tr.203: "Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do."

52.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
52.en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
52.tl: muttakiīna ʿalā sururin maṣfūfatin wazawwajnāhum biḥūrin ʿīnin

tr.85: They are comfortably seated on couches arranged in rows; We pair them with beautiful-eyed maidens;
tr.19: Reclining on ranged couches. And we wed them unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.
tr.22: They will recline (with ease) on Thrones (of dignity) arranged in ranks; and We shall join them to Companions, with beautiful big and lustrous eyes.
tr.203: They will recline (with ease) on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Hûr: (female, fair ones) with wide lovely eyes.

52.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
52.en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
52.tl: wa-alladhīna āmanū wa-ittabaʿathum dhurriyyatuhum biīmānin alḥaqnā bihim dhurriyyatahum wamā alatnāhum min ʿamalihim min shayin kullu im'ri-in bimā kasaba rahīnun

tr.85: We unite the believers with their offspring who followed them in faith–– We do not deny them any of the rewards for their deeds: each person is in pledge for his own deeds––
tr.19: And they who believe and whose seed follow them in faith, We cause their seed to join them (there), and We deprive them of nought of their (life's) work. Every man is a pledge for that which he hath earned.
tr.22: And those who believe and whose families follow them in Faith,- to them shall We join their families: Nor shall We deprive them (of the fruit) of aught of their works: (Yet) is each individual in pledge for his deeds.
tr.203: And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith: to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned.

52.ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
52.en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
52.tl: wa-amdadnāhum bifākihatin walaḥmin mimmā yashtahūna

tr.85: We provide them with any fruit or meat they desire.
tr.19: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
tr.22: And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
tr.203: And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.

52.ar: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
52.en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
52.tl: yatanāzaʿūna fīhā kasan lā laghwun fīhā walā tathīmun

tr.85: They pass around a cup which does not lead to any idle talk or sin.
tr.19: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
tr.22: They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
tr.203: There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk between them), and free from sin (because it will be lawful for them to drink).

52.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
52.en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
52.tl: wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim ghil'mānun lahum ka-annahum lu'lu-on maknūnun

tr.85: Devoted youths like hidden pearls wait on them.
tr.19: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
tr.22: Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
tr.203: And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.

52.ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
52.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
52.tl: wa-aqbala baʿḍuhum ʿalā baʿḍin yatasāalūna

tr.85: They turn to one another and say,
tr.19: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
tr.22: They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
tr.203: And some of them draw near to others, questioning.

52.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
52.en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].
52.tl: qālū innā kunnā qablu fī ahlinā mush'fiqīna

tr.85: ‘When we were still with our families [on earth] we used to live in fear––
tr.19: Saying: Lo! of old, when we were with our families, we were ever anxious;
tr.22: They will say: "Aforetime, we were not without fear for the sake of our people.
tr.203: Saying: "Aforetime, we were afraid (of the punishment of Allâh) in the midst of our families.

52.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
52.en: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
52.tl: famanna l-lahu ʿalaynā wawaqānā ʿadhāba l-samūmi

tr.85: God has been gracious to us and saved us from the torment of intense heat-
tr.19: But Allah hath been gracious unto us and hath preserved us from the torment of the breath of Fire.
tr.22: "But Allah has been good to us, and has delivered us from the Penalty of the Scorching Wind.
tr.203: "So Allâh has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire.

52.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
52.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
52.tl: innā kunnā min qablu nadʿūhu innahu huwa l-baru l-raḥīmu

tr.85: We used to pray to Him: He is the Good, the Merciful One.’
tr.19: Lo! we used to pray unto Him of old. Lo! He is the Benign, the Merciful.
tr.22: "Truly, we did call unto Him from of old: truly it is He, the Beneficent, the Merciful!"
tr.203: "Verily, We used to invoke Him (Alone and none else) before. Verily, He is Al-Barr (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous), the Most Merciful."

52.ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
52.en: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
52.tl: fadhakkir famā anta biniʿ'mati rabbika bikāhinin walā majnūnin

tr.85: So [Prophet] remind [people]. By the grace of your Lord [Prophet], you are neither oracle nor madman.
tr.19: Therefor warn (men, O Muhammad). By the grace of Allah thou art neither soothsayer nor madman.
tr.22: Therefore proclaim thou the praises (of thy Lord): for by the Grace of thy Lord, thou art no (vulgar) soothsayer, nor art thou one possessed.
tr.203: Therefore, remind (mankind of Islâmic Monotheism, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم). By the Grace of Allâh, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.

52.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
52.en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?
52.tl: am yaqūlūna shāʿirun natarabbaṣu bihi rayba l-manūni

tr.85: If they say, ‘He is only a poet: we shall await his fate,’
tr.19: Or say they: (he is) a poet, (one) for whom we may expect the accident of time?
tr.22: Or do they say:- "A Poet! we await for him some calamity (hatched) by Time!"
tr.203: Or do they say: "(Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!"

52.ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
52.en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
52.tl: qul tarabbaṣū fa-innī maʿakum mina l-mutarabiṣīna

tr.85: say, ‘Wait if you wish; I too am waiting’-
tr.19: Say (unto them): Except (your fill)! Lo! I am with you among the expectant.
tr.22: Say thou: "Await ye!- I too will wait along with you!"
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to them): "Wait! I am with you among the waiters!"

52.ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
52.en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
52.tl: am tamuruhum aḥlāmuhum bihādhā am hum qawmun ṭāghūna

tr.85: does their reason really tell them to do this, or are they simply insolent people?
tr.19: Do their minds command them to do this, or are they an outrageous folk?
tr.22: Is it that their faculties of understanding urge them to this, or are they but a people transgressing beyond bounds?
tr.203: Do their minds command them this [i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)] or are they people transgressing all bounds?

52.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
52.en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
52.tl: am yaqūlūna taqawwalahu bal lā yu'minūna

tr.85: If they say, ‘He has made it up himself’- they certainly do not believe-
tr.19: Or say they: He hath invented it? Nay, but they will not believe!
tr.22: Or do they say, "He fabricated the (Message)"? Nay, they have no faith!
tr.203: Or do they say: "He (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has forged it (this Qur’ân)?" Nay! They believe not!

52.ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
52.en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
52.tl: falyatū biḥadīthin mith'lihi in kānū ṣādiqīna

tr.85: let them produce one like it, if what they say is true.
tr.19: Then let them produce speech the like thereof, if they are truthful.
tr.22: Let them then produce a recital like unto it,- If (it be) they speak the truth!
tr.203: Let them then produce a recital like unto it (the Qur’ân) if they are truthful.

52.ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
52.en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
52.tl: am khuliqū min ghayri shayin am humu l-khāliqūna

tr.85: Were they created without any agent? Were they the creators?
tr.19: Or were they created out of naught? Or are they the creators?
tr.22: Were they created of nothing, or were they themselves the creators?
