tr.203: Were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators?

52.ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
52.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
52.tl: am khalaqū l-samāwāti wal-arḍa bal lā yūqinūna

tr.85: Did they create the heavens and the earth? No! They do not have faith.
tr.19: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they are sure of nothing!
tr.22: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, they have no firm belief.
tr.203: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief.

52.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
52.en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
52.tl: am ʿindahum khazāinu rabbika am humu l-muṣayṭirūna

tr.85: Do they possess your Lord’s treasures or have control over them?
tr.19: Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord? Or have they been given charge (thereof)?
tr.22: Or are the Treasures of thy Lord with them, or are they the managers (of affairs)?
tr.203: Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?

52.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
52.en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
52.tl: am lahum sullamun yastamiʿūna fīhi falyati mus'tamiʿuhum bisul'ṭānin mubīnin

tr.85: Do they have a ladder to climb, in order to eavesdrop [on Heaven’s secrets]? Let their eavesdropper produce clear proof.
tr.19: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce some warrant manifest!
tr.22: Or have they a ladder, by which they can (climb up to heaven and) listen (to its secrets)? Then let (such a) listener of theirs produce a manifest proof.
tr.203: Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof.

52.ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
52.en: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
52.tl: am lahu l-banātu walakumu l-banūna

tr.85: Does God have daughters while you have sons?
tr.19: Or hath He daughters whereas ye have sons?
tr.22: Or has He only daughters and ye have sons?
tr.203: Or has He (Allâh) only daughters and you have sons?

52.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
52.en: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
52.tl: am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna

tr.85: Do you [Prophet] demand a payment from them that would burden them with debt?
tr.19: Or askest thou (Muhammad) a fee from them so that they are plunged in debt?
tr.22: Or is it that thou dost ask for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
tr.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask a wage from them (for your preaching of Islâmic Monotheism) so that they are burdened with a load of debt?

52.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
52.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
52.tl: am ʿindahumu l-ghaybu fahum yaktubūna

tr.85: Do they have [access to] the unseen? Could they write it down?
tr.19: Or possess they the Unseen so that they can write (it) down?
tr.22: Or that the Unseen in it their hands, and they write it down?
tr.203: Or that the Ghaib (Unseen) is with them, and they write it down?

52.ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
52.en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
52.tl: am yurīdūna kaydan fa-alladhīna kafarū humu l-makīdūna

tr.85: Do they think they can ensnare you? It is the disbelievers who have been ensnared.
tr.19: Or seek they to ensnare (the messenger)? But those who disbelieve, they are the ensnared!
tr.22: Or do they intend a plot (against thee)? But those who defy Allah are themselves involved in a Plot!
tr.203: Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) are themselves plotted against!

52.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
52.en: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.
52.tl: am lahum ilāhun ghayru l-lahi sub'ḥāna l-lahi ʿammā yush'rikūna

tr.85: Do they really have another god besides God? God is far above anything they set alongside Him.
tr.19: Or have they any god beside Allah? Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)!
tr.22: Or have they a god other than Allah? Exalted is Allah far above the things they associate with Him!
tr.203: Or have they an ilâh (a god) other than Allâh? Glorified be Allâh from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)

52.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
52.en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
52.tl: wa-in yaraw kis'fan mina l-samāi sāqiṭan yaqūlū saḥābun markūmun

tr.85: Even if they saw a piece of heaven falling down on them, they would say, ‘Just a heap of clouds,’
tr.19: And if they were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds.
tr.22: Were they to see a piece of the sky falling (on them), they would (only) say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"
tr.203: And if they were to see a piece of the heaven falling down, they would say: "Clouds gathered in heaps!"

52.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
52.en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
52.tl: fadharhum ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī fīhi yuṣ'ʿaqūna

tr.85: so leave them, Prophet, until they face the Day when they will be thunderstruck,
tr.19: Then let them be (O Muhammad), till they meet their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken,
tr.22: So leave them alone until they encounter that Day of theirs, wherein they shall (perforce) swoon (with terror),-
tr.203: So leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror).

52.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
52.en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
52.tl: yawma lā yugh'nī ʿanhum kayduhum shayan walā hum yunṣarūna

tr.85: the Day when their snares will be of no use to them, when they will get no help.
tr.19: A day in which their guile will naught avail them, nor will they be helped.
tr.22: The Day when their plotting will avail them nothing and no help shall be given them.
tr.203: The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell).

52.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
52.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
52.tl: wa-inna lilladhīna ẓalamū ʿadhāban dūna dhālika walākinna aktharahum lā yaʿlamūna

tr.85: Another punishment awaits the evildoers, though most of them do not realize it.
tr.19: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a punishment beyond that. But most of them know not.
tr.22: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment besides this: But most of them understand not.
tr.203: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves) before this; but most of them know not. (Tafsir At-Tabarî).

52.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
52.en: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise
52.tl: wa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika fa-innaka bi-aʿyuninā wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika ḥīna taqūmu

tr.85: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: you are under Our watchful eye. Celebrate the praise of your Lord when you rise.
tr.19: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
tr.22: Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
tr.203: So wait patiently (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes; and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.

52.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
52.en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
52.tl: wamina al-layli fasabbiḥ'hu wa-id'bāra l-nujūmi

tr.85: Glorify Him at night and at the fading of the stars.
tr.19: And in the night-time also hymn His praise, and at the setting of the stars.
tr.22: And for part of the night also praise thou Him,- and at the retreat of the stars!
tr.203: And in the nighttime also glorify His Praises - and at the setting of the stars.

53.en: By the star when it descends,

tr.85: By the star when it sets!
tr.19: By the Star when it setteth,
tr.22: By the Star when it goes down,-
tr.203: By the star when it goes down (or vanishes).

53.en: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

tr.85: Your companion has not strayed; he is not deluded;
tr.19: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
tr.22: Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.
tr.203: Your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither gone astray nor has erred.

53.en: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

tr.85: he does not speak from his own desire.
tr.19: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
tr.22: Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.
tr.203: Nor does he speak of (his own) desire.

53.en: It is not but a revelation revealed,

tr.85: The Quran is nothing less than a revelation that is sent to him.
tr.19: It is naught save an inspiration that is inspired,
tr.22: It is no less than inspiration sent down to him:
tr.203: It is only a Revelation revealed.

53.en: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

tr.85: It was taught to him by [an angel] with mighty powers
tr.19: Which one of mighty powers hath taught him,
tr.22: He was taught by one Mighty in Power,
tr.203: He has been taught (this Qur’ân) by one mighty in power [Jibrîl (Gabriel)]

53.en: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

tr.85: and great strength, who stood
tr.19: One vigorous; and he grew clear to view
tr.22: Endued with Wisdom: for he appeared (in stately form);
tr.203: One free from any defect in body and mind then he (Jibrîl - Gabriel in his real shape as created by Allah) rose and became stable.

53.en: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.

tr.85: on the highest horizon
tr.19: When he was on the uppermost horizon.
tr.22: While he was in the highest part of the horizon:
tr.203: While he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] was in the highest part of the horizon, (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

53.en: Then he approached and descended

tr.85: and then approached––coming down
tr.19: Then he drew nigh and came down
tr.22: Then he approached and came closer,
tr.203: Then he [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] approached and came closer,

53.en: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

tr.85: until he was two bow-lengths away or even closer––
tr.19: Till he was (distant) two bows' length or even nearer,
tr.22: And was at a distance of but two bow-lengths or (even) nearer;
tr.203: And was at a distance of two bows’ length or (even) nearer.

53.en: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

tr.85: and revealed to God’s servant what He revealed.
tr.19: And He revealed unto His slave that which He revealed.
tr.22: So did (Allah) convey the inspiration to His Servant- (conveyed) what He (meant) to convey.
tr.203: So (Allâh) revealed to His slave [Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel) عليه السلام] whatever He revealed.

53.en: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

tr.85: [The Prophet’s] own heart did not distort what he saw.
tr.19: The heart lied not (in seeing) what it saw.
tr.22: The (Prophet's) (mind and) heart in no way falsified that which he saw.
tr.203: The (Prophet’s) heart lied not in what he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw.

53.en: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

tr.85: Are you going to dispute with him what he saw with his own eyes?
tr.19: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he seeth?
tr.22: Will ye then dispute with him concerning what he saw?
tr.203: Will you then dispute with him (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about what he saw [during the Mi‘râj: (Ascent of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم to the seven heavens)]

53.en: And he certainly saw him in another descent

tr.85: A second time he saw him:
tr.19: And verily he saw him yet another time
tr.22: For indeed he saw him at a second descent,
tr.203: And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] at a second descent (i.e. another time).

53.en: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

tr.85: by the lote tree beyond which none may pass
tr.19: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
tr.22: Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:
tr.203: Near Sidrat-ul-Muntaha (a lote-tree of the utmost boundary over the seventh heaven beyond which none can pass).

53.en: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

tr.85: near the Garden of Restfulness,
tr.19: Nigh unto which is the Garden of Abode.
tr.22: Near it is the Garden of Abode.
tr.203: Near it is the Paradise of Abode.

53.en: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].

tr.85: when the tree was covered in nameless [splendour].
tr.19: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
tr.22: Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)
tr.203: When that covered the lote-tree which did cover it!

53.en: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

tr.85: His sight never wavered, nor was it too bold,
tr.19: The eye turned not aside nor yet was overbold.
tr.22: (His) sight never swerved, nor did it go wrong!
tr.203: The sight (of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) turned not aside (right or left), nor it transgressed beyond the limit (ordained for it).

53.ar: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
53.en: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
53.tl: laqad raā min āyāti rabbihi l-kub'rā

tr.85: and he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.
tr.19: Verily he saw one of the greater revelations of his Lord.
tr.22: For truly did he see, of the Signs of his Lord, the Greatest!
tr.203: Indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) did see of the Greatest Signs, of his Lord (Allâh).

53.en: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

tr.85: [Disbelievers], consider al-Lat and al-Uzza,
tr.19: Have ye thought upon Al-Lat and Al-'Uzza
tr.22: Have ye seen Lat. and 'Uzza,
tr.203: Have you then considered Al-Lât, and Al-‘Uzzâ (two idols of the pagan Arabs)

53.en: And Manāt, the third - the other one?

tr.85: and the third one, Manat––
tr.19: And Manat, the third, the other?
tr.22: And another, the third (goddess), Manat?
tr.203: And Manât (another idol of the pagan Arabs), the other third?

53.en: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

tr.85: are you to have the male and He the female?
tr.19: Are yours the males and His the females?
tr.22: What! for you the male sex, and for Him, the female?
tr.203: Is it for you the males and for Him the females?

53.en: That, then, is an unjust division.

tr.85: That would be a most unjust distribution!––
tr.19: That indeed were an unfair division!
tr.22: Behold, such would be indeed a division most unfair!
tr.203: That indeed is a division most unfair!

53.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
53.en: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
53.tl: in hiya illā asmāon sammaytumūhā antum waābāukum mā anzala l-lahu bihā min sul'ṭānin in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wamā tahwā l-anfusu walaqad jāahum min rabbihimu l-hudā

tr.85: these are nothing but names you have invented yourselves, you and your forefathers. God has sent no authority for them. These people merely follow guesswork and the whims of their souls, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
tr.19: They are but names which ye have named, ye and your fathers, for which Allah hath revealed no warrant. They follow but a guess and that which (they) themselves desire. And now the guidance from their Lord hath come unto them.
tr.22: These are nothing but names which ye have devised,- ye and your fathers,- for which Allah has sent down no authority (whatever). They follow nothing but conjecture and what their own souls desire!- Even though there has already come to them Guidance from their Lord!
tr.203: They are but names which you have named - you and your fathers - for which Allâh has sent down no authority. They follow but a guess and that which they themselves desire, whereas there has surely come to them the Guidance from their Lord!

53.en: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

tr.85: Is man to have everything he wishes for,
tr.19: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
tr.22: Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?
tr.203: Or shall man have what he wishes?

53.en: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

tr.85: when the present life and the life to come belong only to God?
tr.19: But unto Allah belongeth the after (life), and the former.
tr.22: But it is to Allah that the End and the Beginning (of all things) belong.
tr.203: But to Allâh belongs the last (Hereafter) and the first (the world).

53.ar: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
53.en: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
53.tl: wakam min malakin fī l-samāwāti lā tugh'nī shafāʿatuhum shayan illā min baʿdi an yadhana l-lahu liman yashāu wayarḍā

tr.85: There are many angels in heaven whose intercession will be of no use until God gives permission to those He will, whose words He will accept.
tr.19: And how many angels are in the heavens whose intercession availeth naught save after Allah giveth leave to whom He chooseth and accepteth.
tr.22: How many-so-ever be the angels in the heavens, their intercession will avail nothing except after Allah has given leave for whom He pleases and that he is acceptable to Him.
tr.203: And there are many angels in the heavens, whose intercession will avail nothing except after Allâh has given leave for whom He wills and is pleased with.

53.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
53.en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
53.tl: inna alladhīna lā yu'minūna bil-ākhirati layusammūna l-malāikata tasmiyata l-unthā

tr.85: Those who deny the life to come give the angels female names.
tr.19: Lo! it is those who disbelieve in the Hereafter who name the angels with the names of females.
tr.22: Those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.
tr.203: Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, name the angels with female names.

53.ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
53.en: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
53.tl: wamā lahum bihi min ʿil'min in yattabiʿūna illā l-ẓana wa-inna l-ẓana lā yugh'nī mina l-ḥaqi shayan

tr.85: They have no knowledge to base this on: they merely follow guesswork. Guesswork is of no value against the Truth.
tr.19: And they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and lo! a guess can never take the place of the truth.
tr.22: But they have no knowledge therein. They follow nothing but conjecture; and conjecture avails nothing against Truth.
tr.203: But they have no knowledge thereof. They follow but a guess, and verily, guess is no substitute for the truth.

53.ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
53.en: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
53.tl: fa-aʿriḍ ʿan man tawallā ʿan dhik'rinā walam yurid illā l-ḥayata l-dun'yā

tr.85: So [Prophet] ignore those who turn away from Our revelation, who want only the life of this world.
tr.19: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
tr.22: Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.
tr.203: Therefore withdraw (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from him who turns away from Our Reminder (this Qur’ân) and desires nothing but the life of this world.

53.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
53.en: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
53.tl: dhālika mablaghuhum mina l-ʿil'mi inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bimani ih'tadā

tr.85: Their knowledge does not go beyond that. Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who follows guidance.
tr.19: Such is their sum of knowledge. Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth, and He is Best Aware of him whom goeth right.
tr.22: That is as far as knowledge will reach them. Verily thy Lord knoweth best those who stray from His Path, and He knoweth best those who receive guidance.
tr.203: That is what they could reach of knowledge. Verily, your Lord it is He Who knows best him who goes astray from His Path, and He knows best him who receives guidance.

53.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
53.en: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
53.tl: walillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi liyajziya alladhīna asāū bimā ʿamilū wayajziya alladhīna aḥsanū bil-ḥus'nā

tr.85: Everything in the heavens and earth belongs to God. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and reward, with what is best, those who do good.
tr.19: And unto Allah belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, that He may reward those who do evil with that which they have done, and reward those who do good with goodness.
tr.22: Yea, to Allah belongs all that is in the heavens and on earth: so that He rewards those who do evil, according to their deeds, and He rewards those who do good, with what is best.
tr.203: And to Allâh belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth, that He may requite those who do evil with that which they have done (i.e. punish them in Hell), and reward those who do good, with what is best (i.e. Paradise).

53.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
53.en: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
53.tl: alladhīna yajtanibūna kabāira l-ith'mi wal-fawāḥisha illā l-lamama inna rabbaka wāsiʿu l-maghfirati huwa aʿlamu bikum idh ansha-akum mina l-arḍi wa-idh antum ajinnatun fī buṭūni ummahātikum falā tuzakkū anfusakum huwa aʿlamu bimani ittaqā

tr.85: As for those who avoid grave sins and foul acts, though they may commit small sins, your Lord is ample in forgiveness. He has been aware of you from the time He produced you from the earth and from your hiding places in your mothers’ wombs, so do not assert your own goodness:He knows best who is mindful of Him.
tr.19: Those who avoid enormities of sin and abominations, save the unwilled offences - (for them) lo! thy Lord is of vast mercy. He is Best Aware of you (from the time) when He created you from the earth, and when ye were hidden in the bellies of your mothers. Therefor ascribe not purity unto yourselves. He is Best Aware of him who wardeth off (evil).
tr.22: Those who avoid great sins and shameful deeds, only (falling into) small faults,- verily thy Lord is ample in forgiveness. He knows you well when He brings you out of the earth, And when ye are hidden in your mothers' wombs. Therefore justify not yourselves: He knows best who it is that guards against evil.
tr.203: Those who avoid great sins (See the Qur’ân, Verses: 6:152,153) and Al-Fawâhish (illegal sexual intercourse) except the small faults, - verily, your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well when He created you from the earth (Adam), and when you were fetuses in your mothers’ wombs. So ascribe not purity to yourselves. He knows best him who fears Allâh and keeps his duty to Him [i.e. those who are Al-Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2)].

53.en: Have you seen the one who turned away

tr.85: [Prophet], consider that man who turned away:
tr.19: Didst thou (O Muhammad) observe him who turned away,
tr.22: Seest thou one who turns back,
tr.203: Did you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) observe him who turned away (from Islâm).

53.en: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

tr.85: he only gave a little and then he stopped.
tr.19: And gave a little, then was grudging?
tr.22: Gives a little, then hardens (his heart)?
tr.203: And gave a little, then stopped (giving)?

53.en: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?

tr.85: Does he have knowledge of the Unseen? Can he see [the Hereafter]?
tr.19: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?
tr.22: What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?
tr.203: Is with him the knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees?

53.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
53.en: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
53.tl: am lam yunabba bimā fī ṣuḥufi mūsā

tr.85: Has he not been told what was written in the Scriptures of Moses
tr.19: Or hath he not had news of what is in the books of Moses
tr.22: Nay, is he not acquainted with what is in the Books of Moses-
tr.203: Or is he not informed with what is in the Pages (Scripture) of Mûsâ (Moses),

53.en: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

tr.85: and of Abraham, who fulfilled his duty:
tr.19: And Abraham who paid his debt:
tr.22: And of Abraham who fulfilled his engagements?-
tr.203: And of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) who fulfilled (or conveyed) all that (Allâh ordered him to do or convey):

53.en: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

tr.85: that no soul shall bear the burden of another;
tr.19: That no laden one shall bear another's load,
tr.22: Namely, that no bearer of burdens can bear the burden of another;
tr.203: That no burdened person (with sins) shall bear the burden (sins) of another.

53.ar: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
53.en: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
53.tl: wa-an laysa lil'insāni illā mā saʿā

tr.85: that man will only have what he has worked towards;
tr.19: And that man hath only that for which he maketh effort,
tr.22: That man can have nothing but what he strives for;
tr.203: And that man can have nothing but what he does (good or bad).

53.en: And that his effort is going to be seen -

tr.85: that his labour will be seen
tr.19: And that his effort will be seen.
tr.22: That (the fruit of) his striving will soon come in sight:
tr.203: And that his deeds will be seen.

53.en: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

tr.85: and that in the end he will be repaid in full for it;
tr.19: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
tr.22: Then will he be rewarded with a reward complete;
tr.203: Then he will be recompensed with a full and the best recompense.

53.en: And that to your Lord is the finality

tr.85: that the final goal is your Lord;
tr.19: And that thy Lord, He is the goal;
tr.22: That to thy Lord is the final Goal;
tr.203: And that to your Lord (Allâh) is the End (Return of everything).

53.en: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

tr.85: that it is He who makes people laugh and weep;
tr.19: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
tr.22: That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;
tr.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who makes (whom He wills) laugh, and makes (whom He wills) weep.

53.en: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

tr.85: that it is He who gives death and life;
tr.19: And that He it is Who giveth death and giveth life;
tr.22: That it is He Who granteth Death and Life;
tr.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who causes death and gives life.

53.en: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

tr.85: that He Himself created the two sexes, male and female,
tr.19: And that He createth the two spouses, the male and the female,
tr.22: That He did create in pairs,- male and female,
tr.203: And that He (Allâh) creates the pairs, male and female,

53.en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

tr.85: from an ejected drop of sperm;
tr.19: From a drop (of seed) when it is poured forth;
tr.22: From a seed when lodged (in its place);
tr.203: From Nutfah (drops of semen - male and female discharges) when it is emitted.

53.en: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

tr.85: that He will undertake the second Creation;
tr.19: And that He hath ordained the second bringing forth;
tr.22: That He hath promised a Second Creation (Raising of the Dead);
tr.203: And that upon Him (Allâh) is another bringing forth (Resurrection).

53.en: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

tr.85: that it is He who gives wealth and possessions;
tr.19: And that He it is Who enricheth and contenteth;
tr.22: That it is He Who giveth wealth and satisfaction;
tr.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who gives much or a little (of wealth and contentment)

53.en: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.

tr.85: that He is the Lord of Sirius;
tr.19: And that He it is Who is the Lord of Sirius;
tr.22: That He is the Lord of Sirius (the Mighty Star);
tr.203: And that He (Allâh) is the Lord of Sirius (the star which the pagan Arabs used to worship).

53.en: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad.

tr.85: that it was He who destroyed, in their entirety, ancient 'Ad
tr.19: And that He destroyed the former (tribe of) A'ad,
tr.22: And that it is He Who destroyed the (powerful) ancient 'Ad (people),
tr.203: And that it is He (Allâh) Who destroyed the former ‘Âd (people),

53.en: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

tr.85: and Thamud,
tr.19: And (the tribe of) Thamud He spared not;
tr.22: And the Thamud nor gave them a lease of perpetual life.
tr.203: And Thamûd (people): He spared none of them.

53.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
53.en: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
53.tl: waqawma nūḥin min qablu innahum kānū hum aẓlama wa-aṭghā

tr.85: and before them the people of Noah who were even more unjust and insolent;
tr.19: And the folk of Noah aforetime, Lo! they were more unjust and more rebellious;
tr.22: And before them, the people of Noah, for that they were (all) most unjust and most insolent transgressors,
tr.203: And the people of Nûh (Noah) aforetime. Verily, they were more unjust and more rebellious and transgressing [in disobeying Allâh and His Messenger Nûh (Noah) عليه السلام].

53.en: And the overturned towns He hurled down.

tr.85: that it was He who brought down the ruined cities
tr.19: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
tr.22: And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).
tr.203: And He destroyed the overthrown cities [of Sodom to which Prophet Lût (Lot) was sent].

53.en: And covered them by that which He covered.

tr.85: and enveloped them in the punishment He ordained for them?
tr.19: So that there covered them that which did cover.
tr.22: So that (ruins unknown) have covered them up.
tr.203: So there covered them that which did cover (i.e. torment with stones).

53.en: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

tr.85: Which then of your Lord’s blessings do you deny?
tr.19: Concerning which then, of the bounties of thy Lord, canst thou dispute?
tr.22: Then which of the gifts of thy Lord, (O man,) wilt thou dispute about?
tr.203: Then which of the Graces of your Lord (O man!) will you doubt?

53.en: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

tr.85: This is a warning just like the warnings sent in former times.
tr.19: This is a warner of the warners of old.
tr.22: This is a Warner, of the (series of) Warners of old!
tr.203: This (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a warner (Messenger) of the (series of) warners (Messengers) of old.

53.en: The Approaching Day has approached.

tr.85: The imminent Hour draws near
tr.19: The threatened Hour is nigh.
tr.22: The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:
tr.203: The Day of Resurrection draws near.

53.ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
53.en: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.
53.tl: laysa lahā min dūni l-lahi kāshifatun

tr.85: and only God can disclose it.
tr.19: None beside Allah can disclose it.
tr.22: No (soul) but Allah can lay it bare.
tr.203: None besides Allâh can avert it (or advance it or delay it).

53.en: Then at this statement do you wonder?

tr.85: Do you [people] marvel at this?
tr.19: Marvel ye then at this statement,
tr.22: Do ye then wonder at this recital?
tr.203: Do you then wonder at this recitation (the Qur’ân)?

53.en: And you laugh and do not weep

tr.85: Why do you laugh instead of weeping?
tr.19: And laugh and not weep,
tr.22: And will ye laugh and not weep,-
tr.203: And you laugh at it and weep not,

53.en: While you are proudly sporting?

tr.85: Why do you pay no heed?
tr.19: While ye amuse yourselves?
tr.22: Wasting your time in vanities?
tr.203: Wasting your (precious) lifetime in pastime and amusements (singing, etc.).

53.en: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

tr.85: Bow down before God and worship.
tr.19: Rather prostrate yourselves before Allah and serve Him.
tr.22: But fall ye down in prostration to Allah, and adore (Him)!
tr.203: So fall you down in prostration to Allâh and worship Him (Alone).

54.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
54.en: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
54.tl: iq'tarabati l-sāʿatu wa-inshaqqa l-qamaru

tr.85: The Hour draws near; the moon is split in two.
tr.19: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
tr.22: The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
tr.203: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder (the people of Makkah requested Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to show them a miracle, so he showed them the splitting of the moon).

54.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
54.en: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
54.tl: wa-in yaraw āyatan yuʿ'riḍū wayaqūlū siḥ'run mus'tamirrun

tr.85: Whenever the disbelievers see a sign, they turn away and say, ‘Same old sorcery!’
tr.19: And if they behold a portent they turn away and say: Prolonged illusion.
tr.22: But if they see a Sign, they turn away, and say, "This is (but) transient magic."
tr.203: And if they see a sign, they turn away, and say: "This is continuous magic."

54.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
54.en: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
54.tl: wakadhabū wa-ittabaʿū ahwāahum wakullu amrin mus'taqirrun

tr.85: They reject the truth and follow their own desires––everything is recorded––
tr.19: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
tr.22: They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
tr.203: They belied (the Verses of Allâh - this Qur’ân), and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled (according to the kind of deeds: good deeds will take their doers to Paradise, and similarly evil deeds will take their doers to Hell).

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
54.en: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.
54.tl: walaqad jāahum mina l-anbāi mā fīhi muz'dajarun

tr.85: although warning tales that should have restrained them have come down to them––
tr.19: And surely there hath come unto them news whereof the purport should deter,
tr.22: There have already come to them Recitals wherein there is (enough) to check (them),
tr.203: And indeed there has come to them news (in this Qur’ân) wherein there is (enough warning) to check (them from evil),

54.ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
54.en: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
54.tl: ḥik'matun bālighatun famā tugh'ni l-nudhuru

tr.85: farreaching wisdom––but these warnings do not help:
tr.19: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
tr.22: Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
tr.203: Perfect wisdom (this Qur’ân), but (the preaching of) warners benefit them not.

54.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
54.en: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
54.tl: fatawalla ʿanhum yawma yadʿu l-dāʿi ilā shayin nukurin

tr.85: so [Prophet] turn away from them. On the Day the Summoner will summon them to a horrific event,
tr.19: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad) on the day when the Summoner summoneth unto a painful thing.
tr.22: Therefore, (O Prophet,) turn away from them. The Day that the Caller will call (them) to a terrible affair,
tr.203: So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withdraw from them. The Day that the caller will call (them) to a terrible thing.

54.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
54.en: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
54.tl: khushaʿan abṣāruhum yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi ka-annahum jarādun muntashirun

tr.85: eyes downcast, they will come out of their graves like swarming locusts
tr.19: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
tr.22: They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
tr.203: They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,

54.ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
54.en: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
54.tl: muh'ṭiʿīna ilā l-dāʿi yaqūlu l-kāfirūna hādhā yawmun ʿasirun

tr.85: rushing towards the Summoner. The disbelievers will cry, ‘This is a stern day!’
tr.19: Hastening toward the summoner; the disbelievers say: This is a hard day.
tr.22: Hastening, with eyes transfixed, towards the Caller!- "Hard is this Day!", the Unbelievers will say.
tr.203: Hastening towards the caller. The disbelievers will say: "This is a hard Day."

54.ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
54.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
54.tl: kadhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥin fakadhabū ʿabdanā waqālū majnūnun wa-uz'dujira

tr.85: The people of Noah rejected the truth before them: they rejected Our servant, saying, ‘He is mad!’ Noah was rebuked,
tr.19: The folk of Noah denied before them, yea, they denied Our slave and said: A madman; and he was repulsed.
tr.22: Before them the People of Noah rejected (their messenger): they rejected Our servant, and said, "Here is one possessed!", and he was driven out.
tr.203: The people of Nûh (Noah) denied (their Messenger) before them. They rejected Our slave, and said: "A madman!" and he was insolently rebuked and threatened.

54.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
54.en: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
54.tl: fadaʿā rabbahu annī maghlūbun fa-intaṣir

tr.85: and so he called upon his Lord, ‘I am defeated: help me!’
tr.19: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
tr.22: Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
tr.203: Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"

54.ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
54.en: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
54.tl: fafataḥnā abwāba l-samāi bimāin mun'hamirin

tr.85: So We opened the gates of the sky with torrential water,
tr.19: Then opened We the gates of heaven with pouring water
tr.22: So We opened the gates of heaven, with water pouring forth.
tr.203: So We opened the gates of the heaven with water pouring forth.

54.ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
54.en: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
54.tl: wafajjarnā l-arḍa ʿuyūnan fal-taqā l-māu ʿalā amrin qad qudira

tr.85: burst the earth with gushing springs: the waters met for a preordained purpose.
tr.19: And caused the earth to gush forth springs, so that the waters met for a predestined purpose.
tr.22: And We caused the earth to gush forth with springs, so the waters met (and rose) to the extent decreed.
tr.203: And We caused springs to gush forth from the earth. So the waters (of the heaven and the earth) met for a matter predestined.

54.ar: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
54.en: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
54.tl: waḥamalnāhu ʿalā dhāti alwāḥin wadusurin

tr.85: We carried him along on a vessel of planks and nails
tr.19: And We carried him upon a thing of planks and nails,
tr.22: But We bore him on an (Ark) made of broad planks and caulked with palm-fibre:
tr.203: And We carried him on a (ship) made of planks and nails,

54.ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
54.en: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
54.tl: tajrī bi-aʿyuninā jazāan liman kāna kufira

tr.85: that floated under Our watchful eye, a reward for the one who had been rejected.
tr.19: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
tr.22: She floats under our eyes (and care): a recompense to one who had been rejected (with scorn)!
tr.203: Floating under Our Eyes: a reward for him who had been rejected!

54.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
54.en: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
54.tl: walaqad taraknāhā āyatan fahal min muddakirin

tr.85: We have left this as a sign: will anyone take heed?
tr.19: And verily We left it as a token; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.22: And We have left this as a Sign (for all time): then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.203: And indeed, We have left this as a sign. Then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

54.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
54.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
54.tl: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

tr.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
tr.19: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
tr.22: But how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning?
tr.203: Then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
54.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
54.tl: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

tr.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
tr.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.203: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any one who will remember (or receive admonition)?

54.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
54.en: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
54.tl: kadhabat ʿādun fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

tr.85: The people of 'Ad also rejected the truth. How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
tr.19: (The tribe of) A'ad rejected warnings. Then how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings.
tr.22: The 'Ad (people) (too) rejected (Truth): then how terrible was My Penalty and My Warning?
tr.203: ‘Âd (people) belied (their Prophet, Hûd); then how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

54.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
54.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
54.tl: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yawmi naḥsin mus'tamirrin

tr.85: We released a howling wind against them on a day of terrible disaster;
tr.19: Lo! We let loose on them a raging wind on a day of constant calamity,
tr.22: For We sent against them a furious wind, on a Day of violent Disaster,
tr.203: Verily, We sent against them a furious wind of harsh voice on a day of evil omen and continuous calamity.

54.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
54.en: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
54.tl: tanziʿu l-nāsa ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin munqaʿirin

tr.85: it swept people away like uprooted palm trunks.
tr.19: Sweeping men away as though they were uprooted trunks of palm-trees.
tr.22: Plucking out men as if they were roots of palm-trees torn up (from the ground).
tr.203: Plucking out men as if they were uprooted stems of date-palms.

54.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
54.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
54.tl: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

tr.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
tr.19: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
tr.22: Yea, how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
tr.203: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
54.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
54.tl: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

tr.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
tr.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.22: But We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.203: And We have indeed made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

54.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
54.en: Thamūd denied the warning.
54.tl: kadhabat thamūdu bil-nudhuri

tr.85: The people of Thamud also rejected the warnings:
tr.19: (The tribe of) Thamud rejected warnings
tr.22: The Thamud (also) rejected (their) Warners.
tr.203: Thamûd (people also) belied the warnings.

54.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
54.en: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
54.tl: faqālū abasharan minnā wāḥidan nattabiʿuhu innā idhan lafī ḍalālin wasuʿurin

tr.85: they said, ‘What? A man? Why should we follow a lone man from amongst ourselves? That would be misguided; quite insane!
tr.19: For they said; Is it a mortal man, alone among us, that we are to follow? Then indeed we should fall into error and madness.
tr.22: For they said: "What! a man! a Solitary one from among ourselves! shall we follow such a one? Truly should we then be straying in mind, and mad!
tr.203: And they said: "A man, alone among us - shall we follow him? Truly then we should be in error and distress (or madness)!"

54.ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
54.en: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
54.tl: a-ul'qiya l-dhik'ru ʿalayhi min bayninā bal huwa kadhābun ashirun

tr.85: Would a mes-sage be given to him alone out of all of us? No, he is an insolent liar!’
tr.19: Hath the remembrance been given unto him alone among us? Nay, but he is a rash liar.
tr.22: "Is it that the Message is sent to him, of all people amongst us? Nay, he is a liar, an insolent one!"
tr.203: "Is it that the Reminder is sent to him [Prophet Sâlih عليه السلام] alone from among us? Nay, he is an insolent liar!"

54.ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
54.en: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
54.tl: sayaʿlamūna ghadan mani l-kadhābu l-ashiru

tr.85: ‘Tomorrow they will know who is the insolent liar,
tr.19: (Unto their warner it was said): To-morrow they will know who is the rash liar.
tr.22: Ah! they will know on the morrow, which is the liar, the insolent one!
tr.203: Tomorrow they will come to know who is the liar, the insolent one!

54.ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
54.en: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
54.tl: innā mur'silū l-nāqati fit'natan lahum fa-ir'taqib'hum wa-iṣ'ṭabir

tr.85: for We shall send them a she-camel to test them: so watch them [Salih] and be patient.
tr.19: Lo! We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and have patience;
tr.22: For We will send the she-camel by way of trial for them. So watch them, (O Salih), and possess thyself in patience!
tr.203: Verily, We are sending the she-camel as a test for them. So watch them [O Sâlih عليه السلام], and be patient!

54.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
54.en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
54.tl: wanabbi'hum anna l-māa qis'matun baynahum kullu shir'bin muḥ'taḍarun

tr.85: Tell them the water is to be shared between them: each one should drink in turn.’
tr.19: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them. Every drinking will be witnessed.
tr.22: And tell them that the water is to be divided between them: Each one's right to drink being brought forward (by suitable turns).
tr.203: And inform them that the water is to be shared between (her and) them, each one’s right to drink being established (by turns).

54.ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
54.en: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
54.tl: fanādaw ṣāḥibahum fataʿāṭā faʿaqara

tr.85: But they called their companion, who took a sword and hamstrung the camel.
tr.19: But they call their comrade and he took and hamstrung (her).
tr.22: But they called to their companion, and he took a sword in hand, and hamstrung (her).
tr.203: But they called their comrade and he took (a sword) and killed (her).

54.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
54.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
54.tl: fakayfa kāna ʿadhābī wanudhuri

tr.85: How [terrible] was My punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!
tr.19: Then see how (dreadful) was My punishment after My warnings!
tr.22: Ah! how (terrible) was My Penalty and My Warning!
tr.203: Then, how (terrible) was My Torment and My Warnings?

54.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
54.en: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
54.tl: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ṣayḥatan wāḥidatan fakānū kahashīmi l-muḥ'taẓiri

tr.85: We released a single mighty blast against them and they ended up like a fencemaker’s dry sticks.
tr.19: Lo! We sent upon them one Shout, and they became as the dry twigs (rejected by) the builder of a cattle-fold.
tr.22: For We sent against them a single Mighty Blast, and they became like the dry stubble used by one who pens cattle.
tr.203: Verily, We sent against them a single Saihah (torment - awful cry), and they became like the stubble of a fold-builder.

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
54.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
54.tl: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

tr.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
tr.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.203: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

54.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
54.en: The people of Lot denied the warning.
54.tl: kadhabat qawmu lūṭin bil-nudhuri

tr.85: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
tr.19: The folk of Lot rejected warnings.
tr.22: The people of Lut rejected (his) warning.
tr.203: The people of Lût (Lot) belied the warnings.

54.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
54.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.
54.tl: innā arsalnā ʿalayhim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭin najjaynāhum bisaḥarin

tr.85: We released a stonebearing wind against them, all except the family of Lot. We saved them before dawn
tr.19: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
tr.22: We sent against them a violent Tornado with showers of stones, (which destroyed them), except Lut's household: them We delivered by early Dawn,-
tr.203: Verily, We sent against them a violent storm of stones (which destroyed them all), except the family of Lût (Lot), them We saved in the last hour of the night,

54.ar: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
54.en: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
54.tl: niʿ'matan min ʿindinā kadhālika najzī man shakara

tr.85: as a favour from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
tr.19: As grace from Us. Thus We reward him who giveth thanks.
tr.22: As a Grace from Us: thus do We reward those who give thanks.
tr.203: As a Favour from Us. Thus do We reward him who gives thanks (by obeying Us).

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
54.en: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
54.tl: walaqad andharahum baṭshatanā fatamāraw bil-nudhuri

tr.85: He warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warning-
tr.19: And he indeed had warned them of Our blow, but they did doubt the warnings.
tr.22: And (Lut) did warn them of Our Punishment, but they disputed about the Warning.
tr.203: And he [Lût (Lot)] indeed had warned them of Our Seizure (punishment), but they did doubt the warnings!

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
54.en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
54.tl: walaqad rāwadūhu ʿan ḍayfihi faṭamasnā aʿyunahum fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri

tr.85: they even demanded his guests from him- so We sealed their eyes- ‘ Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’-
tr.19: They even asked of him his guests for an ill purpose. Then We blinded their eyes (and said): Taste now My punishment after My warnings!
tr.22: And they even sought to snatch away his guests from him, but We blinded their eyes. (They heard:) "Now taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
tr.203: And they indeed sought to shame his guest (by asking to commit sodomy with them). So We blinded their eyes, (saying) "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
54.en: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
54.tl: walaqad ṣabbaḥahum buk'ratan ʿadhābun mus'taqirrun

tr.85: and early in the morning a punishment seized them that still remains-
tr.19: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
tr.22: Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
tr.203: And verily, an abiding torment seized them early in the morning.

54.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
54.en: So taste My punishment and warning.
54.tl: fadhūqū ʿadhābī wanudhuri

tr.85: ‘Taste My [terrible] punishment and [the fulfilment of] My warnings!’
tr.19: Now taste My punishment after My warnings!
tr.22: "So taste ye My Wrath and My Warning."
tr.203: "Then taste you My Torment and My Warnings."

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
54.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
54.tl: walaqad yassarnā l-qur'āna lildhik'ri fahal min muddakirin

tr.85: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: will anyone take heed?
tr.19: And in truth We have made the Qur'an easy to remember; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.22: And We have indeed made the Qur'an easy to understand and remember: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.203: And indeed, We have made the Qur’ân easy to understand and remember; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
54.en: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
54.tl: walaqad jāa āla fir'ʿawna l-nudhuru

tr.85: The people of Pharaoh also received warnings.
tr.19: And warnings came in truth unto the house of Pharaoh
tr.22: To the People of Pharaoh, too, aforetime, came Warners (from Allah).
tr.203: And indeed, warnings came to the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) [through Mûsâ (Moses) and Hârûn (Aaron)].

54.ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
54.en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
54.tl: kadhabū biāyātinā kullihā fa-akhadhnāhum akhdha ʿazīzin muq'tadirin

tr.85: They rejected all Our signs so We seized them with all Our might and power.
tr.19: Who denied Our revelations, every one. Therefore We grasped them with the grasp of the Mighty, the Powerful.
tr.22: The (people) rejected all Our Signs; but We seized them with such Penalty (as comes) from One Exalted in Power, able to carry out His Will.
tr.203: (They) belied all Our Signs, so We seized them with a Seizure of the All-Mighty, All-Capable (Omnipotent).

54.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
54.en: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
54.tl: akuffārukum khayrun min ulāikum am lakum barāatun fī l-zuburi

tr.85: ‘Are your disbelievers any better than these? Were you given an exemption in the Scripture?’
tr.19: Are your disbelievers better than those, or have ye some immunity in the scriptures?
tr.22: Are your Unbelievers, (O Quraish), better than they? Or have ye an immunity in the Sacred Books?
tr.203: Are your disbelievers (O Quraish!) better than these [nations of Nûh (Noah), Lût (Lot), Sâlih, and the people of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who were destroyed)? Or have you an immunity (against Our Torment) in the Divine Scriptures?

54.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
54.en: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
54.tl: am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamīʿun muntaṣirun

tr.85: Do they perhaps say, ‘We are a great army and we shall be victorious’?
tr.19: Or say they: We are a host victorious?
tr.22: Or do they say: "We acting together can defend ourselves"?
tr.203: Or say they: "We are a great multitude, victorious?"

54.ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
54.en: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
54.tl: sayuh'zamu l-jamʿu wayuwallūna l-dubura

tr.85: Their forces will be routed and they will turn tail and flee.
tr.19: The hosts will all be routed and will turn and flee.
tr.22: Soon will their multitude be put to flight, and they will show their backs.
tr.203: Their multitude will be put to flight, and they will show their backs.

54.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
54.en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
54.tl: bali l-sāʿatu mawʿiduhum wal-sāʿatu adhā wa-amarru

tr.85: But the Hour is their appointed time- the Hour is more severe and bitter:
tr.19: Nay, but the Hour (of doom) is their appointed tryst, and the Hour will be more wretched and more bitter (than their earthly failure).
tr.22: Nay, the Hour (of Judgment) is the time promised them (for their full recompense): And that Hour will be most grievous and most bitter.
tr.203: Nay, but the Hour is their appointed time (for their full recompense), and the Hour will be more grievous and more bitter.

54.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
54.en: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..
54.tl: inna l-muj'rimīna fī ḍalālin wasuʿurin

tr.85: truly the wicked are misguided and quite insane––
tr.19: Lo! the guilty are in error and madness.
tr.22: Truly those in sin are the ones straying in mind, and mad.
tr.203: Verily the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals) are in error (in this world) and will burn (in the Hell-fire in the Hereafter).

54.ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
54.en: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
54.tl: yawma yus'ḥabūna fī l-nāri ʿalā wujūhihim dhūqū massa saqara

tr.85: on the Day when they are dragged on their faces in Hell. ‘Feel the touch of Hell.’
tr.19: On the day when they are dragged into the Fire upon their faces (it is said unto them): Feel the touch of hell.
tr.22: The Day they will be dragged through the Fire on their faces, (they will hear:) "Taste ye the touch of Hell!"
tr.203: The Day they will be dragged on their faces into the Fire (it will be said to them): "Taste you the touch of Hell!"

54.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
54.en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
54.tl: innā kulla shayin khalaqnāhu biqadarin

tr.85: We have created all things in due measure;
tr.19: Lo! We have created every thing by measure.
tr.22: Verily, all things have We created in proportion and measure.
tr.203: Verily, We have created all things with Qadar (Divine Preordainments of all things before their creation as written in the Book of Decrees Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz).

54.ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
54.en: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
54.tl: wamā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥin bil-baṣari

tr.85: when We ordain something it happens at once, in the blink of an eye;
tr.19: And Our commandment is but one (commandment), as the twinkling of an eye.
tr.22: And Our Command is but a single (Act),- like the twinkling of an eye.
tr.203: And Our Commandment is but one as the twinkling of an eye.

54.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
54.en: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
54.tl: walaqad ahlaknā ashyāʿakum fahal min muddakirin

tr.85: We have destroyed the likes of you in the past. Will anyone take heed?
tr.19: And verily We have destroyed your fellows; but is there any that remembereth?
tr.22: And (oft) in the past, have We destroyed gangs like unto you: then is there any that will receive admonition?
tr.203: And indeed, We have destroyed your likes; then is there any that will remember (or receive admonition)?

54.ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
54.en: And everything they did is in written records.
54.tl: wakullu shayin faʿalūhu fī l-zuburi

tr.85: Everything they do is noted in their records:
tr.19: And every thing they did is in the scriptures,
tr.22: All that they do is noted in (their) Books (of Deeds):
tr.203: And everything they have done is noted in (their) Records (of deeds).

54.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
54.en: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
54.tl: wakullu ṣaghīrin wakabīrin mus'taṭarun

tr.85: every action, great or small, is recorded.
tr.19: And every small and great thing is recorded.
tr.22: Every matter, small and great, is on record.
tr.203: And everything, small and big, is written down (in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz already beforehand i.e. before it befalls, or is done by its doer: الإيمان بالقدر) (See the Qur’ân V.57:22 and its footnote).

54.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
54.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
54.tl: inna l-mutaqīna fī jannātin wanaharin

tr.85: The righteous will live securely among Gardens and rivers,
tr.19: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
tr.22: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
tr.203: Verily, The Muttaqûn (the pious - see V.2:2), will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers (Paradise).

54.ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
54.en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
54.tl: fī maqʿadi ṣid'qin ʿinda malīkin muq'tadirin

tr.85: secure in the presence of an all-powerful Sovereign.
tr.19: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
tr.22: In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
tr.203: In a seat of truth (i.e. Paradise), near the Omnipotent King (Allâh, the One, the All-Blessed, the Most High, the Owner of Majesty and Honour).

55.en: The Most Merciful

tr.85: It is the Lord of Mercy
tr.19: The Beneficent
tr.22: (Allah) Most Gracious!
tr.203: The Most Gracious (Allâh)!

55.en: Taught the Qur’ān,

tr.85: who taught the Quran.
tr.19: Hath made known the Qur'an.
tr.22: It is He Who has taught the Qur'an.
tr.203: He has taught (you mankind) the Qur’ân (by His Mercy).

55.en: Created man,

tr.85: He created man
tr.19: He hath created man.
tr.22: He has created man:
tr.203: He created man.

55.en: [And] taught him eloquence.

tr.85: and taught him to communicate.
tr.19: He hath taught him utterance.
tr.22: He has taught him speech (and intelligence).
tr.203: He taught him eloquent speech.

55.en: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

tr.85: The sun and the moon follow their calculated courses;
tr.19: The sun and the moon are made punctual.
tr.22: The sun and the moon follow courses (exactly) computed;
tr.203: The sun and the moon run on their fixed courses (exactly) calculated with measured out stages for each (for reckoning).

55.en: And the stars and trees prostrate.

tr.85: the plants and the trees submit to His designs;
tr.19: The stars and the trees prostrate.
tr.22: And the herbs and the trees - both (alike) prostrate in adoration.
tr.203: And the herbs (or stars) and the trees both prostrate themselves (to Allah - See V.22:18) (Tafsir Ibn Kathir)

55.en: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

tr.85: He has raised up the sky. He has set the balance
tr.19: And the sky He hath uplifted; and He hath set the measure,
tr.22: And the Firmament has He raised high, and He has set up the Balance (of Justice),
tr.203: And the heaven: He has raised it high, and He has set up the Balance.

55.en: That you not transgress within the balance.

tr.85: so that you may not exceed in the balance:
tr.19: That ye exceed not the measure,
tr.22: In order that ye may not transgress (due) balance.
tr.203: In order that you may not transgress (due) balance.

55.ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
55.en: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
55.tl: wa-aqīmū l-wazna bil-qis'ṭi walā tukh'sirū l-mīzāna

tr.85: weigh with justice and do not fall short in the balance.
tr.19: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
tr.22: So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
tr.203: And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.

55.en: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

tr.85: He set down the Earth for His creatures,
tr.19: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
tr.22: It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
tr.203: And the earth: He has put down (laid) for the creatures.

55.en: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

tr.85: with its fruits, its palm trees with sheathed clusters,
tr.19: Wherein are fruit and sheathed palm-trees,
tr.22: Therein is fruit and date-palms, producing spathes (enclosing dates);
tr.203: Therein are fruits and date-palms producing sheathed fruit-stalks (enclosing dates).

55.en: And grain having husks and scented plants.

tr.85: its husked grain, its fragrant plants.
tr.19: Husked grain and scented herb.
tr.22: Also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-smelling plants.
tr.203: And also corn, with (its) leaves and stalk for fodder, and sweet-scented plants.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

tr.85: He created mankind out of dried clay, like pottery,
tr.19: He created man of clay like the potter's,
tr.22: He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
tr.203: He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.

55.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
55.en: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
55.tl: wakhalaqa l-jāna min mārijin min nārin

tr.85: the jinn out of smokeless fire.
tr.19: And the jinn did He create of smokeless fire.
tr.22: And He created Jinns from fire free of smoke:
tr.203: And the jinn: He created from a smokeless flame of fire.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

tr.85: He is Lord of the two risings and Lord of the two settings.
tr.19: Lord of the two Easts, and Lord of the two Wests!
tr.22: (He is) Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests:
tr.203: (He is) the Lord of the two easts (places of sunrise during early summer and early winter) and the Lord of the two wests (places of sunset during early summer and early winter).

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];

tr.85: He released the two bodies of [fresh and salt] water. They meet,
tr.19: He hath loosed the two seas. They meet.
tr.22: He has let free the two bodies of flowing water, meeting together:
tr.203: He has let loose the two seas (the salt and fresh water) meeting together.

55.en: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

tr.85: yet there is a barrier between them they do not cross.
tr.19: There is a barrier between them. They encroach not (one upon the other).
tr.22: Between them is a Barrier which they do not transgress:
tr.203: Between them is a barrier which none of them can transgress.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

tr.85: Pearls come forth from them: large ones, and small, brilliant ones.
tr.19: There cometh forth from both of them the pearl and coral-stone.
tr.22: Out of them come Pearls and Coral:
tr.203: Out of them both come out pearl and coral.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
55.en: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
55.tl: walahu l-jawāri l-munshaātu fī l-baḥri kal-aʿlāmi

tr.85: His are the moving ships that float, high as mountains, on the sea.
tr.19: His are the ships displayed upon the sea, like banners.
tr.22: And His are the Ships sailing smoothly through the seas, lofty as mountains:
tr.203: And His are the ships going and coming in the seas, like mountains.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

tr.85: Everyone on earth perishes;
tr.19: Everyone that is thereon will pass away;
tr.22: All that is on earth will perish:
tr.203: Whatsoever is on it (the earth) will perish.

55.ar: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
55.en: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
55.tl: wayabqā wajhu rabbika dhū l-jalāli wal-ik'rāmi

tr.85: all that remains is the Face of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
tr.19: There remaineth but the Countenance of thy Lord of Might and Glory.
tr.22: But will abide (for ever) the Face of thy Lord,- full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
tr.203: And the Face of your Lord full of Majesty and Honour will remain forever.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
55.en: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
55.tl: yasaluhu man fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi kulla yawmin huwa fī shanin

tr.85: Everyone in heaven and earth entreats Him; every day He is at work.
tr.19: All that are in the heavens and the earth entreat Him. Every day He exerciseth (universal) power.
tr.22: Of Him seeks (its need) every creature in the heavens and on earth: every day in (new) Splendour doth He (shine)!
tr.203: Whosoever is in the heavens and on earth begs of Him (its needs from Him). Every day He is (engaged) in some affair (such as giving honour or disgrace to some, life or death to some, etc.)!

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.

tr.85: We shall attend to you two huge armies [of jinn and mankind].
tr.19: We shall dispose of you, O ye two dependents (man and jinn).
tr.22: Soon shall We settle your affairs, O both ye worlds!
tr.203: We shall attend to you, O you two classes (jinn and men)!

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
55.en: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].
55.tl: yāmaʿshara l-jini wal-insi ini is'taṭaʿtum an tanfudhū min aqṭāri l-samāwāti wal-arḍi fa-unfudhū lā tanfudhūna illā bisul'ṭānin

tr.85: Jinn and mankind, if you can pass beyond the regions of heaven and earth, then do so: you will not pass without Our authority.
tr.19: O company of jinn and men, if ye have power to penetrate (all) regions of the heavens and the earth, then penetrate (them)! Ye will never penetrate them save with (Our) sanction.
tr.22: O ye assembly of Jinns and men! If it be ye can pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, pass ye! not without authority shall ye be able to pass!
tr.203: O assembly of jinn and men! If you have power to pass beyond the zones of the heavens and the earth, then pass beyond (them)! But you will never be able to pass them, except with authority (from Allâh)!

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
55.en: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
55.tl: yur'salu ʿalaykumā shuwāẓun min nārin wanuḥāsun falā tantaṣirāni
