tr.85: A flash of fire and smoke will be released upon you and no one will come to your aid.
tr.19: There will be sent, against you both, heat of fire and flash of brass, and ye will not escape.
tr.22: On you will be sent (O ye evil ones twain!) a flame of fire (to burn) and a smoke (to choke): no defence will ye have:
tr.203: There will be sent against you both, smokeless flames of fire and (molten) brass, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
55.en: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
55.tl: fa-idhā inshaqqati l-samāu fakānat wardatan kal-dihāni

tr.85: When the sky is torn apart and turns crimson, like red hide.
tr.19: And when the heaven splitteth asunder and becometh rosy like red hide -
tr.22: When the sky is rent asunder, and it becomes red like ointment:
tr.203: Then when the heaven is rent asunder, and it becomes rosy or red like red-oil, or red hide - [See V.70:8]

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
55.en: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
55.tl: fayawma-idhin lā yus'alu ʿan dhanbihi insun walā jānnun

tr.85: On that Day neither mankind nor jinn will be asked about their sins.
tr.19: On that day neither man nor jinni will be questioned of his sin.
tr.22: On that Day no question will be asked of man or Jinn as to his sin.
tr.203: So on that Day no question will be asked of man or jinns as to his sin, [because they have already been known from their faces either white (dwellers of Paradise - true believers of Islamic Monotheism) or black (dwellers of Hell - polytheists; disbelievers, criminals)].

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
55.en: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
55.tl: yuʿ'rafu l-muj'rimūna bisīmāhum fayu'khadhu bil-nawāṣī wal-aqdāmi

tr.85: The guilty will be known by their mark and will be seized by their foreheads and their feet.
tr.19: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
tr.22: (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
tr.203: The Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) will be known by their marks (black faces), and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
55.en: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
55.tl: hādhihi jahannamu allatī yukadhibu bihā l-muj'rimūna

tr.85: This is the Hell the guilty deny,
tr.19: This is hell which the guilty deny.
tr.22: This is the Hell which the Sinners deny:
tr.203: This is the Hell which the Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, sinners) denied.

55.en: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

tr.85: but they will go round between its flames and scalding water.
tr.19: They go circling round between it and fierce, boiling water.
tr.22: In its midst and in the midst of boiling hot water will they wander round!
tr.203: They will go between it (Hell) and the fierce boiling water!

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -

tr.85: For those who fear [the time when they will] stand before their Lord there are two gardens.
tr.19: But for him who feareth the standing before his Lord there are two gardens.
tr.22: But for such as fear the time when they will stand before (the Judgment Seat of) their Lord, there will be two Gardens-
tr.203: But for him who fears the standing before his Lord, there will be two Gardens (i.e. in Paradise).

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: Having [spreading] branches.

tr.85: With shading branches.
tr.19: Of spreading branches.
tr.22: Containing all kinds (of trees and delights);-
tr.203: With spreading branches.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

tr.85: With a pair of flowing springs.
tr.19: Wherein are two fountains flowing.
tr.22: In them (each) will be two Springs flowing (free);
tr.203: In them (both) will be two springs flowing (free).

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

tr.85: With every kind of fruit in pairs.
tr.19: Wherein is every kind of fruit in pairs.
tr.22: In them will be Fruits of every kind, two and two.
tr.203: In them (both) will be every kind of fruit in pairs.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
55.en: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
55.tl: muttakiīna ʿalā furushin baṭāinuhā min is'tabraqin wajanā l-janatayni dānin

tr.85: They will sit on couches upholstered with brocade, the fruit of both gardens within easy reach.
tr.19: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.
tr.22: They will recline on Carpets, whose inner linings will be of rich brocade: the Fruit of the Gardens will be near (and easy of reach).
tr.203: Reclining upon the couches lined with silk brocade, and the fruits of the two Gardens will be near at hand.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
55.en: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
55.tl: fīhinna qāṣirātu l-ṭarfi lam yaṭmith'hunna insun qablahum walā jānnun

tr.85: There will be maidens restraining their glances, untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
tr.19: Therein are those of modest gaze, whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them.
tr.22: In them will be (Maidens), chaste, restraining their glances, whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
tr.203: Wherein both will be Qâsirât-ut-Tarf [chaste females (wives) restraining their glances, desiring none except their husbands], with whom no man or jinni has had tamth before them.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: As if they were rubies and coral.

tr.85: Like rubies and brilliant pearls.
tr.19: (In beauty) like the jacynth and the coral-stone.
tr.22: Like unto Rubies and coral.
tr.203: (In beauty) they are like rubies and coral.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

tr.85: Shall the reward of good be anything but good?
tr.19: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?
tr.22: Is there any Reward for Good - other than Good?
tr.203: Is there any reward for good other than good?

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

tr.85: There are two other gardens below these two.
tr.19: And beside them are two other gardens,
tr.22: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens,-
tr.203: And besides these two, there are two other Gardens (i.e. in Paradise).

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: Dark green [in color].

tr.85: Both of deepest green.
tr.19: Dark green with foliage.
tr.22: Dark-green in colour (from plentiful watering).
tr.203: Dark green (in colour).

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

tr.85: With a pair of gushing springs.
tr.19: Wherein are two abundant springs.
tr.22: In them (each) will be two Springs pouring forth water in continuous abundance:
tr.203: In them (both) will be two springs gushing forth.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

tr.85: With fruits- date palms and pomegranate trees.
tr.19: Wherein is fruit, the date-palm and pomegranate.
tr.22: In them will be Fruits, and dates and pomegranates:
tr.203: In them (both) will be fruits, and date-palms and pomegranates.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: In them are good and beautiful women -

tr.85: There are good-natured, beautiful maidens.
tr.19: Wherein (are found) the good and beautiful -
tr.22: In them will be fair (Companions), good, beautiful;-
tr.203: Therein (Gardens) will be Khairâtun-Hisân [fair (wives) good and beautiful];

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.en: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

tr.85: Dark-eyed, sheltered in pavilions.
tr.19: Fair ones, close-guarded in pavilions -
tr.22: Companions restrained (as to their glances), in (goodly) pavilions;-
tr.203: Hûr (beautiful, fair females) guarded in pavilions;

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny? -
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
55.en: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
55.tl: lam yaṭmith'hunna insun qablahum walā jānnun

tr.85: Untouched beforehand by man or jinn.
tr.19: Whom neither man nor jinni will have touched before them -
tr.22: Whom no man or Jinn before them has touched;-
tr.203: With whom no man or jinni has had tamth before them.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?-
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ
55.en: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
55.tl: muttakiīna ʿalā rafrafin khuḍ'rin waʿabqariyyin ḥisānin

tr.85: They will all sit on green cushions and fine carpets.
tr.19: Reclining on green cushions and fair carpets.
tr.22: Reclining on green Cushions and rich Carpets of beauty.
tr.203: Reclining on green cushions and rich beautiful mattresses.

55.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tr.85: Which, then, of your Lord’s blessings do you both deny?
tr.19: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
tr.22: Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
tr.203: Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinn and men) deny?

55.ar: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
55.en: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
55.tl: tabāraka us'mu rabbika dhī l-jalāli wal-ik'rāmi

tr.85: Blessed is the name of your Lord, full of majesty, bestowing honour.
tr.19: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
tr.22: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
tr.203: Blessed be the Name of your Lord (Allâh), the Owner of Majesty and Honour.

56.en: When the Occurrence occurs,

tr.85: When that which is coming arrives,
tr.19: When the event befalleth -
tr.22: When the Event inevitable cometh to pass,
tr.203: When the Event (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) befalls.

56.en: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

tr.85: no one will be able to deny it has come,
tr.19: There is no denying that it will befall -
tr.22: Then will no (soul) entertain falsehood concerning its coming.
tr.203: And there can be no denial of its befalling.

56.en: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

tr.85: bringing low and raising high.
tr.19: Abasing (some), exalting (others);
tr.22: (Many) will it bring low; (many) will it exalt;
tr.203: Bringing low (some - those who will enter Hell) Exalting (others - those who will enter Paradise). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]

56.en: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

tr.85: When the earth is shaken violently
tr.19: When the earth is shaken with a shock
tr.22: When the earth shall be shaken to its depths,
tr.203: When the earth will be shaken with a terrible shake.

56.en: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

tr.85: and the mountains are ground to powder
tr.19: And the hills are ground to powder
tr.22: And the mountains shall be crumbled to atoms,
tr.203: And the mountains will be powdered to dust,

56.en: And become dust dispersing,

tr.85: and turn to scattered dust,
tr.19: So that they become a scattered dust,
tr.22: Becoming dust scattered abroad,
tr.203: So that they will become floating dust particles.

56.en: And you become [of] three kinds:

tr.85: then you will be sorted into three classes.
tr.19: And ye will be three kinds:
tr.22: And ye shall be sorted out into three classes.
tr.203: And you (all) will be in three groups.

56.en: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

tr.85: Those on the Right––what people they are!
tr.19: (First) those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
tr.22: Then (there will be) the Companions of the Right Hand;- What will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
tr.203: So those on the Right Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Records in their right hands) - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand! (As a respect for them, because they will enter Paradise).

56.en: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?

tr.85: Those on the Left––what people they are!
tr.19: And (then) those on the left hand; what of those on the left hand?
tr.22: And the Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
tr.203: And those on the Left Hand (i.e. those who will be given their Record in their left hands) - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand! (As a disgrace for them, because they will enter Hell).

56.en: And the forerunners, the forerunners -

tr.85: And those in front––ahead indeed!
tr.19: And the foremost in the race, the foremost in the race:
tr.22: And those Foremost (in Faith) will be Foremost (in the Hereafter).
tr.203: And those foremost [(in Islâmic Faith of Monotheism and in performing righteous deeds) in the life of this world on the very first call for to embrace Islâm] will be foremost (in Paradise).

56.en: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

tr.85: For these will be the ones brought nearest to God
tr.19: Those are they who will be brought nigh
tr.22: These will be those Nearest to Allah:
tr.203: These will be the nearest (to Allâh).

56.en: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

tr.85: in Gardens of Bliss:
tr.19: In gardens of delight;
tr.22: In Gardens of Bliss:
tr.203: In the Gardens of Delight (Paradise).

56.en: A [large] company of the former peoples

tr.85: many from the past
tr.19: A multitude of those of old
tr.22: A number of people from those of old,
tr.203: A multitude of those (foremost) will be from the first generations (who embraced Islâm).

56.en: And a few of the later peoples,

tr.85: and a few from later generations.
tr.19: And a few of those of later time.
tr.22: And a few from those of later times.
tr.203: And a few of those (foremost) will be from the later generations.

56.en: On thrones woven [with ornament],

tr.85: On couches of well-woven cloth
tr.19: On lined couches,
tr.22: (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
tr.203: (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones.

56.en: Reclining on them, facing each other.

tr.85: they will sit facing each other;
tr.19: Reclining therein face to face.
tr.22: Reclining on them, facing each other.
tr.203: Reclining thereon, face to face.

56.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.

tr.85: everlasting youths will go round among them
tr.19: There wait on them immortal youths
tr.22: Round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness),
tr.203: Immortal boys will go around them (serving),

56.en: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

tr.85: with glasses, flagons, and cups of a pure drink
tr.19: With bowls and ewers and a cup from a pure spring
tr.22: With goblets, (shining) beakers, and cups (filled) out of clear-flowing fountains:
tr.203: With cups, and jugs, and a glass of flowing wine,

56.en: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

tr.85: that causes no headache or intoxication;
tr.19: Wherefrom they get no aching of the head nor any madness,
tr.22: No after-ache will they receive therefrom, nor will they suffer intoxication:
tr.203: Wherefrom they will get neither any aching of the head, nor any intoxication.

56.en: And fruit of what they select

tr.85: [there will be] any fruit they choose;
tr.19: And fruit that they prefer
tr.22: And with fruits, any that they may select:
tr.203: And with fruit that they may choose.

56.en: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

tr.85: the meat of any bird they like;
tr.19: And flesh of fowls that they desire.
tr.22: And the flesh of fowls, any that they may desire.
tr.203: And with the flesh of fowls that they desire.

56.en: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

tr.85: and beautiful companions
tr.19: And (there are) fair ones with wide, lovely eyes,
tr.22: And (there will be) Companions with beautiful, big, and lustrous eyes,-
tr.203: And (there will be) Hûr (fair females) with wide, lovely eyes (as wives for "Al-Muttaqûn" - the pious - See V. 2:2),

56.en: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

tr.85: like hidden pearls:
tr.19: Like unto hidden pearls,
tr.22: Like unto Pearls well-guarded.
tr.203: Like unto preserved pearls.

56.en: As reward for what they used to do.

tr.85: a reward for what they used to do.
tr.19: Reward for what they used to do.
tr.22: A Reward for the deeds of their past (life).
tr.203: A reward for what they used to do.

56.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
56.en: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
56.tl: lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā tathīman

tr.85: They will hear no idle or sinful talk there,
tr.19: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
tr.22: Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
tr.203: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting).

56.en: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.

tr.85: only clean and wholesome speech.
tr.19: (Naught) but the saying: Peace, (and again) Peace.
tr.22: Only the saying, "Peace! Peace".
tr.203: But only the saying of: Salâm! Salâm! (greetings with peace)!

56.en: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

tr.85: Those on the Right, what people they are!
tr.19: And those on the right hand; what of those on the right hand?
tr.22: The Companions of the Right Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Right Hand?
tr.203: And those on the Right Hand - how (fortunate) will be those on the Right Hand?

56.en: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.

tr.85: They will dwell amid thornless lote trees
tr.19: Among thornless lote-trees
tr.22: (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
tr.203: (They will be) among thornless lote-trees,

56.en: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].

tr.85: and clustered acacia
tr.19: And clustered plantains,
tr.22: Among Talh trees with flowers (or fruits) piled one above another,-
tr.203: And among Talh (banana-trees) with fruits piled one above another,

56.en: And shade extended.

tr.85: with spreading shade,
tr.19: And spreading shade,
tr.22: In shade long-extended,
tr.203: And in shade long-extended,

56.en: And water poured out

tr.85: constantly flowing water,
tr.19: And water gushing,
tr.22: By water flowing constantly,
tr.203: And by water flowing constantly,

56.en: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

tr.85: abundant fruits,
tr.19: And fruit in plenty
tr.22: And fruit in abundance.
tr.203: And fruit in plenty,

56.en: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

tr.85: unfailing, unforbidden,
tr.19: Neither out of reach nor yet forbidden,
tr.22: Whose season is not limited, nor (supply) forbidden,
tr.203: Whose supply is not cut off (by change of season), nor are they out of reach,

56.en: And [upon] beds raised high.

tr.85: with incomparable companions
tr.19: And raised couches;
tr.22: And on Thrones (of Dignity), raised high.
tr.203: And on couches or thrones, raised high.

56.en: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation

tr.85: We have specially created––
tr.19: Lo! We have created them a (new) creation
tr.22: We have created (their Companions) of special creation.
tr.203: Verily, We have created them (maidens) of special creation.

56.en: And made them virgins,

tr.85: virginal,
tr.19: And made them virgins,
tr.22: And made them virgin - pure (and undefiled), -
tr.203: And made them virgins.

56.en: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

tr.85: loving, of matching age––
tr.19: Lovers, friends,
tr.22: Beloved (by nature), equal in age,-
tr.203: Loving (their husbands only), (and) of equal age.

56.en: For the companions of the right [who are]

tr.85: for those on the Right,
tr.19: For those on the right hand;
tr.22: For the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.203: For those on the Right Hand.

56.en: A company of the former peoples

tr.85: many from the past
tr.19: A multitude of those of old
tr.22: A (goodly) number from those of old,
tr.203: A multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the first generation (who embraced Islâm).

56.en: And a company of the later peoples.

tr.85: and many from later generations.
tr.19: And a multitude of those of later time.
tr.22: And a (goodly) number from those of later times.
tr.203: And a multitude of those (on the Right Hand) will be from the later generations.

56.en: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

tr.85: But those on the Left, what people they are!
tr.19: And those on the left hand: What of those on the left hand?
tr.22: The Companions of the Left Hand,- what will be the Companions of the Left Hand?
tr.203: And those on the Left Hand - how (unfortunate) will be those on the Left Hand?

56.en: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

tr.85: They will dwell amid scorching wind and scalding water
tr.19: In scorching wind and scalding water
tr.22: (They will be) in the midst of a Fierce Blast of Fire and in Boiling Water,
tr.203: In fierce hot wind and boiling water,

56.en: And a shade of black smoke,

tr.85: in the shadow of black smoke,
tr.19: And shadow of black smoke,
tr.22: And in the shades of Black Smoke:
tr.203: And shadow of black smoke,

56.en: Neither cool nor beneficial.

tr.85: neither cool nor refreshing.
tr.19: Neither cool nor refreshing.
tr.22: Nothing (will there be) to refresh, nor to please:
tr.203: (That shadow) neither cool, nor (even) pleasant,

56.en: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

tr.85: Before, they overindulged in luxury
tr.19: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
tr.22: For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
tr.203: Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,

56.en: And they used to persist in the great violation,

tr.85: and persisted in great sin,
tr.19: And used to persist in the awful sin.
tr.22: And persisted obstinately in wickedness supreme!
tr.203: And were persisting in great sin (joining partners in worship along with Allâh, committing murder and other crimes)

56.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
56.en: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
56.tl: wakānū yaqūlūna a-idhā mit'nā wakunnā turāban waʿiẓāman a-innā lamabʿūthūna

tr.85: always saying, ‘What? When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up?
tr.19: And they used to say: When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again,
tr.22: And they used to say, "What! when we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be raised up again?-
tr.203: And they used to say: "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then indeed be resurrected?

56.en: And our forefathers [as well]?"

tr.85: And our earliest forefathers too?’
tr.19: And also our forefathers?
tr.22: "(We) and our fathers of old?"
tr.203: "And also our forefathers?"

56.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘The earliest and latest generations
tr.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): Lo! those of old and those of later time
tr.22: Say: "Yea, those of old and those of later times,
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "(Yes) verily, those of old, and those of later times.

56.en: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

tr.85: will all be gathered on a predetermined Day
tr.19: Will all be brought together to the tryst of an appointed day.
tr.22: "All will certainly be gathered together for the meeting appointed for a Day well-known.
tr.203: "All will surely be gathered together for appointed Meeting of a known Day.

56.en: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

tr.85: and you who have gone astray and denied the truth
tr.19: Then lo! ye, the erring, the deniers,
tr.22: "Then will ye truly,- O ye that go wrong, and treat (Truth) as Falsehood!-
tr.203: "Then moreover, verily you the erring-ones, the deniers (of Resurrection)!

56.en: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

tr.85: will eat from the bitter tree of Zaqqum,
tr.19: Ye verily will eat of a tree called Zaqqum
tr.22: "Ye will surely taste of the Tree of Zaqqum.
tr.203: "You verily will eat of the trees of Zaqqûm.

56.en: And filling with it your bellies

tr.85: filling your bellies with it,
tr.19: And will fill your bellies therewith;
tr.22: "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
tr.203: "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,

56.en: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.

tr.85: and drink scalding water,
tr.19: And thereon ye will drink of boiling water,
tr.22: "And drink Boiling Water on top of it:
tr.203: "And drink boiling water on top of it.

56.en: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

tr.85: lapping it like thirsty camels.’
tr.19: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
tr.22: "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
tr.203: "And you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"

56.en: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

tr.85: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgement.
tr.19: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
tr.22: Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
tr.203: That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!

56.en: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

tr.85: It was We who created you: will you not believe?
tr.19: We created you. Will ye then admit the truth?
tr.22: It is We Who have created you: why will ye not witness the Truth?
tr.203: We created you: then why do you believe not?

56.en: Have you seen that which you emit?

tr.85: Consider [the semen] you eject-
tr.19: Have ye seen that which ye emit?
tr.22: Do ye then see?- The (human Seed) that ye throw out,-
tr.203: Then tell Me (about) the (human) semen that you emit.

56.en: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

tr.85: do you create it yourselves or are We the Creator?
tr.19: Do ye create it or are We the Creator?
tr.22: Is it ye who create it, or are We the Creators?
tr.203: Is it you who create it (i.e. make this semen into a perfect human being), or are We the Creator?

56.ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
56.en: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
56.tl: naḥnu qaddarnā baynakumu l-mawta wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna

tr.85: We ordained death to be among you. Nothing could stop Us
tr.19: We mete out death among you, and We are not to be outrun,
tr.22: We have decreed Death to be your common lot, and We are not to be frustrated
tr.203: We have decreed death to you all, and We are not outstripped,

56.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
56.en: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
56.tl: ʿalā an nubaddila amthālakum wanunshi-akum fī mā lā taʿlamūna

tr.85: if We intended to change you and recreate you in a way unknown to you.
tr.19: That We may transfigure you and make you what ye know not.
tr.22: from changing your Forms and creating you (again) in (forms) that ye know not.
tr.203: To transfigure you and create you in (forms) that you know not.

56.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
56.en: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
56.tl: walaqad ʿalim'tumu l-nashata l-ūlā falawlā tadhakkarūna

tr.85: You have learned how you were first created: will you not reflect?
tr.19: And verily ye know the first creation. Why, then, do ye not reflect?
tr.22: And ye certainly know already the first form of creation: why then do ye not celebrate His praises?
tr.203: And indeed, you have already known the first form of creation (i.e. the creation of Adam): why then do you not remember (or take heed)?

56.en: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

tr.85: Consider the seeds you sow in the ground-
tr.19: Have ye seen that which ye cultivate?
tr.22: See ye the seed that ye sow in the ground?
tr.203: Then tell Me about the seed that you sow in the ground.

56.en: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

tr.85: is it you who make them grow or We?
tr.19: Is it ye who foster it, or are We the Fosterer?
tr.22: Is it ye that cause it to grow, or are We the Cause?
tr.203: Is it you that make it grow, or are We the Grower?

56.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ حُطَـٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
56.en: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
56.tl: law nashāu lajaʿalnāhu ḥuṭāman faẓaltum tafakkahūna

tr.85: If We wished, We could turn your harvest into chaff and leave you to wail,
tr.19: If We willed, We verily could make it chaff, then would ye cease not to exclaim:
tr.22: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry powder, and ye would be left in wonderment,
tr.203: Were it Our Will, We could crumble it to dry pieces, and you would be regretful (or left in wonderment) [Tafsir Ibn Kathîr].

56.en: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;

tr.85: ‘We are burdened with debt;
tr.19: Lo! we are laden with debt!
tr.22: (Saying), "We are indeed left with debts (for nothing):
tr.203: (Saying): "We are indeed Mughramûn (i.e. ruined or have lost the money without any profit, or are punished by the loss of all that we spend for cultivation)! (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

56.en: Rather, we have been deprived."

tr.85: we are bereft.’
tr.19: Nay, but we are deprived!
tr.22: "Indeed are we shut out (of the fruits of our labour)"
tr.203: "Nay, but we are deprived!"

56.en: And have you seen the water that you drink?

tr.85: Consider the water you drink-
tr.19: Have ye observed the water which ye drink?
tr.22: See ye the water which ye drink?
tr.203: Then tell Me about the water that you drink.

56.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
56.en: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
56.tl: a-antum anzaltumūhu mina l-muz'ni am naḥnu l-munzilūna

tr.85: was it you who brought it down from the rain-cloud or We?
tr.19: Is it ye who shed it from the raincloud, or are We the Shedder?
tr.22: Do ye bring it down (in rain) from the cloud or do We?
tr.203: Is it you who cause it from the rain-clouds to come down, or are We the Causer of it to come down?

56.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
56.en: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
56.tl: law nashāu jaʿalnāhu ujājan falawlā tashkurūna

tr.85: If We wanted, We could make it bitter: will you not be thankful?
tr.19: If We willed We verily could make it bitter. Why then, give ye not thanks?
tr.22: Were it Our Will, We could make it salt (and unpalatable): then why do ye not give thanks?
tr.203: If We willed, We verily could make it salt (and undrinkable): why then do you not give thanks (to Allâh)?

56.en: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

tr.85: Consider the fire you kindle-
tr.19: Have ye observed the fire which ye strike out;
tr.22: See ye the Fire which ye kindle?
tr.203: Then tell Me about the fire which you kindle.

56.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
56.en: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
56.tl: a-antum anshatum shajaratahā am naḥnu l-munshiūna

tr.85: is it you who make the wood for it grow or We?
tr.19: Was it ye who made the tree thereof to grow, or were We the grower?
tr.22: Is it ye who grow the tree which feeds the fire, or do We grow it?
tr.203: Is it you who made the tree thereof to grow, or are We the Grower?

56.en: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,

tr.85: We made it a reminder, and useful to those who kindle it,
tr.19: We, even We, appointed it a memorial and a comfort for the dwellers in the wilderness.
tr.22: We have made it a memorial (of Our handiwork), and an article of comfort and convenience for the denizens of deserts.
tr.203: We have made it a Reminder (of the Hell-fire in the Hereafter), and an article of use for the travellers (and all the others, in this world).

56.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

tr.85: so [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Supreme.
tr.19: Therefor (O Muhammad), praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
tr.22: Then celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme!
tr.203: Then glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

56.en: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,

tr.85: I swear by the positions of the stars-
tr.19: Nay, I swear by the places of the stars -
tr.22: Furthermore I call to witness the setting of the Stars,-
tr.203: So I swear by the setting of the stars.

56.en: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

tr.85: a mighty oath, if you only knew-
tr.19: And lo! that verily is a tremendous oath, if ye but knew -
tr.22: And that is indeed a mighty adjuration if ye but knew,-
tr.203: And verily that is indeed a great oath, if you but know.

56.en: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.

tr.85: that this is truly a noble Quran,
tr.19: That (this) is indeed a noble Qur'an
tr.22: That this is indeed a qur'an Most Honourable,
tr.203: That (this) is indeed an honourable recitation (the Noble Qur’ân).

56.en: In a Register well-protected;.

tr.85: in a protected Record
tr.19: In a Book kept hidden
tr.22: In Book well-guarded,
tr.203: In a Book well-guarded (with Allâh in the heaven i.e. Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz ).

56.en: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].

tr.85: that only the purified can touch,
tr.19: Which none toucheth save the purified,
tr.22: Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
tr.203: Which (that Book with Allâh) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).

56.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

tr.85: sent down from the Lord of all being.
tr.19: A revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: A Revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.203: A Revelation (this Qur’ân) from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

56.en: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

tr.85: How can you scorn this statement?
tr.19: Is it this Statement that ye scorn,
tr.22: Is it such a Message that ye would hold in light esteem?
tr.203: Is it such a talk (this Qur’ân) that you (disbelievers) deny?

56.en: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

tr.85: And how, in return for the livelihood you are given, can you deny it?
tr.19: And make denial thereof your livelihood?
tr.22: And have ye made it your livelihood that ye should declare it false?
tr.203: And instead (of thanking Allâh) for the provision He gives you, you deny (Him by disbelief)!

56.en: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat

tr.85: When the soul of a dying man comes up to his throat
tr.19: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
tr.22: Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
tr.203: Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?

56.en: And you are at that time looking on -

tr.85: while you gaze on-
tr.19: And ye are at that moment looking
tr.22: And ye the while (sit) looking on,-
tr.203: And you at the moment are looking on,

56.ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
56.en: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
56.tl: wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walākin lā tub'ṣirūna

tr.85: We are nearer to him than you, though you do not see Us-
tr.19: - And We are nearer unto him than ye are, but ye see not -
tr.22: But We are nearer to him than ye, and yet see not,-
tr.203: But We (i.e. Our angels who take the soul) are nearer to him than you, but you see not, (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

56.en: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

tr.85: why, if you are not to be judged,
tr.19: Why then, if ye are not in bondage (unto Us),
tr.22: Then why do ye not,- If you are exempt from (future) account,-
tr.203: Then why do you not - if you are exempt from the reckoning and recompense (punishment) -

56.en: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?

tr.85: do you not restore his soul to him, if what you say is true?
tr.19: Do ye not force it back, if ye are truthful?
tr.22: Call back the soul, if ye are true (in the claim of independence)?
tr.203: Bring back the soul (to its body), if you are truthful?

56.en: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],

tr.85: If that dying person is one of those who will be brought near to God,
tr.19: Thus if he is of those brought nigh,
tr.22: Thus, then, if he be of those Nearest to Allah,
tr.203: Then, if he (the dying person) be of the Muqarrabûn (those brought near to Allâh),

56.en: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

tr.85: he will have rest, ease, and a Garden of Bliss;
tr.19: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
tr.22: (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
tr.203: (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of Delights (Paradise).

56.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
56.en: And if he was of the companions of the right,
56.tl: wa-ammā in kāna min aṣḥābi l-yamīni

tr.85: if he is one of those on the Right,
tr.19: And if he is of those on the right hand,
tr.22: And if he be of the Companions of the Right Hand,
tr.203: And if he (the dying person) be of those on the Right Hand,

56.en: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

tr.85: [he will hear], ‘Peace be on you,’ from his companions on the Right;
tr.19: Then (the greeting) "Peace be unto thee" from those on the right hand.
tr.22: (For him is the salutation), "Peace be unto thee", from the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.203: Then there is safety and peace (from the Punishment of Allâh) for those on the right Hand.

56.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
56.en: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
56.tl: wa-ammā in kāna mina l-mukadhibīna l-ḍālīna

tr.85: but if he is one of those who denied the truth and went astray,
tr.19: But if he is of the rejecters, the erring,
tr.22: And if he be of those who treat (Truth) as Falsehood, who go wrong,
tr.203: But if he (the dying person) be of the denying (of the Resurrection), the erring (away from the Right Path of Islâmic Monotheism),

56.en: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

tr.85: he will be welcomed with scalding water.
tr.19: Then the welcome will be boiling water
tr.22: For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.
tr.203: Then for him is an entertainment with boiling water.

56.en: And burning in Hellfire.

tr.85: He will burn in Hell.
tr.19: And roasting at hell-fire.
tr.22: And burning in Hell-Fire.
tr.203: And burning in Hell-fire.

56.en: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

tr.85: This is the certain truth:
tr.19: Lo! this is certain truth.
tr.22: Verily, this is the Very Truth and Certainly.
tr.203: Verily, this! This is an absolute Truth with certainty.

56.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

tr.85: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Supreme.
tr.19: Therefor (O Muhammad) praise the name of thy Lord, the Tremendous.
tr.22: So celebrate with praises the name of thy Lord, the Supreme.
tr.203: So glorify with praises the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

57.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
57.en: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
57.tl: sabbaḥa lillahi mā fī l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wahuwa l-ʿazīzu l-ḥakīmu

tr.85: Everything in the heavens and earth glorifies God––He is the Almighty, the Wise.
tr.19: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifieth Allah; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
tr.22: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth,- let it declare the Praises and Glory of Allah: for He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr.203: Whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth glorifies Allâh - and He is the All-Mighty, All-Wise.

57.ar: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
57.en: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
57.tl: lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi yuḥ'yī wayumītu wahuwa ʿalā kulli shayin qadīrun

tr.85: Control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him; He gives life and death; He has power over all things.
tr.19: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; He quickeneth and He giveth death; and He is Able to do all things.
tr.22: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: It is He Who gives Life and Death; and He has Power over all things.
tr.203: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. It is He Who gives life and causes death: and He is Able to do all things.

57.ar: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
57.en: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
57.tl: huwa l-awalu wal-ākhiru wal-ẓāhiru wal-bāṭinu wahuwa bikulli shayin ʿalīmun

tr.85: He is the First and the Last; the Outer and the Inner; He has knowledge of all things.
tr.19: He is the First and the Last, and the Outward and the Inward; and He is Knower of all things.
tr.22: He is the First and the Last, the Evident and the Immanent: and He has full knowledge of all things.
tr.203: He is the First (nothing is before Him) and the Last (nothing is after Him), the Most High (nothing is above Him) and the Most Near (nothing is nearer than Him). And He is the All-Knower of every thing.

57.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
57.en: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.
57.tl: huwa alladhī khalaqa l-samāwāti wal-arḍa fī sittati ayyāmin thumma is'tawā ʿalā l-ʿarshi yaʿlamu mā yaliju fī l-arḍi wamā yakhruju min'hā wamā yanzilu mina l-samāi wamā yaʿruju fīhā wahuwa maʿakum ayna mā kuntum wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna baṣīrun

tr.85: It was He who created the heavens and earth in six Days and then established Himself on the throne. He knows what enters the earth and what comes out of it; what descends from the sky and what ascends to it. He is with you wherever you are; He sees all that you do;
tr.19: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days; then He mounted the Throne. He knoweth all that entereth the earth and all that emergeth therefrom and all that cometh down from the sky and all that ascendeth therein; and He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah is Seer of what ye do.
tr.22: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in Six Days, and is moreover firmly established on the Throne (of Authority). He knows what enters within the earth and what comes forth out of it, what comes down from heaven and what mounts up to it. And He is with you wheresoever ye may be. And Allah sees well all that ye do.
tr.203: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days and then rose over (Istawâ) the Throne (in a manner that suits His Majesty). He knows what goes into the earth and what comes forth from it, and what descends from the heaven and what ascends thereto. And He is with you (by His Knowledge) wheresoever you may be. And Allâh is the All-Seer of what you do.

57.ar: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
57.en: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.
57.tl: lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wa-ilā l-lahi tur'jaʿu l-umūru

tr.85: control of the heavens and earth belongs to Him. Everything is brought back to God.
tr.19: His is the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and unto Allah (all) things are brought back.
tr.22: To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth: and all affairs are referred back to Allah.
tr.203: His is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And to Allâh return all the matters (for decision).

57.ar: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
57.en: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
57.tl: yūliju al-layla fī l-nahāri wayūliju l-nahāra fī al-layli wahuwa ʿalīmun bidhāti l-ṣudūri

tr.85: He makes night merge into day and day into night. He knows what is in every heart.
tr.19: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night, and He is knower of all that is in the breasts.
tr.22: He merges Night into Day, and He merges Day into Night; and He has full knowledge of the secrets of (all) hearts.
tr.203: He merges night into day (i.e. the decrease in the hours of the night is added into the hours of the day), and merges day into night (i.e. the decrease in the hours of the day is added into the hours of the night), and He has full knowledge of whatsoever is in the breasts.

57.ar: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
57.en: Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
57.tl: āminū bil-lahi warasūlihi wa-anfiqū mimmā jaʿalakum mus'takhlafīna fīhi fa-alladhīna āmanū minkum wa-anfaqū lahum ajrun kabīrun

tr.85: Believe in God and His Messenger, and give out of what He has made pass down to you: those of you who believe and give will have a great reward.
tr.19: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend of that whereof He hath made you trustees; and such of you as believe and spend (aright), theirs will be a great reward.
tr.22: Believe in Allah and His messenger, and spend (in charity) out of the (substance) whereof He has made you heirs. For, those of you who believe and spend (in charity),- for them is a great Reward.
tr.203: Believe in Allâh and His Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), and spend of that whereof He has made you trustees. And such of you as believe and spend (in Allâh’s Way), theirs will be a great reward.

57.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
57.en: And why do you not believe in Allāh while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?
57.tl: wamā lakum lā tu'minūna bil-lahi wal-rasūlu yadʿūkum litu'minū birabbikum waqad akhadha mīthāqakum in kuntum mu'minīna

tr.85: Why should you not believe in God when the Mes-senger calls you to believe in your Lord, and He has already made a pledge with you, if you have faith?
tr.19: What aileth you that ye believe not in Allah, when the messenger calleth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath already made a covenant with you, if ye are believers?
tr.22: What cause have ye why ye should not believe in Allah?- and the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord, and has indeed taken your Covenant, if ye are men of Faith.
tr.203: And what is the matter with you that you believe not in Allâh! While the Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) invites you to believe in your Lord (Allâh); and He (Allâh) has indeed taken your covenant, if you are real believers.

57.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
57.en: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allāh is to you Kind and Merciful.
57.tl: huwa alladhī yunazzilu ʿalā ʿabdihi āyātin bayyinātin liyukh'rijakum mina l-ẓulumāti ilā l-nūri wa-inna l-laha bikum laraūfun raḥīmun

tr.85: It is He who has sent down clear revelations to His Servant, so that He may bring you from the depths of darkness into light; God is truly kind and merciful to you.
tr.19: He it is Who sendeth down clear revelations unto His slave, that He may bring you forth from darkness unto light; and lo! for you, Allah is Full of Pity, Merciful.
tr.22: He is the One Who sends to His Servant Manifest Signs, that He may lead you from the depths of Darkness into the Light and verily Allah is to you most kind and Merciful.
tr.203: It is He Who sends down manifest Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to His slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) that He may bring you out from darkness into light. And verily, Allâh is to you full of kindness, Most Merciful.

57.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَـٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَـٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
57.en: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allāh while to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allāh has promised the best [reward]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Aware.
57.tl: wamā lakum allā tunfiqū fī sabīli l-lahi walillahi mīrāthu l-samāwāti wal-arḍi lā yastawī minkum man anfaqa min qabli l-fatḥi waqātala ulāika aʿẓamu darajatan mina alladhīna anfaqū min baʿdu waqātalū wakullan waʿada l-lahu l-ḥus'nā wal-lahu bimā taʿmalūna khabīrun

tr.85: Why should you not give for God’s cause when God alone will inherit what is in the heavens and earth? Those who gave and fought before the triumph are not like others: they are greater in rank than those who gave and fought afterwards. But God has promised a good reward to all of them: God is fully aware of all that you do.
tr.19: And what aileth you that ye spend not in the way of Allah when unto Allah belongeth the inheritance of the heavens and the earth? Those who spent and fought before the victory are not upon a level (with the rest of you). Such are greater in rank than those who spent and fought afterwards. Unto each hath Allah promised good. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
tr.22: And what cause have ye why ye should not spend in the cause of Allah?- For to Allah belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent (freely) and fought, before the Victory, (with those who did so later). Those are higher in rank than those who spent (freely) and fought afterwards. But to all has Allah promised a goodly (reward). And Allah is well acquainted with all that ye do.
tr.203: And what is the matter with you that you spend not in the Cause of Allâh? And to Allâh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth. Not equal among you are those who spent and fought before the conquering (of Makkah, with those among you who did so later). Such are higher in degree than those who spent and fought afterwards. But to all Allâh has promised the best (reward). And Allâh is All-Aware of what you do.

57.ar: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
57.en: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
57.tl: man dhā alladhī yuq'riḍu l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan fayuḍāʿifahu lahu walahu ajrun karīmun

tr.85: Who will make God a good loan? He will double it for him and reward him generously.
tr.19: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?
tr.22: Who is he that will Loan to Allah a beautiful loan? for (Allah) will increase it manifold to his credit, and he will have (besides) a liberal Reward.
tr.203: Who is he that will lend Allâh a goodly loan: then (Allâh) will increase it manifold to his credit (in repaying), and he will have (besides) a good reward (i.e. Paradise).

57.ar: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَـٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
57.en: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.
57.tl: yawma tarā l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti yasʿā nūruhum bayna aydīhim wabi-aymānihim bush'rākumu l-yawma jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā dhālika huwa l-fawzu l-ʿaẓīmu

tr.85: On the Day when you [Prophet] see the believers, both men and women, with their light streaming out ahead of them and to their right, [they will be told], ‘The good news for you today is that there are Gardens graced with flowing streams where you will stay: that is truly the supreme triumph!’
tr.19: On the day when thou (Muhammad) wilt see the believers, men and women, their light shining forth before them and on their right hands, (and wilt hear it said unto them): Glad news for you this day: Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein ye are immortal. That is the supreme triumph.
tr.22: One Day shalt thou see the believing men and the believing women- how their Light runs forward before them and by their right hands: (their greeting will be): "Good News for you this Day! Gardens beneath which flow rivers! to dwell therein for aye! This is indeed the highest Achievement!"
tr.203: On the Day you shall see the believing men and the believing women: their light running forward before them and by their right hands. Glad tidings for you this Day! Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise), to dwell therein forever! Truly, this is the great success!

57.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَـٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ
57.en: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
57.tl: yawma yaqūlu l-munāfiqūna wal-munāfiqātu lilladhīna āmanū unẓurūnā naqtabis min nūrikum qīla ir'jiʿū warāakum fal-tamisū nūran faḍuriba baynahum bisūrin lahu bābun bāṭinuhu fīhi l-raḥmatu waẓāhiruhu min qibalihi l-ʿadhābu

tr.85: On the same Day, the hypocrites, both men and women, will say to the believers, ‘Wait for us! Let us have some of your light!’ They will be told, ‘Go back and look for a light.’ A wall with a door will be erected between them: inside it lies mercy, outside lies torment.
tr.19: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
tr.22: One Day will the Hypocrites- men and women - say to the Believers: "Wait for us! Let us borrow (a Light) from your Light!" It will be said: "Turn ye back to your rear! then seek a Light (where ye can)!" So a wall will be put up betwixt them, with a gate therein. Within it will be Mercy throughout, and without it, all alongside, will be (Wrath and) Punishment!
tr.203: On the Day when the hypocrites - men and women - will say to the believers: "Wait for us! Let us get something from your light!" It will be said: "Go back to your rear! Then seek a light!" So a wall will be put up between them, with a gate therein. Inside it will be mercy, and outside it will be torment."

57.ar: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
57.en: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the believers], "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allāh. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allāh.
57.tl: yunādūnahum alam nakun maʿakum qālū balā walākinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbaṣtum wa-ir'tabtum wagharratkumu l-amāniyu ḥattā jāa amru l-lahi wagharrakum bil-lahi l-gharūru

tr.85: The hypocrites will call out to the believers, ‘Were we not with you?’ They will reply, ‘Yes. But you allowed yourselves to be tempted, you were hesitant, doubtful, deceived by false hopes until God’s command came- the Deceiver tricked you about God.
tr.19: They will cry unto them (saying): Were we not with you? They will say: Yea, verily; but ye tempted one another, and hesitated, and doubted, and vain desires beguiled you till the ordinance of Allah came to pass; and the deceiver deceived you concerning Allah;
tr.22: (Those without) will call out, "Were we not with you?" (The others) will reply, "True! but ye led yourselves into temptation; ye looked forward (to our ruin); ye doubted (Allah's Promise); and (your false) desires deceived you; until there issued the Command of Allah. And the Deceiver deceived you in respect of Allah.
tr.203: (The hypocrites) will call the believers: "Were we not with you?" The believers will reply: "Yes! But you led yourselves into temptations, you looked forward for our destruction; you doubted (in Faith) and you were deceived by false desires, till the Command of Allâh came to pass. And the chief deceiver (Satan) deceived you in respect of Allâh."

57.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
57.en: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination."
57.tl: fal-yawma lā yu'khadhu minkum fid'yatun walā mina alladhīna kafarū mawākumu l-nāru hiya mawlākum wabi'sa l-maṣīru

tr.85: Today no ransom will be accepted from you or from the disbelievers: your home is the Fire- that is where you belong––a miserable destination!’
tr.19: So this day no ransom can be taken from you nor from those who disbelieved. Your home is the Fire; that is your patron, and a hapless journey's end.
tr.22: "This Day shall no ransom be accepted of you, nor of those who rejected Allah." Your abode is the Fire: that is the proper place to claim you: and an evil refuge it is!"
tr.203: So this Day no ransom shall be taken from you (hypocrites), nor of those who disbelieved, (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism). Your abode is the Fire. That is your maulâ (friend - proper place), and worst indeed is that destination.

57.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
57.en: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
57.tl: alam yani lilladhīna āmanū an takhshaʿa qulūbuhum lidhik'ri l-lahi wamā nazala mina l-ḥaqi walā yakūnū ka-alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba min qablu faṭāla ʿalayhimu l-amadu faqasat qulūbuhum wakathīrun min'hum fāsiqūna

tr.85: Is it not time for believers to humble their hearts to the remembrance of God and the Truth that has been revealed, and not to be like those who received the Scripture before them, whose time was extended but whose hearts hardened and many of whom were lawbreakers?
tr.19: Is not the time ripe for the hearts of those who believe to submit to Allah's reminder and to the truth which is revealed, that they become not as those who received the scripture of old but the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened, and many of them are evil-livers.
tr.22: Has not the Time arrived for the Believers that their hearts in all humility should engage in the remembrance of Allah and of the Truth which has been revealed (to them), and that they should not become like those to whom was given Revelation aforetime, but long ages passed over them and their hearts grew hard? For many among them are rebellious transgressors.
tr.203: Has not the time come for the hearts of those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) to be affected by Allâh’s Reminder (this Qur’ân), and that which has been revealed of the truth, lest they become as those who received the Scripture [the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] before (i.e. Jews and Christians), and the term was prolonged for them and so their hearts were hardened? And many of them were Fâsiqûn (the rebellious, the disobedient to Allâh).

57.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
57.en: Know that Allāh gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
57.tl: iʿ'lamū anna l-laha yuḥ'yī l-arḍa baʿda mawtihā qad bayyannā lakumu l-āyāti laʿallakum taʿqilūna

tr.85: Remember that God revives the earth after it dies; We have made Our revelation clear to you so that you may use your reason.
tr.19: Know that Allah quickeneth the earth after its death. We have made clear Our revelations for you, that haply ye may understand.
tr.22: Know ye (all) that Allah giveth life to the earth after its death! already have We shown the Signs plainly to you, that ye may learn wisdom.
tr.203: Know that Allâh gives life to the earth after its death! Indeed We have made clear the Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) to you, if you but understand.

57.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَـٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
57.en: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
57.tl: inna l-muṣadiqīna wal-muṣadiqāti wa-aqraḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan yuḍāʿafu lahum walahum ajrun karīmun

tr.85: Charitable men and women who make a good loan to God will have it doubled and have a generous reward.
tr.19: Lo! those who give alms, both men and women, and lend unto Allah a goodly loan, it will be doubled for them, and theirs will be a rich reward.
tr.22: For those who give in Charity, men and women, and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and they shall have (besides) a liberal reward.
tr.203: Verily, those who give Sadaqât (i.e. Zakât and alms), men and women, and lend Allâh a goodly loan, it shall be increased manifold (to their credit), and theirs shall be an honourable good reward (i.e. Paradise).

57.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
57.en: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
57.tl: wa-alladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi ulāika humu l-ṣidīqūna wal-shuhadāu ʿinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanūruhum wa-alladhīna kafarū wakadhabū biāyātinā ulāika aṣḥābu l-jaḥīmi

tr.85: Those who believe in God and His messengers are the truthful ones who will bear witness before their Lord: they will have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations are the inhabitants of Hell.
tr.19: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers, they are the loyal, and the martyrs are with their Lord; they have their reward and their light; while as for those who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, they are owners of hell-fire.
tr.22: And those who believe in Allah and His messengers- they are the Sincere (lovers of Truth), and the witnesses (who testify), in the eyes of their Lord: They shall have their Reward and their Light. But those who reject Allah and deny Our Signs,- they are the Companions of Hell-Fire.
tr.203: And those who believe in (the Oneness of) Allâh and His Messengers - they are the Siddiqûn (i.e. those followers of the Prophets who were first and foremost to believe in them), and the martyrs with their Lord, they shall have their reward and their light. But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and deny Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) - they shall be the dwellers of the blazing Fire.

57.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَـٰمًا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
57.en: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
57.tl: iʿ'lamū annamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā laʿibun walahwun wazīnatun watafākhurun baynakum watakāthurun fī l-amwāli wal-awlādi kamathali ghaythin aʿjaba l-kufāra nabātuhu thumma yahīju fatarāhu muṣ'farran thumma yakūnu ḥuṭāman wafī l-ākhirati ʿadhābun shadīdun wamaghfiratun mina l-lahi wariḍ'wānun wamā l-ḥayatu l-dun'yā illā matāʿu l-ghurūri

tr.85: Bear in mind that the present life is just a game, a diversion, an attraction, a cause of boasting among you, of rivalry in wealth and children. It is like plants that spring up after the rain: their growth at first delights the sowers, but then you see them wither away, turn yellow, and become stubble. There is terrible punishment in the next life as well as forgiveness and approval from God; the life of this world is only an illusory pleasure.
tr.19: Know that the life of the world is only play, and idle talk, and pageantry, and boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children; as the likeness of vegetation after rain, whereof the growth is pleasing to the husbandman, but afterward it drieth up and thou seest it turning yellow, then it becometh straw. And in the Hereafter there is grievous punishment, and (also) forgiveness from Allah and His good pleasure, whereas the life of the world is but matter of illusion.
tr.22: Know ye (all), that the life of this world is but play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting and multiplying, (in rivalry) among yourselves, riches and children. Here is a similitude: How rain and the growth which it brings forth, delight (the hearts of) the tillers; soon it withers; thou wilt see it grow yellow; then it becomes dry and crumbles away. But in the Hereafter is a Penalty severe (for the devotees of wrong). And Forgiveness from Allah and (His) Good Pleasure (for the devotees of Allah). And what is the life of this world, but goods and chattels of deception?
tr.203: Know that the life of this world is only play and amusement, pomp and mutual boasting among you, and rivalry in respect of wealth and children. (It is) as the likeness of vegetation after rain, thereof the growth is pleasing to the tiller; afterwards it dries up and you see it turning yellow; then it becomes straw. But in the Hereafter (there is) a severe torment (for the disbelievers - evil-doers), and (there is) Forgiveness from Allâh and (His) Good Pleasure (for the believers - good-doers). And the life of this world is only a deceiving enjoyment.

57.ar: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
57.en: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allāh and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allāh which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.
57.tl: sābiqū ilā maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin ʿarḍuhā kaʿarḍi l-samāi wal-arḍi uʿiddat lilladhīna āmanū bil-lahi warusulihi dhālika faḍlu l-lahi yu'tīhi man yashāu wal-lahu dhū l-faḍli l-ʿaẓīmi

tr.85: So race for your Lord’s forgiveness and a Garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers: that is God’s bounty, which He bestows on whoever He pleases. God’s bounty is infinite.
tr.19: Race one with another for forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whereof the breadth is as the breadth of the heavens and the earth, which is in store for those who believe in Allah and His messengers. Such is the bounty of Allah, which He bestoweth upon whom He will, and Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
tr.22: Be ye foremost (in seeking) Forgiveness from your Lord, and a Garden (of Bliss), the width whereof is as the width of heaven and earth, prepared for those who believe in Allah and His messengers: that is the Grace of Allah, which He bestows on whom he pleases: and Allah is the Lord of Grace abounding.
tr.203: Race with one another in hastening towards forgiveness from your Lord (Allâh), and Paradise the width whereof is as the width of the heaven and the earth, prepared for those who believe in Allâh and His Messengers. That is the Grace of Allâh which He bestows on whom He is pleased with. And Allâh is the Owner of Great Bounty.

57.ar: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
57.en: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allāh, is easy -
57.tl: mā aṣāba min muṣībatin fī l-arḍi walā fī anfusikum illā fī kitābin min qabli an nabra-ahā inna dhālika ʿalā l-lahi yasīrun

tr.85: No misfortune can happen, either in the earth or in yourselves, that was not set down in writing before We brought it into being- that is easy for God-
tr.19: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah -
tr.22: No misfortune can happen on earth or in your souls but is recorded in a decree before We bring it into existence: That is truly easy for Allah:
tr.203: No calamity befalls on the earth or in yourselves but it is inscribed in the Book of Decrees (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz) before We bring it into existence. Verily, that is easy for Allâh.

57.ar: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
57.en: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
57.tl: likaylā tasaw ʿalā mā fātakum walā tafraḥū bimā ātākum wal-lahu lā yuḥibbu kulla mukh'tālin fakhūrin

tr.85: so you need not grieve for what you miss or gloat over what you gain. God does not love the conceited, the boastful,
tr.19: That ye grieve not for the sake of that which hath escaped you, nor yet exult because of that which hath been given. Allah loveth not all prideful boasters,
