tr.22: Say: "See ye?- If Allah were to destroy me, and those with me, or if He bestows His Mercy on us,- yet who can deliver the Unbelievers from a grievous Penalty?"
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If Allâh destroys me, and those with me, or He bestows His Mercy on us - who can save the disbelievers from a painful torment?"

67.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
67.en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
67.tl: qul huwa l-raḥmānu āmannā bihi waʿalayhi tawakkalnā fasataʿlamūna man huwa fī ḍalālin mubīnin

tr.85: Say, ‘He is the Lord of Mercy; we believe in Him; we put our trust in Him. You will come to know in time who is in obvious error.’
tr.19: Say: He is the Beneficent. In Him we believe and in Him we put our trust. And ye will soon know who it is that is in error manifest.
tr.22: Say: "He is (Allah) Most Gracious: We have believed in Him, and on Him have we put our trust: So, soon will ye know which (of us) it is that is in manifest error."
tr.203: Say: "He is the Most Gracious (Allâh), in Him we believe, and in Him we put our trust. So you will come to know who it is that is in manifest error."

67.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
67.en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
67.tl: qul ara-aytum in aṣbaḥa māukum ghawran faman yatīkum bimāin maʿīnin

tr.85: Say, ‘Just think: if all your water were to sink deep into the earth who could give you flowing water in its place?’
tr.19: Say: Have ye thought: If (all) your water were to disappear into the earth, who then could bring you gushing water?
tr.22: Say: "See ye?- If your stream be some morning lost (in the underground earth), who then can supply you with clear-flowing water?"
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "Tell me! If (all) your water were to sink away, who then can supply you with flowing (spring) water?"

68.en: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,

tr.85: Nun By the pen! By all they write!
tr.19: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),
tr.22: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-
tr.203:
Nûn.
[These letters (Nun, etc.) are one of the miracles of the Qur’an, and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings].
By the pen and by what they (the angels) write (in the Records of men).

68.en: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

tr.85: Your Lord’s grace does not make you [Prophet] a madman:
tr.19: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.
tr.22: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.
tr.203: You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), by the Grace of your Lord, are not mad.

68.en: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

tr.85: you will have a never-ending reward––
tr.19: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.
tr.22: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:
tr.203: And Verily, for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) will be an endless reward.

68.en: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

tr.85: truly you have a strong character––
tr.19: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.
tr.22: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.
tr.203: And Verily, you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are on an exalted (standard of) character.

68.en: So you will see and they will see.

tr.85: and soon you will see, as will they,
tr.19: And thou wilt see and they will see
tr.22: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,
tr.203: You will see, and they will see,

68.en: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

tr.85: which of you is afflicted with madness.
tr.19: Which of you is the demented.
tr.22: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
tr.203: Which of you is afflicted with madness.

68.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
68.en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
68.tl: inna rabbaka huwa aʿlamu biman ḍalla ʿan sabīlihi wahuwa aʿlamu bil-muh'tadīna

tr.85: Your Lord knows best who strays from His path and who is rightly guided.
tr.19: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.
tr.22: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.
tr.203: Verily, your Lord is the Best Knower of him who has gone astray from His Path, and He is the Best Knower of those who are guided.

68.en: Then do not obey the deniers.

tr.85: So do not yield to those who deny the truth––
tr.19: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
tr.22: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).
tr.203: So (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) obey you not the deniers [(of Islâmic Monotheism - those who belie the Verses of Allâh), the Oneness of Allâh, and the Messengership of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم]

68.en: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

tr.85: they want you to compromise with them and then they will compromise with you––
tr.19: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.
tr.22: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.
tr.203: They wish that you should compromise (in religion out of courtesy) with them: so they (too) would compromise with you.

68.en: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

tr.85: do not yield to any contemptible swearer,
tr.19: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,
tr.22: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,
tr.203: And (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) obey you not everyone Hallaf Mahîn (the one who swears much and is a liar or is worthless). [Tafsir At-Tabari]

68.en: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

tr.85: to any backbiter, slander-monger,
tr.19: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,
tr.22: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,
tr.203: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,

68.en: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

tr.85: or hinderer of good, to anyone who is sinful, aggressive,
tr.19: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
tr.22: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,
tr.203: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, sinful,

68.en: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.

tr.85: coarse, and on top of all that, an imposter.
tr.19: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.
tr.22: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-
tr.203: Cruel, and moreover base-born (of illegitimate birth).

68.en: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

tr.85: Just because he has wealth and sons,
tr.19: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children
tr.22: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.
tr.203: (He was so) because he had wealth and children.

68.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
68.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
68.tl: idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīna

tr.85: when our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘These are just ancient fables.’
tr.19: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.
tr.22: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!
tr.203: When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him, he says: "Tales of the men of old!"

68.en: We will brand him upon the snout.

tr.85: We shall brand him on the snout!
tr.19: We shall brand him on the nose.
tr.22: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!
tr.203: We shall brand him on the snout (nose)!

68.ar: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
68.en: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
68.tl: innā balawnāhum kamā balawnā aṣḥāba l-janati idh aqsamū layaṣrimunnahā muṣ'biḥīna

tr.85: We have tried them as We tried the owners of a certain garden, who swore that they would harvest its fruits in the morning
tr.19: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,
tr.22: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.
tr.203: Verily, We have tried them as We tried the people of the garden, when they swore to pluck the fruits of the (garden) in the morning,

68.en: Without making exception.

tr.85: and made no allowance [for the Will of God]:
tr.19: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);
tr.22: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").
tr.203: Without saying: Inshâ’ Allâh (If Allâh wills).

68.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
68.en: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
68.tl: faṭāfa ʿalayhā ṭāifun min rabbika wahum nāimūna

tr.85: a disaster from your Lord struck the garden as they slept
tr.19: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
tr.22: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.
tr.203: Then there passed by on the (garden) a visitation (fire) from your Lord at night and burnt it while they were asleep.

68.en: And it became as though reaped.

tr.85: and by morning it was stripped bare, a desolate land.
tr.19: And in the morning it was as if plucked.
tr.22: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).
tr.203: So the (garden) became black by the morning, like a pitch dark night (in complete ruins).

68.en: And they called one another at morning,

tr.85: Still they called each other at daybreak,
tr.19: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,
tr.22: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-
tr.203: Then they called out one to another as soon as the morning broke.

68.ar: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
68.en: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
68.tl: ani igh'dū ʿalā ḥarthikum in kuntum ṣārimīna

tr.85: ‘Go early to your field if you wish to gather all its fruits,’
tr.19: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).
tr.22: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."
tr.203: Saying: "Go to your tilth in the morning, if you would pluck the fruits."

68.en: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

tr.85: and went off, whispering,
tr.19: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:
tr.22: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-
tr.203: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones (saying):

68.ar: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
68.en: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
68.tl: an lā yadkhulannahā l-yawma ʿalaykum mis'kīnun

tr.85: ‘Make sure no poor person enters the garden today!’––
tr.19: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.
tr.22: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."
tr.203: "No Miskîn (poor man) shall enter upon you into it today."

68.en: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

tr.85: they left early, bent on their purpose-
tr.19: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.
tr.22: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.
tr.203: And they went in the morning with strong intention, thinking that they have power (to prevent the poor taking anything of the fruits therefrom).

68.en: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

tr.85: but when they saw the garden, they said, ‘We must have lost our way!
tr.19: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!
tr.22: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:
tr.203: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "Verily, we have gone astray."

68.en: Rather, we have been deprived."

tr.85: No- we are ruined!’
tr.19: Nay, but we are desolate!
tr.22: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"
tr.203: (Then they said): "Nay! Indeed we are deprived of (the fruits)!"

68.ar: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
68.en: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"
68.tl: qāla awsaṭuhum alam aqul lakum lawlā tusabbiḥūna

tr.85: The wisest of them said, ‘Did I not say to you, “Will you not glorify God?”’-
tr.19: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?
tr.22: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"
tr.203: The best among them said: "Did I not tell you: why say you not: Inshâ’ Allâh (If Allâh wills)."

68.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
68.en: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
68.tl: qālū sub'ḥāna rabbinā innā kunnā ẓālimīna

tr.85: they said, ‘Glory be to God, Our Lord! Truly, we were doing wrong!’-
tr.19: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.
tr.22: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"
tr.203: They said: "Glory to Our Lord! Verily, we have been Zâlimûn (wrong-doers)."

68.en: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

tr.85: and then they turned to each other in mutual reproach.
tr.19: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.
tr.22: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.
tr.203: Then they turned one against another, blaming.

68.en: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

tr.85: They said, ‘Alas for us! We have done terrible wrong,
tr.19: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.
tr.22: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!
tr.203: They said: "Woe to us! Verily, we were Tâghûn (transgressors and disobedient)

68.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
68.en: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
68.tl: ʿasā rabbunā an yub'dilanā khayran min'hā innā ilā rabbinā rāghibūna

tr.85: but maybe our Lord will give us something better in its place: we truly turn to Him in hope.’
tr.19: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.
tr.22: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"
tr.203: We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this. Truly, we turn to our Lord (wishing for good that He may forgive our sins and reward us in the Hereafter).

68.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
68.en: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
68.tl: kadhālika l-ʿadhābu walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati akbaru law kānū yaʿlamūna

tr.85: Such is the punishment [in this life], but greater still is the punishment in the Hereafter, if only they knew.
tr.19: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.
tr.22: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!
tr.203: Such is the punishment (in this life), but truly, the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they but knew.

68.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
68.en: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
68.tl: inna lil'muttaqīna ʿinda rabbihim jannāti l-naʿīmi

tr.85: There will be Gardens of bliss for those who are mindful of God.
tr.19: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.
tr.22: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.
tr.203: Verily, for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) are Gardens of delight (Paradise) with their Lord.

68.en: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

tr.85: Should We treat those who submit to Us as We treat those who do evil?
tr.19: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?
tr.22: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?
tr.203: Shall We then treat the Muslims (believers of Islamic Monotheism, doers of righteous deeds) like the Mujrimûn (criminals, polytheists and disbelievers, etc.)?

68.en: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

tr.85: What is the matter with you? On what basis do you judge?
tr.19: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!
tr.22: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
tr.203: What is the matter with you? How judge you?

68.en: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

tr.85: Do you have a Scripture that tells you
tr.19: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
tr.22: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-
tr.203: Or have you a Book wherein you learn,

68.en: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

tr.85: that you will be granted whatever you choose?
tr.19: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?
tr.22: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?
tr.203: That you shall therein have all that you choose?

68.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
68.en: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
68.tl: am lakum aymānun ʿalaynā bālighatun ilā yawmi l-qiyāmati inna lakum lamā taḥkumūna

tr.85: Have you received from Us solemn oaths, binding to the Day of Resurrection, that you will get whatever you yourselves decide?
tr.19: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?
tr.22: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?
tr.203: Or have you oaths from Us, reaching to the Day of Resurrection, that yours will be what you judge?

68.en: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

tr.85: Ask them [Prophet] which of them will guarantee this.
tr.19: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!
tr.22: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!
tr.203: Ask them, which of them will stand surety for that!

68.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
68.en: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
68.tl: am lahum shurakāu falyatū bishurakāihim in kānū ṣādiqīna

tr.85: Do they have ‘partners’ [besides God]? Let them produce their ‘partners’, if what they say is true.
tr.19: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful
tr.22: Or have they some “ Partners ” (in Godhead)? Then let them produce Their “ partners ”, If they are truthful !
tr.203: Or have they "partners"? Then let them bring their "partners" if they are truthful!

68.ar: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
68.en: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
68.tl: yawma yuk'shafu ʿan sāqin wayud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi falā yastaṭīʿūna

tr.85: On the Day when matters become dire, they will be invited to prostrate themselves but will be prevented from doing so,
tr.19: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,
tr.22: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-
tr.203: (Remember) the Day when the Shin shall be laid bare (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) and they shall be called to prostrate themselves (to Allâh), but they (hypocrites) shall not be able to do so.

68.ar: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
68.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
68.tl: khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun waqad kānū yud'ʿawna ilā l-sujūdi wahum sālimūna

tr.85: and their eyes will be downcast and they will be overwhelmed with shame: they were invited to prostrate themselves when they were safe [but refused].
tr.19: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.
tr.22: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).
tr.203: Their eyes will be cast down and ignominy will cover them; they used to be called to prostrate themselves (offer prayers), while they were healthy and good (in the life of the world, but they did not).

68.ar: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
68.en: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
68.tl: fadharnī waman yukadhibu bihādhā l-ḥadīthi sanastadrijuhum min ḥaythu lā yaʿlamūna

tr.85: So [Prophet] leave those who reject this revelation to Me: We shall lead them on, step by step, in ways beyond their knowledge;
tr.19: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.
tr.22: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.
tr.203: Then leave Me Alone with such as belie this Qur’ân. We shall punish them gradually from directions they perceive not.

68.en: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

tr.85: I will allow them more time, for My plan is powerful.
tr.19: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.
tr.22: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.
tr.203: And I will grant them a respite. Verily, My Plan is strong.

68.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
68.en: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
68.tl: am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muth'qalūna

tr.85: Do you demand some reward from them that would burden them with debt?
tr.19: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?
tr.22: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
tr.203: Or is it that you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) ask them a wage, so that they are heavily burdened with debt?

68.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

tr.85: Do they have knowledge of the unseen that enables them to write it down?
tr.19: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?
tr.22: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?
tr.203: Or that the Ghaib (the Unseen - here in this Verse it means Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz) is in their hands, so that they can write it down?

68.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
68.en: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
68.tl: fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā takun kaṣāḥibi l-ḥūti idh nādā wahuwa makẓūmun

tr.85: Wait patiently [Prophet] for your Lord’s judgement: do not be like the man in the whale who called out in distress:
tr.19: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.
tr.22: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.
tr.203: So wait with patience for the Decision of your Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish - when he cried out (to Us) while he was in deep sorrow. (See the Qur’ân, Verse 21:87).

68.ar: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
68.en: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
68.tl: lawlā an tadārakahu niʿ'matun min rabbihi lanubidha bil-ʿarāi wahuwa madhmūmun

tr.85: if his Lord’s grace had not reached him, he would have been left, abandoned and blameworthy, on the barren shore,
tr.19: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
tr.22: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.
tr.203: Had not a Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been (left in the stomach of the fish, but We forgave him): so he was cast off on the naked shore, while he was to be blamed.

68.en: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

tr.85: but his Lord chose him and made him one of the Righteous.
tr.19: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.
tr.22: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.
tr.203: Then his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

68.ar: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
68.en: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
68.tl: wa-in yakādu alladhīna kafarū layuz'liqūnaka bi-abṣārihim lammā samiʿū l-dhik'ra wayaqūlūna innahu lamajnūnun

tr.85: The disbelievers almost strike you down with their looks when they hear the Quran. They say, ‘He must be mad!’
tr.19: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
tr.22: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"
tr.203: And verily, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes (through hatred) when they hear the Reminder (the Qur’ân), and they say: "Verily, he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a madman!"

68.en: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

tr.85: but truly it is nothing other than a Reminder for all peoples.
tr.19: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
tr.22: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.
tr.203: But it is nothing else than a Reminder to all the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, and jinn).

69.en: The Inevitable Reality -

tr.85: The Inevitable Hour!
tr.19: The Reality!
tr.22: The Sure Reality!
tr.203: The Inevitable (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!

69.en: What is the Inevitable Reality?

tr.85: What is the Inevitable Hour?
tr.19: What is the Reality?
tr.22: What is the Sure Reality?
tr.203: What is the Inevitable?

69.en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the Inevitable Hour is?
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
tr.22: And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
tr.203: And what will make you know what the Inevitable is?

69.en: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].

tr.85: The people of Thamud and 'Ad denied that the crashing blowwould come:
tr.19: (The tribes of) Thamud and A'ad disbelieved in the judgment to come.
tr.22: The Thamud and the 'Ad People (branded) as false the Stunning Calamity!
tr.203: Thamûd and ‘Âd people denied the Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour of Judgement)!

69.en: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

tr.85: Thamud was destroyed by a deafening blast;
tr.19: As for Thamud, they were destroyed by the lightning.
tr.22: But the Thamud,- they were destroyed by a terrible Storm of thunder and lightning!
tr.203: As for Thamûd, they were destroyed by the awful cry!

69.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
69.en: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
69.tl: wa-ammā ʿādun fa-uh'likū birīḥin ṣarṣarin ʿātiyatin

tr.85: Ad was destroyed by a furious wind
tr.19: And as for A'ad, they were destroyed by a fierce roaring wind,
tr.22: And the 'Ad, they were destroyed by a furious Wind, exceedingly violent;
tr.203: And as for ‘Âd, they were destroyed by a furious violent wind!

69.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
69.en: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
69.tl: sakharahā ʿalayhim sabʿa layālin wathamāniyata ayyāmin ḥusūman fatarā l-qawma fīhā ṣarʿā ka-annahum aʿjāzu nakhlin khāwiyatin

tr.85: that God let loose against them for seven consecutive nights, eight consecutive days, so that you could have seen its people lying dead like hollow palm-trunks.
tr.19: Which He imposed on them for seven long nights and eight long days so that thou mightest have seen men lying overthrown, as they were hollow trunks of palm-trees.
tr.22: He made it rage against them seven nights and eight days in succession: so that thou couldst see the (whole) people lying prostrate in its (path), as they had been roots of hollow palm-trees tumbled down!
tr.203: Which Allâh imposed on them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so that you could see men lying overthrown (destroyed), as if they were hollow trunks of date-palms!

69.en: Then do you see of them any remains?

tr.85: Can you see any trace of them now?
tr.19: Canst thou (O Muhammad) see any remnant of them?
tr.22: Then seest thou any of them left surviving?
tr.203: Do you see any remnants of them?

69.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
69.en: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
69.tl: wajāa fir'ʿawnu waman qablahu wal-mu'tafikātu bil-khāṭi-ati

tr.85: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
tr.19: And Pharaoh and those before him, and the communities that were destroyed, brought error,
tr.22: And Pharaoh, and those before him, and the Cities Overthrown, committed habitual Sin.
tr.203: And Fir‘aun (Pharaoh), and those before him, and the cities overthrown [the towns of the people of [Lût (Lot)] committed sin.

69.ar: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
69.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
69.tl: faʿaṣaw rasūla rabbihim fa-akhadhahum akhdhatan rābiyatan

tr.85: these people committed grave sins and disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an ever-tightening grip.
tr.19: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
tr.22: And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
tr.203: And they disobeyed their Lord’s Messenger, so He seized them with a strong punishment.

69.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
69.en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
69.tl: innā lammā ṭaghā l-māu ḥamalnākum fī l-jāriyati

tr.85: But when the Flood rose high, We saved you in the floating ship,
tr.19: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship
tr.22: We, when the water (of Noah's Flood) overflowed beyond its limits, carried you (mankind), in the floating (Ark),
tr.203: Verily, when the water rose beyond its limits [Nûh’s (Noah) Flood], We carried you (mankind) in the floating [ship that was constructed by Nûh (Noah)]

69.ar: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
69.en: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
69.tl: linajʿalahā lakum tadhkiratan wataʿiyahā udhunun wāʿiyatun

tr.85: making that event a reminder for you: attentive ears may take heed.
tr.19: That We might make it a memorial for you, and that remembering ears (that heard the story) might remember.
tr.22: That We might make it a Message unto you, and that ears (that should hear the tale and) retain its memory should bear its (lessons) in remembrance.
tr.203: That We might make it (Noah’s ship) an admonition for you and that it might be retained by the retaining ears.

69.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
69.en: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
69.tl: fa-idhā nufikha fī l-ṣūri nafkhatun wāḥidatun

tr.85: When the Trumpet is sounded a single time,
tr.19: And when the trumpet shall sound one blast
tr.22: Then, when one blast is sounded on the Trumpet,
tr.203: Then when the Trumpet will be blown with one blowing (the first one).

69.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
69.en: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
69.tl: waḥumilati l-arḍu wal-jibālu fadukkatā dakkatan wāḥidatan

tr.85: when the earth and its mountains are raised high and then crushed with a single blow,
tr.19: And the earth with the mountains shall be lifted up and crushed with one crash,
tr.22: And the earth is moved, and its mountains, and they are crushed to powder at one stroke,-
tr.203: And the earth and the mountains shall be removed from their places, and crushed with a single crushing.

69.en: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

tr.85: on that Day the Great Event will come to pass.
tr.19: Then, on that day will the Event befall.
tr.22: On that Day shall the (Great) Event come to pass.
tr.203: Then on that Day shall the (Great) Event befall.

69.en: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

tr.85: The sky will be torn apart on that Day, it will be so frail.
tr.19: And the heaven will split asunder, for that day it will be frail.
tr.22: And the sky will be rent asunder, for it will that Day be flimsy,
tr.203: And the heaven will be rent asunder, for that Day it (the heaven) will be frail and torn up.

69.ar: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
69.en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
69.tl: wal-malaku ʿalā arjāihā wayaḥmilu ʿarsha rabbika fawqahum yawma-idhin thamāniyatun

tr.85: The angels will be on all sides of it and, on that Day, eight of them will bear the throne of your Lord above them.
tr.19: And the angels will be on the sides thereof, and eight will uphold the Throne of thy Lord that day, above them.
tr.22: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight will, that Day, bear the Throne of thy Lord above them.
tr.203: And the angels will be on its sides, and eight angels will, that Day, bear the Throne of your Lord above them.

69.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
69.en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
69.tl: yawma-idhin tuʿ'raḍūna lā takhfā minkum khāfiyatun

tr.85: On that Day you will be brought to judgement and none of your secrets will remain hidden.
tr.19: On that day ye will be exposed; not a secret of you will be hidden.
tr.22: That Day shall ye be brought to Judgment: not an act of yours that ye hide will be hidden.
tr.203: That Day shall you be brought to Judgement, not a secret of you will be hidden.

69.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
69.en: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
69.tl: fa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu biyamīnihi fayaqūlu hāumu iq'raū kitābiyah

tr.85: Anyone who is given his Record in his right hand will say, ‘Here is my Record, read it.
tr.19: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
tr.22: Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
tr.203: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Here! read my Record!

69.en: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

tr.85: I knew I would meet my Reckoning,’
tr.19: Surely I knew that I should have to meet my reckoning.
tr.22: "I did really understand that my Account would (One Day) reach me!"
tr.203: "Surely, I did believe that I shall meet my Account!"

69.en: So he will be in a pleasant life -

tr.85: and so he will have a pleasant life
tr.19: Then he will be in blissful state
tr.22: And he will be in a life of Bliss,
tr.203: So he shall be in a life, well-pleasing.

69.en: In an elevated garden,

tr.85: in a lofty Garden,
tr.19: In a high garden
tr.22: In a Garden on high,
tr.203: In a lofty Paradise,

69.en: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

tr.85: with clustered fruit within his reach.
tr.19: Whereof the clusters are in easy reach.
tr.22: The Fruits whereof (will hang in bunches) low and near.
tr.203: The fruits in bunches whereof will be low and near at hand.

69.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
69.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
69.tl: kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā aslaftum fī l-ayāmi l-khāliyati

tr.85: It will be said, ‘Eat and drink to your heart’s content as a reward for what you have done in days gone by.’
tr.19: (And it will be said unto those therein): Eat and drink at ease for that which ye sent on before you in past days.
tr.22: "Eat ye and drink ye, with full satisfaction; because of the (good) that ye sent before you, in the days that are gone!"
tr.203: Eat and drink at ease for that which you have sent on before you in days past!

69.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
69.en: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
69.tl: wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu bishimālihi fayaqūlu yālaytanī lam ūta kitābiyah

tr.85: But anyone who is given his Record in his left hand will say, ‘If only I had never been given any Record
tr.19: But as for him who is given his record in his left hand, he will say: Oh, would that I had not been given my book
tr.22: And he that will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "Ah! Would that my Record had not been given to me!
tr.203: But as for him who will be given his Record in his left hand, will say: "I wish that I had not been given my Record!

69.en: And had not known what is my account.

tr.85: and knew nothing of my Reckoning.
tr.19: And knew not what my reckoning!
tr.22: "And that I had never realised how my account (stood)!
tr.203: "And that I had never known how my Account is!

69.en: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.

tr.85: How I wish death had been the end of me.
tr.19: Oh, would that it had been death!
tr.22: "Ah! Would that (Death) had made an end of me!
tr.203: "Would that it had been my end (death)!

69.en: My wealth has not availed me.

tr.85: My wealth has been no use to me,
tr.19: My wealth hath not availed me,
tr.22: "Of no profit to me has been my wealth!
tr.203: "My wealth has not availed me;

69.en: Gone from me is my authority."

tr.85: and my power has vanished.’
tr.19: My power hath gone from me.
tr.22: "My power has perished from me!"...
tr.203: "My power (and arguments to defend myself) have gone from me!"

69.en: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

tr.85: ‘Take him, put a collar on him,
tr.19: (It will be said): Take him and fetter him
tr.22: (The stern command will say): "Seize ye him, and bind ye him,
tr.203: (It will be said): "Seize him and fetter him;

69.en: Then into Hellfire drive him.

tr.85: lead him to burn in the blazing Fire,
tr.19: And then expose him to hell-fire
tr.22: "And burn ye him in the Blazing Fire.
tr.203: Then throw him in the blazing Fire.

69.ar: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
69.en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
69.tl: thumma fī sil'silatin dharʿuhā sabʿūna dhirāʿan fa-us'lukūhu

tr.85: and [bind him] in a chain seventy metres long:
tr.19: And then insert him in a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits.
tr.22: "Further, make him march in a chain, whereof the length is seventy cubits!
tr.203: "Then fasten him with a chain whereof the length is seventy cubits!"

69.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
69.en: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,
69.tl: innahu kāna lā yu'minu bil-lahi l-ʿaẓīmi

tr.85: he would not believe in Almighty God,
tr.19: Lo! He used not to believe in Allah the Tremendous,
tr.22: "This was he that would not believe in Allah Most High.
tr.203: Verily, he used not to believe in Allâh, the Most Great,

69.en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

tr.85: he never encouraged feeding the hungry,
tr.19: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
tr.22: "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
tr.203: And urged not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor).

69.en: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

tr.85: so today he has no real friend here,
tr.19: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
tr.22: "So no friend hath he here this Day.
tr.203: So no friend has he here this Day,

69.en: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

tr.85: and the only food he has is the filth
tr.19: Nor any food save filth
tr.22: "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
tr.203: Nor any food except filth from the washing of wounds.

69.en: None will eat it except the sinners.

tr.85: that only sinners eat.’
tr.19: Which none but sinners eat.
tr.22: "Which none do eat but those in sin."
tr.203: None will eat it except the Khâti’ûn (sinners, disbelievers, polytheists).

69.en: So I swear by what you see

tr.85: So I swear by what you can see
tr.19: But nay! I swear by all that ye see
tr.22: So I do call to witness what ye see,
tr.203: So I swear by whatsoever you see,

69.en: And what you do not see

tr.85: and by what you cannot see:
tr.19: And all that ye see not
tr.22: And what ye see not,
tr.203: And by whatsoever you see not,

69.en: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

tr.85: this [Quran] is the speech of an honoured messenger,
tr.19: That it is indeed the speech of an illustrious messenger.
tr.22: That this is verily the word of an honoured messenger;
tr.203: That this is verily, the word of an honoured Messenger [i.e. Jibrîl (Gabriel) or Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم which he has brought from Allâh].

69.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
69.en: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
69.tl: wamā huwa biqawli shāʿirin qalīlan mā tu'minūna

tr.85: not the words of a poet- how little you believe!-
tr.19: It is not poet's speech - little is it that ye believe!
tr.22: It is not the word of a poet: little it is ye believe!
tr.203: It is not the word of a poet: little is that you believe!

69.ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
69.en: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
69.tl: walā biqawli kāhinin qalīlan mā tadhakkarūna

tr.85: nor the words of a soothsayer- how little you reflect!
tr.19: Nor diviner's speech - little is it that ye remember!
tr.22: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer: little admonition it is ye receive.
tr.203: Nor is it the word of a soothsayer (or a foreteller): little is that you remember!

69.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

tr.85: This [Quran] is a message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds:
tr.19: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.22: (This is) a Message sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.
tr.203: This is the Revelation sent down from the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

69.en: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

tr.85: if [the Prophet] had attributed some fabrication to Us,
tr.19: And if he had invented false sayings concerning Us,
tr.22: And if the messenger were to invent any sayings in Our name,
tr.203: And if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) had forged a false saying concerning Us (Allâh جل جلاله),

69.en: We would have seized him by the right hand;

tr.85: We would certainly have seized his right hand
tr.19: We assuredly had taken him by the right hand
tr.22: We should certainly seize him by his right hand,
tr.203: We surely would have seized him by his right hand (or with power and might),

69.en: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.

tr.85: and cut off his lifeblood,
tr.19: And then severed his life-artery,
tr.22: And We should certainly then cut off the artery of his heart:
tr.203: And then We certainly would have cut off his life artery (aorta),

69.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
69.en: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
69.tl: famā minkum min aḥadin ʿanhu ḥājizīna

tr.85: and none of you could have defended him.
tr.19: And not one of you could have held Us off from him.
tr.22: Nor could any of you withhold him (from Our wrath).
tr.203: And none of you could have withheld Us from (punishing) him.

69.en: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

tr.85: This [Quran] is a reminder for those who are aware of God.
tr.19: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
tr.22: But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
tr.203: And verily, this (Qur’an) is a Reminder for the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2).

69.en: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

tr.85: We know that some of you consider it to be lies-
tr.19: And lo! We know that some among you will deny (it).
tr.22: And We certainly know that there are amongst you those that reject (it).
tr.203: And verily, We know that there are some among you that belie (this Qur’ân). (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

69.en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

tr.85: this will be a source of bitter regret for the disbelievers-
tr.19: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
tr.22: But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
tr.203: And indeed it (this Qur’ân) will be an anguish for the disbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection).

69.en: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

tr.85: but it is in fact the certain Truth.
tr.19: And lo! it is absolute truth.
tr.22: But verily it is Truth of assured certainty.
tr.203: And verily, it (this Qur’ân) is an absolute truth with certainty.

69.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

tr.85: So [Prophet] glorify the name of your Lord, the Almighty.
tr.19: So glorify the name of thy Tremendous Lord.
tr.22: So glorify the name of thy Lord Most High.
tr.203: So glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most Great.

70.en: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

tr.85: A man [mockingly] demanded the punishment.
tr.19: A questioner questioned concerning the doom about to fall
tr.22: A questioner asked about a Penalty to befall-
tr.203: A questioner asked concerning a torment about to befall

70.en: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

tr.85: It will fall on the disbelievers––none can deflect it––
tr.19: Upon the disbelievers, which none can repel,
tr.22: The Unbelievers, the which there is none to ward off,-
tr.203: Upon the disbelievers, which none can avert,

70.en: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.

tr.85: from God, the Lord of the Ways of Ascent,
tr.19: From Allah, Lord of the Ascending Stairways
tr.22: (A Penalty) from Allah, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
tr.203: From Allâh, the Lord of the ways of ascent.

70.ar: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
70.en: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
70.tl: taʿruju l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu ilayhi fī yawmin kāna miq'dāruhu khamsīna alfa sanatin

tr.85: by which the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him, on a Day whose length is fifty thousand years.
tr.19: (Whereby) the angels and the Spirit ascend unto Him in a Day whereof the span is fifty thousand years.
tr.22: The angels and the spirit ascend unto him in a Day the measure whereof is (as) fifty thousand years:
tr.203: The angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] ascend to Him in a Day the measure whereof is fifty thousand years.

70.en: So be patient with gracious patience.

tr.85: So be patient, [Prophet], as befits you.
tr.19: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
tr.22: Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
tr.203: So be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), with a good patience.

70.en: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,

tr.85: The disbelievers think it is distant,
tr.19: Lo! they behold it afar off
tr.22: They see the (Day) indeed as a far-off (event):
tr.203: Verily, they see it (the torment) afar off.

70.en: But We see it [as] near.

tr.85: but We know it to be close.
tr.19: While we behold it nigh:
tr.22: But We see it (quite) near.
tr.203: But We see it (quite) near.

70.en: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,

tr.85: On a Day when the heavens will be like molten brass
tr.19: The day when the sky will become as molten copper,
tr.22: The Day that the sky will be like molten brass,
tr.203: The Day that the sky will be like the boiling filth of oil, (or molten copper or silver or lead).

70.en: And the mountains will be like wool,

tr.85: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
tr.19: And the hills become as flakes of wool,
tr.22: And the mountains will be like wool,
tr.203: And the mountains will be like flakes of wool.

70.en: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

tr.85: when no friend will ask about his friend,
tr.19: And no familiar friend will ask a question of his friend
tr.22: And no friend will ask after a friend,
tr.203: And no friend will ask a friend (about his condition),

70.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
70.en: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
70.tl: yubaṣṣarūnahum yawaddu l-muj'rimu law yaftadī min ʿadhābi yawmi-idhin bibanīhi

tr.85: even when they are within sight of one another. The guilty person will wish he could save himself from the suffering of that Day by sacrificing his sons,
tr.19: Though they will be given sight of them. The guilty man will long to be able to ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children
tr.22: Though they will be put in sight of each other,- the sinner's desire will be: Would that he could redeem himself from the Penalty of that Day by (sacrificing) his children,
tr.203: Though they shall be made to see one another [(i.e. on the Day of Resurrection), there will be none but see his father, children and relatives, but he will neither speak to them nor will ask them for any help]. The Mujrim, (criminal, sinner, disbeliever) would desire to ransom himself from the punishment of that Day by his children,

70.en: And his wife and his brother

tr.85: his spouse, his brother,
tr.19: And his spouse and his brother
tr.22: His wife and his brother,
tr.203: And his wife and his brother,

70.en: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.

tr.85: the kinsfolk who gave him shelter,
tr.19: And his kin that harboured him
tr.22: His kindred who sheltered him,
tr.203: And his kindred who sheltered him,

70.ar: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
70.en: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
70.tl: waman fī l-arḍi jamīʿan thumma yunjīhi

tr.85: and everyone on earth, if it could save him.
tr.19: And all that are in the earth, if then it might deliver him.
tr.22: And all, all that is on earth,- so it could deliver him:
tr.203: And all that are in the earth, so that it might save him.

70.en: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

tr.85: But no! There is a raging flame
tr.19: But nay! for lo! it is the fire of hell
tr.22: By no means! for it would be the Fire of Hell!-
tr.203: By no means! Verily, it will be the Fire of Hell,

70.en: A remover of exteriors.

tr.85: that strips away the skin,
tr.19: Eager to roast;
tr.22: Plucking out (his being) right to the skull!-
tr.203: Taking away (burning completely) the head skin!

70.en: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

tr.85: and it will claim everyone who rejects the truth, turns away,
tr.19: It calleth him who turned and fled (from truth),
tr.22: Inviting (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from the Right).
tr.203: Calling (all) such as turn their backs and turn away their faces (from Faith) [picking and swallowing them up from that great gathering of mankind on the Day of Resurrection just as a bird picks up a food-grain from the earth with its beak and swallows it up] (Tafsir Al-Qurtubî)

70.en: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.

tr.85: amasses wealth and hoards it.
tr.19: And hoarded (wealth) and withheld it.
tr.22: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from use)!
tr.203: And collect (wealth) and hide it (from spending it in the Cause of Allâh).

70.en: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

tr.85: Man was truly created anxious:
tr.19: Lo! man was created anxious,
tr.22: Truly man was created very impatient;-
tr.203: Verily, man (disbeliever) was created very impatient;

70.en: When evil touches him, impatient,

tr.85: he is fretful when misfortune touches him,
tr.19: Fretful when evil befalleth him
tr.22: Fretful when evil touches him;
tr.203: Irritable (discontented) when evil touches him;

70.en: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

tr.85: but tight-fisted when good fortune comes his way.
tr.19: And, when good befalleth him, grudging;
tr.22: And niggardly when good reaches him;-
tr.203: And niggardly when good touches him.

70.en: Except the observers of prayer -

tr.85: Not so those who pray
tr.19: Save worshippers.
tr.22: Not so those devoted to Prayer;-
tr.203: Except those who are devoted to Salât (prayers).

70.en: Those who are constant in their prayer

tr.85: and are constant in their prayers;
tr.19: Who are constant at their worship
tr.22: Those who remain steadfast to their prayer;
tr.203: Those who remain constant in their Salât (prayers);

70.en: And those within whose wealth is a known right

tr.85: who give a due share of their wealth
tr.19: And in whose wealth there is a right acknowledged
tr.22: And those in whose wealth is a recognised right.
tr.203: And those in whose wealth there is a recognised right

70.en: For the petitioner and the deprived -

tr.85: to beggars and the deprived;
tr.19: For the beggar and the destitute;
tr.22: For the (needy) who asks and him who is prevented (for some reason from asking);
tr.203: For the beggar who asks, and for the unlucky who has lost his property and wealth, (and his means of living has been straitened).

70.en: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

tr.85: who believe in the Day of Judgement
tr.19: And those who believe in the Day of Judgment,
tr.22: And those who hold to the truth of the Day of Judgment;
tr.203: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense.

70.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
70.en: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
70.tl: wa-alladhīna hum min ʿadhābi rabbihim mush'fiqūna

tr.85: and fear the punishment of their Lord––
tr.19: And those who are fearful of their Lord's doom -
tr.22: And those who fear the displeasure of their Lord,-
tr.203: And those who fear the torment of their Lord.

70.en: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

tr.85: none may feel wholly secure from it––
tr.19: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
tr.22: For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
tr.203: Verily, the torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure. -

70.en: And those who guard their private parts

tr.85: who guard their chastity
tr.19: And those who preserve their chastity
tr.22: And those who guard their chastity,
tr.203: And those who guard their chastity (i.e. private parts from illegal sexual acts).

70.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
70.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
70.tl: illā ʿalā azwājihim aw mā malakat aymānuhum fa-innahum ghayru malūmīna

tr.85: from all but their spouses or their slave-girls––there is no blame attached to [relations with] these,
tr.19: Save with their wives and those whom their right hands possess, for thus they are not blameworthy;
tr.22: Except with their wives and the (captives) whom their right hands possess,- for (then) they are not to be blamed,
tr.203: Except from their wives or the (women slaves) whom their right hands possess - for (then) they are not blameworthy.

70.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
70.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
70.tl: famani ib'taghā warāa dhālika fa-ulāika humu l-ʿādūna

tr.85: but those whose desires exceed this limit are truly transgressors––
tr.19: But whoso seeketh more than that, those are they who are transgressors;
tr.22: But those who trespass beyond this are transgressors;-
tr.203: But whosoever seeks beyond that, then it is those who are trespassers.

70.en: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.

tr.85: who are faithful to their trusts and their pledges;
tr.19: And those who keep their pledges and their covenant,
tr.22: And those who respect their trusts and covenants;
tr.203: And those who keep their trusts and covenants.

70.en: And those who are in their testimonies upright

tr.85: who give honest testimony
tr.19: And those who stand by their testimony
tr.22: And those who stand firm in their testimonies;
tr.203: And those who stand firm in their testimonies.

70.en: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

tr.85: and are steadfast in their prayers.
tr.19: And those who are attentive at their worship.
tr.22: And those who guard (the sacredness) of their worship;-
tr.203: And those who guard their Salât (prayers) well.

70.en: They will be in gardens, honored.

tr.85: They will be honoured in Gardens of bliss.
tr.19: These will dwell in Gardens, honoured.
tr.22: Such will be the honoured ones in the Gardens (of Bliss).
tr.203: Such shall dwell in the Gardens (i.e. Paradise), honoured.

70.en: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],

tr.85: What is wrong with the disbelievers? Why do they rush to peer at you [Prophet],
tr.19: What aileth those who disbelieve, that they keep staring toward thee (O Muhammad), open-eyed,
tr.22: Now what is the matter with the Unbelievers that they rush madly before thee-
tr.203: So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), in order to belie you and to mock at you, and at Allâh’s Book (this Qur’ân)].

70.en: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?

tr.85: from right and left, in crowds?
tr.19: On the right and on the left, in groups?
tr.22: From the right and from the left, in crowds?
tr.203: (Sitting) in groups on the right and on the left (of you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?

70.ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
70.en: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
70.tl: ayaṭmaʿu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yud'khala jannata naʿīmin

tr.85: Does every one of them expect to enter a Garden of bliss?
tr.19: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
tr.22: Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
tr.203: Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?

70.en: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.

tr.85: No! We created them from the substance they know,
tr.19: Nay, verily. Lo! We created them from what they know.
tr.22: By no means! For We have created them out of the (base matter) they know!
tr.203: No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know!

70.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
70.en: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
70.tl: falā uq'simu birabbi l-mashāriqi wal-maghāribi innā laqādirūna

tr.85: and, by the Lord of every sunrise and sunset, We have the power
tr.19: But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the planets that We verily are Able
tr.22: Now I do call to witness the Lord of all points in the East and the West that We can certainly-
tr.203: So I swear by the Lord of all the [three hundred and sixty-five (365)] points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able

70.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
70.en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
70.tl: ʿalā an nubaddila khayran min'hum wamā naḥnu bimasbūqīna

tr.85: to substitute for them others better than they are- nothing can prevent Us from doing this.
tr.19: To replace them by (others) better than them. And we are not to be outrun.
tr.22: Substitute for them better (men) than they; And We are not to be defeated (in Our Plan).
tr.203: To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun.

70.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
70.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
70.tl: fadharhum yakhūḍū wayalʿabū ḥattā yulāqū yawmahumu alladhī yūʿadūna

tr.85: So leave them to wallow in idle talk, until they come face to face with their promised Day,
tr.19: So let them chat and play until they meet their Day which they are promised,
tr.22: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they encounter that Day of theirs which they have been promised!-
tr.203: So leave them to plunge in vain talk and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised -

70.ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
70.en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
70.tl: yawma yakhrujūna mina l-ajdāthi sirāʿan ka-annahum ilā nuṣubin yūfiḍūna

tr.85: the Day they will rush out of their graves as if rallying to a flag,
tr.19: The day when they come forth from the graves in haste, as racing to a goal,
tr.22: The Day whereon they will issue from their sepulchres in sudden haste as if they were rushing to a goal-post (fixed for them),-
tr.203: The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,

70.ar: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
70.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
70.tl: khāshiʿatan abṣāruhum tarhaquhum dhillatun dhālika l-yawmu alladhī kānū yūʿadūna

tr.85: eyes downcast and covered in shame: that is the Day of which they were warned.
tr.19: With eyes aghast, abasement stupefying them: Such is the Day which they are promised.
tr.22: Their eyes lowered in dejection,- ignominy covering them (all over)! such is the Day the which they are promised!
tr.203: With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!

71.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
71.en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
71.tl: innā arsalnā nūḥan ilā qawmihi an andhir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum ʿadhābun alīmun

tr.85: We sent Noah to his people: ‘Warn your people, before a painful punishment comes to them.’
tr.19: Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn thy people ere the painful doom come unto them.
tr.22: We sent Noah to his People (with the Command): "Do thou warn thy People before there comes to them a grievous Penalty."
tr.203: Verily, We sent Nûh (Noah) to his people (saying): "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment."

71.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
71.en: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -
71.tl: qāla yāqawmi innī lakum nadhīrun mubīnun

tr.85: And so he said, ‘My people, I am here to warn you plainly.
tr.19: He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you
tr.22: He said: "O my People! I am to you a Warner, clear and open:
tr.203: He said: "O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,

71.ar: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
71.en: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.
71.tl: ani uʿ'budū l-laha wa-ittaqūhu wa-aṭīʿūni

tr.85: Serve God, be mindful of Him and obey me.
tr.19: (Bidding you): Serve Allah and keep your duty unto Him and obey me,
tr.22: "That ye should worship Allah, fear Him and obey me:
tr.203: "That you should worship Allâh (Alone), fear (be dutiful to) Him, and obey me,

71.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
71.en: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."
71.tl: yaghfir lakum min dhunūbikum wayu-akhir'kum ilā ajalin musamman inna ajala l-lahi idhā jāa lā yu-akharu law kuntum taʿlamūna

tr.85: He will forgive you your sins and spare you until your appointed time––when God’s appointed time arrives it cannot be postponed. If only you understood!’
tr.19: That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Lo! the term of Allah, when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew.
tr.22: "So He may forgive you your sins and give you respite for a stated Term: for when the Term given by Allah is accomplished, it cannot be put forward: if ye only knew."
tr.203: "He (Allâh) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allâh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew."

71.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
71.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
71.tl: qāla rabbi innī daʿawtu qawmī laylan wanahāran

tr.85: He said, ‘My Lord, I have called my people night and day,
tr.19: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people night and day
tr.22: He said: "O my Lord! I have called to my People night and day:
tr.203: He said: "O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islâmic Monotheism),

71.ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
71.en: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
71.tl: falam yazid'hum duʿāī illā firāran

tr.85: but the more I call them, the further they run away:
tr.19: But all my calling doth but add to their repugnance;
tr.22: "But my call only increases (their) flight (from the Right).
tr.203: "But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth).

71.ar: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
71.en: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
71.tl: wa-innī kullamā daʿawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaʿalū aṣābiʿahum fī ādhānihim wa-is'taghshaw thiyābahum wa-aṣarrū wa-is'takbarū is'tik'bāran

tr.85: every time I call them, so that You may forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, cover their heads with their garments, persist in their rejection, and grow more insolent and arrogant.
tr.19: And lo! whenever I call unto them that Thou mayst pardon them they thrust their fingers in their ears and cover themselves with their garments and persist (in their refusal) and magnify themselves in pride.
tr.22: "And every time I have called to them, that Thou mightest forgive them, they have (only) thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, grown obstinate, and given themselves up to arrogance.
tr.203: And verily, every time I called unto them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their garments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified themselves in pride.

71.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
71.en: Then I invited them publicly.
71.tl: thumma innī daʿawtuhum jihāran

tr.85: I have tried calling them openly.
tr.19: And lo! I have called unto them aloud,
tr.22: "So I have called to them aloud;
tr.203: "Then verily, I called to them openly (aloud).

71.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
71.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
71.tl: thumma innī aʿlantu lahum wa-asrartu lahum is'rāran

tr.85: I have tried preaching to them in public and speaking to them in private.
tr.19: And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them, and I have appealed to them in private.
tr.22: "Further I have spoken to them in public and secretly in private,
tr.203: "Then verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private.

71.ar: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
71.en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
71.tl: faqul'tu is'taghfirū rabbakum innahu kāna ghaffāran

tr.85: I said, “Ask forgiveness of your Lord: He is ever forgiving.
tr.19: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
tr.22: "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
tr.203: "I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;

71.ar: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
71.en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
71.tl: yur'sili l-samāa ʿalaykum mid'rāran

tr.85: He will send down abundant rain from the sky for you;
tr.19: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
tr.22: "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
tr.203: ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,

71.ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
71.en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
71.tl: wayum'did'kum bi-amwālin wabanīna wayajʿal lakum jannātin wayajʿal lakum anhāran

tr.85: He will give you wealth and sons; He will provide you with gardens and rivers.
tr.19: And will help you with wealth and sons, and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers.
tr.22: "'Give you increase in wealth and sons; and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers (of flowing water).
tr.203: ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’"

71.ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
71.en: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur
71.tl: mā lakum lā tarjūna lillahi waqāran

tr.85: What is the matter with you? Why will you not fear God’s majesty,
tr.19: What aileth you that ye hope not toward Allah for dignity
tr.22: "'What is the matter with you, that ye place not your hope for kindness and long-suffering in Allah,-
tr.203: What is the matter with you, that [you fear not Allâh (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allâh or you believe not in His Oneness).

71.ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
71.en: While He has created you in stages?
71.tl: waqad khalaqakum aṭwāran

tr.85: when He has created you stage by stage?
tr.19: When He created you by (divers) stages?
tr.22: "'Seeing that it is He that has created you in diverse stages?
tr.203: While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nutfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Mudghah, see (V.23:13,14)].

71.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
71.en: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers
71.tl: alam taraw kayfa khalaqa l-lahu sabʿa samāwātin ṭibāqan

tr.85: Have you ever wondered how God created seven heavens, one above the other,
tr.19: See ye not how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony,
tr.22: "'See ye not how Allah has created the seven heavens one above another,
tr.203: See you not how Allâh has created the seven heavens one above another?

71.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
71.en: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
71.tl: wajaʿala l-qamara fīhinna nūran wajaʿala l-shamsa sirājan

tr.85: placed the moon as a light in them and the sun as a lamp,
tr.19: And hath made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?
tr.22: "'And made the moon a light in their midst, and made the sun as a (Glorious) Lamp?
tr.203: And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?

71.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
71.en: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
71.tl: wal-lahu anbatakum mina l-arḍi nabātan

tr.85: how God made you spring forth from the earth like a plant,
tr.19: And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth,
tr.22: "'And Allah has produced you from the earth growing (gradually),
tr.203: And Allâh has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth? (Tafsir At-Tabarî)

71.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
71.en: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
71.tl: thumma yuʿīdukum fīhā wayukh'rijukum ikh'rājan

tr.85: how He will return you into it and then bring you out again,
tr.19: And afterward He maketh you return thereto, and He will bring you forth again, a (new) forthbringing.
tr.22: "'And in the End He will return you into the (earth), and raise you forth (again at the Resurrection)?
tr.203: Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)?

71.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
71.en: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse
71.tl: wal-lahu jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa bisāṭan

tr.85: and how He has spread the Earth out for you
tr.19: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you
tr.22: "'And Allah has made the earth for you as a carpet (spread out),
tr.203: And Allâh has made for you the earth a wide expanse.

71.ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
71.en: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"
71.tl: litaslukū min'hā subulan fijājan

tr.85: to walk along its spacious paths?” ’
tr.19: That ye may thread the valley-ways thereof.
tr.22: "'That ye may go about therein, in spacious roads.'"
tr.203: That you may go about therein in broad roads.

71.ar: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
71.en: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
71.tl: qāla nūḥun rabbi innahum ʿaṣawnī wa-ittabaʿū man lam yazid'hu māluhu wawaladuhu illā khasāran

tr.85: Noah said, ‘My Lord, they have disobeyed me and followed those whose riches and children only increase their ruin;
tr.19: Noah said: My Lord! Lo! they have disobeyed me and followed one whose wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin;
tr.22: Noah said: "O my Lord! They have disobeyed me, but they follow (men) whose wealth and children give them no increase but only Loss.
tr.203: Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss.

71.ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
71.en: And they conspired an immense conspiracy
71.tl: wamakarū makran kubbāran

tr.85: who have made a grand plan,
tr.19: And they have plotted a mighty plot,
tr.22: "And they have devised a tremendous Plot.
tr.203: "And they have plotted a mighty plot.

71.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
71.en: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'
71.tl: waqālū lā tadharunna ālihatakum walā tadharunna waddan walā suwāʿan walā yaghūtha wayaʿūqa wanasran

tr.85: saying, “Do not renounce your gods! Do not renounce Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq, or Nasr!”
tr.19: And they have said: Forsake not your gods. Forsake not Wadd, nor Suwa', nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
tr.22: "And they have said (to each other), 'Abandon not your gods: Abandon neither Wadd nor Suwa', neither Yaguth nor Ya'uq, nor Nasr';-
tr.203: "And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwâ‘, nor Yaghûth, nor Ya‘ûq nor Nasr’ (these are the names of their idols).

71.ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
71.en: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
71.tl: waqad aḍallū kathīran walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā ḍalālan

tr.85: They have led many astray. Lord, bring nothing but destruction down on the evildoers!’
tr.19: And they have led many astray, and Thou increasest the wrong-doers in naught save error.
tr.22: "They have already misled many; and grant Thou no increase to the wrong-doers but in straying (from their mark)."
tr.203: "And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allâh): ‘Grant no increase to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) save error.’"

71.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
71.en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.
71.tl: mimmā khaṭīātihim ugh'riqū fa-ud'khilū nāran falam yajidū lahum min dūni l-lahi anṣāran

tr.85: They were drowned and sent to Hell for their evildoings: they found no one to help them against God.
tr.19: Because of their sins they were drowned, then made to enter a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah.
tr.22: Because of their sins they were drowned (in the flood), and were made to enter the Fire (of Punishment): and they found- in lieu of Allah- none to help them.
tr.203: Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allâh.

71.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
71.en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
71.tl: waqāla nūḥun rabbi lā tadhar ʿalā l-arḍi mina l-kāfirīna dayyāran

tr.85: And Noah said, ‘Lord, do not leave any of the disbelievers on the earth-
tr.19: And Noah said: My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.
