tr.22: And Noah, said: "O my Lord! Leave not of the Unbelievers, a single one on earth!
tr.203: And Nûh (Noah) said: "My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!

71.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
71.en: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
71.tl: innaka in tadharhum yuḍillū ʿibādaka walā yalidū illā fājiran kaffāran

tr.85: if you leave them they will lead Your servants astray and beget only sinners and disbelievers-
tr.19: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
tr.22: "For, if Thou dost leave (any of) them, they will but mislead Thy devotees, and they will breed none but wicked ungrateful ones.
tr.203: "If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers.

71.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
71.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
71.tl: rabbi igh'fir lī waliwālidayya waliman dakhala baytiya mu'minan walil'mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti walā tazidi l-ẓālimīna illā tabāran

tr.85: Lord, forgive me, my parents, and whoever enters my house as a believer. Forgive believing men and women but bring nothing but ruin down on the evildoers!’
tr.19: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents and him who entereth my house believing, and believing men and believing women, and increase not the wrong-doers in aught save ruin.
tr.22: "O my Lord! Forgive me, my parents, all who enter my house in Faith, and (all) believing men and believing women: and to the wrong-doers grant Thou no increase but in perdition!"
tr.203: "My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Zâlimûn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) grant You no increase but destruction!"

72.ar: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
72.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
72.tl: qul ūḥiya ilayya annahu is'tamaʿa nafarun mina l-jini faqālū innā samiʿ'nā qur'ānan ʿajaban

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘It has been revealed to me that a group of jinn once listened in and said, “We have heard a wondrous Quran,
tr.19: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
tr.22: Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinn listened (to this Qur’ân). They said: ‘Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation (this Qur’ân)!

72.ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
72.en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
72.tl: yahdī ilā l-rush'di faāmannā bihi walan nush'rika birabbinā aḥadan

tr.85: that gives guidance to the right path, and we have come to believe it––We shall never set up partners with our Lord––
tr.19: Which guideth unto righteousness, so we believe in it and we ascribe no partner unto our Lord.
tr.22: 'It gives guidance to the Right, and we have believed therein: we shall not join (in worship) any (gods) with our Lord.
tr.203: ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allâh).

72.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
72.en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
72.tl: wa-annahu taʿālā jaddu rabbinā mā ittakhadha ṣāḥibatan walā waladan

tr.85: and that He––exalted be the glory of our Lord!––has neither spouse nor child.
tr.19: And (we believe) that He - exalted be the glory of our Lord! - hath taken neither wife nor son,
tr.22: 'And Exalted is the Majesty of our Lord: He has taken neither a wife nor a son.
tr.203: ‘And He, exalted be the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son (or offspring or children).

72.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
72.en: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.
72.tl: wa-annahu kāna yaqūlu safīhunā ʿalā l-lahi shaṭaṭan

tr.85: Outrageous things have been said about God by the foolish among us,
tr.19: And that the foolish one among us used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.
tr.22: 'There were some foolish ones among us, who used to utter extravagant lies against Allah;
tr.203: ‘And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblîs (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinn] used to utter against Allâh that which was an enormity in falsehood.

72.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
72.en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.
72.tl: wa-annā ẓanannā an lan taqūla l-insu wal-jinu ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban

tr.85: although we had thought that no man or jinn would [dare to] tell a lie about Him.
tr.19: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah -
tr.22: 'But we do think that no man or spirit should say aught that untrue against Allah.
tr.203: ‘And verily, we thought that men and jinn would not utter a lie against Allâh.

72.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
72.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
72.tl: wa-annahu kāna rijālun mina l-insi yaʿūdhūna birijālin mina l-jini fazādūhum rahaqan

tr.85: Men have sought refuge with the jinn in the past, but they only misguided them further.
tr.19: And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn, so that they increased them in revolt against Allah);
tr.22: 'True, there were persons among mankind who took shelter with persons among the Jinns, but they increased them in folly.
tr.203: ‘And verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the jinn, but they (jinn) increased them (mankind) in sin and transgression.

72.ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
72.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].
72.tl: wa-annahum ẓannū kamā ẓanantum an lan yabʿatha l-lahu aḥadan

tr.85: They thought, as you did, that God would never raise anyone from the dead.
tr.19: And indeed they supposed, even as ye suppose, that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead) -
tr.22: 'And they (came to) think as ye thought, that Allah would not raise up any one (to Judgment).
tr.203: ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allâh will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinn).

72.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
72.en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
72.tl: wa-annā lamasnā l-samāa fawajadnāhā muli-at ḥarasan shadīdan washuhuban

tr.85: We tried to reach heaven, but discovered it to be full of stern guards and shooting stars––
tr.19: And (the Jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven but had found it filled with strong warders and meteors.
tr.22: 'And we pried into the secrets of heaven; but we found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.
tr.203: ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires.

72.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
72.en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
72.tl: wa-annā kunnā naqʿudu min'hā maqāʿida lilssamʿi faman yastamiʿi l-āna yajid lahu shihāban raṣadan

tr.85: we used to sit in places there, listening, but anyone trying to listen now will find a shooting star lying in wait for him––
tr.19: And we used to sit on places (high) therein to listen. But he who listeneth now findeth a flame in wait for him;
tr.22: 'We used, indeed, to sit there in (hidden) stations, to (steal) a hearing; but any who listen now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.
tr.203: ‘And verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) a hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush.

72.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
72.en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
72.tl: wa-annā lā nadrī asharrun urīda biman fī l-arḍi am arāda bihim rabbuhum rashadan

tr.85: [so now] we do not know whether those who live on earth are due for misfortune, or whether their Lord intends to guide them.
tr.19: And we know not whether harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them.
tr.22: 'And we understand not whether ill is intended to those on earth, or whether their Lord (really) intends to guide them to right conduct.
tr.203: ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path.

72.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
72.en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
72.tl: wa-annā minnā l-ṣāliḥūna waminnā dūna dhālika kunnā ṭarāiqa qidadan

tr.85: Some of us are righteous and others less so: we follow different paths.
tr.19: And among us there are righteous folk and among us there are far from that. We are sects having different rules.
tr.22: 'There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary: we follow divergent paths.
tr.203: ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways (religious sects).

72.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
72.en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
72.tl: wa-annā ẓanannā an lan nuʿ'jiza l-laha fī l-arḍi walan nuʿ'jizahu haraban

tr.85: We know we can never frustrate God on earth; we can never escape Him.
tr.19: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
tr.22: 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
tr.203: ‘And we think that we cannot escape (the punishment of) Allâh in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

72.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
72.en: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
72.tl: wa-annā lammā samiʿ'nā l-hudā āmannā bihi faman yu'min birabbihi falā yakhāfu bakhsan walā rahaqan

tr.85: When we heard the guidance we came to believe: whoever believes in his Lord need fear no loss nor injustice.
tr.19: And when we heard the guidance, we believed therein, and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss nor oppression.
tr.22: 'And as for us, since we have listened to the Guidance, we have accepted it: and any who believes in his Lord has no fear, either of a short (account) or of any injustice.
tr.203: ‘And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Qur’ân), we believed therein (Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins.

72.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
72.en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
72.tl: wa-annā minnā l-mus'limūna waminnā l-qāsiṭūna faman aslama fa-ulāika taḥarraw rashadan

tr.85: Some of us submit to Him and others go the wrong way: those who submit to God have found wise guidance,
tr.19: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
tr.22: 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
tr.203: ‘And of us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allâh, after listening to this Qur’ân), and of us some are Al-Qâsitûn (disbelievers - those who have deviated from the Right Path)’. And whosoever has embraced Islâm (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allâh), then such have sought the Right Path."

72.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
72.en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
72.tl: wa-ammā l-qāsiṭūna fakānū lijahannama ḥaṭaban

tr.85: but those who go wrong will be fuel for Hellfire.” ’
tr.19: And as for those who are unjust, they are firewood for hell.
tr.22: 'But those who swerve,- they are (but) fuel for Hell-fire'-
tr.203: And as for the Qâsitûn (disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path), they shall be firewood for Hell,

72.ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
72.en: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].
72.tl: wa-allawi is'taqāmū ʿalā l-ṭarīqati la-asqaynāhum māan ghadaqan

tr.85: If they had taken to the right way, We would have given them abundant water to drink-
tr.19: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path, We shall give them to drink of water in abundance
tr.22: (And Allah's Message is): "If they (the Pagans) had (only) remained on the (right) Way, We should certainly have bestowed on them Rain in abundance.
tr.203: If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allâh, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islâm) We would surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance.

72.ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
72.en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
72.tl: linaftinahum fīhi waman yuʿ'riḍ ʿan dhik'ri rabbihi yasluk'hu ʿadhāban ṣaʿadan

tr.85: a test for them––but anyone who turns away from his Lord’s Revelation will be sent by Him to spiralling torment.
tr.19: That We may test them thereby, and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord; He will thrust him into ever-growing torment.
tr.22: "That We might try them by that (means). But if any turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will cause him to undergo a severe Penalty.
tr.203: That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Qur’ân, - and practise not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell).

72.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
72.en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.
72.tl: wa-anna l-masājida lillahi falā tadʿū maʿa l-lahi aḥadan

tr.85: Places of worship are for God alone- so do not pray to anyone other than God-
tr.19: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
tr.22: "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
tr.203: And the mosques are for Allâh (Alone): so invoke not anyone along with Allâh.

72.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
72.en: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
72.tl: wa-annahu lammā qāma ʿabdu l-lahi yadʿūhu kādū yakūnūna ʿalayhi libadan

tr.85: yet when God’s Servant stood up to pray to Him, they pressed in on him.
tr.19: And when the slave of Allah stood up in prayer to Him, they crowded on him, almost stifling.
tr.22: "Yet when the Devotee of Allah stands forth to invoke Him, they just make round him a dense crowd."
tr.203: And when the slave of Allâh (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) stood up invoking Him (his Lord - Allâh) in prayer they (the jinn) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other (in order to listen to the Prophet’s recitation).

72.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
72.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
72.tl: qul innamā adʿū rabbī walā ush'riku bihi aḥadan

tr.85: Say, ‘I pray to my Lord alone; I set up no partner with Him.’
tr.19: Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only, and ascribe unto Him no partner.
tr.22: Say: "I do no more than invoke my Lord, and I join not with Him any (false god)."
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I invoke only my Lord (Allâh Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him."

72.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
72.en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
72.tl: qul innī lā amliku lakum ḍarran walā rashadan

tr.85: Say, ‘I have no control over any harm or good that may befall you.’
tr.19: Say: Lo! I control not hurt nor benefit for you.
tr.22: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to right conduct."
tr.203: Say: "It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path."

72.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
72.en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
72.tl: qul innī lan yujīranī mina l-lahi aḥadun walan ajida min dūnihi mul'taḥadan

tr.85: Say, ‘No one can protect me from God: I have no refuge except in Him.
tr.19: Say: Lo! none can protect me from Allah, nor can I find any refuge beside Him
tr.22: Say: "No one can deliver me from Allah (If I were to disobey Him), nor should I find refuge except in Him,
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "None can protect me from Allâh’s punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor can I find refuge except in Him.

72.ar: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
72.en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
72.tl: illā balāghan mina l-lahi warisālātihi waman yaʿṣi l-laha warasūlahu fa-inna lahu nāra jahannama khālidīna fīhā abadan

tr.85: I only deliver [what I receive] from God- only His messages.’ Whoever disobeys God and His Messenger will have Hell’s Fire as his permanent home:
tr.19: (Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah, and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger, lo! his is fire of hell, wherein such dwell for ever.
tr.22: "Unless I proclaim what I receive from Allah and His Messages: for any that disobey Allah and His Messenger,- for them is Hell: they shall dwell therein for ever."
tr.203: "(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allâh and His Messages (of Islâmic Monotheism), and whosoever disobeys Allâh and His Messenger, then Verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever."

72.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
72.en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
72.tl: ḥattā idhā ra-aw mā yūʿadūna fasayaʿlamūna man aḍʿafu nāṣiran wa-aqallu ʿadadan

tr.85: when they are confronted by what they have been warned about, they will realize who has the weaker protector and the smaller number.
tr.19: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
tr.22: At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
tr.203: Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.

72.ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
72.en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
72.tl: qul in adrī aqarībun mā tūʿadūna am yajʿalu lahu rabbī amadan

tr.85: Say, ‘I do not know whether what you have been warned about is near, or whether a distant time has been appointed for it by my Lord.’
tr.19: Say (O Muhammad, unto the disbelievers): I know not whether that which ye are promised is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.
tr.22: Say: "I know not whether the (Punishment) which ye are promised is near, or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term.

72.ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
72.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
72.tl: ʿālimu l-ghaybi falā yuẓ'hiru ʿalā ghaybihi aḥadan

tr.85: He is the One who knows what is hidden.
tr.19: (He is) the Knower of the Unseen, and He revealeth unto none His secret,
tr.22: "He (alone) knows the Unseen, nor does He make any one acquainted with His Mysteries,-
tr.203: "(He Alone is) the All-Knower of the Ghaib (Unseen), and He reveals to none His Ghaib (Unseen)."

72.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
72.en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
72.tl: illā mani ir'taḍā min rasūlin fa-innahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi raṣadan

tr.85: He does not disclose it except to a messenger of His choosing. He sends watchers to go in front and behind
tr.19: Save unto every messenger whom He hath chosen, and then He maketh a guard to go before him and a guard behind him
tr.22: "Except a messenger whom He has chosen: and then He makes a band of watchers march before him and behind him,
tr.203: Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him.

72.ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
72.en: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
72.tl: liyaʿlama an qad ablaghū risālāti rabbihim wa-aḥāṭa bimā ladayhim wa-aḥṣā kulla shayin ʿadadan

tr.85: to ensure that each of His messengers delivers his Lord’s message: He knows all about them, and He takes account of everything.
tr.19: That He may know that they have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord. He surroundeth all their doings, and He keepeth count of all things.
tr.22: "That He may know that they have (truly) brought and delivered the Messages of their Lord: and He surrounds (all the mysteries) that are with them, and takes account of every single thing."
tr.203: [He (Allâh) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allâh). And He (Allâh) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allâh) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything).

73.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
73.en: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]
73.tl: yāayyuhā l-muzamilu

tr.85: You [Prophet], enfolded in your cloak!
tr.19: O thou wrapped up in thy raiment!
tr.22: O thou folded in garments!
tr.203: O you wrapped in garments (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)!

73.ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
73.en: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
73.tl: qumi al-layla illā qalīlan

tr.85: Stay up throughout the night, all but a small part of it,
tr.19: Keep vigil the night long, save a little -
tr.22: Stand (to prayer) by night, but not all night,-
tr.203: Stand (to pray) all night, except a little -

73.ar: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
73.en: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
73.tl: niṣ'fahu awi unquṣ min'hu qalīlan

tr.85: half, or a little less,
tr.19: A half thereof, or abate a little thereof
tr.22: Half of it,- or a little less,
tr.203: Half of it or a little less than that,

73.ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
73.en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
73.tl: aw zid ʿalayhi warattili l-qur'āna tartīlan

tr.85: or a little more; recite the Quran slowly and distinctly:
tr.19: Or add (a little) thereto - and chant the Qur'an in measure,
tr.22: Or a little more; and recite the Qur'an in slow, measured rhythmic tones.
tr.203: Or a little more. And recite the Qur’ân (aloud) in a slow, (pleasant tone and) style.

73.ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
73.en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
73.tl: innā sanul'qī ʿalayka qawlan thaqīlan

tr.85: We shall send a momentous message down to you.
tr.19: For we shall charge thee with a word of weight.
tr.22: Soon shall We send down to thee a weighty Message.
tr.203: Verily, We shall send down to you a weighty Word (i.e. obligations, laws).

73.ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
73.en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
73.tl: inna nāshi-ata al-layli hiya ashaddu waṭan wa-aqwamu qīlan

tr.85: Night prayer makes a deeper impression and sharpens words––
tr.19: Lo! the vigil of the night is (a time) when impression is more keen and speech more certain.
tr.22: Truly the rising by night is most potent for governing (the soul), and most suitable for (framing) the Word (of Prayer and Praise).
tr.203: Verily, the rising by night (for Tahajjud prayer) is very hard and most potent and good for governing oneself, and most suitable for (understanding) the Word (of Allâh).

73.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
73.en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
73.tl: inna laka fī l-nahāri sabḥan ṭawīlan

tr.85: you are kept busy for long periods of the day––
tr.19: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
tr.22: True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
tr.203: Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties.

73.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
73.en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
73.tl: wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabtīlan

tr.85: so celebrate the name of your Lord and devote yourself wholeheart-edly to Him.
tr.19: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
tr.22: But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
tr.203: And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.

73.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
73.en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
73.tl: rabbu l-mashriqi wal-maghribi lā ilāha illā huwa fa-ittakhidh'hu wakīlan

tr.85: He is Lord of the east and west, there is no god but Him, so take Him as your Protector,
tr.19: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
tr.22: (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
tr.203: (He Alone is) the Lord of the east and the west; Lâ ilâha illâ Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). So take Him Alone as Wakîl (Disposer of your affairs).

73.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
73.en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
73.tl: wa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wa-uh'jur'hum hajran jamīlan

tr.85: patiently endure what they say, ignore them politely,
tr.19: And bear with patience what they utter, and part from them with a fair leave-taking.
tr.22: And have patience with what they say, and leave them with noble (dignity).
tr.203: And be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with what they say, and keep away from them in a good way.

73.ar: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
73.en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
73.tl: wadharnī wal-mukadhibīna ulī l-naʿmati wamahhil'hum qalīlan

tr.85: and leave to Me those who deny the truth and live in luxury. Bear with them for a little while;
tr.19: Leave Me to deal with the deniers, lords of ease and comfort (in this life); and do thou respite them awhile.
tr.22: And leave Me (alone to deal with) those in possession of the good things of life, who (yet) deny the Truth; and bear with them for a little while.
tr.203: And leave Me Alone to deal with the beliers (those who deny My Verses), those who are in possession of good things of life. And give them respite for a little while.

73.ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
73.en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.
73.tl: inna ladaynā ankālan wajaḥīman

tr.85: We have fetters, a blazing fire,
tr.19: Lo! with Us are heavy fetters and a raging fire,
tr.22: With Us are Fetters (to bind them), and a Fire (to burn them),
tr.203: Verily, with Us are fetters (to bind them), and a raging Fire.

73.ar: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
73.en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
73.tl: waṭaʿāman dhā ghuṣṣatin waʿadhāban alīman

tr.85: food that chokes, and agonizing torment in store for them
tr.19: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
tr.22: And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
tr.203: And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.

73.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
73.en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
73.tl: yawma tarjufu l-arḍu wal-jibālu wakānati l-jibālu kathīban mahīlan

tr.85: on the Day when the earth and the mountains will shake. The mountains will become a heap of loose sand.
tr.19: On the day when the earth and the hills rock, and the hills become a heap of running sand.
tr.22: One Day the earth and the mountains will be in violent commotion. And the mountains will be as a heap of sand poured out and flowing down.
tr.203: On the Day when the earth and the mountains will be in violent shake, and the mountains will be a heap of sand poured out.

73.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
73.en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
73.tl: innā arsalnā ilaykum rasūlan shāhidan ʿalaykum kamā arsalnā ilā fir'ʿawna rasūlan

tr.85: We have sent a messenger to you [people] to be your witness, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh,
tr.19: Lo! We have sent unto you a messenger as witness against you, even as We sent unto Pharaoh a messenger.
tr.22: We have sent to you, (O men!) a messenger, to be a witness concerning you, even as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
tr.203: Verily, We have sent to you (O men) a Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to be a witness over you, as We did send a Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)] to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh).

73.ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
73.en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
73.tl: faʿaṣā fir'ʿawnu l-rasūla fa-akhadhnāhu akhdhan wabīlan

tr.85: but Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger and so We inflicted a heavy punishment on him.
tr.19: But Pharaoh rebelled against the messenger, whereupon We seized him with no gentle grip.
tr.22: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger; so We seized him with a heavy Punishment.
tr.203: But Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) disobeyed the Messenger [Mûsâ (Moses)]; so We seized him with a severe punishment.

73.ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
73.en: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?
73.tl: fakayfa tattaqūna in kafartum yawman yajʿalu l-wil'dāna shīban

tr.85: So if you disbelieve, how can you guard yourselves against a Day that will turn children’s hair grey,
tr.19: Then how, if ye disbelieve, will ye protect yourselves upon the day which will turn children grey,
tr.22: Then how shall ye, if ye deny (Allah), guard yourselves against a Day that will make children hoary-headed?-
tr.203: Then how can you avoid the punishment, if you disbelieve, on a Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) that will make the children grey-headed?

73.ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
73.en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
73.tl: al-samāu munfaṭirun bihi kāna waʿduhu mafʿūlan

tr.85: a Day when the sky will be torn apart? God’s promise will certainly be fulfilled.
tr.19: The very heaven being then rent asunder. His promise is to be fulfilled.
tr.22: Whereon the sky will be cleft asunder? His Promise needs must be accomplished.
tr.203: Whereon the heaven will be cleft asunder? His Promise is certainly to be accomplished.

73.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
73.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
73.tl: inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlan

tr.85: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes take the way to his Lord.
tr.19: Lo! This is a Reminder. Let him who will, then, choose a way unto his Lord.
tr.22: Verily this is an Admonition: therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) path to his Lord!
tr.203: Verily, this is an admonition: therefore whosoever will, let him take a Path to His Lord!

73.ar: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
73.en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
73.tl: inna rabbaka yaʿlamu annaka taqūmu adnā min thuluthayi al-layli waniṣ'fahu wathuluthahu waṭāifatun mina alladhīna maʿaka wal-lahu yuqaddiru al-layla wal-nahāra ʿalima an lan tuḥ'ṣūhu fatāba ʿalaykum fa-iq'raū mā tayassara mina l-qur'āni ʿalima an sayakūnu minkum marḍā waākharūna yaḍribūna fī l-arḍi yabtaghūna min faḍli l-lahi waākharūna yuqātilūna fī sabīli l-lahi fa-iq'raū mā tayassara min'hu wa-aqīmū l-ṣalata waātū l-zakata wa-aqriḍū l-laha qarḍan ḥasanan wamā tuqaddimū li-anfusikum min khayrin tajidūhu ʿinda l-lahi huwa khayran wa-aʿẓama ajran wa-is'taghfirū l-laha inna l-laha ghafūrun raḥīmun

tr.85: [Prophet], your Lord is well aware that you sometimes spend nearly two-thirds of the night at prayer––sometimes half, sometimes a third––as do some of your followers. God determines the division of night and day. He knows that you will not be able to keep a measure of it and He has relented towards all of you, so recite as much of the Quran as is easy for you. He knows that some of you will be sick, some of you travelling through the land seeking God’s bounty, some of you fighting in God’s way: recite as much as is easy for you, keep up the prayer, pay the prescribed alms, and make God a good loan. Whatever good you store up for yourselves will be improved and increased for you. Ask God for His forgiveness, He is most forgiving, most merciful.
tr.19: Lo! thy Lord knoweth how thou keepest vigil sometimes nearly two-thirds of the night, or (sometimes) half or a third thereof, as do a party of those with thee. Allah measureth the night and the day. He knoweth that ye count it not, and turneth unto you in mercy. Recite, then, of the Qur'an that which is easy for you. He knoweth that there are sick folk among you, while others travel in the land in search of Allah's bounty, and others (still) are fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite of it that which is easy (for you), and establish worship and pay the poor-due, and (so) lend unto Allah a goodly loan. Whatsoever good ye send before you for your souls, ye will find it with Allah, better and greater in the recompense. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
tr.22: Thy Lord doth know that thou standest forth (to prayer) nigh two-thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and so doth a party of those with thee. But Allah doth appoint night and day in due measure He knoweth that ye are unable to keep count thereof. So He hath turned to you (in mercy): read ye, therefore, of the Qur'an as much as may be easy for you. He knoweth that there may be (some) among you in ill-health; others travelling through the land, seeking of Allah's bounty; yet others fighting in Allah's Cause, read ye, therefore, as much of the Qur'an as may be easy (for you); and establish regular Prayer and give regular Charity; and loan to Allah a Beautiful Loan. And whatever good ye send forth for your souls ye shall find it in Allah's Presence,- yea, better and greater, in Reward and seek ye the Grace of Allah: for Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
tr.203: Verily, your Lord knows that you do stand (to pray at night) a little less than two thirds of the night, or half the night, or a third of the night, and also a party of those with you. And Allâh measures the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to pray the whole night, so He has turned to you (in mercy). So, recite you of the Qur’ân as much as may be easy for you. He knows that there will be some among you sick, others travelling through the land, seeking of Allâh’s Bounty, yet others fighting in Allâh’s Cause. So recite as much of the Qur’ân as may be easy (for you), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât ) and give Zakât, and lend to Allâh a goodly loan. And whatever good you send before you for yourselves (i.e. Nawâfil non-obligatory acts of worship: prayers, charity, fasting, Hajj and ‘Umrah), you will certainly find it with Allâh, better and greater in reward. And seek Forgiveness of Allâh. Verily, Allâh is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.

74.en: O you who covers himself [with a garment],

tr.85: You, wrapped in your cloak,
tr.19: O thou enveloped in thy cloak,
tr.22: O thou wrapped up (in the mantle)!
tr.203: O you (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) enveloped in garments!

74.en: Arise and warn.

tr.85: arise and give warning!
tr.19: Arise and warn!
tr.22: Arise and deliver thy warning!
tr.203: Arise and warn!

74.en: And your Lord glorify.

tr.85: Proclaim the greatness of your Lord;
tr.19: Thy Lord magnify,
tr.22: And thy Lord do thou magnify!
tr.203: And magnify your Lord (Allâh)!

74.en: And your clothing purify.

tr.85: cleanse yourself;
tr.19: Thy raiment purify,
tr.22: And thy garments keep free from stain!
tr.203: And purify your garments!

74.en: And uncleanliness avoid.

tr.85: keep away from all filth;
tr.19: Pollution shun!
tr.22: And all abomination shun!
tr.203: And keep away from Ar-Rujz (the idols)!

74.en: And do not confer favor to acquire more.

tr.85: do not be overwhelmed and weaken;
tr.19: And show not favour, seeking wordly gain!
tr.22: Nor expect, in giving, any increase (for thyself)!
tr.203: And give not a thing in order to have more (or consider not your deeds of obedience to Allâh as a favour to Him).

74.en: But for your Lord be patient.

tr.85: be steadfast in your Lord’s cause.
tr.19: For the sake of thy Lord, be patient!
tr.22: But, for thy Lord's (Cause), be patient and constant!
tr.203: And be patient for the sake of your Lord (i.e. perform your duty to Allâh)!

74.en: And when the trumpet is blown,

tr.85: When the Trumpet sounds,
tr.19: For when the trumpet shall sound,
tr.22: Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
tr.203: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded (i.e. the second blowing of the horn).

74.en: That Day will be a difficult day

tr.85: that will be a Day of anguish for the disbelievers.
tr.19: Surely that day will be a day of anguish,
tr.22: That will be- that Day - a Day of Distress,-
tr.203: Truly, that Day will be a Hard Day -

74.en: For the disbelievers - not easy.

tr.85: They will have no ease.
tr.19: Not of ease, for disbelievers.
tr.22: Far from easy for those without Faith.
tr.203: Far from easy for the disbelievers.

74.en: Leave Me with the one I created alone

tr.85: [Prophet], leave Me to deal with the one I created helpless,
tr.19: Leave Me (to deal) with him whom I created lonely,
tr.22: Leave Me alone, (to deal) with the (creature) whom I created (bare and) alone!-
tr.203: Leave Me Alone (to deal) with whom I created lonely (without any wealth or children etc, i.e. Al-Walîd bin Al-Mughîrah Al-Makhzûmî)!

74.en: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

tr.85: then gave vast wealth,
tr.19: And then bestowed upon him ample means,
tr.22: To whom I granted resources in abundance,
tr.203: And then granted him resources in abundance.

74.en: And children present [with him]

tr.85: and sons by his side,
tr.19: And sons abiding in his presence
tr.22: And sons to be by his side!-
tr.203: And children to be by his side.

74.en: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

tr.85: making everything easy for him––
tr.19: And made (life) smooth for him.
tr.22: To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
tr.203: And made life smooth and comfortable for him.

74.en: Then he desires that I should add more.

tr.85: yet he still hopes I will give him more.
tr.19: Yet he desireth that I should give more.
tr.22: Yet is he greedy-that I should add (yet more);-
tr.203: After all that he desires that I should give more;

74.en: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

tr.85: No! He has been stubbornly hostile to Our revelation:
tr.19: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
tr.22: By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
tr.203: Nay! Verily, he has been opposing Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations).

74.en: I will cover him with arduous torment.

tr.85: I will inflict a spiralling torment on him.
tr.19: On him I shall impose a fearful doom.
tr.22: Soon will I visit him with a mount of calamities!
tr.203: I shall oblige him to (climb a slippery mountain in the Hell-fire called As-Sa‘ûd, or) face a severe torment!

74.en: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.

tr.85: He planned and plotted––
tr.19: For lo! he did consider; then he planned -
tr.22: For he thought and he plotted;-
tr.203: Verily, he thought and plotted.

74.en: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

tr.85: devilishly he plotted!
tr.19: (Self-)destroyed is he, how he planned!
tr.22: And woe to him! How he plotted!-
tr.203: So let him be cursed: how he plotted!

74.en: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

tr.85: ferociously he plotted!––
tr.19: Again (self-)destroyed is he, how he planned! -
tr.22: Yea, Woe to him; How he plotted!-
tr.203: And once more let him be cursed: how he plotted!

74.en: Then he considered [again];

tr.85: and looked
tr.19: Then looked he,
tr.22: Then he looked round;
tr.203: Then he thought.

74.en: Then he frowned and scowled;

tr.85: and frowned and scowled
tr.19: Then frowned he and showed displeasure.
tr.22: Then he frowned and he scowled;
tr.203: Then he frowned and he looked in a bad tempered way;

74.en: Then he turned back and was arrogant

tr.85: and turned away and behaved arrogantly
tr.19: Then turned he away in pride
tr.22: Then he turned back and was haughty;
tr.203: Then he turned back, and was proud.

74.ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
74.en: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
74.tl: faqāla in hādhā illā siḥ'run yu'tharu

tr.85: and said, ‘This is just old sorcery,
tr.19: And said: This is naught else than magic from of old;
tr.22: Then said he: "This is nothing but magic, derived from of old;
tr.203: Then he said: "This is nothing but magic from that of old,

74.en: This is not but the word of a human being."

tr.85: just the talk of a mortal!’
tr.19: This is naught else than speech of mortal man.
tr.22: "This is nothing but the word of a mortal!"
tr.203: "This is nothing but the word of a human being!"

74.en: I will drive him into Saqar.

tr.85: I will throw him into the scorching Fire.
tr.19: Him shall I fling unto the burning.
tr.22: Soon will I cast him into Hell-Fire!
tr.203: I will cast him into Hell-fire.

74.en: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the scorching Fire is?
tr.19: - Ah, what will convey unto thee what that burning is! -
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what Hell-Fire is?
tr.203: And what will make you know (exactly) what Hell-fire is?

74.en: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

tr.85: It spares nothing and leaves nothing;
tr.19: It leaveth naught; it spareth naught
tr.22: Naught doth it permit to endure, and naught doth it leave alone!-
tr.203: It spares not (any sinner), nor does it leave (anything unburnt)!

74.en: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.

tr.85: it scorches the flesh of humans;
tr.19: It shrivelleth the man.
tr.22: Darkening and changing the colour of man!
tr.203: Burning and blackening the skins!

74.en: Over it are nineteen [angels].

tr.85: there are nineteen in charge of it––
tr.19: Above it are nineteen.
tr.22: Over it are Nineteen.
tr.203: Over it are nineteen (angels as guardians and keepers of Hell).

74.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
74.en: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
74.tl: wamā jaʿalnā aṣḥāba l-nāri illā malāikatan wamā jaʿalnā ʿiddatahum illā fit'natan lilladhīna kafarū liyastayqina alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wayazdāda alladhīna āmanū īmānan walā yartāba alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba wal-mu'minūna waliyaqūla alladhīna fī qulūbihim maraḍun wal-kāfirūna mādhā arāda l-lahu bihādhā mathalan kadhālika yuḍillu l-lahu man yashāu wayahdī man yashāu wamā yaʿlamu junūda rabbika illā huwa wamā hiya illā dhik'rā lil'bashari

tr.85: none other than angels appointed by Us to guard Hellfire- and We have made their number a test for the disbelievers. So those who have been given the Scripture will be certain and those who believe will have their faith increased: neither those who have been given the Scripture nor the believers will have any doubts, but the sick at heart and the disbelievers will say, ‘What could God mean by this description?’ God leaves whoever He will to stray and guides whoever He will- no one knows your Lord’s forces except Him- this [description] is a warning to mortals.
tr.19: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and their number have We made to be a stumbling-block for those who disbelieve; that those to whom the Scripture hath been given may have certainty, and that believers may increase in faith; and that those to whom the Scripture hath been given and believers may not doubt; and that those in whose hearts there is disease, and disbelievers, may say: What meaneth Allah by this similitude? Thus Allah sendeth astray whom He will, and whom He will He guideth. None knoweth the hosts of thy Lord save Him. This is naught else than a Reminder unto mortals.
tr.22: And We have set none but angels as Guardians of the Fire; and We have fixed their number only as a trial for Unbelievers,- in order that the People of the Book may arrive at certainty, and the Believers may increase in Faith,- and that no doubts may be left for the People of the Book and the Believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease and the Unbelievers may say, "What symbol doth Allah intend by this?" Thus doth Allah leave to stray whom He pleaseth, and guide whom He pleaseth: and none can know the forces of thy Lord, except He and this is no other than a warning to mankind.
tr.203: And We have set none but angels as guardians of the Fire. And We have fixed their number (19) only as a trial for the disbelievers, in order that the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) may arrive at a certainty [that this Qur’ân is the truth as it agrees with their Books regarding the number (19) which is written in the Taurât (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] and that the believers may increase in Faith (as this Qur’ân is the truth), and that no doubt may be left for the people of the Scripture and the believers, and that those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy) and the disbelievers may say: "What Allâh intends by this (curious) example ?" Thus Allâh leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none can know the hosts of your Lord but He. And this (Hell) is nothing else than a (warning) reminder to mankind.

74.en: No! By the moon.

tr.85: Yes––by the moon!
tr.19: Nay, by the Moon
tr.22: Nay, verily: By the Moon,
tr.203: Nay! And by the moon

74.en: And [by] the night when it departs.

tr.85: By the departing night!
tr.19: And the night when it withdraweth
tr.22: And by the Night as it retreateth,
tr.203: And by the night when it withdraws.

74.en: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

tr.85: By the shining dawn!
tr.19: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
tr.22: And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
tr.203: And by the dawn when it brightens.

74.en: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].

tr.85: It is one of the mightiest things,
tr.19: Lo! this is one of the greatest (portents)
tr.22: This is but one of the mighty (portents),
tr.203: Verily, it (Hell, or their denial of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, or the Day of Resurrection) is but one of the greatest (signs).

74.en: As a warning to humanity -

tr.85: a warning to all mortals,
tr.19: As a warning unto men,
tr.22: A warning to mankind,-
tr.203: A warning to mankind -

74.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
74.en: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
74.tl: liman shāa minkum an yataqaddama aw yata-akhara

tr.85: to those of you who choose to go ahead and those who lag behind.
tr.19: Unto him of you who will advance or hang back.
tr.22: To any of you that chooses to press forward, or to follow behind;-
tr.203: To any of you that chooses to go forward (by working righteous deeds), or to remain behind (by committing sins).

74.en: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.

tr.85: Every soul is held in pledge for its deeds,
tr.19: Every soul is a pledge for its own deeds;
tr.22: Every soul will be (held) in pledge for its deeds.
tr.203: Every person is a pledge for what he has earned,

74.en: Except the companions of the right,.

tr.85: but the Companions of the Right will stay
tr.19: Save those who will stand on the right hand.
tr.22: Except the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.203: Except those on the Right, (i.e. the pious true believers of Islâmic Monotheism).

74.en: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

tr.85: in Gardens and ask
tr.19: In gardens they will ask one another
tr.22: (They will be) in Gardens (of Delight): they will question each other,
tr.203: In Gardens (Paradise) they will ask one another,

74.en: About the criminals,

tr.85: about the guilty.
tr.19: Concerning the guilty:
tr.22: And (ask) of the Sinners:
tr.203: About Al-Mujrimûn (polytheists, criminals, disbelievers), (And they will say to them):

74.en: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

tr.85: ‘What drove you to the Scorching Fire?’ [they will ask]
tr.19: What hath brought you to this burning?
tr.22: "What led you into Hell Fire?"
tr.203: "What has caused you to enter Hell?"

74.en: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

tr.85: and they will answer, ‘We did not pray;
tr.19: They will answer: We were not of those who prayed
tr.22: They will say: "We were not of those who prayed;
tr.203: They will say: "We were not of those who used to offer the Salât (prayers),

74.en: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

tr.85: we did not feed the poor;
tr.19: Nor did we feed the wretched.
tr.22: "Nor were we of those who fed the indigent;
tr.203: "Nor we used to feed Al-Miskîn (the poor);

74.en: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

tr.85: we indulged with others [in mocking the believers];
tr.19: We used to wade (in vain dispute) with (all) waders,
tr.22: "But we used to talk vanities with vain talkers;
tr.203: "And we used to talk falsehood (all that which Allâh hated) with vain talkers.

74.en: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

tr.85: we denied the Day of Judgement
tr.19: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
tr.22: "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
tr.203: And we used to belie the Day of Recompense,

74.en: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

tr.85: until the Certain End came upon us.’
tr.19: Till the Inevitable came unto us.
tr.22: "Until there came to us (the Hour) that is certain."
tr.203: "Until there came to us (the death) that is certain."

74.en: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

tr.85: No intercessor’s plea will benefit them now.
tr.19: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
tr.22: Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
tr.203: So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.

74.en: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.

tr.85: What is the matter with them? Why do they turn away from the warning,
tr.19: Why now turn they away from the Admonishment,
tr.22: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from admonition?-
tr.203: Then what is wrong with them (i.e. the polytheists, the disbelievers) that they turn away from (receiving) admonition?

74.en: As if they were alarmed donkeys.

tr.85: like frightened asses
tr.19: As they were frightened asses
tr.22: As if they were affrighted asses,
tr.203: As if they were (frightened) wild donkeys.

74.en: Fleeing from a lion?

tr.85: fleeing from a lion?
tr.19: Fleeing from a lion?
tr.22: Fleeing from a lion!
tr.203: Fleeing from a hunter, or a lion, or a beast of prey.

74.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
74.en: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
74.tl: bal yurīdu kullu im'ri-in min'hum an yu'tā ṣuḥufan munasharatan

tr.85: Each one of them demands that a scripture be sent down to him and unrolled before his very eyes-
tr.19: Nay, but everyone of them desireth that he should be given open pages (from Allah).
tr.22: Forsooth, each one of them wants to be given scrolls (of revelation) spread out!
tr.203: Nay, everyone of them desires that he should be given pages spread out (coming from Allâh with a writing that Islâm is the right religion, and Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم has come with the truth from Allâh, the Lord of the heavens and earth).

74.en: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

tr.85: No! Truly they have no fear of the life to come-
tr.19: Nay, verily. They fear not the Hereafter.
tr.22: By no means! But they fear not the Hereafter,
tr.203: Nay! But they fear not the Hereafter (from Allâh’s punishment).

74.en: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.

tr.85: but truly this is a reminder.
tr.19: Nay, verily. Lo! this is an Admonishment.
tr.22: Nay, this surely is an admonition:
tr.203: Nay, verily, this (Qur’an) is an admonition,

74.en: Then whoever wills will remember it.

tr.85: Let whoever wishes to take heed do so:
tr.19: So whosoever will may heed.
tr.22: Let any who will, keep it in remembrance!
tr.203: So whosoever will (let him read it), and receive admonition (from it)!

74.ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
74.en: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
74.tl: wamā yadhkurūna illā an yashāa l-lahu huwa ahlu l-taqwā wa-ahlu l-maghfirati

tr.85: they will only take heed if God so wishes. He is the Lord who should be heeded, the Lord of forgiveness.
tr.19: And they will not heed unless Allah willeth (it). He is the fount of fear. He is the fount of Mercy.
tr.22: But none will keep it in remembrance except as Allah wills: He is the Lord of Righteousness, and the Lord of Forgiveness.
tr.203: And they will not receive admonition unless Allâh wills; He (Allâh) is the One, deserving that mankind should be afraid of, and should be dutiful to Him, and should not take any Ilâh (god) along with Him, and He is the One Who forgives (sins).

75.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

tr.85: By the Day of Resurrection
tr.19: Nay, I swear by the Day of Resurrection;
tr.22: I do call to witness the Resurrection Day;
tr.203: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

75.en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

tr.85: and by the self-reproaching soul!
tr.19: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
tr.22: And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
tr.203: And I swear by the self-reproaching person (a believer).

75.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

tr.85: Does man think We shall not put his bones back together?
tr.19: Thinketh man that We shall not assemble his bones?
tr.22: Does man think that We cannot assemble his bones?
tr.203: Does man (a disbeliever) think that We shall not assemble his bones?

75.ar: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
75.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
75.tl: balā qādirīna ʿalā an nusawwiya banānahu

tr.85: In fact, We can reshape his very fingertips.
tr.19: Yea, verily. We are Able to restore his very fingers!
tr.22: Nay, We are able to put together in perfect order the very tips of his fingers.
tr.203: Yes, We are Able to put together in perfect order the tips of his fingers.

75.en: But man desires to continue in sin.

tr.85: Yet man wants to deny what is ahead of him:
tr.19: But man would fain deny what is before him.
tr.22: But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
tr.203: Nay! Man (denies Resurrection and Reckoning. So he) desires to continue committing sins.

75.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

tr.85: he says, ‘So, when will this Day of Resurrection be?’
tr.19: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
tr.22: He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
tr.203: He asks: "When will be this Day of Resurrection?"

75.en: So when vision is dazzled.

tr.85: When eyes are dazzled
tr.19: But when sight is confounded
tr.22: At length, when the sight is dazed,
tr.203: So, when the sight shall be dazed.

75.en: And the moon darkens.

tr.85: and the moon eclipsed,
tr.19: And the moon is eclipsed
tr.22: And the moon is buried in darkness.
tr.203: And the moon will be eclipsed.

75.en: And the sun and the moon are joined,

tr.85: when the sun and the moon are brought together,
tr.19: And sun and moon are united,
tr.22: And the sun and moon are joined together,-
tr.203: And the sun and moon will be joined together (by going one into the other or folded up or deprived of their light).

75.en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

tr.85: on that Day man will say, ‘Where can I escape?’
tr.19: On that day man will cry: Whither to flee!
tr.22: That Day will Man say: "Where is the refuge?"
tr.203: On that Day man will say: "Where (is the refuge) to flee?"

75.en: No! There is no refuge.

tr.85: Truly, there is no refuge:
tr.19: Alas! No refuge!
tr.22: By no means! No place of safety!
tr.203: No! There is no refuge!

75.en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

tr.85: they will all return to your Lord on that Day.
tr.19: Unto thy Lord is the recourse that day.
tr.22: Before thy Lord (alone), that Day will be the place of rest.
tr.203: Unto your Lord (Alone) will be the place of rest that Day.

75.ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
75.en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
75.tl: yunabba-u l-insānu yawma-idhin bimā qaddama wa-akhara

tr.85: On that Day, man will be told what he put first and what he put last.
tr.19: On that day man is told the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind.
tr.22: That Day will Man be told (all) that he put forward, and all that he put back.
tr.203: On that Day man will be informed of what he sent forward (of his evil good deeds), and what he left behind (of his good or evil traditions).

75.en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

tr.85: Truly, man is a clear witness against himself,
tr.19: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
tr.22: Nay, man will be evidence against himself,
tr.203: Nay! Man will be a witness against himself [as his body parts (skin, hands, legs, etc.) will speak about his deeds],

75.en: Even if he presents his excuses.

tr.85: despite all the excuses he may put forward.
tr.19: Although he tender his excuses.
tr.22: Even though he were to put up his excuses.
tr.203: Though he may put forth his excuses (to cover his evil deeds).

75.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
75.en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].
75.tl: lā tuḥarrik bihi lisānaka litaʿjala bihi

tr.85: [Prophet], do not rush your tongue in an attempt to hasten [your memorization of] the Revelation:
tr.19: Stir not thy tongue herewith to hasten it.
tr.22: Move not thy tongue concerning the (Qur'an) to make haste therewith.
tr.203: Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur’ân, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) to make haste therewith.

75.en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

tr.85: We shall make sure of its safe collection and recitation.
tr.19: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
tr.22: It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
tr.203: It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the ability to recite it (the Qur’ân).

75.en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

tr.85: When We have recited it, repeat the recitation
tr.19: And when We read it, follow thou the reading;
tr.22: But when We have promulgated it, follow thou its recital (as promulgated):
tr.203: And when We have recited it to you [O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم through Jibrîl (Gabriel)], then follow its (the Qur’an’s) recital.

75.en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

tr.85: and We shall make it clear.
tr.19: Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof.
tr.22: Nay more, it is for Us to explain it (and make it clear):
tr.203: Then it is for Us (Allâh) to make it clear (to you).

75.en: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate

tr.85: Truly you [people] love this fleeting world
tr.19: Nay, but ye do love the fleeting Now
tr.22: Nay, (ye men!) but ye love the fleeting life,
tr.203: Not [as you think, that you (mankind) will not be resurrected and recompensed for your deeds], but you (men) love the present life of this world,

75.en: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.

tr.85: and neglect the life to come.
tr.19: And neglect the Hereafter.
tr.22: And leave alone the Hereafter.
tr.203: And neglect the Hereafter.

75.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

tr.85: On that Day there will be radiant faces,
tr.19: That day will faces be resplendent,
tr.22: Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
tr.203: Some faces that Day shall be Nâdirah (shining and radiant).

75.en: Looking at their Lord.

tr.85: looking towards their Lord,
tr.19: Looking toward their Lord;
tr.22: Looking towards their Lord;
tr.203: Looking at their Lord (Allâh).

75.en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

tr.85: and on that Day there will be the sad and despairing faces
tr.19: And that day will other faces be despondent,
tr.22: And some faces, that Day, will be sad and dismal,
tr.203: And some faces, that Day, will be Bâsirah (dark, gloomy, frowning, and sad),

75.en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

tr.85: of those who realize that a great calamity is about to befall them.
tr.19: Thou wilt know that some great disaster is about to fall on them.
tr.22: In the thought that some back-breaking calamity was about to be inflicted on them;
tr.203: Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them.

75.en: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones

tr.85: Truly, when the soul reaches the collarbone;
tr.19: Nay, but when the life cometh up to the throat
tr.22: Yea, when (the soul) reaches to the collar-bone (in its exit),
tr.203: Nay, when (the soul) reaches to the collar bone (i.e. up to the throat in its exit),

75.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

tr.85: when it is said, ‘Could any charm-healer save him now?’;
tr.19: And men say: Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?
tr.22: And there will be a cry, "Who is a magician (to restore him)?"
tr.203: And it will be said: "Who can cure him (and save him from death)?"

75.en: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation

tr.85: when he knows it is the final parting;
tr.19: And he knoweth that it is the parting;
tr.22: And he will conclude that it was (the Time) of Parting;
tr.203: And he (the dying person) will conclude that it was (the time) of parting (death);

75.en: And the leg is wound about the leg,

tr.85: when his legs are brought together:
tr.19: And agony is heaped on agony;
tr.22: And one leg will be joined with another:
tr.203: And one leg will be joined with another leg (shrouded).

75.en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

tr.85: on that day he will be driven towards your Lord.
tr.19: Unto thy Lord that day will be the driving.
tr.22: That Day the Drive will be (all) to thy Lord!
tr.203: The drive will be, on that Day, to your Lord (Allâh)!

75.en: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.

tr.85: He neither believed nor prayed,
tr.19: For he neither trusted, nor prayed.
tr.22: So he gave nothing in charity, nor did he pray!-
tr.203: So he (the disbeliever) neither believed (in this Qur’ân and in the Message of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) nor prayed!

75.en: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

tr.85: but denied the truth and turned away,
tr.19: But he denied and flouted.
tr.22: But on the contrary, he rejected Truth and turned away!
tr.203: But on the contrary, he belied (this Qur’ân and the Message of Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) and turned away!

75.en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

tr.85: walking back to his people with a conceited swagger.
tr.19: Then went he to his folk with glee.
tr.22: Then did he stalk to his family in full conceit!
tr.203: Then he walked in conceit (full pride) to his family admiring himself!

75.en: Woe to you, and woe!

tr.85: Closer and closer it comes to you.
tr.19: Nearer unto thee and nearer,
tr.22: Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
tr.203: Woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!

75.en: Then woe to you, and woe!

tr.85: Closer and closer still.
tr.19: Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom).
tr.22: Again, Woe to thee, (O men!), yea, woe!
tr.203: Again, woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!

75.en: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

tr.85: Does man think he will be left alone?
tr.19: Thinketh man that he is to be left aimless?
tr.22: Does man think that he will be left uncontrolled, (without purpose)?
tr.203: Does man think that he will be left neglected (without being punished or rewarded for the obligatory duties enjoined by his Lord Allâh on him)?

75.ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
75.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
75.tl: alam yaku nuṭ'fatan min maniyyin yum'nā

tr.85: Was he not just a drop of spilt-out sperm,
tr.19: Was he not a drop of fluid which gushed forth?
tr.22: Was he not a drop of sperm emitted (in lowly form)?
tr.203: Was he not a Nutfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge) of semen emitted (poured forth)?

75.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

tr.85: which became a clinging form, which God shaped in due proportion,
tr.19: Then he became a clot; then (Allah) shaped and fashioned
tr.22: Then did he become a leech-like clot; then did (Allah) make and fashion (him) in due proportion.
tr.203: Then he became an ‘Alaqah (a clot); then (Allâh) shaped and fashioned (him) in due proportion.

75.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

tr.85: fashioning from it the two sexes, male and female?
tr.19: And made of him a pair, the male and female.
tr.22: And of him He made two sexes, male and female.
tr.203: And made of him two sexes, male and female.

75.ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
75.en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
75.tl: alaysa dhālika biqādirin ʿalā an yuḥ'yiya l-mawtā

tr.85: Does He who can do this not have the power to bring the dead back to life?
tr.19: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
tr.22: Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
tr.203: Is not He (Allâh Who does that) Able to give life to the dead? (Yes! He is Able to do all things).

76.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
76.en: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
76.tl: hal atā ʿalā l-insāni ḥīnun mina l-dahri lam yakun shayan madhkūran

tr.85: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?
tr.19: Hath there come upon man (ever) any period of time in which he was a thing unremembered?
tr.22: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
tr.203: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mentioning?

76.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
76.en: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
76.tl: innā khalaqnā l-insāna min nuṭ'fatin amshājin nabtalīhi fajaʿalnāhu samīʿan baṣīran

tr.85: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;
tr.19: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
tr.22: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
tr.203: Verily, We have created man from Nutfah (drops) of mixed semen (sexual discharge of man and woman), in order to try him: so We made him hearer and seer.

76.ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
76.en: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
76.tl: innā hadaynāhu l-sabīla immā shākiran wa-immā kafūran

tr.85: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.
tr.19: Lo! We have shown him the way, whether he be grateful or disbelieving.
tr.22: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
tr.203: Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.

76.ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
76.en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
76.tl: innā aʿtadnā lil'kāfirīna salāsilā wa-aghlālan wasaʿīran

tr.85: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but
tr.19: Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers manacles and carcans and a raging fire.
tr.22: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
tr.203: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire.

76.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
76.en: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,
76.tl: inna l-abrāra yashrabūna min kasin kāna mizājuhā kāfūran

tr.85: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,
tr.19: Lo! the righteous shall drink of a cup whereof the mixture is of Kafur,
tr.22: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
tr.203: Verily,, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism), shall drink of a cup (of wine) mixed with (water from a spring in Paradise called) Kâfûr

76.ar: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
76.en: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
76.tl: ʿaynan yashrabu bihā ʿibādu l-lahi yufajjirūnahā tafjīran

tr.85: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.
tr.19: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah drink, making it gush forth abundantly,
tr.22: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
tr.203: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allâh will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.

76.ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
76.en: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
76.tl: yūfūna bil-nadhri wayakhāfūna yawman kāna sharruhu mus'taṭīran

tr.85: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;
tr.19: (Because) they perform the vow and fear a day whereof the evil is wide-spreading,
tr.22: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
tr.203: They (are those who) fulfil (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.

76.ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
76.en: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
76.tl: wayuṭ'ʿimūna l-ṭaʿāma ʿalā ḥubbihi mis'kīnan wayatīman wa-asīran

tr.85: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,
tr.19: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan and the prisoner, for love of Him,
tr.22: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
tr.203: And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to the Miskîn (the poor), the orphan, and the captive

76.ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
76.en: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
76.tl: innamā nuṭ'ʿimukum liwajhi l-lahi lā nurīdu minkum jazāan walā shukūran

tr.85: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.
tr.19: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
tr.22: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
tr.203: (Saying): "We feed you seeking Allâh’s Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you.

76.ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
76.en: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
76.tl: innā nakhāfu min rabbinā yawman ʿabūsan qamṭarīran

tr.85: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’
tr.19: Lo! we fear from our Lord a day of frowning and of fate.
tr.22: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
tr.203: "Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislike to it)."

76.ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
76.en: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
76.tl: fawaqāhumu l-lahu sharra dhālika l-yawmi walaqqāhum naḍratan wasurūran

tr.85: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,
