tr.19: Therefor Allah hath warded off from them the evil of that day, and hath made them find brightness and joy;
tr.22: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
tr.203: So Allâh saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadrah (a light of beauty) and joy.

76.ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
76.en: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
76.tl: wajazāhum bimā ṣabarū jannatan waḥarīran

tr.85: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.
tr.19: And hath awarded them for all that they endured, a Garden and silk attire;
tr.22: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
tr.203: And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.

76.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
76.en: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
76.tl: muttakiīna fīhā ʿalā l-arāiki lā yarawna fīhā shamsan walā zamharīran

tr.85: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,
tr.19: Reclining therein upon couches, they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold.
tr.22: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
tr.203: Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon).

76.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
76.en: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
76.tl: wadāniyatan ʿalayhim ẓilāluhā wadhullilat quṭūfuhā tadhlīlan

tr.85: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.
tr.19: The shade thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down.
tr.22: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
tr.203: And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.

76.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
76.en: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
76.tl: wayuṭāfu ʿalayhim biāniyatin min fiḍḍatin wa-akwābin kānat qawārīrā

tr.85: They will be served with silver plates
tr.19: Goblets of silver are brought round for them, and beakers (as) of glass
tr.22: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
tr.203: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal -

76.ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
76.en: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
76.tl: qawārīrā min fiḍḍatin qaddarūhā taqdīran

tr.85: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,
tr.19: (Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured to the measure (of their deeds).
tr.22: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
tr.203: Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).

76.ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
76.en: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
76.tl: wayus'qawna fīhā kasan kāna mizājuhā zanjabīlan

tr.85: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger
tr.19: There are they watered with a cup whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,
tr.22: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
tr.203: And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabîl (ginger),

76.ar: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
76.en: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
76.tl: ʿaynan fīhā tusammā salsabīlan

tr.85: from a spring called Salsabil.
tr.19: (The water of) a spring therein, named Salsabil.
tr.22: A fountain there, called Salsabil.
tr.203: A spring there, called Salsabîl.

76.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
76.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
76.tl: wayaṭūfu ʿalayhim wil'dānun mukhalladūna idhā ra-aytahum ḥasib'tahum lu'lu-an manthūran

tr.85: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––
tr.19: There wait on them immortal youths, whom, when thou seest, thou wouldst take for scattered pearls.
tr.22: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
tr.203: And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.

76.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
76.en: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
76.tl: wa-idhā ra-ayta thamma ra-ayta naʿīman wamul'kan kabīran

tr.85: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:
tr.19: When thou seest, thou wilt see there bliss and high estate.
tr.22: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
tr.203: And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.

76.ar: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
76.en: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
76.tl: ʿāliyahum thiyābu sundusin khuḍ'run wa-is'tabraqun waḥullū asāwira min fiḍḍatin wasaqāhum rabbuhum sharāban ṭahūran

tr.85: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.
tr.19: Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink.
tr.22: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
tr.203: Their garments will be of fine green silk, and gold embroidery. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

76.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
76.en: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
76.tl: inna hādhā kāna lakum jazāan wakāna saʿyukum mashkūran

tr.85: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’
tr.19: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
tr.22: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
tr.203: (And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted."

76.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
76.en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
76.tl: innā naḥnu nazzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna tanzīlan

tr.85: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.
tr.19: Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an, a revelation;
tr.22: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
tr.203: Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’ân to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) by stages.

76.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
76.en: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
76.tl: fa-iṣ'bir liḥuk'mi rabbika walā tuṭiʿ min'hum āthiman aw kafūran

tr.85: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;
tr.19: So submit patiently to thy Lord's command, and obey not of them any guilty one or disbeliever.
tr.22: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
tr.203: Therefore be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with constancy to the Command of your Lord (Allâh, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.

76.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
76.en: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
76.tl: wa-udh'kuri is'ma rabbika buk'ratan wa-aṣīlan

tr.85: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;
tr.19: Remember the name of thy Lord at morn and evening.
tr.22: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
tr.203: And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers].

76.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
76.en: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.
76.tl: wamina al-layli fa-us'jud lahu wasabbiḥ'hu laylan ṭawīlan

tr.85: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.
tr.19: And worship Him (a portion) of the night. And glorify Him through the livelong night.
tr.22: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
tr.203: And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishâ’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer).

76.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
76.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
76.tl: inna hāulāi yuḥibbūna l-ʿājilata wayadharūna warāahum yawman thaqīlan

tr.85: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.
tr.19: Lo! these love fleeting life, and put behind them (the remembrance of) a grievous day.
tr.22: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
tr.203: Verily, these (disbelievers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard).

76.ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
76.en: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
76.tl: naḥnu khalaqnāhum washadadnā asrahum wa-idhā shi'nā baddalnā amthālahum tabdīlan

tr.85: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.
tr.19: We, even We, created them, and strengthened their frame. And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them in their stead.
tr.22: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
tr.203: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.

76.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
76.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
76.tl: inna hādhihi tadhkiratun faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi sabīlan

tr.85: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.
tr.19: Lo! this is an Admonishment, that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord.
tr.22: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
tr.203: Verily, this (Verse of the Qur’ân) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allâh).

76.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
76.en: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
76.tl: wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu inna l-laha kāna ʿalīman ḥakīman

tr.85: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-
tr.19: Yet ye will not, unless Allah willeth. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise.
tr.22: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
tr.203: But you cannot will, unless Allâh wills. Verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.

76.ar: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
76.en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
76.tl: yud'khilu man yashāu fī raḥmatihi wal-ẓālimīna aʿadda lahum ʿadhāban alīman

tr.85: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.
tr.19: He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy, and for evil-doers hath prepared a painful doom.
tr.22: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
tr.203: He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Zâlimûn - (polytheists, wrong-doers) He has prepared a painful torment.

77.en: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

tr.85: By the [winds] sent forth in swift succession,
tr.19: By the emissary winds, (sent) one after another
tr.22: By the (Winds) sent forth one after another (to man's profit);
tr.203: By the winds (or angels or the Messengers of Allâh) sent forth one after another.

77.en: And the winds that blow violently

tr.85: violently storming,
tr.19: By the raging hurricanes,
tr.22: Which then blow violently in tempestuous Gusts,
tr.203: And by the winds that blow violently.

77.en: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

tr.85: scattering far and wide,
tr.19: By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive;
tr.22: And scatter (things) far and wide;
tr.203: And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain.

77.en: And those [angels] who bring criterion

tr.85: separating forcefully,
tr.19: By those who winnow with a winnowing,
tr.22: Then separate them, one from another,
tr.203: And by the Verses (of the Qur’ân) that separate the right from the wrong.

77.en: And those [angels] who deliver a message.

tr.85: delivering a reminder,
tr.19: By those who bring down the Reminder,
tr.22: Then spread abroad a Message,
tr.203: And by the angels that bring the revelations to the Messengers,

77.en: As justification or warning,

tr.85: as a proof or a warning:
tr.19: To excuse or to warn,
tr.22: Whether of Justification or of Warning;-
tr.203: To cut off all excuses or to warn.

77.en: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

tr.85: what you are promised will come to pass.
tr.19: Surely that which ye are promised will befall.
tr.22: Assuredly, what ye are promised must come to pass.
tr.203: Surely, what you are promised must come to pass.

77.en: So when the stars are obliterated

tr.85: When the stars are dimmed
tr.19: So when the stars are put out,
tr.22: Then when the stars become dim;
tr.203: Then when the stars lose their lights.

77.en: And when the heaven is opened

tr.85: and the sky is torn apart,
tr.19: And when the sky is riven asunder,
tr.22: When the heaven is cleft asunder;
tr.203: And when the heaven is cleft asunder.

77.en: And when the mountains are blown away

tr.85: when the mountains are turned to dust
tr.19: And when the mountains are blown away,
tr.22: When the mountains are scattered (to the winds) as dust;
tr.203: And when the mountains are blown away.

77.en: And when the messengers' time has come...

tr.85: and the messengers given their appointed time––
tr.19: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed -
tr.22: And when the messengers are (all) appointed a time (to collect);-
tr.203: And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed.

77.en: For what Day was it postponed?

tr.85: for what Day has all this been set?
tr.19: For what day is the time appointed?
tr.22: For what Day are these (portents) deferred?
tr.203: For what Day are these signs postponed?

77.en: For the Day of Judgement.

tr.85: The Day of Decision.
tr.19: For the Day of Decision.
tr.22: For the Day of Sorting out.
tr.203: For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell).

77.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the Day of Decision is?
tr.19: And what will convey unto thee what the Day of Decision is! -
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what is the Day of Sorting out?
tr.203: And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out?

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

tr.85: Did We not destroy the first [of them]?
tr.19: Destroyed We not the former folk,
tr.22: Did We not destroy the men of old (for their evil)?
tr.203: Did We not destroy the ancients?

77.en: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

tr.85: We shall make the last follow them:
tr.19: Then caused the latter folk to follow after?
tr.22: So shall We make later (generations) follow them.
tr.203: So shall We make later generations to follow them.

77.en: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

tr.85: this is how We deal with the guilty.
tr.19: Thus deal We ever with the guilty.
tr.22: Thus do We deal with men of sin.
tr.203: Thus do We deal with the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

tr.85: Did We not make you from an underrated fluid
tr.19: Did We not create you from a base fluid
tr.22: Have We not created you from a fluid (held) despicable?-
tr.203: Did We not create you from a despised water (semen)?

77.en: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]

tr.85: which We housed in a safe lodging
tr.19: Which We laid up in a safe abode
tr.22: The which We placed in a place of rest, firmly fixed,
tr.203: Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),

77.en: For a known extent.

tr.85: for a determined period?
tr.19: For a known term?
tr.22: For a period (of gestation), determined (according to need)?
tr.203: For a known period (determined by gestation)?

77.en: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

tr.85: We determine [it]: how excellently We determine!
tr.19: Thus We arranged. How excellent is Our arranging!
tr.22: For We do determine (according to need); for We are the best to determine (things).
tr.203: So We did measure; and We are the Best to measure (the things).

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day! to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: Have We not made the earth a container

tr.85: Did We not make the earth a home
tr.19: Have We not made the earth a receptacle
tr.22: Have We not made the earth (as a place) to draw together.
tr.203: Have We not made the earth a receptacle

77.en: Of the living and the dead?

tr.85: for the living and the dead?
tr.19: Both for the living and the dead,
tr.22: The living and the dead,
tr.203: For the living and the dead?

77.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
77.en: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
77.tl: wajaʿalnā fīhā rawāsiya shāmikhātin wa-asqaynākum māan furātan

tr.85: Did We not place firm, lofty mountains on it and provide you with sweet water?
tr.19: And placed therein high mountains and given you to drink sweet water therein?
tr.22: And made therein mountains standing firm, lofty (in stature); and provided for you water sweet (and wholesome)?
tr.203: And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains, and have given you to drink sweet water?

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
77.en: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
77.tl: inṭaliqū ilā mā kuntum bihi tukadhibūna

tr.85: They will be told, ‘Go to that which you used to deny!
tr.19: (It will be said unto them:) Depart unto that (doom) which ye used to deny;
tr.22: (It will be said:) "Depart ye to that which ye used to reject as false!
tr.203: (It will be said to the disbelievers): "Depart you to that which you used to deny!

77.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
77.en: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns.
77.tl: inṭaliqū ilā ẓillin dhī thalāthi shuʿabin

tr.85: Go to a shadow of smoke!’ It rises in three columns;
tr.19: Depart unto the shadow falling threefold,
tr.22: "Depart ye to a Shadow (of smoke ascending) in three columns,
tr.203: "Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-Fire smoke ascending) in three columns,

77.ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
77.en: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
77.tl: lā ẓalīlin walā yugh'nī mina l-lahabi

tr.85: no shade does it give, nor relief from the flame;
tr.19: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
tr.22: "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
tr.203: Neither shady, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."

77.en: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

tr.85: it shoots out sparks as large as treetrunks
tr.19: Lo! it throweth up sparks like the castles,
tr.22: "Indeed it throws about sparks (huge) as Forts,
tr.203: Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qasr (a fort or a huge log of wood),

77.en: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

tr.85: and as bright as copper.
tr.19: (Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue.
tr.22: "As if there were (a string of) yellow camels (marching swiftly)."
tr.203: As if they were yellow camels or bundles of ropes.

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: This is a Day they will not speak,

tr.85: On that Day they will be speechless,
tr.19: This is a day wherein they speak not,
tr.22: That will be a Day when they shall not be able to speak.
tr.203: That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),

77.en: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

tr.85: and they will be given no chance to offer any excuses.
tr.19: Nor are they suffered to put forth excuses.
tr.22: Nor will it be open to them to put forth pleas.
tr.203: And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse.

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

tr.85: [They will be told], ‘This is the Day of Decision: We have gathered you and earlier generations.
tr.19: This is the Day of Decision, We have brought you and the men of old together.
tr.22: That will be a Day of Sorting out! We shall gather you together and those before (you)!
tr.203: That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!

77.en: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

tr.85: If you have any plots against Me, try them now.’
tr.19: If now ye have any wit, outwit Me.
tr.22: Now, if ye have a trick (or plot), use it against Me!
tr.203: So if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allâh جل جلاله)!

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

tr.85: But those who took heed of God will enjoy cool shade, springs,
tr.19: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
tr.22: As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
tr.203: Verily, the Muttaqûn (the pious. See V.2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.

77.en: And fruits from whatever they desire,

tr.85: and any fruit they desire;
tr.19: And fruits such as they desire.
tr.22: And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
tr.203: And fruits, such as they desire.

77.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
77.en: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
77.tl: kulū wa-ish'rabū hanīan bimā kuntum taʿmalūna

tr.85: [they will be told], ‘Eat and drink to your hearts’ content as a reward for your deeds:
tr.19: (Unto them it is said:) Eat, drink and welcome, O ye blessed, in return for what ye did.
tr.22: "Eat ye and drink ye to your heart's content: for that ye worked (Righteousness).
tr.203: "Eat and drink comfortably for that which you used to do."

77.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tr.85: this is how We reward those who do good.’
tr.19: Thus do We reward the good.
tr.22: Thus do We certainly reward the Doers of Good.
tr.203: Verily, thus We reward the Muhsinûn (good-doers. See V.2:112).

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

tr.85: [You may] eat and enjoy yourselves for a short while, evildoers that you are.
tr.19: Eat and take your ease (on earth) a little. Lo! ye are guilty.
tr.22: (O ye unjust!) Eat ye and enjoy yourselves (but) a little while, for that ye are Sinners.
tr.203: (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are the Mujrimûn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals).

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
77.en: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
77.tl: wa-idhā qīla lahumu ir'kaʿū lā yarkaʿūna

tr.85: When they are told, ‘Bow down in prayer,’ they do not do so.
tr.19: When it is said unto them: Bow down, they bow not down!
tr.22: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate yourselves!" they do not so.
tr.203: And when it is said to them: "Bow down yourself (in prayer)!" They bow not down (offer not their prayers).

77.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tr.85: Woe, on that Day, to those who denied the truth!
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
tr.203: Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!

77.en: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?

tr.85: In what revelation, after this, will they believe?
tr.19: In what statement, after this, will they believe?
tr.22: Then what Message, after that, will they believe in?
tr.203: Then in what statement after this (the Qur’ân) will they believe?

78.en: About what are they asking one another?

tr.85: What are they asking about?
tr.19: Whereof do they question one another?
tr.22: Concerning what are they disputing?
tr.203: What are they asking (one another) about?

78.en: About the great news -

tr.85: The momentous announcement
tr.19: (It is) of the awful tidings,
tr.22: Concerning the Great News,
tr.203: About the great news, (i.e. Islâmic Monotheism, the Qur’ân, which Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم brought and the Day of Resurrection)

78.en: That over which they are in disagreement.

tr.85: about which they differ.
tr.19: Concerning which they are in disagreement.
tr.22: About which they cannot agree.
tr.203: About which they are in disagreement.

78.en: No! They are going to know.

tr.85: They will find out.
tr.19: Nay, but they will come to know!
tr.22: Verily, they shall soon (come to) know!
tr.203: Nay, they will come to know!

78.en: Then, no! They are going to know.

tr.85: In the end they will find out.
tr.19: Nay, again, but they will come to know!
tr.22: Verily, verily they shall soon (come to) know!
tr.203: Nay, again, they will come to know!

78.en: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

tr.85: Did We not make the earth smooth,
tr.19: Have We not made the earth an expanse,
tr.22: Have We not made the earth as a wide expanse,
tr.203: Have We not made the earth as a bed,

78.en: And the mountains as stakes?

tr.85: and make the mountains to keep it stable?
tr.19: And the high hills bulwarks?
tr.22: And the mountains as pegs?
tr.203: And the mountains as pegs?

78.en: And We created you in pairs.

tr.85: Did We not create you in pairs,
tr.19: And We have created you in pairs,
tr.22: And (have We not) created you in pairs,
tr.203: And We have created you in pairs (male and female, tall and short, good and bad, etc.).

78.en: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

tr.85: give you sleep for rest,
tr.19: And have appointed your sleep for repose,
tr.22: And made your sleep for rest,
tr.203: And We have made your sleep as a thing for rest.

78.en: And made the night as clothing.

tr.85: the night as a cover,
tr.19: And have appointed the night as a cloak,
tr.22: And made the night as a covering,
tr.203: And We have made the night as a covering (through its darkness),

78.en: And made the day for livelihood.

tr.85: and the day for your livelihood?
tr.19: And have appointed the day for livelihood.
tr.22: And made the day as a means of subsistence?
tr.203: And We have made the day for livelihood.

78.en: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].

tr.85: Did We not build seven strong [heavens] above you,
tr.19: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),
tr.22: And (have We not) built over you the seven firmaments,
tr.203: And We have built above you seven strong (heavens),

78.en: And made [therein] a burning lamp

tr.85: and make a blazing lamp?
tr.19: And have appointed a dazzling lamp,
tr.22: And placed (therein) a Light of Splendour?
tr.203: And We have made (therein) a shining lamp (sun).

78.en: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.

tr.85: Did We not send water pouring down from the clouds
tr.19: And have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water,
tr.22: And do We not send down from the clouds water in abundance,
tr.203: And We have sent down from the rainy clouds abundant water.

78.en: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.

tr.85: to bring forth with it grain, plants,
tr.19: Thereby to produce grain and plant,
tr.22: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetables,
tr.203: That We may produce therewith corn and vegetations,

78.en: And gardens of entwined growth.

tr.85: and luxuriant gardens?
tr.19: And gardens of thick foliage.
tr.22: And gardens of luxurious growth?
tr.203: And gardens of thick growth.

78.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

tr.85: A time has been appointed for the Day of Decision:
tr.19: Lo! the Day of Decision is a fixed time,
tr.22: Verily the Day of Sorting out is a thing appointed,
tr.203: Verily, the Day of Decision is a fixed time,

78.ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
78.en: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
78.tl: yawma yunfakhu fī l-ṣūri fatatūna afwājan

tr.85: a Day when the Trumpet will sound and you will come forward in crowds,
tr.19: A day when the trumpet is blown and ye come in multitudes,
tr.22: The Day that the Trumpet shall be sounded, and ye shall come forth in crowds;
tr.203: The Day when the Trumpet will be blown, and you shall come forth in crowds (groups after groups). [Tafsir At-Tabari]

78.en: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.

tr.85: when the sky will open up like wide portals,
tr.19: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
tr.22: And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
tr.203: And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates,

78.en: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

tr.85: when the mountains will vanish like a mirage.
tr.19: And the hills are set in motion and become as a mirage.
tr.22: And the mountains shall vanish, as if they were a mirage.
tr.203: And the mountains shall be moved away from their places and they will be as if they were a mirage.

78.en: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

tr.85: Hell lies in wait,
tr.19: Lo! hell lurketh in ambush,
tr.22: Truly Hell is as a place of ambush,
tr.203: Truly, Hell is a place of ambush -

78.en: For the transgressors, a place of return,

tr.85: a home for oppressors
tr.19: A home for the rebellious.
tr.22: For the transgressors a place of destination:
tr.203: A dwelling place for the Tâghûn (those who transgress the boundary limits set by Allâh like polytheists, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, hyprocrites, sinners, criminals),

78.en: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

tr.85: to stay in for a long, long time,
tr.19: They will abide therein for ages.
tr.22: They will dwell therein for ages.
tr.203: They will abide therein for ages.

78.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
78.en: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.
78.tl: lā yadhūqūna fīhā bardan walā sharāban

tr.85: where they will taste no coolness nor drink
tr.19: Therein taste they neither coolness nor (any) drink
tr.22: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink,
tr.203: Nothing cool shall they taste therein, nor any drink.

78.en: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

tr.85: except one that is scalding and dark––
tr.19: Save boiling water and a paralysing cold:
tr.22: Save a boiling fluid and a fluid, dark, murky, intensely cold,
tr.203: Except boiling water, and dirty wound discharges -

78.en: An appropriate recompense.

tr.85: a fitting requital,
tr.19: Reward proportioned (to their evil deeds).
tr.22: A fitting recompense (for them).
tr.203: An exact recompense (according to their evil crimes).

78.en: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

tr.85: for they did not fear a reckoning,
tr.19: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
tr.22: For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
tr.203: For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.

78.en: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

tr.85: and they rejected Our messages as lies.
tr.19: They called Our revelations false with strong denial.
tr.22: But they (impudently) treated Our Signs as false.
tr.203: But they belied Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم brought) completely.

78.en: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

tr.85: We have recorded everything in a Record.
tr.19: Everything have We recorded in a Book.
tr.22: And all things have We preserved on record.
tr.203: And all things We have recorded in a Book.

78.en: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

tr.85: ‘Taste this: all you will get from Us is more torment.’
tr.19: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
tr.22: "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
tr.203: So taste you (the results of your evil actions). No increase shall We give you, except in torment.

78.en: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

tr.85: For those who were aware of God there is supreme fulfilment:
tr.19: Lo! for the duteous is achievement -
tr.22: Verily for the Righteous there will be a fulfilment of (the heart's) desires;
tr.203: Verily, for the Muttaqûn, there will be a success (Paradise);

78.en: Gardens and grapevines.

tr.85: private gardens, vineyards,
tr.19: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
tr.22: Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
tr.203: Gardens and vineyards,

78.en: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age.

tr.85: nubile, well-matched companions,
tr.19: And voluptuous women of equal age;
tr.22: And voluptuous women of equal age;
tr.203: And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age,

78.en: And a full cup.

tr.85: and an overflowing cup.
tr.19: And a full cup.
tr.22: And a cup full (to the brim).
tr.203: And a full cup (of wine).

78.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
78.en: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
78.tl: lā yasmaʿūna fīhā laghwan walā kidhāban

tr.85: There they will hear no vain or lying talk:
tr.19: There hear they never vain discourse, nor lying -
tr.22: No vanity shall they hear therein, nor Untruth:-
tr.203: No Laghw (dirty, false, evil talk) shall they hear therein, nor lying;

78.en: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

tr.85: a reward from your Lord, a fitting gift
tr.19: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
tr.22: Recompense from thy Lord, a gift, (amply) sufficient,
tr.203: A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (according to the best of their good deeds),

78.ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
78.en: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
78.tl: rabbi l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wamā baynahumā l-raḥmāni lā yamlikūna min'hu khiṭāban

tr.85: from the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Lord of Mercy. They will have no authority from Him to speak.
tr.19: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them, the Beneficent; with Whom none can converse.
tr.22: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between, (Allah) Most Gracious: None shall have power to argue with Him.
tr.203: (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom they cannot dare to speak (on the Day of Resurrection except by His Leave).

78.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
78.en: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
78.tl: yawma yaqūmu l-rūḥu wal-malāikatu ṣaffan lā yatakallamūna illā man adhina lahu l-raḥmānu waqāla ṣawāban

tr.85: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in rows, they will not speak except for those to whom the Lord of Mercy gives permission, who will say only what is right.
tr.19: On the day when the angels and the Spirit stand arrayed, they speak not, saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth and who speaketh right.
tr.22: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand forth in ranks, none shall speak except any who is permitted by (Allah) Most Gracious, and He will say what is right.
tr.203: The Day that Ar-Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom the Most Gracious (Allâh) allows, and he will speak what is right.

78.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
78.en: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
78.tl: dhālika l-yawmu l-ḥaqu faman shāa ittakhadha ilā rabbihi maāban

tr.85: That is the Day of Truth. So whoever wishes to do so should take the path that leads to his Lord.
tr.19: That is the True Day. So whoso will should seek recourse unto his Lord.
tr.22: That Day will be the sure Reality: Therefore, whoso will, let him take a (straight) return to his Lord!
tr.203: That is (without doubt) the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!

78.ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
78.en: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
78.tl: innā andharnākum ʿadhāban qarīban yawma yanẓuru l-maru mā qaddamat yadāhu wayaqūlu l-kāfiru yālaytanī kuntu turāban

tr.85: We have warned you of imminent torment, on the Day when every person will see what their own hands have sent ahead for them, when the disbeliever will say, ‘If only I were dust!’
tr.19: Lo! We warn you of a doom at hand, a day whereon a man will look on that which his own hands have sent before, and the disbeliever will cry: "Would that I were dust!"
tr.22: Verily, We have warned you of a Penalty near, the Day when man will see (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the Unbeliever will say, "Woe unto me! Would that I were (mere) dust!"
tr.203: Verily, We have warned you of a near torment - the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbeliever will say: "Woe to me! Would that I were dust!"

79.en: By those [angels] who extract with violence

tr.85: By the forceful chargers
tr.19: By those who drag forth to destruction,
tr.22: By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
tr.203: By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence.

79.en: And [by] those who remove with ease

tr.85: raring to go,
tr.19: By the meteors rushing,
tr.22: By those who gently draw out (the souls of the blessed);
tr.203: By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers).

79.en: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

tr.85: sweeping ahead at full stretch,
tr.19: By the lone stars floating,
tr.22: And by those who glide along (on errands of mercy),
tr.203: And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits).

79.en: And those who race each other in a race

tr.85: overtaking swiftly
tr.19: By the angels hastening,
tr.22: Then press forward as in a race,
tr.203: And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses).

79.en: And those who arrange [each] matter,

tr.85: to bring the matter to an end,
tr.19: And those who govern the event,
tr.22: Then arrange to do (the Commands of their Lord),
tr.203: And by those angels who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbelievers will be called to account).

79.en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

tr.85: on the Day when the blast reverberates
tr.19: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
tr.22: One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
tr.203: On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die).

79.en: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

tr.85: and the second blast follows,
tr.19: And the second followeth it,
tr.22: Followed by oft-repeated (commotions):
tr.203: The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected).

79.en: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

tr.85: hearts will tremble
tr.19: On that day hearts beat painfully
tr.22: Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
tr.203: (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.

79.en: Their eyes humbled.

tr.85: and eyes will be downcast.
tr.19: While eyes are downcast
tr.22: Cast down will be (their owners') eyes.
tr.203: Their eyes will be downcast.

79.en: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

tr.85: They say, ‘What? shall we be brought back to life,
tr.19: (Now) they are saying: Shall we really be restored to our first state
tr.22: They say (now): "What! shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state?
tr.203: They say: "Shall we indeed be returned to (our) former state of life?

79.en: Even if we should be decayed bones?"

tr.85: after we have turned into decayed bones?’ and they say,
tr.19: Even after we are crumbled bones?
tr.22: "What! - when we shall have become rotten bones?"
tr.203: "Even after we are crumbled bones?"

79.en: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

tr.85: ‘Such a return is impossible!’
tr.19: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
tr.22: They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
tr.203: They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"

79.en: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

tr.85: But all it will take is a single blast,
tr.19: Surely it will need but one shout,
tr.22: But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
tr.203: But it will be only a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)], (See Verse 37:19).

79.en: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

tr.85: and they will be back above ground.
tr.19: And lo! they will be awakened.
tr.22: When, behold, they will be in the (full) awakening (to Judgment).
tr.203: When behold, they find themselves on the surface of the earth alive after their death,

79.en: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

tr.85: Have you [Prophet] heard the story of Moses?
tr.19: Hath there come unto thee the history of Moses?
tr.22: Has the story of Moses reached thee?
tr.203: Has there come to you the story of Mûsâ (Moses)?

79.ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
79.en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,
79.tl: idh nādāhu rabbuhu bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwan

tr.85: His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:
tr.19: How his Lord called him in the holy vale of Tuwa,
tr.22: Behold, thy Lord did call to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:-
tr.203: When his Lord called him in the sacred valley of Tûwâ,

79.en: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

tr.85: ‘Go to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds,
tr.19: (Saying:) Go thou unto Pharaoh - Lo! he hath rebelled -
tr.22: "Go thou to Pharaoh for he has indeed transgressed all bounds:
tr.203: Go to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily he has transgressed all bounds (in crimes, sins, polytheism, disbelief).

79.ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
79.en: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
79.tl: faqul hal laka ilā an tazakkā

tr.85: and ask him, “Do you want to purify yourself [of sin]?
tr.19: And say (unto him): Hast thou (will) to grow (in grace)?
tr.22: "And say to him, 'Wouldst thou that thou shouldst be purified (from sin)?-
tr.203: And say to him: "Would you purify yourself (from the sin of disbelief by becoming a believer)?"

79.en: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

tr.85: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you may hold Him in awe?” ’
tr.19: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord and thou shalt fear (Him).
tr.22: "'And that I guide thee to thy Lord, so thou shouldst fear Him?'"
tr.203: "And that I guide you to your Lord, so you should fear Him?"

79.en: And he showed him the greatest sign,

tr.85: Moses showed him the great sign,
tr.19: And he showed him the tremendous token.
tr.22: Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
tr.203: Then [Mûsâ (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).

79.en: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

tr.85: but he denied it and refused [the faith].
tr.19: But he denied and disobeyed,
tr.22: But (Pharaoh) rejected it and disobeyed (guidance);
tr.203: But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] belied and disobeyed.

79.en: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].

tr.85: He turned away and hastily
tr.19: Then turned he away in haste,
tr.22: Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
tr.203: Then he turned his back, striving (against Allâh).

79.en: And he gathered [his people] and called out.

tr.85: gathered his people, proclaiming,
tr.19: Then gathered he and summoned
tr.22: Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
tr.203: Then he gathered (his people) and cried aloud,

79.en: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

tr.85: ‘I am your supreme lord,’
tr.19: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
tr.22: Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
tr.203: Saying: "I am your lord, most high."

79.en: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..

tr.85: so God condemned him to punishment in the life to come as well as in this life:
tr.19: So Allah seized him (and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former.
tr.22: But Allah did punish him, (and made an) example of him, - in the Hereafter, as in this life.
tr.203: So Allâh, seized him with punishment for his last and first transgression. [Tafsir At-Tabari]

79.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
79.en: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].
79.tl: inna fī dhālika laʿib'ratan liman yakhshā

tr.85: there truly is a lesson in this for anyone who stands in awe of God.
tr.19: Lo! herein is indeed a lesson for him who feareth.
tr.22: Verily in this is an instructive warning for whosoever feareth (Allah).
tr.203: Verily, in this is an instructive admonition for whosoever fears Allâh.

79.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
79.en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.
79.tl: a-antum ashaddu khalqan ami l-samāu banāhā

tr.85: Which is harder to create: you people or the sky that He built,
tr.19: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
tr.22: What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
tr.203: Are you more difficult to create or is the heaven that He constructed?

79.en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

tr.85: raising it high and perfecting it,
tr.19: He raised the height thereof and ordered it;
tr.22: On high hath He raised its canopy, and He hath given it order and perfection.
tr.203: He raised its height, and has perfected it.

79.en: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

tr.85: giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness,
tr.19: And He made dark the night thereof, and He brought forth the morn thereof.
tr.22: Its night doth He endow with darkness, and its splendour doth He bring out (with light).
tr.203: Its night He covers with darkness and its forenoon He brings out (with light)

79.en: And after that He spread the earth.

tr.85: and the earth, too, He spread out,
tr.19: And after that He spread the earth,
tr.22: And the earth, moreover, hath He extended (to a wide expanse);
tr.203: And after that He spread the earth,

79.en: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

tr.85: bringing waters and pastures out of it,
tr.19: And produced therefrom the water thereof and the pasture thereof,
tr.22: He draweth out therefrom its moisture and its pasture;
tr.203: And brought forth therefrom its water and its pasture.

79.en: And the mountains He set firmly

tr.85: and setting firm mountains [in it]
tr.19: And He made fast the hills,
tr.22: And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
tr.203: And the mountains He has fixed firmly,

79.en: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

tr.85: for you and your animals to enjoy?
tr.19: A provision for you and for your cattle.
tr.22: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
tr.203: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

79.en: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

tr.85: When the great overwhelming event arrives
tr.19: But when the great disaster cometh,
tr.22: Therefore, when there comes the great, overwhelming (Event),-
tr.203: But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) -

79.en: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

tr.85: on the Day that man remembers what he has done
tr.19: The day when man will call to mind his (whole) endeavour,
tr.22: The Day when man shall remember (all) that he strove for,
tr.203: The Day when man shall remember what he strove for.

79.en: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

tr.85: and Hell is there for all to see,
tr.19: And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth,
tr.22: And Hell-Fire shall be placed in full view for (all) to see,-
tr.203: And Hell-fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees.

79.en: So as for he who transgressed

tr.85: for anyone who has transgressed
tr.19: Then, as for him who rebelled
tr.22: Then, for such as had transgressed all bounds,
tr.203: Then for him who transgressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allâh).

79.en: And preferred the life of the world,

tr.85: and preferred the present life
tr.19: And chose the life of the world,
tr.22: And had preferred the life of this world,
tr.203: And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),

79.en: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

tr.85: Hell will be home;
tr.19: Lo! hell will be his home.
tr.22: The Abode will be Hell-Fire;
tr.203: Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;

79.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
79.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
79.tl: wa-ammā man khāfa maqāma rabbihi wanahā l-nafsa ʿani l-hawā

tr.85: for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from base desires,
tr.19: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
tr.22: And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
tr.203: But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts.

79.en: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

tr.85: Paradise will be home.
tr.19: Lo! the Garden will be his home.
tr.22: Their abode will be the Garden.
tr.203: Verily, Paradise will be his abode.

79.en: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

tr.85: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour,
tr.19: They ask thee of the Hour: when will it come to port?
tr.22: They ask thee about the Hour,-'When will be its appointed time?
tr.203: They ask you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) about the Hour - when will be its appointed time?

79.en: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

tr.85: saying, ‘When will it arrive?’, but how can you tell [them that]?
tr.19: Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?
tr.22: Wherein art thou (concerned) with the declaration thereof?
tr.203: You have no knowledge to say anything about it.

79.en: To your Lord is its finality.

tr.85: Its time is known only to your Lord;
tr.19: Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof.
tr.22: With thy Lord in the Limit fixed therefor.
tr.203: To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?

79.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

tr.85: you are only sent to warn those who fear it.
tr.19: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
tr.22: Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
tr.203: You (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) are only a warner for those who fear it,

79.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
79.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
79.tl: ka-annahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbathū illā ʿashiyyatan aw ḍuḥāhā

tr.85: On the Day they see it, it will seem they lingered [in this life] an evening [at most,] or its morning.
tr.19: On the day when they behold it, it will be as if they had but tarried for an evening or the morn thereof.
tr.22: The Day they see it, (It will be) as if they had tarried but a single evening, or (at most till) the following morn!
tr.203: The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning.

80.en: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away

tr.85: He frowned and turned away
tr.19: He frowned and turned away
tr.22: (The Prophet) frowned and turned away,
tr.203: (The Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم) frowned and turned away.

80.en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

tr.85: when the blind man came to him––
tr.19: Because the blind man came unto him.
tr.22: Because there came to him the blind man (interrupting).
tr.203: Because there came to him the blind man (i.e. ‘Abdullâh bin Umm-Maktûm, who came to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم while he was preaching to one or some of the Quraish chiefs).

80.en: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified

tr.85: for all you know, he might have grown in spirit,
tr.19: What could inform thee but that he might grow (in grace)
tr.22: But what could tell thee but that perchance he might grow (in spiritual understanding)?-
tr.203: And how can you know that he might become pure (from sins)?

80.en: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

tr.85: or taken note of something useful to him.
tr.19: Or take heed and so the reminder might avail him?
tr.22: Or that he might receive admonition, and the teaching might profit him?
tr.203: Or he might receive admonition, and the admonition might profit him?

80.en: As for he who thinks himself without need,

tr.85: For the self-satisfied one
tr.19: As for him who thinketh himself independent,
tr.22: As to one who regards Himself as self-sufficient,
tr.203: As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,

80.en: To him you give attention.

tr.85: you go out of your way––
tr.19: Unto him thou payest regard.
tr.22: To him dost thou attend;
tr.203: To him you attend;

80.en: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

tr.85: though you are not to be blamed for his lack of spiritual growth––
tr.19: Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace).
tr.22: Though it is no blame to thee if he grow not (in spiritual understanding).
tr.203: What does it matter to you if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allâh).

80.en: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

tr.85: but from the one who has come to you full of eagerness
tr.19: But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose
tr.22: But as to him who came to thee striving earnestly,
tr.203: But as to him who came to you running,

80.en: While he fears [Allāh],

tr.85: and awe
tr.19: And hath fear,
tr.22: And with fear (in his heart),
tr.203: And is afraid (of Allâh and His punishment).

80.en: From him you are distracted.

tr.85: you allow yourself to be distracted.
tr.19: From him thou art distracted.
tr.22: Of him wast thou unmindful.
tr.203: Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,

80.en: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;

tr.85: No indeed! This [Quran] is a lesson
tr.19: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
tr.22: By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
tr.203: Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ân) is an admonition.

80.en: So whoever wills may remember it.

tr.85: from which those who wish to be taught should learn,
tr.19: So let whosoever will pay heed to it,
tr.22: Therefore let whoso will, keep it in remembrance.
tr.203: So whoever wills, let him pay attention to it.

80.en: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

tr.85: [written] on honoured,
tr.19: On honoured leaves
tr.22: (It is) in Books held (greatly) in honour,
tr.203: (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz),

80.en: Exalted and purified,

tr.85: exalted, pure pages,
tr.19: Exalted, purified,
tr.22: Exalted (in dignity), kept pure and holy,
tr.203: Exalted (in dignity), purified,

80.en: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

tr.85: by the hands of
tr.19: (Set down) by scribes
tr.22: (Written) by the hands of scribes-
tr.203: In the hands of scribes (angels).

80.en: Noble and dutiful.

tr.85: noble and virtuous scribes.
tr.19: Noble and righteous.
tr.22: Honourable and Pious and Just.
tr.203: Honourable and obedient.

80.en: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.

tr.85: Woe to man! How ungrateful he is!
tr.19: Man is (self-)destroyed: how ungrateful!
tr.22: Woe to man! What hath made him reject Allah;
tr.203: Be cursed (the disbelieving) man! How ungrateful he is!

80.en: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?

tr.85: From what thing does God create him?
tr.19: From what thing doth He create him?
tr.22: From what stuff hath He created him?
tr.203: From what thing did He create him?

80.en: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

tr.85: He creates him from a droplet, He proportions him,
tr.19: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
tr.22: From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
tr.203: From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him and then set him in due proportion.

80.en: Then He eased the way for him;

tr.85: He makes the way easy for him,
tr.19: Then maketh the way easy for him,
tr.22: Then doth He make His path smooth for him;
tr.203: Then He makes the Path easy for him.

80.en: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

tr.85: then He causes him to die and be buried.
tr.19: Then causeth him to die, and burieth him;
tr.22: Then He causeth him to die, and putteth him in his grave;
tr.203: Then He causes him to die and puts him in his grave.

80.en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

tr.85: When He wills, He will raise him up again.
tr.19: Then, when He will, He bringeth him again to life.
tr.22: Then, when it is His Will, He will raise him up (again).
tr.203: Then when it is His Will, He will resurrect him (again).

80.en: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

tr.85: Yet man does not fulfil God’s commands.
tr.19: Nay, but (man) hath not done what He commanded him.
tr.22: By no means hath he fulfilled what Allah hath commanded him.
tr.203: Nay, but (man) has not done what He commanded him.

80.en: Then let mankind look at his food -

tr.85: Let man consider the food he eats!
tr.19: Let man consider his food:
tr.22: Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
tr.203: Then let man look at his food:

80.en: How We poured down water in torrents,

tr.85: We pour down abundant water
tr.19: How We pour water in showers
tr.22: For that We pour forth water in abundance,
tr.203: We pour forth water in abundance.

80.en: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

tr.85: and cause the soil to split open.
tr.19: Then split the earth in clefts
tr.22: And We split the earth in fragments,
tr.203: And We split the earth in clefts.

80.en: And caused to grow within it grain

tr.85: We make grain grow,
tr.19: And cause the grain to grow therein
tr.22: And produce therein corn,
tr.203: And We cause therein the grain to grow,

80.en: And grapes and herbage

tr.85: and vines, fresh vegetation,
tr.19: And grapes and green fodder
tr.22: And Grapes and nutritious plants,
tr.203: And grapes and clover plants (i.e. green fodder for the cattle),

80.en: And olive and palm trees

tr.85: olive trees, date palms,
tr.19: And olive-trees and palm-trees
tr.22: And Olives and Dates,
tr.203: And olives and date-palms,

80.en: And gardens of dense shrubbery

tr.85: luscious gardens,
tr.19: And garden-closes of thick foliage
tr.22: And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
tr.203: And gardens dense with many trees,

80.en: And fruit and grass -

tr.85: fruits, and fodder:
tr.19: And fruits and grasses:
tr.22: And fruits and fodder,-
tr.203: And fruits and herbage

80.en: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

tr.85: all for you and your livestock to enjoy.
tr.19: Provision for you and your cattle.
tr.22: For use and convenience to you and your cattle.
tr.203: (To be) a provision and benefit for you and your cattle.

80.en: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

tr.85: When the Deafening Blast comes––
tr.19: But when the Shout cometh
tr.22: At length, when there comes the Deafening Noise,-
tr.203: Then when there comes As-Sâkhkhah (the second blowing of the Trumpet on the Day of Resurrection)

80.en: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

tr.85: the Day man will flee from his own brother,
tr.19: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
tr.22: That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
tr.203: That Day shall a man flee from his brother,

80.en: And his mother and his father

tr.85: his mother, his father,
tr.19: And his mother and his father
tr.22: And from his mother and his father,
tr.203: And from his mother and his father,

80.en: And his wife and his children,

tr.85: his wife, his children:
tr.19: And his wife and his children,
tr.22: And from his wife and his children.
tr.203: And from his wife and his children.

80.ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
80.en: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
80.tl: likulli im'ri-in min'hum yawma-idhin shanun yugh'nīhi

tr.85: each of them will be absorbed in concerns of their own on that Day-
tr.19: Every man that day will have concern enough to make him heedless (of others).
tr.22: Each one of them, that Day, will have enough concern (of his own) to make him indifferent to the others.
tr.203: Everyman that Day will have enough to make him careless of others.

80.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

tr.85: on that Day some faces will be beaming,
tr.19: On that day faces will be bright as dawn,
tr.22: Some faces that Day will be beaming,
tr.203: Some faces that Day will be bright (true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),

80.en: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

tr.85: laughing, and rejoicing,
tr.19: Laughing, rejoicing at good news;
tr.22: Laughing, rejoicing.
tr.203: Laughing, rejoicing at good news (of Paradise).

80.en: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

tr.85: but some faces will be dust-stained
tr.19: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
tr.22: And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
tr.203: And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained.

80.en: Blackness will cover them.

tr.85: and covered in darkness:
tr.19: Veiled in darkness,
tr.22: Blackness will cover them:
tr.203: Darkness will cover them.

80.en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

tr.85: those are the disbelievers, the licentious.
tr.19: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
tr.22: Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
tr.203: Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم, etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).

81.en: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

tr.85: When the sun is shrouded in darkness,
tr.19: When the sun is overthrown,
tr.22: When the sun (with its spacious light) is folded up;
tr.203: When the sun is wound round and its light is lost and is overthrown.

81.en: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

tr.85: when the stars are dimmed,
tr.19: And when the stars fall,
tr.22: When the stars fall, losing their lustre;
tr.203: And when the stars fall.

81.en: And when the mountains are removed

tr.85: when the mountains are set in motion,
tr.19: And when the hills are moved,
tr.22: When the mountains vanish (like a mirage);
tr.203: And when the mountains are made to pass away;

81.en: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

tr.85: when pregnant camels are abandoned,
tr.19: And when the camels big with young are abandoned,
tr.22: When the she-camels, ten months with young, are left untended;
tr.203: And when the pregnant she-camels are neglected;

81.en: And when the wild beasts are gathered

tr.85: when wild beasts are herded together,
tr.19: And when the wild beasts are herded together,
tr.22: When the wild beasts are herded together (in the human habitations);
tr.203: And when the wild beasts are gathered together.

81.en: And when the seas are filled with flame

tr.85: when the seas boil over,
tr.19: And when the seas rise,
tr.22: When the oceans boil over with a swell;
tr.203: And when the seas become as blazing Fire or overflow.

81.en: And when the souls are paired

tr.85: when souls are sorted into classes,
tr.19: And when souls are reunited,
tr.22: When the souls are sorted out, (being joined, like with like);
tr.203: And when the souls are joined with their bodies, (the good with the good and the bad with the bad).

81.en: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

tr.85: when the baby girl buried alive is asked
tr.19: And when the girl-child that was buried alive is asked
tr.22: When the female (infant), buried alive, is questioned -
tr.203: And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) is questioned:

81.en: For what sin she was killed

tr.85: for what sin she was killed,
tr.19: For what sin she was slain,
tr.22: For what crime she was killed;
tr.203: For what sin, was she killed?

81.en: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]

tr.85: when the records of deeds are spread open,
tr.19: And when the pages are laid open,
tr.22: When the scrolls are laid open;
tr.203: And when the (written) pages [of deeds (good and bad) of every person] are laid open.

81.en: And when the sky is stripped away

tr.85: when the sky is stripped away,
tr.19: And when the sky is torn away,
tr.22: When the world on High is unveiled;
tr.203: And when the heaven is stripped off and taken away from its place;

81.en: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

tr.85: when Hell is made to blaze
tr.19: And when hell is lighted,
tr.22: When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
tr.203: And when Hell-fire is set ablaze.

81.en: And when Paradise is brought near,

tr.85: and Paradise brought near:
tr.19: And when the Garden is brought nigh,
tr.22: And when the Garden is brought near;-
tr.203: And when Paradise is brought near.

81.en: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

tr.85: then every soul will know what it has brought about.
tr.19: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
tr.22: (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
tr.203: (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil).

81.en: So I swear by the retreating stars -

tr.85: I swear by the planets
tr.19: Oh, but I call to witness the planets,
tr.22: So verily I call to witness the planets - that recede,
tr.203: So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night).

81.en: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

tr.85: that recede, move, and hide,
tr.19: The stars which rise and set,
tr.22: Go straight, or hide;
tr.203: And by the planets that move swiftly and hide themselves.

81.en: And by the night as it closes in

tr.85: by the night that descends,
tr.19: And the close of night,
tr.22: And the Night as it dissipates;
tr.203: And by the night as it departs.

81.en: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

tr.85: by the dawn that softly breathes:
tr.19: And the breath of morning
tr.22: And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
tr.203: And by the dawn as it brightens.

81.en: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

tr.85: this is the speech of a noble messenger,
tr.19: That this is in truth the word of an honoured messenger,
tr.22: Verily this is the word of a most honourable Messenger,
tr.203: Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’ân brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrîl (Gabrîl), from Allâh to Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم].

81.ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
81.en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
81.tl: dhī quwwatin ʿinda dhī l-ʿarshi makīnin

tr.85: who possesses great strength and is held in honour by the Lord of the Throne––
tr.19: Mighty, established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne,
tr.22: Endued with Power, with rank before the Lord of the Throne,
tr.203: Owner of power, (and high rank) with (Allâh), the Lord of the Throne,

81.en: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

tr.85: he is obeyed there and worthy of trust.
tr.19: (One) to be obeyed, and trustworthy;
tr.22: With authority there, (and) faithful to his trust.
tr.203: Obeyed (by the angels in the heavens), and trustworthy.

81.en: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.

tr.85: Your companion is not mad:
tr.19: And your comrade is not mad.
tr.22: And (O people!) your companion is not one possessed;
tr.203: And (O people) your companion (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is not a madman.

81.en: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.

tr.85: he did see him on the clear horizon.
tr.19: Surely he beheld Him on the clear horizon.
tr.22: And without doubt he saw him in the clear horizon.
tr.203: And indeed he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) saw him [Jibrîl (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east).

81.en: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

tr.85: He does not withhold what is revealed to him from beyond.
tr.19: And he is not avid of the Unseen.
tr.22: Neither doth he withhold grudgingly a knowledge of the Unseen.
tr.203: And he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) withholds not a knowledge of the Unseen.

81.en: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

tr.85: This is not the word of an outcast devil.
tr.19: Nor is this the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned.
tr.22: Nor is it the word of an evil spirit accursed.
tr.203: And it (the Qur’ân) is not the word of the outcast Shaitân (Satan).

81.en: So where are you going?

tr.85: So where are you [people] going?
tr.19: Whither then go ye?
tr.22: When whither go ye?
tr.203: Then where are you going?

81.en: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

tr.85: This is a message for all people;
tr.19: This is naught else than a reminder unto creation,
tr.22: Verily this is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds:
tr.203: Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn)

81.en: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

tr.85: for those who wish to take the straight path.
tr.19: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
tr.22: (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
tr.203: To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight.

81.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
81.en: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.
81.tl: wamā tashāūna illā an yashāa l-lahu rabbu l-ʿālamīna

tr.85: But you will only wish to do so by the will of God, the Lord of all people.
tr.19: And ye will not, unless (it be) that Allah willeth, the Lord of Creation.
tr.22: But ye shall not will except as Allah wills,- the Cherisher of the Worlds.
tr.203: And you cannot will unless (it be) that Allâh wills - the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists).

tr.85: When the sky is torn apart,
tr.19: When the heaven is cleft asunder,
tr.22: When the Sky is cleft asunder;
tr.203: When the heaven is cleft asunder.

82.en: And when the stars fall, scattering,

tr.85: when the stars are scattered,
tr.19: When the planets are dispersed,
tr.22: When the Stars are scattered;
tr.203: And when the stars have fallen and scattered.

82.en: And when the seas are erupted

tr.85: when the seas burst forth,
tr.19: When the seas are poured forth,
tr.22: When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
tr.203: And when the seas are burst forth.

82.en: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

tr.85: when graves turn inside out:
tr.19: And the sepulchres are overturned,
tr.22: And when the Graves are turned upside down;-
tr.203: And when the graves are turned upside down (and bring out their contents)

82.en: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

tr.85: each soul will know what it has done and what it has left undone.
tr.19: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
tr.22: (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
tr.203: (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).

82.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
82.en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
82.tl: yāayyuhā l-insānu mā gharraka birabbika l-karīmi

tr.85: Mankind, what has lured you away from God,
tr.19: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful,
tr.22: O man! What has seduced thee from thy Lord Most Beneficent?-
tr.203: O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous?

82.en: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

tr.85: your generous Lord, who created you, shaped you, proportioned you,
tr.19: Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee?
tr.22: Him Who created thee. Fashioned thee in due proportion, and gave thee a just bias;
tr.203: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion.

82.ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
82.en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
82.tl: fī ayyi ṣūratin mā shāa rakkabaka

tr.85: in whatever form He chose?
tr.19: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee.
tr.22: In whatever Form He wills, does He put thee together.
tr.203: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.

82.en: No! But you deny the Recompense.

tr.85: Yet you still take the Judgement to be a lie!
tr.19: Nay, but ye deny the Judgment.
tr.22: Nay! But ye do reject Right and Judgment!
tr.203: Nay! But you deny Ad-Dîn (i.e. the Day of Recompense).

82.en: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

tr.85: Over you stand
tr.19: Lo! there are above you guardians,
tr.22: But verily over you (are appointed angels) to protect you,-
tr.203: But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you,

tr.85: watchers, noble recorders
tr.19: Generous and recording,
tr.22: Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
tr.203: Kirâman (Honourable) Kâtibîn writing down (your deeds),

tr.85: who know what you do:
tr.19: Who know (all) that ye do.
tr.22: They know (and understand) all that ye do.
tr.203: They know all that you do.

82.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
