tr.85: the good will live in bliss,
tr.19: Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight.
tr.22: As for the Righteous, they will be in bliss;
tr.203: Verily, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise);

82.en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

tr.85: and the wicked will burn in the Fire.
tr.19: And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell;
tr.22: And the Wicked - they will be in the Fire,
tr.203: And verily, the Fujjâr (the wicked, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners and evil-doers) will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),

82.en: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

tr.85: They will enter it on the Day of Judgement
tr.19: They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment,
tr.22: Which they will enter on the Day of Judgment,
tr.203: Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,

82.en: And never therefrom will they be absent.

tr.85: and they will find no escape.
tr.19: And will not be absent thence.
tr.22: And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
tr.203: And they (Al-Fujjâr) will not be absent therefrom.

82.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
tr.203: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

82.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
82.en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
82.tl: thumma mā adrāka mā yawmu l-dīni

tr.85: Yes! What will explain to you what the Day of Judgement is?
tr.19: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is!
tr.22: Again, what will explain to thee what the Day of Judgment is?
tr.203: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?

82.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
82.en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.
82.tl: yawma lā tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan wal-amru yawma-idhin lillahi

tr.85: The Day when no soul will be able to do anything for another; on that Day, command will belong to God.
tr.19: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's.
tr.22: (It will be) the Day when no soul shall have power (to do) aught for another: For the command, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allah.
tr.203: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allâh.

83.en: Woe to those who give less [than due],

tr.85: Woe to those who give short measure,
tr.19: Woe unto the defrauders:
tr.22: Woe to those that deal in fraud,-
tr.203: Woe to Al-Mutaffifûn (those who give less in measure and weight).

83.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
83.en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
83.tl: alladhīna idhā ik'tālū ʿalā l-nāsi yastawfūna

tr.85: who demand of other people full measure for themselves,
tr.19: Those who when they take the measure from mankind demand it full,
tr.22: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, exact full measure,
tr.203: Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,

83.en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

tr.85: but give less than they should when it is they who weigh or measure for others!
tr.19: But if they measure unto them or weight for them, they cause them loss.
tr.22: But when they have to give by measure or weight to men, give less than due.
tr.203: And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due.

83.en: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

tr.85: Do these people not realize that they will be raised up
tr.19: Do such (men) not consider that they will be raised again
tr.22: Do they not think that they will be called to account?-
tr.203: Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),

83.en: For a tremendous Day -

tr.85: on a mighty Day,
tr.19: Unto an Awful Day,
tr.22: On a Mighty Day,
tr.203: On a Great Day?

83.en: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

tr.85: a Day when everyone will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.19: The day when (all) mankind stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.22: A Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
tr.203: The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Âlamîn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?

83.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
83.en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
83.tl: kallā inna kitāba l-fujāri lafī sijjīnin

tr.85: No indeed! The list of the wicked is in Sijjin––
tr.19: Nay, but the record of the vile is in Sijjin -
tr.22: Nay! Surely the record of the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjin.
tr.203: Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the Fujjâr (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, evil-doers and the wicked) is (preserved) in Sijjîn.

83.en: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

tr.85: what will explain to you what Sijjin is?––
tr.19: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is! -
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what Sijjin is?
tr.203: And what will make you know what Sijjîn is?

83.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

tr.85: a clearly numbered list.
tr.19: A written record.
tr.22: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed.
tr.203: A Register inscribed.

83.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

tr.85: Woe on that day to the deniers,
tr.19: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
tr.22: Woe, that Day, to those that deny-
tr.203: Woe, that Day, to those who deny.

83.en: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

tr.85: those who deny the Day of Judgement!
tr.19: Those who deny the Day of Judgment
tr.22: Those that deny the Day of Judgment.
tr.203: Those who deny the Day of Recompense.

83.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
83.en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
83.tl: wamā yukadhibu bihi illā kullu muʿ'tadin athīmin

tr.85: Only the evil aggressor denies it:
tr.19: Which none denieth save each criminal transgressor,
tr.22: And none can deny it but the Transgressor beyond bounds the Sinner!
tr.203: And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allâh) the sinner!

83.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
83.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
83.tl: idhā tut'lā ʿalayhi āyātunā qāla asāṭīru l-awalīna

tr.85: when Our revelations are recited to him, he says, ‘Ancient fables!’
tr.19: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
tr.22: When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
tr.203: When Our Verses (of the Qur’ân) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"

83.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
83.en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
83.tl: kallā bal rāna ʿalā qulūbihim mā kānū yaksibūna

tr.85: No indeed! Their hearts are encrusted with what they have done.
tr.19: Nay, but that which they have earned is rust upon their hearts.
tr.22: By no means! but on their hearts is the stain of the (ill) which they do!
tr.203: Nay! But on their hearts is the Rân (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn.

83.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
83.en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
83.tl: kallā innahum ʿan rabbihim yawma-idhin lamaḥjūbūna

tr.85: No indeed! On that Day they will be screened off from their Lord,
tr.19: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
tr.22: Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
tr.203: Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.

83.en: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

tr.85: they will burn in Hell,
tr.19: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
tr.22: Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
tr.203: Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell.

83.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
83.en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
83.tl: thumma yuqālu hādhā alladhī kuntum bihi tukadhibūna

tr.85: and they will be told, ‘This is what you called a lie.’
tr.19: And it will be said (unto them): This is that which ye used to deny.
tr.22: Further, it will be said to them: "This is the (reality) which ye rejected as false!
tr.203: Then, it will be said to them: "This is what you used to deny!"

83.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
83.en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.
83.tl: kallā inna kitāba l-abrāri lafī ʿilliyyīna

tr.85: No indeed! The list of the truly good is in 'Illiyyin––
tr.19: Nay, but the record of the righteous is in 'Illiyin -
tr.22: Nay, verily the record of the Righteous is (preserved) in 'Illiyin.
tr.203: Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyûn

83.en: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

tr.85: what will explain to you what 'Illiyyin is?––
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what 'Illiyin is! -
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what 'Illiyun is?
tr.203: And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyûn is?

83.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

tr.85: a clearly written list,
tr.19: A written record,
tr.22: (There is) a Register (fully) inscribed,
tr.203: A Register inscribed,

83.en: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

tr.85: witnessed by those brought near.
tr.19: Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord).
tr.22: To which bear witness those Nearest (to Allah).
tr.203: To which bear witness those nearest (to Allâh, i.e. the angels).

83.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

tr.85: The truly good will live in bliss,
tr.19: Lo! the righteous verily are in delight,
tr.22: Truly the Righteous will be in Bliss:
tr.203: Verily, Al-Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism) will be in Delight (Paradise).

83.en: On adorned couches, observing.

tr.85: seated on couches, gazing around.
tr.19: On couches, gazing,
tr.22: On Thrones (of Dignity) will they command a sight (of all things):
tr.203: On thrones, looking (at all things).

83.en: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

tr.85: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
tr.19: Thou wilt know in their faces the radiance of delight.
tr.22: Thou wilt recognise in their faces the beaming brightness of Bliss.
tr.203: You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight.

83.en: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

tr.85: They will be served a sealed nectar,
tr.19: They are given to drink of a pure wine, sealed,
tr.22: Their thirst will be slaked with Pure Wine sealed:
tr.203: They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine.

83.ar: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
83.en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
83.tl: khitāmuhu mis'kun wafī dhālika falyatanāfasi l-mutanāfisūna

tr.85: its seal [perfumed with] a fragrant herb––let those who strive, strive for this––
tr.19: Whose seal is musk - for this let (all) those strive who strive for bliss -
tr.22: The seal thereof will be Musk: And for this let those aspire, who have aspirations:
tr.203: The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of Musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allah).

83.en: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

tr.85: mixed with the water of Tasnim,
tr.19: And mixed with water of Tasnim,
tr.22: With it will be (given) a mixture of Tasnim:
tr.203: It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnîm:

83.en: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

tr.85: a spring from which those brought near will drink.
tr.19: A spring whence those brought near (to Allah) drink.
tr.22: A spring, from (the waters) whereof drink those Nearest to Allah.
tr.203: A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allâh.

83.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
83.en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
83.tl: inna alladhīna ajramū kānū mina alladhīna āmanū yaḍḥakūna

tr.85: The wicked used to laugh at the believers––
tr.19: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
tr.22: Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
tr.203: Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

83.en: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

tr.85: they would wink at one another when the believers passed by them,
tr.19: And wink one to another when they passed them;
tr.22: And whenever they passed by them, used to wink at each other (in mockery);
tr.203: And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery).

83.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
83.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
83.tl: wa-idhā inqalabū ilā ahlihimu inqalabū fakihīna

tr.85: joke about them when they got back to their own people,
tr.19: And when they returned to their own folk, they returned jesting;
tr.22: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;
tr.203: And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;

83.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
83.en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
83.tl: wa-idhā ra-awhum qālū inna hāulāi laḍāllūna

tr.85: and say, when they saw them, ‘These people are misguided,’
tr.19: And when they saw them they said: Lo! these have gone astray.
tr.22: And whenever they saw them, they would say, "Behold! These are the people truly astray!"
tr.203: And when they saw them, they said: "Verily these have indeed gone astray!"

83.en: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

tr.85: though they were not sent to be their keepers-
tr.19: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
tr.22: But they had not been sent as keepers over them!
tr.203: But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers).

83.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
83.en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
83.tl: fal-yawma alladhīna āmanū mina l-kufāri yaḍḥakūna

tr.85: so today the believers are laughing at the disbelievers
tr.19: This day it is those who believe who have the laugh of disbelievers,
tr.22: But on this Day the Believers will laugh at the Unbelievers:
tr.203: But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers

83.en: On adorned couches, observing.

tr.85: as they sit on couches, gazing around.
tr.19: On high couches, gazing.
tr.22: On Thrones (of Dignity) they will command (a sight) (of all things).
tr.203: On (high) thrones, looking (at all things).

83.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
83.en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
83.tl: hal thuwwiba l-kufāru mā kānū yafʿalūna

tr.85: Have the disbelievers [not] been repaid for their deeds?
tr.19: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
tr.22: Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
tr.203: Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?

84.en: When the sky has split [open]

tr.85: When the sky is ripped apart,
tr.19: When the heaven is split asunder
tr.22: When the sky is rent asunder,
tr.203: When the heaven is split asunder,

84.en: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

tr.85: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,
tr.19: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
tr.22: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
tr.203: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

84.en: And when the earth has been extended

tr.85: when the earth is levelled out,
tr.19: And when the earth is spread out
tr.22: And when the earth is flattened out,
tr.203: And when the earth is stretched forth,

84.en: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it].

tr.85: casts out its contents, and becomes empty,
tr.19: And hath cast out all that was in her, and is empty
tr.22: And casts forth what is within it and becomes (clean) empty,
tr.203: And has cast out all that was in it and became empty.

84.en: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

tr.85: obeying its Lord as it rightly must,
tr.19: And attentive to her Lord in fear!
tr.22: And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord,- and it must needs (do so);- (then will come Home the full reality).
tr.203: And listens to and obeys its Lord - and it must do so.

84.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
84.en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
84.tl: yāayyuhā l-insānu innaka kādiḥun ilā rabbika kadḥan famulāqīhi

tr.85: you humans, toiling laboriously towards your Lord, will meet Him:
tr.19: Thou, verily, O man, art working toward thy Lord a work which thou wilt meet (in His presence).
tr.22: O thou man! Verily thou art ever toiling on towards thy Lord- painfully toiling,- but thou shalt meet Him.
tr.203: O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, and you will meet (the results of your deeds which you did).

84.en: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

tr.85: whoever is given his record in his right hand
tr.19: Then whoso is given his account in his right hand
tr.22: Then he who is given his Record in his right hand,
tr.203: Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,

84.en: He will be judged with an easy account

tr.85: will have an easy reckoning
tr.19: He truly will receive an easy reckoning
tr.22: Soon will his account be taken by an easy reckoning,
tr.203: He surely will receive an easy reckoning,

84.en: And return to his people in happiness.

tr.85: and return to his people well pleased,
tr.19: And will return unto his folk in joy.
tr.22: And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
tr.203: And will return to his family in joy!

84.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
84.en: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
84.tl: wa-ammā man ūtiya kitābahu warāa ẓahrihi

tr.85: but whoever is given his record from behind his back
tr.19: But whoso is given his account behind his back,
tr.22: But he who is given his Record behind his back,-
tr.203: But whosoever is given his Record behind his back,

84.en: He will cry out for destruction

tr.85: will cry out for destruction––
tr.19: He surely will invoke destruction
tr.22: Soon will he cry for perdition,
tr.203: He will invoke (for his) destruction,

84.en: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

tr.85: he will burn in the blazing Fire.
tr.19: And be thrown to scorching fire.
tr.22: And he will enter a Blazing Fire.
tr.203: And he shall enter a blazing Fire, and be made to taste its burning.

84.en: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

tr.85: He used to live among his people well pleased.
tr.19: He verily lived joyous with his folk,
tr.22: Truly, did he go about among his people, rejoicing!
tr.203: Verily, he was among his people in joy!

84.en: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

tr.85: He thought he would never return [to his Lord]––
tr.19: He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah).
tr.22: Truly, did he think that he would not have to return (to Us)!
tr.203: Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!

84.ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
84.en: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
84.tl: balā inna rabbahu kāna bihi baṣīran

tr.85: indeed he will! His Lord was watching him.
tr.19: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
tr.22: Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
tr.203: Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!

84.en: So I swear by the twilight glow

tr.85: I swear by the glow of sunset,
tr.19: Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,
tr.22: So I do call to witness the ruddy glow of Sunset;
tr.203: So I swear by the afterglow of sunset;

84.en: And [by] the night and what it envelops

tr.85: by the night and what it covers,
tr.19: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth,
tr.22: The Night and its Homing;
tr.203: And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness,

84.en: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

tr.85: by the full moon,
tr.19: And by the moon when she is at the full,
tr.22: And the Moon in her fullness:
tr.203: And by the moon when it is at the full.

84.en: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.

tr.85: you will progress from stage to stage.
tr.19: That ye shall journey on from plane to plane.
tr.22: Ye shall surely travel from stage to stage.
tr.203: You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter).

84.en: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

tr.85: So why do they not believe?
tr.19: What aileth them, then, that they believe not
tr.22: What then is the matter with them, that they believe not?-
tr.203: What is the matter with them, that they believe not?

84.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
84.en: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?
84.tl: wa-idhā quri-a ʿalayhimu l-qur'ānu lā yasjudūna

tr.85: Why, when the Quran is read to them, do they not prostrate themselves [to God]?
tr.19: And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them, worship not (Allah)?
tr.22: And when the Qur'an is read to them, they fall not prostrate,
tr.203: And when the Qur’ân is recited to them, they fall not prostrate.

84.en: But those who have disbelieved deny,

tr.85: No! The disbelievers reject the Quran––
tr.19: Nay, but those who disbelieve will deny;
tr.22: But on the contrary the Unbelievers reject (it).
tr.203: Nay, those who disbelieve belie (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ân and Islâmic Monotheism, etc.).

84.en: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

tr.85: God knows best what they keep hidden inside––
tr.19: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
tr.22: But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
tr.203: And Allâh knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),

84.en: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

tr.85: so give them news of a painful torment.
tr.19: So give them tidings of a painful doom,
tr.22: So announce to them a Penalty Grievous,
tr.203: So announce to them a painful torment.

84.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
84.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
84.tl: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin

tr.85: But those who believe and do good deeds will have a never-ending reward.
tr.19: Save those who believe and do good works, for theirs is a reward unfailing.
tr.22: Except to those who believe and work righteous deeds: For them is a Reward that will never fail.
tr.203: Save those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise).

85.en: By the sky containing great stars

tr.85: By the sky with its towering constellations,
tr.19: By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars,
tr.22: By the sky, (displaying) the Zodiacal Signs;
tr.203: By the heaven holding the big stars.

85.en: And [by] the promised Day

tr.85: by the promised Day,
tr.19: And by the Promised Day.
tr.22: By the promised Day (of Judgment);
tr.203: And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

85.en: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

tr.85: by the Witness and that which is witnessed,
tr.19: And by the witness and that whereunto he beareth testimony,
tr.22: By one that witnesses, and the subject of the witness;-
tr.203: And by the Witnessing day (i.e. Friday), and by the Witnessed day [i.e. the day of ‘Arafât (Hajj) the ninth of Dhul-Hijjah];

85.en: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench

tr.85: damned were the makers of the trench,
tr.19: (Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch
tr.22: Woe to the makers of the pit (of fire),
tr.203: Cursed were the people of the Ditch (in the story of the Boy and the King).

85.en: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

tr.85: the makers of the fuel-stoked fire!
tr.19: Of the fuel-fed fire,
tr.22: Fire supplied (abundantly) with fuel:
tr.203: Of fire fed with fuel,

85.en: When they were sitting near it.

tr.85: They sat down
tr.19: When they sat by it,
tr.22: Behold! they sat over against the (fire),
tr.203: When they sat by it (fire),

85.ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
85.en: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
85.tl: wahum ʿalā mā yafʿalūna bil-mu'minīna shuhūdun

tr.85: to watch what they were doing to the believers.
tr.19: And were themselves the witnesses of what they did to the believers.
tr.22: And they witnessed (all) that they were doing against the Believers.
tr.203: And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them).

85.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
85.en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
85.tl: wamā naqamū min'hum illā an yu'minū bil-lahi l-ʿazīzi l-ḥamīdi

tr.85: Their only grievance against them was their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy,
tr.19: They had naught against them save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty, the Owner of Praise,
tr.22: And they ill-treated them for no other reason than that they believed in Allah, Exalted in Power, Worthy of all Praise!-
tr.203: And they had no fault except that they believed in Allâh, the All-Mighty, Worthy of all Praise!

85.ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
85.en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.
85.tl: alladhī lahu mul'ku l-samāwāti wal-arḍi wal-lahu ʿalā kulli shayin shahīdun

tr.85: to whom all control over the heavens and earth belongs: God is witness over all things.
tr.19: Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth; and Allah is of all things the Witness.
tr.22: Him to Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allah is Witness to all things.
tr.203: To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allâh is Witness over everything.

85.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
85.en: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
85.tl: inna alladhīna fatanū l-mu'minīna wal-mu'mināti thumma lam yatūbū falahum ʿadhābu jahannama walahum ʿadhābu l-ḥarīqi

tr.85: For those who persecute believing men and women, and do not repent afterwards, there will be the torment of Hell and burning.
tr.19: Lo! they who persecute believing men and believing women and repent not, theirs verily will be the doom of hell, and theirs the doom of burning.
tr.22: Those who persecute (or draw into temptation) the Believers, men and women, and do not turn in repentance, will have the Penalty of Hell: They will have the Penalty of the Burning Fire.
tr.203: Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance (to Allâh), then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire.

85.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
85.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
85.tl: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti lahum jannātun tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru dhālika l-fawzu l-kabīru

tr.85: But for those who believe and do good deeds there will be Gardens graced with flowing streams: that is the great triumph.
tr.19: Lo! those who believe and do good works, theirs will be Gardens underneath which rivers flow. That is the Great Success.
tr.22: For those who believe and do righteous deeds, will be Gardens; beneath which rivers flow: That is the great Salvation, (the fulfilment of all desires),
tr.203: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.

85.en: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

tr.85: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is truly stern––
tr.19: Lo! the punishment of thy Lord is stern.
tr.22: Truly strong is the Grip (and Power) of thy Lord.
tr.203: Verily, (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the Seizure (punishment) of your Lord is severe and painful. [See V.11:102].

85.en: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

tr.85: it is He who brings people to life, and will restore them to life again––
tr.19: Lo! He it is Who produceth, then reproduceth,
tr.22: It is He Who creates from the very beginning, and He can restore (life).
tr.203: Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection).

85.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

tr.85: and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving.
tr.19: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving,
tr.22: And He is the Oft-Forgiving, Full of Loving-Kindness,
tr.203: And He is Oft-Forgiving, full of love (towards the pious who are real true believers of Islâmic Monotheism),

85.en: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

tr.85: The Glorious Lord of the Throne,
tr.19: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
tr.22: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
tr.203: Owner of the throne, the Glorious,

85.en: Effecter of what He intends.

tr.85: He does whatever He will.
tr.19: Doer of what He will.
tr.22: Doer (without let) of all that He intends.
tr.203: (He is the) Doer of whatsoever He intends (or wills).

85.en: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

tr.85: Have you [not] heard the stories of the forces
tr.19: Hath there come unto thee the story of the hosts
tr.22: Has the story reached thee, of the forces-
tr.203: Has the story reached you of the hosts,

85.en: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?

tr.85: of Pharaoh and Thamud?
tr.19: Of Pharaoh and (the tribe of) Thamud?
tr.22: Of Pharaoh and the Thamud?
tr.203: Of Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and Thamûd?

85.en: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

tr.85: Yet still the disbelievers persist in denial.
tr.19: Nay, but those who disbelieve live in denial
tr.22: And yet the Unbelievers (persist) in rejecting (the Truth)!
tr.203: Nay! The disbelievers (persisted) in denying (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and his Message of Islâmic Monotheism).

85.en: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.

tr.85: God surrounds them all.
tr.19: And Allah, all unseen, surroundeth them.
tr.22: But Allah doth encompass them from behind!
tr.203: And Allâh encompasses them from behind! (i.e. all their deeds are within His Knowledge, and He will requite them for their deeds).

85.en: But this is an honored Qur’ān

tr.85: This is truly a glorious Quran
tr.19: Nay, but it is a glorious Qur'an.
tr.22: Nay, this is a Glorious Qur'an,
tr.203: Nay! This is a Glorious Qur’ân,

85.en: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

tr.85: [written] on a preserved Tablet.
tr.19: On a guarded tablet.
tr.22: (Inscribed) in a Tablet Preserved!
tr.203: (Inscribed) in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfûz (The Preserved Tablet)!

86.en: By the sky and the night comer

tr.85: By the sky and the night-comer––
tr.19: By the heaven and the Morning Star
tr.22: By the Sky and the Night-Visitant (therein);-
tr.203: By the heaven, and At-Târiq (the night-comer, i.e. the bright star);

86.en: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the night-comer is?
tr.19: - Ah, what will tell thee what the Morning Star is!
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what the Night-Visitant is?-
tr.203: And what will make you to know what At-Târiq (night-comer) is?

tr.85: The piercing star––
tr.19: - The piercing Star!
tr.22: (It is) the Star of piercing brightness;-
tr.203: (It is) the star of piercing brightness;

86.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
86.en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
86.tl: in kullu nafsin lammā ʿalayhā ḥāfiẓun

tr.85: there is a watcher over every soul.
tr.19: No human soul but hath a guardian over it.
tr.22: There is no soul but has a protector over it.
tr.203: There is no human being but has a protector over him (or her) (i.e. angels in charge of each human being guarding him, writing his good and bad deeds)

86.en: So let man observe from what he was created.

tr.85: Man should reflect on what he was created from.
tr.19: So let man consider from what he is created.
tr.22: Now let man but think from what he is created!
tr.203: So let man see from what he is created!

86.en: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

tr.85: He is created from spurting fluid,
tr.19: He is created from a gushing fluid
tr.22: He is created from a drop emitted-
tr.203: He is created from a water gushing forth,

86.en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

tr.85: then he emerges from between the backbone and breastbone:
tr.19: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
tr.22: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
tr.203: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs.

86.en: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

tr.85: God is certainly able to bring him back to life.
tr.19: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
tr.22: Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
tr.203: Verily, (Allâh) is Able to bring him back (to life)!

86.en: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

tr.85: On the Day when secrets are laid bare
tr.19: On the day when hidden thoughts shall be searched out.
tr.22: The Day that (all) things secret will be tested,
tr.203: The Day when all the secrets (deeds, prayers, fasting, etc.) will be examined (as to their truth).

86.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
86.en: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
86.tl: famā lahu min quwwatin walā nāṣirin

tr.85: he will have no power and no one to help him.
tr.19: Then will he have no might nor any helper.
tr.22: (Man) will have no power, and no helper.
tr.203: Then he will have no power, nor any helper.

86.en: By the sky which sends back

tr.85: By the sky and its recurring rain,
tr.19: By the heaven which giveth the returning rain,
tr.22: By the Firmament which returns (in its round),
tr.203: By the sky (having rain clouds) which gives rain, again and again.

tr.85: by the earth that cracks open!
tr.19: And the earth which splitteth (with the growth of trees and plants)
tr.22: And by the Earth which opens out (for the gushing of springs or the sprouting of vegetation),-
tr.203: And the earth which splits (with the growth of trees and plants).

86.en: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

tr.85: This is truly a decisive statement;
tr.19: Lo! this (Qur'an) is a conclusive word,
tr.22: Behold this is the Word that distinguishes (Good from Evil):
tr.203: Verily, this (the Qur’ân) is the Word that separates (the truth from falsehood, and commands strict laws for mankind to cut the roots of evil).

tr.85: it is not something to be taken lightly.
tr.19: It is no pleasantry.
tr.22: It is not a thing for amusement.
tr.203: And it is not a thing for amusement.

86.en: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

tr.85: They plot and scheme,
tr.19: Lo! they plot a plot (against thee, O Muhammad)
tr.22: As for them, they are but plotting a scheme,
tr.203: Verily, they are but plotting a plot (against you O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم).

86.en: But I am planning a plan.

tr.85: but so do I:
tr.19: And I plot a plot (against them).
tr.22: And I am planning a scheme.
tr.203: And I (too) am planning a plan.

86.en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

tr.85: [Prophet], let the disbelievers be, let them be for a while.
tr.19: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
tr.22: Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
tr.203: So give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while.

87.en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

tr.85: [Prophet], glorify the name of your Lord the Most High,
tr.19: Praise the name of thy Lord the Most High,
tr.22: Glorify the name of thy Guardian-Lord Most High,
tr.203: Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Most High,

tr.85: who created [all things] in due proportion;
tr.19: Who createth, then disposeth;
tr.22: Who hath created, and further, given order and proportion;
tr.203: Who has created (everything), and then proportioned it.

tr.85: who determined their destinies and guided them;
tr.19: Who measureth, then guideth;
tr.22: Who hath ordained laws. And granted guidance;
tr.203: And Who has measured (preordainments for everything even to be blessed or wretched); and then guided (i.e. showed mankind the right as well as the wrong paths, and guided the animals to pasture).

87.en: And who brings out the pasture

tr.85: who brought out the green pasture
tr.19: Who bringeth forth the pasturage,
tr.22: And Who bringeth out the (green and luscious) pasture,
tr.203: And Who brings out the pasturage,

tr.85: then made it dark debris.
tr.19: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
tr.22: And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
tr.203: And then makes it dark stubble.

87.en: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

tr.85: [Prophet], We shall teach you [the Quran] and you will not forget––
tr.19: We shall make thee read (O Muhammad) so that thou shalt not forget
tr.22: By degrees shall We teach thee to declare (the Message), so thou shalt not forget,
tr.203: We shall make you to recite (the Qur’ân), so you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) shall not forget (it),

87.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
87.en: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
87.tl: illā mā shāa l-lahu innahu yaʿlamu l-jahra wamā yakhfā

tr.85: unless God wishes; He knows both what is open and what is hidden––
tr.19: Save that which Allah willeth. Lo! He knoweth the disclosed and that which still is hidden;
tr.22: Except as Allah wills: For He knoweth what is manifest and what is hidden.
tr.203: Except what Allâh may will. He knows what is apparent and what is hidden.

87.en: And We will ease you toward ease.

tr.85: We shall show you the easy way.
tr.19: And We shall ease thy way unto the state of ease.
tr.22: And We will make it easy for thee (to follow) the simple (Path).
tr.203: And We shall make easy for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) the easy way (i.e. the doing of righteous deeds).

87.en: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

tr.85: So remind, if reminding will help.
tr.19: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
tr.22: Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
tr.203: Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).

87.en: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

tr.85: Those who stand in awe of God will heed the reminder,
tr.19: He will heed who feareth,
tr.22: The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
tr.203: The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allâh),

87.en: But the wretched one will avoid it

tr.85: but it will be ignored by the most wicked,
tr.19: But the most hapless will flout it,
tr.22: But it will be avoided by those most unfortunate ones,
tr.203: But it will be avoided by the wretched,

87.en: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

tr.85: who will enter the Great Fire,
tr.19: He who will be flung to the great Fire
tr.22: Who will enter the Great Fire,
tr.203: Who will enter the great Fire (and will be made to taste its burning).

87.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
87.tl: thumma lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥyā

tr.85: where they will neither die nor live.
tr.19: Wherein he will neither die nor live.
tr.22: In which they will then neither die nor live.
tr.203: There he will neither die (to be in rest) nor live (a good living).

87.en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

tr.85: Prosperous are those who purify themselves,
tr.19: He is successful who groweth,
tr.22: But those will prosper who purify themselves,
tr.203: Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islâmic Monotheism) shall achieve success,

87.en: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

tr.85: remember the name of their Lord, and pray.
tr.19: And remembereth the name of his Lord, so prayeth,
tr.22: And glorify the name of their Guardian-Lord, and (lift their hearts) in prayer.
tr.203: And remembers (glorifies) the Name of his Lord (worships none but Allâh), and prays (five compulsory prayers and Nawâfil - additional prayers).

87.en: But you prefer the worldly life,

tr.85: Yet you [people] prefer the life of this world,
tr.19: But ye prefer the life of the world
tr.22: Nay (behold), ye prefer the life of this world;
tr.203: Nay, you prefer the life of this world,

87.en: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

tr.85: even though the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
tr.19: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
tr.22: But the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
tr.203: Although the Hereafter is better and more lasting.

87.en: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

tr.85: All this is in the earlier scriptures,
tr.19: Lo! This is in the former scrolls.
tr.22: And this is in the Books of the earliest (Revelation),-
tr.203: Verily, this is in the former Scriptures -

87.en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

tr.85: the scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
tr.19: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
tr.22: The Books of Abraham and Moses.
tr.203: The Scriptures of Ibrâhîm (Abraham) and Mûsâ (Moses) (عليهما السلام).

88.en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

tr.85: Have you heard tell [Prophet] about the Overwhelming Event?
tr.19: Hath there come unto thee tidings of the Overwhelming?
tr.22: Has the story reached thee of the overwhelming (Event)?
tr.203: Has there come to you the narration of the overwhelming (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)?

88.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

tr.85: On that Day, there will be downcast faces,
tr.19: On that day (many) faces will be downcast,
tr.22: Some faces, that Day, will be humiliated,
tr.203: Some faces, that Day will be humiliated (in the Hell-fire, i.e. the faces of all disbelievers, Jews and Christians).

88.en: Working [hard] and exhausted.

tr.85: toiling and weary,
tr.19: Toiling, weary,
tr.22: Labouring (hard), weary,-
tr.203: Labouring (hard in the worldly life by worshipping others besides Allâh), weary (in the Hereafter with humility and disgrace).

88.en: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

tr.85: as they enter the blazing Fire
tr.19: Scorched by burning fire,
tr.22: The while they enter the Blazing Fire,-
tr.203: They will enter in the hot blazing Fire.

88.en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

tr.85: and are forced to drink from a boiling spring,
tr.19: Drinking from a boiling spring,
tr.22: The while they are given, to drink, of a boiling hot spring,
tr.203: They will be given to drink from a boiling spring,

88.ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
88.en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
88.tl: laysa lahum ṭaʿāmun illā min ḍarīʿin

tr.85: with no food for them except bitter dry thorns
tr.19: No food for them save bitter thorn-fruit
tr.22: No food will there be for them but a bitter Dhari'
tr.203: No food will there be for them but a poisonous thorny plant,

88.ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
88.en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
88.tl: lā yus'minu walā yugh'nī min jūʿin

tr.85: that neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
tr.19: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
tr.22: Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
tr.203: Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.

88.en: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

tr.85: On that Day there will also be faces radiant with bliss,
tr.19: In that day other faces will be calm,
tr.22: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,
tr.203: (Other) faces that Day will be joyful,

88.en: With their effort [they are] satisfied

tr.85: well pleased with their labour,
tr.19: Glad for their effort past,
tr.22: Pleased with their striving,-
tr.203: Glad with their endeavour (for their good deeds which they did in this world, along with the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism).

88.en: In an elevated garden,

tr.85: in a lofty garden,
tr.19: In a high Garden
tr.22: In a Garden on high,
tr.203: In a lofty Paradise.

88.en: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.

tr.85: where they will hear no idle talk,
tr.19: Where they hear no idle speech,
tr.22: Where they shall hear no (word) of vanity:
tr.203: Where they shall neither hear harmful speech nor falsehood.

88.en: Within it is a flowing spring.

tr.85: with a flowing spring,
tr.19: Wherein is a gushing spring,
tr.22: Therein will be a bubbling spring:
tr.203: Therein will be a running spring.

88.en: Within it are couches raised high

tr.85: raised couches,
tr.19: Wherein are couches raised
tr.22: Therein will be Thrones (of dignity), raised on high,
tr.203: Therein will be thrones raised high.

88.en: And cups put in place

tr.85: goblets placed before them,
tr.19: And goblets set at hand
tr.22: Goblets placed (ready),
tr.203: And cups set at hand.

88.en: And cushions lined up

tr.85: cushions set in rows,
tr.19: And cushions ranged
tr.22: And cushions set in rows,
tr.203: And cushions set in rows.

88.en: And carpets spread around.

tr.85: and carpets spread.
tr.19: And silken carpets spread.
tr.22: And rich carpets (all) spread out.
tr.203: And rich carpets (all) spread out.

88.ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
88.en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
88.tl: afalā yanẓurūna ilā l-ibili kayfa khuliqat

tr.85: Do the disbelievers not see how rain clouds are formed
tr.19: Will they not regard the camels, how they are created?
tr.22: Do they not look at the Camels, how they are made?-
tr.203: Do they not look at the camels, how they are created?

88.en: And at the sky - how it is raised?

tr.85: how the heavens are lifted,
tr.19: And the heaven, how it is raised?
tr.22: And at the Sky, how it is raised high?-
tr.203: And at the heaven, how it is raised?

88.en: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

tr.85: how the mountains are raised high,
tr.19: And the hills, how they are set up?
tr.22: And at the Mountains, how they are fixed firm?-
tr.203: And at the mountains, how they are rooted (and fixed firm)?

88.en: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

tr.85: how the earth is spread out?
tr.19: And the earth, how it is spread?
tr.22: And at the Earth, how it is spread out?
tr.203: And at the earth, how it is outspread?

88.en: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.

tr.85: So [Prophet] warn them: your only task is to give warning,
tr.19: Remind them, for thou art but a remembrancer,
tr.22: Therefore do thou give admonition, for thou art one to admonish.
tr.203: So remind them (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) - you are only one who reminds.

88.en: You are not over them a controller.

tr.85: you are not there to control them.
tr.19: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
tr.22: Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
tr.203: You are not a dictator over them -

88.en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves

tr.85: As for those who turn away and disbelieve,
tr.19: But whoso is averse and disbelieveth,
tr.22: But if any turn away and reject Allah,-
tr.203: Save the one who turns away and disbelieves.

88.en: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

tr.85: God will inflict the greatest torment upon them.
tr.19: Allah will punish him with direst punishment.
tr.22: Allah will punish him with a mighty Punishment,
tr.203: Then Allâh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

88.en: Indeed, to Us is their return.

tr.85: It is to Us they will return,
tr.19: Lo! unto Us is their return
tr.22: For to Us will be their return;
tr.203: Verily, to Us will be their return;

88.en: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

tr.85: and then it is for Us to call them to account.
tr.19: And Ours their reckoning.
tr.22: Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
tr.203: Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.

89.en: By the dawn

tr.85: By the Daybreak,
tr.19: By the Dawn
tr.22: By the break of Day
tr.203: By the dawn;

89.en: And [by] ten nights

tr.85: by the Ten Nights,
tr.19: And ten nights,
tr.22: By the Nights twice five;
tr.203: By the ten nights (i.e. the first ten days of the month of Dhul-Hijjah),

89.en: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

tr.85: by the even and the odd,
tr.19: And the Even and the Odd,
tr.22: By the even and odd (contrasted);
tr.203: And by the even and the odd (of all the creations of Allâh).

89.en: And [by] the night when it passes,

tr.85: by the passing night––
tr.19: And the night when it departeth,
tr.22: And by the Night when it passeth away;-
tr.203: And by the night when it departs.

89.ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
89.en: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
89.tl: hal fī dhālika qasamun lidhī ḥij'rin

tr.85: is this oath strong enough for a rational person?
tr.19: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
tr.22: Is there (not) in these an adjuration (or evidence) for those who understand?
tr.203: There is indeed in them (the above oaths) sufficient proofs for men of understanding (and that, they should avoid all kinds of sins and disbeliefs)!

89.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
89.en: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -
89.tl: alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka biʿādin

tr.85: Have you [Prophet] considered how your Lord dealt with [the people] of 'Ad,
tr.19: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
tr.22: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the 'Ad (people),-
tr.203: Saw you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not how your Lord dealt with ‘Âd (people)

89.en: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

tr.85: of Iram, [the city] of lofty pillars,
tr.19: With many-columned Iram,
tr.22: Of the (city of) Iram, with lofty pillars,
tr.203: Of Iram (who were very tall) like (lofty) pillars,

89.ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
89.en: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
89.tl: allatī lam yukh'laq mith'luhā fī l-bilādi

tr.85: whose like has never been made in any land,
tr.19: The like of which was not created in the lands;
tr.22: The like of which were not produced in (all) the land?
tr.203: The like of which were not created in the land?

89.en: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

tr.85: and the Thamud, who hewed into the rocks in the valley,
tr.19: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
tr.22: And with the Thamud (people), who cut out (huge) rocks in the valley?-
tr.203: And (with) Thamûd (people), who hewed out rocks in the valley (to make dwellings)?

89.en: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?

tr.85: and the mighty and powerful Pharaoh?
tr.19: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
tr.22: And with Pharaoh, lord of stakes?
tr.203: And (with) Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) who had the stakes (to torture men by binding them to the stakes)?

89.en: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

tr.85: All of them committed excesses in their lands,
tr.19: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
tr.22: (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
tr.203: Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allâh).

89.en: And increased therein the corruption.

tr.85: and spread corruption there:
tr.19: And multiplied iniquity therein?
tr.22: And heaped therein mischief (on mischief).
tr.203: And made therein much mischief.

89.en: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

tr.85: your Lord let a scourge of punishment loose on them.
tr.19: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
tr.22: Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
tr.203: So your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.

89.en: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

tr.85: Your Lord is always watchful.
tr.19: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
tr.22: For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
tr.203: Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them).

89.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
89.en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
89.tl: fa-ammā l-insānu idhā mā ib'talāhu rabbuhu fa-akramahu wanaʿʿamahu fayaqūlu rabbī akramani

tr.85: [The nature of] man is that, when his Lord tries him through honour and blessings, he says, ‘My Lord has honoured me,’
tr.19: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
tr.22: Now, as for man, when his Lord trieth him, giving him honour and gifts, then saith he, (puffed up), "My Lord hath honoured me."
tr.203: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and bounties, then he says (in exultation): "My Lord has honoured me."

89.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
89.en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
89.tl: wa-ammā idhā mā ib'talāhu faqadara ʿalayhi riz'qahu fayaqūlu rabbī ahānani

tr.85: but when He tries him through the restriction of his provision, he says, ‘My Lord has humiliated me.’
tr.19: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
tr.22: But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
tr.203: But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"

89.en: No! But you do not honor the orphan

tr.85: No indeed! You [people] do not honour orphans,
tr.19: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
tr.22: Nay, nay! but ye honour not the orphans!
tr.203: Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity (i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)!

89.en: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

tr.85: you do not urge one another to feed the poor,
tr.19: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
tr.22: Nor do ye encourage one another to feed the poor!-
tr.203: And urge not one another on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor)!

89.en: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,

tr.85: you consume inheritance greedily,
tr.19: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
tr.22: And ye devour inheritance - all with greed,
tr.203: And you devour the inheritance all with greed.

89.en: And you love wealth with immense love.

tr.85: and you love wealth with a passion.
tr.19: And love wealth with abounding love.
tr.22: And ye love wealth with inordinate love!
tr.203: And you love wealth with much love.

89.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
89.en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed
89.tl: kallā idhā dukkati l-arḍu dakkan dakkan

tr.85: No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust, pounded and pounded,
tr.19: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
tr.22: Nay! When the earth is pounded to powder,
tr.203: Nay! When the earth is ground to powder.

89.en: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

tr.85: when your Lord comes with the angels, rank upon rank,
tr.19: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
tr.22: And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
tr.203: And your Lord comes with the angels in rows.

89.ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
89.en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?
89.tl: wajīa yawma-idhin bijahannama yawma-idhin yatadhakkaru l-insānu wa-annā lahu l-dhik'rā

tr.85: when Hell is that Day brought near- on that Day man will take heed, but what good will that be to him then?
tr.19: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
tr.22: And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
tr.203: And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him?

89.en: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

tr.85: He will say, ‘Would that I had provided for this life to come!’
tr.19: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
tr.22: He will say: "Ah! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my (Future) Life!"
tr.203: He will say: "Alas! Would that I had sent forth (good deeds) for (this) my life!"

89.en: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

tr.85: On that Day, no one will punish as He punishes,
tr.19: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
tr.22: For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
tr.203: So on that Day none will punish as He will punish.

89.en: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

tr.85: and no one will bind as He binds.
tr.19: None bindeth as He then will bind.
tr.22: And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
tr.203: And none will bind (the wicked, disbelievers and polytheists) as He will bind.

89.en: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

tr.85: ‘[But] you, soul at peace:
tr.19: But ah! thou soul at peace!
tr.22: (To the righteous soul will be said:) "O (thou) soul, in (complete) rest and satisfaction!
tr.203: (It will be said to the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism): "O (you) the one in (complete) rest and satisfaction!

89.en: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

tr.85: return to your Lord well pleased and well pleasing;
tr.19: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
tr.22: "Come back thou to thy Lord,- well pleased (thyself), and well-pleasing unto Him!
tr.203: "Come back to your Lord well-pleased (yourself) and well-pleasing (unto Him)!

89.en: And enter among My [righteous] servants

tr.85: go in among My servants;
tr.19: Enter thou among My bondmen!
tr.22: "Enter thou, then, among My devotees!
tr.203: "Enter you then among My (honoured) slaves,

89.en: And enter My Paradise."

tr.85: and into My Garden.’
tr.19: Enter thou My Garden!
tr.22: "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!
tr.203: "And enter you My Paradise!"

90.en: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah]

tr.85: I swear by this city––
tr.19: Nay, I swear by this city -
tr.22: I do call to witness this City;-
tr.203: I swear by this city (Makkah);

90.en: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city

tr.85: and you [Prophet] are an inhabitant of this city––
tr.19: And thou art an indweller of this city -
tr.22: And thou art a freeman of this City;-
tr.203: And you are free (from sin, and to punish the enemies of Islâm on the Day of the conquest) in this city (Makkah).

90.en: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

tr.85: [I swear] by parent and offspring,
tr.19: And the begetter and that which he begat,
tr.22: And (the mystic ties of) parent and child;-
tr.203: And by the begetter (i.e. Adam عليه السلام) and that which he begot (i.e. his progeny).

90.en: We have certainly created man into hardship.

tr.85: that We have created man for toil and trial.
tr.19: We verily have created man in an atmosphere:
tr.22: Verily We have created man into toil and struggle.
tr.203: Verily, We have created man in toil.

90.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
90.en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
90.tl: ayaḥsabu an lan yaqdira ʿalayhi aḥadun

tr.85: Does he think that no one will have power over him?
tr.19: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
tr.22: Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
tr.203: Does he think that none can overcome him?

90.en: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

tr.85: ‘I have squandered great wealth,’ he says.
tr.19: And he saith: I have destroyed vast wealth:
tr.22: He may say (boastfully); Wealth have I squandered in abundance!
tr.203: He says (boastfully): "I have wasted wealth in abundance!"

90.en: Does he think that no one has seen him?

tr.85: Does he think no one observes him?
tr.19: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
tr.22: Thinketh he that none beholdeth him?
tr.203: Does he think that none sees him?

90.en: Have We not made for him two eyes?

tr.85: Did We not give him eyes,
tr.19: Did We not assign unto him two eyes
tr.22: Have We not made for him a pair of eyes?-
tr.203: Have We not made for him two eyes,

90.en: And a tongue and two lips?

tr.85: a tongue, lips,
tr.19: And a tongue and two lips,
tr.22: And a tongue, and a pair of lips?-
tr.203: And a tongue and two lips?

90.en: And have shown him the two ways?

tr.85: and point out to him the two clear ways [of good and evil]?
tr.19: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
tr.22: And shown him the two highways?
tr.203: And shown him the two ways (good and evil)?

90.en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

tr.85: Yet he has not attempted the steep path.
tr.19: But he hath not attempted the Ascent -
tr.22: But he hath made no haste on the path that is steep.
tr.203: But he has not attempted to pass on the path that is steep (i.e. the path which will lead to goodness and success).

90.en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the steep path is?
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Ascent is! -
tr.22: And what will explain to thee the path that is steep?-
tr.203: And what will make you know the path that is steep?

90.en: It is the freeing of a slave

tr.85: It is to free a slave,
tr.19: (It is) to free a slave,
tr.22: (It is:) freeing the bondman;
tr.203: (It is) freeing a neck (slave)

90.ar: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
90.en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
90.tl: aw iṭ'ʿāmun fī yawmin dhī masghabatin

tr.85: to feed at a time of hunger
tr.19: And to feed in the day of hunger.
tr.22: Or the giving of food in a day of privation
tr.203: Or giving food in a day of hunger (famine),

90.en: An orphan of near relationship

tr.85: an orphaned relative
tr.19: An orphan near of kin,
tr.22: To the orphan with claims of relationship,
tr.203: To an orphan near of kin.

90.en: Or a needy person in misery

tr.85: or a poor person in distress,
tr.19: Or some poor wretch in misery,
tr.22: Or to the indigent (down) in the dust.
tr.203: Or to a Miskîn (poor) cleaving to dust (out of misery).

90.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
90.en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
90.tl: thumma kāna mina alladhīna āmanū watawāṣaw bil-ṣabri watawāṣaw bil-marḥamati

tr.85: and to be one of those who believe and urge one another to steadfastness and compassion.
tr.19: And to be of those who believe and exhort one another to perseverance and exhort one another to pity.
tr.22: Then will he be of those who believe, and enjoin patience, (constancy, and self-restraint), and enjoin deeds of kindness and compassion.
tr.203: Then he became one of those who believed (in the Islamic Monotheism) and recommended one another to perseverance and patience, and (also) recommended one another to pity and compassion.

90.en: Those are the companions of the right.

tr.85: Those who do this will be on the right-hand side,
tr.19: Their place will be on the right hand.
tr.22: Such are the Companions of the Right Hand.
tr.203: They are those on the Right Hand (i.e. the dwellers of Paradise),

90.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
90.en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
90.tl: wa-alladhīna kafarū biāyātinā hum aṣḥābu l-mashamati

tr.85: but those who disbelieve in Our revelations will be on the left-hand side,
tr.19: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
tr.22: But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
tr.203: But those who disbelieved in Our Ayât (proofs, evidence, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).

90.en: Over them will be fire closed in.

tr.85: and the Fire will close in on them.
tr.19: Fire will be an awning over them.
tr.22: On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
tr.203: The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.

91.en: By the sun and its brightness

tr.85: By the sun in its morning brightness
tr.19: By the sun and his brightness,
tr.22: By the Sun and his (glorious) splendour;
tr.203: By the sun and its brightness.

91.en: And [by] the moon when it follows it

tr.85: and by the moon as it follows it,
tr.19: And the moon when she followeth him,
tr.22: By the Moon as she follows him;
tr.203: By the moon as it follows it (the sun).

91.en: And [by] the day when it displays it

tr.85: by the day as it displays the sun’s glory
tr.19: And the day when it revealeth him,
tr.22: By the Day as it shows up (the Sun's) glory;
tr.203: By the day as it shows up (the sun’s) brightness.

91.en: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it

tr.85: and by the night as it conceals it,
tr.19: And the night when it enshroudeth him,
tr.22: By the Night as it conceals it;
tr.203: By the night as it conceals it (the sun).

91.en: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

tr.85: by the sky and how He built it
tr.19: And the heaven and Him Who built it,
tr.22: By the Firmament and its (wonderful) structure;
tr.203: By the heaven and Him Who built it.

91.en: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

tr.85: and by the earth and how He spread it,
tr.19: And the earth and Him Who spread it,
tr.22: By the Earth and its (wide) expanse:
tr.203: By the earth and Him Who spread it.

91.en: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

tr.85: by the soul and how He formed it
tr.19: And a soul and Him Who perfected it
tr.22: By the Soul, and the proportion and order given to it;
tr.203: By Nafs (Adam or a person or a soul), and Him Who perfected him in proportion;

91.en: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,

tr.85: and inspired it [to know] its own rebellion and piety!
tr.19: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
tr.22: And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
tr.203: Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him.

91.en: He has succeeded who purifies it,

tr.85: The one who purifies his soul succeeds
tr.19: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
tr.22: Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
tr.203: Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself (i.e. obeys and performs all that Allâh ordered, by following the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds).

91.en: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].

tr.85: and the one who corrupts it fails.
tr.19: And he is indeed a failure who stunteth it.
tr.22: And he fails that corrupts it!
tr.203: And indeed he fails who corrupts his ownself (i.e. disobeys what Allâh has ordered by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism or by following polytheism or by doing every kind of evil wicked deeds).

91.en: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,

tr.85: In their arrogant cruelty, the people of Thamud called [their messenger] a liar,
tr.19: (The tribe of) Thamud denied (the truth) in their rebellious pride,
tr.22: The Thamud (people) rejected (their prophet) through their inordinate wrong-doing,
tr.203: Thamûd (people) denied (their Prophet) through their transgression (by rejecting the true Faith of Islâmic Monotheism, and by following polytheism, and by committing every kind of sin).

91.en: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.

tr.85: when the most wicked man among them rose [against him].
tr.19: When the basest of them broke forth
tr.22: Behold, the most wicked man among them was deputed (for impiety).
tr.203: When the most wicked man among them went forth (to kill the she-camel).

91.ar: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَـٰهَا
91.en: And the messenger of Allāh [i.e., Ṣāliḥ] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allāh or [prevent her from] her drink."
91.tl: faqāla lahum rasūlu l-lahi nāqata l-lahi wasuq'yāhā

tr.85: The messenger of God said to them, ‘[Leave] God’s camel to drink,’
tr.19: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
tr.22: But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
tr.203: But the Messenger of Allâh [Sâlih عليه السلام] said to them: "Be cautious! (Fear the evil end). That is the she-camel of Allâh! (Do not harm it) and bar it not from having its drink!"

91.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
91.en: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
91.tl: fakadhabūhu faʿaqarūhā fadamdama ʿalayhim rabbuhum bidhanbihim fasawwāhā

tr.85: but they called him a liar and hamstrung her. Their Lord destroyed them for their crime and levelled them.
tr.19: But they denied him, and they hamstrung her, so Allah doomed them for their sin and rased (their dwellings).
tr.22: Then they rejected him (as a false prophet), and they hamstrung her. So their Lord, on account of their crime, obliterated their traces and made them equal (in destruction, high and low)!
tr.203: Then they denied him and they killed it. So their Lord destroyed them because of their sin, and made them equal in destruction (i.e. all grades of people, rich and poor, strong and weak, etc.)!

91.en: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

tr.85: He did not hesitate to punish them.
tr.19: He dreadeth not the sequel (of events).
tr.22: And for Him is no fear of its consequences.
tr.203: And He (Allâh) feared not the consequences thereof.

92.en: By the night when it covers

tr.85: By the enshrouding night,
tr.19: By the night enshrouding
tr.22: By the Night as it conceals (the light);
tr.203: By the night as it envelops.

92.en: And [by] the day when it appears

tr.85: by the radiant day,
tr.19: And the day resplendent
tr.22: By the Day as it appears in glory;
tr.203: By the day as it appears in brightness.

92.en: And [by] He who created the male and female,

tr.85: by His creation of male and female!
tr.19: And Him Who hath created male and female,
tr.22: By (the mystery of) the creation of male and female;-
tr.203: By Him Who created male and female.

92.en: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.

tr.85: The ways you take differ greatly.
tr.19: Lo! your effort is dispersed (toward divers ends).
tr.22: Verily, (the ends) ye strive for are diverse.
tr.203: Certainly, your efforts and deeds are diverse (different in aims and purposes);

92.en: As for he who gives and fears Allāh

tr.85: There is the one who gives, who is mindful of God,
tr.19: As for him who giveth and is dutiful (toward Allah)
tr.22: So he who gives (in charity) and fears (Allah),
tr.203: As for him who gives (in charity) and keeps his duty to Allâh and fears Him,

92.en: And believes in the best [reward],

tr.85: who testifies to goodness––
tr.19: And believeth in goodness;
tr.22: And (in all sincerity) testifies to the best,-
tr.203: And believes in Al-Husnâ.

92.en: We will ease him toward ease.

tr.85: We shall smooth his way towards ease.
tr.19: Surely We will ease his way unto the state of ease.
tr.22: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Bliss.
tr.203: We will make smooth for him the path of ease (goodness).

92.en: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need

tr.85: There is the one who is miserly, who is self-satisfied,
tr.19: But as for him who hoardeth and deemeth himself independent,
tr.22: But he who is a greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient,
tr.203: But he who is greedy miser and thinks himself self-sufficient.

92.en: And denies the best [reward],

tr.85: who denies goodness––
tr.19: And disbelieveth in goodness;
tr.22: And gives the lie to the best,-
tr.203: And belies Al-Husnâ (See the footnote of the Verse No.6)

92.en: We will ease him toward difficulty.

tr.85: We shall smooth his way towards hardship
tr.19: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
tr.22: We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
tr.203: We will make smooth for him the path for evil.

92.ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
92.en: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
92.tl: wamā yugh'nī ʿanhu māluhu idhā taraddā

tr.85: and his wealth will not help him as he falls.
tr.19: His riches will not save him when he perisheth.
tr.22: Nor will his wealth profit him when he falls headlong (into the Pit).
tr.203: And what will his wealth avail him when he goes down (in destruction)?.

92.en: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.

tr.85: Our part is to provide guidance––
tr.19: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
tr.22: Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
tr.203: Truly! On Us is (to give) guidance.

92.en: And indeed, to us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

tr.85: this world and the next belong to Us––
tr.19: And lo! unto Us belong the latter portion and the former.
tr.22: And verily unto Us (belong) the End and the Beginning.
tr.203: And truly, unto Us (belong) the last (Hereafter) and the first (this world).

92.en: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.

tr.85: so I warn you about the raging Fire,
tr.19: Therefor have I warned you of the flaming Fire
tr.22: Therefore do I warn you of a Fire blazing fiercely;
tr.203: Therefore I have warned you of a blazing Fire (Hell).

92.en: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one

tr.85: in which none but the most wicked one will burn,
tr.19: Which only the most wretched must endure,
tr.22: None shall reach it but those most unfortunate ones
tr.203: None shall enter it save the most wretched.

92.en: Who had denied and turned away.

tr.85: who denied [the truth], and turned away.
tr.19: He who denieth and turneth away.
tr.22: Who give the lie to Truth and turn their backs.
tr.203: Who denies and turns away.

92.en: But the righteous one will avoid it

tr.85: The most pious one will be spared this––
tr.19: Far removed from it will be the righteous
tr.22: But those most devoted to Allah shall be removed far from it,-
tr.203: And Al-Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) will be far removed from it (Hell).

92.en: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself

tr.85: who gives his wealth away as self-purification,
tr.19: Who giveth his wealth that he may grow (in goodness).
tr.22: Those who spend their wealth for increase in self-purification,
tr.203: He who spends his wealth for increase in self-purification,

92.ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ
92.en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
92.tl: wamā li-aḥadin ʿindahu min niʿ'matin tuj'zā

tr.85: not to return a favour to anyone
tr.19: And none hath with him any favour for reward,
tr.22: And have in their minds no favour from anyone for which a reward is expected in return,
tr.203: And who has (in mind) no favour from anyone to be paid back,

92.en: But only seeking the face [i.e., acceptance] of his Lord, Most High.

tr.85: but for the sake of his Lord the Most High––
tr.19: Except as seeking (to fulfil) the purpose of his Lord Most High.
tr.22: But only the desire to seek for the Countenance of their Lord Most High;
tr.203: Except to seek the Countenance of his Lord, the Most High.

92.en: And he is going to be satisfied.

tr.85: and he will be well pleased.
tr.19: He verily will be content.
tr.22: And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
tr.203: He surely will be pleased (when he enters Paradise).

tr.85: By the morning brightness
tr.19: By the morning hours
tr.22: By the Glorious Morning Light,
tr.203: By the forenoon (after sunrise).

93.en: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

tr.85: and by the night when it grows still,
tr.19: And by the night when it is stillest,
tr.22: And by the Night when it is still,-
tr.203: By the night when it darkens (and stand still).

93.en: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muḥammad], nor has He detested [you].

tr.85: your Lord has not forsaken you [Prophet], nor does He hate you,
tr.19: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee nor doth He hate thee,
tr.22: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
tr.203: Your Lord (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has neither forsaken you nor hates you.

93.en: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

tr.85: and the future will be better for you than the past;
tr.19: And verily the latter portion will be better for thee than the former,
tr.22: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
tr.203: And indeed the Hereafter is better for you than the present (life of this world).

93.en: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

tr.85: your Lord is sure to give you so much that you will be well satisfied.
tr.19: And verily thy Lord will give unto thee so that thou wilt be content.
tr.22: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
tr.203: And verily, your Lord will give you (all good) so that you shall be well-pleased.

93.en: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

tr.85: Did He not find you an orphan and shelter you?
tr.19: Did He not find thee an orphan and protect (thee)?
