tr.22: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
tr.203: Did He not find you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) an orphan and gave you a refuge?

93.en: And He found you lost and guided [you],

tr.85: Did He not find you lost and guide you?
tr.19: Did He not find thee wandering and direct (thee)?
tr.22: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
tr.203: And He found you unaware (of the Qur’ân, its laws, and Prophethood) and guided you?

93.en: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

tr.85: Did He not find you in need and make you self-sufficient?
tr.19: Did He not find thee destitute and enrich (thee)?
tr.22: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
tr.203: And He found you poor and made you rich (self-sufficient with self-contentment)?

93.en: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

tr.85: So do not be harsh with the orphan
tr.19: Therefor the orphan oppress not,
tr.22: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
tr.203: Therefore, treat not the orphan with oppression.

93.en: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

tr.85: and do not chide the one who asks for help;
tr.19: Therefor the beggar drive not away,
tr.22: Nor repulse the petitioner (unheard);
tr.203: And repulse not the beggar.

93.en: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].

tr.85: talk about the blessings of your Lord.
tr.19: Therefor of the bounty of thy Lord be thy discourse.
tr.22: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
tr.203: And proclaim the Grace of your Lord (i.e. the Prophethood and all other Graces).

94.en: Did We not expand for you, [O Muḥammad], your breast?

tr.85: Did We not relieve your heart for you [Prophet],
tr.19: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
tr.22: Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
tr.203: Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)?

94.en: And We removed from you your burden

tr.85: and remove the burden
tr.19: And eased thee of the burden
tr.22: And removed from thee thy burden
tr.203: And removed from you your burden.

94.en: Which had weighed upon your back

tr.85: that weighed so heavily on your back,
tr.19: Which weighed down thy back;
tr.22: The which did gall thy back?-
tr.203: Which weighed down your back?

94.en: And raised high for you your repute.

tr.85: and raise your reputation high?
tr.19: And exalted thy fame?
tr.22: And raised high the esteem (in which) thou (art held)?
tr.203: And have We not raised high your fame?

94.en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].

tr.85: So truly where there is hardship there is also ease;
tr.19: But lo! with hardship goeth ease,
tr.22: So, verily, with every difficulty, there is relief:
tr.203: Verily, along with every hardship is relief,

tr.85: truly where there is hardship there is also ease.
tr.19: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;
tr.22: Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
tr.203: Verily, along with every hardship is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).

94.en: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].

tr.85: The moment you are freed [of one task] work on,
tr.19: So when thou art relieved, still toil
tr.22: Therefore, when thou art free (from thine immediate task), still labour hard,
tr.203: So when you have finished (your occupation), devote yourself for Allâh’s worship.

94.en: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.

tr.85: and turn to your Lord for everything.
tr.19: And strive to please thy Lord.
tr.22: And to thy Lord turn (all) thy attention.
tr.203: And to your Lord (Alone) turn (all your) intentions and hopes.

95.en: By the fig and the olive

tr.85: By the fig, by the olive,
tr.19: By the fig and the olive,
tr.22: By the Fig and the Olive,
tr.203: By the fig, and the olive.

tr.85: by Mount Sinai,
tr.19: By Mount Sinai,
tr.22: And the Mount of Sinai,
tr.203: By Mount Sinai.

tr.85: by this safe town,
tr.19: And by this land made safe;
tr.22: And this City of security,-
tr.203: By this city of security (Makkah).

95.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
95.en: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
95.tl: laqad khalaqnā l-insāna fī aḥsani taqwīmin

tr.85: We create man in the finest state
tr.19: Surely We created man of the best stature
tr.22: We have indeed created man in the best of moulds,
tr.203: Verily, We created man in the best stature (mould).

95.en: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,

tr.85: then reduce him to the lowest of the low,
tr.19: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low,
tr.22: Then do We abase him (to be) the lowest of the low,-
tr.203: Then We reduced him to the lowest of the low.

95.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
95.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
95.tl: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti falahum ajrun ghayru mamnūnin

tr.85: except those who believe and do good deeds–– they will have an unfailing reward.
tr.19: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing.
tr.22: Except such as believe and do righteous deeds: For they shall have a reward unfailing.
tr.203: Save those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds. Then they shall have a reward without end (Paradise).

95.en: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?

tr.85: After this, what makes you [man] deny the Judgement?
tr.19: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment?
tr.22: Then what can, after this, contradict thee, as to the judgment (to come)?
tr.203: Then what (or who) causes you (O disbelievers) to deny the Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)?

95.en: Is not Allāh the most just of judges?

tr.85: Is God not the most decisive of judges?
tr.19: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges?
tr.22: Is not Allah the wisest of judges?
tr.203: Is not Allâh the Best of judges?

96.en: Recite in the name of your Lord who created

tr.85: Read! In the name of your Lord who created:
tr.19: Read: In the name of thy Lord Who createth,
tr.22: Proclaim! (or read!) in the name of thy Lord and Cherisher, Who created-
tr.203: Read! In the Name of your Lord Who has created (all that exists).

96.en: Created man from a clinging substance.

tr.85: He created manfrom a clinging form.
tr.19: Createth man from a clot.
tr.22: Created man, out of a (mere) clot of congealed blood:
tr.203: He has created man from a clot (a piece of thick coagulated blood).

96.en: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -

tr.85: Read! Your Lord is the Most Bountiful One
tr.19: Read: And thy Lord is the Most Bounteous,
tr.22: Proclaim! And thy Lord is Most Bountiful,-
tr.203: Read! And your Lord is the Most Generous.

tr.85: who taught by [means of] the pen,
tr.19: Who teacheth by the pen,
tr.22: He Who taught (the use of) the pen,-
tr.203: Who has taught (the writing) by the pen.

96.en: Taught man that which he knew not.

tr.85: who taught man what he did not know.
tr.19: Teacheth man that which he knew not.
tr.22: Taught man that which he knew not.
tr.203: He has taught man that which he knew not.

tr.85: But man exceeds all bounds
tr.19: Nay, but verily man is rebellious
tr.22: Nay, but man doth transgress all bounds,
tr.203: Nay! Verily, man does transgress (in disbelief and evil deed).

tr.85: when he thinks he is self-sufficient:
tr.19: That he thinketh himself independent!
tr.22: In that he looketh upon himself as self-sufficient.
tr.203: Because he considers himself self-sufficient.

96.en: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.

tr.85: [Prophet], all will return to your Lord.
tr.19: Lo! unto thy Lord is the return.
tr.22: Verily, to thy Lord is the return (of all).
tr.203: Surely, unto your Lord is the return.

96.en: Have you seen the one who forbids

tr.85: Have you seen the man who forbids
tr.19: Hast thou seen him who dissuadeth
tr.22: Seest thou one who forbids-
tr.203: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) seen him (i.e. Abû Jahl) who prevents

tr.85: [Our] servant to pray?
tr.19: A slave when he prayeth?
tr.22: A votary when he (turns) to pray?
tr.203: A slave (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) when he prays?

96.en: Have you seen if he is upon guidance

tr.85: Have you seen whether he is rightly guided,
tr.19: Hast thou seen if he relieth on the guidance (of Allah)
tr.22: Seest thou if he is on (the road of) Guidance?-
tr.203: Tell me if he (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is on the guidance (of Allâh)

tr.85: or encourages true piety?
tr.19: Or enjoineth piety?
tr.22: Or enjoins Righteousness?
tr.203: Or enjoins piety!

96.en: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -

tr.85: Have you seen whether he denies the truth and turns away from it?
tr.19: Hast thou seen if he denieth (Allah's guidance) and is froward?
tr.22: Seest thou if he denies (Truth) and turns away?
tr.203: Tell me if he (Abû Jahl) denies (the truth, i.e. this Qur’ân) and turns away?

96.en: Does he not know that Allāh sees?

tr.85: Does he not realize that God sees all?
tr.19: Is he then unaware that Allah seeth?
tr.22: Knoweth he not that Allah doth see?
tr.203: Knows he not that Allâh does see (what he does)?

96.ar: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
96.en: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock
96.tl: kallā la-in lam yantahi lanasfaʿan bil-nāṣiyati

tr.85: No! If he does not stop, We shall drag him by his forehead––
tr.19: Nay, but if he cease not We will seize him by the forelock -
tr.22: Let him beware! If he desist not, We will drag him by the forelock,-
tr.203: Nay! If he (Abû Jahl) ceases not, We will catch him by the forelock -

tr.85: his lying, sinful forehead.
tr.19: The lying, sinful forelock -
tr.22: A lying, sinful forelock!
tr.203: A lying, sinful forelock!

96.en: Then let him call his associates;

tr.85: Let him summon his comrades;
tr.19: Then let him call upon his henchmen!
tr.22: Then, let him call (for help) to his council (of comrades):
tr.203: Then let him call upon his council (of helpers).

96.en: We will call the angels of Hell.

tr.85: We shall summon the guards of Hell.
tr.19: We will call the guards of hell.
tr.22: We will call on the angels of punishment (to deal with him)!
tr.203: We will call out the guards of Hell (to deal with him)!

96.en: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allāh].

tr.85: No! Do not obey him [Prophet]: bow down in worship and draw close.
tr.19: Nay, Obey not thou him. But prostrate thyself, and draw near (unto Allah).
tr.22: Nay, heed him not: But bow down in adoration, and bring thyself the closer (to Allah)!
tr.203: Nay! (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)! Do not obey him (Abû Jahl). Fall prostrate and draw near to Allâh!

97.en: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.

tr.85: We sent it down on the Night of Glory.
tr.19: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination.
tr.22: We have indeed revealed this (Message) in the Night of Power:
tr.203: Verily, We have sent it (this Qur’ân) down in the night of Al-Qadr (Decree).

97.en: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

tr.85: What will explain to you what that Night of Glory is?
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is!
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what the night of power is?
tr.203: And what will make you know what the night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is?

97.ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
97.en: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
97.tl: laylatu l-qadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

tr.85: The Night of Glory is better than a thousand months;
tr.19: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
tr.22: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
tr.203: The night of Al-Qadr (Decree) is better than a thousand months (i.e. worshipping Allâh in that night is better than worshipping Him a thousand months, i.e. 83 years and 4 months).

97.ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
97.en: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
97.tl: tanazzalu l-malāikatu wal-rūḥu fīhā bi-idh'ni rabbihim min kulli amrin

tr.85: on that night the angels and the Spirit descend again and again with their Lord’s permission on every task;
tr.19: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees.
tr.22: Therein come down the angels and the Spirit by Allah's permission, on every errand:
tr.203: Therein descend the angels and the Rûh [Jibrîl (Gabrîl)] by Allâh’s Permission with all Decrees,

97.en: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.

tr.85: [there is] peace that night until the break of dawn.
tr.19: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn.
tr.22: Peace!... This until the rise of morn!
tr.203: (All that night), there is Peace (and Goodness from Allâh to His believing slaves) until the appearance of dawn.

98.ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
98.en: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence
98.tl: lam yakuni alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna munfakkīna ḥattā tatiyahumu l-bayinatu

tr.85: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters were not about to change their ways until they were sent clear evidence,
tr.19: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters could not have left off (erring) till the clear proof came unto them,
tr.22: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, were not going to depart (from their ways) until there should come to them Clear Evidence,-
tr.203: Those who disbelieve from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn, were not going to leave (their disbelief) until there came to them clear evidence.

98.ar: رَسُولٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًا مُّطَهَّرَةً
98.en: A Messenger from Allāh, reciting purified scriptures
98.tl: rasūlun mina l-lahi yatlū ṣuḥufan muṭahharatan

tr.85: a messenger from God, reading out pages [blessed with] purity,
tr.19: A messenger from Allah, reading purified pages
tr.22: An messenger from Allah, rehearsing scriptures kept pure and holy:
tr.203: A Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from Allâh, reciting (the Qur’ân) purified pages [purified from Al-Bâtil (falsehood)].

98.en: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].

tr.85: containing true scriptures.
tr.19: Containing correct scriptures.
tr.22: Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.
tr.203: Wherein are correct and straight laws from Allâh.

98.ar: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
98.en: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
98.tl: wamā tafarraqa alladhīna ūtū l-kitāba illā min baʿdi mā jāathumu l-bayinatu

tr.85: [Yet] those who were given the Scripture became divided only after they were sent [such] clear evi-dence
tr.19: Nor were the People of the Scripture divided until after the clear proof came unto them.
tr.22: Nor did the People of the Book make schisms, until after there came to them Clear Evidence.
tr.203: And the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) differed not until after there came to them clear evidence (i.e. Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم and whatever was revealed to him).

98.ar: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
98.en: And they were not commanded except to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.
98.tl: wamā umirū illā liyaʿbudū l-laha mukh'liṣīna lahu l-dīna ḥunafāa wayuqīmū l-ṣalata wayu'tū l-zakata wadhālika dīnu l-qayimati

tr.85: though all they are ordered to do is worship God alone, sincerely devoting their religion to Him as people of true faith, keep up the prayer, and pay the prescribed alms, for that is the true religion.
tr.19: And they are ordered naught else than to serve Allah, keeping religion pure for Him, as men by nature upright, and to establish worship and to pay the poor-due. That is true religion.
tr.22: And they have been commanded no more than this: To worship Allah, offering Him sincere devotion, being true (in faith); to establish regular prayer; and to practise regular charity; and that is the Religion Right and Straight.
tr.203: And they were commanded not, but that they should worship Allâh, and worship none but Him Alone (abstaining from ascribing partners to Him), and perform As-Salât (Iqâmat-as-Salât) and give Zakât, and that is the right religion.

98.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
98.en: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
98.tl: inna alladhīna kafarū min ahli l-kitābi wal-mush'rikīna fī nāri jahannama khālidīna fīhā ulāika hum sharru l-bariyati

tr.85: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Book and the idolaters will have the Fire of Hell, there to remain. They are the worst of creation.
tr.19: Lo! those who disbelieve, among the People of the Scripture and the idolaters, will abide in fire of hell. They are the worst of created beings.
tr.22: Those who reject (Truth), among the People of the Book and among the Polytheists, will be in Hell-Fire, to dwell therein (for aye). They are the worst of creatures.
tr.203: Verily, those who disbelieve (in the religion of Islâm, the Qur’ân and Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) from among the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) and Al-Mushrikûn will abide in the Fire of Hell. They are the worst of creatures.

98.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
98.en: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
98.tl: inna alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti ulāika hum khayru l-bariyati

tr.85: Those who believe and do good deeds are the best of creation.
tr.19: (And) lo! those who believe and do good works are the best of created beings.
tr.22: Those who have faith and do righteous deeds,- they are the best of creatures.
tr.203: Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allâh, and in His Messenger Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) including all obligations ordered by Islâm] and do righteous good deeds, they are the best of creatures.

98.ar: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
98.en: Their reward with their Lord will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allāh being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
98.tl: jazāuhum ʿinda rabbihim jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā abadan raḍiya l-lahu ʿanhum waraḍū ʿanhu dhālika liman khashiya rabbahu

tr.85: Their reward with their Lord is everlasting Gardens graced with flowing streams, where they will stay forever. God is well pleased with them and they with Him. All this is for those who stand in awe of their Lord.
tr.19: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
tr.22: Their reward is with Allah: Gardens of Eternity, beneath which rivers flow; they will dwell therein for ever; Allah well pleased with them, and they with Him: all this for such as fear their Lord and Cherisher.
tr.203: Their reward with their Lord is ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity), underneath which rivers flow. They will abide therein forever, Allâh will be pleased with them, and they with Him. That is for him who fears his Lord.

99.en: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake

tr.85: When the earth is shaken violently in its [last] quaking,
tr.19: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
tr.22: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
tr.203: When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake.

99.en: And the earth discharges its burdens

tr.85: when the earth throws out its burdens,
tr.19: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
tr.22: And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
tr.203: And when the earth throws out its burdens.

99.en: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -

tr.85: when man cries, ‘What is happening to it?’;
tr.19: And man saith: What aileth her?
tr.22: And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her?'-
tr.203: And man will say: "What is the matter with it?"

99.en: That Day, it will report its news

tr.85: on that Day, it will tell all
tr.19: That day she will relate her chronicles,
tr.22: On that Day will she declare her tidings:
tr.203: That Day it will declare its information (about all that happened over it of good or evil).

99.en: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.

tr.85: because your Lord will inspire it [to do so].
tr.19: Because thy Lord inspireth her.
tr.22: For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration.
tr.203: Because your Lord will inspire it.

99.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
99.en: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
99.tl: yawma-idhin yaṣduru l-nāsu ashtātan liyuraw aʿmālahum

tr.85: On that Day, people will come forward in separate groups to be shown their deeds:
tr.19: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
tr.22: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
tr.203: That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.

99.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
99.en: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
99.tl: faman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin khayran yarahu

tr.85: whoever has done an atom’s-weight of good will see it,
tr.19: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then,
tr.22: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it!
tr.203: So whosoever does good equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it.

99.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
99.en: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
99.tl: waman yaʿmal mith'qāla dharratin sharran yarahu

tr.85: but whoever has done an atom’s-weight of evil will see that.
tr.19: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then.
tr.22: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it.
tr.203: And whosoever does evil equal to the weight of an atom (or a small ant) shall see it.

tr.85: By the charging steeds that pant
tr.19: By the snorting courses,
tr.22: By the (Steeds) that run, with panting (breath),
tr.203: By the (steeds) that run, with panting.

100.en: And the producers of sparks [when] striking

tr.85: and strike sparks with their hooves,
tr.19: Striking sparks of fire
tr.22: And strike sparks of fire,
tr.203: Striking sparks of fire (by their hooves).

tr.85: who make dawn raids,
tr.19: And scouring to the raid at dawn,
tr.22: And push home the charge in the morning,
tr.203: And scouring to the raid at dawn.

tr.85: raising a cloud of dust,
tr.19: Then, therewith, with their trail of dust,
tr.22: And raise the dust in clouds the while,
tr.203: And raise the dust in clouds the while.

100.en: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,

tr.85: and plunging into the midst of the enemy,
tr.19: Cleaving, as one, the centre (of the foe),
tr.22: And penetrate forthwith into the midst (of the foe) en masse;-
tr.203: And penetrating forthwith as one into the midst (of the foe).

100.en: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.

tr.85: man is ungrateful to his Lord––
tr.19: Lo! man is an ingrate unto his Lord
tr.22: Truly man is, to his Lord, ungrateful;
tr.203: Verily, man (disbeliever) is ungrateful to his Lord.

100.en: And indeed, he is to that a witness.

tr.85: and He is witness to this––
tr.19: And lo! he is a witness unto that;
tr.22: And to that (fact) he bears witness (by his deeds);
tr.203: And to that he bears witness (by his deeds).

100.en: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.

tr.85: he is truly excessive in his love of wealth.
tr.19: And lo! in the love of wealth he is violent.
tr.22: And violent is he in his love of wealth.
tr.203: And verily, he is violent in the love of wealth.

100.ar: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
100.en: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
100.tl: afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūri

tr.85: Does he not know that when the contents of graves burst forth,
tr.19: Knoweth he not that, when the contents of the graves are poured forth
tr.22: Does he not know,- when that which is in the graves is scattered abroad
tr.203: Knows he not that when the contents of the graves are poured forth (all mankind is resurrected)?

100.en: And that within the breasts is obtained,

tr.85: when the secrets of hearts are uncovered, on that Day,
tr.19: And the secrets of the breasts are made known,
tr.22: And that which is (locked up) in (human) breasts is made manifest-
tr.203: And that which is in the breasts (of men) is made known?

100.en: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Aware.

tr.85: their Lord will be fully aware of them all?
tr.19: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
tr.22: That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
tr.203: Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds and will reward them for their deeds).

tr.85: The Crashing Blow!
tr.19: The Calamity!
tr.22: The (Day) of Noise and Clamour:
tr.203: Al-Qâri‘ah (the striking Hour i.e. the Day of Resurrection).

tr.85: What is the Crashing Blow?
tr.19: What is the Calamity?
tr.22: What is the (Day) of Noise and Clamour?
tr.203: What is the striking (Hour)?

101.en: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the Crashing Blow is?
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is!
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what the (Day) of Noise and Clamour is?
tr.203: And what will make you know what the striking (Hour) is?

101.en: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,

tr.85: On a Day when people will be like scattered moths
tr.19: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths
tr.22: (It is) a Day whereon men will be like moths scattered about,
tr.203: It is a Day whereon mankind will be like moths scattered about.

101.en: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.

tr.85: and the mountains like tufts of wool,
tr.19: And the mountains will become as carded wool.
tr.22: And the mountains will be like carded wool.
tr.203: And the mountains will be like carded wool.

101.en: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],

tr.85: the one whose good deeds are heavy on the scales
tr.19: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works),
tr.22: Then, he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) heavy,
tr.203: Then as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be heavy,

101.en: He will be in a pleasant life.

tr.85: will have a pleasant life,
tr.19: He will live a pleasant life.
tr.22: Will be in a life of good pleasure and satisfaction.
tr.203: He will live a pleasant life (in Paradise).

101.en: But as for one whose scales are light,

tr.85: but the one whose good deeds are light
tr.19: But as for him whose scales are light,
tr.22: But he whose balance (of good deeds) will be (found) light,-
tr.203: But as for him whose balance (of good deeds) will be light,

101.en: His refuge will be an abyss.

tr.85: will have the Bottomless Pit for his home––
tr.19: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother,
tr.22: Will have his home in a (bottomless) Pit.
tr.203: He will have his home in Hâwiyah (pit, i.e. Hell).

101.en: And what can make you know what that is?

tr.85: what will explain to you what that is?––
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is! -
tr.22: And what will explain to thee what this is?
tr.203: And what will make you know what it is?

101.en: It is a Fire, intensely hot.

tr.85: a blazing fire.
tr.19: Raging Fire.
tr.22: (It is) a Fire Blazing fiercely!
tr.203: (It is) a fiercely blazing Fire!

tr.85: Striving for more distracts you
tr.19: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you
tr.22: The mutual rivalry for piling up (the good things of this world) diverts you (from the more serious things),
tr.203: The mutual rivalry (for piling up of worldly things) diverts you,

tr.85: until you go into your graves.
tr.19: Until ye come to the graves.
tr.22: Until ye visit the graves.
tr.203: Until you visit the graves (i.e. till you die).

102.en: No! You are going to know.

tr.85: No indeed! You will come to know.
tr.19: Nay, but ye will come to know!
tr.22: But nay, ye soon shall know (the reality).
tr.203: Nay! You shall come to know!

102.en: Then, no! You are going to know.

tr.85: No indeed! In the end you will come to know.
tr.19: Nay, but ye will come to know!
tr.22: Again, ye soon shall know!
tr.203: Again nay! You shall come to know!

102.en: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...

tr.85: No indeed! If only you knew for certain.
tr.19: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge!
tr.22: Nay, were ye to know with certainty of mind, (ye would beware!)
tr.203: Nay! If you knew with a sure knowledge (the end result of piling up, you would not have been occupied yourselves in worldly things).

102.en: You will surely see the Hellfire.

tr.85: You will most definitely see Hellfire,
tr.19: For ye will behold hell-fire.
tr.22: Ye shall certainly see Hell-Fire!
tr.203: Verily, You shall see the blazing Fire (Hell)!

102.en: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.

tr.85: you will see it with the eye of certainty.
tr.19: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision.
tr.22: Again, ye shall see it with certainty of sight!
tr.203: And again, you shall see it with certainty of sight!

102.en: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.

tr.85: On that Day, you will be asked about your pleasures.
tr.19: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
tr.22: Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
tr.203: Then on that Day you shall be asked about the delights (you indulged in, in this world)!

tr.85: By the declining day,
tr.19: By the declining day,
tr.22: By (the Token of) Time (through the ages),
tr.203: By Al-‘Asr (the time).

tr.85: man is [deep] in loss,
tr.19: Lo! man is a state of loss,
tr.22: Verily Man is in loss,
tr.203: Verily, man is in loss,

103.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
103.en: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
103.tl: illā alladhīna āmanū waʿamilū l-ṣāliḥāti watawāṣaw bil-ḥaqi watawāṣaw bil-ṣabri

tr.85: except for those who believe, do good deeds, urge one another to the truth, and urge one another to steadfastness.
tr.19: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance.
tr.22: Except such as have Faith, and do righteous deeds, and (join together) in the mutual teaching of Truth, and of Patience and Constancy.
tr.203: Except those who believe (in Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds, and recommend one another to the truth [i.e. order one another to perform all kinds of good deeds (Al-Ma‘ruf) which Allâh has ordained, and abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds (Al-Munkar which Allâh has forbidden], and recommend one another to patience (for the sufferings, harms, and injuries which one may encounter in Allâh’s Cause during preaching His religion of Islâmic Monotheism or Jihâd).

104.en: Woe to every scorner and mocker

tr.85: Woe to every fault-finding backbiter
tr.19: Woe unto every slandering traducer,
tr.22: Woe to every (kind of) scandal-monger and-backbiter,
tr.203: Woe to every slanderer and backbiter.

104.en: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.

tr.85: who amasses riches, counting them over,
tr.19: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
tr.22: Who pileth up wealth and layeth it by,
tr.203: Who has gathered wealth and counted it.

104.en: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.

tr.85: thinking they will make him live for ever.
tr.19: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
tr.22: Thinking that his wealth would make him last for ever!
tr.203: He thinks that his wealth will make him last forever!

104.en: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.

tr.85: No indeed! He will be thrust into the Crusher!
tr.19: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
tr.22: By no means! He will be sure to be thrown into That which Breaks to Pieces,
tr.203: Nay! Verily, he will be thrown into the crushing Fire.

104.en: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?

tr.85: What will explain to you what the Crusher is?
tr.19: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
tr.22: And what will explain to thee That which Breaks to Pieces?
tr.203: And what will make you know what the crushing Fire is?

104.en: It is the fire of Allāh, [eternally] fueled,

tr.85: It is God’s Fire, made to blaze,
tr.19: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
tr.22: (It is) the Fire of (the Wrath of) Allah kindled (to a blaze),
tr.203: The fire of Allâh kindled,

104.en: Which mounts directed at the hearts.

tr.85: which rises over people’s hearts.
tr.19: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
tr.22: The which doth mount (Right) to the Hearts:
tr.203: Which leaps up over the hearts,

104.en: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them

tr.85: It closes in on them
tr.19: Lo! it is closed in on them
tr.22: It shall be made into a vault over them,
tr.203: Verily, it shall be closed upon them,

tr.85: in towering columns.
tr.19: In outstretched columns.
tr.22: In columns outstretched.
tr.203: In pillars stretched forth (i.e. they will be punished in the Fire with pillars).

105.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
105.en: Have you not considered, [O Muḥammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
105.tl: alam tara kayfa faʿala rabbuka bi-aṣḥābi l-fīli

tr.85: Do you [Prophet] not see how your Lord dealt with the army of the elephant?
tr.19: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant?
tr.22: Seest thou not how thy Lord dealt with the Companions of the Elephant?
tr.203: Have you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) not seen how your Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant? [The Elephant army which came from Yemen under the command of Abrahah Al-Ashram intending to destroy the Ka‘bah at Makkah].

105.en: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?

tr.85: Did He not utterly confound their plans?
tr.19: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught,
tr.22: Did He not make their treacherous plan go astray?
tr.203: Did He not make their plot go astray?

105.en: And He sent against them birds in flocks,

tr.85: He sent ranks of birds against them,
tr.19: And send against them swarms of flying creatures,
tr.22: And He sent against them Flights of Birds,
tr.203: And He sent against them birds, in flocks,

105.en: Striking them with stones of hard clay,

tr.85: pelting them with pellets of hard-baked clay:
tr.19: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay,
tr.22: Striking them with stones of baked clay.
tr.203: Striking them with stones of Sijjîl (baked clay).

105.en: And He made them like eaten straw.

tr.85: He made them [like] cropped stubble.
tr.19: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)?
tr.22: Then did He make them like an empty field of stalks and straw, (of which the corn) has been eaten up.
tr.203: And He made them like (an empty field of) stalks (of which the corn has been eaten up by cattle).

106.en: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -

tr.85: [He did this] to make the Quraysh feel secure,
tr.19: For the taming of Qureysh.
tr.22: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
tr.203: (It is a great Grace from Allâh) for the protection of the Quraish,

106.en: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -

tr.85: secure in their winter and summer journeys.
tr.19: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
tr.22: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
tr.203: (And with all those Allâh’s Grace and Protections, We cause) the (Quraish) caravans to set forth safe in winter (to the south) and in summer (to the north without any fear),

106.en: Let them worship the Lord of this House,

tr.85: So let them worship the Lord of this House:
tr.19: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
tr.22: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
tr.203: So let them worship (Allâh) the Lord of this House (the Ka‘bah in Makkah),

106.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
106.en: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
106.tl: alladhī aṭʿamahum min jūʿin waāmanahum min khawfin

tr.85: who provides them with food to ward off hunger, safety to ward off fear.
tr.19: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
tr.22: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
tr.203: (He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.

107.en: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?

tr.85: [Prophet], have you considered the person who denies the Judgement?
tr.19: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion?
tr.22: Seest thou one who denies the Judgment (to come)?
tr.203: Have you seen him who denies the Recompense?

107.en: For that is the one who drives away the orphan

tr.85: It is he who pushes aside the orphan
tr.19: That is he who repelleth the orphan,
tr.22: Then such is the (man) who repulses the orphan (with harshness),
tr.203: That is he who repulses the orphan (harshly),

107.en: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.

tr.85: and does not urge others to feed the needy.
tr.19: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy.
tr.22: And encourages not the feeding of the indigent.
tr.203: And urges not on the feeding of Al-Miskîn (the poor),

107.en: So woe to those who pray

tr.85: So woe to those who pray
tr.19: Ah, woe unto worshippers
tr.22: So woe to the worshippers
tr.203: So woe unto those performers of Salât (prayers) (hypocrites),

107.en: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -

tr.85: but are heedless of their prayer;
tr.19: Who are heedless of their prayer;
tr.22: Who are neglectful of their prayers,
tr.203: Those who delay their Salât (prayer from their stated fixed times).

107.en: Those who make show [of their deeds]

tr.85: those who are all show
tr.19: Who would be seen (at worship)
tr.22: Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
tr.203: Those who do good deeds only to be seen (of men),

tr.85: and forbid common kindnesses.
tr.19: Yet refuse small kindnesses!
tr.22: But refuse (to supply) (even) neighbourly needs.
tr.203: And prevent Al-Mâ‘ûn (small kindnesses like salt, sugar, water).

108.en: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muḥammad], al-Kawthar.

tr.85: We have truly given abundance to you [Prophet]––
tr.19: Lo! We have given thee Abundance;
tr.22: To thee have We granted the Fount (of Abundance).
tr.203: Verily, We have granted you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) Al-Kauthar (a river in Paradise).

108.en: So pray to your Lord and offer sacrifice [to Him alone].

tr.85: so pray to your Lord and make your sacrifice to Him alone––
tr.19: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice.
tr.22: Therefore to thy Lord turn in Prayer and Sacrifice.
tr.203: Therefore turn in prayer to your Lord and sacrifice (to Him only).

108.en: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.

tr.85: it is the one who hates you who has been cut off.
tr.19: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity.
tr.22: For he who hateth thee, he will be cut off (from Future Hope).
tr.203: For he who hates you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم), he will be cut off (from posterity and every good thing in this world and in the Hereafter).

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘Disbelievers:
tr.19: Say: O disbelievers!
tr.22: Say: O ye that reject Faith!
tr.203: Say: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم to these Mushrikûn and Kâfirûn): "O Al-Kafirûn (disbelievers in Allâh, in His Oneness, in His Angels, in His Books, in His Messengers, in the Day of Resurrection, and in Al-Qadar)!

109.en: I do not worship what you worship.

tr.85: I do not worship what you worship,
tr.19: I worship not that which ye worship;
tr.22: I worship not that which ye worship,
tr.203: "I worship not that which you worship,

109.en: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.

tr.85: you do not worship what I worship,
tr.19: Nor worship ye that which I worship.
tr.22: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
tr.203: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.

109.en: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.

tr.85: I will never worship what you worship,
tr.19: And I shall not worship that which ye worship.
tr.22: And I will not worship that which ye have been wont to worship,
tr.203: "And I shall not worship that which you are worshipping.

109.en: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.

tr.85: you will never worship what I worship:
tr.19: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
tr.22: Nor will ye worship that which I worship.
tr.203: "Nor will you worship that which I worship.

109.en: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."

tr.85: you have your religion and I have mine.’
tr.19: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion.
tr.22: To you be your Way, and to me mine.
tr.203: "To you be your religion, and to me my religion (Islâmic Monotheism)."

110.en: When the victory of Allāh has come and the conquest,

tr.85: When God’s help comes and He opens up your way [Prophet],
tr.19: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh
tr.22: When comes the Help of Allah, and Victory,
tr.203: When there comes the Help of Allâh (to you, O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم against your enemies) and the conquest (of Makkah).

110.ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
110.en: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allāh in multitudes,
110.tl: wara-ayta l-nāsa yadkhulūna fī dīni l-lahi afwājan

tr.85: when you see people embracing God’s faith in crowds,
tr.19: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops,
tr.22: And thou dost see the people enter Allah's Religion in crowds,
tr.203: And you see that the people enter Allah’s religion (Islâm) in crowds.

110.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
110.en: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of Repentance.
110.tl: fasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika wa-is'taghfir'hu innahu kāna tawwāban

tr.85: celebrate the praise of your Lord and ask His forgiveness: He is always ready to accept repentance.
tr.19: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy.
tr.22: Celebrate the praises of thy Lord, and pray for His Forgiveness: For He is Oft-Returning (in Grace and Mercy).
tr.203: So glorify the Praises of your Lord, and ask His Forgiveness. Verily, He is the One Who accepts the repentance and Who forgives.

111.en: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.

tr.85: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined! May he be ruined too!
tr.19: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish.
tr.22: Perish the hands of the Father of Flame! Perish he!
tr.203: Perish the two hands of Abû Lahab (an uncle of the Prophet) and perish he!

111.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
111.en: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
111.tl: mā aghnā ʿanhu māluhu wamā kasaba

tr.85: Neither his wealth nor his gains will help him:
tr.19: His wealth and gains will not exempt him.
tr.22: No profit to him from all his wealth, and all his gains!
tr.203: His wealth and his children will not benefit him!

111.en: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame

tr.85: he will burn in the Flaming Fire––
tr.19: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
tr.22: Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
tr.203: He will be burnt in a Fire of blazing flames!

111.en: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.

tr.85: and so will his wife, the firewood-carrier,
tr.19: And his wife, the wood-carrier,
tr.22: His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
tr.203: And his wife, too, who carries wood (thorns of Sa‘dân which she used to put on the way of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, or use to slander him).

111.en: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.

tr.85: with a palm-fibre rope around her neck.
tr.19: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre.
tr.22: A twisted rope of palm-leaf fibre round her (own) neck!
tr.203: In her neck is a twisted rope of Masad (palm fibre).

tr.85: Say, ‘He is God the One,
tr.19: Say: He is Allah, the One!
tr.22: Say: He is Allah, the One and Only;
tr.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "He is Allâh, (the) One.

tr.85: God the eternal.
tr.19: Allah, the eternally Besought of all!
tr.22: Allah, the Eternal, Absolute;
tr.203: "Allâh-us-Samad (السيد الذي يصمد إليه في الحاجات) [Allâh the Self-Sufficient Master, Whom all creatures need, (He neither eats nor drinks)].

112.en: He neither begets nor is born,

tr.85: He begot no one nor was He begotten.
tr.19: He begetteth not nor was begotten.
tr.22: He begetteth not, nor is He begotten;
tr.203: "He begets not, nor was He begotten.

112.en: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

tr.85: No one is comparable to Him.’
tr.19: And there is none comparable unto Him.
tr.22: And there is none like unto Him.
tr.203: "And there is none co-equal or comparable unto Him."

113.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak

tr.85: Say [Prophet], ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak
tr.19: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak
tr.22: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord of the Dawn
tr.203: Say: "I seek refuge with (Allâh), the Lord of the daybreak,

113.en: From the evil of that which He created

tr.85: against the harm in what He has created,
tr.19: From the evil of that which He created;
tr.22: From the mischief of created things;
tr.203: "From the evil of what He has created,

113.en: And from the evil of darkness when it settles

tr.85: the harm in the night when darkness gathers,
tr.19: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense,
tr.22: From the mischief of Darkness as it overspreads;
tr.203: "And from the evil of the darkening (night) as it comes with its darkness; (or the moon as it sets or goes away),

113.en: And from the evil of the blowers in knots

tr.85: the harm in witches when they blow on knots,
tr.19: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft,
tr.22: From the mischief of those who practise secret arts;
tr.203: "And from the evil of those who practise witchcraft when they blow in the knots,

113.en: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."

tr.85: the harm in the envier when he envies.’
tr.19: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth.
tr.22: And from the mischief of the envious one as he practises envy.
tr.203: "And from the evil of the envier when he envies."

114.en: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,

tr.85: Say, ‘I seek refuge with the Lord of people,
tr.19: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
tr.22: Say: I seek refuge with the Lord and Cherisher of Mankind,
tr.203: Say: "I seek refuge with (Allâh) the Lord of mankind,

tr.85: the Controller of people,
tr.19: The King of mankind,
tr.22: The King (or Ruler) of Mankind,
tr.203: "The King of mankind -

tr.85: the God of people,
tr.19: The God of mankind,
tr.22: The God (or Judge) of Mankind
tr.203: "The Ilâh (God) of mankind,

114.en: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -

tr.85: against the harm of the slinking whisperer––
tr.19: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,
tr.22: From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper),-
tr.203: "From the evil of the whisperer (devil who whispers evil in the hearts of men) who withdraws (from his whispering in one’s heart after one remembers Allâh).

114.en: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -

tr.85: who whispers into the hearts of people––
tr.19: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,
tr.22: (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind,-
tr.203: "Who whispers in the breasts of mankind.

114.en: From among the jinn and mankind".

tr.85: whether they be jinn or people.’
tr.19: Of the jinn and of mankind.
tr.22: Among Jinns and among men.
tr.203: "Of jinn and men."
